papers.title: Clinical outcomes were evaluated in 82 dogs with B-cell lymphoma treated with adoptive T-cell therapy following cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, and prednisone chemotherapy.
papers.authors: Westfall TE, Impellizeri JA
papers.abstract: To describe clinical outcomes and adverse events in dogs with B-cell lymphoma treated with adoptive T-cell therapy (ACT) following cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, and prednisone (CHOP) chemotherapy. Medical records of 82 dogs with B-cell lymphoma that received ACT following CHOP chemotherapy between 2017 and 2025 were retrospectively reviewed. Overall survival was defined as the time from lymphoma diagnosis to death from any cause or last follow-up. Post-ACT survival was defined as the time from first ACT infusion to death from any cause or last follow-up. Time to next anti-lymphoma treatment was defined as the time from first ACT infusion to initiation of subsequent lymphoma-directed therapy. Survival outcomes were estimated using Kaplan-Meier analysis. 82 dogs met inclusion criteria. Median overall survival from diagnosis was 660 days (95% CI, 539 to 781 days). Median post-ACT survival was 368 days (95% CI, 261 to 474 days), and median time to next anti-lymphoma treatment was 317 days (95% CI, 284 to 350 days). Adoptive T-cell therapy was generally well tolerated following CHOP chemotherapy. Adverse events occurred in 5% (4 of 82) of dogs; most were grade 1 or 2, with 1 grade 3 event reported. Clinical outcomes varied among dogs with B-cell lymphoma treated with ACT following CHOP chemotherapy. Adoptive T-cell therapy was generally well tolerated, with adverse events reported in 4 of 82 dogs. This study describes clinical outcomes and adverse events in 82 dogs with B-cell lymphoma that received ACT following CHOP chemotherapy. These findings provide clinical data on the use of ACT in this patient population and may inform the design of prospective controlled studies evaluating ACT in canine B-cell lymphoma.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] CHOP 화학요법 후 양자적 T세포 치료(ACT)는 개의 B세포 림프종에서 전반적으로 잘 견디어지며, 진단 후 중앙값 생존 기간 660일을 달성했다.
[방법·수치] 2017~2025년 CHOP 화학요법 후 ACT를 받은 B세포 림프종 개 82마리의 의료기록을 후향적으로 검토했다. 중앙값 전체 생존 기간 660일(95% CI, 539-781일), ACT 후 생존 기간 368일(95% CI, 261-474일), 다음 항림프종 치료까지의 중앙값 시간 317일(95% CI, 284-350일). 부작용은 5%(4/82)에서 발생, 대부분 1-2등급이었으며 3등급 1건만 보고됨.
[임상 적용·한계] CHOP 화학요법 후 ACT는 B세포 림프종 개에서 임상 선택지로 고려될 수 있으나, 후향적 단일 기관 연구로 대조군이 부재하며 향후 전향적 대조군 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Treatment of Canine Atopic Dermatitis: Updated Guidelines From the International Committee on Allergic Diseases of Animals (ICADA).
papers.authors: Mueller RS, Banovic F, Bensignor E, Santoro D, Nuttall T
papers.abstract: Canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) is a genetically, aetiologically, immunologically and clinically complex disease requiring both individualised immediate and long-term management. These updated guidelines from the International Committee on Allergic Diseases of Animals (ICADA) aim to substantially revise previous recommendations by organising treatment according to mechanism-of-action and by distinguishing two therapeutic phases: reactive therapy to resolve existing pruritus and skin lesions, followed by proactive therapy to maintain remission and reduce flares. The literature was reviewed and recommendations are based, where possible, on randomised controlled trials and systematic reviews, with evidence graded using the Strength of Recommendation Taxonomy. The guidelines review skin barrier care, antimicrobial and microbiome-modulating interventions, avoidance of nonallergenic and allergenic flare factors, allergen-specific immunotherapy, and anti-inflammatory, antipruritic and immunomodulatory treatments. Rapid-acting broad-spectrum drugs, particularly glucocorticoids, are recommended for reactive treatment. Janus Kinase (JAK) inhibitors and lokivetmab may be effective depending on lesion type, severity and inflammatory complexity. Secondary infections and flare factors must be addressed. Proactive management essential to prevent repeated cycles of inflammation may include skin barrier support, infection control, allergen avoidance, allergen immunotherapy, topical glucocorticoids, ciclosporin, tacrolimus, lokivetmab or JAK inhibitors, selected according to the patient's disease pattern and response. A number of interventions are suitable for the treatment of cAD. Interventions are neither universally required, interchangeable nor effective in all cases. Treatment selection should take into account efficacy, safety, practicality, cost, the quality-of-life of both dog and owner, and the legal regulations applicable in the country of use.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 아토피성 피부염(cAD)은 복잡한 질환으로 반응치료(기존 소양증과 병변 해결)와 선제치료(관해 유지 및 재발 감소)의 두 단계로 구분하여 치료해야 하며, 치료약제는 작용기전에 따라 선택하고 개별 환자의 질환 양식과 반응에 맞춰야 한다.
[방법·수치] ICADA(국제 동물 알레르기질환 위원회)가 무작위 대조시험과 체계적 고찰을 기반으로 근거등급 분류를 사용하여 지침을 개발했다. 피부장벽 관리, 항미생물제, 미생물군집 조절, 알레르기항원 회피, 알레르기항원 특이면역치료, 항염증·항소양증·면역조절 치료를 검토했으며 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 반응치료는 글루코코르티코이드 같은 광범위 빠른약물을, 선제치료는 JAK 억제제·로키벳맙·사이클로스포린·타크롤리무스 등을 병변 유형·중증도·염증 복잡도에 따라 선택한다. 이차감염과 악화인자 제거가 필수이며, 치료는 효과·안전성·실용성·비용·삶의 질과 국가별 법적 규정을 고려해 개별화해야 한다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Urinary extracellular vesicle microRNA profile in dogs with visceral leishmaniasis: differential expression and exploratory associations with renal Doppler indices and proteinuria.
papers.authors: Guimarães MA, Rebech GT, Ito LTS, Umino GM, Boas JSV
papers.abstract: Canine visceral leishmaniasis (CVL) is a systemic zoonosis caused by Leishmania infantum, for which dogs are the main urban reservoir. Infected dogs may present non-specific clinical signs and, in advanced cases, die of chronic kidney disease. This study evaluated urinary microRNAs (miRNAs) as candidate biomarkers of renal injury in naturally infected dogs. Fifteen dogs were included: five healthy controls and ten untreated dogs at the moderate stage of disease according to the LeishVet guidelines. All dogs underwent clinical and laboratory assessment, renal Doppler ultrasonography, and serological and molecular diagnosis of CVL. The CVL group showed typical clinical signs, including onychogryphosis, lymphadenomegaly, and cutaneous lesions, as well as laboratory abnormalities such as hyperglobulinemia. Ultrasonography revealed increased renal echogenicity and an elevated peak systolic velocity in the left kidney. Urinary extracellular vesicles were isolated for RNA extraction and miRNA sequencing (RNA-Seq), followed by bioinformatic analysis. Twenty-one differentially expressed miRNAs were identified, including three with previously described physiological renal expression: miR-486 and miR-378 (up-regulated) and cfa-let-7f (down-regulated). The differentially expressed miRNAs were correlated with renal Doppler indices and the urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio (UPC). Pearson correlation analyses were performed in the infected group, without correction for multiple comparisons. These exploratory analyses identified six statistically significant associations involving five miRNAs: miR-222 was negatively correlated with the resistive index (RI) of both kidneys; miR-95 was negatively correlated with the RI of the left kidney; miR-221 was negatively correlated with the RI of the right kidney; cfa-let-7a-2 was positively correlated with the RI of the left kidney; and cfa-let-7g was negatively correlated with UPC.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 내장 리슈마니아증(CVL)에서 뇨 중 세포외소낭 miRNA 프로파일이 변화하며, 특히 miR-486, miR-378 상향조절과 cfa-let-7f 하향조절이 관찰되었고, 이들이 신장 도플러 지수 및 단백뇨와 연관성을 보여 신손상의 비침습적 바이오마커 후보로 제시된다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 대조견 5마리와 CVL 중등도 감염견 10마리를 대상으로 임상검사, 신장 도플러 초음파, 혈청/분자 진단 시행 후 뇨 세포외소낭에서 miRNA를 추출하여 RNA-Seq 수행, 21개의 차등발현 miRNA 확인; miR-222는 양쪽 신장의 저항지수(RI)와 음의 상관(P값 제시 없음), cfa-let-7g은 단백뇨-크레아티닌 비(UPC)와 음의 상관.
[임상 적용·한계] CVL 감염견의 신손상 모니터링을 위한 뇨 miRNA의 임상 활용 가능성을 제시하나, 소규모 표본(n=10), 상관분석에 다중비교 보정 미시행, 인과관계 미확립으로 추가 대규모 연구 필요.

papers.title: ST-elevation myocardial infarction in Europe (2022-24): the EuroHeart Acute Coronary Syndromes-Percutaneous Coronary Interventions Programme.
papers.authors: Erlinge D, Batra G, Eriksson N, Bhatty A, Chappel S
papers.abstract: The European Unified Registries on Heart Care Evaluation And Randomized Trials (EuroHeart) collaboration of national registries evaluates contemporary care of common cardiovascular diseases in Europe. This report summarizes care of patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) across 13 countries using EuroHeart Acute Coronary Syndromes-Percutaneous Coronary Interventions registry data. Aggregated data were analysed from national registries in the EuroHeart Acute Coronary Syndromes-Percutaneous Coronary Interventions registry collaboration, expanding from six countries in 2022 to 13 in 2024. Baseline characteristics, acute reperfusion, discharge medications, and in-hospital outcomes were collected for STEMI admissions. Key quality indicators were evaluated. In total, 146 958 STEMI admissions were collected between 2022 and 2024. Mean age across all countries was 65.4 years (lowest and highest individual country mean: 62.0; 69.3); 27.9% were female (18.2; 36.2), 37.8% current smoker (22.4; 58.7), 58.2% had hypertension (42.9; 76.2), 22.5% diabetes (12.8; 35.2), and 8.9% prior heart failure (3.0; 31.2). The proportion of patients reperfused was high [95.0% (90.6; 100)], with radial artery access in 87.6% (73.2; 95.1). Only 63.9% (34.3; 95.5) received reperfusion within 90 min of diagnostic ECG, with large variability between countries. Prescriptions at discharge were high for aspirin [90.3% (83.2; 98.5)], P2Y12 inhibitors [95.1% (92.0; 100.0)], and statins [93.2% (86.5; 97.1)], but lower for ezetimibe [23.4% (12.9; 34.2)] and sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors [32.7% (16.7; 42.3)]. In-hospital mortality was 6.4% (1.6; 9.5). The EuroHeart Acute Coronary Syndromes-Percutaneous Coronary Interventions registry provides continuous monitoring of standards of care for patients with STEMI.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 유럽 13개국의 ST상승 심근경색(STEMI) 환자에서 재관류 치료율은 높으나(95.0%), 90분 이내 재관류는 63.9%에 불과하며, 퇴원 시 에제티미브와 SGLT2 억제제 처방률이 낮아 개선이 필요함.
[방법·수치] 2022-2024년 EuroHeart 급성관동맥증후군-경피관상동맥중재술 레지스트리에서 146,958명의 STEMI 입원 환자를 분석; 평균 연령 65.4세, 여성 27.9%, 고혈압 58.2%, 당뇨 22.5%; 요골동맥 접근 87.6%, 퇴원 시 아스피린 90.3%, P2Y12 억제제 95.1%, 스타틴 93.2%, 원내 사망률 6.4%.
[임상 적용·한계] STEMI 환자의 재관류 성공률 모니터링과 국가 간 질 관리 비교에 유용하며, 90분 문제시간 목표 달성과 고위험 약제(SGLT2 억제제, 에제티미브) 처방 개선의 임상적 필요성을 제시함. 국가 간 큰 편차가 있어 지역별 맞춤 개선 전략 필요.

papers.title: Canine Hypercalcaemia: part 1, Pathophysiology and Causes.
papers.authors: Cardoso M, Ward PM, Ramsey IK
papers.abstract: Hypercalcaemia is an important metabolic abnormality that has been associated with a wide range of conditions in the dog. This paper reviews calcium regulation, the pathophysiological mechanisms leading to increased calcium concentrations and the clinical consequences. It then provides a narrative review of all reported causes of canine hypercalcaemia. Although neoplasia, particularly lymphoma, is the most frequently recognised cause, there are also important endocrine (hyperparathyroidism and hypoadrenocorticism), renal, inflammatory and toxic causes. A second part of this review will focus on the diagnostic approach and the treatment of canine hypercalcaemia in greater detail. The aims of these reviews are to provide an evidence-based summary of the pathogenesis, differential diagnosis and clinical approach to canine hypercalcaemia.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 고칼슘혈증은 종양(특히 림프종), 부갑상선항진증, 부신피질기능저하증, 신장질환, 염증성질환, 독성물질 등 다양한 원인에서 발생하며, 칼슘 조절 메커니즘의 이해가 진단과 치료의 기초를 이룬다.
[방법·수치] 개의 고칼슘혈증 원인에 대한 내러티브 문헌 고찰로, 칼슘 조절 생리와 고칼슘혈증의 병태생리 메커니즘을 종합적으로 검토했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 종양이 가장 흔한 원인이므로 먼저 감별하되, 내분비질환과 염증성질환도 주의 깊게 평가해야 하며, 임상증상과 혈청 칼슘 농도에 따라 적절한 진단 및 치료 전략을 수립해야 한다. 본 고찰은 병태생리 중심이므로 구체적인 진단 및 치료 방법은 2부에서 다룬다.

papers.title: Prospective clinical evaluation of an impaction interference bolt design for intramedullary nail fracture fixation in dogs.
papers.authors: Hanlon J, Kim SE
papers.abstract: To evaluate clinical application and postoperative outcomes of traumatic, long bone fractures repaired using intramedullary nails locked with novel impaction interference design (IID) bolts. Dogs presented with traumatic long bone fractures amenable to intramedullary nail fixation were consecutively enrolled between July 2023 and December 2025. Intramedullary nails were implanted and stabilized using IID bolts in all patients enrolled. Surgery time, bolt implantation complications, drilling accuracy, adjunct fracture fixation, and nail modifications were recorded. Fracture alignment, nail parameters, bolt seating and cortical occupation, cortical evaluation, time to radiographic union, bolt related or other complications, lameness at the time of union and bolt palpation sensitivity were recorded postoperatively. 13 dogs totaling 14 fractures (10 femur and 4 tibia) were enrolled with median subject age and weight of 18 months and 26.1 kg, respectively. Adjunct fixation was utilized in 4 cases. No bolt implantation complications were encountered. Median surgical time was 105 minutes and complete bolt seating and bicortical bolt engagement was observed in 54 of 55 bolts and 53 of 55 bolts, respectively. The drilling accuracy was 100% and no cortical bone damage was appreciated at any site. All cases achieved radiographic union at a median time of 8.5 weeks with no evidence of bolt loosening, no bolt palpation sensitivity and subjectively acceptable return to function. IID bolts were safely implanted and offer an alternative mechanism for angle-stable intramedullary nailing with good clinical outcomes.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 새로운 impaction interference design(IID) bolt를 사용한 골수내 못 고정은 안전하게 식립되며 각도 안정성을 제공하고 양호한 임상 결과를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 2023년 7월~2025년 12월 장골 골절 13두 14예(대퇴골 10예, 경골 4예)에 대해 IID bolt로 고정한 전향적 임상 평가 연구이며, 중앙 수술 시간 105분, bolt 완전 식립 54/55예(98.2%), 양측 피질골 engagement 53/55예(96.4%), drilling 정확도 100%, 방사선학적 유합까지 중앙 8.5주, bolt 이완 및 촉진 감응성 없음을 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] IID bolt는 기존 골수내 못 고정의 대안이 될 수 있으나, 단일 기관의 소규모 연구이고 중기 추적 관찰 결과로서 장기 성적 평가와 더 많은 환자군에서의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Technical note on fenestrated clamp-guided hand-sewn ileocolic functional end-to-end anastomosis during subtotal colectomy in cats: Description and clinical application in 12 cases.
papers.authors: Yamada E, Okamoto Y
papers.abstract: This Technical Note describes a fenestrated clamp-guided method (FCGM) for hand-sewn ileocolic functional end-to-end anastomosis (FEEA) and its clinical application in 12 client-owned cats with idiopathic megacolon undergoing subtotal colectomy. The technique uses a fenestrated intestinal clamp to maintain parallel intestinal alignment and guide common-channel creation. A continuous seromuscular suture layer was placed before full-thickness enterotomy through the clamp fenestration, followed by two-layer closure of the common opening and intraoperative hydrostatic leak testing. Postoperative outcomes were evaluated through postoperative day 180. The FCGM was completed as planned in all 12 cats without conversion to another anastomotic technique, and no major complications were identified during follow-up. Initial leak testing showed no leakage in 10/12 cats. In the remaining 2/12 cats, leakage near the center of the closure line of the common opening resolved after placement of one additional interrupted Lembert suture in each cat. No leakage from the cut edges of the common channel was detected. Soft-formed or formed feces were observed in 12/12 cats by postoperative day 30. Constipation recurred in 3/12 cats and was managed medically without revision surgery. In this case series, the FCGM was feasible and may provide a practical means of maintaining intestinal alignment and guiding common-channel creation during hand-sewn ileocolic FEEA in cats undergoing subtotal colectomy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 창 있는 클램프 유도 방법(FCGM)을 이용한 손수 회맹장 기능적 단단 문합은 특발성 거대결장증 고양이의 전체 결장절제술에서 실행 가능하며, 모든 증례에서 계획된 대로 완료되었고 추적 관찰 중 주요 합병증이 없었다.
[방법·수치] 특발성 거대결장증으로 전체 결장절제술을 받은 12마리 고양이를 대상으로 했다. 창이 있는 장 클램프로 장 정렬을 유지하고 공통 채널 생성을 유도했으며, 연속 장막근층 봉합 후 전층 장절개를 시행하고 2층 폐쇄 및 수술 중 정수압 누수 검사를 실시했다. 초기 누수 검사에서 12/12마리 중 10마리에서 누수가 없었고, 2/12마리에서는 추가 Lembert 봉합으로 해결되었다. 술 후 30일까지 12/12마리 모두에서 정상 또는 약간 무른 대변이 관찰되었으나, 3/12마리에서 변비가 재발하여 약물 치료로 관리했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 이 기법은 고양이의 회맹장 기능적 단단 문합 시 장 정렬 유지와 공통 채널 생성을 위한 실용적인 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 그러나 12마리의 소규모 증례 시리즈이며 장기 추적 관찰 자료가 제한적이고, 단일 기관 경험에 기반한 연구라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Electromyographic evaluation and response to electrical stimulation of the cricoarytenoideus dorsalis muscle in dogs with idiopathic laryngeal paralysis.
papers.authors: Colón-Acevedo CS, Hardie RJ, Rylander H
papers.abstract: To describe the electromyographic (EMG) activity and the responsiveness to direct electrical stimulation of the cricoarytenoideus dorsalis (CAD) muscle in dogs with idiopathic laryngeal paralysis (LP). Prospective clinical study. A total of 10 adult client-owned dogs with idiopathic LP and four young adult Beagles (reference dogs). A standardized anesthetic protocol was used. A left lateral approach to the larynx was performed, and the left CAD muscle was exposed. The endotracheal tube was temporarily removed. Electromyography and electrical stimulation of the CAD muscle was performed. Stimulation ranged from 2 to 20 mA and was progressively increased in 2 mA increments. Response of the left arytenoid cartilage was recorded using a video laparoscope. Response to electrical stimulation was categorized as "yes" or "no". The "yes" responses were further categorized as "weak," "strong," or "excessive" based on a subjective grading system. All LP dogs had EMG changes consistent with denervation of the CAD muscle including fibrillation potentials and positive sharp waves. All reference dogs had normal EMGs. All LP and reference dogs had a "yes" response to stimulation. Stimulation levels of 6-14 mA produced the most "strong" responses in the LP dogs based on our grading system. The CAD muscle in dogs with LP has the ability to respond to electrical stimulation despite EMG changes consistent with denervation. The results of this study provide the foundation for future investigation of the use of laryngeal pacemakers for the treatment of idiopathic LP in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 특발성 후두마비에서 윤상피열배근(CAD)은 신경퇴행성 변화(활동전위, 양성예리파)를 보이지만 직접 전기자극에 반응할 수 있는 능력을 유지하고 있으며, 이는 향후 후두심박조율기 치료 개발의 기초를 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 특발성 후두마비 성견 10두와 대조군 비글 4두에서 표준화된 마취 프로토콜 하에 좌측 윤상피열배근을 노출하고 근전도 검사 및 2~20 mA의 전기자극을 2 mA씩 증가시키며 수행했다. 모든 후두마비 개는 신경퇴행성 변화를 보였고, 모든 대조군은 정상 근전도를 나타냈으며, 6~14 mA에서 가장 강한 반응을 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 후두마비 개에서 근육의 반응성이 유지되어 있으므로 전기자극 기반 치료법 개발이 가능할 것으로 예상되나, 소규모 전향적 연구이고 임상 치료 효과를 직접 입증하지 못했으며 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Postoperative complications and long-term incisional outcomes after a three-pointed star abdominal incision in dogs: A retrospective case series of 104 procedures in 102 dogs.
papers.authors: Asano K, Ishigaki K, Negishi A, Hayakawa T, Iida K
papers.abstract: To describe short-term incision-related outcomes and 1-year incisional status after a three-pointed star abdominal incision in dogs. Retrospective case series. A total of 102 client-owned dogs undergoing 104 three-pointed star incision procedures. Medical records were reviewed for incision-related findings from surgery through skin suture removal or the last wound examination. Exploratory univariable analyses evaluated associations between delayed healing/skin dehiscence and selected variables. One-year incisional status was assessed using medical records or telephone follow-up. Four dogs died within three postoperative days, leaving 100 evaluable procedures in 98 dogs. Erythema (57%) and ecchymosis (54%) were most frequent. Delayed healing/skin dehiscence occurred after 12 procedures (12%). Six of the 12 wounds with delayed healing/skin dehiscence required re-suturing. No evaluated variable was significantly associated with this outcome. No clinically apparent incisional hernia was identified after 85 procedures in 84 dogs with confirmed 1-year status. In 15 postoperative intervals ending in death before 1 year, no incisional dehiscence or hernia was documented during available follow-up (median, 143 days; range: 20-345 days). Delayed healing/skin dehiscence was documented after 12% of evaluable procedures, and no clinically apparent incisional hernia was identified among dogs with confirmed 1-year assessment. These findings provide descriptive short-term and 1-year incision-related outcome estimates for this approach. Prospective comparative studies are needed to determine relative morbidity, postoperative pain, and optimal indications.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 삼각별 모양 복부절개술은 단기 합병증으로 홍반(57%)과 반상출혈(54%)이 주로 발생했으며, 12%에서 지연된 치유/피부열개가 발생했으나 1년 추적에서 임상적으로 명백한 절개부 탈장은 관찰되지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 102마리 개(104건의 절개술)를 대상으로 한 후향적 사례 연구로, 수술부터 피부봉합 제거 또는 최종 상처 검사까지 절개 관련 소견을 검토했으며, 1년 절개부 상태는 의료기록 또는 전화 추적으로 평가했다. 평가 가능한 100건 중 지연된 치유/피부열개는 12건(12%), 이 중 6건은 재봉합이 필요했으며, 85건(1년 확인)에서 임상적 탈장은 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 삼각별 절개술은 단기적으로 비교적 안전한 절개법으로 보이나, 후향적 소규모 연구이고 비교 대상 절개술이 없으며 통증 평가가 부재하다. 최적의 적응증 결정과 상대적 이환율 비교를 위해 전향적 비교 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Process, Heterogeneity, and Modifiable Risk Factors of Postoperative Recovery After Cardiac Surgery.
papers.authors: Sun R, Jiao Z, Chen S, Rao C, Zhao Y
papers.abstract: Cardiac surgery improves clinical endpoints but imposes challenges in recovery. Understanding patient-reported postoperative recovery is crucial for optimal care. The goal of this study was to reveal the process, heterogeneity, and modifiable risk factors of patient-reported postoperative recovery. In this multicenter prospective cohort study involving patients undergoing nonemergent cardiac surgery, patient-reported outcomes were assessed using the Fuwai-Cardiac Recovery Scale (a 9-item scale including symptoms and functional status) at baseline and 8 timepoints after surgery (days 1-4, weeks 2 and 3, and months 1 and 3). Total score and each item score of the Fuwai-Cardiac Recovery Scale were reported to characterize the recovery process. Group-based trajectory models were applied to detect heterogeneity, and trajectory with the largest area under trajectory curve was defined as poor recovery pattern. Multivariable stepwise regression was performed to uncover modifiable risk factors of poor recovery. From May 2023 to December 2024, 2,993 patients from 8 Chinese centers were enrolled. The proportions of patients achieving a total score ≤30 (less likely to experience 3-month unplanned readmission) were 77.4% at discharge (week 2) and 97.7% at month 3. Areas under the curve of the item score within 2 weeks, ranked from highest to lowest, were thirst, toileting dependency, poor mobility, fatigue, pain, poor sleep, poor appetite, shortness of breath, and nausea or vomiting. Three different poor recovery patterns were identified: 1) "initial worsening followed by improving" in shortness of breath, poor appetite, nausea or vomiting, poor sleep, and pain; 2) "persistently not improving" in thirst; and 3) "slowly improving" in fatigue, poor mobility, and toileting dependency.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심장수술 후 회복은 시간에 따라 진행되는 역동적 과정이며 환자 간 이질성이 크고, 조기 인식과 중재를 위한 기회를 제공한다. 흡연, 비만, 빈혈이 수정 가능한 위험인자로 확인되었다.
[방법·수치] 중국 8개 센터의 2,993명 대상 전향적 다기관 코호트 연구로, Fuwai-Cardiac Recovery Scale(9개 항목)을 수술 후 1-4일, 2-3주, 1-3개월에 평가했다. 총점 ≤30(3개월 미계획 재입원 가능성 낮음)을 달성한 환자는 퇴원 시 77.4%, 3개월 시 97.7%였다. 흡연(호흡곤란, OR: 1.55), 비만(운동성 저하, OR: 1.52), 빈혈(식욕부진 OR: 1.47, 피로 OR: 1.36)이 불량 회복의 위험인자였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 회복 궤적의 이질성 파악으로 고위험 환자를 조기 선별하고 개인화된 중재가 가능하다. 중국 단일 지역 다기관 연구이고 비응급 수술 환자만 포함하여 응급 수술이나 다른 지역 적용성에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Diastolic dysfunction in adults with congenital heart disease.
papers.authors: Ratwatte S, Miranda WR, Valente AM, El Sayed M, Elgamal SM
papers.abstract: Diastolic dysfunction is a major determinant of cardiovascular symptoms, quality of life, and overall prognosis in adults with acquired heart disease. The global burden of disease is increasing, and substantial progress has been made in developing standardized multimodality approaches for the assessment of left ventricular diastolic function. In adults with congenital heart disease (ACHD) diastolic dysfunction is substantially more prevalent than in the general population; however, it remains comparatively under-investigated, under-diagnosed, and under-treated. Assessment is complicated by the marked heterogeneity of this population, including the influence of underlying anatomy, prior surgical interventions, and residual haemodynamic lesions on ventricular filling physiology. Consequently, a 'one-size-fits-all' approach or direct extrapolation of guidelines from acquired heart disease is often inappropriate. This state-of-the-art review summarized the current evidence and contemporary approaches to the assessment and management of diastolic dysfunction in ACHD, highlighting the strengths and limitations of available diagnostic modalities. In addition, lesion-specific considerations and practical diagnostic and management frameworks are proposed to evaluate and treat diastolic dysfunction across the spectrum of ACHD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 성인 선천성 심장질환 환자에서 이완기 기능 부전은 일반인보다 훨씬 높은 유병률을 보이지만 과소진단되고 과소치료되고 있으며, 기존의 후천성 심장질환 가이드라인을 직접 적용하기에는 부적절하다.
[방법·수치] 성인 선천성 심장질환(ACHD) 환자에서 이완기 기능 부전의 평가 및 관리에 대한 현황 검토 논문으로, 기저 해부학적 구조, 선행 수술 및 잔존 혈역학적 병변이 심실 충만 생리에 미치는 영향을 고려한 다중영상 접근법의 표준화된 평가 방법 검토; 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] ACHD 환자의 질환 특이적 이완기 기능 부전 평가를 위해 환자의 근본적인 해부학적 특성을 고려한 맞춤형 진단 및 치료 프레임워크 제시가 필요하며, 현재까지 단일 가이드라인 적용의 한계가 있어 병변 특이적 고려사항이 중요함.

papers.title: Macrophage CD40 signalling inhibition improves cardiac function after myocardial infarction by limiting fibroblast activation.
papers.authors: Lang A, Ampem G, Witkowski S, Wernet C, Duplessis AJ
papers.abstract: Myocardial infarction (MI) triggers a dynamic immune response transitioning through inflammatory, reparative, and fibrotic phases. While CD40L-CD40 signalling is central to immune activation, its role in macrophage-driven fibrosis post-MI remains poorly understood. Plasma soluble (s)CD40L was determined in patients with ST-segment elevation MI (STEMI; n = 360). Left ventricular (LV) function was quantified by cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) at 5 days and 6 months post-MI. In a murine model of reperfused MI, CD40-TRAF6 signalling was inhibited using TRAF-STOP. LV function was assessed by echocardiography. Cardiac fibrosis was analysed histologically and by qPCR. Cardiac cells were profiled by scRNA-/CITE-seq, flow cytometry, and spatial transcriptomics. Predicted key cell-cell interactions were recapitulated in vitro. In STEMI patients, sCD40L peaked 5 days post-admission and was associated with scar size, LV remodelling, and re-hospitalization at 6 months. In mice, a CD40+SPP1+ macrophage population with pro-fibrotic marker expression (e.g. Fn1, Nampt, Spp1) emerged transiently at Day 5 post-MI and co-localized with activated fibroblasts. TRAF-STOP treatment initiated 5 days post-MI reduced CD40+SPP1+ macrophage abundance, attenuated fibrotic gene expression, limited scar formation, and improved LV function. In co-culture experiments, TRAF-STOP ameliorated pro-fibrotic macrophage signalling and macrophage-mediated fibroblast activation. In STEMI patients, elevated plasma sCD40L at Day 5 post-MI is associated with larger scar size, impaired LV function, adverse remodelling, and an increased rate of re-hospitalization at 6 months. Mechanistically, this is driven by a transient CD40+SPP1+ macrophage population emerging during the reparative phase of MI that is targetable by CD40-TRAF6 inhibition to limit fibrosis and preserve LV function.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심근경색 후 CD40-TRAF6 신호 경로를 통한 대식세포의 활성화가 심실 재형성과 섬유화를 유도하며, TRAF-STOP으로 이를 억제하면 좌심실 기능이 개선된다.
[방법·수치] STEMI 환자 360명에서 혈장 sCD40L을 측정하고 심자기공명영상으로 좌심실 기능을 평가했으며, 마우스 재관류 심근경색 모델에서 TRAF-STOP 투여 후 심초음파, 조직학, qPCR, scRNA-seq, 공동배양 실험을 수행했다. 환자에서 sCD40L은 입원 5일째 최고조에 달했고 흉터 크기, 좌심실 재형성, 6개월 재입원과 연관됐으며, 마우스에서 TRAF-STOP 치료는 CD40+SPP1+ 대식세포를 감소시키고 섬유화 유전자 발현을 약화시켰다.
[임상 적용·한계] 심근경색 초급성기(5일째) 혈장 sCD40L 측정이 예후 예측 바이오마커로 활용 가능하며, CD40-TRAF6 경로 차단이 섬유화 제한 치료 표적이 될 수 있다. 다만 환자 연구는 관찰 연구이고 마우스 모델 결과의 임상 번역 가능성은 추가 임상시험으로 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Cysteinyl leukotriene profiles in obstructive and non-obstructive feline lower urinary tract disease.
papers.authors: Bayendur SH, Tunç AC, Dinçer PFP, Saraçlı S, Acar A
papers.abstract: Feline lower urinary tract disease is a complex syndrome characterized by high recurrence rates, and standard treatments targeting the cyclooxygenase pathway often lack efficacy. This suggests that alternative inflammatory mechanisms are involved in the pathology. This study aimed to investigate the role of the 5-lipoxygenase pathway and its byproducts, cysteinyl leukotrienes, along with the pro-inflammatory cytokine interleukin-18, in the pathophysiology of obstructive and non-obstructive feline lower urinary tract disease phenotypes. Serum and urine samples from 60 male cats (20 obstructive, 20 non-obstructive, and 20 healthy controls) were analyzed. Both disease phenotypes showed significantly elevated serum and urinary concentrations of leukotrienes and interleukin-18 compared to the healthy controls. The obstructive group exhibited a massive localized inflammatory burden, characterized by significantly higher urinary leukotriene and interleukin-18 levels. In contrast, the non-obstructive group presented a more prominent systemic inflammatory load, highlighted by elevated serum leukotriene B4 concentrations. An explainable artificial intelligence classification model achieved an 85 percent overall accuracy in differentiating the clinical phenotypes. The model identified elevated urinary interleukin-18 as the primary predictor for obstructive cases, and increased serum leukotriene B4 as the key indicator for non-obstructive cases. The 5-lipoxygenase pathway is concurrently activated and serves as a critical driver within the inflammatory cascade of feline lower urinary tract disease. While these robust findings pave the way for future interventional trials, comprehensive longitudinal research remains essential to definitively isolate their exact cellular origins and fully establish their clinical translation.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 하부요로질환의 폐쇄성과 비폐쇄성 표현형 모두에서 5-리폭시게나제 경로와 시스테이닐 류코트리엔, 인터루킨-18이 활성화되며, 폐쇄성은 국소 염증(뇨 염증매개물 증가), 비폐쇄성은 전신 염증(혈청 류코트리엔B4 증가)이 우세함을 규명했다.
[방법·수치] 60마리 수컷 고양이(폐쇄성 20마리, 비폐쇄성 20마리, 건강 대조군 20마리)의 혈청과 뇨 샘플을 분석했다. 질병군 모두에서 류코트리엔과 인터루킨-18이 대조군 대비 현저히 증가했으며, 인공지능 분류 모델의 정확도는 85%였다. 폐쇄성은 뇨 인터루킨-18이 주요 예측인자, 비폐쇠성은 혈청 류코트리엔B4가 주요 지표였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 사이클로옥시게나제 경로를 표적하는 표준 치료에 반응이 없는 고양이 하부요로질환 환자에서 5-리폭시게나제 경로 억제제 개발의 근거를 제공하며, 폐쇄성과 비폐쇄성 표현형을 구분하는 바이오마커로 활용 가능하다. 그러나 염증매개물의 세포 기원과 임상 번역을 위해서는 종단 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Right Ventricular Reverse Remodeling Without Pulmonary Vascular Unloading During Sotatercept Therapy: An Invasive Pressure-Volume Loop Study.
papers.authors: Kremer N, Lemay SE, Valasarajan C, Thal BR, Harth S
papers.abstract: Sotatercept improves hemodynamics and functional capacity in pulmonary arterial hypertension; however, its direct actions on the right ventricle (RV) remain poorly understood. We investigated whether sotatercept exerts intrinsic RV protective effects beyond pulmonary vascular unloading. In this registry-based cohort study, 28 consecutive patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension between April 2024 and September 2025 underwent right-heart catheterization with conductance-catheter RV pressure-volume analysis and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging before sotatercept initiation and again after a median of 6.1 months of treatment. Hemodynamic nonresponse was defined as a decrease in mean pulmonary arterial pressure by <10%. Reproducibility was tested in 2 independent sotatercept-treated cohorts (SPECTRA [Sotatercept Phase 2 Exploratory Clinical Trial in Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension], n=20, cardiac magnetic resonance; Cologne, n=20, echocardiography). Among 28 patients (17 [61%] female; median age, 48 [IQR, 34-67] years), 21 (75%) were responders and 7 (25%) nonresponders. In responders, sotatercept significantly decreased mean pulmonary arterial pressure (52.0 [IQR, 49.0-65.0] to 39.0 [IQR, 32.0-42.0] mm Hg; P<0.001) and pulmonary vascular resistance (10.7±3.9 to 6.7±2.3 Wood units; P<0.001) without changing cardiac output, reduced RV end-diastolic volume (222 [IQR, 183-242] to 160 [IQR, 129-204] mL; P<0.001) and RV mass (42.8 [IQR, 33.6-56.0] to 33.1 [IQR, 28.2-44.4] g; P<0.001), and improved 6-minute walk distance by +64 m (95% CI, 27 to 102; P=0.002). Ventricular-arterial coupling (end-systolic/arterial elastance) improved although load-independent contractility decreased alongside the decrease in effective arterial elastance. By contrast, nonresponders demonstrated a clinical-hemodynamic disconnect.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소타터셉트는 폐혈관 언로딩 없이도 우심실의 역리모델링(질량 및 용적 감소)을 유도하며, 이는 심근에 대한 직접 보호 효과를 시사한다. 혈역학 반응자에서만 운동 능력이 개선되었다.
[방법·수치] 폐동맥 고혈압 환자 28명을 대상으로 소타터셉트 투여 전후(중앙값 6.1개월)에 도관 카테터를 이용한 우심실 압력-용적 분석을 수행했다. 반응자(n=21, 75%)에서 평균 폐동맥압 52→39 mmHg(P<0.001), 폐혈관저항 10.7→6.7 Wood units(P<0.001) 감소, 우심실 용적 222→160 mL(P<0.001), 우심실 질량 42.8→33.1 g(P<0.001) 감소, 6분 보행거리 +64 m(P=0.002) 개선. 비반응자(n=7, 25%)에서는 폐혈관저항이 지속적으로 상승했음에도 우심실 질량 56.1→46.4 g(P=0.003) 감소(운동능력 개선 없음).
[임상 적용·한계] 소타터셉트의 우심실 보호 효과는 폐혈관 언로딩과 독립적이므로, 혈역학 비반응자에서도 구조적 개선이 기대된다. 그러나 운동 능력 개선은 혈역학 반응자에만 한정되어 임상 예후와의 관계 규명이 필요하다. 단일 기관 소규모 연구(n=28)로 추적 기간이 짧으며 검증 코호트의 영상 방식 차이가 있다.

papers.title: Description of a transtemporal surgical approach to the mandibular coronoid process region in two dogs with oral pain.
papers.authors: Pang YY, Hertel B, Logothetou V
papers.abstract: Conditions affecting the mandibular coronoid process and surgical approaches to it are rarely described in veterinary medicine. We describe and illustrate an alternative surgical approach to the mandibular coronoid process in two dogs. Two dogs presented with a chronic history of pain while opening the mouth. Computed tomography identified unilateral contrast-enhancing soft tissues around the proximal mandibular coronoid process. The mandibular coronoid process in each dog was approached via a transtemporal muscular approach dorsal to the zygomatic arch, without the need for a zygomatic osteotomy. This allowed access to both the proximal medial and lateral aspects of the mandibular coronoid process. A foreign body was surgically identified in one case, whereas no foreign material was retrieved in the other. Both dogs were free of clinical signs up to 6 months postoperatively. The described technique provided a less invasive approach, resulting in reduced tissue damage, reduced postoperative pain and rapid recovery.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 하악 관상돌기 주변 병변에 대해 광대뼈 골절단 없이 측두근 접근법(transtemporal muscular approach)을 통해 안전하게 접근 가능하며, 이 기법은 조직 손상을 최소화하고 빠른 회복을 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 개 2마리에서 개입 개구 시 만성 동통을 보였고, CT상 하악 관상돌기 근위부 주변에 조영증강되는 연부조직이 확인되었다. 광대뼈궁 배측의 측두근을 통한 경측두 접근법으로 관상돌기의 근위 내측 및 외측에 접근했으며, 1례에서는 이물질이 적출되었고 다른 1례에서는 적출할 이물질이 없었다. 술후 6개월까지 임상증상이 완전히 소실되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 하악 관상돌기 병변에 대한 진료 시 광대뼈 골절단을 피하면서도 양측 접근이 가능한 유용한 술식이다. 그러나 증례 수가 2례로 매우 제한적이고, 술기의 안전성과 효과를 평가하기 위해서는 더 많은 증례 축적이 필요하다.

papers.title: Evaluation of the association of serum paraoxonase-1 and butyrylcholinesterase activities with ultrasonographic gastrointestinal changes in dogs with acute pancreatitis.
papers.authors: Cordon B, Tvarijonaviciute A, Soler M, Agut A
papers.abstract: Gastrointestinal ultrasonographic (USGI) abnormalities are frequently detected in dogs with acute pancreatitis (AP), but their relationship with systemic biochemical changes has not been well studied. This retrospective study evaluated the association between serum paraoxonase-1 (PON1) and butyrylcholinesterase (BChE) activities and the presence and severity of USGI abnormalities in dogs with AP. The medical records of dogs diagnosed with AP between January 1, 2017, and January 1, 2026, were reviewed. Dogs were included if a clinical examination, laboratory testing and abdominal ultrasonography were performed within a 6-hour period. Gastrointestinal ultrasonographic findings were graded using the Ultrasonographic Gastrointestinal Assessment Severity Score (UGASS) developed for this study. Fifty-seven dogs met the inclusion criteria, and 35 of them (61.4%) showed USGI abnormalities, with the stomach being the most frequently affected segment. Dogs with USGI changes had significantly lower serum PON1 and BChE activities than those without USGI abnormalities (p < 0.05), although considerable overlap in individual values was observed between groups. PON1 activity was not significantly correlated with UGASS, whereas BChE activity showed a moderate negative correlation with UGASS (r = -0.460, p = 0.005). Serum PON1 and BChE activities were positively correlated (r = 0.340, p = 0.009). In conclusion, USGI abnormalities were common in dogs with AP and were associated with lower serum PON1 and BChE activities. Only BChE activity correlated significantly with the severity of USGI abnormalities, as assessed using the UGASS.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 급성 췌장염 개에서 위장관 초음파 이상소견이 있는 경우 혈청 PON1과 BChE 활성도가 유의하게 낮았으며, 특히 BChE 활성도만이 위장관 초음파 중증도와 중등도의 음의 상관관계를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 2017년 1월~2026년 1월 급성 췌장염 진단 개 57마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구이며, 6시간 이내에 임상검사·혈액검사·복부초음파를 시행한 35마리(61.4%)에서 위장관 초음파 이상소견이 발견되었다. USGI 이상 군에서 PON1과 BChE 활성도 모두 유의하게 낮았고(p<0.05), BChE 활성도는 UGASS와 중등도의 음의 상관관계를 보였다(r=-0.460, p=0.005). PON1과 BChE는 양의 상관관계를 나타냈다(r=0.340, p=0.009).
[임상 적용·한계] 급성 췌장염 개에서 혈청 BChE 활성도 측정이 위장관 초음파 중증도 평가의 보조지표로 활용될 수 있으나, 개별 수치 간 상당한 겹침이 관찰되어 단독 진단도구로는 제한적이다. 단일기관 후향적 연구이고 샘플 크기가 제한적이다.

papers.title: RECOVER CPR Guidelines: Preparedness and Prevention. Updated Evidence, Recommendations, Knowledge Gap Analysis, and Clinical Guidelines for Veterinary CPR Teams.
papers.authors: McMichael MA, Herring J, Burkitt-Creedon JM, Hoehne SN, Fletcher DJ
papers.abstract: To systematically review the evidence on, update existing and create new recommendations for, and identify critical knowledge gaps regarding veterinary resuscitation team communication, composition, and training. Standardized, systematic evaluation of literature pertinent to veterinary CPR team or "resuscitation team" communication, composition, and training, following the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation methodology. Identified evidence pertinent to prioritized topical questions posed in Population-Intervention-Comparator-Outcome (PICO) format was reviewed by Evidence Evaluators; findings were reconciled by Domain Chairs and Reassessment Campaign on Veterinary Resuscitation Initiative Co-Chairs to arrive at recommendations commensurate with the certainty of evidence, risk-benefit analysis, and perceived feasibility. This process was implemented using a standardized Evidence Profile Worksheet for each question that included an introduction, consensus on science, recommendations, justification of recommendations, and knowledge gaps sections. Recommendations underwent a 4-week comment period among international veterinary stakeholders prior to finalization. Transdisciplinary, international collaboration in university, specialty, and emergency practice. Five PICO questions on resuscitation team composition, communication, and team training were addressed in this paper. Of the seven recommendations formulated, two took the form of recommendations ("strong" recommendations) and five were suggestions ("weak" recommendations), all supported by low-certainty (one recommendation) or very low-certainty (six recommendations) evidence. Taken together, recommendations pertain to optimal team composition, structured training, and communication. The limited evidence supports a resuscitation team size of 4-8 rescuers led by an experienced veterinary rescuer.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 수의 심폐소생술팀의 최적 구성은 경험 있는 리더가 이끄는 4-8명의 구조자이며, 표준화된 팀 훈련과 팀원 간 체계적 소통이 권장된다.
[방법·수치] GRADE 방법론을 따른 체계적 문헌 검토로 팀 구성, 소통, 훈련에 관한 5개의 PICO 질문을 다루었다. 7개 권고안 중 2개는 강한 권고(1개 저확실도 근거), 5개는 약한 권고(6개 매우 저확실도 근거)로 도출되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 적용 시 CPR팀 구성 최적화와 표준화 훈련 프로토콜 도입이 필요하나, 대부분의 질문에서 수의 임상 결과 데이터가 부재하며 개와 고양이에서 팀 준비성이 실제 CPR 수행과 결과를 개선하는지 입증하는 추가 연구가 필수적이다.

papers.title: Retrospective Evaluation of Injury Severity, Use of Blood Products, and Surgical Intervention in 293 Dogs With Gunshot Wounds: A VetCOT Registry Study (2017-2024).
papers.authors: Bleuet JVN, Davros AM, Brainard BM
papers.abstract: To evaluate injury severity scores and outcomes in dogs with gunshot wounds (GSWs) and to assess the use of blood products and surgical interventions in this population. Retrospective evaluation of veterinary trauma registry data. Veterinary Committee on Trauma (VetCOT)-identified veterinary trauma centers. A total of 293 canine trauma patients suffering from GSWs with data entered in the VetCOT trauma registry from April 1, 2017, to October 1, 2024. Variables evaluated included injury severity scores (Animal Trauma Triage [ATT], modified Glasgow Coma Scale [mGCS]), point-of-care ultrasound findings (pleural/abdominal effusion), surgical intervention and location of surgery (operating room vs. emergency room), blood products transfused, and survival outcome. Nonsurvivors had significantly higher ATT scores and lower mGCS scores. Surgery, performed in 51% of cases, was associated with improved survival and greater likelihood of transfusion. Presence of pleural effusion was associated with decreased survival and increased likelihood of transfusion, while abdominal effusion was not. In multivariable analysis, higher ATT scores and surgery independently predicted transfusion, although higher ATT scores were inversely associated with surgery. This is the largest multicenter study on canine GSWs to date, demonstrating that dogs with higher ATT scores and lower mGCS scores were less likely to survive and more likely to receive a blood transfusion. Surgical intervention was associated with improved survival and lower ATT scores, suggesting that dogs undergoing surgery may have had less severe injuries or injuries more amenable to anatomic correction. Transfusion and surgery were closely associated, likely as a result of greater injury severity. These findings underscore the need for future prospective studies to better understand the impact of transfusions and long-term outcomes in dogs with gunshot injuries.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 총상 외상견에서 높은 ATT 점수와 낮은 mGCS 점수는 생존율 감소와 연관되었으며, 수술적 개입은 생존율 향상과 연관되었다.
[방법·수치] 2017년 4월부터 2024년 10월까지 VetCOT 외상 레지스트리에 등록된 총상 외상견 293례를 후향적으로 평가했다. 51%에서 수술을 시행했으며, 수술군에서 생존율 향상 및 수혈 가능성 증가가 관찰되었다. 흉강 삼출액 존재는 생존율 감소 및 수혈 가능성 증가와 연관되었으나, 복강 삼출액은 유의한 연관성이 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] ATT 및 mGCS 점수를 활용한 중증도 평가와 조기 수술 개입이 총상 외상견의 치료 결정에 도움이 될 수 있다. 그러나 이 연구는 후향적 분석이며, 수술 여부에 따른 초기 중증도 차이 가능성과 수혈의 장기 예후에 미치는 영향을 명확히 하기 위한 전향적 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Preliminary Investigation of Ilunocitinib Versus Prednisolone for the Management of Atopic Dermatitis in Client-Owned Dogs: A Double-Blind, Randomised Comparative Study.
papers.authors: Menegon FG, Risse SD, Lima ACC, Gmyterco VC, Ludwig LA
papers.abstract: Canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) is a chronic, inflammatory and pruritic skin disease characterised by skin barrier dysfunction and T-cell dysregulation. Ilunocitinib, a nonselective Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor, is a promising therapeutic option for the control of cAD. To perform a preliminary comparison of the clinical efficacy and safety of ilunocitinib and prednisolone in cAD. Twenty dogs with cAD were randomly allocated into two experimental groups (n = 10 each). Group 1 received oral prednisolone at 0.5-1 mg/kg every 24 h for 7 days, followed by every 48 h for 7 days, and subsequently every 72 h for 45 days. Group 2 received oral ilunocitinib at 0.6-0.8 mg/kg every 24 h for 60 days. Clinical evaluations were performed on Day D0, D7, D15, D30 and D60, including physical examination and scoring for pruritus (via pruritus Visual Analog Scale [pVAS]), lesions (via Canine Atopic Dermatitis Extent and Severity Index, 4th iteration [CADESI-4]) and otitis (via 0-3 Otitis Index Score [OTIS-3]). Median pVAS decreased from 9 to 4.5 in Group 1 and from 9.5 to 2.5 in Group 2. Median CADESI-4 scores decreased from 40 to 17 in Group 1 and from 35.5 to 5.5 in Group 2. Differences between groups were observed for pVAS on D7 and D60 and for CADESI-4 on D15 and D60. Prednisolone was associated with increased fibrinogen and triglyceride concentrations, while dogs treated with ilunocitinib showed eosinopenia. In this preliminary study, daily use of ilunocitinib was associated with improvements in pruritus and skin lesions, supporting its potential role in the management of cAD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] JAK 억제제인 일루노시티닙은 프레드니솔론과 비교하여 개의 아토피성 피부염에서 가려움증과 피부병변 개선에 더 효과적이며, 임상 관리에서의 잠재적 역할을 지지한다.
[방법·수치] 아토피성 피부염을 가진 개 20마리를 두 그룹(각 10마리)으로 무작위 배정하여 이중맹검 비교연구 수행. 프레드니솔론군은 0.5-1 mg/kg을 60일간 감량 투여, 일루노시티닙군은 0.6-0.8 mg/kg을 60일간 매일 투여. 가려움증(pVAS)은 프레드니솔론군에서 9→4.5로, 일루노시티닙군에서 9.5→2.5로 감소. CADESI-4 점수는 프레드니솔론군에서 40→17로, 일루노시티닙군에서 35.5→5.5로 감소(D15, D60에서 유의차).
[임상 적용·한계] 일루노시티닙은 프레드니솔론의 고용량 감량 필요성을 피하면서 더 우수한 가려움증 완화를 제공할 수 있으나, 소규모 예비연구로서 더 큰 규모 임상시험 필요. 프레드니솔론은 피브리노겐 및 중성지방 증가를 보였으며 일루노시티닙은 호산구감소증을 나타냄.

papers.title: NR6A1 Drives Cardiac Remodeling by Transcriptionally Activating the Mineralocorticoid Receptor.
papers.authors: Zhang Z, Zhuang H, Chang X, Chen T, Zhao X
papers.abstract: Activation of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) and mineralocorticoid receptor (MR/NR3C2) signaling is a central driver of pathologic cardiac remodeling and heart failure (HF). The transcriptional regulation of NR3C2 and the amplification of RAAS-driven cardiac remodeling remain poorly understood. Transcriptome and single-cell RNA sequencing data, along with HF samples from humans and mice, were used for gene expression analysis. Cardiomyocyte-specific Nr6a1 transgenic (Nr6a1-cTG) and knockout (Nr6a1-cKO) mice were subjected to transverse aortic constriction to evaluate cardiac remodeling and dysfunction. Adeno-associated virus 9-shNr3c2 was used to test whether Nr3c2 contributes to remodeling driven by Nr6a1 overexpression. Primary mouse cardiomyocytes were used for in vitro analysis. RNA sequencing, Western blot, chromatin immunoprecipitation, and luciferase assays were performed for the mechanism analysis. NR6A1 (nuclear receptor subfamily 6, group A, member 1) expression was increased in the heart tissue from human and mouse failing hearts. Activation of NR6A1 contributed to the hypertrophic growth of cardiomyocytes in vitro. In mice, a cardiomyocyte-specific Nr6a1 transgene aggravated left ventricular dysfunction, hypertrophy, and fibrosis after transverse aortic constriction, whereas a cardiomyocyte-specific Nr6a1 knockout protected the heart from failure and remodeling. Transcriptome analysis of NR6A1 downstream transcriptional targets revealed that Nr3c2 is a prominent RAAS-related downstream target in both hearts and cardiomyocytes. The transcription cofactor NR6A1 directly bound the Nr3c2 promoter, increased promoter activity, and enhanced Nr3c2 transcription in cardiomyocytes. Nr3c2 silencing attenuated NR6A1-associated cardiomyocyte hypertrophy in vitro and reduced cardiac dysfunction and hypertrophy in Nr6a1-cTG mice after transverse aortic constriction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] NR6A1은 심부전 시 미네랄로코르티코이드 수용체(MR/NR3C2)의 전사를 직접 활성화하며, 안지오텐신II/AT1R 신호에 의해 STAT1 의존적으로 증가하여 레닌-앙기오텐신-알도스테론계(RAAS)의 피드포워드 증폭 메커니즘을 형성한다.
[방법·수치] 심부전 환자 및 마우스 심장 조직, 심근세포 특이적 Nr6a1 과발현(Nr6a1-cTG) 및 knockout(Nr6a1-cKO) 마우스를 대동맥궁협착(transverse aortic constriction) 모델에 적용하여 평가했으며, RNA 염기서열 분석, 크로마틴 면역침전, 루시퍼라제 분석을 통해 메커니즘을 검증했다. NR6A1 발현은 인간 및 마우스 심부전 심장에서 증가되었고, Nr6a1 knockout은 심부전과 심실 재형성으로부터 보호하는 반면 과발현은 좌심실 기능부전, 비대 및 섬유화를 악화시켰다(수치 제시 없음).
[임상 적용·한계] NR6A1-MR/NR3C2 축은 RAAS 경로의 새로운 치료 표적이 될 수 있으며, MR 길항제와 함께 NR6A1 억제가 지속적인 MR 활성화를 보이는 심부전 치료에 활용될 수 있다. 그러나 동물 모델 중심의 연구로 인간 임상 적용까지는 추가 임상시험이 필요하다.

papers.title: VAD Wean Recovery Network: Long-Term Outcomes of LVAD Weaning for Myocardial Recovery.
papers.authors: Patel SR, Potapov E, Kanwar M, Sun B, Selzman CH
papers.abstract: Myocardial recovery facilitated by the combination of a left ventricular assist device (LVAD) and guideline-directed medical therapy can lead to sufficient myocardial improvement. This in turn may allow LVAD weaning in appropriately selected patients with chronic advanced heart failure. However, sufficient data on the long-term outcomes of this therapeutic strategy are lacking, thereby hindering widespread adoption of LVAD weaning. We present the primary results from the VAD Wean Myocardial Recovery International Network examining long-term outcomes after LVAD weaning for myocardial recovery. We studied 603 patients with chronic advanced heart failure from 60 international centers who underwent LVAD weaning. Preimplantation, LVAD cardiac recovery assessment, and postweaning patient characteristics and outcomes were analyzed. The primary outcome was event-free survival (free of heart transplantation or re-LVAD) in the weaned-for-recovery cohort. The LVAD-weaned cohort had a mean age of 42±15 years; 33% were female; and 9.4% had ischemic cardiomyopathy. At LVAD implantation, 88% had Intermacs (Interagency Registry for Mechanically Assisted Circulatory Support) profiles 1 to 3, and 41.6% required temporary mechanical circulatory support. Median LVAD support duration was 440 days (interquartile range, 261-770) before weaning. At the time of weaning, median left ventricular ejection fraction was 50% (interquartile range, 45%-57.5%), and left ventricular internal diastolic diameter was 48 mm (interquartile range, 43-53 mm). One-year survival after weaning was 91%, with 2.3% requiring re-LVAD and 3.7% requiring heart transplantation. In a secondary exploratory matched analysis against LVAD bridge-to-transplantation recipients from the International Society for Heart and Lung Transplantation registry, long-term survival was similar between groups.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 적절히 선별된 만성 고도 심부전 환자에서 LVAD 지지 하에 심근 회복을 달성한 후 LVAD 제거 시 우수한 장기 생존율을 보였으며, 이는 심장이식 연결 전략과 유사한 장기 생존을 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 60개 국제 센터에서 LVAD 제거 대상 만성 고도 심부전 환자 603명을 분석했다. 평균 연령 42±15세, 여성 33%, 허혈성 심근병증 9.4%였으며, LVAD 지지 기간 중앙값 440일이었다. 제거 시점의 좌심실 박출률 중앙값 50%, 좌심실 내경 이완기 직경 48mm였다. 제거 후 1년 생존율 91%, 재LVAD 필요 2.3%, 심장이식 필요 3.7%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] LVAD 제거를 통한 심근 회복 전략이 선별된 환자에서 효과적임을 시사하며, 현재 과소이용되는 LVAD 심근 회복 전략의 임상 적용 확대를 뒷받침한다. 다만 국제 멀티센터 관찰 연구로 선별 편향이 있을 수 있으며, 추가 전향적 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair for Severe Isolated Tricuspid Regurgitation After Extended Follow-Up: The TRI-FR Randomized Clinical Trial.
papers.authors: Donal E, Dreyfus J, Leurent G, Nejjari M, Auffret V
papers.abstract: Transcatheter tricuspid edge-to-edge repair (T-TEER) improves symptoms and health status at 1 year in patients with severe tricuspid regurgitation, but its association with clinical events during longer follow-up remains uncertain. This secondary analysis reports extended follow-up of TRI-FR (URL: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov; Unique identifier: NCT04646811), a prospectively registered, multicenter randomized trial comparing T-TEER plus optimized medical therapy (OMT) with OMT alone in patients with severe symptomatic tricuspid regurgitation. In total, 300 patients were randomized (152 to T-TEER plus OMT and 148 to OMT alone). Prespecified analyses included time to first heart failure hospitalization (HFH), tricuspid surgery, or cardiovascular death using cause-specific Cox proportional-hazards models and recurrent HFH using the Lin-Wei-Yang-Ying model. A 12-month landmark analysis included patients alive and under follow-up at 12 months. During a median follow-up of 30.8 months (75th percentile, 41.0; maximum, 56.4), 101 HFHs (17 fatal), 5 additional cardiovascular deaths, and 11 tricuspid surgeries were recorded. Among 81 patients with a first composite event, T-TEER plus OMT reduced the risk versus OMT alone (hazard ratio, 0.56 [95% CI, 0.36-0.88]; P=0.0109). Cardiovascular death or tricuspid surgery did not differ significantly (hazard ratio, 0.75 [95% CI, 0.33-1.71]; P=0.4911). T-TEER plus OMT reduced recurrent HFH (Lin-Wei-Yang-Ying rate ratio, 0.52 [95% CI, 0.32-0.84]; P=0.0073). In the 12-month landmark cohort (n=276), T-TEER plus OMT was associated with lower risks of a first composite event (hazard ratio, 0.40 [95% CI, 0.23-0.70]; log-rank P=0.0009) and recurrent HFH (Lin-Wei-Yang-Ying rate ratio, 0.44 [95% CI, 0.23-0.83]; P=0.0120). Severe or greater tricuspid regurgitation at the last core laboratory assessment was present in 6.77% with T-TEER plus OMT and 53.5% with OMT alone (P<0.0001).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경카테터 삼첨판 절제술(T-TEER)과 최적의약물치료(OMT)를 병용한 환자는 OMT 단독 치료 환자에 비해 중앙추적기간 30.8개월 동안 첫 복합사건(심부전 입원, 삼첨판 수술, 심혈관 사망)의 위험도가 유의하게 감소했다.
[방법·수치] 300명의 중증 증상성 삼첨판역류 환자를 무작위 배정(T-TEER+OMT군 152명, OMT 단독군 148명)하여 비교한 다기관 무작위대조시험으로, 중앙추적기간 30.8개월(최대 56.4개월) 동안 평가했다. T-TEER+OMT군이 첫 복합사건 위험도 감소(위험비 0.56, 95% CI 0.36-0.88, P=0.0109), 반복적 심부전 입원 감소(rate ratio 0.52, P=0.0073)를 나타냈으며, 마지막 평가에서 심각도 이상의 역류 발생은 T-TEER+OMT군 6.77% vs OMT 단독군 53.5%(P<0.0001)였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 중증 증상성 삼첨판역류 환자의 장기 임상 관리에서 경카테터 절제술은 약물치료 단독보다 심부전 입원과 역류 악화를 효과적으로 예방하는 치료 옵션으로 고려할 수 있다. 다만 심혈관 사망이나 추가 수술 필요성에는 유의한 차이가 없었으며, 단기 임상 개선 이후 장기 추적 데이터의 축적이 필요하다.

papers.title: Clinical efficacy of cordycepin in feline upper respiratory infection: A randomized trial.
papers.authors: Li J, Xu G, Zhang K, Zhang J, Guo Z
papers.abstract: Presenting predominantly with upper airway, oral, and ocular anomalies, feline upper respiratory infection (FURI) is highly pervasive among cat populations. Given its substantial morbidity and tendency to trigger severe secondary conditions like pneumonia, it persists as a formidable hurdle in feline medicine. We investigated the therapeutic impact of cordycepin, a major active component of Cordyceps militaris, on the clinical progression and physiological recovery of cats with FURI. Our data revealed that oral administration of cordycepin over 14 days significantly mitigated respiratory symptoms, reduced systemic inflammation, re-established redox equilibrium and regulated the relative abundance of various bacteria, specifically a substantial reduction in the relative abundance of Staphylococcus. Metagenomic analysis and correlation Analysis with host defense factors further highlighted that the decline in Staphylococcus was significantly associated with increased levels of host defense factors, including IgA, CAT, and GSH-Px, as well as lower clinical scores. Collectively, cordycepin confers multi-faceted protection by synergistically dampening inflammation, mitigating oxidative stress, bolstering host immunity, and modulating microbial ecosystems. These findings underscore its translational potential, positioning cordycepin as a highly viable and promising therapeutic candidate for the clinical management of feline upper respiratory infections.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 14일간의 경구 코디셉핑 투여는 고양이 상기도감염(FURI)의 호흡기 증상을 유의하게 완화하고, 전신 염증 감소, 산화환원 균형 회복, 특히 황색포도상구균의 상대적 풍도를 감소시켰으며, 이러한 개선이 IgA, CAT, GSH-Px 등 숙주방어인자 증가와 임상점수 저하와 연관되었다.
[방법·수치] 무작위배정 시험으로 고양이 상기도감염 모델에서 코디셉핑의 치료 효과를 평가했으며, 메타게노믹 분석 및 상관분석을 통해 황색포도상구균 감소와 숙주방어인자 증가 간의 유의한 연관성을 확인했으나 구체적인 수치(감소율, P값 등)는 제시되지 않음.
[임상 적용·한계] 항염증, 항산화, 면역증강, 미생물생태계 조절의 다중 기전을 통해 고양이 상기도감염의 임상 관리에 활용 가능한 치료제 후보를 제시했으나, 초록만으로는 대조군 설정, 표본 규모, 통계적 유의성 등 상세 정보 부족으로 임상 적용 판단에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Effects of laparoscopic vertical sleeve gastrectomy on weight and glucose regulation in a feline obesity model.
papers.authors: Buote NJ, Loftus JP, Reuter MA, Dakin G, Cummings BP
papers.abstract: To determine the safety and impact of laparoscopic vertical sleeve gastrectomy (LVSG) on bodyweight and glucose regulation in an obese feline model. Prospective experimental study. Seven adult cats. After obesity induction, an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) was performed, with blood glucose, insulin, and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) measured before surgery, at 1 and 6 months postoperatively. A LVSG was performed, and surgical data were recorded. After LVSG, bodyweight was monitored, and any postoperative complications and outcomes were recorded for 6 months. The surgical procedure took a median of 75 min (interquartile range [IQR] 55-78.5). No cats experienced intra- or postoperative complications, and all cats were adopted. All cats lost weight after the LVSG procedure, with significant differences between preoperative obesity weight and two postoperative time points (the 6-month timepoint p = .006) and the weight at adoption (p = .047). No significant differences were found between the pre-obesity induction weight and the 6-month weight (p > .9) or the weight at adoption (p = .69). There was no change in glucose tolerance after LVSG, but GLP-1 secretion increased at 1 month (p = .031) and insulin secretion increased at 6 months (p = .046) after surgery. LVSG was safe and effective for weight loss in this obesity-induced experimental feline model. Despite unchanged blood glucose levels after LVSG, enhanced GLP-1 secretion and increased insulin secretory capacity suggest possible improved metabolic regulation after surgery. Future studies on LVSG could be considered to determine the effects on weight loss in clinically obese cats or glucose regulation in diabetic cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 복강경 수직 소매 위절제술(LVSG)은 비만 고양이 모델에서 안전하며 유의미한 체중 감소를 달성했고, 혈당은 변화 없었으나 GLP-1 분비 증가(1개월)와 인슐린 분비 증가(6개월)로 대사 조절 개선 가능성을 시사했다.
[방법·수치] 비만 유도된 성묘 7마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 실험 연구; 수술 시간 중앙값 75분(IQR 55-78.5); 술 전후 경구 포도당 내성검사(OGTT) 시행; 6개월 추적 관찰 결과 체중 감소(p=.006), GLP-1 분비 1개월 후 증가(p=.031), 인슐린 분비 6개월 후 증가(p=.046); 술 중·술 후 합병증 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 비만 고양이의 체중 감소 치료 및 당뇨병 고양이의 대사 조절 개선에 적용 가능성이 있으나, 소규모 실험 연구(n=7)이고 단일 모델 시스템으로 임상 비만 고양이에서의 효과 검증이 필요하며 장기 추적 데이터 부족.

papers.title: Evaluation of post-occlusion hepatofugal blood flow on surgeon decision making during ligation of portosystemic shunts in 53 dogs.
papers.authors: Ray SE, Folk CA, Bechtold MA, Center SA, Flanders JA
papers.abstract: To determine whether hepatofugal contrast flow or caudal vena cava (CdVC) contrast filling during post-occlusion intraoperative mesenteric portovenography (PO-IOMP) were associated with the degree of extrahepatic portosystemic shunt (EHPSS) ligation performed. Retrospective observational cohort study. A total of 53 dogs. Data were collected retrospectively for dogs that underwent suture ligation of a single EHPSS with concurrent intraoperative mesenteric portovenography (IOMP). Review of IOMP studies was performed in a blinded manner by a single author. Logistic regression was used to evaluate associations between PO-IOMP interpretations and the degree of EHPSS ligation selected by the primary surgeon. Identified associations were further investigated using a multivariable model to control for confounding variables. Complete ligation was performed in 37/53 dogs (69.8%), partial ligation in 13/53 (24.5%), and no ligation in 3/53 (5.7%). Hepatofugal contrast flow during PO-IOMP was identified in 21/53 dogs (39.6%). Dogs with hepatofugal contrast flow during PO-IOMP were more likely to have undergone incomplete ligation (partial or none) when controlling for confounding variables (odds ratio [OR] 7.06, 95% CI: 1.49-33.44, p = .014). Absence of CdVC filling during PO-IOMP was identified in 11/53 dogs (20.8%). No association was identified between dogs lacking CdVC filling during PO-IOMP and incomplete EHPSS ligation (OR 1.43, 95% CI: 0.35-5.79, p = .617). Non-responsive postoperative portal hypertension was identified in 2/53 dogs (3.8%), both necessitating euthanasia. Hepatofugal contrast flow on PO-IOMP was associated with the decision to perform incomplete EHPSS ligation. The identification of post-occlusion hepatofugal contrast flow may aid in patient-specific EHPSS ligation decision making.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 폐쇄 후 간외향 혈류(hepatofugal contrast flow)가 술중 장간막 문맥조영술에서 관찰되면 외간문맥단락의 불완전 결찰을 시행할 가능성이 7배 증가하며, 이는 외간문맥단락 결찰 정도 결정에 중요한 영상 소견입니다.
[방법·수치] 외간문맥단락 단일 결찰을 받은 개 53마리의 후향적 관찰 코호트 연구로, 술중 문맥 폐쇄 후 장간막 문맥조영술 영상을 맹검 검토했습니다. 완전 결찰 37마리(69.8%), 부분 결찰 13마리(24.5%), 비결찰 3마리(5.7%)였으며, 간외향 혈류는 21마리(39.6%)에서 관찰되었고 불완전 결찰과의 연관성은 OR 7.06(95% CI: 1.49-33.44, p=0.014)이었습니다.
[임상 적용·한계] 술중 폐쇄 후 간외향 혈류 소견은 각 환자별 맞춤형 결찰 결정에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 단일 기관 후향적 소규모 연구이고 외간문맥단락 완전 결찰이 항상 필요한지 부분 결찰의 임상적 결과가 동등한지에 대한 추가 평가가 필요합니다.

papers.title: Environmental noise and cardiometabolic health: a transatlantic perspective.
papers.authors: Münzel T, Osborne MT, Basner M, Röösli M, Angell SY
papers.abstract: Environmental noise is a pervasive but under-recognized cardiovascular and metabolic risk factor. Drawing on prior expert reviews and large-scale epidemiologic and mechanistic studies, this review synthesizes evidence on the burden, major clinical associations, biological pathways, vulnerable populations, and mitigation strategies relevant to cardiovascular health. Road traffic noise is consistently and dose-dependently associated with higher risks of ischaemic heart disease, stroke, heart failure, diabetes, sleep disturbance, and adverse mental health outcomes, whereas for railway and aircraft noise, the evidence base is less consistent, although important associations are increasingly reported. Translational human imaging studies, controlled exposure experiments, and animal models converge on a common pathway in which chronic and intermittent noise exposure activates stress-responsive neural circuits, increases sympathetic and hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis activity, promotes oxidative stress, endothelial dysfunction, and vascular inflammation, and may thereby accelerate cardiometabolic disease. Noise frequently co-occurs with air pollution, heat, and adverse social and built environments, particularly in socioeconomically disadvantaged communities, and these combined exposures may contribute additively to cardiovascular risk. These effects are especially relevant in urban populations with nighttime exposure and multiple co-exposures. Despite this growing evidence base, environmental noise remains largely absent from contemporary cardiovascular risk assessment tools, prevention guidelines, and routine patient counselling, representing a missed opportunity for risk reduction. Effective mitigation will require a hierarchical strategy combining source reduction, health-informed urban and transport planning, and targeted individual protection.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 환경소음은 심혈관 및 대사질환의 과소평가된 위험요인으로, 특히 도로교통소음이 허혈성심질환, 뇌졸중, 심부전, 당뇨병, 수면장애와 용량-반응 관계로 일관되게 연관되어 있으며, 철도 및 항공기 소음도 중요한 연관성이 보고되고 있다.
[방법·수치] 대규모 역학연구, 중개 인체영상 연구, 대조군 노출 실험, 동물모델을 종합한 체계적 고찰이다. 만성 및 간헐적 소음노출은 스트레스 반응 신경회로 활성화, 교감신경 및 시상하부-뇌하수체-부신축 활동 증가, 산화스트레스, 내피기능장애, 혈관염증을 유발하는 공통 경로를 통해 심대사질환을 가속화하며, 대기오염, 열, 사회경제적 취약 환경과 복합 노출될 경우 심혈관 위험이 가산적으로 증가한다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 현재 심혈관 위험평가도구, 예방지침, 임상상담에서 환경소음이 거의 반영되지 않고 있어 위험감소의 기회를 놓치고 있다. 음원감소, 보건기반 도시 및 교통계획, 개인보호를 포함한 위계적 중재전략이 필요하다. 역학 연구 기반이므로 인과관계 확립에 추가 임상 증거가 필요하고, 개인 보호 방법의 효과 크기에 대한 구체적 수치가 부족하다.

papers.title: Intra-arterial vinblastine is well tolerated for the treatment of urothelial cell carcinomas and prostatic carcinomas in dogs.
papers.authors: Vigouroux O, Horton A, O'Keeffe J, Letwin L, McLauchlan G
papers.abstract: To describe the treatment and outcome for dogs with lower urinary tract carcinoma or prostatic carcinoma treated with intra-arterial vinblastine. 14 client-owned dogs from a single private referral center identified through a search of the medical records as having either urothelial cell carcinoma (n = 8) or prostatic carcinoma (6) treated with intra-arterial vinblastine from September 1, 2016, through September 30, 2023. The most commonly reported clinical signs were pollakiuria, stranguria, and hematuria alone or in combination. Median duration of clinical signs prior to vinblastine treatment was 5 weeks (range, 1 to 18 weeks). Median body weight and age at intra-arterial vinblastine treatment were 14.85 kg (range, 5.7 to 33.5 kg) and 8 years (range, 6 to 11 years). There were 9 castrated males and 5 spayed females. Vinblastine was successfully administered via the internal iliac arteries in all cases. Clinical outcome was reported in 10 dogs: 9 improved, and 1 had stable clinical signs. Restaging was available for 8 dogs, of which 2 of 8 were classified as having partial response, 4 of 8 stable disease, and 2 of 8 progressive disease. Intra-arterial vinblastine was well tolerated in dogs in this study and may contribute to rapid clinical improvement. Intra-arterial vinblastine shows promise in treating urothelial cell carcinoma and prostatic carcinoma in dogs; however, additional research is needed.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 요로상피세포암종과 전립선암종에 대한 동맥 내 빈블래스틴 치료는 잘 견디어지며 임상적 개선에 기여할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 단일 민간 종양 전문 센터에서 2016년 9월~2023년 9월 사이 요로상피세포암종(8마리) 또는 전립선암종(6마리)으로 동맥 내 빈블래스틴 치료를 받은 개 14마리를 대상으로 한 의료기록 검색 연구이며, 중앙 체중 14.85kg, 중앙 나이 8세, 거세수컷 9마리와 중성화 암컷 5마리였고, 치료 전 임상증상 중앙 지속 기간은 5주(1~18주)였으며, 임상 결과가 보고된 10마리 중 9마리는 개선, 1마리는 안정적 증상을 보였고, 재검사 가능한 8마리 중 부분관해 2마리, 안정질환 4마리, 진행성질환 2마리였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 동맥 내 빈블래스틴은 모든 경우에 내장골동맥을 통해 성공적으로 투여되었으며 급속한 임상 개선에 기여할 수 있으나, 단일 기관의 소규모 증례 보고이므로 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Prophylactic paracostal gastropexy in a canine.
papers.authors: Garland M, Grimes JA
papers.abstract: To demonstrate a paracostal approach for prophylactic gastropexy in a dog. A healthy client-owned canine was used for demonstration, with informed client consent. The surgical site is clipped and aseptically prepared from cranial to the last rib to mid-abdomen on the right ventrolateral side. The skin is incised caudal and parallel to the 13th rib. The abdominal musculature is identified and transected to open the abdominal cavity. The pyloric antrum is identified, and stay sutures are placed at the dorsal and ventral aspects from the stomach to the transversus abdominis. A 4-cm seromuscular incision is created in the pyloric antrum. The seromuscular layer of the stomach is sutured to the transversus abdominis muscle using 2-0 long-lasting absorbable suture on a taper needle in a simple continuous pattern. This is performed on both the caudal and cranial aspects. The internal and external abdominal oblique muscles are closed in 2 layers using 2-0 absorbable suture in a simple continuous pattern followed by routine closure of the subcutaneous tissues and skin. Using NSAIDs if appropriate, the patient is discharged from the hospital with instructions for incision monitoring, exercise restriction, and an e-collar or surgisuit. This procedure will prevent future gastric dilation and volvulus. Prophylactic gastropexies are indicated for deep-chested canines at risk for gastric dilation and volvulus. This paracostal approach allows for gastropexy to be performed through a smaller incision than the ventral midline approach.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 늑골곁(paracostal) 접근법을 이용한 예방적 위고정술은 위팽대-염전증 고위험 견에서 미래의 위팽대-염전증을 예방할 수 있으며, 복부 정중선 접근법보다 더 작은 절개로 수술을 수행할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 개를 대상으로 한 술식 시연 연구로, 13번째 늑골 뒤쪽 복부 측면에 4cm의 위수장막근층 절개를 만들고, 2-0 흡수성 봉합사를 이용하여 위의 수장막근층을 복횡근에 단순 연속 봉합하는 방식으로 시행하였다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 가슴이 깊은 견에서 위팽대-염전증 고위험군에 대한 예방적 위고정술의 적응증이 있으며, 복부 정중선 접근법 대비 더 작은 절개로 수술할 수 있다는 장점이 있다. 단일 증례 시연 연구로 술식의 안전성 및 장기 추적 결과 데이터가 부족하다.

papers.title: Infections following dental extractions in dogs are rare both with and without antimicrobial therapy based on a 10-year retrospective study.
papers.authors: Volk A, Goldschmidt S, Park L, Soltero-Rivera M, Blandino A
papers.abstract: To report postoperative local infection rates in dogs undergoing dental extractions with versus without antimicrobial treatment. Medical records were reviewed for dogs undergoing dental extractions at a single institution between 2014 and 2024. Use of prophylactic antimicrobials and presence of postoperative infection were recorded. The impact of different risk factors on the presence of infection was assessed with logistic regression. The number needed to treat to prevent infection in 1 dog was calculated with inverse absolute risk reduction. Antimicrobial usage was common, with 62.8% (573 of 913) of dogs receiving antimicrobials. The overall rate of postoperative infections was 0.66% (6 of 913 dogs). Patients prescribed an antimicrobial had decreased odds (OR, 0.16) of postoperative infection (0.2% with and 1.5% without). However, 76 patients (95% CI, 30 to 399 patients) had to be treated unnecessarily with prophylactic antimicrobials to prevent infection in a single patient. Neither the number of extractions nor the severity of periodontal disease increased the odds of infection; rather, they were protective (OR, 0.1 to 0.2). No other risk factors were significantly associated with infection rate. All patients with identified infection at the postoperative recheck had resolution of infection with appropriate treatment. Both perioperative and postoperative extraction complications were rare, at 5.4% and 4.9% of visits, respectively. Postoperative infection is rare with dental extractions, regardless of the number of extractions, the severity of periodontal disease, or antimicrobial use. This study provides evidence against the use of antimicrobial prophylaxis during dental extractions in immunocompetent dogs. Rather, treatment is recommended in the rare case that surgical site infections occur.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 치아 발거 후 술후감염은 항균제 사용 여부와 관계없이 매우 드물며(전체 0.66%), 면역능이 정상인 개에서는 예방적 항균제 사용이 권장되지 않음.
[방법·수치] 2014~2024년 단일 기관 후향적 의료기록 검토, 913마리 개 대상; 항균제 사용군 0.2% vs 미사용군 1.5% 감염률(OR 0.16), 감염 1건 예방을 위해 76마리를 불필요하게 항균제로 치료해야 함(95% CI 30~399); 발거 개수, 치주질환 심도는 오히려 보호인자(OR 0.1~0.2); 술중·술후 합병증 각각 5.4%, 4.9%.
[임상 적용·한계] 면역능 정상 개의 치아 발거에서 예방적 항균제 투여는 비용-효과 측면에서 부정적이며, 술후감염 발생 시에만 치료적 항균제 사용 권장; 단일기관 후향적 연구로 선택편향 가능성 있고 면역저하 개는 제외됨.

papers.title: Diamond burr debridement with bandage contact lens placement may be a minimally invasive treatment option for selected cats with superficial corneal sequestra.
papers.authors: Ahn J, Kim G, Seo K, Kang S
papers.abstract: To evaluate the clinical outcomes of diamond burr debridement (DBD) combined with bandage contact lens (BCL) placement for treatment of feline corneal sequestra (FCS). Medical records of client-owned cats diagnosed with superficial FCS and treated with DBD and BCL between October 1, 2022, and April 1, 2026, were retrospectively reviewed. Diamond burr debridement was performed under topical anesthesia using a handheld diamond burr, followed by BCL placement. Clinical assessments included lesion width, epithelial healing rate, recurrence, and postprocedural corneal opacity. Correlations between lesion characteristics and outcomes were analyzed using the Spearman ρ test. 17 cats (17 eyes) met the inclusion criteria. Mean age was 8.0 ± 3.0 years (range, 3 to 14 years), and 13 of 17 (76.4%) were brachycephalic breeds. Complete corneal epithelialization occurred in 14 of 17 eyes at 2 weeks and in 3 of 17 eyes at 4 weeks after procedure. Blepharospasm, epiphora, and conjunctival hyperemia resolved in all cats. Recurrence occurred in 4 eyes (23.5%). Spearman correlation analysis revealed a positive correlation between lesion size and recurrence (ρ = 0.684). Lesion size was negatively correlated with the presence of a BCL at recheck (ρ = -0.502), and recurrence was negatively correlated with the presence of a BCL at recheck (ρ = -0.523). DBD with BCL placement may be considered as a minimally invasive treatment option in carefully selected cats with superficial FCS. Superficial keratectomy remains the gold-standard treatment for FCS. Careful assessment of lesion depth and strict case selection are essential when considering DBD, particularly because deeper stromal involvement may require complete sequestrum removal and structural repair.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 다이아몬드 버 박리술과 밴드 콘택트렌즈 병용은 선택된 고양이의 표재성 각막 격자체(FCS)에 대한 최소침습적 치료 옵션이 될 수 있으며, 17안 중 14안(82.4%)이 2주 내 완전한 각막상피화를 달성했다.
[방법·수치] 2022년 10월~2026년 4월 표재성 FCS로 진단받고 다이아몬드 버 박리술과 밴드 콘택트렌즈로 치료받은 고양이 17마리(17안)의 의무기록을 후향적 검토. 평균 연령 8.0±3.0세, 76.4%(13/17)가 단두종. 완전 상피화는 2주에 14안, 4주에 3안에서 달성. 재발률 23.5%(4/17), 병변 크기와 재발 간 양의 상관(ρ=0.684), 병변 크기와 재검 시 렌즈 존재 간 음의 상관(ρ=-0.502), 재발과 렌즈 존재 간 음의 상관(ρ=-0.523).
[임상 적용·한계] 표재성 FCS에서 다이아몬도 버 박리술은 신중한 증례 선별 시 최소침습적 선택지가 될 수 있으나, 각막층 깊이 평가와 엄격한 케이스 선별이 필수적이고, 더 깊은 기질 침범은 완전 격자체 제거 및 구조 복구가 필요할 수 있으며, 표층각막절제가 여전히 금표준 치료. 후향적 단일기관 소규모 연구로 대규모 전향적 연구 필요.

papers.title: Serum aldosterone concentrations in Cavalier King Charles Spaniels across ACVIM stages of myxomatous mitral valve disease and their associations with echocardiographic indices.
papers.authors: Lewicki M, Kumiega E, Wojtczak Z, Noszczyk-Nowak A
papers.abstract: Myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD) is common in Cavalier King Charles Spaniels (CKCS) and may involve activation of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS). This study evaluated serum aldosterone concentrations across ACVIM MMVD stages in CKCS and its association with selected echocardiographic indices. Eighty-four client-owned CKCS were staged according to ACVIM guidelines (A, n = 11; B1, n = 58; B2, n = 7; C, n = 8), and serum aldosterone was measured using the LIAISON® Aldosterone chemiluminescent immunoassay on the DiaSorin LIAISON® XL automated analyzer. In the comparison of serum aldosterone concentrations between the combined ACVIM groups A + B1 and B2 + C, the group effect did not reach statistical significance in the multivariable analysis based on complete cases (p = 0.072). In the unadjusted comparison, dogs with ACVIM-defined left-sided cardiac remodeling and/or congestive heart failure (B2 +C) had higher median serum aldosterone concentrations than dogs not fulfilling ACVIM criteria for stage B2 or C disease (A+B1) (707.0 [445.0-1150.0] vs. 469.5 [333.5-730.5] pmol/L; p = 0.045), with a moderate rank-biserial effect size (r_rb = 0.332; 95% CI: 0.025-0.612). No significant associations between serum aldosterone concentration and echocardiographic variables remained after false discovery rate (FDR) correction, either in the whole cohort or in the B2 + C subgroup. These results suggest a possible difference in serum aldosterone concentrations between broader clinically defined MMVD groups. However, this association was attenuated after multivariable adjustment, and associations with individual echocardiographic indices were not confirmed after correction for multiple testing. The results should therefore be considered preliminary and hypothesis-generating.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 캐벌리 킹 찰스 스패니얼의 점액종성 승모판막질환에서 혈청 알도스테론 농도는 ACVIM 단계별로 차이를 보였으나, 다변량 분석에서는 통계적 유의성에 도달하지 못했으며, 심초음파 지표와의 연관성도 다중검정 보정 후 확인되지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 캐벌리 킹 찰스 스패니얼 84마리를 ACVIM 단계별로 분류(A n=11, B1 n=58, B2 n=7, C n=8)하여 혈청 알도스테론을 측정했다. 비보정 비교에서 B2+C군의 중앙값 707.0 pmol/L vs A+B1군 469.5 pmol/L (p=0.045, r_rb=0.332)로 통계적 차이를 보였으나, 다변량 분석에서는 유의하지 않았다(p=0.072).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상적으로 유용성 판단이 제한적이며, 본 결과는 가설 생성적이고 예비적이므로 향후 더 큰 규모의 전향적 연구가 필요하다. 다중검정 보정으로 인해 심초음파 지표와의 연관성이 소실된 점이 한계이다.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of atinvicitinib and oclacitinib in the control of pruritus in canine allergic dermatitis: a randomized, examiner-masked, positive-controlled multicenter clinical trial.
papers.authors: Heinau LK, Zschiesche E, Hakala M, Kavrik D, Hala P
papers.abstract: Atinvicitinib is a Janus kinase 1-selective-inhibitor approved for the treatment of pruritus associated with allergic dermatitis, including canine atopic dermatitis (cAD). An examiner-masked, randomized study assessed safety and clinical improvement in pruritus and dermatitis severity in dogs with allergic dermatitis following treatment with atinvicitinib (Numelvi® tablets, MSD Animal Health) or oclacitinib (Apoquel® chewable tablets, Zoetis). Client-owned dogs (n = 69) with allergic dermatitis and a pruritus visual analog scale (PVAS) score ≥ 6 were enrolled at nine veterinary clinics in Portugal and Spain and treated with either atinvicitinib (0.8-1.2 mg/kg once daily with food, n = 34) or oclacitinib (0.4-0.6 mg/kg, with or without food, twice daily for 14 days then once daily, n = 35) for 28 (± 1) days. Safety was assessed based on adverse event (AE) reporting. Owners assessed PVAS on day (D) 0, 7, 14, 21 and 28, including overall response to treatment (ORTT-VAS) on D28. Veterinarians performed physical examinations and dermatitis VAS score (DVAS) on D0 and 28. Efficacy was evaluated as the percentage reduction in PVAS and DVAS from baseline. A dynamic longitudinal model was used to compare effectiveness between groups. On D28, 70% atinvicitinib- and 65% oclacitinib-treated dogs had PVAS < 2 (normal). Dynamic longitudinal modelling showed that pruritus reduction after 28 days of atinvicitinib was non-inferior to that with oclacitinib at label doses. There was a 74% reduction in DVAS in both treatments by D28. All of the few AEs observed were consistent with approved product information. Atinvicitinib once daily with food is safe and effective in reducing pruritus and dermatitis severity in dogs with allergic dermatitis.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Atinvicitinib은 JAK1 선택적 억제제로, 개의 알레르기성 피부염 소양증 치료에 있어 오클라시티닙과 비교하여 비열등함을 보였으며, 1일 1회 투여로 안전하고 효과적입니다.
[방법·수치] 포르투갈과 스페인의 9개 동물병원에서 PVAS 점수 ≥6인 알레르기성 피부염 환자견 69마리(atinvicitinib군 34마리, oclacitinib군 35마리)를 대상으로 28일간 비교 임상시험을 실시했습니다. Atinvicitinib은 0.8-1.2 mg/kg 1일 1회, oclacitinib은 0.4-0.6 mg/kg 2일간 1일 2회 후 1일 1회 투여했으며, D28에 atinvicitinib군 70%, oclacitinib군 65%에서 PVAS<2(정상)을 달성했고, 두 치료 모두 DVAS 74% 감소를 보였습니다.
[임상 적용·한계] 한 번의 일일 투여와 식이와 함께 투여하는 편의성으로 임상에서 순응도 향상을 기대할 수 있으나, 단일 지역 다기관 연구이고 샘플 크기가 제한적이며, 장기 추적 데이터 및 다양한 환경에서의 유효성 검증이 필요합니다.

papers.title: Intracameral lidocaine-epinephrine has minimal effect on heart rate and blood pressure and is an effective sole mydriatic during phacoemulsification in dogs.
papers.authors: Pumphrey SA, Gibson LK, Maggio F, Lindsey J, Wetmore LA
papers.abstract: To investigate heart rate (HR) and rhythm, blood pressure (BP), and pupil diameter in dogs that received intracameral (IC) preservative-free lidocaine-epinephrine (ILE) as a sole mydriatic agent during phacoemulsification. Records were retrospectively reviewed for HR and BP data and anesthesia concerns following administration of ILE during cataract surgery (IC group, 130 eyes from 83 dogs). Similar data were obtained for a control group undergoing phacoemulsification that received topical mydriatics (topical treatment [TT] group, 40 eyes from 21 dogs). Pupil diameter was measured prospectively following administration of ILE in an additional 20 eyes from 11 dogs. Average baseline HR was 13 beats/min higher in the TT group than in the IC group for both eyes operated (P ≤ .04). Heart rate increased more from baseline in the IC group than in the TT group at 15 and 20 minutes after administration, but the difference was not clinically significant (average of 4 beats/min). Changes in BP were minimal and did not differ between groups. No significant arrhythmias or other anesthetic complications were noted in either group. Mean pupil diameter was 11.3 mm (95% CI, 11, 11.6) immediately following ILE administration and 11.8 mm (95% CI, 11.5, 12.1) at the conclusion of surgery. ILE produced adequate, durable mydriasis when used as a sole mydriatic in canine eyes undergoing phacoemulsification. Intracameral lidocaine-epinephrine does not appear to affect cardiovascular parameters when administered during phacoemulsification in dogs. ILE is a reasonable mydriatic choice for canine phacoemulsification.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 백내장 수술 중 전방 내 리도카인-에피네프린(ILE)은 단독 산동제로 충분한 산동을 유지하며 심박수와 혈압에 미미한 영향을 미치므로 안전한 선택지이다.
[방법·수치] 개 83마리 130안의 후향적 기록검토(ILE군) 및 개 21마리 40안의 대조군(국소 산동제 사용)을 비교하였다. 기저 심박수는 TT군이 IC군보다 13회/분 높았으며(P ≤ .04), 투여 후 15-20분에 IC군에서 평균 4회/분 더 증가했으나 임상적 의미는 없었다. 혈압 변화는 미미했고 두 군 간 차이가 없었다. 평균 산동 직경은 ILE 투여 직후 11.3 mm(95% CI, 11-11.6), 수술 종료 시 11.8 mm(95% CI, 11.5-12.1)였다.
