[임상 적용·한계] ILE는 개의 수정체유화술 중 불규칙맥박이나 마취 합병증 없이 안전하게 사용할 수 있으며, 국소 산동제를 반복 점안할 필요가 없어 편의성이 높다. 후향적 설계이고 단일기관 연구로 대규모 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Evaluation of the efficacy of extended-release buprenorphine (Ethiqa XR) using objective gait analysis in dogs.
papers.authors: Tiffinger K, Benito de la Vibora J, Hall A, Hall N, Taylor R
papers.abstract: To evaluate the efficacy of an extended-release formulation of buprenorphine HCl (XR-Bup) using objective gait analysis in a canine stifle arthrotomy model. We hypothesized that a single SC injection of XR-Bup would reduce postoperative pain and improve limb function. In a randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled crossover study design, 8 purpose-bred Beagles underwent 2 unilateral stifle arthrotomies, randomized to XR-Bup for 1 procedure and placebo for the other, separated by a washout period. Kinetic and static ground reaction force data were collected at baseline (pretreatment) and multiple time points up to 72 hours after arthrotomy. Symmetry indices were calculated for ground reaction force variables and compared between groups using a repeated-measures analysis. Overall, symmetry indices of static body weight distribution (%BWdistrib) showed significantly greater limb use symmetry following XR-Bup compared to placebo. There was significant time and treatment interaction (P = .025) for %BWdistrib to the operated limb, with %BWdistrib approaching baseline levels more quickly when treated with XR-Bup. Similarly, kinetic variables demonstrated higher limb use in the XR-Bup group, although the treatment effects were not significant. All dogs experienced nausea and hyporexia/anorexia after XR-Bup over 72 hours. Vomiting occurred in 6 of 9 and regurgitation was observed in 8 of 9 arthrotomy cases. XR-Bup treatment was associated with greater limb usage (static and dynamic) at all time points, with data indicating effective pain alleviation in a small cohort of dogs. Although Ethiqa XR may be an alternative option for postoperative pain control, its clinical utility at the dose evaluated in this study may be limited by the occurrence of adverse events.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 단회 피하주사 연장방출성 부프레노르핀(XR-Bup)은 개의 슬관절 관혈술 후 사지 대칭성을 개선하고 통증 경감 효과를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 무작위 맹검 위약대조 교차 연구로 비글 8마리를 대상으로 슬관절 관혈술 2회(XR-Bup 1회, 위약 1회) 수행했으며, 술 후 72시간까지 지면반력 분석으로 평가했다. 정적 체중분배 대칭지수(%BWdistrib)에서 XR-Bup이 위약 대비 유의하게 더 빠르게 기저값으로 회복되었으며 시간-치료 상호작용이 유의하였다(P=.025). 모든 개에서 XR-Bup 투여 후 72시간 동안 구역질과 식욕부진/거식증이 발생했으며, 9례 중 6례에서 구토, 8례에서 역류가 관찰되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] Ethiqa XR는 술 후 통증 관리의 대안이 될 수 있으나, 본 연구의 용량에서는 오심, 구토, 역류 등의 이상반응으로 인해 임상 활용성이 제한될 수 있다. 소규모 개 집단 연구로 임상 적용 전 추가 용량-반응 연구와 이상반응 관리 방안이 필요하다.

papers.title: Computed tomography extracellular volume fraction in canine hepatic fibrosis: A retrospective preliminary study.
papers.authors: Goda Y, Seki A, Hanazono K, Tamura M, Yamamoto S
papers.abstract: Liver biopsy remains the gold standard for diagnosing hepatic fibrosis in dogs; however, its invasive nature limits suitability for repeated assessment. Computed tomography-extracellular volume fraction (CT-ECV) has been investigated as a quantitative imaging measure associated with hepatic fibrosis in humans; however, its characteristics in dogs with spontaneous hepatic fibrosis remain incompletely understood. This retrospective study aimed to compare hepatic CT-ECV between dogs with only histopathologically normal biopsied hepatic lobes and dogs with at least one biopsied hepatic lobe showing clinically significant fibrosis, and to explore the ability of CT-ECV to discriminate between these groups. Thirty-six client-owned dogs that underwent triple-phase contrast-enhanced CT and liver biopsy were analyzed. Histopathologic examination identified 47 histopathologically normal hepatic lobes from 26 dogs and 27 hepatic lobes with fibrosis from 11 dogs; one dog contributed hepatic lobes to both categories. CT-ECV was calculated from changes in hepatic and aortic attenuation between pre-contrast and equilibrium phase images, with correction for hematocrit. For the principal doglevel analysis, 25 dogs were classified as normal and 11 as fibrotic, and dog-level CTECV was calculated as the mean across all biopsied hepatic lobes. Mean dog-level CT-ECV was 21.46 ± 3.02% in the normal group and 32.75 ± 10.67% in the fibrosis group. After adjustment for CT scanner, CT-ECV was significantly higher in the fibrosis group, with an estimated mean difference of 12.10 %age points (robust 95% CI, 4.60-19.59; P = .002). Dog-level receiver operating characteristic analysis yielded an area under the curve of 0.865 (95% CI, 0.726-1.000). An exploratory candidate threshold of 29.56% provided a sensitivity of 63.6% (95% CI, 30.8-89.1%) and a specificity of 100% (95% CI, 86.3-100%). Intra-observer repeatability was high (intraclass correlation coefficient, 0.886).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] CT 세외용적분획(CT-ECV)은 개의 임상적으로 유의한 간 섬유화와 연관이 있으며, 조직검사를 대체할 수 있는 비침습적 영상 지표로 가능성을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 삼중영상 조영 증강 CT와 간 생검을 받은 36마리 개(정상군 25마리, 섬유화군 11마리)를 대상으로 후향적 분석 수행. 정상군 평균 CT-ECV 21.46±3.02%, 섬유화군 32.75±10.67% (P=0.002, 조정된 평균 차이 12.10 백분율 포인트). ROC 분석 결과 AUC 0.865, 임계값 29.56%에서 민감도 63.6%, 특이도 100%. 관찰자 내 반복성 높음(ICC 0.886).
[임상 적용·한계] CT-ECV는 간 섬uno화 진단의 비침습적 모니터링 도구로 활용 가능하나, 단일기관 후향적 소규모 연구(간 섬유화 11마리만 포함)이고 표준화된 영상 프로토콜 부재로 추가 검증 연구 필요. 임계값의 임상적 유효성 확인도 별도 대규모 독립 임상군에서 필요함.

papers.title: Occurrence of Toxocara spp. in companion animals and serological evidence of human exposure at the human-companion animal interface in Giza, Egypt.
papers.authors: Gouda MA, Shalaan FH, Seleem AA, Anwer AZ, Bakry NM
papers.abstract: Toxocariasis, caused by Toxocara spp., is one of the most neglected zoonotic parasitic diseases worldwide. In Egypt, integrated One Health studies investigating human, animal, and occupational risk factors remain limited. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of zoonotic Toxocara spp. in companion animals and to identify associated risk factors within a One Health framework. A cross-sectional study was conducted in Giza, Egypt, including dogs (n = 70) and cats (n = 35) from animal shelters and veterinary clinics, eosinophilic children (n = 227), and shelter workers (n = 22). Animal fecal samples were examined microscopically for intestinal parasites, while human serum samples were tested for anti-Toxocara IgG antibodies using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Demographic characteristics and potential risk factors were collected through standardized questionnaires. Associations were evaluated using Pearson's Chi-square or Fisher's exact tests, followed by binary logistic regression to estimate odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Toxocara canis-like eggs were detected in a percentage of 17.1% in canine cases, with no significant difference in positivity rates regarding sex. In contrast, T. canis positivity rate was significantly correlated with younger age, lack of anthelmintic medication, and concurrent detection of Cystoisospora species. Among the studied eosinophilic children, anti-Toxocara IgG antibodies were detected in 41/227 (18.1%). In the univariable analysis, rural residence was significantly associated with anti-T. canis IgG seropositivity (COR = 2.08, 95% CI: 1.00-4.32; P = 0.047). Similarly, contact with soil (COR = 2.51, 95% CI: 1.17-5.42; P = 0.02), consumption of unpurified water (COR = 2.80, 95% CI: 1.15-6.82; P = 0.02), and interaction with pets (COR = 3.19, 95% CI: 1.48-6.87; P = 0.002) were significantly associated with anti IgG seropositivity.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 이집트 기자에서 개와 고양이의 톡소카라 감염률이 각각 17.1%이며, 아동의 18.1%에서 항-톡소카라 IgG 항체가 검출되어 인수공통감염병 위험이 상당함을 입증했다.
[방법·수치] 개(n=70), 고양이(n=35), 호산구증다증 아동(n=227), 보호소 근무자(n=22)를 대상으로 한 단면연구로, 동물 분변 현미경검사와 인간 혈청 ELISA 검사를 수행했다. 톡소카라 감염은 어린 나이, 구충 약물 미사용, Cystoisospora 동시감염과 유의하게 관련이 있었으며, 아동의 토양 접촉(AOR=3.10, P=0.02), 미정수 물 섭취(AOR=2.64, P=0.04), 반려동물과의 접촉(AOR=3.60, P=0.002)이 독립적으로 혈청양성과 관련되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 반려동물의 정기적 구충, 공중보건 교육, 수의-의학 감시 체계 강화가 필요하며, 특히 토양 접촉과 반려동물 상호작용이 주요 감염원이므로 위생 교육이 중요하다. 단일 지역 연구이고 아동 집단이 호산구증다증으로 선별된 대상이라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Beating-heart pulmonary arteriotomy under cardiopulmonary bypass for heartworm extraction in three dogs without caval syndrome.
papers.authors: Vurucu M, Cokogullu A
papers.abstract: To describe the clinical outcomes of beating-heart open-heart surgery under cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) for surgical extraction of adult heartworms from the pulmonary arteries in dogs without caval syndrome. Animals Three client-owned dogs. Three client-owned dogs with heartworm disease, ≥5 adult heartworms visualized within a single pulmonary arterial branch, and no evidence of caval syndrome were included. After establishment of CPB, the pulmonary artery was opened without cardioplegic arrest, and adult heartworms were surgically extracted. Clinical follow-up ranged from 6 to 22 months, with objective echocardiographic, radiographic, right pulmonary artery distensibility (RPAD) index, and heartworm antigen assessments performed at scheduled follow-up examinations. Study design Case report. Adult heartworms visible intraoperatively were surgically removed in each dog. All dogs survived surgery and were discharged without major perioperative complications. During follow-up, heartworm antigen tests became negative, and no residual heartworms were detected on echocardiographic examinations. Pulmonary arterial dilation and radiographic abnormalities improved, while right pulmonary artery distensibility (RPAD) index values increased from 27.7%, 28.0%, and 22.5% preoperatively to 38.8%, 35.6%, and 35.4%, respectively. Surgical extraction of adult heartworms from the pulmonary arteries was associated with favorable postoperative and follow-up findings in these three dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심폐우회술 하에서 박동 중인 심장의 폐동맥절개술로 성충 심사충을 외과적으로 추출하면 대정맥증후군이 없는 개에서 양호한 수술 성적과 추적 관찰 결과를 얻을 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 증례보고: 폐동맥 내 5개 이상의 성충 심사충이 확인되고 대정맥증후군이 없는 개 3마리를 대상으로 심폐우회술 하에 폐동맥을 개방하여 성충을 직접 제거함. 추적 관찰 기간 6~22개월, 우측폐동맥신장성 지수(RPAD)는 수술 전 27.7%, 28.0%, 22.5%에서 수술 후 38.8%, 35.6%, 35.4%로 증가; 모든 개가 수술 생존하였고 주요 합병증 없이 퇴원, 추적 관찰 중 심사충 항원 검사 음전, 심초음파상 잔존 심사충 미검출, 폐동맥 확장과 방사선학적 이상 개선.
[임상 적용·한계] 대정맥증후군 없는 고부담 폐동맥 심사충증 환자에서 직시하 심사충 제거술의 치료적 가치를 제시하나, 소수 증례(3마리)에 대한 단일기관 보고이고 장기 추적 관찰 부재로 일반화의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Symptom-Based Clinical Deterioration as a Patient-Centred Endpoint in Canine Urothelial Carcinoma.
papers.authors: Lim J, Kim JK, Hong YJ, Park JH, Kim SH
papers.abstract: This multicentre retrospective cohort study operationalized structured clinical deterioration endpoints in canine urothelial carcinoma (UC) and compared them with conventional outcomes. A total of 182 dogs with imaging-supported, cytologically and/or histopathologically confirmed UC from three referral institutions were included. Clinical signs were retrospectively mapped using prespecified grading rules anchored to VCOG-CTCAE v2 and symptom-based endpoints were defined from treatment initiation as time to lower urinary tract symptom progression (TTSP) and time to systemic deterioration (TTD), each assessed as initial (first grade ≥ 2 deterioration) and confirmed (grade ≥ 2 deterioration sustained at the next consecutive assessment) events. Imaging-based progression-free survival (PFS) was reconstructed from serial ultrasonography using VCOG cRECIST progression criteria (≥ 20% increase in longest tumour diameter or a new lesion). Confirmed TTSP and TTD were strongly associated with OS (rank correlations, 0.81 and 0.82, respectively) and remained prognostically informative in multivariable models and at most prespecified landmark times; the corresponding correlation for imaging-based PFS was 0.74. TTSP/TTD were not temporally interchangeable with imaging-based PFS or with acute kidney injury (AKI) and complete obstruction, showing broad individual-level discordance and limited overlap even within ±7- and ±14-day windows. In descriptive treatment-group comparisons, patterns differed across OS, PFS and deterioration endpoints and in the rescue-intervention subcohort, most dogs developed recurrent deterioration after decompression for malignant obstruction. These findings suggest that TTSP/TTD are feasible structured endpoints that capture clinically relevant and prognostically informative worsening not fully represented by imaging progression or catastrophic events alone.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 요상피암에서 임상 증상 악화(하부요로계 증상 진행, 전신 악화)는 전체생존기간과 강한 상관관계(0.81-0.82)를 보이며 영상기반 무진행생존기간(0.74)보다 예후 예측력이 우수하다.
[방법·수치] 세 개 대학병원의 182마리 개 요상피암 환자를 대상으로 한 다기관 후향적 코호트 연구로, VCOG-CTCAE v2 기준에 따라 하부요로계 증상 진행 시간(TTSP)과 전신 악화 시간(TTD)을 측정하고 초음파 기반 PFS와 비교했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 증상 기반 악화 지표는 영상검사나 급성 신부전 같은 치명적 사건만으로는 포착되지 않는 임상적으로 유의미한 악화를 반영하므로 종양 치료 반응 평가에 유용하지만, 후향적 연구이고 임상 증상의 주관적 해석 가능성이 있다.

papers.title: Lipid-Lowering Strategies in the Era of Early Atherosclerosis Detection: 2026 ACC Scientific Statement: A Report of the American College of Cardiology.
papers.authors: Greenland P, Badimon L, Bittner V, Bonaca MP, Hlatky MA
papers.abstract: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) begins early in life, driven in large part by cumulative exposure to low-density lipoprotein cholesterol and other atherogenic lipoproteins. Contemporary evidence from epidemiologic cohorts, genetic studies, imaging studies, and lipid-lowering trials supports a paradigm of earlier identification and more sustained treatment of individuals at increased ASCVD risk. This American College of Cardiology Scientific Statement reviews the rationale for early adoption of lipid-lowering strategies, with emphasis on lifetime lipid burden, inherited and acquired risk enhancers, and the role of subclinical atherosclerosis assessment. Available clinical trial data suggest that greater absolute low-density lipoprotein cholesterol reduction and longer treatment duration can reduce ASCVD events, even though direct evidence remains limited in younger populations at low short-term risk. Atherosclerosis detected by imaging may identify individuals whose ASCVD risk is underestimated by traditional calculators, but optimal strategies for screening, treatment thresholds, safety, adherence, cost-effectiveness, and value require further study. Clinicians should integrate estimated short- and long-term risk, lipid burden, risk enhancers, imaging findings when appropriate, and patient preferences to guide individualized, shared decision making to reduce lifetime ASCVD risk.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 죽상동맥경화성 심혈관질환은 생애 초기부터 저밀도지단백콜레스테롤의 누적 노출로 진행되며, 조기 발견과 지속적 지질저하치료를 통해 심혈관 사건 감소가 가능하다. 더 큰 절대 LDL 콜레스테롤 감소와 연장된 치료 기간이 사건 감소를 가져올 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 역학 코호트, 유전학 연구, 영상 연구, 지질저하 임상시험의 근거를 종합 분석한 과학성명서이다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상의는 추정 단기·장기 위험도, 평생 지질부담, 위험인자, 영상소견을 통합하여 개별화된 의사결정으로 평생 심혈관질환 위험을 감소시켜야 한다. 젊은 연령층의 직접 근거가 제한적이고, 선별검사 전략·치료역치·안전성·순응도·비용-효과성에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Severe cytopenia in dogs treated with fenbendazole for Heterobilharzia americana.
papers.authors: Poellmann LJ, Fajt VR, Verocai GG, Aicher KM
papers.abstract: To report the features and outcomes of dogs experiencing severe febrile cytopenia following treatment with fenbendazole for Heterobilharzia americana. 6 client-owned dogs that received fenbendazole for treatment of H americana and subsequently developed severe transient cytopenia with accompanying clinical illness were evaluated. In this observational retrospective multicenter case series, medical records of affected dogs reported by veterinarians through consultation with the Gastrointestinal Laboratory at Texas A&M University between June 2023 and November 2025 were reviewed. Dogs were included if they had a diagnosis of H americana by fecal PCR or saline sedimentation, received treatment with fenbendazole, and developed an episode of cytopenia with accompanying clinical signs within 21 days of beginning treatment. All dogs were spayed females, representing a variety of breeds. Six dogs received praziquantel and fenbendazole for treatment. Five of these dogs received concurrent doses of pyrantel pamoate and febantel through use of a combination tablet as the source of praziquantel, resulting in high total benzimidazole drug exposure. Dogs developed marked neutropenia, variable thrombocytopenia, fever, and severe clinical illness warranting hospitalization. All dogs experienced hematologic and clinical recovery following discontinuation of fenbendazole, supportive care, and administration of short-term parenteral antimicrobials. Prescribing veterinarians should remain aware of the risk for cytopenia with extralabel use of fenbendazole to treat H americana infection in dogs. The use of combination products to dose praziquantel is contraindicated, as it may also contain febantel and could expose dogs to toxic doses of benzimidazole.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 Heterobilharzia americana 치료를 위한 펜벤다졸 사용 후 심각한 호중구감소증, 혈소판감소증, 발열 및 전신증상이 발생했으며, 약물 중단 및 대증치료 후 회복되었다.
[방법·수치] 2023년 6월부터 2025년 11월까지 Texas A&M 대학 소화기계 실험실 상담을 통해 보고된 6마리 개의 의무기록을 후향적 다기관 증례 검토; 모두 암컷 중성화견이었고, 6마리 모두 프라지콴텔과 펜벤다졸 병용, 5마리가 추가로 피란텔 파모에이트와 페반텔 함유 복합제 사용으로 고용량 벤지미다졸 노출.
[임상 적용·한계] H americana 치료 시 펜벤다졸의 비허가 사용에 따른 골수억제 위험성을 인식해야 하며, 프라지콴텔 용량 조절 목적의 복합제 사용은 금기; 후향적 소규모 증례 보고이고 용량-반응 관계 등 상세 수치가 부족하다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: An ultra-low indocyanine green dose maximizes biliary-to-hepatic contrast in dogs: A prospective pilot study.
papers.authors: Lacitignola L, Guadalupi M, Cavalluzzo F, Belvito R, Magli PFP
papers.abstract: Indocyanine green fluorescence cholangiography (ICG-FC) may improve intraoperative visualization of the extrahepatic biliary tract in dogs, but the dose and timing that optimize biliary-to-hepatic contrast during the early intraoperative window remain undefined. This prospective randomized pilot study evaluated dose- and time-dependent fluorescence behavior in 18 healthy client-owned female dogs undergoing elective laparoscopic ovariectomy. Dogs received ultra-low-dose (0.0119 mg/kg), low-dose (0.05 mg/kg), or high-dose (0.25 mg/kg) intravenous ICG, with six dogs assigned to each group. Fluorescence imaging was performed at 5, 20, 30, and 45 min after injection; 60-minute observations were available in a subset and analyzed descriptively. Liver, gallbladder, cystic duct, and duodenal fluorescence were quantified on monochromatic near-infrared images by three blinded observers using region-of-interest analysis. Background-corrected target-to-liver ratios (TLRs) were calculated, and cystic duct TLR at 45 min was the clinically prioritized endpoint. Hepatic fluorescence increased with ICG dose, whereas gallbladder and cystic duct fluorescence showed substantially less dose-dependent variation, resulting in an inverse dose-contrast relationship. At 45 min, cystic duct TLR differed among groups (Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.015; mixed-effects model dose effect p = 0.016). The ultra-low-dose group had the highest median cystic duct TLR (2.63), with five of six dogs exceeding a TLR of 1, compared with one of six dogs receiving low-dose ICG and none receiving high-dose ICG. Gallbladder contrast was also highest after ultra-low-dose ICG, with a significant ultra-low-dose versus high-dose difference at 45 min (Holm-adjusted p = 0.006). Ultra-low-dose ICG may improve early biliary-to-hepatic contrast in dogs primarily by reducing hepatic fluorescence, supporting further evaluation in dogs with spontaneous hepatobiliary disease.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 초저용량 인도시아닌그린(ICG 0.0119mg/kg)이 고용량보다 담도-간 대조도를 향상시키며, 이는 주로 간의 형광을 감소시킴으로써 달성됨.
[방법·수치] 건강한 암컷개 18마리를 대상으로 초저용량, 저용량(0.05mg/kg), 고용량(0.25mg/kg) ICG를 무작위 배정(각 군 6마리)하여 복강경 난소절제술 중 형광영상을 획득. 주요 평가시점은 주입 후 45분의 담낭관 목표-간 비율(TLR)로, 초저용량 군에서 중앙값 2.63, 6마리 중 5마리가 TLR 1 이상 달성(Kruskal-Wallis p=0.015, 혼합효과모형 p=0.016).
[임상 적용·한계] ICG 형광담도조영술로 간외담도의 술중 시각화를 개선할 수 있으나, 본 연구는 건강한 개를 대상으로 한 소규모 조종 연구로 자발성 간담도질환 환자의 효과를 평가하기 위한 추가 연구가 필요함.

papers.title: A virtual reality-based test for assessing laparoscopic canine ovariectomy competency: A validity study.
papers.authors: Redander J, Brunius Enlund K, Ström L, Höglund O, Bjerrum F
papers.abstract: Simulation-based training can be used to develop basic laparoscopic skills. Proficiency-based training is the gold standard but requires competency assessment. This study investigated validity evidence for a virtual reality simulator-based test assessing laparoscopic canine ovariectomy skills. Validity investigation study. Eleven surgeons with experience of at least 30 laparoscopic canine ovariectomies, and 16 novices with no laparoscopic experience. Participants completed three attempts on both the left and right sides of the LapSim Canine Ovariectomy simulator module. Data were collected automatically, and the second and third attempts were analyzed. Discriminatory parameters were identified, and pass/fail levels were determined using the contrasting groups method. A noncompensatory standard-setting method was used. Validity evidence was reported using Messick's framework. Experienced surgeons were faster (total time, p = .008) and used fewer instrument movements than novices (combined instrument path length, p = .031; combined instrument angular path, p = .038). A test was developed for the module's left side and relevant pass/fail levels identified. Approximately half of the novices and one experienced surgeon failed the test. Test-retest analysis indicated generally low reliability. This study provided validity evidence for a virtual reality simulator-based test assessing competency in laparoscopic canine ovariectomy. The test can currently be used for formative assessment during training. Virtual reality simulation is an emerging field in veterinary medicine with the potential to enhance surgical training. These findings can inform the incorporation of proficiency-based virtual reality training into veterinary curricula.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] LapSim 개 난소절제술 시뮬레이터 모듈은 복강경 수술 능력을 변별할 수 있으며, 형성평가로 사용 가능한 타당성 증거를 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 복강경 경험 30회 이상의 숙련 외과의 11명과 초보자 16명을 대상으로 양측 LapSim 시뮬레이터에서 3회 시도. 숙련 외과의가 초보자보다 총 소요시간이 더 짧음(p=0.008), 기구 경로거리 감소(p=0.031), 기구 각도 경로 감소(p=0.038). 초보자의 약 50%와 숙련 외과의 1명이 불합격. 재검사 신뢰도는 대체로 낮음.
[임상 적용·한계] 가상현실 시뮬레이션은 수의학 교육과정에서 숙련도 기반 복강경 수술 훈련을 보강할 수 있으나, 현재는 훈련 중 형성평가 용도에만 적합하며 낮은 재검사 신뢰도와 제한된 모듈 설계(좌측만 평가)가 한계다.

papers.title: Diagnostic and Translational Challenges in Canine Endocrine and Neuroendocrine Neoplasms: A Comparative Pathology Perspective.
papers.authors: Mitze S, Williams J, Davison LJ, Xia D, Buishand FO
papers.abstract: The recognition and detection of endocrine and neuroendocrine neoplasms (NENs) in dogs and humans is challenging. This is, in part, because some are non-functional, and where hormone hypersecretion occurs, it can lead to a great variety of clinical syndromes. Additionally, metastatic patterns vary according to the primary anatomical site, and the typically slow growth of many endocrine tumours/NENs may lead to underestimation of biological aggressiveness and misclassification as benign disease. In human medicine, diagnostic evaluation relies on a comprehensive, anatomical site-specific histopathologic framework, incorporating immunohistochemistry as formalised in the 2025 World Health Organisation classification of endocrine tumours/NENs. In contrast, veterinary diagnostic frameworks for canine endocrine tumours/NENs remain comparatively underdeveloped, with limited standardisation of terminology, grading systems, and validated cut-off values. This review aims to raise awareness of key diagnostic challenges associated with the most clinically prevalent canine endocrine tumours/NENs: insulinoma, phaeochromocytoma and cortisol-producing adrenocortical tumours. Emphasis is placed on histopathological characterisation using immunohistochemistry, drawing parallels with established human diagnostic algorithms where appropriate. By synthesising current knowledge from human and canine pathology, this review highlights critical gaps in veterinary diagnostic practice and identifies opportunities for harmonisation of classification strategies. The development of standardised diagnostic guidelines has the potential not only to improve clinical management of affected dogs but also to strengthen the translational value of spontaneous canine endocrine tumours/NENs within the field of comparative oncology and One Medicine.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 개의 내분비 및 신경내분비 종양(insulinoma, phaeochromocytoma, cortisol-producing adrenocortical tumour)은 비기능성 종양, 다양한 임상증후군, 가변적인 전이 패턴, 느린 성장으로 인해 진단이 어려우며, 수의학에서는 인의학의 2025 WHO 분류 기준처럼 표준화된 조직병리학적 프레임워크와 면역조직화학 평가 체계가 부족한 상태이다. [방법·수치] 개와 인간의 내분비 종양/신경내분ocrine 종양에 대한 비교병리학적 문헌 고찰로, 면역조직화학을 포함한 조직병리학적 특성화와 인의학의 진단 알고리즘과의 비교 분석을 수행했으며, 수치 제시 없음. [임상 적용·한계] 개 내분비 종양의 표준화된 진단 지침 개발은 임상 관리 개선과 비교종양학 분야에서의 중개 연구 가치 향상에 기여할 수 있으나, 본 연구는 현황 분석 및 개선안 제시에 초점을 맞춘 것으로 실제 임상 적용 데이터는 제한적이다.

papers.title: Azotemia does not clinically affect the interpretation of increased serum pancreatic lipase activity or pancreatic lipase immunoreactivity in dogs.
papers.authors: Niemann L, Vigani A, Torgerson PR, Kook PH
papers.abstract: The objective was to compare paired pancreatic lipase immunoreactivity (PLI) concentrations and pancreatic lipase activity in serum samples in a population of azotemic dogs. This observational study included client-owned dogs with azotemia and serum lipase activity above the reference interval (17 to 156 U/L). Lipase activity (Roche LIPC lipase colorimetric assay, substrate 1,2-o-dilauryl-rac-glycero-3-glutaric acid-[60-methylresorufin] ester) and serum creatinine concentration were measured as part of routine clinical diagnostics. Monthly screening identified leftover serum samples from azotemic dogs with hyperlipasemia. The PLI concentration was measured from banked serum aliquots of those samples. Associations between serum creatinine concentration, lipase activity, and PLI concentration were evaluated using correlation analysis and generalized linear mixed-effects models. 49 serum samples from 32 dogs were included. Serum creatinine concentration weakly correlated with lipase activity (Spearman rank correlation coefficient = 0.36) and PLI concentration (Spearman rank correlation coefficient = 0.30). Generalized linear mixed-effects modeling identified a significant association between azotemia and lipase activity, whereas no significant association was identified for PLI concentration. Per 0.3-mg/dL increase in serum creatinine concentration, lipase activity increased by 1.11 U/L. Although azotemia was statistically associated with a significant increase in lipase activity in azotemic dogs, the magnitude of this effect was negligible. Azotemia has no clinically relevant effect on the diagnostic interpretation of increased lipase activity in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 아조혈증이 있는 개에서 혈청 크레아티닌 증가는 췌장 리파아제 활성도와 약한 상관관계를 보이지만, 임상적으로는 리파아제 해석에 유의미한 영향을 주지 않는다.
[방법·수치] 아조혈증을 동반한 고리파아제혈증 개 32마리에서 49개 혈청 샘플을 대상으로 리파아제 활성도와 췌장 리파아제 면역반응성(PLI)을 측정하였다. 혈청 크레아티닌과 리파아제 활성도의 Spearman 상관계수 0.36, PLI와의 상관계수 0.30이었으며, 혈청 크레아티닌 0.3mg/dL 증가당 리파아제 활성도는 1.11U/L 증가하였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 아조혈증 개에서 증가된 리파아제 활성도의 진단적 해석은 신기능 감소의 영향을 고려하지 않아도 된다. 단일 기관의 후향적 연구이며 개체 수 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Cavitary effusion patterns are associated with different survival times in dogs with pulmonary hypertension and right-sided congestive heart failure.
papers.authors: Cho J, Kim M, Choi M, Lee J, Park C
papers.abstract: To describe and compare clinical characteristics and survival among dogs with pulmonary hypertension-associated right-sided congestive heart failure (RCHF) according to cavitary effusion pattern. This retrospective multicenter observational study included client-owned dogs with pulmonary hypertension-associated RCHF presented to 3 referral hospitals from February 2021 through April 2025. Pulmonary hypertension was assessed echocardiographically, and RCHF was defined by ascites with caudal vena cava dilation. Dogs were categorized as having ascites alone, ascites with pleural effusion, or ascites with pericardial effusion. Clinical and imaging characteristics were compared among groups, and survival was evaluated using Kaplan-Meier and exploratory Cox regression analyses. 61 dogs were included: 40 with ascites alone, 16 with pleural effusion, and 5 with pericardial effusion. Median survival was 157, 42.5, and 7 days, respectively. In an exploratory multivariable Cox model adjusted for age and grouped etiology, pericardial effusion was associated with a higher mortality hazard compared with ascites alone. Pleural effusion was not significantly associated with mortality. Survival differed according to cavitary effusion pattern in this retrospective cohort of dogs with RCHF. Dogs with concurrent pericardial effusion had the shortest observed survival and a higher adjusted mortality hazard, although this finding should be interpreted cautiously because only 5 dogs had pericardial effusion. Cavitary effusion pattern may provide additional descriptive information when assessing dogs with RCHF. Concurrent pericardial effusion may identify a subgroup with shorter observed survival, but its prognostic value requires confirmation in larger cohorts.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 폐고혈압 관련 우심부전 개에서 흉강액 패턴에 따라 생존 시간이 크게 차이나며, 심낭액을 동반한 경우 가장 짧은 생존 기간과 높은 사망 위험도를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 3개 임상 센터에서 2021년 2월~2025년 4월 사이 폐고혈압 관련 우심부전 개 61마리(복수만 40마리, 복수+흉강액 16마리, 복수+심낭액 5마리)를 대상으로 한 후향적 다기관 관찰 연구로, 중앙 생존 기간이 각각 157일, 42.5일, 7일이었으며, 다변량 Cox 모형에서 심낭액은 복수 단독 대비 조정된 사망 위험도가 높았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 우심부전 개 평가 시 흉강액 패턴을 추가적인 예후 정보로 활용할 수 있으며, 특히 심낭액 동반 여부가 예후 판정에 도움이 될 수 있다. 그러나 심낭액군이 5마리로 매우 소규모이고 후향적 연구이므로, 더 큰 규모 코호트에서의 확인이 필요하다.

papers.title: Distribution and clinical features of raccoon roundworm (Baylisascaris procyonis) infection in dogs and cats as detected by fecal quantitative polymerase chain reaction.
papers.authors: Teng E, Kimmerlein AK, Jimenez Castro PD, Kerl ME, Evason M
papers.abstract: To describe the geographic distribution and clinical features of dogs and cats with Baylisascaris procyonis detected by fecal quantitative PCR (qPCR). Dogs and cats in the US and Canada that were diagnosed with B procyonis via fecal qPCR performed by a veterinary diagnostic laboratory from March 3, 2022, through November 1, 2023, were identified. Details about patient demographics, clinical signs, treatment, and outcome were retrospectively captured via questionnaires sent to each pet's primary care veterinarian. Descriptive statistics were calculated. B procyonis was detected in 74 dogs and 3 cats through fecal qPCR screening. Dogs were from Canada (n = 22) and the US (52), and cats were from the US (3). The US-detected samples were from the Midwest (35%) and Northeast (22%). Most US-detected cases (69%) resided in a suburban environment, and most Canadian cases (80%) resided in an urban environment. Clinical signs were not reported in most (62%) cases with fecal qPCR-detected B procyonis. Gastrointestinal signs were reported in 36% of cases, and resolution of gastrointestinal signs following anthelmintic treatment was reported in most (72.9%) of those. The geographic distribution of detected B procyonis in dogs and cats is similar to that reported in raccoons. Reported clinical disease appears mild and responsive to anthelmintic treatment in most dogs and cats. Veterinarian awareness of risk regions for raccoon roundworm detection is critical for One Health. Detection of B procyonis through routine fecal screening of dogs and cats informs risk of environmental exposure and zoonoses and allows for targeted antiparasitic prevention.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 개와 고양이에서 분변 qPCR로 검출된 Baylisascaris procyonis 감염은 지리적으로 중서부와 북동부 미국에 집중되어 있으며, 대부분의 감염 동물이 임상 징후를 보이지 않거나 경미한 위장관 증상만 나타내고 구충제에 반응한다. [방법·수치] 2022년 3월부터 2023년 11월까지 미국과 캐나다의 개 74마리와 고양이 3마리에서 분변 qPCR로 B. procyonis를 검출했다. 미국 표본은 중서부 35%, 북동부 22%에서 검출되었으며, 증상이 없는 경우 62%, 위장관 증상 36%, 구충제 치료 후 증상 소실률 72.9%였다. [임상 적용·한계] 개와 고양이의 일상적 분변 검사를 통해 B. procyonis 감염을 조기에 발견하면 환경 노출 위험과 인수공통감염 가능성을 평가할 수 있으며, 임상의가 감염 위험 지역에 대한 인식을 갖는 것이 중요하다. 다만 단일 진단 검사실 자료의 후향적 분석이고 고양이 감염 사례가 소수(3례)이다.

papers.title: Retrospective Description of the Outcomes of Dogs With Intraperitoneal Dissemination of Bladder Uroliths and Septic Uroabdomen: Eight Cases From Four Hospitals (2014-2024).
papers.authors: Mattioli G, Bigazzi V, Montinaro V, Cino M, Magno SD
papers.abstract: To describe the clinical features, diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis for dogs diagnosed with septic uroabdomen secondary to bladder rupture and dissemination of uroliths in the peritoneal cavity. Retrospective study. Two veterinary teaching hospitals and two private referral hospitals. Eight adult client-owned dogs. Bladder rupture and migration of uroliths in the abdomen were observed intraoperatively in all eight dogs. Free abdominal uroliths were detected preoperatively by abdominal ultrasonography in three of eight dogs and by radiography in two of five dogs. Partial cystectomy due to bladder wall necrosis was performed in seven of eight dogs. Cytology of the peritoneal fluid identified bacteria in all dogs, and positive culture results were available in seven of eight. The most commonly reported bacterium was Staphylococcus spp. in five of seven dogs, and only one multidrug-resistant bacterial species was isolated. Struvite was the most common type of urolith. No intraoperative or long-term postoperative complications were reported, and all dogs survived to hospital discharge. Mild, transient incontinence occurred in two dogs. Septic uroabdomen secondary to bladder rupture and dissemination of uroliths in the peritoneal cavity can result in a good to excellent prognosis. Because uroliths may not always be detectable on preoperative imaging, a thorough abdominal exploration is recommended.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 방광 파열로 인한 복막염과 복강 내 요석 산재는 철저한 복강 탐색을 통해 좋은 예후를 기대할 수 있으며, 본 연구에서는 8마리 모두 생존 퇴원했고 심각한 합병증이 없었다.
[방법·수치] 2014-2024년 4개 병원의 후향적 증례 연구로 성견 8마리를 대상으로 했다. 수술 소견상 모든 개에서 방광 파열과 요석 산재 확인, 초음파로 3/8마리, 방사선으로 2/5마리에서만 요석 검출, 7/8마리에서 부분 방광절제술 시행, 복강액 배양에서 7/8마리 양성(포도상구균 5/7마리 가장 흔함), 스트루바이트 요석이 가장 많았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 방광 파열로 인한 급성 복막염 의심 시 초음파나 방사선에서 요석이 보이지 않더라도 적극적인 수술적 복강 탐색을 권장하며, 본 연구는 소규모 후향적 증례 보고로 제한된다.

papers.title: Retrospective Evaluation of the Prognostic Value of Neutrophil-to-Lymphocyte Ratio and Platelet-to-Lymphocyte Ratio in Cats With Trauma and Their Relationship With the Animal Trauma Triage Score: 60 Cats (2024-2025).
papers.authors: Parlak K, Akyol ET, Erdogan NZ, Yazıcı S, Besoluk FC
papers.abstract: To evaluate the prognostic use of the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), and blood lactate concentration at admission in cats with trauma. Additionally, we investigated the correlation between these biomarkers and the Animal Trauma Triage (ATT) score. Retrospective study conducted between June 2024 and June 2025. University animal hospital. Medical records of 60 cats with trauma and 47 clinically healthy control cats undergoing preanesthetic screening were reviewed. None. Median NLR and PLR were higher in the trauma group compared with controls (p < 0.001). Among cats with trauma, nonsurvivors had higher PLR (p = 0.013) and ATT scores (p = 0.002), whereas NLR and lactate concentrations did not differ between survivors and nonsurvivors (p = 0.422 and p = 0.246, respectively). In nonsurvivors, negative correlations were observed between ATT score and NLR (ρ = -0.499, p = 0.030) and positive correlations between ATT score and lactate (ρ = 0.476, p = 0.039). NLR and PLR showed differences across ATT score categories (p = 0.011-0.012 and p = 0.208, respectively), with the severe trauma group exhibiting lower NLR values. Receiver operating characteristic analysis demonstrated that PLR had predictive value for mortality (area under the curve  = 0.701, cutoff = 174.80), while NLR showed no prognostic use (area under the curve = 0.435, p = 0.422). Our findings suggest that PLR may serve as a predictive factor for mortality in cats with trauma, whereas no clear predictive value was seen with NLR. These results indicate that extremely low NLR might represent severe immune dysregulation in critical cases. Overall, PLR appears to be a more consistent hematologic biomarker for early risk stratification in this study population, but further prospective validation is warranted.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 외상 고양이에서 혈소판-림프구 비율(PLR)은 사망 예측의 프로그노스틱 인자로 가치가 있으나(ROC AUC=0.701, 절단값=174.80), 호중구-림프구 비율(NLR)은 예측 가치가 없었다(AUC=0.435). 극도로 낮은 NLR은 중증 면역 역조절을 나타낼 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 2024년 6월~2025년 6월 대학 동물병원에서 외상 고양이 60마리와 건강한 대조군 고양이 47마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구. 외상군에서 중앙값 NLR과 PLR이 대조군보다 유의하게 높았다(p<0.001). 사망군에서 PLR이 더 높았으나(p=0.013), NLR은 차이가 없었다(p=0.422). PLR은 사망률 예측에 유의한 차이를 보였으나 NLR은 보이지 않았다.
[임상 적용·한계] PLR을 외상 고양이의 조기 위험도 층화에 사용할 수 있으나, 단일 기관 후향적 소규모 연구로 전향적 검증이 필요하다. 혈청 락테이트 농도는 생존군과 사망군 간 유의한 차이가 없었다(p=0.246).

papers.title: Transmural and Intraluminal Gallbladder Hemorrhage (Hemocholecyst) in a Dog Following Snakebite Envenomation.
papers.authors: Thompson BL, Dreese K, Hawkins IK, Semenova V, Peper K
papers.abstract: To describe a case of hemocholecyst as a sequela to snake envenomation in a dog. A 2-year-old neutered male mixed-breed dog was hospitalized for 4 days after a suspected crotaline envenomation and possible anaphylactic reaction. Significant clinical findings included coagulopathy, thrombocytopenia, hyperbilirubinemia, anemia, multiorgan dysfunction, and hypotension. Point-of-care ultrasound was suggestive of gallbladder wall thickening, a finding frequently associated with anaphylaxis or intramural hemorrhage, with other differentials including cholecystitis, mucocele, or neoplasia. Despite aggressive therapy with antivenom, blood products, and supportive care, the dog experienced cardiopulmonary arrest. Necropsy revealed widespread hemorrhage, multiorgan tissue necrosis, pigment nephropathy, and marked obstructive hemorrhage and necrosis of the gallbladder, consistent with hemocholecyst formation. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first report of hemocholecyst as a sequela to snake envenomation in a dog. Obstructive hemocholecyst and transmural gallbladder wall hemorrhage should remain differentials for severe hyperbilirubinemia in dogs with venom-induced coagulopathy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개에서 뱀 독(크로탈린) 중독 후 혈종담낭증(hemocholecyst)이 발생한 첫 임상 증례로, 독액 유발 응고장애에 동반된 심각한 고빌리루빈혈증의 감별진단으로 담낭 출혈성 괴사를 고려해야 한다.
[방법·수치] 2세 중성화 수컷 믹스견 1례, 의심 크로탈린 중독 후 4일간 입원; 주요 소견은 응고장애, 혈소판감소증, 고빌리루빈혈증, 빈혈, 다장기부전, 저혈압이며 초음파에서 담낭벽 비후가 관찰됨; 항독소, 혈액제제, 집중치료에도 불구하고 심폐정지 발생.
[임상 적용·한계] 뱀 독으로 인한 출혈성 질환의 응급 치료 시 담낭 출혈성 괴사와 함께 고빌리루빈혈증의 감별진단으로 혈종담낭증을 추가 고려해야 하며, 단일 증례 보고로 임상적 빈도나 예후 판단에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Acute Tracheal Narrowing due to Suspected Intramural Tracheal Hemorrhage in a Dog With Hemophilia A.
papers.authors: Kang A, Gonzalez AL, Mazzaferro EM
papers.abstract: To describe a case of spontaneous intramural tracheal hemorrhage with subsequent tracheal narrowing leading to a respiratory crisis in a dog with hemophilia A (factor VIII deficiency). A 5-year-old neutered male Havanese presented in respiratory distress following acute-onset cough. The dog had a known history of hemophilia A and had been evaluated at a different facility the day prior, where thoracic radiographs showed severe tracheal attenuation, leading to a presumptive diagnosis of tracheal collapse. The patient was intubated on presentation due to severe respiratory distress. Serial blood work monitoring showed development of anemia and a prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time. Intramural tracheal hemorrhage was suspected, and a cryoprecipitate transfusion was administered. Subsequent thoracic radiographs at the 1-week follow-up showed improving tracheal attenuation, with complete resolution of tracheal narrowing. In hindsight, having a high index of suspicion of hemorrhage as the cause of respiratory distress at first presentation, and early transfusion of a factor VIII-containing blood product, would have likely reduced the progression and severity of the clinical episode in this dog. Intramural tracheal hemorrhage can present similarly to tracheal collapse and is a differential for tracheal narrowing on radiographs. There have been previous reports of dogs in respiratory distress with tracheal narrowing due to hemorrhage caused by anticoagulant rodenticide toxicosis. This is the first case report documenting spontaneous hemorrhage secondary to hemophilia A causing tracheal narrowing. Although rare, hemorrhage should be considered in all cases of tracheal narrowing, especially in patients without a chronic history of cough and those that fail to respond to standard treatment for tracheal collapse. Dogs with a known diagnosis of hemophilia A should be assumed to have bleeding almost regardless of their clinical presentation and treated accordingly.

[핵심 결론] 혈우병 A 환자견에서 자발적 기관 벽내 출혈로 인한 급성 기관 협착이 호흡곤란을 유발할 수 있으며, 이는 기관허탈과 유사하게 나타나므로 감별진단으로 고려되어야 한다.
[방법·수치] 5세 중성화된 하바니즈견의 증례 보고로, 제8인자 결핍증(혈우병 A) 병력이 있던 환자가 급성 기침 후 호흡곤란으로 내원했다. 흉부 방사선 검사에서 심한 기관 협착이 관찰되었고, 혈액 검사에서 빈혈 발생 및 활성화 부분 트롬보플라스틴 시간의 연장이 확인되었다. 동결침전물 수혈 후 1주일 후속 검사에서 기관 협착이 완전히 해결되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 기관 협착을 보이는 환자에서 특히 만성 기침 병력이 없거나 기관허탈의 표준 치료에 반응하지 않는 경우, 출혈을 감별진단으로 고려해야 한다. 혈우병 A 확진 환자는 임상 증상과 관계없이 출혈 위험이 있다고 가정하고 조기에 제8인자 함유 혈액제제를 투여해야 한다. 단일 증례 보고로 제한된다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Dysbiosis correlates with more severe changes in intestinal function in cats with chronic enteropathy.
papers.authors: Chen CC, Moraiti KT, Giordano MV, Blake AB, Pilla R
papers.abstract: BackgroundMultiple pathophysiological mechanisms have been reported in animals with chronic enteropathy, as reflected by altered serum and fecal metabolites indicative of mucosal damage (e.g., fecal cholesterol, nervonic acid, arachidonic acid), malabsorption (e.g., serum cobalamin, fecal glucose), and loss of microbial function (e.g., fecal bile acid conversion). Furthermore, in dogs, marked intestinal dysbiosis has been linked to more severe underlying intestinal dysfunction, but this relationship is less characterized in cats.ObjectivesCharacterizing fecal microbiome and metabolome in healthy cats (HC), and cats with chronic enteropathy (FCE), either with increased dysbiosis index (DI > 0) or normal DI (< 0).MethodsRetrospective cross-sectional study including 49 HC and 71 cats with FCE. Fecal microbiome was assessed by DNA shotgun sequencing and qPCR-based DI. Targeted fecal metabolites (long-chain fatty acids, sterols, bile acids, and carbohydrates) were measured by mass spectrometry-based platforms.ResultsMultivariate analysis accounted for age, showed significant differences in metabolomic (median R2 [95% CI]: 0.19 [0.15-0.24]), microbial (0.17 [0.11-0.24]), and functional gene (0.16 [0.10-0.25]) profiles in cats with FCE (adjusted-P < 0.01), with more pronounced shifts in those with increased DI. Fecal cholesterol, nervonic acid, and arachidonic acid were higher in FCE (adjusted-P < 0.01) and correlated positively with DI (r = 0.33, 0.41, and 0.44, respectively; adjusted-P < 0.01). Increased fecal glucose and primary bile acid percentage were observed only in FCE-increased DI. A significantly lower cobalamin concentration was observed in cats with increased DI compared to those with a normal DI.Conclusions and relevanceFCE is associated with multiple functional marker alterations, including intestinal cell structural damage, malabsorption, and disrupted microbial function.

[핵심 결론] 고양이 만성 장병증에서 dysbiosis index가 높을수록 장 기능 손상이 더 심하며, 이는 점막 손상, 흡수 불량, 미생물 기능 저하를 포함한 다중 대사 변화와 관련이 있다.
[방법·수치] 건강 고양이 49마리, 만성 장병증 고양이 71마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 단면 연구로, DNA 샷건 시퀀싱과 qPCR 기반 dysbiosis index로 미생물을 평가하고 질량분석으로 대사체를 측정했다. 다변량 분석(연령 보정) 결과 만성 장병증에서 대사체 R2=0.19, 미생물 R2=0.17, 기능 유전자 R2=0.16 (모두 P<0.01)의 유의한 차이를 보였고, dysbiosis 증가군에서 더 두드러진 변화를 나타냈다. 분변 콜레스테롤, 신경산, 아라키돈산이 만성 장병증에서 증가했으며 dysbiosis index와 양의 상관을 보였다 (r=0.33~0.44, P<0.01).
[임상 적용·한계] 만성 장병증 고양이에서 dysbiosis index 측정과 분변 대사체 분석을 통해 질병의 심각도를 평가할 수 있으나, 소규모 단일 기관 단면 연구이고 임상 증상 개선과의 상관성이 명시되지 않아 치료 반응 예측 도구로서의 임상적 타당성은 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Hedgehog Signaling-Dependent Heterochronic Control of Cardiomyocyte Differentiation Establishes Distinct Cardiac Progenitor Fields.
papers.authors: Canac R, Mikolajczak W, Tarampoulous I, Dreyer KS, Nolasco MJ
papers.abstract: The mammalian heart is formed from distinct cardiac progenitor fields: the first heart field (FHF), second heart field (SHF), and juxta-cardiac field (JCF). How these fields are established remains one of the oldest questions in cardiac biology and is central to understanding congenital heart disease, which differentially affects derivatives of the individual fields. Previous work has demonstrated that the fields emerge and differentiate at distinct times; however, the mechanisms underlying their establishment have remained elusive. Here, we implicate Hedgehog signaling-dependent heterochronic control of cardiac differentiation in the emergence of different heart fields. We assessed Hedgehog signaling activity by assembling a cardio-mesodermal single-cell atlas. We analyzed Hedgehog ligand gene expression by confocal imaging in gastrulating mouse embryos. We investigated the necessity of Hedgehog signaling using 2 distinct genetic Hedgehog loss-of-function mouse models, analyzed by single-nucleus RNA sequencing analysis. Our results show that Hedgehog signaling mediates field-specific heterochronic control of differentiation timing that orchestrates the establishment of the SHF and JCF as distinct from the FHF. We identify a common cardiac progenitor transcriptomic state from which all 3 fields emerge. We show that the SHF and JCF are established coincident with Hedgehog signaling reception, whereas the FHF evades Hedgehog pathway activity and rapidly differentiates. We find that Hedgehog ligand expression sandwiches the cardiac mesoderm emerging from the primitive streak, spatially coordinating SHF and JCF establishment. Partial depletion of Hedgehog signaling causes premature activation of the cardiac differentiation program in the SHF and JCF. Complete ablation of Hedgehog signaling results in failed SHF and JCF establishment. Our findings reveal a Hedgehog signaling-dependent, non-cell-autonomous heterochronic mechanism required for SHF and JCF formation.

papers.title: Transapical Beating-Heart Septal Myectomy for Symptomatic Nonobstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Initial Clinical Experience.
papers.authors: Fang J, Chen Y, Zhou W, Li R, Gong C
papers.abstract: Nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM), defined as hypertrophic cardiomyopathy without left ventricular outflow tract obstruction, remains challenging to treat because of its heterogeneous pathophysiology. This study evaluated the safety and efficacy of transapical beating-heart septal myectomy in patients with symptomatic nHCM. Patients with symptomatic, drug-refractory nHCM were prospectively enrolled to undergo transapical beating-heart septal myectomy through a left minithoracotomy. Under real-time transesophageal echocardiographic guidance, septal myectomy was tailored to relieve systolic cavity obliteration and mid-to-apical ventricular obstruction and to enlarge the left ventricular cavity. The primary end point was procedural success at 6 to 12 months postoperatively, defined as fulfillment of all prespecified criteria compared with baseline: ≥1-class improvement in New York Heart Association functional class, ≥10-point increase in Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire score, ≥10-mL increase in stroke volume, and normal or grade I diastolic function. Between January 2023 and January 2025, 97 consecutive eligible patients with nHCM underwent transapical beating-heart septal myectomy at Tongji Hospital. At postoperative 6 to 12 months, procedural success was achieved in 87.6%. Specifically, New York Heart Association functional class I increased from 0% at baseline to 93.8% at follow-up, the median Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire score improved from 64 (interquartile range, 56-69) to 87 (interquartile range, 82-92; P<0.001), the stroke volume increased from 53.5 mL (interquartile range, 41.0-66.6 mL) to 70.8 mL (interquartile range, 61.3-82.3 mL; P<0.001), and normal or grade I diastolic function increased from 65.6% to 97.9%. Among patients who underwent paired cardiopulmonary exercise testing (n=58), peak oxygen uptake increased by 1.1±2.9 mL/kg/min (P=0.008).

papers.title: Biatrial Versus Left Atrial Maze Ablation During Cardiac Valve Surgery for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: The ABLATION Trial.
papers.authors: Li Z, Yu C, Li H, Wang Y, Shao Y
papers.abstract: Guidelines recommend concomitant surgical ablation during cardiac surgery in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). However, the optimal lesion set remains uncertain, with ongoing debate regarding the relative benefits and risks of biatrial versus left atrial (LA) maze ablation. In this multicenter, randomized, single-blind trial, patients with persistent or long-standing persistent AF undergoing rheumatic mitral valve surgery, with or without concomitant cardiac surgical procedures, were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to undergo biatrial or LA maze ablation. The biatrial group underwent a complete Cox-Maze IV procedure; the LA group received a left-sided maze lesion set. To ensure standardization and consistency of the ablation procedures, surgeons underwent pretrial training and certification, and all procedures were videorecorded and centrally reviewed. The primary outcome was freedom from atrial tachyarrhythmias lasting >30 seconds without antiarrhythmic drugs within 12 months. The key secondary end point was freedom from permanent pacemaker implantation. All 323 randomized patients were included in the intention-to-treat analysis (mean age, 56.5 years; 72.1% women; mean LA diameter, 51.9 mm). At 12 months, 78.7% of patients (129 of 164) in the biatrial group and 68.6% (109 of 159) in the LA group were free from atrial tachyarrhythmias (adjusted difference, 10.7% [1-sided lower 95% CI, 3%]; P=0.01). Freedom from permanent pacemaker implantation was noted in 97.0% (159 of 164) of the biatrial group and 98.1% (156 of 159) of the LA group, meeting the predefined noninferiority criterion with a margin of -5% (adjusted difference, -1.1% [1-sided lower 95% CI, -3.9%]; Pnoninferiority=0.01).

papers.title: Transapical Beating-Heart Septal Myectomy for Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
papers.authors: Wei X, Fang J, Wan S
papers.abstract: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a prevalent heterogenous genetic cardiac disorder. In the cardiac myosin inhibitor era, the guideline-directed management of HCM remains an emerging frontier worldwide. Septal myectomy has been the gold standard treatment option for obstructive HCM over the past 60 years. However, the complexity of this procedure and required expertise (and lack of qualified training) have limited its success and availability beyond high-volume HCM centers. Transapical beating-heart septal myectomy (TA-BSM), a newly developed innovative technique, simplifies conventional septal myectomy by eliminating the need for sternotomy, cardiopulmonary bypass, and aortotomy. Most important, the inclusion of real-time intraoperative echocardiographic guidance and evaluation makes TA-BSM safer, more precise, cost-effective, and reproducible. The apparent advantages of TA-BSM, including substantial reductions in surgical trauma and operating times and much faster postoperative recovery in patients with obstructive HCM, are encouraging. TA-BSM is particularly feasible in patients with long-segment obstruction, or small aortic valve annulus, or in those who had undergone previous cardiac operations. The frequent resolution of systolic anterior motion and associated mitral regurgitation after TA-BSM, without concomitant mitral valve intervention, highlights the central role of intraoperative echocardiography and close surgeon-echocardiographer collaboration in achieving optimal procedural outcomes. Further multicenter evaluation of TA-BSM will help define its role among septal reduction strategies for patients with obstructive HCM.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경심첨 무박동심 중격절제술(TA-BSM)은 폐쇄성 비후성 심근병증의 치료에서 기존 중격절제술의 복잡성을 단순화하고, 흉골절개, 체외순환, 대동맥절개를 제거하여 보다 안전하고 정확한 수술을 가능하게 한다. 술중 실시간 심초음파 유도로 수술 외상과 수술시간을 현저히 감소시키고 회복을 촉진한다.
[방법·수치] 폐쇄성 비후성 심근병증 환자를 대상으로 경심첨 무박동심 중격절제술을 수행하였으며, 술중 심초음파 평가를 통해 실시간 감시하였다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] TA-BSM은 장분절 폐쇄, 소구경 대동맥판막, 이전 심장수술 병력이 있는 환자에서 특히 적용 가능하다. 중격절제술만으로 수축기 전방운동과 승모판 역류가 해결되어 추가적 판막 중재 없이도 최적의 결과를 얻을 수 있다. 다기관 추가 평가가 필요하며, 고주파HCM 센터 이외의 의료기관에서의 적용 가능성 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Surgical Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation.
papers.authors: Khiabani AJ, Damiano RJ Jr
papers.abstract: Atrial fibrillation is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia and is associated with an increased risk of stroke, heart failure, mortality, and reduced quality of life. Although catheter ablation is the most widely used rhythm control strategy, its efficacy is limited in patients with non-paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and large left atria. To address this therapeutic gap, surgical approaches, including minimally invasive ablation, hybrid epicardial-endocardial strategies, and left atrial appendage exclusion, have continued to evolve. In this review, we focus on recent evidence to guide clinical decision-making on patient selection, advances in minimally invasive surgical and hybrid techniques, left atrial appendage exclusion, and postoperative anticoagulation management. Minimally invasive standalone Cox-Maze IV procedure and hybrid epicardial-endocardial ablation have demonstrated superior long-term freedom from atrial tachyarrhythmias compared with thoracoscopic epicardial surgical ablation or catheter ablation alone. Five-year arrhythmia-free survival has approached 85% to 95% in experienced centers after the Cox-Maze IV procedure and approximately 60% to 70% after hybrid ablation, compared with 35% to 45% after thoracoscopic epicardial ablation and 30% to 35% after single catheter ablation alone. Surgical left atrial appendage exclusion performed at the time of ablation may further reduce thromboembolic risk, although the optimal strategy for postprocedural anticoagulation remains uncertain. Careful patient selection remains essential, with atrial fibrillation type, duration, left atrial size, and previous treatment failure known to be key predictors of procedural success.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 카테터 절제술의 효과가 제한적인 비발작성 심방세동과 좌심방 확대 환자에서 최소침습 Cox-Maze IV 수술과 하이브리드 심외막-심내막 절제술이 카테터 절제술 단독에 비해 우수한 장기 부정맥 완화 효과를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 최소침습 Cox-Maze IV 수술의 5년 부정맥 무재발 생존율은 85~95%(경험이 많은 센터), 하이브리드 절제술은 약 60~70%, 흉강경 심외막 절제술은 35~45%, 단독 카테터 절제술은 30~35%였다. 환자 선택의 주요 예측인자는 심방세동 유형, 지속 기간, 좌심방 크기, 이전 치료 실패 여부이다.
[임상 적용·한계] 수술적 좌심방 귀 제외술을 절제술과 함께 시행하면 혈전색전증 위험을 추가로 감소시킬 수 있으나, 술후 항응고 치료의 최적 전략은 아직 불명확하다. 고급 병기의 심방세동 환자, 특히 카테터 절제술로 지속적인 율동 조절이 어려울 것으로 예상되는 경우에 단독 수술적 절제술의 역할이 증대될 것으로 보인다.

papers.title: Off-Pump Versus On-Pump Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting in Prefrail and Frail Patients: 30-Day and 1-Year Outcomes From the FRAGILE Randomized Trial.
papers.authors: Mejia OAV, Meneghini B, de Freitas FL, Deininger MO, Segalote RC
papers.abstract: Frailty is associated with worse outcomes after coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG). However, the comparative effectiveness of off-pump CABG (OPCAB) versus on-pump CABG (ONCAB) in prefrail and frail patients remains uncertain. This multicenter, randomized, open-label trial enrolled patients ≥60 years of age classified as prefrail or frail, randomized 1:1, between January 2018 and December 2024. The primary outcome was a 30-day composite of death, myocardial infarction, stroke, renal failure, acute respiratory distress syndrome, or reoperation for bleeding. Secondary outcomes included ventilation time, intensive care unit and hospital stay, transfusion requirements, completeness of revascularization, surgical wound infection at 30 days, and neurocognitive function preoperatively and at 1 year. Analyses followed the intention-to-treat principle; relative risks with 95% CIs were estimated. A total of 508 patients were included (OPCAB, n=258; ONCAB, n=250; median age, 68 years [interquartile range, 65.0-73]; 30.5% female). The primary composite outcome occurred in 28 patients receiving OPCAB (10.9%) and 40 patients receiving ONCAB (16.0%; relative risk, 1.47 [95% CI, 0.94-2.31]; P=0.09). Surgical wound infection was more frequent with ONCAB (20 [8.0%] versus 9 [3.5%]; P=0.04). No significant differences were observed in neurocognitive or quality of life outcomes at 1 year. Estimated 1-year survival probabilities were 96.1% and 92.8% in the OPCAB and ONCAB groups, respectively (P=0.099). In prefrail and frail patients undergoing CABG, OPCAB and ONCAB resulted in similar rates of the primary composite outcome. No significant differences between OPCAB and ONCAB were found in neurocognitive outcomes. URL: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov; Unique identifier: NCT02338947.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 허약/전허약 고령 환자의 관상동맥우회로술에서 off-pump와 on-pump 술식은 30일 복합 주요 합병증(사망, 심근경색, 뇌졸중, 신부전, 급성호흡곤란증후군, 재개복) 발생률에서 유사한 결과를 보였으며, 1년 신경인지 기능도 차이가 없었다.
[방법·수치] 60세 이상 허약/전허약 환자 508명(OPCAB 258명, ONCAB 250명; 중앙값 68세)을 대상으로 한 다기관 무작위 대조 시험(2018-2024년). 30일 복합 주요 결과는 OPCAB 10.9% vs ONCAB 16.0%(상대위험도 1.47, 95% CI 0.94-2.31, P=0.09); 수술부위 감염은 OPCAB 3.5% vs ONCAB 8.0%(P=0.04); 1년 생존율 OPCAB 96.1% vs ONCAB 92.8%(P=0.099).
[임상 적용·한계] 허약 고령 CABG 환자에서 off-pump 술식이 주요 합병증 감소에 명확한 이점을 보이지 않아, 환자 상태와 기관의 경험을 고려한 술식 선택이 필요하다. 단일 기관 경험이 아닌 다기관 연구이나 의도적 치료 분석에 따른 결과 해석의 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Intravascular Lithotripsy vs Super-High-Pressure Noncompliant Balloons for Treatment of Calcified Coronary Lesions: The VICTORY Trial.
papers.authors: Bossard M, Sheth T, Pinilla N, Attinger-Toller A, Cioffi G
papers.abstract: Although calcified coronary lesions are associated with poor outcomes after percutaneous coronary interventions (PCI), randomized data guiding lesion preparation are limited. Small studies suggest potential benefits of super-high-pressure noncompliant balloons (SH-NCB); however, they have not been directly compared with intravascular lithotripsy (IVL). The goal of this study was to conduct a randomized comparison of SH-NCBs vs IVL in calcified lesions. In this open-label, randomized controlled, noninferiority trial with blinded outcomes assessment (ie, the PROBE design), patients aged ≥18 years with calcified coronary lesions were randomly assigned (1:1) to undergo lesion preparation with SH-NCBs or IVL before PCI with drug-eluting stents. All patients were required to undergo optical coherence tomography (OCT). The primary endpoint was final stent expansion (%) according to OCT. Secondary endpoints included procedural success, strategy success, target vessel failure, stent expansion <80%, and safety outcomes (eg, coronary perforation). Between December 21, 2022, and August 11, 2025, a total of 278 patients underwent the randomly assigned study procedure using plaque modification with SH-NCBs or IVL before stent implantation. The majority of patients (68%) had severe calcium based on an OCT Fujino score ≥4. Study procedures involving IVL tended to be longer and require more auxiliary devices compared with SH-NCBs. The median pressure applied with SH-NCBs compared with IVL was 40 atmospheres vs 6 atmospheres. Regarding the primary endpoint of stent expansion, SH-NCBs were noninferior to IVL (85% vs 84%; Pnoninferiority < 0.0001). The results were consistent across all subgroups, including calcium severity. Use of SH-NCBs, compared with IVL, resulted in similar rates of procedural and strategy success. Safety outcomes, specifically coronary perforations, did not differ between the 2 groups.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 석회화된 관상동맥병변의 치료에서 초고압 비순응풍선(SH-NCB)은 혈관내쇄석술(IVL)과 비교하여 스텐트 확장 측면에서 열등하지 않으며 유사한 안전성을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 2022년 12월~2025년 8월 사이 18세 이상의 석회화된 관상동맥병변 환자 278명을 대상으로 한 무작위 대조시험으로, SH-NCB군과 IVL군(1:1)에 배정되어 광학간섭단층촬영(OCT)으로 평가되었다. 1차 평가항목은 최종 스텐트 확장율이었으며, SH-NCB는 85%, IVL은 84%로 비열등성 입증(P<0.0001), 30일 추적관찰에서 목표혈관실패는 SH-NCB군 2.8%(4명), IVL군 5.7%(8명)이었다(HR: 0.50; 95% CI: 0.15-1.66; P=0.26).
[임상 적용·한계] 경험 많은 술자가 혈관내영상을 사용하는 경우 석회화 병변 치료 시 SH-NCB가 IVL의 대안으로 사용 가능하며, 절차 소요시간과 보조장치 사용은 SH-NCB가 더 효율적이었다. 단일 시점의 추적관찰, 개방표지 설계, 선택된 경험 많은 센터의 결과로서 일반화의 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Artificial intelligence-based dental screening using a cellular phone in dogs: a practical tool for detecting visible calculus and gingivitis.
papers.authors: Kim P, Kim SE, Lee E, Huh EA, Kim H
papers.abstract: To train, validate, and evaluate a cellular phone-based AI system for image-level classification of visible dental calculus and gingivitis in conscious dogs. This multicenter retrospective study used dental photographs collected from 12 veterinary hospitals (2022 through 2024). Dental photographs were obtained from conscious dogs using cellular phone cameras. A single veterinarian assigned reference labels using standardized criteria. Separate binary datasets for dental calculus and gingivitis were split by dog into training, validation, and independent test datasets. A convolutional neural network was trained using transfer learning, and final models were selected by validation loss. A total of 3,170 dogs were included in this study. For dental calculus, 2,771 images were analyzed: 2,451 for training and validation and 320 in the independent test dataset. For gingivitis, 1,684 images were analyzed: 1,434 for training and validation and 250 in the independent test dataset. On the independent test datasets, the dental calculus model achieved precision of 0.977 (95% CI, 0.941 to 0.991), sensitivity of 0.965 (95% CI, 0.926 to 0.984), specificity of 0.973 (95% CI, 0.932 to 0.989), accuracy of 0.969 (95% CI, 0.943 to 0.983), and F1 score of 0.971. The gingivitis model achieved precision of 0.912 (95% CI, 0.855 to 0.948), sensitivity of 0.950 (95% CI, 0.901 to 0.976), specificity of 0.881 (95% CI, 0.807 to 0.929), accuracy of 0.920 (95% CI, 0.880 to 0.948), and F1 score of 0.931. The AI system demonstrated high classification performance for visible dental calculus and gingivitis in conscious dogs. This system may serve as an adjunctive screening and triage tool but is not intended to replace comprehensive oral examination or dental radiography.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 휴대폰 기반 AI 시스템이 의식 있는 개의 치석과 치은염을 높은 정확도로 분류할 수 있으며, 임상 선별 및 분류 도구로 활용 가능함을 입증했다.
[방법·수치] 12개 수의 병원에서 2022-2024년 수집한 3,170마리 개의 치아 사진을 대상으로 한 다기관 후향적 연구. 치석 모델: 정밀도 0.977, 민감도 0.965, 특이도 0.973, 정확도 0.969, F1 스코어 0.971; 치은염 모델: 정밀도 0.912, 민감도 0.950, 특이도 0.881, 정의도 0.920, F1 스코어 0.931.
[임상 적용·한계] 완전한 구강 검사나 치과 방사선 촬영을 대체하지 못하며 보조적 선별 도구로만 사용해야 한다. 의식 있는 환자에서만 평가되었고, 단일 수의사의 참고 라벨링으로 인한 잠재적 편향 존재.

papers.title: Computed Tomography Lymphography for Sentinel Lymph Node Mapping in Cats.
papers.authors: Pérez AR, Escoda-Llorens X, Alonso-Fernandez I, Tobon M, Rodriguez-Piza I
papers.abstract: Sentinel lymph node (SLN) mapping improves nodal staging accuracy in veterinary oncology, but computed tomography (CT)-based SLN mapping has not been clinically described in cats with superficial tumours. This prospective study evaluated the feasibility and clinical applicability of indirect CT lymphography for SLN identification in feline superficial tumours. Seventeen client-owned cats with cytologically or histologically confirmed superficial tumours were prospectively enrolled. Following routine contrast-enhanced CT staging, indirect CT lymphography was performed by peritumoural subcutaneous injection of iodinated contrast medium. CT acquisitions were obtained at 1, 3, and 5minutes after injection. SLN identification, lymphatic drainage patterns, opacification characteristics, attenuation values, and metastatic status were assessed. SLN identification was successful in 15/17 cats (88.2%), with a total of 26 SLNs identified. The mandibular lymphocentre was the most frequently identified drainage basin (76.9%). All SLNs demonstrated contrast uptake by 3minutes post-injection. Heterogeneous opacification predominated at all post-injection time points. Atypical lymphatic drainage patterns were identified in 5/15 cats (33.3%), including bilateral drainage within the expected tumour-associated lymphocentre (3/15), contralateral drainage (1/15), and drainage to a non-tumour-associated lymphocentre (1/15). Bilateral drainage was exclusively observed in rostral facial tumours. Neoplastic involvement was identified in 5/26 SLNs (19.2%), including metastatic disease in four SLNs and lymphomatous infiltration in one. Indirect CT lymphography is a feasible and clinically applicable technique for SLN mapping in cats with superficial tumours. The frequent identification of atypical lymphatic drainage patterns highlights the limitations of relying solely on anatomically presumed regional lymph nodes for nodal staging.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 피부 종양에서 간접 CT 림프조영술을 이용한 감시 림프절(SLN) 매핑은 실행 가능하며 임상적으로 적용 가능한 기법이며, 비정형 림프 배액 패턴이 빈번하게 나타나 해부학적 추정만으로는 림프절 병기 결정의 한계가 있음을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 세포학 또는 조직학적으로 확진된 피부 종양을 가진 17마리 고양이를 전향적으로 등록하여 종양 주변에 요오드화 조영제를 피하 주입 후 1, 3, 5분 후 CT 촬영을 수행했다. SLN 확인 성공률 88.2%(15/17), 총 26개 SLN 확인, 하악 림프절 중심이 76.9%로 가장 빈번, 비정형 배액 패턴 33.3%(5/15), SLN 중 종양 침범 19.2%(5/26, 전이 4개, 림프종 침윤 1개).
[임상 적용·한계] CT 림프조영술은 고양이 종양의 림프절 병기 결정을 개선하기 위한 최소침습적 도구로 활용 가능하나, 단일 기관 전향적 연구이고 샘플 크기가 제한적이며 다양한 종양 유형에 대한 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Intrametatarsal pad injection of indocyanine green for near-infrared fluorescence imaging of the thoracic duct in four dogs and two cats with chylothorax.
papers.authors: Composto K, Porter I, Griffin MA, Buote NJ
papers.abstract: To assess the efficacy of direct near-infrared fluorescence (NIRF) using indocyanine green (ICG) via intrametatarsal pad injection in dogs and cats with idiopathic chylothorax. Retrospective case series of client-owned animals undergoing intrametatarsal ICG injection and thoracoscopic thoracic duct ligation between 2020 and 2025. A total of four dogs and two cats. Inclusion criteria consisted of cytologically confirmed chylothorax, preoperative computed tomography (CT) lymphangiogram (CTL), and known intraoperative injection of ICG in the metatarsal pad(s). Data collected included signalment, weight, preoperative diagnostics, number of ducts visualized intraoperatively, dose of ICG, additional doses required, and concordance with CTL. Time to visualization of the ICG in the thoracic duct, surgical procedures performed, and any intraoperative complications encountered were also reported. Postoperative data included time to discharge, time to first recheck, presence of fluid at first recheck, postoperative complications, status at last recheck, and total follow-up time. Median number of ducts seen between T10 and 13 region on preoperative CT was 2.5 (range: 1-4). The ICG dose ranged from 0.06 to 0.25 mg/kg, and two cases required additional injections to visualize the duct and all branches. A duct not previously seen on CT was visualized with NIRF in one dog. Median time to TD visualization was 7 min (range: 5-22 min). No intra- or postoperative complications due to the metatarsal injections were reported, and all patients were discharged. A total of 5/6 patients did not require thoracocentesis and were clinically well at a median last follow-up of 647 days (range: 454-793). Intrametatarsal injection of ICG appears effective for identification of the thoracic duct in animals with chylothorax.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 족근패드 주입 인도시아닌 그린을 이용한 근적외선 형광 영상은 유미흉증 환자의 흉관 식별에 효과적이며, CT 림프관조영에서 보이지 않은 관을 추가로 시각화할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 개 4마리, 고양이 2마리의 후향적 증례 시리즈(2020-2025년). ICG 용량 0.06-0.25 mg/kg, 흉관 시각화까지 중앙값 7분(범위: 5-22분), CT에서 보인 흉관 중앙값 2.5개(범위: 1-4개), 2례는 추가 주입 필요, 1례에서 CT에 미보이던 관이 NIRF로 시각화됨.
[임상 적용·한계] 족근패드 주입 관련 술중·술후 합병증 없었으며 모든 환자가 퇴원했고, 5/6례가 중앙값 647일(범위: 454-793일) 추적 관찰 시 흉수천자 불필요하고 임상적으로 양호했다. 소규모 증례 시리즈로 대규모 비교 연구 필요.

papers.title: Peripheral Artery Disease in Acute Care Settings: Diagnosis and Management of Common Presentations and Emergencies: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association.
papers.authors: Rymer JA, Banerjee S, Beckman J, Damluji AA, McGinigle KL
papers.abstract: People with peripheral artery disease (PAD) are often misdiagnosed or diagnosed late and, even after diagnosis, are undertreated with both pharmacologic and invasive therapies. The disease is associated with an increased risk of mortality, myocardial infarction, stroke, other vascular disease, limb loss, and reduced quality of life. Although the risks and long-term management of PAD are well documented, these risks are acutely magnified when PAD exists as a comorbidity in patients hospitalized for other cardiovascular or medical conditions. Procedures requiring vascular access for the treatment of acute myocardial infarction, cardiogenic shock, or valvular heart disease, as well as procedures for the treatment of the patient's underlying PAD, require special consideration in patients with PAD. Familiarity with the use and placement of mechanical circulatory support in patients with PAD, as well as the management of recent endovascular or surgical vascular interventions, is essential for providing appropriate care in the acute care setting.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 말초동맥질환(PAD) 환자는 진단이 늦어지거나 과소치료되는 경향이 있으며, 급성기 입원 환자에서 PAD가 동반질환으로 존재할 때 사망, 심근경색, 뇌졸중, 사지괴사 위험이 급격히 증가한다.
[방법·수치] 미국심장협회 과학위원회의 급성기 PAD 진단 및 관리에 대한 성명서이며, 급성심근경색·심인성 쇼크·판막질환 치료 중 혈관접근이 필요한 환자와 PAD 환자에서의 고려사항을 다루었다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 응급실 입원 환자에서 PAD 동반 여부를 파악하고, 혈관접근 필수 절차 시 특별한 주의가 필요하며, 기계순환보조장치 사용과 최근 혈관중재술 후 관리에 익숙해야 한다. 성명서 기반으로 구체적 임상시험 근거가 제한적이다.

papers.title: Analytical agreement of a multiparametric, fully quantitative fluorescent immunoassay analyser (Vcheck) with commercial laboratory assays for NT‑proBNP and cardiac troponin‑I in dogs and cats.
papers.authors: Ferasin L, Hudson E, Farminer J, Ferasin H
papers.abstract: Cardiac biomarkers, such as N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) and cardiac troponin-I (cTnI), are widely used in dogs and cats to assess myocardial stretch and injury, respectively. However, most measurements rely on external laboratories, resulting in turnaround times of 2-7 days. The Vcheck analyser is a fully quantitative, automated fluorescent immunoassay platform capable of providing rapid point-of-care results, but independent validation using robust statistical methodology is required. To evaluate the analytical agreement between Vcheck NT-proBNP and cTnI measurements and established commercial assays (Cardiopet® and Access®), and to assess clinical classification concordance, turnaround time, and per-test consumable cost comparison. Paired serum samples from 60 cats and 60 dogs were analysed using Vcheck and corresponding commercial assays. Agreement was assessed using Bland-Altman analysis. Out-of-range values were excluded from Bland-Altman analysis but retained for clinical classification. NT-proBNP demonstrated minimal proportional differences and excellent clinical classification agreement in both species (cats: 100% across all categories; dogs: 88.2-96.0%). Cardiac TnI showed proportional bias, but classification agreement remained high, particularly for elevated and high values (cats: 78.8-100%; dogs: 70.0-94.7%). Vcheck provided results within 10-15 min, compared with 2-7 days for commercial assays, and per-test costs were substantially lower. Vcheck demonstrates analytical agreement with reference laboratory assays for NT-proBNP and cTnI, with substantial advantages in turnaround time and lower per-test consumable costs. These findings support its integration into small-animal cardiology practice, particularly where rapid decision-making is essential.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Vcheck 분석기는 NT-proBNP와 심근트로포닌-I(cTnI) 측정에서 상용 검사실 검사와 우수한 분석적 일치도를 보였으며, 특히 NT-proBNP는 고양이와 개에서 100%, 88.2-96.0%의 임상 분류 일치도를 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 개 60마리, 고양이 60마리의 혈청 샘플을 Vcheck와 Cardiopet/Access 상용 검사로 분석했다. NT-proBNP 임상 분류 일치도는 고양이 100%, 개 88.2-96.0%였고, cTnI는 고양이 78.8-100%, 개 70.0-94.7%였다. Bland-Altman 분석으로 일치도를 평가했다.
[임상 적용·한계] Vcheck는 10-15분 내 결과 제공으로 기존 2-7일 대비 획기적으로 단축되며 검사 비용도 대폭 절감되어 신속한 임상 의사결정이 필요한 소동물 심장질환 진료에 통합 가능하다. 다만 단일 기관 연구이고 표본크기가 제한적이며, cTnI는 비례 편향을 보여 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Comparison of Von Frey filaments and Electronic Von Frey device in healthy dogs - a prospective, randomized, experimental study.
papers.authors: Schütter AF, Bennmann L, Brause S, Rupp V, Freise F
papers.abstract: Quantitative sensory testing (QST) using Von Frey Monofilaments (VFM) is established for assessing mechanical sensitivity in dogs. Alternatively, an Electronic Von Frey device (EVF) is available. At present no direct method comparison with both devices has been conducted in dogs. Therefore, it was aimed to compare usage of EVF and VFM in healthy dogs in terms of inter-rater and inter-device reliability. Further the influence of clipping on results gained and a possible correlation between body weight and sensory threshold should be assessed. In a prospective, randomized experimental study, with four raters VFM and EVF were compared in 61 healthy dogs (18 male, 6 male neutered, 25 female, 12 female spayed) at four anatomical locations across three appointments. Agreement between VFM and EVF was poor across all three appointments (ICC = 0.282-0.285). Inter-rater ICCs were poor for both methods, ranging from 0.25 to 0.34 for VFM and from 0.21 to 0.25 for EVF. Mixed-model analyses revealed significant effects of rater, dog type, anatomical location, and body weight for both devices (p < 0.0001). No significant effect of fur clipping on thresholds was detected for either method. EVF measurements were significantly shorter in duration than VFM (p < 0.001). The two devices do not represent the same test modality and cannot be used interchangeably. Device- and site-specific reference values should be established separately for each method. Given the poor interrater reliability, consistent rater training and the use of a single rater are essential in both clinical and research settings.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Von Frey Monofilaments(VFM)과 Electronic Von Frey device(EVF)는 개의 기계적 감각 역치 측정에서 상호교환 불가능한 서로 다른 검사 양식이며, 각 기기별·부위별 독립적인 참고값 설정이 필요하다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 개 61마리(수컷 18, 중성화 수컷 6, 암컷 25, 중성화 암컷 12)를 대상으로 4명의 평가자가 3회 방문 동안 4개 해부학적 부위에서 VFM과 EVF를 비교한 전향적 무작위 실험 연구; VFM과 EVF 간 일치도는 3회 모두 불량(ICC = 0.282-0.285), VFM 평가자 간 ICC 0.25-0.34, EVF 평가자 간 ICC 0.21-0.25, 평가자·개 타입·해부학적 부위·체중 모두 유의한 영향(p < 0.0001), 털 깎기는 유의한 영향 없음, EVF 측정 시간이 VFM보다 유의하게 단축(p < 0.001).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 및 연구 현장에서 일관된 평가자 훈련과 단일 평가자 사용이 필수적이며, 두 기기의 결과를 직접 비교하거나 상호 대체하면 안 된다; 단일 종·단일 기관 연구로서 다양한 임상 환경에서의 추가 검증 필요.

papers.title: Membranous Ezrin Expression Is Associated With Regional Lymph Node Involvement in Canine Mast Cell Tumours.
papers.authors: Dos Santos MA, Siqueira PB, Maués T, Consalter A, de Freitas BA
papers.abstract: Canine mast cell tumours (MCTs) show variable biological behaviour, ranging from localized tumours to aggressive disease with regional lymph node involvement. Understanding cellular features associated with this variability may help characterize their biological behaviour. Ezrin, a member of the ERM protein family involved in cell motility, has been associated with tumour progression in several neoplasms. However, its role in canine MCT remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate ezrin immunoreactivity and its association with regional lymph node histological status in a retrospective series of 27 canine cutaneous and subcutaneous MCTs. Cytoplasmic and membranous immunolabelling were scored by intensity and percentage of positive neoplastic cells. Cytoplasmic positivity exceeded 50% in 26/27 tumours (96.3%) and membranous positivity exceeded 50% in 19/27 (70.4%). Histological lymph node categories (HN0-HN3) were documented for 26 tumours. The ordinal percentage score for membranous immunolabel correlated positively with HN category (Spearman's ρ = 0.418, two-sided p = 0.034; n = 26), whereas the combined membranous score did not (ρ = 0.259, p = 0.202). The diffuse immunolabelling pattern also showed no statistically significant correlation with HN category (ρ = 0.165, p = 0.430; n = 25). These findings suggest an association between the proportion of MCT cells showing membranous ezrin immunoreactivity and regional lymph node histological status. Further studies are required in order to enlighten ezrin's role in MCT disease evolution.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 비만세포종에서 세포막 국소화 에즈린 발현이 증가할수록 국소 림프절 전이 정도가 높아지며, 이는 종양의 생물학적 공격성과 연관된 가능성을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 개 피부 및 피하 비만세포종 27개 대상 후향적 연구, 에즈린 면역조직화학 염색 평가, 세포질 양성 26/27(96.3%), 세포막 양성 19/27(70.4%), 세포막 양성 세포 비율과 림프절 조직학적 분류(HN 등급)의 상관성 검증(스피어만 상관계수 ρ=0.418, p=0.034).
[임상 적용·한계] 비만세포종의 림프절 전이 위험성 평가 시 세포막 에즈린 발현 비율을 보조 지표로 활용할 수 있으나, 소규모 단일 후향적 연구이고 에즈린의 역할 메커니즘 규명을 위한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Alcohol and cardiovascular disease: inter-organ crosstalk, microvascular dysfunction, and cardiovascular ageing.
papers.authors: Yokus B, Ungvari Z, Haskó G, Lohoff FW, Thum T
papers.abstract: Alcohol-related cardiovascular risk is being fundamentally reappraised. Observational associations suggesting cardioprotection with light-to-moderate drinking have been challenged by contemporary cohort analyses, Mendelian-randomization studies, biomarker-informed investigations, and updated public-health guidance. Uncertainty nevertheless persists at very low exposure levels and for selected coronary or all-cause outcomes. Alcohol is therefore best viewed as a dose-, pattern-, and host-dependent cardiovascular stressor. Acute or binge drinking, sustained heavy intake, chronic intake with episodic binges, and withdrawal produce overlapping but distinct phenotypes, including hypertension, atrial fibrillation, ventricular arrhythmias, sudden death, alcohol-associated cardiomyopathy, heart failure, stroke, and vascular disease. A systems-cardiology framework is presented in which direct myocardial injury, electrical instability, haemodynamic and autonomic stress, vascular and microvascular dysfunction, and disrupted inter-organ signalling interact. Ethanol and acetaldehyde toxicity, redox imbalance, microbial and inflammatory mediators, neurohumoral activation, and metabolic or electrolyte disturbances can impair endothelial signalling, mitochondrial energetics, excitation-contraction coupling, electrical stability, and repair. Pathway dominance varies across exposure patterns and susceptible hosts; coronary microvascular dysfunction may represent a convergence pathway rather than an obligatory mediator. Cumulative injury can diminish perfusion, contractile, electrical, autonomic, and exercise reserve. Alcohol-related cardiovascular ageing is proposed as a unifying cumulative phenotype encompassing mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative and nitrative stress, inflammageing, senescence, impaired repair, circadian and epigenetic dysregulation, fibrosis, and ventriculo-arterial uncoupling, although direct human evidence remains incomplete.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 알코올은 용량, 음주 패턴, 숙주 요인에 따라 달라지는 심혈관 스트레스 물질이며, 급성 폭음에서 만성 과음까지 다양한 표현형(고혈압, 심방세동, 심근병증, 심부전, 뇌졸중)을 유발한다. 알코올 관련 심혈관 노화는 미토콘드리아 기능장애, 산화스트레스, 염증, 섬유화, 심실-동맥 불일치를 포함하는 누적 표현형으로 제시된다.
[방법·수치] 최근 코호트 연구, Mendelian randomization 연구, 바이오마커 연구 및 공중보건 지침을 종합한 체계적 검토이다. 직접 심근 손상, 전기적 불안정성, 혈역학 및 자율신경 스트레스, 혈관 및 미세혈관 기능장애, 장기간 신호전달 장애를 포함한 다층적 기전을 제시하였으며, 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 구조화된 음주 노출 평가와 위험 환자에서의 음주 감량 또는 금주가 심혈관 예방과 치료의 실행 가능한 요소임을 강조한다. 그러나 직접적인 인간 증거가 불완전하며, 나이, 성별, 유전, 동반질환, 수면-일주기 장애, 영양, 약물, 다중 물질 오용에 따른 개별 경로 지배력 및 가역성 평가는 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Changing tonometers, changing intraocular pressure? Rethinking intraocular pressure interpretation in dogs.
papers.authors: Yogo T
papers.abstract: Intraocular pressure measurement is fundamental to the diagnosis and management of canine glaucoma, yet the value reported by a tonometer is inherently dependent on the instrument used.
