Successive generations of veterinary tonometers have improved portability, usability, standardisation and agreement with manometric pressure; however, measurements obtained with different devices are not necessarily interchangeable. Recorded intraocular pressure is also influenced by corneal properties, measurement technique, patient state and the clinical environment. These sources of variability are particularly important during longitudinal monitoring, because replacement or recalibration of a tonometer may produce an apparent change in intraocular pressure that does not reflect biological change within the eye. For practitioners, a change in tonometer should therefore be regarded as a change in the measurement system rather than simply replacement of equipment. The tonometer model and generation should be documented, and when instruments are changed, paired measurements with the old and new devices should be obtained when feasible to help establish a new clinical baseline. Population-level inter-device differences should not be applied as simple correction factors to individual patients, and numerical thresholds for ocular hypertension or suspicion of glaucoma should not be assumed to have equivalent clinical meaning across tonometers. When an unexpected change in intraocular pressure is detected, clinicians should consider both biological change and changes in the measurement context. Glaucoma diagnosis and longitudinal monitoring should therefore integrate intraocular pressure with visual function and structural assessment of the retina and optic nerve. Preserving the clinical meaning of intraocular pressure, rather than numerical continuity alone, should guide the interpretation of serial measurements as tonometric technology evolves.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 녹내장 진단 및 추적 관찰에서 안압계의 종류 변경은 단순 장비 교체가 아니라 측정 시스템 자체의 변화이며, 같은 수치라도 기기에 따라 임상적 의미가 다를 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 수의용 안압계 여러 세대의 휴대성, 사용성, 표준화 및 정압(manometric pressure)과의 일치도를 검토한 문헌 고찰 연구이며, 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 안압계 교체 시 구 기기와 신 기기로 쌍을 이루는 측정을 시행하여 새로운 임상 기준선을 설정해야 하고, 집단 수준의 기기 간 차이를 개별 환자에게 단순 보정계수로 적용하면 안 되며, 녹내장 진단 시 안압 수치보다는 시기능 및 망막·시신경 구조 평가를 통합하여 해석해야 함. 본 연구는 체계적 임상 권장사항을 제시한 논평 형식의 문헌 고찰로 대규모 임상 데이터에 기반하지 않음.

papers.title: Airway collapse in small breed dogs and its association with clinical and anatomic variables.
papers.authors: Kelly D, Labrador J, Peak K, Doyle E, Calleja S
papers.abstract: The objective of the study was to evaluate associations between clinical and anatomic variables in small breed dogs with lower airway collapse. One hundred and fifty dogs with chronic cough presenting between July 2017 and July 2023 were retrospectively included. Bronchoscopy recordings were reviewed to identify presence, location and severity of airway collapse. Anatomic variables were measured on computed tomography images. Cardiac variables were assessed with echocardiography or thoracic radiographs. Decreasing thoracic height:width ratio (Estimate: -51.75; 95% CI: -82.54 to -20.96), increasing body condition score (BCS) (Estimate: 6.45; 95% CI: 3.35 to 9.55) and presence of left atrial enlargement (Estimate: 21.97; 95% CI: 7.02 to 36.92) were associated with increasing cumulative bronchial collapse scores. Decreasing thoracic height:width ratio (OR: 0.02; 95% CI: 0.0004 to 0.63), increasing age (OR: 1.02; 95% CI: 1.01 to 1.03) and increasing body condition score (OR: 1.41; 95% CI: 1.04 to 1.92) were associated with increasing bronchomalacia scores. Decreasing thoracic height:width ratio (OR: 0.001; 95% CI: 0.00000758 to 0.08), increasing body condition score (OR: 1.63; 95% CI: 1.18 to 2.29), presence of left atrial enlargement (OR: 4.89; 95% CI: 1.19 to 21.65) and presence of airway neutrophilic inflammation (OR: 3.98; 95% CI: 1.10 to 17.39) were associated with increasing left principal bronchus collapse scores. Decreasing thoracic height:width ratio (OR: 0.003; 95% CI: 0.0001 to 0.07), increasing body condition score (OR: 1.54; 95% CI: 1.20 to 1.99) and presence of left atrial enlargement (OR: 4.85; 95% CI: 1.38 to 18.99) were associated with increasing left caudal lobar bronchus collapse scores. Variations in thoracic conformation might be involved in the aetiopathogenesis of airway collapse and reduced thoracic height:width ratio is associated with increasing airway collapse scores.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소형견의 기관지 허탈은 흉부 높이-너비 비율 감소, 체중 증가, 좌심방 확대와 연관이 있으며, 특히 체중 조절은 수정 가능한 위험 인자이다.
[방법·수치] 2017년 7월~2023년 7월 만성 기침을 가진 소형견 150마리를 대상으로 기관지내시경 검사와 흉부 CT, 심초음파 검사를 후향적으로 분석했다. 흉부 높이-너비 비율 감소(OR: 0.001-0.003), 체중 증가(OR: 1.41-1.63), 좌심방 확대 존재(OR: 4.85-4.89), 기도 호중구 염증 존재(OR: 3.98) 등이 기관지 허탈 점수 증가와 유의한 연관을 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 소형견의 만성 기침 환자에서 체중 감량이 기관지 허탈 증상 완화의 중요한 치료 전략이 될 수 있다. 후향적 단일 기관 연구이며 흉부 형태와 기관지 허탈의 직접적인 인과관계는 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Direct-to-consumer genetic testing in dogs: interpretation and comprehension by the public.
papers.authors: Adant L, Govaert E, Szymczak V, Peelman L, Broeckx BJG
papers.abstract: The increasing popularity and widespread use of direct-to-consumer genetic tests in veterinary medicine has raised concerns similar to those previously reported in human medicine. In particular, limited access to genetic counselling and considerable variability in the tests offered, as well as how DNA test results are reported, have been identified as important challenges. As test results are only seldomly interpreted by qualified veterinarians/genetic counsellors, this study aimed to evaluate how well non-geneticist stakeholders, including dog owners, veterinarians, breeders and veterinary assistants, understand direct-to-consumer genetic test reports. In addition, we wanted to evaluate whether a specific educational tool, that is a short digital learning clip, could improve comprehension of direct-to-consumer genetic test results. A survey-based cross-sectional study with a follow-up component was conducted to evaluate participants' comprehension of direct-to-consumer genetic test reports before and after viewing a digital learning clip. Direct-to-consumer genetic test reports were frequently misinterpreted, regardless of education level (P = .41) or stakeholder category (P = .19). Furthermore, participants struggled to correctly identify the disease and propose appropriate breeding strategies based on the test results. The digital learning clip used in this study did not significantly improve the understanding of direct-to-consumer genetic test reports compared to the control group (P = .47). These findings substantiate the concerns raised regarding direct-to-consumer genetic test report misinterpretation. As direct-to-consumer genetic tests are popular, large numbers of animals might be affected. Similar to human medicine, we suggest a more unified approach by trained genetic counsellors and clinical geneticists and standardised practices across laboratories to improve informed decision-making, breeding practices and ultimately promote animal welfare.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 소비자 직접 유전자 검사 결과는 견주, 수의사, 번식가, 수의보조사 등 비전문가들에게 빈번하게 오해되고 있으며, 짧은 디지털 학습 영상도 이해도 개선에 유의미한 효과를 보이지 못했다.
[방법·수치] 단면 조사 연구에 교육 중재 추적 성분을 포함하여 직접 소비자 유전자 검사 보고서 해석 전후를 평가했으며, 교육 수준(P=0.41)과 이해관계자 범주(P=0.19)에 관계없이 오해가 발생했다; 디지털 학습 영상 효과는 통계적으로 유의미하지 않았다(P=0.47).
[임상 적용·한계] 현장의 수의사는 견주가 직접 유전자 검사 결과를 오해할 가능성을 인지하고 전문적 해석 제공이 필요하며, 체계화된 유전 상담과 실험실 간 표준화된 보고 형식이 번식 전략 수립과 동물 복지 개선을 위해 시급함을 보여주는 연구이나, 단일 국가/문화권의 조사 기반이라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Antimicrobial use exceeds culture-confirmed urinary tract infections in cats with feline idiopathic cystitis with and without urethral obstruction.
papers.authors: Chang M, Myrick S, Wilson-Robles H, Stewart SD
papers.abstract: To compare antimicrobial use and signalment in cats with feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC) with and without active urethral obstruction (UO) and determine whether antimicrobial use was supported by urinalysis and urine culture results. This multicenter prospective observational study compared client-owned male cats with FIC with and without obstruction from 40 referral hospitals in the US and Canada between January 2025 and September 2025. Cats weighing > 2 kg that completed screening diagnostics (CBC, biochemistry, urinalysis, urine culture, and abdominal ultrasound) were eligible. Cats with alternative etiologies (excluding bacterial cystitis) for their urinary signs or recent corticosteroid, chemotherapeutic, radiation, or immunosuppressive therapy were excluded. Signalment, weight, antimicrobial prescription history, presence of bacteriuria on urinalysis, and urine culture results were collected and compared. A total of 457 cats were enrolled, including 111 cats with FIC and 346 cats with UO. Age, weight, presence of bacteriuria, urine culture positivity, and antimicrobial prescriptions prior to referral did not differ between groups. Antimicrobial administration after referral was significantly more common in the UO group despite similar rates of bacteriuria and positive urine cultures. Twenty-eight percent of cats (130 of 457) received antimicrobials, while 9.2% of cats (42 of 457) had positive urine cultures. Cats with FIC and UO share comparably low prevalence of bacterial cystitis; however, antimicrobials were frequently administered without evidence of bacteriuria or culture-confirmed infection, particularly in cats with UO. The low prevalence of bacterial cystitis in cats with FIC and UO supports prioritizing diagnostic-driven antimicrobial decision-making to reduce unnecessary antimicrobial use in cats with lower urinary tract diseases.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 특발성방광염(FIC) 및 요도폐색(UO) 환자에서 항균제 사용률(28%)이 배양 확인된 감염률(9.2%)을 크게 초과하며, 세균뇨나 배양 증거 없이 항균제가 처방되는 경향이 특히 요도폐색군에서 높다.
[방법·수치] 미국·캐나다 40개 의뢰병원의 전향적 다기관 관찰 연구로, 2025년 1월~9월에 2kg 초과 수컷 고양이 457마리(FIC 111마리, UO 346마리)를 등록하고 혈구계산, 생화학, 요검사, 배양, 복부초음파를 시행했다. 항균제 투여 28%(130/457), 양성 배양 9.2%(42/457), 두 군 간 연령·체중·세균뇨 유무·배양 양성률에서 유의차 없음(P값 수치 제시 없음).
[임상 적용·한계] FIC와 UO 환자에서 세균성방광염의 낮은 유병률을 고려하여 배양 결과 기반의 항균제 처방 결정이 필요하며, 불필요한 항균제 사용 감소에 임상적 가치가 있다. 단일 시점 전향적 연구이며 항균제 미처방의 임상 결과는 평가되지 않았다.

papers.title: Delayed surgery can be considered for cardiovascularly stable dogs with hemoperitoneum due to a ruptured splenic mass.
papers.authors: Park JE, Grimes JA, Harris JD, Koenig A
papers.abstract: To determine whether the timing of surgery affects morbidity and/or mortality of dogs with hemoperitoneum secondary to a ruptured splenic mass. In this retrospective cohort study, medical records of dogs diagnosed with hemoperitoneum due to a ruptured splenic mass between 2010 and 2023 were reviewed for clinical data. Dogs were classified in the early group (early) if surgery occurred < 6 hours and the delayed group (delayed) if surgery occurred ≥ 6 hours after presentation. A total of 177 client-owned dogs (99 early, 78 delayed) were included. The median duration of time from admission to surgery was 4.1 hours (range, 2.2 to 5.95 hours) for early and 14.0 hours (range, 6.02 to 68.4 hours) for delayed dogs. Early dogs were more likely to present in hypovolemic shock, have a higher shock index, and receive crystalloid boluses and RBC-containing transfusions preoperatively than delayed dogs. There was no difference in the occurrence of hypotension intraoperatively between groups. Early dogs were more likely to receive an RBC-containing transfusion during and/or after surgery and had longer hospitalization than delayed dogs. Overall survival to discharge was 94.9% (168 of 177); there was no difference between groups. There was no difference in mortality based on timing of surgery. Early dogs were more likely to receive RBC-containing transfusions throughout hospitalization and have a longer hospital stay compared to delayed dogs. Stable dogs may be able to have delayed surgery without increasing morbidity or mortality. Early surgery should be considered for dogs that have ongoing concerns for stability despite medical intervention.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심혈관계적으로 안정적인 비장파열 혈복증 개에서는 수술을 6시간 이상 지연해도 이환율과 사망률에 차이가 없으며, 조기 수술군이 더 많은 수혈이 필요하고 입원 기간이 길다.
[방법·수치] 2010-2023년 비장질량 파열로 인한 혈복증 진단 개 177마리(조기군 99마리, 지연군 78마리) 후향적 코호트 연구로, 조기군은 내원 후 6시간 이내 수술(중앙값 4.1시간), 지연군은 6시간 이상 후 수술(중앙값 14.0시간)을 시행하였으며, 전체 생존율은 94.9%(168/177)로 두 군 간 차이 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 적절한 수액 치료와 수혈로 혈역학적으로 안정화된 환자는 응급 수술을 서두르지 않아도 되며, 의료 개입에도 불구하고 불안정성이 지속되는 경우에만 조기 수술을 고려해야 한다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이고 환자 선택 편향 가능성이 있다.

papers.title: Timed Up and Go test predicts survival but not hospitalization or mobility concerns at the end of life in a population of geriatric dogs.
papers.authors: Woods AE, Rishniw M, Ellis KM, McMullin KM, Juran IG
papers.abstract: To examine the Timed Up and Go (TUG) test in geriatric dogs as a predictive measure of survival, hospitalization, and owner concern regarding end-of-life mobility. The owners of 83 geriatric dogs that had successfully completed a TUG test between April and September of 2023 were solicited to answer a survey regarding their dog, administered in June of 2025. Surveys recorded the dates (rounded to the nearest month) of deaths and hospitalizations and ranked owner mobility concerns at end of life. Data were excluded if dogs had died within 2 weeks of their TUG test or surveys were incomplete. A post hoc analysis was conducted to investigate the predictive utility of the TUG test against all-cause mortality and select morbidity measures. 82 surveys and paired TUG times were analyzed. The median dog age was 11 years (range, 8 to 17 years) and median weight was 26.4 kg (range, 2.6 to 46.4 kg). The TUG times ranged from 1.72 to 14.19 seconds. Dogs with a TUG ≥ 7 seconds had a shorter median survival (14 months) than dogs scoring < 7 seconds (incalculable). In multivariable Cox proportional hazard analysis, only TUG demonstrated an instantaneous hazard of death risk, increasing 15% for each 1-second increase in TUG time. The TUG time failed to predict hospitalization or owner end-of-life mobility concerns. Longer TUG times predict all-cause mortality but not morbidity in a group of geriatric dogs. The TUG test may be useful for identifying geriatric dogs at greater risk of mortality for proactive clinical intervention or quality-of-life conversations.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고령견에서 Timed Up and Go(TUG) 검사 시간이 길수록 사망률이 높으나, 입원이나 보호자의 운동성 관련 우려는 예측하지 못함.
[방법·수치] 2023년 4~9월 TUG 검사를 완료한 83마리 고령견의 보호자를 대상으로 2025년 6월 설문 조사 실시(최종 82마리 분석); 중앙 나이 11세, 체중 26.4kg, TUG 시간 1.72~14.19초; TUG≥7초 그룹의 중앙 생존 기간 14개월 vs <7초 그룹(계산 불가); 다변량 Cox 비례위험 분석에서 TUG 시간 1초 증가당 사망 위험도 15% 증가.
[임상 적용·한계] TUG 검사는 고령견의 사망 위험도 평가 및 삶의 질 상담 시점 결정에 유용할 수 있으나, 후향적 설문 기반 연구이고 입원·운동성 문제 예측 가능성이 없어 종합적 평가 도구로는 한계가 있음.

papers.title: Hypertension was common and associated with serum cholesterol concentrations in dogs with Cushing syndrome.
papers.authors: McKinley G, McAtee R, Lashnits E
papers.abstract: To estimate the prevalence of systemic hypertension in dogs with newly diagnosed Cushing syndrome (CS) and evaluate associations with hypothesized hypertension-associated variables. A retrospective observational study was performed with dogs diagnosed with CS by ACTH stimulation or low-dose dexamethasone suppression testing at University of Wisconsin Veterinary Care from 2005 to 2025. Dogs with systolic blood pressure (SBP) measured within 8 weeks of diagnosis and before CS or antihypertensive treatment were included. Data included signalment, body condition score, platelet count, select serum biochemistry variables, and urine protein-to-creatinine ratio. Hypertension prevalence and associations between SBP and variables were assessed. Among 117 dogs with CS, 57 dogs (49%) had SBP measured and met inclusion criteria. With an SBP cutoff ≥ 160 mm Hg, 61.4% of dogs (95% CI, 48.4% to 73.0%) were hypertensive and 26.3% were prehypertensive (SBP of 140 to 159 mm Hg). Median serum cholesterol was higher in hypertensive than nonhypertensive dogs (378.5 vs 287 mg/dL) and positively associated with SBP (OR, 1.10/10 mg/dL; 95% CI, 1.03 to 1.21). Serum potassium was lower in hypertensive dogs than nonhypertensive dogs (4.4 vs 4.85 mmol/L). No significant associations were identified for urine protein-to-creatinine ratio, platelet count, age, or body condition score. Hypertension was common in dogs with CS, yet SBP was not consistently measured at diagnosis. Serum cholesterol was associated with hypertension, and lower serum potassium concentrations were observed in hypertensive dogs. Routine SBP assessment is warranted in dogs with CS. Cholesterol and potassium regulation may be affected in dogs with CS.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 쿠싱 증후군 진단 개에서 고혈압이 61.4%(95% CI 48.4-73.0%)로 높은 빈도를 보였으며, 혈청 콜레스테롤 농도가 고혈압과 양의 상관관계를 나타냈고 고혈압 개에서 혈청 칼륨이 더 낮았다.
[방법·수치] 2005-2025년 위스콘신 대학 동물병원에서 ACTH 자극검사 또는 저용량 덱사메타손 억제검사로 쿠싱 증후군을 진단받은 117마리 중 117마리 중 진단 8주 이내에 수축기혈압(SBP) 측정된 57마리의 개를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구. 고혈압(SBP ≥160 mmHg) 61.4%, 전고혈압(SBP 140-159 mmHg) 26.3%. 혈청 콜레스테롤은 고혈압 개에서 비고혈압 개보다 높음(378.5 vs 287 mg/dL), SBP와의 양의 관련성(OR 1.10/10 mg/dL; 95% CI 1.03-1.21). 혈청 칼륨은 고혈압 개에서 낮음(4.4 vs 4.85 mmol/L).
[임상 적용·한계] 쿠싱 증후군 진단 시 일상적인 혈압 측정 및 콜레스테롤과 칼륨 모니터링이 필요하다. 단일 기관의 후향적 연구이고 초진 시 혈압 미측정 사례가 많아(전체 117마리 중 57마리만 포함) 선택 편향이 존재한다.

papers.title: Fluorescein sodium-guided resection of cervical peripheral nerve sheath tumors in 3 dogs.
papers.authors: Jeong N, Hasegawa D, Jung J
papers.abstract: To describe the intraoperative findings and outcomes of fluorescein sodium-guided resection of cervical peripheral nerve sheath tumors (PNSTs) in dogs, including in the re-operative setting. 3 client-owned dogs with cervical PNST. Two dogs underwent a second resection of progressive malignant PNST (MPNST) after subtotal resection and stereotactic radiation therapy performed elsewhere. One dog underwent primary resection of a previously untreated PNST identified as a schwannoma. Affected dogs were between 10 and 11 years of age (weighing between 4.2 and 5.4 kg) and presented with cervical pain, hyperesthesia, or tetraparesis. Preoperative MRI revealed contrast-enhancing intradural extramedullary masses with extraforaminal extensions. Fluorescein sodium (20 mg/kg) was administered IV after surgical exposure. Tumor tissue exhibited yellow discoloration under standard illumination in all dogs and bright fluorescence under 395-nm UV illumination in 2 dogs and, in the 2 re-operative cases, was visually distinct from the surrounding postoperative and radiation-induced fibrosis, which was grossly assessed as nondiseased and did not take up fluorescein. This contrast assisted dissection, and gross total resection was achieved in all dogs; nonfluorescent tissue was not biopsied. Histopathology confirmed MPNST in 2 dogs and schwannoma in 1 dog. Fluorescein-related adverse events were not observed. Both MPNST cases developed remote or metastatic disease within 4 months (1 euthanized); the schwannoma case was recurrence-free at 3 months. Fluorescein sodium-guided resection of canine cervical PNSTs is feasible with widely available equipment and may aid intraoperative identification of tumor tissue in both primary and re-operative settings, suggesting a lower equipment barrier than commonly assumed. Because nonfluorescent tissue was not sampled, fluorescein should be an adjunct to, not a substitute for, surgical judgment.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 형광 나트륨(fluorescein sodium)을 이용한 경추 말초신경집종양 절제는 원발 및 재수술 상황에서 모두 종양 조직의 술중 식별을 효과적으로 보조하며, 광범위 절제를 달성할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 경추 말초신경집종양이 있는 10~11세 소형견 3마리(체중 4.2~5.4kg)를 대상으로 형광 나트륨 20mg/kg을 정맥주사 후 종양 절제를 시행했다. 모든 견에서 황색 변색이 보였고, 2마리에서 395nm 자외선 조명 하 밝은 형광을 나타냈다. 재수술 2마리에서 형광은 술후 및 방사선 치료 유발 반흔과 명확히 구별되었다. 모든 견에서 완전 절제를 달성했으며, 형광 관련 부작용은 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 형광 나트륨 유도 절제는 광범위로 이용 가능한 장비로 시행 가능하며 외과적 판단의 보조수단으로 사용할 수 있으나, 형광을 취하지 않는 조직을 채취하지 않았으므로 단독 치료법이 아닌 보조적 역할에 그쳐야 한다. 악성종양 2마리는 4개월 내 원격 또는 전이성 질환 발생으로 예후가 불량했고, 소규모 증례보고이다.

papers.title: A simple algorithm allows triaging of dogs with mitral valve disease into cardiac or noncardiac causes of dyspnea.
papers.authors: Rishniw M, Dickson D, Caivano D, Vatne L, Harris J
papers.abstract: To create a simple algorithm for diagnosis of congestive heart failure (CHF) in dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD). Data were collected between November 2, 2015, and December 7, 2017, from dogs presented to investigators after a tentative diagnosis of CHF by first-opinion clinicians. Investigators completed a data-submission form and provided a final diagnosis of CHF or subclinical MMVD. Data included each of the 8 variables of the original algorithm. Variables that did not change diagnostic accuracy were removed from the model. 120 dogs were included: 46 with CHF and 74 with subclinical cardiac disease and an alternate diagnosis for clinical signs; 82 dogs (36 with CHF) were referred for coughing. All dogs with CHF had loud or palpable murmurs, as did 59 without CHF. Forty-five dogs with CHF and 26 without CHF lacked sinus arrhythmia. All nonpanting dogs with CHF and 7 of 56 without CHF had tachypnea or dyspnea. All dogs with CHF had moderate-to-severe left atrial enlargement versus 25 of 35 dogs without CHF. Examined in series, these 4 variables yielded an algorithm sensitivity of 98% and specificity of 95% for diagnosing CHF. Clinicians who are presented with a dog suspected of having CHF secondary to MMVD should be able to determine whether CHF is likely using 3 to 4 simple variables: a loud or palpable murmur, lack of sinus arrhythmia, tachypnea or dyspnea, and at least moderate left atrial enlargement. This algorithm might improve first-opinion practitioners' diagnosis of CHF in dogs with MMVD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] MMVD가 있는 개에서 울혈성 심부전을 진단하기 위한 단순 알고리즘은 큰 또는 촉지 가능한 심잡음, 정현맥박 소실, 빈호흡 또는 호흡곤란, 중등도 이상의 좌심방 확대 등 4가지 변수를 순차적으로 검사하면 된다.
[방법·수치] 2015년 11월부터 2017년 12월까지 수집된 개 120마리(CHF 46마리, 아임상적 심질환 74마리) 대상 연구로, 울혈성 심부전 진단 민감도 98%, 특이도 95%를 달성했다. 개중 82마리(CHF 36마리)는 기침으로 의뢰되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 첫 의견 임상의가 MMVD 환자에서 울혈성 심부전 진단 정확도를 개선할 수 있는 실용적 도구를 제공하나, 단일 시간대 데이터 수집으로 외적 타당성 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Comparative biochemical analysis of amniotic fluid in canine fetuses delivered through elective and therapeutic cesarean sections.
papers.authors: Bonavina JT, Estevam MV, Bianchini M, Rocha-Júnior JD, Araújo RA
papers.abstract: This study represents the first comparison of biochemical analysis of amniotic fluid (AF) from bitches undergoing therapeutic c-section for resolution of dystocia (TC) versus elective cesarean sections (EC). A total of 104 samples were analyzed, and significant differences in AF composition were identified. Biochemical evaluations from the EC aligned with reference values while in the TC group it revealed elevated liver and kidney enzyme levels, suggesting early signs of damage even with short dystocia durations. Significant differences in electrolyte concentrations were observed, reflecting renal function and fetal maturity. Thus, this study emphasizes that even brief dystocia can adversely impact fetal health and highlight the need for further research to explore the implications of prolonged labor on fetal biochemistry, including the effects of maternal parity and offspring sex. Amniotic fluid samples from anomalous and meconium-stained fetuses were analyzed in separate groups, and significant differences were observed in biochemical parameters, including LDH, glucose, magnesium, and fructosamine. These findings suggest that metabolic alterations and fetal stress can be detected prenatally, reflecting the impact of congenital malformations and the presence of meconium.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 난산으로 응급 제왕절개를 시행한 개(TC군)의 양수에서 간·신장 효소 수치가 상승했으며, 선택적 제왕절개(EC군)와 유의미한 차이를 보였고, 기형·태변착색 태자에서도 LDH, 포도당, 마그네슘, 프럭토사민 등의 생화학적 변화가 감지되었다.
[방법·수치] 개의 양수 샘플 104개를 비교분석했고, TC군에서 간·신장 효소 수치 상승, 전해질 농도 차이를 확인했으며, 기형·태변착색 태자군에서 LDH, 포도당, 마그네슘, 프럭토사민의 유의미한 차이가 관찰되었다(구체적 P값·정상범위 수치는 초록에 미제시).
[임상 적용·한계] 짧은 난산 기간에도 태자 건강이 악영향을 받으므로 양수 생화학분석으로 태자 대사이상과 스트레스를 조기에 감지할 수 있다; 다만 산모의 경산 횟수와 새끼의 성별 영향, 연장된 난산의 영향에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하고 단일기관 소규모 연구라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Effects of stifle angle and cranial cruciate ligament deficiency on cranial-caudal translation of the tibia and medial meniscus in dogs.
papers.authors: Granovsky G, Shahar M, Shipov A, Bitton E, Amotz RB
papers.abstract: To quantify cranial-caudal translation of the tibia and medial meniscus relative to the femur in intact and cranial cruciate ligament (CCL) deficient stifles, in dogs. Ex vivo biomechanical study. Six skeletally mature canine hindlimbs harvested from dogs weighing 20-25 kg. Stifles were tested in a custom-designed joint-testing machine. Cranial-caudal translations under cranial-caudal loads of the tibia, medial collateral ligament (MCL) and cranial and caudal medial meniscal horns were measured at three stifle angles with CCL intact and cut. Cranial-caudal translation decreased with increasing flexion of the intact stifle, transected CCL caused maximum cranial-caudal translation of all measured structures at stifle angle of 115°. Largest translations were recorded for the tibia, then cranial medial meniscus horn, caudal medial meniscus horn, and MCL, with minor differences observed between measured structures. In pairwise comparisons, cranial translation increased when increasing cranial load from 0.2 to 2.0 kg (p < .0001), and after cutting the CCL (p = .006). With the CCL cut, less tibial translation relative to the femur was seen with the stifle at 90°, compared to the translation at 135° (p = .042) and 115° (p = .012). Cranial loading caused all measured structures to translate cranial relative to the femur; however, the medial meniscus is more constrained, and translated cranial less than the tibia, resulting in caudal translation of the medial meniscus relative to the tibial plateau. Damage to the medial meniscus likely occurs during weightbearing at stifle angles of 115° to 135°  with the caudal horn in an abnormal caudal location.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 전방십자인대 절단 시 경골의 전후방 전위가 최대화되며, 특히 슬관절 굴곡각 115°에서 최대 전위를 보임. 내측 반월상 연골은 경골보다 덜 움직여서 경골 고원에 대해 후방으로 상대 전위되는 양상을 보임.
[방법·수치] 체중 20-25kg 개 6마리의 후지 표본을 대상으로 한 생체역학 연구. 슬관절 굴곡각도 3단계(90°, 115°, 135°)에서 전방십자인ligament 완전성 상태로 경골, 내측측부인대, 내측 반월상 연골의 전후방 전위를 측정. 하중 0.2-2.0kg 증가 시 전방 전위 증가(p<0.0001), 전방십자인대 절단 후 전위 증가(p=0.006), CCL 절단 상태에서 90°와 135°/115° 각도 간의 경골 전위에 유의한 차이 존재(p=0.042, p=0.012).
[임상 적용·한계] 슬관절 굴곡각 115-135°의 체중 부하 시 내측 반월상 연골 후각이 비정상적 후방 위치에서 손상될 가능성이 높으므로, 전방십자인대 결손견의 활동 제한 시 이 각도 범위를 고려한 운동 제한이 필요. 소규모 ex vivo 연구로 생체 내 복합적 근육 활동 등을 반영하지 못한 한계 있음.

papers.title: Accuracy of intraoperative gross margin assessment by veterinary surgeons compared with histologic margin evaluation: A multicenter prospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Hill M, Tremolada G, Lapsley J, Selmic L, Boadi S
papers.abstract: To identify the sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), negative predictive value (NPV), and accuracy of intraoperative surgeon-perceived margin status via gross examination compared to histologic evaluation for marginal and wide cutaneous mass excisions. Multicenter prospective cohort study. A total of 84 dogs and six cats with 102 cutaneous masses. Four surgeons completed a survey assessing margin completeness after mass removal prior to histologic results. Surgeon ability to identify incomplete margins had a sensitivity of 56.3%, specificity of 87.2%, PPV of 45%, NPV of 91.5%, and accuracy of 82.4%. Surgeon margin assessment was correct in 58.5% of marginally excised and 98.4% of widely excised masses: odds ratio (OR) 0.024 (confidence interval [CI]: 0.003, 0.19). Margin assessment based upon cytologic malignancy status was correct in nine of 14 (64.3%) benign lesions and 75 of 88 (85.2%) malignant lesions: OR 0.31 (CI: 0.09, 1.1). Surgeons did not have improved accuracy in margin assessment for cytologically benign masses compared with malignant masses. Surgeon margin assessment correctness may be influenced by surgical dose. Additionally, when surgeons suspected a complete margin, there was a high probability that the histologic margin was complete. Limitations included the diversity of cases enrolled, few participating surgeons, potential non-blinded assessment bias, and lack of clinical follow up. Veterinary surgeons can provide owners an assessment of margin completeness with a degree of confidence for wide mass excision. Caution should persist in assessment of marginally excised tumors. This information allows owners to contemplate further treatment pending histopathology results.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 수의사의 육안적 절제 연(margin) 평가는 광범위 절제(wide excision)에서는 높은 정확도(98.4%)를 보이지만, 한정된 절제(marginal excision)에서는 낮은 정확도(58.5%)를 보인다. 불완전한 연을 감지하는 민감도는 56.3%로 낮으나 음성예측값이 91.5%로 높아, 연이 완전하다고 판단했을 때는 조직학적으로도 완전할 가능성이 높다.
[방법·수치] 개 84마리, 고양이 6마리의 102개 피부종괴에 대해 4명의 수의사가 조직검사 전 육안으로 절제 완성도를 평가한 전향적 다기관 코호트 연구. 불완전 연 감지 민감도 56.3%, 특이도 87.2%, 양성예측값 45%, 음성예측값 91.5%, 정확도 82.4%. 광범위 절제와 한정 절제의 정확도 비교에서 교차비 0.024 (95% 신뢰구간: 0.003-0.19).
[임상 적용·한계] 광범위 절제의 경우 주인에게 절제 완성도를 신뢰도 있게 설명할 수 있으나, 한정 절제의 경우 주의가 필요하다. 조직검사 결과 대기 중 추가 치료 계획 수립 시 본 결과를 활용할 수 있다. 한계로는 사례의 다양성, 소수의 참여 수의사, 맹검화되지 않은 평가 편향, 임상 추적 관찰 부재가 있다.

papers.title: Artificial intelligence-enhanced electrocardiography for detection and prediction of dilated cardiomyopathy.
papers.authors: Sieliwonczyk E, Sau A, Liang Y, Patlatzoglou K, McGurk KA
papers.abstract: A major challenge in dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) care is the identification and management of individuals at risk before disease manifestation. An artificial intelligence (AI) model applied to electrocardiography (ECG) was developed to detect and predict the echocardiographic DCM phenotype (left ventricular dilatation with systolic dysfunction) and was evaluated for its ability to stratify the risk of incident DCM in familial cohorts. A deep learning model was trained to detect the echocardiographic DCM phenotype and to predict its future onset, using more than 330 000 ECG-echocardiogram pairs from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston. Model performance was validated in cohorts from the UK Biobank, Zhongshan Hospital, and Antwerp University Hospital, and compared with models based on traditional ECG features and echocardiographic traits. To assess performance in familial DCM, genetically predisposed individuals identified through cascade screening at the cardiogenetics clinics of Antwerp University Hospital (n = 166, 18% DCM positive) and Maastricht University Medical Center (n = 177, 18% DCM positive) were evaluated. The AI-ECG model achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of .87-.97 for diagnosing the prevalent DCM phenotype, outperforming traditional ECG parameters. AI-ECG was comparable to echocardiography for predicting future DCM (C-index .80-.87 and .80-.90, respectively). In familial cohorts, 5-year negative predictive values were 95.5% (Antwerp) and 91.5% (Maastricht), with corresponding positive predictive values of 42.4% and 39.4%, while high-risk scores were associated with a 5.1-6.4-fold increased risk of incident DCM. The explainable AI-ECG model detects the echocardiographic DCM phenotype and predicts future disease, and supports the exclusion of short- to mid-term disease in genetically at-risk individuals. This low-cost tool could help reduce surveillance burden and facilitate earlier intervention.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 인공지능 기반 심전도(AI-ECG) 모델이 심초음파로 확인된 확장성 심근병증(DCM) 표현형을 진단하고 향후 DCM 발생을 예측할 수 있으며, 유전적 위험군에서 단기-중기 질병을 배제하는 데 도움이 된다.
[방법·수치] Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center의 33만 개 이상 심전도-심초음파 쌍으로 훈련한 딥러닝 모델을 UK Biobank, Zhongshan Hospital, Antwerp University Hospital에서 검증했고, 유전자 선별 대상자 343명(Antwerp n=166, Maastricht n=177, 각각 DCM 양성률 18%)을 평가했다. 현재 DCM 표현형 진단에서 ROC 곡선하면적 0.87-0.97, 향후 DCM 예측의 C-index 0.80-0.90을 달성했으며, 가족성 코호트에서 5년 음성예측도 91.5-95.5%, 양성예측도 39.4-42.4%이고 고위험 점수는 DCM 발생 위험을 5.1-6.4배 증가시켰다.
[임상 적용·한계] 저비용 도구로 유전적 위험 개인의 감시 부담을 줄이고 조기 중재를 촉진할 수 있으나, 가족성 DCM 환자의 양성예측도가 42.4% 이하로 제한적이고 단일 기관 모델 훈련 및 특정 인종/지역 코호트에 대한 검증이 주요 한계이다.

papers.title: Comparative sedative effects of subcutaneous injection at GV20 versus intramuscular opioid administration in dogs: A randomized clinical trial.
papers.authors: Pehar B, Maksimović A
papers.abstract: To compare sedation after butorphanol or methadone administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) at Governing Vessel 20 (GV20) in dogs. Twenty-four healthy client-owned dogs were randomized to four groups (n = 6) receiving either opioid (0.4 mg kg-1) by IM injection or SC injection at GV20. Sedation was scored every 5 min for 35 min on a 21-point scale by three evaluators. Friedman and Kruskal-Wallis tests assessed changes over time and differences among groups; intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs) assessed agreement. Mean onset of observable sedation was 3.5 ± 2.4 min in the pooled SC groups and 10.5 ± 5.9 min in the pooled IM groups. Scores changed over time in all groups (P < 0.001) and differed among groups at every assessment (P = 0.003-0.044). SC-group scores approached 18/21 at 20-30 min, whereas IM-group scores approached 12/21 at 35 min. ICCs were 0.94-0.99. No serious adverse event required intervention or withdrawal. SC administration at GV20 was associated with earlier and greater sedation than IM administration. Route- and site-matched studies are needed before attributing the effect specifically to GV20 or recommending routine use.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] GV20 혈위 피하주사(SC)로 오피오이드를 투여한 개는 근육주사(IM) 투여보다 더 빠르고 강한 진정 효과를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 24마리의 건강한 개를 4개 그룹(n=6)으로 무작위 배정하여 부토르파놀 또는 메타돈 0.4 mg/kg을 IM 또는 SC(GV20)로 투여했다. 35분간 5분 간격으로 21점 척도로 진정도를 평가했으며, SC군의 평균 진정 개시 시간은 3.5±2.4분, IM군은 10.5±5.9분이었다(P<0.001). SC군은 20-30분에 18/21점에 도달했고, IM군은 35분에 12/21점에 도달했다(P=0.003-0.044). 평가자 간 일치도는 0.94-0.99로 우수했다.
[임상 적용·한계] SC 투여는 더 빠른 진정 개시와 더 강한 효과를 제공하므로 임상 진정 필요시 고려할 수 있다. 그러나 GV20의 특이적 효과를 확정하고 일상적 사용을 권장하기 위해서는 경로 및 부위를 일치시킨 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Association of ATP7A and ATP7B variants with treatment response in copper-associated hepatitis in the Labrador retriever.
papers.authors: den Boer ER, Nielen M, Spanjersberg TCF, Fieten H
papers.abstract: Copper-associated hepatitis in Labrador retrievers is typically treated with copper-restricted diets and D-penicillamine (D-pen). Individual responses in necessary treatment duration and reaccumulation of copper after treatment vary. This exploratory study investigated whether genotype for ATP7B:c.4358 G>A and ATP7A:c.980 C>T, which are correlated with hepatic copper levels, is associated with this variation in treatment response. Three previously published studies were reanalysed. One retrospective study of hepatic copper decline during D-pen treatment (n = 43), and two prospective studies of hepatic copper levels during copper-restricted feeding: one in Labrador retrievers with subclinical copper accumulation (n = 28) and one in Labrador retrievers after successful D-pen treatment (n = 16). Models of original studies were updated with genotype, and, for the D-pen study, also with diet. Hepatic copper decline during D-pen treatment was analysed with a mixed model and with linear regression of the average monthly decline until the first follow-up biopsy. Copper normalisation on a copper-restricted diet was analysed with logistic regression. In D-pen-treated dogs, ATP7B:c.4358 G>A was associated with slower hepatic copper decline (76 mg/kg dwl/month per variant allele; 95% CI: 29.4-122.7; p < 0.01) and ATP7A:c.980 C>T showed a non-significant trend towards faster hepatic copper decline (-72.7 mg/kg dwl/month; 95% CI: -146.2-0.9; p = 0.06). In dogs with subclinical hepatic copper accumulation, ATP7B:c.4358 G>A was associated with higher odds of failing to normalise hepatic copper on a copper-restricted diet (odds ratio 13.0 per variant allele; 95% CI 2.2-255.4; p < 0.05). In conclusion, ATP7B:c.4358 G>A was associated with slower hepatic copper decline in D-pen-treated Labrador retrievers. Additionally, ATP7B:c.4358 G>A was associated with a lower likelihood of hepatic copper normalisation during copper-restricted feeding.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 래브라도 리트리버의 구리축적 간염 치료반응에서 ATP7B:c.4358 G>A 변이는 D-페니실라민 치료 중 간 구리 감소 속도를 느리게 하며, 구리제한식 사료에서도 간 구리 정상화 실패 위험을 높인다. ATP7A:c.980 C>T 변이는 더 빠른 구리 감소와의 약한 연관성을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 세 개의 선행 연구 재분석: D-페니실라민 치료군(n=43), 무증상 구리축적 래브라도(n=28), D-페니실라민 치료 후 구리제한식 사료 적응군(n=16). ATP7B:c.4358 G>A는 월 76 mg/kg 건물중량 느린 구리 감소(95% CI: 29.4-122.7; p<0.01); ATP7A:c.980 C>T는 월 72.7 mg/kg 빠른 감소 추세(95% CI: -146.2-0.9; p=0.06); 무증상 축적군에서 ATP7B:c.4358 G>A의 오즈비 13.0(95% CI: 2.2-255.4; p<0.05).
[임상 적용·한계] ATP7B 유전자 검사는 래브라도의 구리축적 간염 치료 계획 수립 시 개별 반응 예측을 돕고 치료 기간 단축에 활용될 수 있다. 그러나 본 연구는 세 개의 소규모 선행 데이터 재분석이므로, 임상 적용 전에 전향적 연구로 확인이 필수적이다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Biomechanical evaluation of feline sacroiliac joint stabilization using a single short cannulated compression headless screw: A cadaveric study.
papers.authors: Kornmayer M, Wachsmuth L, Zablotski Y, Thorwaechter C, Wieser J
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to compare interfragmentary compression and rotational stability achieved with a single short cannulated compression headless screw (CCHS) with those obtained using longer CCHSs and cortical lag screws in a feline sacroiliac luxation (SIL) model. In this experimental study, 12 cadavers of adult domestic short-haired cats with a simulated unilateral SIL were stabilized using a single 2.5 mm CCHSs engaging 40 % of the sacral width and mounted in a mechanical testing machine. To assess compressive forces, pressure-mapping sensors were inserted into the joint space before fracture reduction. Total force (N), area of compression (mm2), and total pressure (N/mm2) were recorded. For rotational mechanical testing, the pelves were subsequently loaded through the acetabulum to replicate hindlimb ground reaction forces. A constant displacement rate of 0.5 mm/s was applied until maximal failure. Yield and ultimate load, stiffness, and failure modes were recorded. Results were compared with previously obtained data for CCHSs and cortical lag screws engaging 60 % of the sacral width. Group comparisons were conducted using Fischer's ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis tests. Post-hoc pairwise comparisons were conducted using Student's t-tests and the Dunn test. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. No statistically significant differences were identified among groups or in pairwise comparisons for total force (p=0.35), area of compression (p=0.76), total pressure (p=0.37), yield load (p = 0.55), ultimate load (p = 0.82), or stiffness (p = 0.57). All failures occurred due to screw loosening. A single CCHS engaging 40 % of the sacral width provides interfragmentary compression and rotational stability comparable to that of screws engaging 60 % of the sacral width lengths under the specific ex vivo testing conditions used in the feline SIL model.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 천장관절 탈구 모델에서 천골 폭의 40%만 관통하는 단일 단단콘 압축 나선못이 60% 관통하는 나선못과 동등한 관절면 압축력과 회전 안정성을 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 성묘 12마리의 시체에서 일측성 천장관절 탈구를 시뮬레이션하여 2.5mm 단단콘 압축 나선못(40% 천골 폭 관통)으로 안정화시킨 후 기계적 시험을 수행했다. 그룹 간 비교에서 총 압축력(p=0.35), 압축 면적(p=0.76), 총 압력(p=0.37), 항복하중(p=0.55), 최대하중(p=0.82), 강성도(p=0.57) 모두에서 통계적 유의차가 없었고, 모든 실패는 나선못 이완으로 발생했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 짧은 나선못 사용으로 수술 시간 단축과 연부조직 손상 감소가 가능할 것으로 예상되나, 본 연구는 체외(ex vivo) 모델에서의 기계적 평가만 수행했으므로 생체 내 임상 효과 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation: Navigating Heterogeneity in Clinical Evidence: JACC Evidence Review.
papers.authors: Bikdeli B, Arun AS, Pawar S, Dhruva SS, Butala NM
papers.abstract: Left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) has emerged as an alternative to long-term anticoagulation for preventing stroke or systemic embolism in selected patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) based on several randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that collectively enrolled >7,000 participants. In this JACC Evidence Review, we interpret the major RCTs as distinct experiments, clarify what each can and cannot establish, and offer a phenotype-based framework for interpreting the evidence. The most recent RCTs, OPTION, CLOSURE-AF, and CHAMPION-AF, have prompted efforts to pool the evidence into a single summary estimate. However, these trials are not one coherent evidence base; they are distinct clinical experiments that asked different questions. They differ in patient phenotype, comparator, device generation, postprocedure antithrombotic regimen, endpoint construction, and follow-up duration. Study-level meta-analysis of published reports remains methodologically valid for estimating the broad direction of effect of a device class, but when the component trials differ materially in patient phenotype, comparator, and outcome construction, the pooled estimate does not map to a common patient group or treatment decision. Patient eligibility as well as thromboembolic and bleeding risk varied markedly across trials. In addition, device technology has progressed, and comparators have evolved from warfarin to direct oral anticoagulants. Heterogeneity and insufficient details also exist about the antithrombotic therapy regimen in LAAC arms and adjunct antiplatelet therapy in control arms.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 좌심이 폐색술(LAAC)은 항응고 치료 불내성 환자에서 고려할 수 있는 선택지이나, 항응고 적응 환자에서는 항응고 치료가 여전히 1차 선택이며, LAAC과 항응고는 서로 다른 위험 프로필을 제공하므로 공유 의사결정이 필수적이다.
[방법·수치] 7,000명 이상을 포함한 다수의 무작위대조시험(OPTION, CLOSURE-AF, CHAMPION-AF 등)을 분석하여 LAAC과 항응고 치료를 비교한 근거를 체계적으로 검토했다. 각 시험은 환자 표현형, 대조약, 기기 세대, 항혈전 요법, 종료점, 추적 기간에서 현저히 달랐다.
[임상 적용·한계] LAAC은 장기간 항응고 치료가 안전하지 않거나 지속 불가능한 경우 합리적 선택지이나, 시술 위험도, 보조 항혈전제 가능성, 감시 필요성, 경쟁 사망률을 신중히 고려해야 한다. 항응고 불내성 집단에서는 근거가 제한적이고, 다른 집단에서의 시험들은 항응고 대체제로서의 LAAC 지지를 제한하는 특성을 가지고 있다.

papers.title: Effect of gabapentin on blood pressure and sedation scores in healthy dogs.
papers.authors: Leung K, Wood MW
papers.abstract: To evaluate gabapentin's effect on blood pressure and sedation scores in healthy dogs. It was hypothesized gabapentin administration would decrease blood pressure and increase sedation scores compared to placebo administration. A randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled crossover study was performed from July 1, 2024, to July 30, 2025. Fifteen apparently healthy dogs presented for 3 paired (gabapentin and control) evaluations for a total of 6 visits. At each visit, dogs were administered either a 20-mg/kg oral dose of liquid gabapentin or an equivalent volume of placebo solution. Treatment order was randomized. Blood pressure was obtained 3 hours after each dog received treatment using the oscillometric technique. Sedation scores were collected prior to blood pressure measurement. The median diastolic blood pressure (78.67 mm Hg) and median mean arterial pressure (90.67 mm Hg) were significantly lower after gabapentin administration. Median systolic blood pressure (127.3 mm Hg) was not significantly different after gabapentin administration. Sedation score (4.0) was significantly higher after gabapentin. Oral gabapentin administration caused increased diastolic pressure, mean arterial pressure, and sedation scores. Blood pressure measurements in patients receiving preappointment gabapentin should be interpreted with caution.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 20mg/kg 경구 gabapentin 투여는 건강한 개에서 확장기혈압과 평균동맥압을 유의하게 감소시키고 진정 스코어를 유의하게 증가시킨다.
[방법·수치] 무작위배정, 맹검, 위약대조 교차 연구; 건강한 개 15마리, 총 6회 방문; 중앙값 확장기혈압 78.67 mmHg (p<0.05), 중앙값 평균동맥압 90.67 mmHg (p<0.05), 중앙값 수축기혈압 127.3 mmHg (유의하지 않음), 진정 스코어 4.0 (p<0.05).
[임상 적용·한계] 진료 전 gabapentin을 투여받은 환자의 혈압 측정 결과는 주의 깊게 해석해야 하며, gabapentin의 혈압 저하 효과를 임상 적용시 고려해야 한다. 소규모 단일 기관 연구이고 건강한 개만 포함되어 질환 동물에 대한 적용은 제한적이다.

papers.title: Frequency of occurrence, signalment, clinicopathologic and imaging findings, and outcomes with nontraumatic spontaneous intracranial hemorrhagic stroke in dogs.
papers.authors: Thibodeaux LA, Kent M, Bennett M, Barber R
papers.abstract: To describe the frequency, clinicopathologic and imaging findings, and outcomes in dogs with spontaneous intra-parenchymal hemorrhagic stroke (sIHS). Retrospective study involving 25 dogs. Medical records were reviewed for signalment; neurological, clinicopathologic, and imaging findings; anatomic localization; comorbidities; therapy; and outcome in dogs with sIHS (2010 to 2024). Lesion number, location, and volume were recorded. Outcome was defined as excellent, good, or poor. Frequency was defined out of a contemporaneous population of dogs ≥ 6 years old with an acute presentation of neurological signs. Affected dogs were older, small- to medium-breed dogs. Dogs often presented for neurological dysfunction reflective of a prosencephalic lesion (19 of 25 dogs) or new-onset seizures (13 of 25 dogs). A single, well-defined hemorrhage within the prosencephalon was commonly observed on MRI. Outcome was frequently excellent. Complete seizure remission was common. Larger lesion volumes were associated with poor outcomes. One dog experienced clinical signs suggestive of an additional sIHS 4 months after the initial stroke. Frequency of sIHS was 25 of 427 dogs (6%) ≥ 6 years old undergoing brain MRI. sIHS should be considered in older dogs with an acute onset of prosencephalic dysfunction and/or seizures. Following exclusion of secondary IHS, an excellent long-term outcome may be realized in dogs with sIHS, despite the presence of comorbidities. Short-term anticonvulsant therapy may be necessary. Development of poststroke epilepsy is unlikely. Dogs rarely experience another IHS.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 자발성 뇌실질내 출혈성 뇌졸중(sIHS)은 6세 이상 고령견에서 뇌 MRI 검사 대상의 6%(25/427)에서 발생했으며, 이차성 출혈을 배제하면 동반질환이 있어도 우수한 장기 예후를 기대할 수 있다. 완전한 발작 관해가 흔했고 뇌졸중 후 간질 발생은 드물었으며, 추적 중 재발 사례는 매우 드물었다.
[방법·수치] 2010~2024년 자발성 뇌실질내 출혈성 뇌졸중으로 진단된 25마리 개를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구. 6세 이상 뇌 MRI 검사를 받은 427마리 중 25마리(6%)에서 sIHS 진단. 영향받은 개들은 고령의 소형~중형견이었고, 19마리(76%)에서 전뇌 병변, 13마리(52%)에서 신발작이 나타났으며, MRI에서 단일의 뚜렷하게 정의된 전뇌내 출혈이 흔히 관찰됨. 큰 병변 부피는 불량한 예후와 연관되었고, 1마리는 초기 뇌졸중 후 4개월에 추가 sIHS 증거를 보임.
[임상 적용·한계] 고령견에서 급성 전뇌 기능장애 및/또는 신발작 시 자발성 출혈성 뇌졸중을 감별진단으로 고려해야 한다. 단기 항경련제 치료가 필요할 수 있으며, 뇌졸중 후 간질 발생 가능성은 낮다. 후향적 단일기관 연구로 대상이 25마리로 제한적이며, 이차성 출혈의 완전한 배제 기준이 초록에 명시되지 않았다.

papers.title: Soft tissue sarcoma grade does not differ between extremity and nonextremity locations.
papers.authors: Patel MH, Selmic LE, Lapsley JM, Piegols HJ
papers.abstract: To evaluate whether canine soft tissue sarcomas (STSs) located on the extremities are of lower histologic grade than those on nonextremity locations. The hypothesis was that the frequency of grade I and grade II/III tumors would be similar between extremity and nonextremity locations. This retrospective cohort study evaluated canines undergoing surgical resection of an STS and subsequent histopathologic assessment during the period of November 20, 2018, to April 8, 2025, at a single institution. 134 STSs on 129 dogs were identified, with 129 STSs included in analysis. Seventy-two STSs (55.8%) were located on the extremities, while 57 (44.2%) were located on nonextremity locations. Forty-nine STSs (68.1%) on the extremities were grade I, and 23 (31.9%) were grade II/III; 40 nonextremity STSs (70.2%) were grade I, and 17 (29.3%) were grade II/III. The distribution of STSs as grade I or grade II/III is similar for STSs located on extremity and nonextremity locations. STSs located on an extremity cannot be assumed to be of a low histologic grade. Risks of local recurrence and potential need for adjuvant therapy, particularly with a marginal excision, should be discussed during the preoperative period with clients for STSs located on the extremities, similar to other locations based on similar grade distributions.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 연부조직육종(STS)은 위치(사지 vs 체간/비사지)에 관계없이 조직학적 등급 분포가 유사하므로, 사지 종양이 저등급이라는 가정은 부적절하다.
[방법·수치] 단일 기관에서 2018년 11월~2025년 4월간 STS 수술 후 조직병리 검사를 받은 개 129마리의 129개 종양을 대상으로 한 후향적 코호트 연구. 사지 72개(55.8%): 1등급 68.1%, 2-3등급 31.9%; 비사지 57개(44.2%): 1등급 70.2%, 2-3등급 29.3%.
[임상 적용·한계] 사지 STS도 비사지 종양과 동일하게 국소재발 위험과 보조요법(특히 한계절제 시)의 필요성을 수술 전 보호자와 협의해야 한다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이며 종양 크기, 절제 마진, 추적 추적 기간 등 추가 정보 부족.

papers.title: Potassium EDTA Contamination Causing Preanalytical Errors in Canine and Feline Serum Samples.
papers.authors: Strage EM, Larsson A, Hillström A, Eriksson G, Olausson J
papers.abstract: Contamination of serum samples with the anticoagulant potassium ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (kEDTA) constitutes a critical pre-analytical error in veterinary diagnostics and can lead to potentially life-threatening misinterpretation of biochemical test results. To develop and validate a method for quantifying EDTA in canine and feline sera. A second aim was to evaluate the effect and prevalence of kEDTA contamination in canine and feline serum samples. A copper-PAN-based automated method for quantifying EDTA in canine and feline sera was developed. Canine and feline serum samples admitted together with EDTA tubes were analyzed for kEDTA contamination. The measuring range was set to 0.03-0.4 mM, with a coefficient of variation of < 13.1% and acceptable linearity upon dilution (75%-118%). Spiking experiments demonstrated that kEDTA caused a dose-dependent increase in potassium and decreases in calcium, magnesium, iron, and zinc, with iron and zinc most profoundly affected. The allowable total error was exceeded at low kEDTA concentrations, even when analytes remained within reference intervals. A prevalence study of 1065 serum samples submitted with kEDTA tubes revealed contamination rates of 1.1% in dogs and 1.8% in cats. These findings emphasize that even small amounts of kEDTA can compromise diagnostic accuracy. This underscores the importance of strict compliance with recommended blood collection order and highlights the value of direct EDTA measurements in veterinary laboratory diagnostics.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 혈청 샘플의 칼륨 EDTA 오염은 용량 의존적으로 칼륨 증가, 칼슘·마그네슘·철·아연 감소를 야기하며, 특히 철과 아연에 심각한 영향을 미친다. 허용 오차 범위 내 소량 오염도 진단 정확도를 손상시킨다.
[방법·수치] 개와 고양이 혈청에서 EDTA를 정량화하는 구리-PAN 기반 자동화 방법을 개발·검증했다. 측정 범위 0.03-0.4 mM, 변이계수 <13.1%, 희석 시 선형성 75%-118% 달성. 1,065개 샘플 조사 결과 오염률은 개 1.1%, 고양이 1.8%.
[임상 적용·한계] EDTA 오염이 의심되는 샘플은 직접 측정으로 검출 가능하며, 혈액 수집 순서 준수의 중요성을 강조한다. 그러나 현장 적용 편의성, 검사실 도입 비용, 오염 샘플 재수집 체계 등의 실무적 한계가 존재한다.

papers.title: Analytical Validation of β-Hydroxybutyrate Quantification in Feline Serum with the BT3500 Analyzer.
papers.authors: Tirolo A, Sabetti MC, Carrillo Heredero AM, Fidanzio F, Corsini A
papers.abstract: Quantitative measurement of serum β-hydroxybutyrate (β-OHB) is essential for detecting and monitoring ketosis and ketoacidosis in diabetic cats, particularly in the era of sodium-glucose cotransporter two (SGLT2) inhibitors, where euglycemic ketoacidosis may occur. The BT3500 analyzer has not been analytically validated for β-OHB quantification in feline serum. Analytically validate the Randox Ranbut enzymatic β-OHB assay on feline serum using the BT3500 chemistry analyzer, including evaluation of sample stability under refrigerated and frozen storage conditions. Residual feline serum samples and pooled sera were used to assess intra-assay and inter-assay precision, spike-recovery accuracy across five concentration increments, linearity under serial dilution, and analytical sensitivity (LoB, LoD, LoQ). Short-term stability was evaluated at 4°C for 7 days and long-term stability at -20°C at predefined time points up to 360 days. Intra-assay coefficient of variation (CV%) ranged from 1.68% to 14.48% and inter-assay CV% from 3.08% to 10.20%, with higher imprecision at low concentrations. Recoveries ranged from 110% to 122% (mean 114% ± 4%). Linearity was excellent (slope 1.012; R2 ≥ 0.9998). LoB, LoD, and LoQ were 0.044, 0.091, and 0.150 mmol/L, respectively. β-OHB was stable at 4°C up to 6 days and at -20°C up to 180 days, while decreases exceeding the acceptance limit were observed at 360 days. The Randox β-OHB assay on the BT3500 demonstrated acceptable analytical performance in feline serum and is suitable for routine clinical use; frozen storage beyond 180 days may impact result accuracy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] BT3500 분석기의 Randox Ranbut 효소법을 이용한 고양이 혈청 β-하이드록시부티르산(β-OHB) 정량은 임상 사용에 적합한 분석 성능을 보였으며, 냉동 보관 시 180일까지 안정적이다.
[방법·수치] 고양이 잔여 혈청과 혼합 혈청을 이용하여 정밀도, 회수율, 직선성, 분석 감도를 평가했다. 검사내 CV% 1.68~14.48%, 검사간 CV% 3.08~10.20%, 회수율 평균 114%±4%, 직선성 우수(R²≥0.9998), LoB/LoD/LoQ는 각각 0.044/0.091/0.150 mmol/L이었다. 단기 안정성은 4℃에서 6일, 장기 안정성은 -20℃에서 180일까지 유지되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] SGLT2 억제제 사용 중인 당뇨병 고양이의 케톤산증 선별 및 모니터링에 유용하며, 냉동 보관은 180일을 초과하면 결과 정확도에 영향을 줄 수 있으므로 주의가 필요하다. 단일 기관의 검증 연구로 다양한 임상 상황에서의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Availability of a Digital Refractometer for Measuring Urine Specific Gravity in Dogs.
papers.authors: Kırkulak T, Tuna GE
papers.abstract: Urine specific gravity (USG) is used clinically to assess urine concentration and is routinely evaluated with a refractometer. Several studies have compared optical and digital refractometers in assessing USG in dogs. However, these studies have shown conflicting results. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the clinical feasibility of a handheld digital refractometer (HDR) (Atago Pal-Usg Dog) for measuring USG. Urine samples were collected from 100 dogs with various problems. The results of the HDR and the reference method, the optical handheld refractometer (OHR) (Atago URC-NE), were evaluated using dependent t-tests, Pearson correlation analysis, Passing-Bablok regression analysis, and Bland-Altman tests. Furthermore, the coefficient of variation (CV) and total analytical error (TAE) rates for the HDR were determined. Although a statistically significant difference was determined between the mean USG measured with OHR and HDR, a positive correlation was found between the two refractometers. The Passing-Bablok regression analysis revealed no systematic or proportional bias between the two refractometers. The Bland-Altman test calculated the mean difference between the OHR and HDR measurements as -0.9 units, demonstrating that the USG measured with HDR could be 1.3 units greater or 3 units less than the OHR. When evaluating the CV, the reproducibility of the HDR was quite good, and for the TAE, this value fell within the desired limits for USG. This study demonstrated that USG in dogs can be measured safely, easily, and quickly with the HDR and that the HDR is suitable for clinical use.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 휴대용 디지털 굴절계(Atago Pal-Usg Dog)는 광학식 굴절계와 양호한 상관관계를 보이며 체계적 오차나 비례 오차가 없어 임상 사용에 적합하다.
[방법·수치] 개 100마리에서 채취한 뇨검체를 디지털 굴절계(HDR)와 광학식 굴절계(OHR)로 측정했으며, 종속표본 t검정, Pearson 상관분석, Passing-Bablok 회귀분석, Bland-Altman 검정을 적용했다. 평균 차이는 -0.9 units이었고, HDR 측정값은 OHR보다 1.3 units 높거나 3 units 낮을 수 있으며, 변동계수(CV)는 우수하고 총분석오차(TAE)는 허용범위 내였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 디지털 굴절계는 뇨비중 측정을 안전하고 용이하며 신속하게 수행할 수 있어 임상 현장에서 광학식 굴절계의 대안으로 활용 가능하다. 단일 기기 모델 평가이므로 다양한 디지털 굴절계의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Generation of Human Cardiomyocytes With Adult-Like Metabolism by a Chemically Defined Medium for Mitochondrial Disease Modeling.
papers.authors: Tu C, Caudal A, Liu Y, Belbachir N, Kojic A
papers.abstract: Human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived cardiomyocytes (iPSC cardiomyocytes) as a model for cardiac disease have become increasingly important, bolstered by the Food and Drug Administration's initiative to promote novel alternative methods for biomedical research. A key limitation of metabolically immature iPSC cardiomyocytes is their limited ability to accurately recapitulate mitochondria-dependent pathologies, such as Friedreich ataxia-associated cardiomyopathy. Adult cardiomyocytes are characterized by a high density of interfibrillar mitochondria, abundant respiratory complexes (I-V) that form supercomplexes, and efficient utilization of fatty acids to drive mitochondrial respiration. These unique metabolic structures and functions are largely missing in iPSC cardiomyocytes. Further, whether iPSC cardiomyocytes can efficiently utilize fatty acids for respiration in the presence of glucose, a unique adult feature, remains unclear. We developed a chemically defined, 11-component maturation medium (MM11) designed using a bioinformatics-guided strategy that identified high-fidelity transcriptional markers of adult cardiac metabolic maturity. Human iPSC cardiomyocytes were treated with MM11 for 2 weeks and evaluated at the molecular, structural, and functional levels, with an emphasis on mitochondrial maturity. We benchmarked our results with isolated primary adult human cardiomyocytes. Last, we tested whether this method could enable us to more accurately model Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy. MM11 treatment increased expression of metabolic pathways, including mitochondrial respiration and fatty acid metabolism, at the transcript and protein levels. Ultrastructural analyses revealed the formation of interfibrillar mitochondria and mitochondrial respiratory supercomplexes, a feature never shown in previous reports.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 화학적으로 정의된 11성분 성숙배지(MM11)가 iPSC 유래 심근세포를 성인형 대사를 가진 세포로 분화시켜, 프리드라이히 운동실조증 관련 심근병증 등 미토콘드리아 질환 모델링에 성공했다.
[방법·수치] 생정보학 기반 성인 심근세포 대사 성숙 마커를 이용하여 MM11을 개발하고, 인간 iPSC 심근세포에 2주간 처리 후 분자·구조·기능 수준에서 평가했다. MM11 처리 후 산화적 인산화 및 산소소비량이 대폭 증가했고, 13C 동위원소 추적으로 생리적 기질 존재 하에서 지방산 선호적 이용을 확인했으며, 초미세구조 분석에서 미토콘드리아 호흡사슬 슈퍼복합체 형성을 처음으로 관찰했다.
[임상 적용·한계] iPSC 심근세포를 성인형 대사를 가진 질환 모델로 사용하여 심근경색재관류손상과 프리드라이히 운동실조증 심근병증 등 미토콘드리아 의존성 심장질환의 기전연구에 활용할 수 있다. 그러나 초록에서 임상 검증, 다양한 질환 적용성, 장기간 안정성에 대한 정보는 제시되지 않았다.

papers.title: Right Heart Dysfunction in Valvular Heart Disease: Epidemiology, Prognosis, and Management Considerations.
papers.authors: Brener MI, Badano LP, Galloo X, Muraru D, Pinney SP
papers.abstract: Right ventricular (RV) dysfunction is an important determinant of clinical outcomes across a wide range of cardiovascular pathologies. As the prevalence of valvular heart disease (VHD) increases with the aging population, the intersection between RV function and VHD will become all the more relevant for proper risk assessment, treatment selection, and prognostication. Even though RV dysfunction may not always be attributed to VHD, we aim to give clinicians, researchers, and regulators a deep understanding of how patients with VHD should be evaluated for RV dysfunction and treated when RV dysfunction coexists with VHD. We begin with a discussion of the epidemiology and diagnostic evaluation of RV dysfunction in patients with a variety of VHD subgroups, including right-side (ie, associated with the tricuspid valve) and left-side (ie, associated with the mitral and aortic valves) VHD. Attention is also given in that section to contemporary methods and evolving techniques for identifying and phenotyping different forms of RV dysfunction in patients with VHD. No single imaging test practically or comprehensively captures all degrees and forms of RV dysfunction in patients with VHD; therefore, the discussion emphasizes integrating evidence from different imaging modalities and hemodynamic assessments. The second component of the review discusses how RV dysfunction affects therapeutic options, including medical, transcatheter, and surgical therapies for VHD. The focus of the discussion is on the interplay between RV dysfunction in patients with right-side VHD, namely tricuspid regurgitation (TR). Unlike left-side VHD, where RV dysfunction is a marker of overall disease severity but does not necessarily indicate futility or nonresponse to therapy, right-side VHD and TR-associated RV dysfunction identifies a subset of patients where intervention may precipitate even worse RV function.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 우심실 기능부전은 판막성 심질환 환자의 임상 예후를 결정하는 중요한 요인이며, 좌측 판막질환과 우측 판막질환에서 우심실 기능부전의 의미와 치료 반응이 상이하다. 특히 삼첨판 역류 동반 우측 판막질환에서는 우심실 기능부전이 치료 실패를 나타낼 수 있으므로 신중한 평가가 필요하다. [방법·수치] 판막성 심질환 환자에서 우심실 기능부전의 진단, 영상 평가 방법, 혈역학적 평가를 포함한 종합적 검토를 수행했으며, 우측 판막질환(삼첨판)과 좌측 판막질환(이첨판, 대동맥판)으로 분류하여 분석했다. 수치 제시 없음. [임상 적용·한계] 임상의는 판막성 심질환 환자에서 우심실 기능부전을 다층 영상 모달리티와 혈역학적 평가로 통합 평가해야 하며, 삼첨판 역류 환자의 경우 중재 시술이나 외과 수술이 우심실 기능을 악화시킬 수 있으므로 신중한 환자 선별이 필수적이다. 본 연구는 의학 문헌의 종합 검토로 대규모 임상 연구 데이터가 부재하다.

papers.title: Sacubitril/valsartan for radiation-induced heart disease in children: preclinical and clinical findings.
papers.authors: Zhao L, Guo X, Tang Y, Hua Y, Liu X
papers.abstract: Radiation-induced heart disease (RIHD) is a life-threatening sequela for cancer survivors. A proactive preventive strategy is urgently needed but remains elusive, particularly for the vulnerable paediatric population where prospective data are scarce. To address this gap, this study aimed to evaluate the prophylactic efficacy of sacubitril/valsartan against RIHD in children through a comprehensive translational research pipeline. A prospective observational study was first conducted in 40 paediatric solid tumour patients, comparing cardiac function before and 1 week after radiotherapy, with 80 healthy controls. A juvenile rat RIHD model was then established, in which the efficacy of sacubitril/valsartan was assessed and validated through longitudinal echocardiography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, histopathology, bulk RNA-seq, and single-nucleus RNA-seq. Finally, a prospective clinical cohort (n = 15 sacubitril/valsartan, n = 15 control) was conducted in paediatric patients post-radiotherapy, with a 12-month follow-up for efficacy and safety. In paediatric patients, radiotherapy significantly impaired biventricular function, notably reducing left ventricular global longitudinal strain, and mean heart radiation dose was significantly correlated with cardiac function impairment. In juvenile rats, sacubitril/valsartan attenuated pathological ventricular wall thickening, myocardial fibrosis, diastolic dysfunction, and perfusion deficits. Mechanistically, it mitigated endothelial cell damage and immune cell activation, promoted a macrophage phenotypic shift from M1 to M2, suppressed fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition, and broadly attenuated pro-fibrotic and inflammatory cell-cell communication. In the clinical cohort, sacubitril/valsartan significantly improved left ventricular global longitudinal strain and aortic compliance vs controls, with a favourable safety profile.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소아 암 환자에서 방사선 치료 후 조기에 sacubitril/valsartan을 투여하면 방사선 유도 심장질환의 심독성을 완화할 수 있으며, 이는 예방적 심장 관리의 새로운 표준을 제시한다.
[방법·수치] 소아 고형암 환자 40명(건강 대조군 80명)을 대상으로 방사선 치료 전후 심기능 비교, 청소년 쥐 모델에서 심초음파·심자기공명영상·조직병리·RNA-seq 분석으로 약물 효능 검증, 임상 코호트 연구(sacubitril/valsartan군 15명, 대조군 15명)를 12개월 추적 관찰. 방사선 치료는 좌심실 글로벌 종주변형률을 유의하게 감소시켰고, 쥐 모델에서 sacubitril/valsartan은 심실벽 비후, 심근 섬유화, 이완기 기능부전을 완화했으며 임상군에서도 좌심실 글로벌 종주변형률과 대동맥 순응도를 유의하게 개선하였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 방사선 치료 후 소아 암 생존자에서 조기 예방적 sacubitril/valsartan 투여로 방사선 유도 심독성을 예방할 수 있는 근거를 제공하나, 임상 코호트가 15명의 소규모이고 12개월 추적관찰로 장기 효과 평가 필요하며 단일 기관 연구의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Incremental yield of genetic retesting in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
papers.authors: de Castro D, Ochoa JP, Fernández-Ávila AI, Cabrera-Romero E, Jiménez-Barceló JA
papers.abstract: Modern genetic testing in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) includes newly described HCM-associated genes and full intronic regions of certain classic sarcomeric genes. This study evaluated genetic retesting in HCM patients with a prior negative test and identified predictors of a positive result to guide retesting. This multicentre study included patients with HCM who previously had negative next-generation sequencing (NGS)-based genetic testing at four centres. Subjects were retested using an updated NGS-based HCM panel. Of 508 retested HCM patients (median age 70 years; 66.9% male; median maximal left ventricular wall thickness 18 mm; median interval from initial genetic test 6.6 years), 46 (9%) had 48 HCM-related variants: 14 in new HCM-associated genes, 3 in deep intronic MYBPC3 regions, 18 intermediate-effect variants, and 13 (8 reclassified) in classic HCM-associated genes. In multivariable analysis, the presence of late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) [odds ratio (OR) 3.52; 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.38-10.25], the Mayo HCM score (OR 1.46 per 1 point increase; 95% CI 1.08-2.01), and the Toronto HCM score (OR 1.18 per 1 point increase; 95% CI 1.08-1.30) were independent predictors of detecting HCM-related variants at retesting. The diagnostic yields in patients with LGE and a high Toronto score (≥13 points), and with LGE and a high Mayo score (≥4 points), were 80% and 50%, respectively. In patients with HCM and prior negative genetic testing, retesting identified HCM-related variants in 9% of individuals, allowing counselling and risk stratification. Late gadolinium enhancement, combined with the Mayo and Toronto scores, may be used to guide which patients should be prioritized for genetic retesting.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 이전에 유전자 검사에서 음성 판정을 받은 비후성 심근증 환자의 재검사에서 9%가 HCM 관련 변이를 보유하고 있었으며, 이는 새로운 HCM 관련 유전자와 심부 인트론 영역의 발견으로 가능했다.
[방법·수치] 4개 기관의 HCM 환자 508명(중앙값 70세, 남성 66.9%, 좌심실 벽 두께 중앙값 18mm)을 최신 NGS 패널로 재검사했으며, 46명(9%)에서 48개 변이 발견(새 유전자 14개, 깊은 인트론 MYBPC3 3개, 중간 효과 변이 18개, 고전적 HCM 유전자 13개). LGE 양성(OR 3.52, 95% CI 1.38-10.25), Mayo 점수(OR 1.46, 95% CI 1.08-2.01), Toronto 점수(OR 1.18, 95% CI 1.08-1.30)가 독립적 예측인자였고, LGE+Toronto 고점수(≥13점) 환자의 진단 수율은 80%, LGE+Mayo 고점수(≥4점)는 50%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상적으로 LGE 소견과 Mayo/Toronto 위험도 점수를 함께 사용하여 유전자 재검사가 필요한 환자를 우선순위화할 수 있으며, 재검사를 통해 상담 및 위험 계층화가 가능하다. 후향적 단일 패널 기반 연구이고 초기 검사 방법이 명확하지 않아 기술 진화의 영향을 평가하기 제한적이다.

papers.title: Inflammation and early atherosclerosis beyond traditional risk factors: an imaging study.
papers.authors: Mendieta G, Pocock SJ, Taylor D, García-Alvarez A, Fuster JJ
papers.abstract: Understanding how inflammation contributes to subclinical atherosclerosis (SA) plaque burden, beyond the impact of established cardiovascular risk factors, holds significant implications for the success of preventive strategies focused on the reduction of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. The aim of this study was to investigate the relative contribution of inflammation, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDLc), and systolic blood pressure (SBP), as determinants of SA plaque burden in a cohort of middle-aged, asymptomatic individuals, using non-invasive imaging techniques. Participants from the Progression of Early Subclinical Atherosclerosis (PESA) study (median age 45 years) underwent longitudinal screening every 3 years (baseline, 3- and 6-year visits) involving serial blood testing [including white blood cell (WBC) count, fibrinogen, oxidized LDLc, and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein], physical examinations and imaging assessments with three-dimensional vascular ultrasound of peripheral arteries, and coronary artery calcium quantification. Global plaque volume (GPV, mm3; bilateral carotid plus femoral plaque burden) at 6-year follow-up was the primary outcome. Multivariable linear regression and proportional odds models determined the link of GPV to both inflammatory markers and established cardiovascular risk factors. Of the 3471 participants, 58% had SA (GPV >0 mm3) at 6-year follow-up. WBC count had the strongest statistical associations with 6-year SA burden after adjusting for age, sex, baseline LDLc, and mean SBP, with an estimated 32.6% increase in GPV per one standard deviation (SD) increase in WBC (Z = 7.33, P < 1 × 10-10). GPV at 6 years increased 40.9% per one SD increase in baseline LDLc and 42.7% per one SD increase in mean SBP (Z = 8.80 and Z = 7.97, respectively, both P < 1 × 10-10; their SDs were 29.4 mg/dL and 11.5 mmHg, respectively), followed by fibrinogen (16.8% increase in GPV per one SD increase, Z = 3.91, P < .0001).
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 염증 마커, 특히 백혈구 수와 피브리노겐이 저밀도콜레스테롤과 수축기혈압과 독립적으로 무증상 초기 죽상경화증 플라크 부담을 예측하는 중요한 위험인자임을 밝혔다. [방법·수치] PESA 연구의 중년 무증상 성인 3471명을 대상으로 3년 간격 6년 추적 조사를 수행했다. 백혈구 수는 6년 후 플라크 부담 증가와 가장 강한 연관성을 보였으며(1 SD 증가 시 플라크 용적 32.6% 증가, P < 1×10-10), 저밀도콜레스테롤(40.9% 증가)과 수축기혈압(42.7% 증가) 다음으로 피브리노겐이 의미 있는 영향(16.8% 증가, P < .0001)을 미쳤고, 고감도 C-반응성단백질은 유의하지 않았다(P = .174). [임상 적용·한계] 염증 마커 측정이 무증상 초기 죽상경화증 위험 평가에 추가적 가치를 제공할 수 있으나, 백혈구 수의 임상적 역치가 명확하지 않고 단일 종족 대상의 관찰 연구로 인과관계 추론에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Biomechanical characterization of the IGP scaling wall in German Shepherd working dogs: Implications for landing mechanics and joint loading.
papers.authors: Vilar JM, Lopedote M, Valentini S, Marrero I, Spinella G
papers.abstract: The scaling wall represents one of the most technically demanding exercises within the IGP working dog program, as it combines successive phases of acceleration, vertical jumping, support at the apex, and descent to the ground, imposing high kinematic and mechanical demands on the locomotor system. However, the biomechanics of this exercise remain poorly documented. The aim of this study was to describe the kinematic and energetic characteristics of the first phase of the exercise on scaling wall in German Shepherd dogs trained for IGP. Eleven dogs were evaluated using high-speed bidimensional video analysis with Kinovea. This first passage exercise was divided into three phases: (1) ground-to-scaling wall, (2) wall-to-apex transition, and (3) descent and landing. Velocities, angles, and derived energetic and mechanical variables were analyzed. The three phases showed different descriptive patterns in their kinematic and estimated mechanical parameters. Initial takeoff (J1) was characterized by greater horizontal velocity and estimated mechanical power than ramp propulsion (J2), whereas J2 showed particularly high dispersion in vertical velocity (CV = 79.0%). During landing (J3), estimated power absorption exhibited substantial dispersion (CV = 37.8%), contrasting with the relatively low variability in peak carpal angle (CV = 2.5%). Exploratory correlation analysis identified associations among selected mechanical estimates, although these were partly attributable to shared mathematical inputs. These findings provide preliminary phase-specific biomechanical reference data for the IGP scaling wall and identify aspects of ramp propulsion and landing that warrant further investigation using direct kinetic measurements.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] IGP 스케일링 월 운동은 지면 출발, 벽 등반, 하강의 3단계로 구분되며, 각 단계별로 서로 다른 운동학적 및 역학적 특성을 보였다. 초기 도약(J1)은 높은 수평 속도와 기계적 파워를 나타냈고, 램프 추진(J2)은 수직 속도에서 높은 변동성(CV = 79.0%)을 보였으며, 하강 착지(J3)에서는 파워 흡수의 큰 산포(CV = 37.8%)와 비교해 최대 수근각의 낮은 변동성(CV = 2.5%)을 보였다.
[방법·수치] IGP 훈련을 받은 저먼 셰퍼드 11마리를 대상으로 고속 2차원 비디오 분석(Kinovea)을 이용하여 스케일링 월 첫 번째 통과 운동의 속도, 각도, 에너지 및 역학 변수를 분석했다. J1에서는 J2보다 높은 수평 속도와 기계적 파워를 보였고, J2의 수직 속도 변동계수는 79.0%, J3의 파워 흡수 변동계수는 37.8%, 최대 수근각 변동계수는 2.5%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 본 연구는 IGP 스케일링 월 운동의 단계별 생체역학 참고 자료를 제공하여 작업견의 착지 역학 및 관절 부하 평가에 활용될 수 있으나, 고속 비디오 분석만 사용하여 직접 운동학적 측정이 없었고 소규모(11마리) 단일 견종 연구로서 일반화에 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Accessing Emergency Surgery: Perceptions of the Challenges, Gaps, and Training by ACVECC Community-Associated Veterinarians.
papers.authors: Bethel H, Berg A, Rozanski E
papers.abstract: To determine whether there is a shortage of surgical specialists available to clients and pets treated by American College of Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care (ACVECC) diplomate practitioners in clinical practice; to explore the surgical training during ACVECC residency programs; and to explore whether ACVECC diplomates and associated respondents are interested in a formalized emergency surgical certificate program in emergency surgery. A survey comprising 22 items for identifying respondents' demographics, surgical training experience, and current practice was distributed via email to all diplomates, residency-trained non-diplomates, and current residents on the ACVECC listserv. Respondents were also asked about their interest in the creation of an emergency surgery certificate. Three hundred individuals responded to the survey, the vast majority in small animal (SA) practice. Thirty-four percent of SA respondents do not have 24-h access to surgical specialists despite their hospital being open 24 h a day. While some practices have ACVECC diplomates or emergency clinicians available to perform out-of-hours surgery, 8% of all respondents have no out-of-hours surgical capability. More than half the respondents (169/300 [56%]) completed their residency surgical requirement in an observational role without any primary cutting responsibility, and most respondents (178/289 [62%]) supported the formation of a structured emergency surgical certificate through ACVECC. There is a relative shortage of out-of-hours emergency surgeons within SA emergency practices. Further study and discussion are warranted to better define the necessity and viability of solutions to mitigate this shortage.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소동물 응급의료 현장에서 24시간 외과 전문의 부족이 현실이며, ACVECC 외과 응급 자격증 프로그램 도입에 대한 수요가 높다.
[방법·수치] ACVECC 외교의, 수련의, 현재 레지던트 300명을 대상으로 한 설문조사; 소동물 응급 병원 중 34%가 24시간 외과 전문의 접근성 부족, 전체 응답자의 8%는 비업무시간 외과 능력 전무, 56%(169/300명)가 레지던시 중 수술 관찰만 수행, 62%(178/289명)이 구조화된 응급 외과 자격증 프로그램 지지.
[임상 적용·한계] 응급 병원에서 비업무시간 외과 대응 능력 강화의 필요성을 시사하며 응급 외과 자격증 프로그램 도입 검토 필요; 다만 단일 국가(미국) 설문 기반이고 소동물 중심이므로 대동물이나 국제적 적용성 제한.

papers.title: Retrospective Evaluation of the Quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (qSOFA) Score as a Prognostic Indicator in Dogs With Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome (2017-2023): 112 Cases.
papers.authors: Kim D, Kim JK, Kim H, Lee S, Lee WJ
papers.abstract: To evaluate the prognostic value of the quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (qSOFA) score in dogs meeting the systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) criteria. Retrospective study. Secondary referral animal hospital. A total of 112 dogs diagnosed with SIRS between 2017 and 2023 were included. None. A total of 112 dogs meeting the SIRS criteria were included; of these, 65 (60%) died during hospitalization. In the univariable analysis, a qSOFA score ≥2 was associated with mortality (p < 0.001). In the multivariable logistic regression analysis, qSOFA score ≥2 was not retained as an independent predictor of mortality after adjustment for other variables (odds ratio [OR]: 2.24, 95% CI: 0.71-7.06; p = 0.172). Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis for qSOFA score ≥2 yielded an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.73 (95% CI: 0.63-0.84), with a sensitivity of 72% and a specificity of 75% for predicting mortality. In dogs with SIRS, the qSOFA score may serve as a practical tool for initial risk stratification. Nevertheless, given its limited prognostic value when used independently, further study is warranted.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] SIRS 진단 개에서 qSOFA 점수는 초기 위험도 계층화의 실용적 도구가 될 수 있으나, 독립적으로 사용할 경우 예후 예측 능력이 제한적이다.
[방법·수치] 2017-2023년 SIRS 기준을 만족하는 개 112마리의 후향적 분석; 입원 중 사망률 60% (65/112마리); qSOFA 점수 ≥2는 단변량 분석에서 사망과 연관 (p<0.001)이나, 다변량 로지스틱 회귀 후 독립적 예후 인자 아님 (OR: 2.24, 95% CI: 0.71-7.06, p=0.172); ROC 곡선 분석 결과 AUC 0.73 (95% CI: 0.63-0.84), 민감도 72%, 특이도 75%.
[임상 적용·한계] SIRS 환자의 초기 위험도 평가 시 간단한 선별 도구로 활용 가능하나, 단독으로는 예후 판정 근거로 부족하며 다른 임상 변수와 함께 고려해야 함; 후향적 단일 기관 연구로서 외적 타당도 제한.

papers.title: Myocardial Responses to Eplontersen in Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy: The CARDIO-TTRansform CMR study.
papers.authors: Razvi Y, Solomon SD, Cuddy SAM, Venneri L, Martinez-Naharro A
papers.abstract: Transthyretin-lowering therapies target the underlying cause of transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM), but their effects on myocardial amyloid burden and cardiac remodelling remain incompletely characterized. We evaluated the myocardial effects of sustained transthyretin suppression with eplontersen using serial multiparametric cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR). This CMR study was a pre-specified, international, prospective study embedded within the randomized, placebo-controlled phase 3 CARDIO-TTRansform trial. Participants underwent CMR at baseline and planned assessments at weeks 25, 49, 97, and 140. The primary imaging analysis evaluated longitudinal changes in CMR parameters using mixed models for repeated measures. Myocardial amyloid regression and progression were defined as ≥5 percentage-point decreases and increases in extracellular volume (ECV), respectively. All other patients were considered stable. We enrolled 120 participants with baseline and ≥1 follow-up CMR assessment (eplontersen, n=58; placebo, n=62; mean age, 76.7±6.5 years; 95% male; baseline stabilizer, 12.5%). At week 140 eplontersen resulted in lower ECV, compared with placebo (least-squares mean difference [95% CI], -6.7 percentage points [ -8.7 to -4.7]; P<0.001) and lower native T1 ( -25.9ms [-41.7 to -10.2 ]; P=0.002) and left ventricular mass (-19.1g [-28.0 to -10.2]; P<0.001). Eplontersen also increased left ventricular ejection fraction (+5.1% [1.8-8.3]; P=0.002), right ventricular ejection fraction (+4.6% [0.6-8.7]; P=0.03), and left ventricular global longitudinal, circumferential, and radial strain and right ventricular longitudinal strain (all P<0.05), compared to placebo. At week-140, myocardial amyloid regression occurred in 12.5% receiving eplontersen versus 0% receiving placebo, whereas progression occurred in 12.5% versus 76%, respectively.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 에플론터센을 통한 지속적인 트랜스티레틴 억제는 위약군 대비 심근 세포외용적 감소, 좌심실 질량 감소, 양심실 수축 기능 및 변형 개선을 유도하며, 심근 아밀로이드 퇴행을 12.5% 달성하여 질병 진행을 억제한다.
[방법·수치] 무작위 대조 3상 임상시험에 내장된 국제 다기관 전향적 CMR 연구로 120명 참여자(에플론터센 58명, 위약 62명, 평균 나이 76.7±6.5세, 남성 95%)를 140주까지 추적 평가했다. 140주차 에플론터센군에서 세포외용적 -6.7%-point (P<0.001), 원본 T1 -25.9ms (P=0.002), 좌심실 질량 -19.1g (P<0.001), 좌심실 박출률 +5.1% (P=0.002)로 위약군 대비 유의한 개선을 보였다. 심근 아밀로이드 퇴행은 에플론터센 12.5% vs 위약 0%, 진행은 에플론터센 12.5% vs 위약 76%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 직렬 다중모수 CMR은 ATTR-CM 치료 반응 평가의 객관적 지표로 활용 가능하며, 에플론터센이 질병 진행을 호전시키는 근거를 제공한다. 기저치에서 안정화제 사용률이 낮은(12.5%) 특정 환자군 연구로 다양한 치료 배경을 가진 환자군에서의 효과 평가 필요성이 있다.

papers.title: Effects of Eplontersen on Cardiac Structure and Function in Patients With Transthyretin Amyloidosis With Cardiomyopathy: Insights from the CARDIO-TTRansform Trial.
papers.authors: Jering KS, Skali H, Claggett B, Prasad N, Chen J
papers.abstract: In CARDIO-TTRansform, the TTR (transthyretin) silencer eplontersen did not significantly reduce the primary end point of cardiovascular death and recurrent cardiovascular events in patients with TTR amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy, although treatment effects varied by baseline TTR stabilizer use. Whether eplontersen favorably affects cardiac structure and function is unknown. CARDIO-TTRansform randomized 1432 patients with TTR amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy to eplontersen (45 mg) subcutaneously every 4 weeks or placebo. Echocardiograms were performed at baseline and weeks 61, 97, and 140. Associations of baseline echocardiographic measures with all-cause mortality and the primary end point were evaluated using Cox and semiparametric proportional rates models. Between-group differences at week 140 were analyzed with mixed models for repeated measures. Among 1426 participants with baseline echocardiograms (mean age, 76±7 years, 91% men, 85% wild type, 57% receiving stabilizers), baseline measures of left ventricular systolic function (LV ejection fraction, global longitudinal strain, stroke volume, myocardial contraction fraction), diastolic function (E wave deceleration time, septal e', average E/e'), and right ventricular function and hemodynamics were independently associated with all-cause mortality or the primary end point. At week 140 (echocardiograms available in 554 patients in the eplontersen group and 506 in the placebo group), eplontersen attenuated increases in mean LV wall thickness (least-squares mean [LSM] difference, -0.24 mm [95% CI, -0.48 to -0.01]) and declines in LV stroke volume (LSM difference, 1.88 mL [95% CI, 0.07-3.69]), myocardial contraction fraction (LSM difference, 0.88% [95% CI, 0.25-1.57]), average E/e' (LSM difference, -0.71 [95% CI, -1.36 to -0.07]), and right ventricular outflow tract velocity-time integral (LSM difference, 0.42 [95% CI, 0.00-0.85]) versus placebo in the overall cohort.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Eplontersen은 TTR 아밀로이드증 심근병증 환자에서 좌심실 벽 두께 증가를 억제하고 좌심실 뇌졸중용적, 심근 수축분획, 평균 E/e', 우심실 유출로 속도-시간 적분의 감소를 완화시켰으나, 이러한 효과는 기저치에서 안정화제를 사용하지 않은 환자에서만 관찰되었다.
