[방법·수치] CARDIO-TTRansform 시험에 TTR 아밀로이드증 심근병증 환자 1432명을 무작위 배정하였고, eplontersen 45 mg 또는 위약을 4주마다 피하주사하였다. 심초음파는 기저치, 61주, 97주, 140주에 시행하였다. 140주 평가에서 eplontersen 군 554명, 위약 군 506명의 심초음파 자료가 있었다. 좌심실 벽 두께 증가 감소(-0.24 mm, 95% CI -0.48~-0.01), 좌심실 뇌졸중용적 감소 완화(1.88 mL, 95% CI 0.07-3.69), 심근 수축분획 개선(0.88%, 95% CI 0.25-1.57), 평균 E/e' 개선(-0.71, 95% CI -1.36~-0.07), 우심실 유출로 속도-시간 적분 개선(0.42, 95% CI 0.00-0.85)이 위약 대비 관찰되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 주요 임상 종료점(심혈관 사망·반복 심혈관 사건)을 유의하게 줄이지 못했으나, 예후와 연관된 좌심실·우심실 기능 지표의 악화를 완만하게 했다는 점에서 TTR 침묵화의 구조적 이점을 보여준다. 다만 140주 시점 심초음파가 eplontersen 554명·위약 506명(기저치 검사 1426명의 약 40%)에서만 확보된 하위 분석이고, 효과가 기저치 안정화제 미사용 환자에 국한됐다.

papers.title: Validation of a New Quick and High-Throughput Latex Agglutination Immuno-Assay for Feline Alpha-1-Acid Glycoprotein.
papers.authors: Museux K, Remmel P, Leloup J, Bouillet G, Montaufray E
papers.abstract: Alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP) is currently considered the most sensitive and specific inflammatory marker for diagnosing feline infectious peritonitis (FIP) and monitoring cats undergoing antiviral treatment. Various feline AGP assays have been validated, but currently, no assay compatible with biochemistry analyzers is available for the rapid analysis of high sample volumes in reference laboratories. This study aimed to validate a novel method of AGP measurement in cats using a latex agglutination immunoassay on the Cobas 6000 (Roche, Meylan, France) and establish a reference interval (RI). Surplus serum/heparin plasma sample pools with low (~330 μg/mL), medium (~970 μg/mL), and high (~2600 μg/mL) AGP concentrations, determined by the latex agglutination immunoassay, were used to establish intra- and inter-assay coefficient of variation (CV). Precision, linearity, recovery, and stability were assessed using pooled samples. RI was determined on surplus serum samples of 43 healthy cats. The intra-assay CV was 7.6%, 6.1%, and 3.5%, and the inter-assay CV was 6.4%, 5.1%, and 6.2% for low, medium, and high AGP concentrations, respectively. Excellent linearity (R2 = 0.99) was observed for AGP concentrations between 194.1 and 1412.4 μg/mL. The upper reference limit was 622.8 μg/mL (90% confidence interval 517.1-713.7 μg/mL). Age and sex did not have a significant impact on AGP concentrations. The latex agglutination immunoassay allows a precise and high-throughput analysis of AGP concentrations in cats. This assay will greatly enhance the availability of AGP measurements.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 라텍스 응집 면역검사법은 고양이 알파-1-산성 당단백질(AGP) 측정에서 정밀하고 높은 처리량의 분석을 제공하며, 생화학 분석기에 호환되어 대량 샘플 분석이 가능하다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 고양이 43마리의 혈청에서 기준 범위를 설정했으며, 저/중/고 농도에서 검사 내 변동계수는 각각 7.6%, 6.1%, 3.5%, 검사 간 변동계수는 6.4%, 5.1%, 6.2%였다. 194.1~1412.4 μg/mL 범위에서 우수한 직선성(R2=0.99)을 보였고, 상한 기준값은 622.8 μg/mL(90% 신뢰구간 517.1-713.7 μg/mL)이다.
[임상 적용·한계] FIP 진단 및 항바이러스 치료 모니터링 시 AGP 측정의 가용성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있으나, 연구에 사용된 건강한 고양이 샘플이 제한적이고 질병 고양이 샘플에서의 성능 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Comparative Immunoreactivity of iNOS, PCNA and p53 in Stable and Progressive Canine Transmissible Venereal Tumours.
papers.authors: Dincel GC, Yıldırım S, Anteplioğlu T, İlhan F, Karasu A
papers.abstract: Canine transmissible venereal tumour (CTVT) is a naturally occurring transmissible neoplasm with variable biological behaviour, including progressive growth, stationary behaviour and spontaneous regression. However, the marker-expression patterns associated with these clinicopathological phenotypes remain incompletely characterised. The present study investigated iNOS, PCNA and p53 expression in CTVT and evaluated their association with the operational clinicopathological phenotype. Sixteen genital CTVT samples obtained from surgically treated dogs were classified as stable (n = 7) or progressive (n = 9) using predefined criteria requiring concordance between local invasion and quantitative mitotic count. Immunohistochemistry was performed for iNOS, PCNA, p53 and cytokeratin (CK), and immunoreactivity was evaluated semiquantitatively by two blinded observers. Progressive tumours showed significantly higher iNOS, PCNA and p53 immunoreactivity scores than stable tumours. Across the three markers, median scores ranged from 0 to 1 in stable tumours and were 3 in progressive tumours, with significant differences in all comparisons (Mann-Whitney U = 0.0; two-sided exact p = 0.0002). iNOS immunoreactivity was predominantly cytoplasmic in tumour cells, with occasional staining in vascular endothelial and inflammatory cells, whereas PCNA and p53 showed widespread nuclear positivity in progressive tumours and more limited expression in stable tumours. CK immunoreactivity was absent in all samples, consistent with the absence of detectable cytokeratin expression in the examined tumours. To our knowledge, the present study provides the first tumour-cell-focused characterisation of iNOS immunoreactivity in CTVT, evaluated concurrently with PCNA and p53 across operationally defined stable and progressive clinicopathological phenotypes.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 전염성 음부종양(CTVT)에서 iNOS, PCNA, p53의 면역반응성은 진행성 종양에서 안정적 종양보다 유의하게 높으며, 이들 표지자가 종양의 생물학적 행동을 반영할 수 있음을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 수술로 제거된 개 생식기 CTVT 샘플 16개(안정적 7개, 진행성 9개)를 면역조직화학으로 분석했다. 진행성 종양의 세 표지자 중앙값은 3이었고 안정적 종양은 0~1이었으며, 모든 비교에서 유의한 차이를 보였다(Mann-Whitney U=0.0, p=0.0002).
[임상 적용·한계] iNOS, PCNA, p53 발현 패턴이 CTVT의 임상경과 예측에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 소규모 샘플(n=16)에 기반한 연구이며 단일기관 데이터로서 임상적 유용성 검증을 위한 추가 대규모 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Iron Repletion in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction: The IRONMET-HFpEF Randomized Trial.
papers.authors: Lewis GD, Horick NK, Moreno F, Lim K, Cocca-Spofford D
papers.abstract: Iron deficiency is present in >50% of patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and is associated with reduced exercise capacity and survival. Whether iron repletion improves exercise capacity as objectively measured by peak oxygen uptake ([Formula: see text]) is unknown. The IRONMET-HFpEF trial (Impact of Intravenous Iron Repletion on Mechanisms of Exercise Intolerance in HFpEF) sought to determine whether ferric derisomaltose (FDI) compared with placebo improves peak [Formula: see text] in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction with iron deficiency. This was a double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial of patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and iron deficiency, defined as ferritin <100 ng/mL or <300 ng/mL with transferrin saturation <20%. Participants were enrolled between December 2021 and April 2026. Single-dose ferric derisomaltose (1000 mg; n=44) or placebo (n=21) was administered once intravenously. The primary end point was the change in peak [Formula: see text] from baseline to 12 weeks with an analysis of covariance model including terms for treatment group, baseline peak [Formula: see text], and sex. Secondary end points included changes in [Formula: see text] at the anaerobic threshold, 6-minute walk test distance, New York Heart Association class, health status assessed by the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire-Overall Summary Score, and iron biomarkers at 12 weeks. Among 65 randomized participants (median age, 68 years [interquartile range, 58-76 years], 72% women, transferrin saturation 16.0±7.4%, ferritin 57.8±48.9 ng/mL), 64 (98.5%) completed the study. The median baseline peak [Formula: see text] was 12.7 mL·kg-1·min-1 (interquartile range, 10.6-15.8 mL·kg-1·min-1) in the FDI group and 12.2 mL·kg-1·min-1 (11.6-14.6 mL·kg-1·min-1) in the placebo group.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 보존된 좌심실 박출계수를 가진 심부전(HFpEF) 환자에서 철 결핍이 50% 이상 존재하며, 정맥 철분 보충(ferric derisomaltose)은 위약 대비 운동 능력을 유의하게 개선시킨다.
[방법·수치] 이중맹검 위약 대조 무작위임상시험으로 철 결핍 HFpEF 환자 65명(중앙값 68세, 여성 72%)을 대상으로 1000mg ferric derisomaltose(n=44) 또는 위약(n=21)을 단회 정맥 투여 후 12주 추적. Peak VO2는 FDI군에서 1.2 mL·kg-1·min-1 증가, 위약군에서 0.1 증가(최소제곱평균차 1.1, 95% CI 0.2-1.9, P=0.02); 무산소역치 VO2, 6분 보행거리, NYHA 등급도 FDI군이 우월(모두 P<0.05).
[임상 적용·한계] HFpEF와 철 결핍이 동반된 환자의 운동 불내증 개선에 정맥 철분 보충이 임상적 효용을 보이므로 대상 환자 선별 시 고려 가능하나, 소규모 단일 지역 연구로 대규모 추가 검증 필요하며 삶의 질 점수(KCCQ)는 유의한 개선을 보이지 않았다.

papers.title: A blinded, non-inferiority randomised clinical trial comparing the efficacy and safety of low-dose methotrexate and ciclosporin for the control of moderate to severe canine atopic dermatitis.
papers.authors: Rostang A, Mosca M, Panzuti P, Pressanti C, Idée A
papers.abstract: Canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) is a chronic, inflammatory skin disease that may require long-term systemic immunomodulatory treatment. Low-dose methotrexate (MTX) is an inexpensive immunomodulator used in human dermatology, but robust veterinary data are lacking. To determine whether weekly subcutaneous low-dose MTX is non-inferior to oral ciclosporin (CsA) in controlling moderate-to-severe cAD. Fifty-five client-owned dogs with non-seasonal moderate-to-severe cAD enrolled at nine dermatology centres in France. Randomised, double-blind, positive-controlled, multicentre non-inferiority trial. Dogs received either subcutaneous MTX (0.15-0.5 mg/kg/week) plus oral placebo, or oral CsA (5 mg/kg/day, then spaced) plus injectable placebo. The primary endpoint was the percentage reduction in the CADESI-04 lesional score on week 28 (non-inferiority margin 20%). Secondary endpoints included the Pruritus Visual Analogue Scale (PVAS) and CADESI-04 scores, assessed 4-weekly, and drug protocol safety assessments. Fifty-five dogs were randomised (MTX n = 28; CsA n = 27). At week 28, mean CADESI-04 reductions were 65.4% (MTX) and 69.5% (CsA), demonstrating non-inferiority. CsA induced faster improvement (weeks 4-12), but efficacy converged by week 20. Gastrointestinal adverse events occurred more frequently with MTX (82%) than with CsA (70%). No consistent haematological, renal or hepatic injury was observed during the study. Two MTX-treated dogs developed severe liver disease during long-term follow-up. Weekly subcutaneous low-dose MTX provided non-inferior control of lesions and pruritus compared with CsA by week 28. Although slower in onset and associated with more gastrointestinal adverse events, MTX may represent an affordable long-term cAD treatment option, with appropriate hepatic monitoring.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 저용량 메토트렉세이트(MTX)는 주 1회 피하주사로 경구 사이클로스포린(CsA)과 비교하여 중등도 이상 개 아토피성 피부염의 병변 조절에 있어 비열등성을 입증했다. MTX는 발효가 느리지만 최종적으로 동등한 효과를 보였으며, 더 저렴한 장기 치료 옵션이 될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 프랑스 9개 피부과 센터에서 중등도 이상 비계절성 개 아토피성 피부염 환자 55마리(MTX군 28마리, CsA군 27마리)를 대상으로 한 맹검 비열등성 임상시험. MTX는 0.15-0.5 mg/kg/주, CsA는 5 mg/kg/일 투여. 주요 평가지표는 28주차 CADESI-04 병변점수 감소율(비열등성 마진 20%), 주요 결과는 MTX 65.4%, CsA 69.5% 감소로 비열등성 입증. MTX군에서 소화기계 이상반응이 82%로 CsA군 70%보다 높음.
[임상 적용·한계] MTX는 저렴한 가격으로 장기 치료 옵션이 될 수 있으나, 초기 반응이 느리고 위장관계 부작용이 더 많으며 간독성 모니터링이 필수적이다. 소규모 단일국가 임상시험이고 장기 추적에서 2마리의 MTX 치료견이 심각한 간질환을 발병했으므로, 정기적인 간기능 검사가 필요하다.

papers.title: Statin-Ezetimibe Combination Therapy versus Statin Monotherapy in Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease: A Prespecified Secondary Analysis of the Randomized Ez-PAVE Trial.
papers.authors: Lee SH, Byun YS, Kim JW, Park JH, Cho JM
papers.abstract: In a target-directed low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C)-lowering strategy, the impact of the initial treatment regimen has not been investigated in patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. We compared the efficacy and safety of initial statin-ezetimibe combination therapy versus statin monotherapy within intensive or conventional LDL-C-targeting strategies. In this prespecified second randomization of the randomized Ez-PAVE trial (Effects of Ezetimibe Combination Therapy for Patients With Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease: Randomized Comparison of LDL Cholesterol Targeting <70 versus <55 mg/dL) conducted at 17 centers in South Korea, a total of 3048 patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease were enrolled between January 2021 and July 2022. Following the first randomization to either an intensive (<55 mg/dL) or conventional (<70 mg/dL) LDL-C-targeting strategy, patients underwent subsequent randomization (initial statin-ezetimibe combination therapy [n=1525] versus statin monotherapy [n=1523]) and were followed up for 3 years. Lipid-lowering therapy was adjusted according to a predefined protocol to achieve LDL-C targets. The primary end point was a 3-year composite of death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, any revascularization, or hospitalization for unstable angina. The mean±SD age was 64.4±9.0 years, and 638 patients (20.9%) were female. The incidence of the primary end point did not differ between statin-ezetimibe combination therapy (128 patients [8.5%]) and statin monotherapy (119 patients [7.9%]; hazard ratio, 1.07 [95% CI, 0.83-1.37]; P=0.596).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 죽상동맥경화성 심혈관질환 환자에서 초기 스타틴-에제티미브 병합요법은 스타틴 단독요법 대비 3년 추적관찰 중 심혈관 사건 발생률을 유의하게 감소시키지 못했으나, 더 낮은 LDL-콜레스테롤 수준 달성을 용이하게 했다.
[방법·수치] 한국 17개 센터의 무작위 임상시험(Ez-PAVE)에서 죽상동맥경화성 심혈관질환 환자 3048명(평균 연령 64.4세, 여성 20.9%)을 집중적 LDL-C 목표(<55 mg/dL) 또는 기존 목표(<70 mg/dL) 전략에 따라 초기 병합요법(n=1525) 또는 단독요법(n=1523)으로 무작위배정하여 3년간 추적관찰했다. 주요 종료점(3년간 심혈관 사망, 비치명적 심근경색, 비치명적 뇌졸중, 혈관재개통, 불안정성 협심증 입원)은 병합요법 8.5%(128명) 대 단독요법 7.9%(119명, 위험비 1.07, 95% CI 0.83-1.37, P=0.596)로 차이 없었으며, 병합요법은 집중-목표 전략에서 중앙 LDL-C 53 mg/dL 대 62 mg/dL, 기존-목표 전략에서 63 mg/dL 대 70 mg/dL로 더 낮은 수준을 달성했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 목표지향 LDL-C 강하에서 초기 병합요법은 임상 결과 개선 없이도 더 낮은 LDL-C 목표 도달을 앞당기는 선택지가 될 수 있다. 단일 국가·3년 추적이라 장기 효과는 알 수 없고, 단독요법군에서도 프로토콜에 따라 에제티미브가 추가돼(집중목표군 34.3%, 기존목표군 24.8%) 두 군의 실제 치료 차이가 줄어든 점을 감안해야 한다.

papers.title: Leveraging AI-ECG Technology for Early Notification and Tracking of AF Development (LATENT): A Randomized Controlled Trial.
papers.authors: Lee CC, Lin WY, Liu WT, Chang CH, Liu YL
papers.abstract: Electrocardiographic analysis aided by artificial intelligence (AI) may identify atrial electrical vulnerability during sinus rhythm. The objective of this study was to determine whether AI-enabled ECG (AI-ECG) is effective for detecting atrial fibrillation (AF), atrial flutter (AFl), or prespecified pre-AF atrial findings in a randomized trial. In this single-center, open-label trial, 14 665 adults 40 to 85 years of age without previous AF/AFl were randomized to an AI-ECG-guided strategy or usual care. Participants randomized to AI-ECG who were then identified by AI as having a high-risk sinus-rhythm ECG in the preceding year were offered Holter monitoring for ≤7 days. Each monitored high-risk intervention participant was paired with an age- and sex-matched control selected before control ECGs underwent AI analysis. Matched controls received identical monitoring to reduce ascertainment bias. Reporting cardiologists were blinded to AI results and randomized assignment. The primary outcome was a composite of newly detected AF, AFl, or pre-AF atrial findings within 90 days. Pre-AF atrial findings comprised frequent premature atrial complexes, short runs of premature atrial complexes, or nonsustained AF/AFl. Among 7337 intervention and 7328 control participants, 84 (1.1%) and 78 (1.1%), respectively, were classified as high risk. Of the 84 high-risk intervention participants, 48 (57.1%) underwent monitoring, as did 48 matched controls. The primary outcome occurred in 54 intervention participants (0.74%) versus 35 control participants (0.48%; odds ratio, 1.54 [95% CI, 1.01-2.37]; P=0.046). Hypothetical reclassification of 1 intervention event to a nonevent changed the primary analysis P value to 0.057. The intervention effect on detection of the primary composite outcome differed by baseline AI-ECG risk (Pinteraction<0.001): 32.1% versus 2.6% among high-risk participants and 0.4% versus 0.5% among low-risk participants.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] AI-ECG 기반 고위험 환자에 대한 선택적 홀터 모니터링은 심방세동, 심방조동, 전-AF 심방 소견의 검출을 통계적으로 미약하게 증가시켰으나(OR 1.54, P=0.046), 통계적 강건성이 낮고 1개 사건 재분류로 P값이 0.057로 변화하여 임상적 의미는 제한적임.
[방법·수치] 단일 기관 개방 표지 무작위 대조군 연구로 40-85세 AF/AFl 기왕력 없는 성인 14,665명(중재군 7,337명, 대조군 7,328명)을 등록했고, AI-ECG 고위험 판정자에게 ≤7일 홀터 모니터링을 제공함. 1차 결과는 90일 내 새로운 AF/AFl/전-AF 심방 소견으로, 중재군 0.74% vs 대조군 0.48% 발생(P=0.046); 고위험 부분군에서는 32.1% vs 2.6%로 큰 차이를 보임.
[임상 적용·한계] AI-ECG 위험도 계층화는 타겟화된 리듬 감시 가이드 전략으로서 임상 적용 가능성을 제시하나, 본 연구는 단일 기관 소규모(모니터링 시행 48명)이며 통계적 강건성 부족, AF/AFl 검출 및 항부정맥약 치료 개시에서 유의한 차이 없음, 모니터링 관련 부작용 22.9% 발생 등 한계가 있으므로 더 큰 규모의 환자 결과 개선 평가 필요.

papers.title: AI-Enabled Echocardiography Identifies Prominent Epicardial Adipose Tissue Associated With an Adverse Cardiometabolic Profile.
papers.authors: Aminorroaya A, Coppi A, McNamara RL, Lima JAC, Krumholz HM
papers.abstract: Excess epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) is associated with cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic dysfunction, but its assessment has traditionally required advanced imaging. We investigated whether artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled echocardiography could characterize epicardial adiposity and identify residual cardiometabolic risk. We developed PanAdipo, a video-based deep learning model in 1,114,441 videos from 28,797 studies across the Yale-New Haven Health System (YNHHS) (2016-2022), using report-derived expert reader labels of prominent EAT (2.3% of studies). PanAdipo was evaluated in 5 testing cohorts: a temporally distinct YNHHS transthoracic echocardiography set (n = 4,588 patients contributing 5,130 studies), an emergency department point-of-care ultrasound cohort (n = 10,957), the geographically distinct MIMIC-IV (Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care, version IV) data set (n = 4,549), the community-based MESA (Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis) Exam 6 (n = 2,740), as well as in held-out YNHHS patients with paired coronary computed tomography (CT) angiography within 12 months (n = 5,167). Analyses examined discrimination of the report label and of CT-defined high indexed EAT volume, correlation with paired cardiac CT phenotypes, and body mass index (BMI)-adjusted associations with cardiometabolic biomarkers and newly documented metabolic disease. In the held-out health system test set, PanAdipo identified prominent EAT documented in clinical reports with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.82-0.91) across views.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] AI 기반 심초음파 모델(PanAdipo)은 심외막지방(EAT)을 정확히 식별하며, 이는 인슐린 저항성, 지방간질환, 고지혈증 등 불리한 대사 프로필과 연관됨을 보여 심초음파를 대사 위험 계층화에 활용할 수 있음을 시사함.
[방법·수치] 28,797건의 초음파 연구(1,114,441개 동영상)로 개발된 딥러닝 모델을 5개 테스트 코호트에서 평가(YNHHS n=4,588, 응급실 POC 초음파 n=10,957, MIMIC-IV n=4,549, MESA n=2,740, CT 쌍을 이룬 환자 n=5,167). PanAdipo는 임상 보고서 기반 현저한 EAT 식별 시 AUROC 0.86(95% CI: 0.82-0.91), CT 정의 고용적 EAT 판별 시 AUROC 0.90(95% CI: 0.89-0.92) 달성. 용적 지정 EAT와의 상관(Spearman ρ=0.76)이 BMI(ρ=0.41)보다 강함. MESA에서 높은 점수는 HOMA-IR 증가(β=0.17 per SD; 95% CI: 0.11-0.22)와 연관, 지방간질환(pooled HR: 1.33 per SD; 95% CI: 1.11-1.59)과 고지혈증(HR: 1.11; 95% CI: 1.04-1.18)의 새로운 진단과도 관련.
[임상 적용·한계] 표준 심초음파 영상만으로 별도의 고급 영상 없이 심외막지방을 비침습적으로 평가해 대사 위험을 계층화할 수 있음을 시사한다. 다만 단일 의료기관 데이터로 개발된 모델이라 외부 검증이 제한적이고, 질환 연관 분석은 탐색적이어서 일부 추정치의 신뢰구간이 1을 넘으며, 인과관계는 입증되지 않았다.

papers.title: Multimodality Cardiac Imaging Substudy of the DAPT-SHOCK-AMI Randomized Trial: Echocardiographic and Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Assessment of Cangrelor versus Crushed Ticagrelor in Cardiogenic Shock Complicating Acute Myocardial Infarction.
papers.authors: Motovska Z, Ionita O, Guglielmo M, Hromadka M, Baxa J
papers.abstract: In acute myocardial infarction complicated by cardiogenic shock (AMI-CS), the myocardium sustains a dual injury: ischemia of the culprit territory and global hypoperfusion from low cardiac output. Whether platelet inhibition at reperfusion affects the microcirculation, the infarct, the noninfarcted myocardium, and ventricular function, and over what time course, has not been examined with serial imaging. The prespecified multimodality imaging substudy of the randomized DAPT-SHOCK-AMI trial (intravenous cangrelor versus crushed oral ticagrelor) addressed this question. Patients at prespecified imaging sites underwent serial echocardiography (208 enrolled; evaluable examinations in 175, 120, and 99 patients in the acute phase, at 1 month, and at 1 year) and cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR; 93 enrolled; 73, 68, and 63); 81 patients (40 and 41) underwent both modalities. Blinded core laboratories analyzed all studies. The primary imaging endpoint was microvascular obstruction (MVO) on acute CMR, evaluable in 60 patients; secondary endpoints were infarct size, native T1 of the global, infarcted, and remote myocardium, left ventricular (LV) ejection fraction (LVEF), global longitudinal strain (GLS), E/e', and left atrial volume, and their changes. Comparisons between the cangrelor and crushed ticagrelor arms used covariate-adjusted logistic or linear regression; the substudy was not separately powered. The odds of acute MVO were lower with cangrelor (adjusted odds ratio 0.27 [95% CI 0.08 to 0.98]; P=0.023). Infarct size did not differ between the arms. At 1 year, native T1 of the remote myocardium was lower with cangrelor (adjusted mean 1114 [95% CI 1057 to 1171] versus 1171 [1115 to 1228] ms; P=0.005).
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 급성 심근경색 동반 심인성 쇼크에서 캉그렐러는 분쇄 티카그렐러 대비 급성 미세혈관폐색(MVO) 발생을 유의하게 감소시켰으며, 1년 추적에서 좌심실 사출률 회복이 더 우수하고 원격 심근의 조직 손상이 경미했다. [방법·수치] DAPT-SHOCK-AMI 무작위 대조시험의 사전계획 영상 분석으로, 심초음파 208명(급성기 175명, 1개월 120명, 1년 99명) 및 심자기공명 93명(73명, 68명, 63명) 대상; 급성 MVO 발생률은 캉그렐러군에서 유의하게 낮음(보정 승산비 0.27, 95% CI 0.08-0.98, P=0.023), 1년 좌심실 사출률 증가는 캉그렐러군에서 더 큼(심초음파 37.9% vs 21.7%, P=0.046; 심자기공명 15.8% vs 2.1%, P=0.027), 원격 심근 T1값은 캉그렐러군에서 낮음(1114 vs 1171 ms, P=0.005). [임상 적용·한계] 심인성 쇼크 동반 급성 심근경색 환자에서 캉그렐러 사용이 미세혈관 보호와 심실 기능 회복에 유리할 가능성을 시사하나, 사전동력분석이 없는 부분연구이고 기전이 확실하지 않으므로 추가 대규모 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Long-Term Survival After Initial Invasive or Conservative Management of Stable Coronary Disease in Patients With Advanced Chronic Kidney Disease: ISCHEMIA-CKD EXTEND.
papers.authors: Bangalore S, Maron DJ, Anthopolos R, Reynolds HR, Xu Y
papers.abstract: In the ISCHEMIA-CKD trial (International Study of Comparative Health Effectiveness With Medical and Invasive Approaches-Chronic Kidney Disease), at a median follow-up of 2.2 years, the primary composite outcome of death or nonfatal myocardial infarction was similar between an initial invasive strategy (INV) compared with an initial conservative strategy (CON) in patients with moderate or severe myocardial ischemia and advanced chronic kidney disease. However, the long-term outcomes comparing the 2 strategies are unknown. Participants in the ISCHEMIA-CKD trial were randomly assigned to either INV, involving coronary angiography and revascularization when feasible, added to guideline-directed medical therapy or to CON with guideline-directed medical therapy alone and invasive procedures reserved for failure of guideline-directed medical therapy. After the active intervention trial phase, long-term vital status follow-up was conducted through participant contact by participating sites and by health record and centralized death database searches. The primary outcome for the extended follow-up phase was all-cause mortality. Secondary outcomes were cause-specific mortality, including cardiovascular and noncardiovascular mortality. Among the 777 participants randomized (388 to INV and 389 to CON), over a median of 8 years of follow-up, vital status retention among survivors was 95%. There was a total of 429 deaths (55%). Cumulative all-cause mortality (57.4% versus 56.8%; adjusted hazard ratio, 1.05 [95% CI, 0.87-1.28]) or cardiovascular mortality (40.3% versus 38.4%; adjusted hazard ratio, 1.06 [95% CI, 0.84-1.34]) at 8 years did not differ between INV and CON. The restricted mean survival time was 1941 days (1834-2047 days) for INV versus 1990 days (1885-2094 days) for CON, with an adjusted estimated difference of -99 days (-245 to 46).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 중등도 이상의 심근 허혈을 가진 말기 만성신부전 환자에서 초기 침습적 전략(관상동맥조영술 및 재관류술)은 초기 보존적 치료 전략에 비해 전체 사망률 또는 심혈관 사망률을 감소시키는 장기 이득이 없었다.
[방법·수치] ISCHEMIA-CKD 무작위배정 시험에서 침습적 전략 388명, 보존적 전략 389명의 총 777명을 중앙 8년 추적 관찰하였으며, 전체 사망 429명(55%)이 발생했다. 누적 전체 사망률 57.4% vs 56.8%(adjusted HR 1.05, 95% CI 0.87-1.28), 심혈관 사망률 40.3% vs 38.4%(adjusted HR 1.06, 95% CI 0.84-1.34)로 두 군 간 차이가 없었다. 제한된 평균 생존 시간은 침습적 1941일 vs 보존적 1990일로 조정 차이 -99일(-245~46)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 진행된 신기능 감소 환자에서 무증상 심근 허혈 발견 시 침습적 재관류 치료의 생존 이득이 명확하지 않으므로 개별화된 치료 결정이 필요하다. 본 연구는 고위험 환자군 대상이므로 다른 환자군에의 외삽 가능성 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Surgical outcomes of congenital cleft palate repair in dogs: a scoping review.
papers.authors: Elazegui E, Wolfs E
papers.abstract: Congenital cleft palate (CFP) is a common orofacial malformation in dogs associated with substantial morbidity and neonatal mortality. The objective of this scoping review was to map the current veterinary literature describing surgical approaches, reported outcomes, complications, and evidence gaps following surgical repair of canine CFPs. A scoping review was conducted and reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (ie, PRISMA-ScR) framework. PubMed, Web of Science, and Google Scholar were searched through January 21, 2026. Two reviewers independently screened records and charted outcomes. Eligible studies reported clinical data on surgical management of canine CFP, including oronasal fistula formation, revision surgery, or postoperative complications. "Experimental Design Grade" and "Evidence Grade" were used as descriptive critical appraisal tools. These grades were not considered formal risk-of-bias assessments. 19 studies involving 122 dogs met inclusion criteria. No prospective studies were identified. Surgical approaches included von Langenbeck-type repairs, overlapping flap palatoplasty, and other mucoperiosteal or adjunctive reconstructive techniques. Oronasal fistula formation was the most commonly reported complication, ranging from 0% to 100%. Revision surgery was reported in up to 50% of cases. All included sources were classified as Experimental Design Grade III-V, and substantial heterogeneity existed in surgical techniques, outcome definitions, and follow-up duration (0.25 to 127 months). No surgical technique demonstrated consistent superiority. Multiple surgical techniques can achieve acceptable functional outcomes in dogs with CFPs; however, postoperative complications, particularly oronasal fistula formation, remain common.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 선천성 구개열 수술 후 기능적 개선은 가능하나 구비강루(oronasal fistula) 형성이 가장 흔한 합병증이며, 재수술이 최대 50%까지 보고되었다.
[방법·수치] 19개 연구, 122마리 개를 대상으로 한 범위 체계적 검토이며, von Langenbeck 형 수술, 겹침 판막 구개성형술 등 다양한 수술법이 보고되었다. 구비강루 발생률 0~100%, 재수술률 최대 50%, 추적관찰 기간 0.25~127개월로 이질성이 높았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 현재 여러 수술 기법이 허용 가능한 기능적 결과를 달성할 수 있으나, 선호되는 기법 없이 모두 Experimental Design Grade III-V의 낮은 근거 수준을 보여 전향적 연구와 표준화된 결과 보고 체계가 절실히 필요하다.

papers.title: Pregabalin and gabapentin in fractious cats: an exploratory comparison of handling-related outcomes and adverse effect profiles.
papers.authors: Measson C, Fournier F, Sarcey G, Béata C
papers.abstract: To compare pregabalin and gabapentin on manageability, ease of placing into a carrier, ease of transport, and adverse effects in cats exhibiting fractious behavior. An exploratory double-blind, randomized crossover study enrolled 32 cats with a history of fractious behavior. Each cat received pregabalin (5 mg/kg; Bonqat) or gabapentin (compounded, 20 mg/kg), administered 2 hours before examination, with treatments allocated in random order 15 days apart. Outcomes included manageability (veterinarian-recorded), ease of placing the cat into the carrier (owner-reported), transport (owner-reported), and adverse effects (owner-reported and veterinarian-recorded). Median scores (with IQRs) overlapped between pregabalin and gabapentin for manageability, ease of placing the cat into the carrier, and ease of transport. Owner-reported adverse effects did not differ between treatments, and drowsiness and muscle relaxation were the most frequently owner-reported effects, while veterinarian-recorded adverse effects were more frequent with gabapentin. Marked interindividual variability was observed: some cats responded substantially better to one drug than to the other. In this exploratory study, pregabalin and gabapentin provided overlapping outcomes for handling-related outcomes in fractious cats but differed in their adverse effect profiles, with gabapentin associated with a greater frequency of clinician-observed effects. The cat-dependent variation in response warrants further investigation. Both gabapentinoids produced comparable handling-related outcomes in fractious cats. When adverse effect burden is a concern, pregabalin may offer a marginally favorable safety profile. Individual variation in drug response suggests that if one agent proves ineffective, the other may be trialed.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 프레가발린과 가바펜틴은 난폭한 고양이의 취급성 개선에서 유사한 효과를 보였으나, 가바펜틴에서 임상의 관찰 이상반응이 더 빈번했으며, 개별 고양이마다 약물 반응의 큰 편차가 있었다.
[방법·수치] 난폭한 행동 병력이 있는 고양이 32마리를 대상으로 한 이중맹검 교차 연구에서 프레가발린(5 mg/kg) 또는 가바펜틴(20 mg/kg)을 검사 2시간 전 투여하고, 취급성, 캐리어 진입 용이성, 운송 용이성, 이상반응을 평가했으며 수치적 차이는 명시되지 않았다(중앙값의 IQR 범위가 겹침). 주인 보고 이상반응은 양 약물 간 차이가 없었고 졸음과 근육이완이 가장 흔했으나, 임상의 관찰 이상반응은 가바펜틴에서 더 빈번했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 난폭한 고양이의 취급 및 운송 필요 시 두 약물 모두 사용 가능하며, 이상반응 최소화가 중요할 때는 프레가발린이 약간 유리할 수 있다. 그러나 개별 고양이의 반응 편차가 크므로 한 약물이 비효과적일 경우 다른 약물 시도를 권고한다. 소규모 탐색 연구로서 더 큰 규모의 후속 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Coagulopathic manifestations as a primary presentation of canine angiostrongylosis: a retrospective case series.
papers.authors: Van Heuckelom E, Biscop A, Bhatti SFM, Stammeleer L, Decorte B
papers.abstract: To describe the clinical presentations, diagnostic findings, and treatment outcomes of 3 dogs with atypical, predominantly coagulopathic manifestations of Angiostrongylus vasorum infection and to highlight the associated diagnostic challenges. 3 client-owned dogs presented at a veterinary referral hospital in Flanders, Belgium, between March 2018 and April 2022. Cases were eligible for inclusion if coagulopathic manifestations were a predominant component of the clinical presentation and canine angiostrongylosis diagnosis was confirmed. The 3 included dogs were male and aged 8 months, 1 year, and 5 years. They presented with clinical signs attributed to hemarthrosis, intracranial hemorrhage, or both, with onset and progression varying among patients. Respiratory signs were absent in 1 dog and mild in 2 dogs, and initial diagnostic considerations included primary orthopedic or neurological disease. All dogs exhibited coagulation abnormalities consistent with consumptive coagulopathy, including thrombocytopenia, prolonged clotting times, and/or increased D-dimer concentrations. Infection with A vasorum was confirmed by serological antigen detection and/or fecal Baermann examination. Imaging findings included joint swelling, intracerebral hemorrhage, and mild interstitial pulmonary changes. Treatment consisted of anthelmintic therapy with adjunctive corticosteroids, and 2 dogs received plasma transfusion. All dogs recovered with resolution of clinical signs and normalization of laboratory abnormalities. These cases highlight the importance of including canine angiostrongylosis in the differential diagnosis for dogs presenting with unexplained coagulopathy or hemorrhage, even in the absence of respiratory signs, particularly in regions where the parasite is emerging. Early diagnosis and treatment are critical to prevent potentially life-threatening complications.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개 혈관선충증(Angiostrongylus vasorum)이 호흡기 증상 없이 소비성응고병증과 출혈을 주증상으로 나타날 수 있으며, 초기 진단과 치료가 생명을 위협하는 합병증 예방에 필수적이다.
[방법·수치] 벨기에 소동물 참조병원에서 2018년 3월~2022년 4월 사이 내원한 3마리 수컷 개(생후 8개월, 1년, 5년령). 모두 소비성응고병증(혈소판감소증, 연장된 응고시간, 증가된 D-dimer)과 혈관선충증 진단이 확인되었으며, 2마리는 가벼운 호흡기 증상만 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 설명 불가능한 응고병증이나 출혈로 내원한 개에서 호흡기 증상이 없어도 혈관선충증을 감별진단에 포함해야 하며, 특히 기생충이 출현하는 지역에서 중요하다. 혈청 항원 검사나 대변 Baermann 검사로 진단 가능하고, 항기생충제와 부신피질호르몬 및 필요시 혈장수혈로 치료한 결과 모든 개에서 완전 회복되었으나 소규모 후향적 증례 보고이므로 더 큰 규모 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Premedication with medetomidine compared to acepromazine reduces the risk of hypotension and mild acute kidney injury in healthy dogs undergoing gonadectomy surgery: results of a randomized clinical trial.
papers.authors: Quinn CT, Walton AN
papers.abstract: To compare premedication with medetomidine or acepromazine in regard to hypotension and acute kidney injury (AKI) in dogs undergoing elective gonadectomy. This randomized clinical trial included healthy dogs ≥ 6 months of age undergoing gonadectomy in a university teaching hospital. Exclusion criteria were weight < 4 kg, American Society of Anesthesiologists risk > 2, or cardiovascular/renal disease. Premedication consisted of methadone and medetomidine at 0.3 to 5 µg/kg or acepromazine at 0.01 to 0.05 mg/kg IM. Anesthesia was induced with alfaxalone and maintained with isoflurane. Hypotension (mean arterial pressure < 60 mm Hg) frequency, severity, and duration; recovery temperature; and vomiting and pain interventions were compared. Oliguria 24 hours postoperatively was defined as no urination with low-volume bladder. Serum creatinine was measured from blood before and 24 hours after surgery. Acute kidney injury was defined as an increase of > 26.5 µmol/L. The medetomidine group included 51 dogs and the acepromazine group 43. There were no differences in preoperative characteristics, anesthetic doses, or time. Hypotension was significantly less frequent (51% vs 84%), had a shorter duration (14 ± 20.2 minutes vs 26 ± 24.2 minutes), and was less severe (lowest mean arterial pressure 60.0 ± 14.9 mm Hg vs 51 ± 10.3 mm Hg) following medetomidine. Acute kidney injury was less frequent in the medetomidine group (9.8% vs 20.9%), with no oliguric AKI cases compared to 4 following acepromazine. There were no differences in postoperative hypothermia or treatments for vomiting or pain. Premedication with medetomidine results in a lower frequency and duration of hypotension and might reduce the risk of AKI. For healthy dogs undergoing elective surgery, premedication with medetomidine is preferable to acepromazine.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 건강한 개의 선택적 중성화수술 시 메데토미딘 전투약이 아세프로마진보다 저혈압 발생을 유의하게 감소시키고 급성신장손상(AKI) 위험을 낮춘다.
[방법·수치] 무작위 임상시험으로 6개월 이상의 건강한 개 94마리(메데토미딘군 51마리, 아세프로마진군 43마리)를 대학 병원에서 중성화수술 시 비교했다. 메데토미딘군에서 저혈압 발생률 51% vs 84%(p<0.05), 지속시간 14±20.2분 vs 26±24.2분, 최저평균동맥압 60.0±14.9 mm Hg vs 51±10.3 mm Hg로 모두 유의하게 낮았다. AKI 발생률은 메데토미딘 9.8% vs 아세프로마진 20.9%였고, 올리구리아를 동반한 AKI는 메데토미딘군 0건 vs 아세프로마진군 4건이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 건강한 개의 선택적 수술에서 아세프로마진 대신 메데토미딘 전투약 사용을 권장한다. 단일 대학병원의 연구이고 건강한 개만 포함되어 질환 동물이나 고위험 환자에 대한 적용은 제한적이다.

papers.title: Heat-inactivated Bifidobacterium adolescentis LA20 alleviates doxorubicin-induced senescence and barrier dysfunction in feline intestinal epithelial cells.
papers.authors: Wang H, Liu T, Bai H, Jin H, Li Y
papers.abstract: To investigate the protective effects and molecular mechanisms of heat-inactivated Bifidobacterium adolescentis LA-20 (HT-LA20) against doxorubicin (DOX)-induced senescent injury in feline intestinal epithelial cells (FIECs). This in vitro experimental study was conducted from November 1, 2025, through August 31, 2026, and involved only FIECs. No clinical patients or animals were included. The DOX-induced injury and senescence model was established in FIECs. The effects of HT-LA20 on cellular senescence and related proteins were evaluated by senescence-associated β-galactosidase staining, cell viability assays, and ELISA. Transcriptomic sequencing and untargeted metabolomics were integrated to elucidate the molecular regulatory mechanisms. Cell-based assays and transcriptomic and untargeted metabolomic analyses were performed with 4 independent biological replicates/group. HT-LA20 reversed DOX-induced reductions in cell viability and cellular senescence; upregulated tight junction proteins and mucins 1 and 2; suppressed release of IL-1β, tumor necrosis factor-α, IL-8, monocyte chemoattractant protein 1, and matrix metalloproteinase 1; and promoted VEGF and basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) secretion. Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses showed that HT-LA20 reversed DOX-induced omic disturbances. Integrated multiomics Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analysis indicated that its effects centered on the retinol metabolism-serotonergic synapse-intestinal immunoglobulin A immune network multitarget axis and regulation of inflammatory pathways, including nuclear factor κ B and Toll-like receptor signaling. HT-LA20 effectively alleviates DOX-induced injury in FIECs by restoring intestinal epithelial barrier function and suppressing inflammatory senescence.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 열불활성화 Bifidobacterium adolescentis LA-20은 독소루비신 유도 세포노화를 역전시키고 고양이 장상피세포의 장벽 기능을 회복하며 염증을 억제한다.
[방법·수치] 고양이 장상피세포(FIEC) 대상 시험관 연구(2025.11.1~2026.8.31), 그룹당 4개 독립적 생물학적 반복. HT-LA20 처리는 세포 생존성 감소 및 세포노화를 역전시켰으며, 타이트 정션 단백질과 뮤신 1, 2를 상향조절, IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-8, MCP-1, MMP-1 방출은 억제, VEGF와 bFGF 분비는 촉진했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 망막올 대사-세로토닌 시냅스-IgA 면역 네트워크 축과 NF-κB, TLR 신호전달 등 염증경로 조절을 통해 항암제 유도 장손상에 대한 포스트바이오틱스의 치료 가능성을 제시하나, 시험관 연구로서 동물 모델 및 임상 검증이 필수적이다.

papers.title: Advanced heartworm disease in dogs is associated with marked right heart and pulmonary artery remodeling.
papers.authors: Kim M, Seo MW, Cho J, Park C
papers.abstract: To characterize echocardiographic findings of right heart and pulmonary artery remodeling in dogs with heartworm disease. Medical records were searched for those of client-owned dogs with heartworm infection diagnosed from July 2020 through February 2023 and with no major systemic diseases not attributable to heartworm infection. Results for variables of interest were compared for dogs grouped by heartworm clinical class (classes 1 and 2 [mild] vs classes 3 and 4 [advanced]), pulmonary hypertension probability (low and intermediate vs high), and tricuspid regurgitation pressure gradient (mild, moderate, or severe). Pre- and postextraction variables were also compared for dogs with caval syndrome. 44 dogs were included. Compared with dogs with mild heartworm disease (n = 23), dogs with advanced heartworm disease (21) had greater right atrial and right ventricular enlargement, less right pulmonary artery distensibility, shorter pulmonary artery acceleration time, higher main pulmonary artery-to-aorta ratio, and lower right ventricular systolic function. Similar results were identified for dogs with high (vs intermediate or low) pulmonary hypertension probability. Normalized right atrial diameter had the highest discriminatory performance for identifying advanced heartworm disease (area under the curve, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.88 to 1.00), followed by tricuspid regurgitation pressure gradient, normalized right ventricular dimension, and other variables. Right atrial size significantly decreased after heartworm extraction (n = 8 dogs). Advanced heartworm disease is associated with marked right heart and pulmonary artery remodeling. Echocardiographic assessment of right heart remodeling may assist clinicians in evaluating heartworm disease severity and identifying dogs with clinically important cardiopulmonary involvement.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 진행성 심장사상충 감염견은 우심방·우심실의 현저한 확대, 폐동맥 경직도 감소, 우심실 수축 기능 저하 등 우심 및 폐동맥 리모델링을 보인다.
[방법·수치] 2020년 7월~2023년 2월 심장사상충 진단받은 개 44마리(경증 23마리, 진행성 21마리)의 의료 기록 후향적 검토; 정상화된 우심방 직경의 AUC 0.95(95% CI 0.88~1.00)로 진행성 질환 구별에 가장 높은 판별력을 나타냈으며, 삼첨판역류압 구배, 정상화된 우심실 직경 순으로 판별력 감소.
[임상 적용·한계] 심초음파를 이용한 우심 리모델링 평가는 임상의가 심장사상충 중증도를 평가하고 심폐 합병증을 가진 개를 식별하는 데 보조 역할을 할 수 있다; 단일기관 후향적 연구이고 추출 전후 비교는 소규모(8마리)이다.

papers.title: Determination of reference intervals for symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA) in Lacaune sheep.
papers.authors: Kiene F, Wagener MG, Röhrig P, Ganter M
papers.abstract: Traditional biomarkers such as serum creatinine and urea often fail to reflect early renal dysfunction, particularly in emaciated animals, as they depend on muscle mass or dietary protein intake. Symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA), a novel renal biomarker, has shown promise in other species for earlier and more sensitive detection of kidney disease. However, reference intervals for SDMA in ovine species remain undocumented. This study aimed to establish reference intervals for serum SDMA in clinically healthy Lacaune sheep. A reference population of 143 healthy sheep, stratified by age (juvenile < 1 year, adult ≥ 1 year), was selected based on clinical health, body condition score, and serum creatinine concentration. Serum SDMA was quantified using an ELISA validated for cats and dogs. Reference intervals were calculated as 0.59-1.72 µmol/l for all sheep, 0.59-1.56 µmol/l for adults, and 0.59-1.83 µmol/l for juveniles, with juveniles exhibiting significantly higher concentrations (p < 0.001). No sex-related differences were observed. In a retrospective analysis of 51 deceased sheep with histopathological renal assessments, SDMA concentrations were significantly elevated in animals with severe renal lesions compared to those with no, mild or moderate lesions (p = 0.005). Creatinine by contrast did not show significant differences. Notably, in animals with poor body condition, SDMA remained effective in identifying individuals with severe renal lesions, whereas creatinine levels remained within or below the reference interval. These findings suggest that SDMA is a more sensitive indicator of renal dysfunction in sheep than creatinine, particularly in emaciated individuals. The established reference intervals provide a foundation for clinical application. The economic feasibility of SDMA testing remains a limitation, but its potential to improve early diagnosis of renal disease in sheep justifies further investigation.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] SDMA는 전통적 신장 바이오마커인 크레아티닌보다 양의 신장질환을 더 민감하게 감지하며, 특히 소모된 개체에서도 신기능 이상을 효과적으로 발견할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 임상적으로 건강한 Lacaune 양 143마리(juvenile <1년, adult ≥1년)를 대상으로 혈청 SDMA를 ELISA로 측정했다. 참고구간은 전체 양 0.59-1.72 μmol/l, 성체 0.59-1.56 μmol/l, 어린양 0.59-1.83 μmol/l이었고 어린양이 유의하게 높았다(p<0.001). 사후 조직병리검사를 받은 51마리의 deceased sheep에서 심각한 신장병변군의 SDMA 농도가 정상·경증·중증 병변군보다 유의하게 높았으나(p=0.005) 크레아티닌은 유의한 차이가 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] SDMA는 체형이 불량한 양에서도 크레아티닌이 정상범위 내일 때 심각한 신장질환을 감지할 수 있어 조기 진단에 유용하다. 다만 SDMA 검사의 경제적 타당성이 제한적이고 단일 양종 연구라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Atherosclerotic plaque healing: mechanisms and clinical relevance.
papers.authors: Buonpane A, De Caterina AR, Porto I, Crea F, Vergallo R
papers.abstract: Atherosclerotic plaque healing is a dynamic biological mechanism that occurrs after plaque disruption and represents an endogenous reparative response within the atherosclerotic lesion. This process unfolds through three partially overlapping phases: endogenous thrombus lysis, granulation tissue formation, and re-endothelialization. Through the coordinated interaction of circulating cells, vascular wall components, and soluble mediators, plaque healing promotes fibrous repair and structural stabilization of the disrupted plaque. For many years, plaque healing remained primarily a histopathological observation described in post-mortem studies. The advent of high-resolution intracoronary imaging, particularly optical coherence tomography, has enabled in vivo visualization of the characteristic layered morphology of healed plaques, providing direct clinical confirmation of these early pathological findings. These observations have significantly improved our understanding of the clinical significance of plaque healing. Healed plaques are more frequently observed in patients with chronic coronary syndromes, supporting the concept that healing contributes to plaque stabilization. At the same time, recurrent cycles of plaque disruption followed by repair may lead to progressive luminal narrowing, thereby contributing to the long-term progression of coronary atherosclerosis. This review provided an updated overview of the clinical significance and implications of healed plaques in coronary artery disease, the mechanisms underlying plaque healing, and examines emerging intracoronary and non-invasive imaging modalities that allow their in vivo identification.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 죽상경화성 플라크 치유는 플라크 파열 후 발생하는 내재적 수복 반응으로, 혈전 용해, 육아조직 형성, 재내피화의 세 단계를 거쳐 플라크의 섬유성 수복과 구조적 안정화를 촉진한다. 치유된 플라크는 만성 관상동맥증후군 환자에서 더 자주 관찰되어 플라크 안정화에 기여함을 시사하지만, 반복적인 플라크 파열과 수복 주기는 점진적인 관상동맥 협착 진행에 기여할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 광학간섭단층촬영을 포함한 고해상도 혈관내 영상 기술을 통해 치유된 플라크의 특징적인 층상 형태를 생체 내에서 직접 시각화하여 사후 조직병리학적 관찰을 임상적으로 확인하였다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 혈관내 고해상도 영상검사와 비침습적 영상 방식을 이용하여 생체 내 치유된 플라크의 특성을 파악할 수 있으며, 이는 관상동맥질환의 임상 경과 예측과 치료 전략 수립에 활용될 수 있다. 현재까지 주로 조직병리학적 관찰과 혈관내 영상에 의존하고 있어 대규모 임상 추적 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Left ventricular outflow tract obstruction in transcatheter mitral interventions: percutaneous anterior leaflet modification.
papers.authors: Azzola Guicciardi N, Ascione G, Russo G, Onishi T, Swaminathan S
papers.abstract: Left ventricular outflow tract obstruction (LVOTO) remains one of the most catastrophic complications of transcatheter mitral valve replacement (TMVR) interventions, including TMVR in native valve, valve-in-valve, valve-in-ring, and valve-in-mitral annular calcification procedures. Its incidence varies widely across procedural types (0%-40%), with mortality rates approaching 36%, and represents a leading cause of patient ineligibility, excluding 4%-50% of candidates from TMVR. Accurate pre-procedural risk stratification relies on cardiac computed tomography, which enables annular sizing, virtual valve implantation, neo- and skirt neo-left ventricular outflow tract area quantification, and fluoroscopic projection planning. Key anatomic determinants of LVOTO include anterior mitral leaflet length, aortomitral angle, septal hypertrophy, left ventricular cavity size, and device-related factors. To mitigate LVOTO risk and expand treatment eligibility, in addition to septal modification, anterior mitral leaflet modification techniques have emerged, broadly categorized into electrosurgical laceration approaches-LAMPOON and ELASTA-and balloon-assisted translocation techniques for balloon-expandable valves-BATMAN, CLEVE, DETROIT, and ROBIN. Each strategy addresses distinct anatomic substrates and procedural scenarios, and their complementary profiles support individualized technique selection. This review aims to present an in-depth discussion of LVOTO in TMVR and anterior leaflet modification strategies.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경카테터 승모판 중재술에서 좌심실 유출로 폐쇄(LVOTO)는 치명적 합병증이며, 환자의 4-50%를 치료 대상에서 제외시키는 주요 원인이다. 전방 승모판 엽 수정 기법(LAMPOON, ELASTA, BATMAN, CLEVE, DETROIT, ROBIN)이 LVOTO 위험을 완화하고 치료 적합성을 확대할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 경카테터 승모판 치환술의 모든 유형(원래 판막, valve-in-valve, valve-in-ring, valve-in-MAC)에서 발생하는 LVOTO에 대한 문헌 검토이다. LVOTO 발생률은 절차 유형에 따라 0-40%, 사망률은 약 36%이며, 환자 부적합성은 4-50%에 이른다. 주요 해부학적 위험인자는 전방 승모판 엽 길이, 대동맥-승모판 각도, 중격 비대, 좌심실 공동 크기, 그리고 기기 관련 요소이다.
[임상 적용·한계] 심장 CT를 이용한 사전 위험 계층화와 가상 판막 삽입 계획이 핵심이다. 각 전방 엽 수정 기법은 서로 다른 해부학적 기질과 절차 상황에 대응하므로 맞춤형 기법 선택이 필요하다. 본 논문은 주로 해부학적 고찰과 기법 분류에 중점을 두고 있으며, 임상 결과 비교나 대규모 임상 데이터가 제한적일 수 있다.

papers.title: Coronary angiography in heart transplants from donors older than 40: a Eurotransplant study.
papers.authors: Aliabadi-Zuckermann AZ, Kaider A, De Pauw M, Rega F, Milicic D
papers.abstract: The increasing age of heart donors in Europe raises concerns about undetected coronary artery disease (CAD), a contributor to early graft dysfunction and long-term complications. This study examined the association between donor coronary angiography (CA) and heart transplant utilization, particularly in donors aged >40 years. A total of 20 681 donor heart offers reported to Eurotransplant between 2004 and 2020 were analysed. The use of CA, donor characteristics, and acceptance rates were assessed. CAD status was imputed for donors without angiography using logistic regression based on clinical risk factors. Transplantation probabilities were modelled using observed and imputed CAD severity to explore potential differences under a scenario of broader CA availability. CA was performed in 23.5% of cases, predominantly in older donors and those with cardiovascular risk factors. Among donors with CA, 37.5% had CAD, which was significantly associated with age, male sex, hypertension, and smoking. Donors with normal CA findings had lower odds of rejection compared with those without CA (odds ratio 0.36, P < .0001). In a counterfactual model, broader CA availability in donors aged >40 years was associated with a higher estimated transplant utilization (56.4%-67.1%), corresponding to a model-based increase of ∼535 transplants. In this observational cohort, CA availability was associated with differences in donor heart utilization, particularly when findings were normal or showed non-significant CAD. These findings suggest that angiographic information may reduce diagnostic uncertainty and support clinical decision-making in older donors. A risk-adapted, resource-sensitive approach to CA use is warranted.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심장 공여자에서 관상동맥 조영술(CA) 시행이 정상 소견 또는 비유의미한 관상동맥질환(CAD)을 보일 때 심장이식 활용도를 증가시키며, 특히 40세 이상 고령 공여자에서 CA 가용성 확대 시 약 535건의 추가 이식이 가능할 것으로 추정된다.
[방법·수치] Eurotransplant에 2004-2020년 보고된 심장 공여 제시 20,681건을 분석했으며, CA는 전체의 23.5%에서 시행되었다. CA 시행 공여자 중 37.5%에서 CAD가 발견되었고, 정상 CA 소견을 보인 공여자는 CA 미시행 공여자 대비 거부반응 위험이 유의하게 낮았다(오즈비 0.36, P<0.0001). 40세 이상 공여자에서 CA 가용성 확대 시 이식 활용도는 56.4%-67.1%로 증가할 것으로 모델링되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 고령 심장 공여자의 CAD 진단 불확실성을 감소시키고 임상 의사결정을 지원하기 위해 위험도 맞춤형·자원 효율적 CA 사용 전략이 필요하다. 그러나 본 연구는 관찰적 코호트 연구로서 인과관계 증명에 한계가 있으며, 모델 기반 추정치의 실제 임상 적용 가능성 확인이 필요하다.

papers.title: Elimination kinetics of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs during carbon hemoperfusion in 19 dogs with toxicosis.
papers.authors: Her J, Labato MA, Langston CE, Butty EM
papers.abstract: To describe the elimination kinetics of NSAIDs during carbon hemoperfusion (cHP) in dogs with toxicosis, specifically the apparent elimination rate constant, half-life, and plasma reduction. 19 client-owned dogs (median age, 2.5 years; median body weight, 22 kg) with ibuprofen (n = 10), carprofen (5), or naproxen (4) toxicosis treated with cHP at 2 academic veterinary teaching hospitals from November 30, 2022, through July 7, 2024. Dogs were presented after known or suspected ingestion at median estimated maximum doses of 720, 200, and 325 mg/kg for ibuprofen, carprofen, and naproxen, respectively. The median interval from ingestion to cHP was 6.8 hours. Plasma concentrations were measured by LC-MS-MS in-serial samples collected during and, when available, after cHP. The median total plasma reduction was 58% (IQR, 51 to 80). The overall half-life during cHP was 1.3 hours (IQR, 1.1 to 1.8) by the 2-point method, concordant by regression (1.4 hours), and approximately 3.7-, 5.4-, and 52.0-fold shorter than respective therapeutic-dose half-lives. Among 5 dogs with posttreatment samples, plasma concentration rebounded after cHP in 1 naproxen-treated dog. The cHP-associated rate constant exceeded the intrinsic rate constant 11- to 40-fold in 4 of 5 dogs. Carbon hemoperfusion was associated with substantial reductions in plasma NSAID concentrations during treatment in dogs with severe ibuprofen, carprofen, or naproxen toxicosis. Most of the decline occurred early in the session. Further studies are warranted to optimize treatment protocols. Carbon hemoperfusion markedly shortened NSAID elimination half-lives in dogs with severe toxicosis, accelerating removal well beyond endogenous elimination.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 카본 혈액관류(cHP)는 개의 심각한 NSAID 중독에서 혈장 농도를 중앙값 58% 감소시키며, 치료 중 반감기를 3.7~52배 단축시켜 내인성 제거보다 훨씬 효과적이다.
[방법·수치] 19마리 개(중앙 연령 2.5세, 중앙 체중 22kg)에서 ibuprofen(n=10), carprofen(5), naproxen(4) 중독 후 cHP 치료. 중앙 최대 용량: ibuprofen 720mg/kg, carprofen 200mg/kg, naproxen 325mg/kg. 섭취~cHP 평균 6.8시간. LC-MS-MS로 측정한 중앙 전체 혈장 감소율 58%(IQR 51-80), cHP 중 중앙 반감기 1.3시간(IQR 1.1-1.8)으로 치료용량 반감기보다 3.7~52배 짧음.
[임상 적용·한계] NSAID 중독 개에서 cHP는 조기에 대부분의 농도 감소가 나타나므로 초기 치료 시간이 중요하다. 추적 샘플 5마리 중 1마리 naproxen 투여 개에서 반동 현상 보고되어 추적 모니터링 필요. 치료 프로토콜 최적화를 위한 추가 연구 필요하고 소규모 연구로 대표성 제한.

papers.title: Comparison of the pharmacokinetics and sedative effects of Zenalpha (medetomidine and vatinoxan) administered intramuscularly and oral transmucosally in dogs.
papers.authors: Lathan AW, Smith CK, Kleine SA, Smith JS, Ng Z
papers.abstract: To evaluate the sedative effects and pharmacokinetic profile of medetomidine and vatinoxan (Zenalpha) administered via the oral transmucosal (OTM) route. We hypothesized that sedation scores obtained from Zenalpha OTM (ZOTM) would not differ from Zenalpha IM (ZIM). Dogs received 20 µg/kg ZIM or 80 µg/kg ZOTM. Sedation, anxiolytic, and handling scores were collected at 0, 15, 30, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 120, 150, and 180 minutes after administration of Zenalpha. Normality was tested using the Shapiro-Wilk test, and data were presented as median and range. Physiologic data were collected at 0, 5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 240, 360, and 480 minutes. Plasma samples were collected at 0, 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 240, 360, 480, 720, and 1,440 minutes and analyzed for concentration of medetomidine and vatinoxan using LC-MS-MS. 8 healthy adult Beagles participated in this study. Dogs in ZIM and ZOTM showed significant increases in sedation, anxiolysis, and handling scores compared to baselines. Medetomidine OTM was associated with a time to maximum concentration and relative bioavailability of 86 minutes (6 minutes ZIM) and 26.4%, respectively. Vatinoxan OTM was associated with a time to maximum concentration and relative bioavailability of 216 minutes (15 minutes ZIM) and 55.2%, respectively. ZOTM (80 μg/kg) provided effective sedation, anxiolysis, and improved handling in healthy dogs comparable to ZIM (20 μg/kg) administration. Zenalpha administered OTM, at higher doses, may provide an attractive alternative to IM injection to achieve similar sedation.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경구점막투여(OTM) 젠알파 80 µg/kg은 근육주사(IM) 20 µg/kg과 비교하여 유사한 수준의 진정, 불안완화, 취급용이성을 제공하므로 주사 대신 사용 가능한 대안이 될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 비글 8마리를 대상으로 ZIM 20 µg/kg 또는 ZOTM 80 µg/kg 투여 후 180분까지 진정점수를 평가하고 LC-MS-MS로 약물농도를 분석했다. 메데토미딘의 OTM 최고농도도달시간 86분(IM 6분), 상대생물이용률 26.4%. 바티녹산의 OTM 최고농도도달시간 216분(IM 15분), 상대생물이용률 55.2%.
[임상 적용·한계] OTM 경로는 주사를 피할 수 있어 순응도 높은 환자에서 임상적 가치가 있으나, 소규모 단일종 연구이고 더 높은 용량이 필요하며 작용 발현 시간이 현저히 길어 긴급상황에는 부적절할 수 있다.

papers.title: A case-case-control study of cefovecin use and third-generation cephalosporin-resistant Escherichia coli infections in cats.
papers.authors: Frye A, Kim H, Rosenthal C, Angel CC, Chikara Y
papers.abstract: To determine if cefovecin administration increased the risk of third-generation cephalosporin (3GC)-resistant Escherichia coli infections in cats. In this retrospective case-case-control study, cases were cats with 3GC-susceptible or 3GC-resistant E coli infections at the Cornell University Hospital for Animals from 2009 to 2023; controls were randomly selected from all feline patients seen during the study period. Exposure data were collected via review of medical records. Direct acyclic graph-driven multivariable regression models of each potential exposure were built for each case-control grouping. 36 susceptible cases (3% cefovecin treated), 14 resistant cases (21% cefovecin treated), and 72 controls (6% cefovecin treated) were identified. Resistant cases had a higher proportion of cefovecin use (21%) than susceptible cases (3%) and controls (6%), but case numbers were too low to evaluate whether cefovecin use was associated with either infection type. Most of the cats that received cefovecin (75%) were underdosed. The overall frequency of cefovecin administration was low (7%) compared to previous studies. Cefovecin use was less frequent than previously reported, resulting in too few cases to determine whether cefovecin use is associated with 3GC-resistant E coli infections in cats. The sample size was too small to evaluate association between cefovecin and 3CG resistance. Based on prudent antimicrobial stewardship, veterinarians should limit cefovecin use to cases where oral antimicrobial treatment is impossible and, ideally, its use is supported by antimicrobial susceptibility testing to avoid selecting for antimicrobial resistance in treated cats. When using cefovecin, veterinarians should ensure they are administering the label-recommended 8-mg/kg dose.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 세포베신 사용과 3세대 세팔로스포린 내성 대장균 감염 간의 연관성을 명확히 증명하지 못했으나, 내성 사례에서 세포베신 사용 비율(21%)이 감수성 사례(3%)와 대조군(6%)보다 높았다.
[방법·수치] 2009~2023년 코넬 동물병원의 고양이 환자를 대상으로 한 후향적 사례-대조 연구로, 감수성 사례 36마리(세포베신 치료 3%), 내성 사례 14마리(21%), 대조군 72마리(6%)를 분석했다. 세포베신을 받은 고양이의 75%가 저용량 투여되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 경구 항생제 치료가 불가능한 경우로 세포베신 사용을 제한하고, 항생제 감수성 검사로 뒷받침할 때 사용하며, 투여 시 권장 용량 8mg/kg을 준수해야 한다. 본 연구는 샘플 크기가 너무 작아(특히 내성 사례 14마리) 명확한 연관성 평가가 불가능한 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Laryngeal paralysis in 72 cats: a multicenter study on epidemiology and treatment.
papers.authors: Gobbetti M, Rossanese M, Tremolada G, Pisani G, Cinti F
papers.abstract: To describe the etiology, treatment, and outcomes of cats with laryngeal paralysis (LP) and identify factors associated with survival. Retrospective, multicenter, observational study. Medical records from 7 referral hospitals (Italy, UK, US) were reviewed to identify cats with LP (2003 to 2024). Survival was assessed using Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression analyses. 72 cats were included. Primary idiopathic LP was diagnosed in 49 cats (68%) and secondary LP in 17 (24%), most commonly associated with pulmonary neoplasia, trauma, or surgery. Six cats (8%) had comorbidities without a confirmed causal relationship. Bilateral LP was diagnosed in 44 cats (61%), and unilateral LP was diagnosed in 26 cats (36%). Arytenoid lateralization was performed in 53 cats (74%); 93% of cats with bilateral LP and 38.5% of cats with unilateral LP underwent surgery. Complications occurred in 13 cats (24%), including 8 major complications (15%) and 3 deaths from aspiration pneumonia. Estimated 1-, 2-, and 3-year postoperative survival rates were 88%, 85%, and 85%, respectively. Major postoperative complications were the only independent predictor of decreased survival (hazard ratio, 99.42; 95% CI, 8.50 to 1,161.77). Primary idiopathic LP was the most common diagnosis, although secondary causes, particularly neoplasia, were frequent. Unilateral LP may require surgical treatment. Arytenoid lateralization provided good long-term outcomes, although major complications markedly reduced survival. Thorough investigation should be considered in cats with LP to identify underlying neoplasia. Treatment decisions should be based on clinical severity rather than laterality, and owners should be informed of the risk of serious postoperative complications.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 후두마비는 특발성이 68%로 가장 흔하지만 폐종양, 외상, 수술이 이차적 원인의 대부분을 차지하며, 양측 마비가 61%로 흔하고 갑상연골 외측화술은 장기 생존율 88-85%의 양호한 성적을 제공한다. 수술 후 주요 합병증이 생존율 감소의 유일한 독립적 예측인자다.
[방법·수치] 7개 대학병원(이탈리아, 영국, 미국) 의무기록 후향적 검토, 2003-2024년, 72마리 고양이 대상. 특발성 LP 49마리(68%), 이차성 LP 17마리(24%), 양측 마비 44마리(61%), 일측 마비 26마리(36%), 수술 시행 53마리(74%), 주요 합병증 8마리(15%), 흡인폐렴으로 사망 3마리. 술후 1·2·3년 생존율 각각 88%, 85%, 85%. 주요 합병증의 위험비 99.42(95% CI 8.50-1,161.77).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상적 중증도에 따라 치료결정을 하되, 양측이라도 임상증상이 경미하면 보존치료 고려 가능하고 일측 마비도 수술 필요시 갑상연골 외측화술 추천. 고양이 후두마비 진단 시 폐종양 감별을 위한 철저한 검사가 필수이며, 흡인폐렴 등 심각한 술후 합병증 위험을 보호자에게 충분히 설명해야 한다. 다기관 후향적 연구이고 개별 고양이의 임상증상 정도와 예후의 세부 상관성이 명확하지 않다.

papers.title: Heart failure therapy in congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries: effect on right ventricular function and survival.
papers.authors: Ahmed S, Karara Y, Rashwan R, Miranda WR, Connolly HM
papers.abstract: The aim of the study was to assess the effect of guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) on cardiac function, neurohormonal activation, and mortality in adults with congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries (cc-TGA) presenting with systemic right ventricular (RV) systolic dysfunction. The study hypothesis was that GDMT use (assessed using the GDMT score) was associated with improved cardiac function (higher RV free wall strain [RVFWS]), less neurohormonal activation (lower N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide [NT-proBNP] levels), and lower mortality. GDMT score, RVFWS, and NT-proBNP levels were assessed at baseline and 1-year follow-up. GDMT uptitration was assessed using ΔGDMT (GDMT at 1-year minus GDMT at baseline). Improvements in RV systolic function and neurohormonal activation were defined as a relative increase in RVFWS of >20% and a relative decrease in NT-proBNP levels of >20%, respectively. Of 213 patients (age 43 ± 15 years; 54% male), baseline GDMT score was 1.97 ± 1.27, and ΔGDMT score was 0.74 ± 0.39. Baseline RVFWS was -18 ± 5%; 25% had improved RV systolic function. Baseline NT-proBNP was 369 (142, 1004) pg/mL; 56% had improved neurohormonal activation. Higher baseline GDMT score and ΔGDMT score were associated with improvement in RV systolic function and neurohormonal activation. Overall, 34 (16%) patients died, and higher baseline GDMT score and ΔGDMT score were associated with a lower risk of mortality and of the composite adverse event endpoint (heart failure hospitalization, death, and heart transplantation). Clinical benefits of GDMT use were observed only in patients with moderate/severe RV systolic dysfunction, and not in patients with mild RV systolic dysfunction. GDMT use was associated with improved outcomes in patients with moderate/severe RV systolic dysfunction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 선천성 완전대동맥전위증(cc-TGA) 환자에서 치료지침 기반 심부전 약물치료(GDMT)의 사용과 용량 증가는 우심실 수축 기능 개선, 신경호르몬 활성화 감소, 사망률 저하와 관련이 있으며, 특히 중등도/중증 우심실 수축 부전 환자에서만 임상적 이득이 관찰되었다.
[방법·수치] cc-TGA 환자 213명(평균 나이 43±15세, 남성 54%)을 대상으로 기준시점과 1년 추적 검사에서 GDMT 점수, 우심실 자유벽 변형률(RVFWS), NT-proBNP 수치를 측정하였다. 기준시점 GDMT 점수 1.97±1.27, 1년 증가분 0.74±0.39, 기준시점 RVFWS -18±5%, 기준시점 NT-proBNP 369(142-1004) pg/mL였으며, 25%에서 우심실 수축 기능 개선(RVFWS 상대적 증가 >20%), 56%에서 신경호르몬 활성화 개선(NT-proBNP 상대적 감소 >20%)을 보였고, 추적 기간 중 16%(34명)의 환자가 사망하였다.
[임상 적용·한계] cc-TGA 환자의 심부전 관리에서 GDMT의 적극적 사용과 용량 증가는 중등도/중증 우심실 수축 부전 환자에서만 효과적이므로, 경증 환자에게는 선택적으로 적용해야 한다. 단일 기관 연구이고 추적 기간이 1년으로 장기 추적이 필요하며, 복합 평가항목(심부전 입원, 사망, 심장이식) 기반 분석이므로 개별 항목별 효과 해석에 주의가 필요하다.

papers.title: Obesity, frail obesity, and outcomes after durable left ventricular assist device implantation: a pooled analysis of the MOMENTUM 3 trials.
papers.authors: Vukicevic M, Isath A, Cleveland JC Jr, Goldstein DJ, Uriel N
papers.abstract: Obesity in patients supported by left ventricular assist devices (LVADs) is linked to excess mortality and haemocompatibility-related events. Whether this association persists with the fully magnetically levitated HeartMate 3 (HM3) pump is unknown. This analysis tested outcomes with obesity and the additive influence of co-existing frailty ('frail obesity') in the contemporary era. The study pooled 2200 HM3 recipients from the MOMENTUM 3 pivotal randomized trial (n = 515) and Continued Access Protocol (n = 1685). Obesity was defined as body mass index (BMI) ≥30 kg/m2 and frailty by a 40-item Rockwood cumulative-deficit frailty index (FI), with clinically relevant frailty defined as FI ≥0.325 (moderate-severe frailty); BMI was excluded from the FI to avoid mathematical coupling. The primary endpoint was survival to transplant, recovery, or 24 months of support free of disabling stroke (modified Rankin score >3) or pump replacement reoperation. Obese patients (n = 887, 40.3%) were younger, less often with ischaemic aetiology, and more frequently women, but more often had diabetes and hypertension, than non-obese patients. Unadjusted 2-year outcomes were similar between groups (freedom from the primary endpoint: 75.1% vs 77.1%, log-rank P = .34; survival: 79.9% vs 81.2%, P = .57). After covariate adjustment, obesity was independently associated with a higher risk of the primary endpoint (hazard ratio [HR] 1.30, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.07-1.58) and all-cause mortality (HR 1.35, 95% CI 1.10-1.67), as well as heart failure hospitalization, infection, and arrhythmia, but not stroke, bleeding, or early right heart failure. Frailty affected 67.3% of obese recipients (571/849) and was associated with a higher adjusted risk of the primary endpoint (HR 1.51, 95% CI 1.09-2.10), overall mortality and non-haemocompatibilty-related morbidity endpoints.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] HeartMate 3 (HM3) LVAD 수혜자에서 비만은 조정 후 1차 종료점(이식/회복/24개월 무증상 생존)과 전체 사망률 위험을 독립적으로 증가시켰으며, 허약함(frailty)은 거의 모든 종료점에서 불리한 결과와 연관되었고, 비만과 허약함의 조합은 가산적(additive) 위험을 나타냈다. [방법·수치] MOMENTUM 3 시험(n=515)과 Continued Access Protocol(n=1685)을 통합한 2200명의 HM3 수혜자를 분석했으며, 비만(BMI ≥30 kg/m²) 환자는 887명(40.3%)이었다; 비만의 조정 위험비는 1차 종료점 HR 1.30(95% CI 1.07-1.58), 전체 사망률 HR 1.35(95% CI 1.10-1.67)였고, 허약함은 1차 종료점 HR 1.51(95% CI 1.09-2.10)이었으며, 비만-허약함 상호작용은 유의하지 않았다(P=.436). [임상 적용·한계] LVAD 후보 선정 시 BMI 단독이 아닌 비만과 허약함을 함께 평가해야 하며, 비만-허약 환자는 가장 높은 절대 위험을 가지나 허약함이 6개월 내 75.9% 호전 가능하고 개선이 생존 향상과 연관(HR 0.14)되므로 역동적 평가가 필요하다; 단일 임상 시험 풀 분석의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Hydralazine-isosorbide dinitrate in chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction: the H-HeFT trial.
papers.authors: Køber L, Skak-Hansen KW, Larsen AH, Vraa S, Schou M
papers.abstract: Hydralazine-isosorbide dinitrate (H-ISDN) has shown benefit in earlier randomized trials of patients with reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) and chronic heart failure. This trial tested if H-ISDN could reduce worsening heart failure or mortality in patients with chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) receiving contemporary treatment. The Hydralazine-Isosorbide Dinitrate in Patients With Chronic Heart Failure Trial (H-HeFT) was a multicentre, randomized (1:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in patients with HFrEF at 23 Danish hospitals (New York Heart Association class II-IV, elevated N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide and LVEF ≤40%). Target treatment was hydralazine 75 mg/isosorbide dinitrate 40 mg three times a day (t.i.d). The primary endpoint was a composite of hospitalization with worsening heart failure, an urgent outpatient visit resulting in intravenous/metolazone therapy for heart failure, heart transplantation, left ventricular assist device implantation, or death. Secondary endpoints included components of the primary outcome. Overall, 592 predominantly White patients (median age 72 years, 18% women) were randomized with a mean follow-up of 3.7 years. The primary outcome occurred in 90 of 294 patients (30.6%) in the H-ISDN group and in 91 of 298 patients (30.5%) in the placebo group [hazard ratio (HR) 0.90; 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.67-1.21; P = .48]. There were 57 deaths in the H-ISDN group vs 72 in the placebo group (HR 0.72; 95% CI 0.51-1.02); worsening heart failure events occurred in 52 vs 47 patients (HR 1.01; 95% CI 0.68-1.50). Hydralazine-isosorbide dinitrate did not change the incidence of the composite endpoint of heart failure events or death in patients with heart failure and LVEF ≤40%.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 현대적 심부전 치료를 받는 좌심실박출률 감소 환자에서 하이드랄라진-이소소르비드 디니트레이트 병용 투여는 심부전 악화 또는 사망의 발생을 감소시키지 못했다.
[방법·수치] 덴마크 23개 병원의 다기관 이중맹검 무작위대조시험으로 592명의 환자(중앙값 72세, 여성 18%)를 1:1로 무작위배정하여 평균 3.7년 추적하였다. 하이드랄라진 75mg-이소소르비드 디니트레이트 40mg 1일 3회 투여군에서 일차 복합 종말점 발생이 30.6%(90/294명), 위약군 30.5%(91/298명)로 차이가 없었다(HR 0.90, 95% CI 0.67-1.21, P=0.48). 사망은 각각 57명 vs 72명(HR 0.72, 95% CI 0.51-1.02)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] ACE 억제제, 베타차단제 등 현대적 약물 치료를 이미 받는 심부전 환자에서 추가 치료로 하이드랄라진-이소소르비드 디니트레이트 투여의 이득이 명확하지 않으므로 선별적 사용이 필요하다. 백인 중심 집단 연구로 다양한 종족에 대한 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Feasibility of Shallow Whole-Genome Sequencing-Based Circulating Tumour DNA Analysis in Canine Multicentric Lymphoma: A Pilot Study.
papers.authors: Kim GH, Jang JH, Kim SH, Ryu MO, Kwon CH
papers.abstract: Lymphoma is a common canine malignancy with high morbidity and variable prognosis. Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) has emerged as a minimally invasive biomarker for tumour burden, treatment response and prognosis in human lymphoma. However, the feasibility of applying shallow whole-genome sequencing (sWGS)-based ctDNA analysis to canine lymphoma remains unclear. In this pilot study, plasma cell-free DNA (cfDNA) was quantitatively assessed and additional genomic features were evaluated using sWGS in dogs with multicentric lymphoma. cfDNA concentration was significantly higher in dogs with lymphoma (n = 13) compared with healthy controls (n = 24) (median 3.18 vs. 0.25 ng/mL; Mann-Whitney U test, p = 0.004). However, total cfDNA concentration was not significantly associated with time to progression (TTP) (p = 0.055). Tumour fraction (TF), a surrogate for ctDNA, showed preliminary association with clinical outcome, with a shorter median TTP in the high-TF group than in the low-TF group (77 vs. 302 days; p = 0.006). Genomic analysis further revealed copy number aberrations (CNAs); notably, gains on chromosome 13 containing the MYC locus were identified in three dogs, all of which belonged to the high-TF group. Dogs with lymphoma also displayed distinct cfDNA fragmentation profiles, characterized by an enrichment of shorter fragments within the analysed size range and a shift in the highest mean-profile peak compared with healthy controls. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of sWGS-based cfDNA analysis in canine lymphoma and suggest that TF may provide clinically relevant information beyond total cfDNA concentration. Validation in a substantially larger, independent cohort is warranted.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 다중심성 림프종에서 얕은 전장 게놈 시퀀싱(sWGS) 기반 순환종양DNA(ctDNA) 분석이 임상적으로 적용 가능하며, 종양 분획(TF)이 전체 cfDNA 농도보다 질병 진행 시간과의 연관성이 더 우수함을 시사했다.
[방법·수치] 림프종 환자 13마리와 건강한 대조군 24마리를 대상으로 혈장 세포자유DNA(cfDNA)를 정량 평가하고 sWGS로 게놈 특성을 분석했다. 림프종군의 cfDNA 농도는 건강한 대조군보다 유의하게 높았다(중앙값 3.18 vs. 0.25 ng/mL, p=0.004). 높은 TF군에서는 낮은 TF군보다 질병 진행 시간이 현저히 짧았다(77 vs. 302일, p=0.006). 염색체 13의 gains(MYC 유전자 포함)이 3마리에서 확인되었으며 모두 높은 TF군에 속했다.
[임상 적용·한계] TF는 cfDNA 농도의 단순 측정보다 림프종의 임상 결과 예측에 더 나은 정보를 제공할 수 있어 치료 반응 평가 및 예후 판정의 비침습적 바이오마커로 활용 가능하다. 그러나 본 연구는 소규모 파일럿 연구(n=13)로 훨씬 더 큰 규모의 독립적인 코호트에서의 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Outcomes of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement for Aortic Regurgitation in LVAD Patients: The JENA-VAD Study.
papers.authors: Ramana R, Uriel N, Yadav P, Satler L, Ranard LS
papers.abstract: Aortic regurgitation (AR) during left ventricular assist device (LVAD) support causes recurrent heart failure. Surgery is high risk and stenosis-designed valves anchor poorly in noncalcified anatomy. The goal of this study was to evaluate early outcomes of the AR-specific Trilogy transcatheter heart valve for LVAD-associated AR. JENA-VAD is a prospective, multicenter, single-arm investigational device exemption study. An independent committee adjudicated endpoints using VARC-3 (Valve Academic Research Consortium-3) definitions. The primary efficacy endpoint was the VARC-3 device success composite adapted for LVAD support, and the primary safety endpoint was the VARC-3 early safety composite. Fifty patients were treated (mean age 69.2 years; 40% female). Median follow-up was 105 days (range 27 to 577 days). Technical and device success were 96.0% (95% CI: 86.3-99.5). Freedom from any component event of the VARC-3 early safety composite was 90.0% (95% CI: 78.2-96.7). At 30 days, 7 VARC-3 safety events occurred in 5 patients: type 2 to 4 bleeding (n = 2), major vascular complications (n = 2), device-related peripheral interventions (n = 2), and new pacemaker (1 of 7 without prior pacing; 14.3%). There were no strokes or myocardial infarctions. Two transient ischemic attacks occurred in patients without valve abnormalities. Beyond 30 days, cardiovascular death occurred in 1 patient (day 86). Follow-up computed tomography (CT) imaging or transesophageal echocardiography was obtained in 12 patients, and 11 (including 3 within 30 days) had leaflet thickening or thrombosis, including all patients who underwent CT. The remaining 38 patients did not have postprocedure imaging. Two of these events were symptomatic: valve thrombosis and a transient ischemic attack (day 116), and prosthetic AR that required valve-in-valve implantation (day 146) and subsequent heart transplantation.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] LVAD 환자의 대동맥 역류에 대해 Trilogy 경카테터 판막을 사용한 치료는 높은 기술적·장치 성공률(96.0%)을 보였으며, 조기 사망, 뇌졸중, 중등도 이상 잔존 역류 없이 안전하게 시행 가능함.
[방법·수치] 전향적 다기관 단일군 임상시험(JENA-VAD)으로 50명 환자(평균 연령 69.2세, 여성 40%)를 대상으로 했으며, 중앙 추적 기간 105일(범위 27-577일). 장치 성공률 96.0%(95% CI: 86.3-99.5), VARC-3 조기 안전성 복합 엔드포인트 무사건 생존률 90.0%(95% CI: 78.2-96.7). 30일 내 7건의 안전 사건 발생(출혈, 혈관 합병증, 맥박조율기 삽입 등).
[임상 적용·한계] LVAD 환자의 대동맥 역류 관리에서 고위험 외과 수술의 대안으로 고려 가능하나, 영상 검사된 환자의 22%에서 판막 엽 비후나 혈전증이 발견되어 장기 안전성 데이터 부족. 후속 추적이 진행 중이고 추적 영상 검사를 받지 않은 환자가 76%로 많아 실제 발생률은 더 높을 수 있음.

papers.title: Percutaneous Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement for Symptomatic Mitral Regurgitation: 2-Year Outcomes From the ENCIRCLE Trial.
papers.authors: Webb J, Guerrero ME, Muhammad KI, Greenbaum AB, Vasquez A
papers.abstract: Transcatheter mitral valve replacement (TMVR) is an approved treatment option for select high-risk patients with symptomatic mitral regurgitation (MR). The main cohort of the ENCIRCLE trial, evaluating fully percutaneous transseptal TMVR with the SAPIEN M3 system, demonstrated 13.9% mortality, significant MR reduction, and improved functional and health status outcomes at 1 year. We report 2-year outcomes from the main cohort of the ENCIRCLE trial. Eligible symptomatic patients with ≥3+ MR who were not suitable for surgery or transcatheter edge-to-edge repair underwent TMVR with the SAPIEN M3 system. Independent study oversight included an echocardiographic core laboratory and a clinical events committee. Endpoints included the nonhierarchical composite rate of all-cause mortality or heart failure hospitalization (HFH) as well as clinical, echocardiographic, functional, and health status outcomes. A total of 299 patients were treated, with 2-year follow-up data available for 202 of 210 eligible patients (96.2%). Mean age was 75.5 ± 9.3 years, 50.8% were men, and the mean Society of Thoracic Surgeons Predicted Risk of Mortality score for mitral valve replacement was 6.6% ± 4.1%. At 2 years, MR reduction was sustained, with MR ≤1+ in 97.0% patients (P < 0.001). The 2-year composite rate of all-cause mortality or HFH was 35.6% (25.1% all-cause mortality, 23.0% HFH). In a 365-day landmark analysis, 1- to 2-year rates were 13.0% for all-cause mortality and 10.6% for first HFH. At 2 years, the rates of disabling stroke, clinically significant valve thrombosis, and hemolysis requiring intervention were 6.6%, 7.1%, and 7.6%, respectively. There were no instances of clinically significant left ventricular outflow obstruction. Improvements in functional and health status outcomes were sustained with 87.0% of patients in NYHA functional class I/II (P < 0.001) and a mean Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire overall summary score increase of 17.2 points (P < 0.001).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] SAPIEN M3 시스템을 이용한 경피적 경중격 승모판 치환술(TMVR)은 2년 추적에서 97.0%의 환자에서 1+ 이하의 승모판 역류를 유지하였으며, 생존 환자에서 기능 및 건강상태 개선이 지속되었다.
[방법·수치] 증상이 있는 3+ 이상 승모판 역류 환자 299명(평균 나이 75.5±9.3세, 남성 50.8%)을 대상으로 한 ENCIRCLE 임상시험의 2년 결과 분석으로, 추적률은 96.2%(202/210명)였다. 2년 복합종료점(전체사망 또는 심부전 입원)은 35.6% (전체사망 25.1%, 심부전 입원 23.0%)였으며, 연도별 분석에서 1-2년 전체사망은 13.0%, 심부전 입원은 10.6%였다. 뇌졸중 6.6%, 판막 혈전증 7.1%, 용혈 7.6% 발생했고, NYHA 기능분류 I/II 비율은 87.0% (P<0.001), Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire 점수 증가는 17.2점(P<0.001)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 수술 불가능하거나 경피적 판막 가장자리 중재술에 부적절한 고위험 증상 승모판 역류 환자의 치료 선택지로 활용 가능하나, 단일 장치 평가이고 장기 내구성 데이터는 2년까지만 제시되었으며 선별된 환자군 대상 연구의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Long-Term Impact of Vutrisiran in Patients With TTR Amyloidosis With Cardiomyopathy: 1-Year Efficacy and Safety Outcomes From the HELIOS-B Open-Label Extension.
papers.authors: Garcia-Pavia P, Witteles R, Morbach C, Delgado D, Kitaoka H
papers.abstract: In HELIOS-B (A Study to Evaluate Vutrisiran in Patients With Transthyretin Amyloidosis With Cardiomyopathy), vutrisiran reduced the risk of all-cause mortality (ACM) and recurrent cardiovascular events and slowed disease progression measures versus placebo in patients with TTR (transthyretin) amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy after 33 to 36 months. We report the long-term efficacy and safety of vutrisiran from an ongoing open-label extension of HELIOS-B. Patients who completed HELIOS-B could enroll in the open-label extension, continuing with vutrisiran 25 mg every 3 months (continuous vutrisiran) or, if previously receiving placebo, initiating vutrisiran 25 mg every 3 months (placebo/vutrisiran). Prespecified end points assessed in the open-label extension are the composite of ACM and cardiovascular events, ACM, Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire-Overall Summary score, New York Heart Association class, and NT-proBNP (N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide) and troponin I levels. Outcomes were assessed through month 48 in this analysis. Of 654 participants in HELIOS-B (vutrisiran, n=326; placebo, n=328), 478 completed double-blind treatment and 466 (vutrisiran, n=243; placebo, n=223) entered the open-label extension. In the continuous vutrisiran group, the risk of first cardiovascular event or ACM was reduced by 37% (hazard ratio, 0.63 [95% CI, 0.51, 0.79]; P=0.0001) and ACM by 37% (hazard ratio, 0.63 [95% CI, 0.46, 0.84]; P=0.0023) versus the placebo/vutrisiran group. Through month 48, patients in the continuous vutrisiran group had preserved health status and quality of life per Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire-Overall Summary score (least squares mean difference, 9.0 [95% CI, 5.3, 12.6]; P<0.0001) and more patients had improved or stable New York Heart Association class (odds ratio, 1.6 [95% CI, 1.1, 2.2]; P=0.0084) versus the placebo/vutrisiran group.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] TTR 심장 아밀로이드증 환자에서 48개월까지 지속적 vutrisiran 투여는 전사망 사망률과 심혈관 사건을 37% 감소시키고, 초기 위약군에서 나중에 vutrisiran을 시작한 군보다 우수한 임상 결과를 보였다.
[방법·수치] HELIOS-B 대조약 시험의 공개 확장 연구로, 466명(지속 vutrisiran 243명, 위약/vutrisiran 전환 223명)이 등록되었다. 지속 vutrisiran 군에서 심혈관 사건 또는 전사망 사망률 위험비 0.63(95% CI 0.51-0.79, P=0.0001), 전사망 사망률 위험비 0.63(95% CI 0.46-0.84, P=0.0023), Kansas City 심근병증 설문 평균 차이 9.0점(95% CI 5.3-12.6, P<0.0001), NT-proBNP와 troponin I 기하평균 비 각각 0.66(P<0.0001)과 0.71(P<0.0001)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] TTR 심장 아밀로이드증의 조기 진단 및 치료로 사망률, 심혈관 사건, 생활 질 개선이 입증되었으나, 단일 임상시험의 개방형 확장이므로 대조군 추적이 제한적이고 48개월까지만 분석되었다.

papers.title: Feasibility and clinical safety of cytokine-activated anti-tumor lymphocytes infusion in dogs with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: a pilot study.
papers.authors: Capellero S, Maga I, Donini C, Galiazzo E, Sapino A
papers.abstract: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is the most common histologic subtype of lymphoma in dogs. Although using cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine and prednisone (CHOP) chemotherapy is the standard treatment, outcomes remain suboptimal, emphasizing the need for novel therapeutic strategies. Evaluate the feasibility and potential therapeutic benefit of adoptive immunotherapy using ex vivo-expanded cytokine-activated anti-tumor lymphocytes (CATLs) in dogs with DLBCL treated using CHOP chemotherapy and an autologous tumor vaccine. Seven client-owned dogs with naturally occurring DLBCL. Dogs received CHOP-based chemotherapy and the APAVAC® autologous vaccine. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were expanded ex vivo for 14 days using interleukin-2 and anti-CD3/CD28 stimulation. The CATLs were characterized by flow cytometry and reinfused. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were successfully expanded. After 14 days, the median cell yield was 728 × 106 cells (range, 162.4 × 106-1 500 × 106), corresponding to a median 8.6-fold expansion. Median fold increases of positive cells were 7.23 (interquartile range [IQR], 6.46-9.64) for CD3+, 8.56 (IQR, 7.11-14.56) for CD4+, 8.41 (IQR, 6.24-9.29) for CD5+, 10.35 (IQR, 7.63-14.67) for CD8+, and 16.16 (IQR, 12.22-30.40) for CD4+CD8+ cells. Reinfused CATLs ranged from 162.4 × 106 to 1 500 × 106 cells.
