Ex vivo expansion and reinfusion of autologous CATLs in dogs with DLBCL receiving CHOP chemotherapy and APAVAC® vaccination are feasible and induce robust T-cell expansion, suggesting this combined chemo-immunotherapeutic approach may enhance anti-tumor immunity and warrants further investigation in larger clinical studies.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 미만성 큰 B세포 림프종(DLBCL)에서 세포토킨 활성화 항종양 림프구(CATLs)의 입양 면역요법은 실현 가능하며, CHOP 화학요법과 자가종양 백신 병행 시 강력한 T세포 확장을 유도하여 항종양 면역을 증강할 가능성을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 자연발생 DLBCL 환자견 7마리에서 말초혈액단핵세포(PBMC)를 인터루킨-2와 항-CD3/CD28 자극으로 14일간 체외 배양하였다. 중앙 세포 수득량은 728×10⁶개(범위 162.4-1,500×10⁶), 중앙 8.6배 확장을 달성했으며, CD3+ 7.23배, CD4+ 8.56배, CD8+ 10.35배, CD4+CD8+ 16.16배 증가를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] CHOP 화학요법의 치료 성적 개선을 위해 자가 CATLs 재주입 병용이 임상적으로 적용 가능하나, 소규모 파일럿 연구(n=7)로서 더 큰 규모의 임상시험을 통한 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Evaluation of urine clusterin and cystatin B concentrations in relation to histopathologic findings of renal disease in dogs.
papers.authors: Rivera C, Hines ES, Schultz D, Cianciolo RE, Jeffery N
papers.abstract: Conventional markers of kidney disease detect altered kidney function but do not consistently identify active kidney injury. Urine clusterin (uClust) and cystatin B (uCysB) are renal injury biomarkers, but their evaluation is limited in dogs with biopsy-confirmed diagnoses. Determine the association of uClust and uCysB with conventional biomarkers, category of renal disease, severity of renal injury, and survival in dogs with biopsy-confirmed kidney disease. Urine from client-owned dogs (n = 199) submitted to the International Veterinary Renal Pathology Service between 2008 and 2018 with corresponding kidney biopsy samples. Retrospective study. Urine clusterin and uCysB were measured using an ELISA, and correlations with serum creatinine (sCr), symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA), urine protein-to-creatinine ratio (UPC), and histopathology severity scores were determined. Significant differences in uClust and uCysB among conventional biomarker groups were determined using analysis of variance. Multivariate survival analysis was performed. Concentrations of uClust and uCysB were highest in dogs with membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (MPGN) and mixed MPGN, and they were positively correlated with sCr, SDMA, UPC, and histopathology scores (r = 0.25-0.50). Risk of death was higher in dogs with uCysB > 238 ng/mL (hazard ratio, 2.40; P < .05), whereas uClust > 7329 ng/mL was associated with lower risk of death (hazard ratio, 0.32; P < .01). Higher uCysB was associated with more severe disease and decreased survival; therefore, uCysB might identify dogs with active renal injury and worse prognosis. Although uClust was associated with more severe disease, its association with survival needs further investigation.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소변 cystatin B (uCysB)는 신장 손상의 활동성을 나타내며 더 심한 질환과 생존율 감소와 연관되어 있고, clusterin (uClust)은 질환 중증도와 연관되지만 생존율과의 관계는 추가 연구가 필요함.
[방법·수치] 2008-2018년 사이에 신장 생검을 받은 개 199마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구이며, uClust와 uCysB는 ELISA로 측정하고 혈청 creatinine, SDMA, 단백뇨-크레아티닌 비, 조직병리 점수와의 상관성을 분석함. uClust와 uCysB는 membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis에서 가장 높았고, sCr, SDMA, UPC 및 조직병리 점수와 양의 상관(r=0.25-0.50)을 보임. uCysB >238 ng/mL 시 사망 위험이 높음(위험비 2.40, P<0.05), uClust >7329 ng/mL 시 사망 위험이 낮음(위험비 0.32, P<0.01).
[임상 적용·한계] uCysB는 활동성 신장 손상을 식별하고 나쁜 예후를 판단하는 생물표지자로 임상 활용 가능하나, 단일 기관의 후향적 연구이고 uClust의 생존율에 대한 임상적 의미는 추가 조사가 필요함.

papers.title: Reassessing outcome and adverse events associated with ventral slot decompression for cervical intervertebral disc disease in dogs: 241 cases (2021-2024).
papers.authors: Marocco P, Taylor AR
papers.abstract: Cervical intervertebral disc herniations (IVDH) are a common cause of cervical myelopathy in dogs, with ventral slot decompression (VSD) often being the surgical treatment of choice. The contemporary United States breed population has changed since the large retrospective review on VSD outcomes in 2013, with French bulldogs increasing in popularity.4,8 A 2025 retrospective study evaluated outcomes in patients receiving VSD but it was a single institution United Kingdom based cohort that focused on concomitant fenestration.7. Evaluate adverse events (AEs) and outcomes in dogs that underwent VSD for cervical IVDH since the increase in French bulldog prevalence in US populations. We hypothesized that there would be an increase in the number of reported AEs with no difference in outcome. A total of 241 dogs from 4 private neurology practices treated between 2021 and 2024. Retrospective case series. Most cases had excellent or good outcomes (n = 182/241 and 34/241, respectively), with poor outcomes in 9 cases. Overall AE rate was 25% (n = 60/241). A negative outcome was significantly associated with increased body weight (P < .001), higher AE grades (P < .001), higher AE severity (P < .001), caudal disc spaces (P = .04), and lateralized extruded material (P = .01). Outcome was not significantly associated with sex, surgical or anesthetic duration, surgeon experience, prior ventral slot surgery, perioperative hypotension, or hemorrhage. Despite the increased prevalence of French bulldogs undergoing VSD in US populations, this surgery continues to have favorable outcomes.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경추 추간판탈출증에 대한 복부슬릿 감압술은 우수 또는 양호한 결과를 보였으며(182/241, 34/241), 전체 부작용 발생률은 25%(60/241)였다.
[방법·수치] 2021~2024년 미국 사설 신경외과 클리닉 4곳에서 복부슬릿 감압술을 받은 개 241마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 사례 연구이며, 불량한 결과는 증가된 체중(P<0.001), 높은 부작용 등급(P<0.001), 높은 부작용 심도(P<0.001), 미골 추간판 공간(P=0.04), 외측화된 탈출물질(P=0.01)과 유의한 연관이 있었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 복부슬릿 감압술은 프렌치 불독의 증가된 유병률에도 불구하고 계속해서 호의적인 결과를 제공하므로, 경추 추간판탈출증의 외과적 치료로 추천할 수 있다. 단일 기관이 아닌 다중 기관 연구이지만 최근 미국 개 품종 변화를 반영한 데이터이다.

papers.title: Evaluation of intrarenal hypoperfusion and renal congestion assessed by intrarenal Doppler ultrasonography in dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease.
papers.authors: Iwai Y, Morita T, Terukina H, Yamasaki M
papers.abstract: While the predictive value of venous impedance index (VII) for evaluating renal congestion is reported in dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD), an ultrasonographic index of renal perfusion has not been reported. Low renal perfusion assessed by interlobar renal artery velocity time integral (VTI) is associated with a worse prognosis in dogs with MMVD. Combining VTI and VII provides additional prognostic information. Sixty-two client-owned dogs without heart disease evaluated for preanesthetic or general health assessment and 80 client-owned dogs with MMVD. Prospective cohort study. The VTI was measured by manually tracing the spectral velocity envelope of interlobar arteries. The primary endpoint was defined as the composite of cardiac-related death and renal-related death. The VTI was corrected for the effect of heart rate (VTIc) because VTI and heart rate were negatively correlated in dogs without heart disease. In dogs with MMVD, the VTIc decreased with higher ACVIM stage. Dogs with lower VTIc (< 8.3) had significantly shorter survival times (median, not reached; 95% CI, 98 days-not reached; P < .001) than those with normal VTIc (median, not reached; 95% CI, not reached). In multivariable Cox analysis, VII remained significantly associated with outcome (HR, 1.24 per 0.1-unit increase; 95% CI, 1.07-1.42). Exploratory classification combining VII (<0.37 or ≥0.37) and VTIc (≥8.3 or < 8.3) identified 4 subsets with different survival outcomes. The VTIc might be associated with outcome in dogs with MMVD and combined assessment might provide additional exploratory prognostic information. Myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD) is a common heart disease in dogs and can affect blood flow within the kidneys. We investigated whether Doppler ultrasonography could detect reduced kidney blood flow and kidney congestion in dogs with this disease. Reduced kidney blood flow was observed as heart disease became more severe and was associated with shorter survival.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심근종 승모판 질환(MMVD) 개에서 도플러 초음파로 측정한 신장 간질엽 동맥 혈류속도-시간 적분(VTI)의 감소는 더 심한 질병 단계와 관련이 있으며, 심박수 보정값(VTIc < 8.3)이 낮을수록 생존 시간이 유의하게 단축되었다(P < 0.001).
[방법·수치] 심장질환이 없는 개 62마리, MMVD 환자 개 80마리의 전향적 코호트 연구로, 신장 간질엽 동맥의 분광 도플러로 VTI를 측정하고 심박수로 보정(VTIc)했으며, 정맥 임피던스 지수(VII) ≥ 0.37일 때 다변량 콕스 분석에서 예후와 유의하게 관련(HR 1.24, 95% CI 1.07-1.42).
[임상 적용·한계] MMVD 환자견의 신장 관류 저하를 도플러 초음파로 비침습적으로 평가할 수 있으며, VII과 VTIc를 함께 평가하면 예후 예측에 추가 정보를 제공할 수 있으나, 단일 기관 중소규모 연구이고 중앙값 생존시간 미도달 항목이 있어 장기 추적의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Abnormalities in cobalamin status in dogs with congenital portosystemic shunt before and after shunt closure.
papers.authors: Proksch AL, Kunath T, Heilmann RM, Schneider MA, Kaline M
papers.abstract: Cobalamin dysvitaminosis occurs with congenital portosystemic shunt (cPSS). Limited data exist on the effects of cPSS-type, cPSS-closure, and association with hyperammonemia. Cobalamin and folate status differ between healthy and cPSS-dogs, before and after cPSS-closure, between complete and incomplete cPSS-closure, and cPSS-types. Cobalamin dysvitaminosis is associated with hyperammonemia, which ameliorates after cPSS-closure. Eighty-three dogs. Concentrations of cobalamin, transcobalamin (TCB), metabolites (homocysteine [HCy], serum [sMMA], urinary [uMMA:crea] methylmalonic acid), folate, and blood ammonia were prospectively compared between 44 cPSS-dogs and 39 age and body weight matched controls. Compared were 32 out of 44 intrahepatic (cIPSS) and 12 out of 44 extrahepatic (cEPSS) cPSS-dogs, before (PSS-0) and 12 weeks (PSS-12) after cPSS-closure, and complete versus incomplete cPSS-closure. Hypocobalaminemia occurred in 2 out of 44 PSS-0-dogs (cIPSS) and hypercobalaminemia in 8 out of 44 PSS-0-dogs (5/12 cEPSS, 3/32 cIPSS). Of 34 normocobalaminemic PSS-0-dogs, in 47% available HCy samples concentrations were below the reference interval, whereas sMMA and uMMA:crea were higher in 61% and 27%. PSS-0-dogs had lower HCy, higher sMMA and uMMA:crea, and lower folate concentrations than controls (each P < .0001). Hyperammonemia occurred in 35 out of 43 PSS-0-dogs, but ammonia did not correlate with any variable. Of 32 out of 38 normocobalaminemic PSS-12-dogs, 31% had supraphysiologic sMMA and 10% supraphysiologic uMMA:crea concentrations. PSS-12-dogs had lower cobalamin (P = .0001) and TCB (P = .014), higher HCy (P < .0001), lower uMMA:crea (P = .0002), and higher folate concentrations (P < .0001) than PSS-0-dogs. At PSS12, cIPSS-dogs had significantly higher sMMA concentrations (P = .0001) than cEPSS-dogs. Lower sMMA (P = .0001) and uMMA:crea (P = .003) were more common with complete than incomplete cPSS-closure.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 선천성 문맥전신단락(cPSS) 개에서 코발라민 이상이 흔하며, 단락 폐쇄 후 12주에 일부 개선되지만 일부 개는 지속적인 이상을 보인다. 완전 폐쇄 시 불완전 폐쇄보다 비타민 대사 지표가 더 호전된다.
[방법·수치] cPSS 개 44마리와 나이·체중 대조군 39마리 비교, 단락 폐쇄 전후 코발라민·폴산·호모시스테인·메틸말론산·암모니아 측정. 단락 폐쇄 전 44마리 중 35마리(81%)에서 고암모니아혈증 발생, 61%에서 혈청 메틸말론산 상승, 47%에서 호모시스테인 저하. 폐쇄 후 메틸말론산이 여전히 31%, 유리 메틸말론산이 10%에서 비정상(P값 각각 P<0.0001, P=0.0001, P=0.0002).
[임상 적용·한계] 비타민 대사산물 측정은 정상 혈중 코발라민 농도에도 불구하고 세포 내 비타민 결핍을 감지할 수 있어 cPSS 개의 영양 평가에 유용하다. 단락 폐쇄 후에도 모니터링이 필요하며 완전 폐쇄 여부가 예후와 치료 반응에 영향을 미친다. 본 연구는 단일 시점(12주) 추적이므로 장기적 대사 회복 과정은 미지수이다.

papers.title: Immunogenicity of half-dose versus full-dose Leptospira quadrivalent vaccine in dogs: a prospective randomized pilot study.
papers.authors: Craig C, Pastey MK
papers.abstract: In clinical veterinary practice, incomplete vaccine administration can occur because of movement or partial injection loss; however, the immunologic consequences of reduced vaccine dosing are unknown. To compare antibody responses after administration of a half-dose versus a full-dose of a quadrivalent leptospirosis vaccine in dogs. Ten client-owned, healthy dogs (body weight range, 9-31 kg) with no history of leptospirosis vaccination. Prospective randomized pilot study. Dogs were assigned to receive either a full-dose (n = 5) or a half-dose (n = 5) of a quadrivalent inactivated leptospirosis vaccine. Serum samples were collected before vaccination and 4 weeks after vaccination. The primary outcome was post-vaccination microscopic agglutination test (MAT) titers against vaccine-associated serovars. Secondary outcomes included cross-reactive titers and associations with body weight. All dogs were seronegative before vaccination. Dogs receiving the full-dose developed relatively uniform MAT responses against vaccine serovars, whereas responses in the half-dose group varied among individual dogs and serovars. Half-dose titers ranged from 1:100 to 1:3200, compared with 1:800 to 1:3200 in the full-dose group. Cross-reactive titers to Leptospira bratislava were detected in both groups, whereas all dogs remained seronegative for Leptospira hardjo. Within the half-dose group, dogs weighing < 50 lb had higher observed titers than dogs weighing ≥50 lb for several vaccine serovars. Reduced vaccine dosing resulted in variable antibody responses, with lower observed titers for some vaccine serovars, compared with full-dose vaccination, supporting adherence to recommended dosing to achieve consistent immunogenic responses in clinical practice. Leptospirosis is a bacterial disease that can cause serious illness in dogs. Sometimes a dog receives less than the intended vaccine dose because it moves during an injection or some of the vaccine leaks out.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 반량 접종은 전량 접종에 비해 렙토스피라 백신 혈청형에 대한 항체 반응이 불균일하고 일부 혈청형에서 낮은 역가를 나타내므로, 임상 현장에서 권장 용량 준수의 중요성을 뒷받침한다.
[방법·수치] 렙토스피라 사백신 접종 경험이 없는 건강한 개 10마리(체중 9-31 kg)를 전량군(n=5) 또는 반량군(n=5)에 무작위 배정하여 접종 4주 후 미세응집반응(MAT) 역가를 측정했다. 반량군의 역가는 1:100~1:3200, 전량군은 1:800~1:3200으로 나타났고, 반량군 내에서 체중 50 lb 미만인 개들이 더 높은 역가를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 불완전한 백신 접종이 발생했을 때 항체 반응의 신뢰성이 감소할 수 있으므로 정확한 용량 준수가 필수적이다. 본 연구는 항체 형성만 측정했을 뿐 실제 질병 보호 효능을 평가하지 않았으며, 소규모 단일기관 파일럿 연구로서 대규모 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: K-number-based selection in Danish dachshunds: offspring outcomes and implications for genetic diversity.
papers.authors: Sullivan S, Kutzler MA
papers.abstract: In dachshunds, the number of calcified discs (K-number [KN]) is one heritable determinant of the risk of intervertebral disc disease and is used for breeding selection in some countries; however, there are no prior reports of offspring KN outcomes or the effect of KN selection on size of the effective breeding population (Ne). To determine whether progressively limiting breeding eligibility to dogs with lower KNs would: (1) improve offspring KN outcomes and (2) reduce the effective population size of the breeding population below a threshold that risks genetic bottleneck. Danish dachshunds (n = 2120) with KN recorded to a public database from 1993 to 2024. This retrospective study analyzed KN records from 2120 dogs screened between 1990 and 2024. Associations between parental KN and offspring KN phenotype were evaluated using parent-offspring regression and cumulative-link ordinal models. Worse offspring KN was predicted by both worse sire (P = 4.8 × 10-6; odds ratio [OR] 1.3; 95% CI, 1.16-1.45) and dam (P = 3.3 × 10-5; OR 1.3; 95% CI, 1.13-1.40) KN. Increasingly stringent parental KN selection was associated with improved offspring KN distributions, with predicted next-generation mean KN decreasing from 2.26 under K ≤ 4 selection to 1.54 under K0 selection. However, more stringent selection reduced effective breeding population size below thresholds associated with genetic bottleneck risk (eg, standard wirehaired: Ne = 179 under K ≤ 4 vs Ne = 52 under K0). Increasingly stringent limitation of parent KN was associated with lower-KN offspring groups but also decreased effective population size, highlighting the need to balance disease-risk reduction against preservation of genetic diversity. Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD) is a common health problem in dachshunds.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 덕스훈드에서 석회화된 추간판 개수(K-number)에 기반한 선택적 번식은 자손의 K-number 개선과 추간판질환 유병률 약 19% 감소를 예측하나, 번식 제한이 강할수록 유효 번식 개체수가 유전적 병목 위험 이하로 감소한다.
[방법·수치] 덴마크 덕스훈드 2120마리를 1993-2024년 대상으로 후향적 분석하였고, 부모의 K-number가 나쁠수록 자손의 K-number도 악화(부(父) P=4.8×10-6, OR 1.3; 모(母) P=3.3×10-5, OR 1.3); K≤4 선택 시 차세대 평균 K-number 2.26에서 K0 선택 시 1.54로 감소했으나, 표준 와이어헤어의 경우 유효 번식 개체수가 K≤4에서 Ne=179에서 K0에서 Ne=52로 감소.
[임상 적용·한계] 추간판질환 위험 감소와 유전적 다양성 보존 사이의 균형을 고려하여 선택적 번식을 적용해야 하며, 2026년부터 덴마크에서 모든 번식견의 필수 K-number 검사 도입이 유효 번식 개체수 확대에 도움될 것으로 예상됨; 단일국가 데이터 및 현재 K-number 검사 번식견 수 제한이 한계.

papers.title: In vitro susceptibility of antimicrobial resistant strains of Escherichia coli isolated from the urine of dogs to pivmecillinam and fosfomycin.
papers.authors: Pohlmann M, LeCuyer TE, Woerde D, Palm C, Westropp JL
papers.abstract: Multidrug resistant (MDR) and extended spectrum beta-lactamase-producing (ESBL) uropathogenic Escherichia coli are a cause of urinary tract infection (UTI) in dogs. Limited antimicrobial options are available for these infections. Determine the in vitro susceptibility of MDR and ESBL urinary E. coli isolates to pivmecillinam and fosfomycin using isolates collected from dogs with either UTI or subclinical bacteriuria. The secondary aim was to compare 2 susceptibility test methods for pivmecillinam: agar dilution and gradient strip testing. Thirty-four banked frozen urine isolates stored at the University of California, Davis Microbiology Laboratory collected from 33 dogs. Gradient strip tests and agar dilution were used to evaluate E. coli susceptibility to mecillinam, the active form of pivmecillinam. Median paired mecillinam minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) differences by the 2 test methods were compared. For mecillinam resistant isolates, genomic sequencing was performed to determine resistance genes. Fosfomycin MICs were determined by gradient strip susceptibility testing. All isolates were susceptible to fosfomycin (34/34) and most isolates were susceptible using mecillinam agar dilution (31/34) and gradient strip (32/34), respectively. The paired log2-transformed mecillinam MIC results were significantly higher for agar dilution compared with gradient strip testing (V = 21.5, r = -0.91). Pivmecillinam and fosfomycin are potential antimicrobial treatment options for dogs with MDR or ESBL E. coli UTI. Agar dilution is the preferred testing method for mecillinam susceptibility.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 요로감염에서 분리된 다제내성 및 확장스펙트럼 베타락타메이스 생성 대장균에 대해 피브메실리남과 포스포마이신 모두 높은 감수성을 보였으며, 임상 치료 옵션으로 활용 가능하다.
[방법·수치] 개 33마리의 요 샘플에서 분리된 34개 대장균 분리주에 대해 한천 희석법과 그래디언트 스트립 검사로 메실리남(피브메실리남의 활성형)과 포스포마이신 감수성을 평가했다. 포스포마이신 감수성 34/34(100%), 메실리남 한천 희석법 31/34(91%), 그래디언트 스트립 32/34(94%)이 감수성을 보였으며, 두 방법 간 MIC 결과는 유의한 차이를 보였다(V=21.5, r=-0.91).
[임상 적용·한계] 다제내성 및 확장스펙트럼 베타락타메이스 생성 대장균으로 인한 요로감염 치료에서 피브메실리남과 포스포마이신을 대체 선택지로 고려할 수 있으며, 메실리남 감수성 검사에는 한천 희석법을 권장한다. 단일 기관의 보관 샘플을 이용한 소규모 연구로 임상 치료 효과 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Esophageal strictures associated with prolonged nasoesophageal tube placement in three cats.
papers.authors: Cho J, Kim M, Kim S, Lee J, Chae HK
papers.abstract: Nasoesophageal tube placement for a prolonged period of time has not previously been associated with esophageal stricture in cats. Three cats with suspected hepatic lipidosis required extended enteral nutritional support because voluntary food intake remained < 25% of the calculated resting energy requirement. The cumulative duration of nasoesophageal tube placement was 24-37 days. Regurgitation or retching developed within 1-3 days after tube removal, and esophagoscopy identified severe focal strictures in the cervical esophagus at the C4-C6 vertebral level in all 3 cats. One cat underwent 3 endoscopic balloon dilatation sessions at 1-week intervals, with enlargement of the esophageal lumen. The consistent anatomic location and temporal association with prolonged tube placement suggest that extended nasoesophageal intubation may be a risk factor for cervical esophageal stricture formation in cats. When prolonged nutritional support is anticipated, transition to a feeding tube intended for long-term use should be considered.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 24-37일간의 연장된 비식도관 삽입이 경추 식도협착(C4-C6 수준)을 유발할 수 있으며, 이는 이전에 보고되지 않은 합병증이다.
[방법·수치] 간지방증 의심 고양이 3마리로 자발적 섭식량이 안정시 에너지 요구량의 25% 미만일 때 비식도관을 24-37일간 유지했고, 제거 후 1-3일 내에 역류 또는 구역질이 발생했으며 식도경검사로 모든 고양이에서 경추 식도의 심한 국소협착을 확인했다. 1마리는 1주 간격 내시경 풍선 확장술 3회 시술로 식도강 확대를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 연장된 영양 지원이 필요한 경우 비식도관에서 장기용 급식관으로의 전환을 고려해야 하며, 단일 기관의 증례 보고로 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Use of a novel low-fat hydrolyzed diet in the management of dogs with chronic enteropathy.
papers.authors: Hernández-Anllo C, Feo L, Hervera M, Puig J
papers.abstract: Dietary management plays a central role in the diagnosis and treatment of chronic enteropathy (CE) in dogs. Although hydrolyzed-protein diets are commonly used in patients with CE, and dietary fat restriction is recommended in selected gastrointestinal disorders, the combined effect of low fat and hydrolyzed protein has not been specifically evaluated. Assess clinical response and acceptability of a low-fat, hydrolyzed diet in dogs with CE. Thirty-one client-owned dogs. Prospective clinical study. Dogs were fed a commercial low-fat (2.01 g/100 kcal metabolizable energy) hydrolyzed salmon protein diet and stratified according to previous dietary history. Dogs were evaluated at baseline, 1 month, and 3 months. The primary outcome was clinical response, classified as complete response (CR), partial response (PR), or non-response (NR) based on gastrointestinal signs and the Canine Inflammatory Bowel Disease Activity Index (CIBDAI) score. Dogs with CR or PR were considered responders. Diet acceptability was assessed. At T1, 20 of 31 (64.5%) dogs were categorized as CR, 3 of 31 (9.7%) as PR, and 8 of 31 (25.8%) as NR. Twenty-three of 31 (74.2%) dogs had a positive clinical response. The CIBDAI scores decreased significantly from T0 to T1 (P < .001). At T2, 94.4% of initial responders maintained CR. Diet acceptability was excellent in 75.0% of cases. This low-fat, hydrolyzed diet had significant short- and mid-term effectiveness and was well tolerated in dogs with CE, reinforcing its potential as a treatment for food-responsive enteropathy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 저지방 가수분해 단백질 사료는 개의 만성 장질환에서 단기 및 중기에 유의한 임상 효과를 보이며 우수한 기호성을 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 31마리 개를 대상으로 한 전향적 임상연구로, 저지방(2.01 g/100 kcal ME) 가수분해 연어 단백질 사료를 급여하고 기저선, 1개월, 3개월에 평가했다. 1개월 시점에 완전반응 64.5%(20/31), 부분반응 9.7%(3/31), 무반응 25.8%(8/31)이었고, 반응자는 74.2%(23/31)였다. CIBDAI 점수는 유의하게 감소(P<.001)했으며, 3개월 시점에 초기 반응자의 94.4%가 완전반응을 유지했고, 기호성이 75.0% 우수했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 식이 반응성 장질환의 치료제로서 임상 적용 가능하다. 단일 사료 제품에 대한 소규모 연구이고, 대조군이 없는 전향적 연구로서 객관적 효능 비교가 제한적이다.

papers.title: Ultrasound-measured renal length and corticomedullary thickness for the diagnosis and staging of chronic kidney disease in cats.
papers.authors: Brans M, Stock E, Duchateau L, Paepe D
papers.abstract: Ultrasonography is well established in veterinary practice, and renal dimensions may aid in diagnosing chronic kidney disease (CKD) in cats. Assess whether renal length, cortical and medullary thickness, and derived ratios identify CKD, reflect CKD severity, and are changed by hyperthyroidism. Evaluate effects of age, body weight, sex, laterality, and observer variability on renal dimensions. Two hundred fifty-nine client-owned cats: healthy (n = 179), CKD-affected (n = 38), and nonazotemic hyperthyroid (n = 42). Ultrasonographic renal dimensions were measured retrospectively. Group comparisons were performed using fixed effects and mixed models. Diagnostic accuracy was assessed using receiver operating characteristic analysis. Effects of age, body weight, sex, and laterality were evaluated using multiple linear regression. Intraobserver (novice) and interobserver (novice vs expert) variability were quantified using intraclass correlation coefficients from random effect models. Age, body weight, and sex accounted for biological variation in healthy cats, which also exhibited minor left-right kidney asymmetry. Cats with CKD were reliably distinguished from healthy and hyperthyroid cats by renal dimensions. Compared with age-comparable healthy cats, CKD-affected cats had shorter kidneys (-0.49 cm, -13.26%, P < .001), thinner cortices (dorsal: -0.10 cm, -16.23%, P < .001; transverse: -0.06 cm, -9.14%, P < .05), and thinner medullae (dorsal: -0.28 cm, -26.25%, P < .001; transverse: -0.24 cm, -19.7%, P < .001). Renal length and medullary thickness showed the highest diagnostic accuracy, but no renal dimension reliably reflected disease severity. Interobserver variability was considerable. Ultrasonographic renal dimensions may support CKD diagnosis in cats, but biological and observer variability must be considered.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 초음파로 측정한 신장 길이와 수질 두께는 고양이 만성신장질환(CKD) 진단에 유용하나, 질환의 심각도를 반영하지는 못한다.
[방법·수치] 259마리 고양이(건강군 179마리, CKD군 38마리, 갑상선기능항진증군 42마리)를 대상으로 초음파 신장 치수를 후향적으로 측정했다. CKD군은 건강군 대비 신장 길이 -0.49cm(-13.26%, P<0.001), 수질 두께(배측: -0.28cm, -26.25%, P<0.001; 횡단면: -0.24cm, -19.7%, P<0.001)가 유의하게 감소했다. 신장 길이와 수질 두께가 가장 높은 진단 정확도를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 나이, 체중, 성별 등 생물학적 변수를 고려하면 초음파 신장 치수가 CKD 진단을 보조할 수 있으나, 관찰자간 변이도가 상당하고 질환 심각도 평가에는 부적절하므로 임상병리 결과와 함께 해석해야 한다.

papers.title: Comparative cytokine profiling in cerebrospinal fluid and serum of dogs with meningoencephalitis of unknown origin.
papers.authors: Gasser A, Démoulins T, Stein VM
papers.abstract: Meningoencephalitis of unknown origin (MUO) is a common inflammatory central nervous system (CNS) disease in dogs with unclear etiology, complicating diagnosis. Dogs with MUO exhibit distinct cytokine profiles in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) compared to other CNS diseases and controls. The study included 23 dogs diagnosed with MUO based on clinical signs, supportive CSF, and imaging findings. For comparison, 110 dogs were included, comprising dogs with CNS disorders, neurological diseases not involving the CNS (non-CNS), and orthopedic diseases. In this prospective cross-sectional observational study, 6 cytokines (interferon-γ [IFN-γ], TNF-α, IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-15) were measured in paired CSF and serum samples using multiplex bead-based immunoassays. Primary outcome was the association between CSF cytokine concentrations and MUO, assessed by logistic regression. Meningoencephalitis of unknown origin showed significantly higher CSF concentrations compared to idiopathic epilepsy, intracranial neoplasia, intervertebral disc herniation, and non-CNS diseases in IFN-γ (MUO: median 108.4 pg/mL, IQR 25.8 vs comparison group: 10.5 pg/mL, IQR 0.0; β-coefficient 0.039, 95% CI, 0.021-0.057, P < .001) and interleukin (IL)-10 (MUO: 171.1 pg/mL, IQR 37.0 vs 8.5 pg/mL, IQR 0.0; β-coefficient 0.021, 95% CI, 0.011-0.030, P < .001). Moreover, TNF-α (β-coefficient 0.062, 95% CI, 0.023-0.102, P < .01), IL-15 (β-coefficient 0.080, 95% CI, 0.012-0.148, P < .05) and IL-2 (β-coefficient 0.055, 95% CI, 0.005-0.104, P < .05) concentrations were also elevated in MUO versus comparison group. Cerebrospinal fluid cytokine profiling identifies a characteristic intrathecal immune signature in MUO, advancing the understanding of its immunopathogenesis.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 원인불명의 뇌수막뇌염(MUO) 개에서 뇌척수액의 IFN-γ, IL-10, TNF-α, IL-15, IL-2 농도가 특징적으로 상승하며, 이러한 세포인자 프로파일이 MUO의 뇌척수액 내 특이적 면역 서명을 나타낸다.
[방법·수치] MUO 진단견 23마리와 대조군(CNS 질환, 비CNS 신경질환, 정형외과 질환) 110마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 횡단면 연구; 뇌척수액에서 IFN-γ 중앙값 108.4 pg/mL (MUO) vs 10.5 pg/mL (비교군, P<0.001), IL-10 171.1 pg/mL vs 8.5 pg/mL (P<0.001), TNF-α·IL-15·IL-2도 MUO에서 유의하게 상승 (P<0.05).
[임상 적용·한계] 뇌척수액 세포인자 측정은 원인불명의 뇌염 진단 보조 도구로 활용 가능하나, 단일 기관 연구이고 대조군 구성이 다양하여 임상 절단값 설정을 위한 추가 대규모 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Blood serotonin, ionized magnesium, cardiac troponin I, N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide concentrations, and mitral valve billowing in horses with mitral valve regurgitation.
papers.authors: Demeyere M, Dufourni A, Verhaeghe LM, Paulussen E, Heirman L
papers.abstract: Serotonin, ionized magnesium (iMg), cardiac biomarkers, and mitral valve prolapse are extensively investigated in humans and dogs with mitral valve regurgitation (MR), but not in horses. To investigate serotonin, iMg, cardiac troponin I (cTnI), and N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) concentrations and degree of mitral valve billowing (MVB) in horses with MR. Eighty controls (no/trivial MR), 122 horses with MR (92 mild, 24 moderate, 6 severe). Prospective cross-sectional observational study. All horses underwent echocardiography with MVB distance assessment and MR classification. Platelet-poor plasma serotonin and serum iMg, cTnI, and NT-proBNP concentrations were determined. Controls and horses with different MR grades, biomarker concentrations, and MVB distance were compared using (non-)parametric tests. Ionized magnesium concentration was lower in MR compared to controls (mean difference, 0.03 mmol/L; 95% CI, 0.01-0.05; P = .01), but showed no correlation with billowing distance. The billowing distance was higher in horses with MR than in controls (septal: median difference, 0.2 cm; 95% CI, 0.1-0.3; P < .001; parietal: median difference, 0.3 cm; 95% CI, 0.2-0.3; P < .001), and in horses with a crescendo compared to a holosystolic MR jet (septal: median difference, 0.2 cm; 95% CI, 0.1-0.3; P = .003; parietal: median difference, 0.1 cm; 95% CI, 0.0-0.2; P = .01). No differences in serotonin, cTnI, and NT-proBNP concentrations were detected. Mitral valve billowing is to some extent likely physiological. The association of serotonin and iMg in MVB and MR requires further investigation. Both cTnI and NT-proBNP showed limited use as biomarkers of MR severity. Achtergrondinformatie: Serotonine, geïoniseerd magnesium (iMg), cardiale biomarkers en mitraalklep prolaps werden reeds uitgebreid onderzocht bij mensen en honden met mitraalklep regurgitatie (MR), in tegenstelling tot paarden met MR.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 말의 승모판 역류(MR)에서 이온화 마그네슘(iMg) 농도는 대조군보다 유의하게 낮지만 판막 돌출(MVB) 정도와는 상관관계가 없었으며, 세로토닌·심장트로포닌I·NT-proBNP는 MR 중증도를 판별하는 유용한 바이오마커로서 제한적 가치만 보였다.
[방법·수치] 대조군 80두(MR 없음/경미함), MR군 122두(경증 92두, 중등도 24두, 중증 6두)를 대상으로 한 전향적 횡단면 관찰연구; 심초음파로 판막 돌출 거리와 MR 분류 평가, 혈중 세로토닌과 혈청 iMg·cTnI·NT-proBNP 측정; iMg 평균차이 0.03 mmol/L(P=0.01), MVB 거리는 MR군에서 더 높음(중격부 중앙값 차이 0.2cm P<0.001, 측벽부 0.3cm P<0.001).
[임상 적용·한계] 말의 MR 임상진단에 있어 심초음파를 통한 MVB 평가가 여전히 중요하나, iMg·세로토닌·심장바이오마커 단독 사용은 MR 중증도 판정에 제한적이며, 단일기관 전향적 연구로 추가 다기관 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Bendamustine induces peripheral lymphodepletion in dogs with relapsed lymphoma.
papers.authors: Lenz JA, Upton L, Ma J, Talone MM, Peng B
papers.abstract: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has improved outcomes for many human patients with B-cell lymphoma and provides a rational template for analogous canine patients. To date, the expansion, persistence, and activity of CAR T cells in dogs have been limited. Lymphodepletion supports CAR T-cell engraftment and antitumor activity. In human medical oncology, bendamustine has emerged as a well-tolerated lymphodepleting agent. However, prospective use of bendamustine for dogs with lymphoma has not been characterized. To determine the lymphodepleting activity and tolerability of bendamustine in dogs with relapsed lymphoma. Secondary objectives included monitoring serum cytokines and short-term changes in peripheral tumor burden. Eleven client-owned dogs with relapsed lymphoma. Luminescent assays were used to assess the direct cytotoxic activity of bendamustine against canine lymphoid cell lines. A prospective rapid dose-escalation pilot trial was undertaken in 11 dogs with relapsed lymphoma to evaluate tolerability while tracking peripheral lymphocyte counts, serum cytokine concentrations, and lymph node measurements. Bendamustine induced concentration-dependent cytotoxicity in all cell lines tested. Two-dose bendamustine regimens up to 90 mg/m2 were generally well tolerated, with no dose-limiting toxicities observed, and resulted in peripheral lymphodepletion (pretreatment median, 880 cells/μL; posttreatment median, 310 cells/μL), an exploratory decrease in circulating interleukin-6 (pretreatment median, 5.32 pg/mL; posttreatment median, 1.33 pg/mL), and a short-term decrease in peripheral nodal burden in 8 of 11 dogs. Bendamustine was generally well tolerated and induced lymphodepletion in our cohort. These findings support further evaluation of bendamustine as a preconditioning agent before autologous canine CAR T-cell infusion.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 벤다무스틴은 재발성 림프종 개에서 말초 림프구 감소증을 유도하며 내약성이 우수하여, 향후 개의 CAR T세포 치료 전 전처치제로서의 가능성을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 재발성 림프종 개 11마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 용량 단계 증가 시험; 벤다무스틴 2회 용량 최대 90 mg/m2 투여 시 용량 제한 독성 없음; 림프구 중앙값 880 cells/μL에서 310 cells/μL로 감소, IL-6 중앙값 5.32 pg/mL에서 1.33 pg/mL로 감소, 11마리 중 8마리에서 단기 말초 림프절 부담 감소.
[임상 적용·한계] 벤다무스틴은 개의 CAR T세포 주입 전 전처치제로 임상 적용 가능하나, 소규모 파일럿 연구로 더 큰 규모의 검증 연구가 필요하고 장기 추적 관찰 자료는 제시되지 않았다.

papers.title: Frequency of arrhythmias detected in 53,708 canine electrocardiograms by breed, life stage, and sex.
papers.authors: Gentile-Solomon J, Castaneda EL, Grimaldi DA, Spake AK, Estrada AH
papers.abstract: The purpose of this study was to describe the frequency of arrhythmias detected in unsedated canine patients from general practice settings. A total of 57,950 canine electrocardiograms (ECGs) were retrospectively collected, of which 53,708 met the inclusion criteria. Recordings were evaluated by a board-certified cardiologist. If an arrhythmia was present in the ECG tracing, the cardiologist categorized the arrhythmia using pre-established keywords. The number of dogs with at least one arrhythmia was 1758 (3.3%, 1758/53,708). The most frequently diagnosed arrhythmias were ventricular premature complexes (1.4%, 740/53,708), supraventricular premature complexes (0.7%, 380/53,708), and first-degree atrioventricular block (0.6%, 337/53,708). When adjusting for sex, weight bucket, life stage, and multiple comparisons, Whippets were seen to have the highest odds (odds ratio: 5.31, 95% confidence interval: 2.07-12.34, P=0.039). Senior dogs had the highest odds of having an arrhythmia (odds ratio: 1.93, 95% confidence interval: 1.67-2.22, P<0.001). Both male-neutered and female-spayed dogs had higher proportions of arrhythmias than the intact male and intact female dogs, respectively. While it is important to note that the presence of an arrhythmia alone does not always indicate the presence of heart disease, further research on the association between breed and cardiac health is needed. Of the 53,708 ECGs included in this study, at least one arrhythmia was detected in 1758 distinct cases. Arrhythmias were more common in fixed dogs compared to intact dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 53,708건의 개 심전도에서 3.3%의 개가 최소 1개 이상의 부정맥을 보였으며, 심실기외수축(1.4%), 심방기외수축(0.7%), 1도 방실전도 차단(0.6%)이 가장 흔했다. Whippet 견종과 노령견에서 부정맥 발생률이 유의하게 높았고, 중성화/불임 개에서 미처리 개보다 부정맥이 더 흔했다.
[방법·수치] 일반 진료 환경의 무진정 개 환자 57,950건의 심전도를 후향적으로 수집하여 53,708건을 분석했다. 전문 심장 전문의가 평가했으며, 부정맥 검출률 1758/53,708(3.3%), Whippet의 교차비 5.31(95% CI: 2.07-12.34, P=0.039), 노령견의 교차비 1.93(95% CI: 1.67-2.22, P<0.001)이다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 현장에서 무진정 상태의 심전도 검사 시 Whippet 견종과 노령견에서 부정맥 발견의 가능성이 높으므로 주의 깊은 평가가 필요하다. 그러나 부정맥의 존재 자체만으로는 심장질환을 의미하지 않으며, 견종과 심장 건강의 연관성에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Therapeutic approaches to the companion animal pneumothorax: A review for veterinary practice.
papers.authors: Nishigaki AM, DeRoche MW, Strickland R, Rossanese M, Previdelli RL
papers.abstract: This narrative literature review critically evaluates current evidence on the management of pneumothorax in dogs and cats, reviewing surgical and nonsurgical treatment strategies according to underlying etiology to support evidence-based clinical decision-making. Published studies involving dogs and cats with pneumothorax were reviewed, with emphasis on the pathophysiology, diagnosis, and management of the condition and outcomes associated with surgical and nonsurgical treatments across different etiologies. Current evidence indicates that both medical and surgical management can achieve favorable outcomes, with low reported recurrence rates when appropriately selected. Nonsurgical approaches may provide effective, minimally invasive treatment in selected cases, whereas surgical intervention enables direct thoracic exploration, identification and correction of underlying pulmonary lesions, and definitive treatment of refractory or severe pneumothorax. Treatment selection should be guided by disease etiology, severity, patient stability, available resources, and clinician expertise. Both surgical and nonsurgical treatments can be effective when tailored to the underlying cause and clinical presentation, highlighting the importance of individualized treatment planning to optimize outcomes. This review synthesizes current evidence to guide clinical decision-making in the management of pneumothorax in dogs and cats and highlights the need for high-quality studies evaluating long-term outcomes to strengthen the evidence base.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 기흉 관리에서 내과적 치료와 수술적 치료 모두 적절히 선택하면 양호한 결과를 얻을 수 있으며, 재발률이 낮게 보고되고 있다.
[방법·수치] 개와 고양이의 기흉 관련 출판 논문을 검토한 내러티브 문헌 고찰로, 원인별 병태생리, 진단, 치료 전략 및 결과를 평가했으며 구체적 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 비수술적 접근은 선택된 증례에서 최소침습적 치료를 제공하고, 수술적 개입은 흉강 직접 탐색과 폐병변 교정으로 난치성 또는 중증 기흉의 최종 치료를 가능하게 한다. 치료 선택은 원인, 중증도, 환자 안정성, 가용 자원, 임상의 경험을 고려해야 하며, 고품질 장기 추적 연구의 필요성이 강조된다.

papers.title: 10-Year Outcomes of Initial CTO-PCI vs No CTO-PCI Strategies for Chronic Total Occlusion: The DECISION-CTO Randomized Trial.
papers.authors: Kim JH, Kang DY, Ahn JM, Wee SB, Kim S
papers.abstract: The long-term clinical effects of percutaneous coronary intervention for chronic total occlusion (CTO-PCI) remain uncertain. This study aimed to compare 10-year clinical outcomes between initial CTO-PCI and no CTO-PCI strategies in the extended follow-up of the DECISION-CTO trial. The DECISION-CTO trial was an open-label, multicenter, randomized trial conducted at 19 centers in 5 Asian countries. Patients were randomly assigned to an initial strategy of CTO-PCI or no CTO-PCI, with guideline-directed medical therapy in both groups and PCI of obstructive non-CTO lesions encouraged in both groups. The primary endpoint was a composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, stroke, or any revascularization at 10 years, analyzed in the modified intention-to-treat group. Between March 2010 and October 2016, 834 patients were randomly assigned, and 804 of these patients were included in the modified intention-to-treat analysis (413 CTO-PCI, 391 no CTO-PCI). Clinical follow-up at 10 years was complete in 688 patients (85.6%), without a significant between-group difference (P = 0.69). At 10 years, the primary endpoint had occurred in 134 patients in the CTO-PCI group and 138 patients in the no CTO-PCI group (Kaplan-Meier estimates: 33.9% vs 37.4%; risk difference: -3.5 percentage points; 95% CI: -10.4 to 3.3 percentage points; P = 0.32). Restricted mean event-free survival time at 10 years was also similar between groups (7.52 vs 7.53 years; difference: -0.01 years; 95% CI: -0.54 to 0.52 years; P = 0.97). Death from any cause did not differ significantly between groups (12.7% vs 16.5%; HR: 0.76; 95% CI: 0.52-1.12; P = 0.16). Over 10 years, an initial strategy of CTO-PCI was not associated with a significant difference in the primary endpoint or all-cause mortality compared with an initial strategy of no CTO-PCI. However, the wide CIs preclude definitive conclusions regarding the potential benefit or harm of an initial CTO-PCI strategy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 10년 추적에서 초기 CTO-PCI 시술 전략은 시술하지 않은 전략과 비교하여 사망, 심근경색, 뇌졸중, 재혈관화의 복합 주요 종료점에서 유의미한 차이를 보이지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 아시아 5개국 19개 센터의 다기관 무작위대조시험으로, 2010년 3월~2016년 10월 사이에 834명이 등록되어 804명이 최종 분석에 포함되었다(CTO-PCI군 413명, 비시술군 391명). 10년 추적 완성률은 85.6%였고, 주요 종료점은 CTO-PCI군 33.9% vs 비시술군 37.4%로 위험비 차이 -3.5%포인트(95% CI: -10.4~3.3, P=0.32), 전체 사망률은 12.7% vs 16.5%(HR: 0.76, 95% CI: 0.52-1.12, P=0.16)였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 만성 전폐색 환자에서 초기 CTO-PCI의 명확한 임상적 이득이 입증되지 않았으나, 광범위한 신뢰구간으로 인해 잠재적 이득 또는 해로움에 대한 확정적 결론을 내릴 수 없으며, 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: A newly derived formula outperforms published formulae for estimating urine osmolality in healthy dogs receiving intravenous fluids.
papers.authors: Jeong Y, Qu Y, Kim MS, Her J
papers.abstract: To derive a formula to estimate urine osmolality (Uosm) in dogs with urine sodium, potassium, glucose, and urea nitrogen and to compare the performance of the derived formula with published formulae. A prospective observational study was conducted using purpose-bred Beagles housed at a university research facility. Healthy dogs, confirmed by physical examination and laboratory testing, received isotonic or hypotonic IV fluids in a randomized sequence for 48 hours, with a 10-day washout period between treatments. Urine samples were collected through indwelling urinary catheters at baseline and every 12 hours. Urine osmolality and urinary osmolytes were measured. Linear mixed models were used to derive formulae, and agreement was assessed using the concordance correlation coefficient (CCC), Bland-Altman analysis, and Passing-Bablok regression. Performance was compared with published formulae. 9 dogs provided 89 urine measurements. The proposed formula was Uosm = 2 X sodium + 1.8 X potassium + urea nitrogen2.5 (mg/dL) + glucose3.9 (mg/dL). The CCC was 0.96 (95% CI, 0.94 to 0.97), and the fixed bias was +7.99 mOsm/kg. Passing-Bablok regression revealed no proportional or constant bias. Compared with the published formulae, the proposed formula had the highest CCC and lowest fixed bias. The proposed formula provided a simple and reliable method to estimate Uosm in healthy dogs receiving isotonic and hypotonic IV fluids and outperformed the published formulae. Further validation in pathologic states is warranted. This formula improves the assessment of renal water handling, fluid balance, and kidney concentration ability when measuring Uosm is unavailable.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 새로운 요삼투질 추정 공식(Uosm = 2×나트륨 + 1.8×칼륨 + 요소질소2.5 + 포도당3.9)은 건강한 개에서 기존 공식들보다 우수한 성능을 보였으며, 요삼투질 측정이 불가능할 때 신장 수분 처리능과 농축능 평가에 유용하다.
[방법·수치] 목적 사육 비글 9마리에서 등장액 또는 저장액 정맥수액을 48시간 투여하면서 89개의 요 샘플을 수집하여 선형혼합모델로 공식을 도출했다. 제안된 공식의 일치상관계수(CCC)는 0.96(95% CI, 0.94~0.97)이었고, 고정편향은 +7.99 mOsm/kg였으며, Passing-Bablok 회귀분석에서 비례 편향이나 상수 편향이 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상에서 요삼투질을 직접 측정할 수 없는 상황에서 간단한 계산으로 신장의 수분 조절 능력을 평가할 수 있다. 그러나 건강한 개만 대상으로 한 소규모 연구(9마리)이므로 질병 상태에서의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Fixation of proximal humeral Salter-Harris type 1 fractures in a 3-dimensionally printed skeletally immature canine bone model: a biomechanical assessment of fully threaded headless cannulated screws.
papers.authors: Hwang TW, Kang E, Kim JM, Kim HY
papers.abstract: To compare the biomechanical stability of 4 fixation techniques for proximal humeral physeal fractures in skeletally immature canines using 3-D-printed models. This experimental in vitro study was conducted from September 25, 2025, through April 22, 2026. To strictly control biological variability, identical 3-D-printed models of juvenile canine proximal humeral Salter-Harris type 1 fractures (CT-derived from a 6-month-old 26-kg Labrador Retriever) were evaluated across 4 groups: pin and tension band wire (group A), partially threaded cannulated screw (group B), fully threaded headless cannulated screw (FTHCS) alone (group C), and FTHCS with a 1.6-mm Kirschner (K)-wire (group D). Tensile loading was applied at 10 mm/min at 105° to simulate supraspinatus traction. Outcomes included loads at 1- and 2-mm displacements, maximum failure load, and failure modes. Twenty-four models were tested (n = 6/group). Group D exhibited significantly higher resistance at 1-mm (663.95 N) and 2-mm (1,080.33 N) displacements than other groups. At 1-mm displacement, group D outperformed groups C, A, and B (mean differences [MD]: 206.2 N, 380.6 N, and 405.7 N, respectively; P < .0083). Maximum failure load did not differ significantly. Group B failed via localized proximal crushing and subsidence, whereas FTHCS groups (C, D) preserved proximal integrity, failing distally. In this 3-D-printed model, FTHCS combined with a K-wire provided superior resistance to tensile displacement compared with other tested constructs. FTHCS augmented with a K-wire may offer a biomechanically robust alternative mitigating subhead bone collapse, providing sufficient standalone stability for early rehabilitation in immature canines.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 완전나선형 무두부 중공나선(FTHCS)을 Kirschner 선과 함께 사용한 고정법이 3D 프린팅 모델에서 근위상완골 Salter-Harris type 1 골절의 견인 변위에 대한 저항성이 가장 우수했으며, 근위부 골 붕괴를 완화시킬 수 있는 견고한 대안으로 제시되었다.
[방법·수치] 6개월령 26kg 라브라도 레트리버의 CT 기반 3D 프린팅 근위상완골 골절 모델 24개를 4개 군으로 분류(각 n=6): A군(핀+긴장밴드 와이어), B군(부분나선형 중공나선), C군(FTHCS 단독), D군(FTHCS+1.6mm K-선). 105도 각도에서 10mm/분 속도의 견인 하중을 적용했을 때, D군이 1mm 변위(663.95 N)와 2mm 변위(1,080.33 N) 시 다른 모든 군보다 유의하게 높은 저항성을 보였다(P<0.0083). 최대 파괴 하중은 유의한 차이 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 미성숙 개의 조기 재활을 위해 충분한 단독 안정성을 제공할 수 있으나, 본 연구는 3D 프린팅 모델을 사용한 생체 외(in vitro) 실험으로 생물학적 변동성을 배제한 한계가 있으며 임상 추적 결과 없음.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Hyperammonemia in cats with acute (on chronic) kidney disease: associations with urea cycle amino acids, azotemia and acid-base status.
papers.authors: McFadden K, Labato MA, Linder DE, Webster CR
papers.abstract: ObjectivesHyperammonemia occurs in cats with kidney disease although the pathophysiology is poorly understood. The objective of this study was to determine if hyperammonemia in cats with kidney disease is associated with decreased concentrations of plasma amino acids involved in the urea cycle and more severe acid-base derangements.MethodsTwenty cats presenting with acute kidney injury (AKI) and acute on chronic kidney disease (AoCKD) were prospectively enrolled. Fasting blood samples were analyzed for ammonia, pH, anion gap, electrolytes, lactate, blood urea nitrogen (BUN), creatinine and phosphorus. Plasma was frozen at -80oC and shipped for amino acid analysis.ResultsFive of 20 cats had an AKI and 15/20 had AoCKD. Median age and weight were 12 years (range 3-14) and 4.5 kg (range 3-5.6), respectively. Seven cats were hyperammonemic (median 252 µmol/l, range 113-886) and 13 were not (median 23 µmol/l, range 11-49). Creatinine, BUN and phosphorus were significantly higher in hyperammonemic cats. BUN and phosphorus correlated with ammonia. Fifteen of 20 cats (75%) were acidotic but there was no difference in lactate or blood and urine pH between the cats with and without hyperammonemia. The anion gap was higher (29.6, range 27-40 vs 25.1, range 11-34) and serum bicarbonate lower (9 mEq/L, range 4.8-13.5 vs 11.9, range 8-24.2) in hyperammonemic cats. Median plasma citrulline (47 nMol/mL, range 31-128 vs 22, range 12-37) and ornithine (20 nMol/mL, range 12-33 vs 10, range 7-35) but not arginine concentrations were significantly higher in hyperammonemic cats (p<0.05). Plasma citrulline concentrations were positively correlated with serum creatinine (r = 0.621, p = 0.003).Conclusions and relevanceHyperammonemic cats with AKI/AoCKD do not have deficiencies in urea cycle amino acid concentrations but do have more severe azotemia with accompanying high anion gap metabolic acidosis. Increases in citrulline may reflect decreased kidney function.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 급성신부전 또는 급성만성신부전에서 고암모니아혈증은 요소회로 아미노산 결핍이 아니라 더 심한 질소혈증과 고음이온틈 대사성산증을 동반한다. 고암모니아혈증 고양이에서 혈청 크레아티닌과 양의 상관관계를 보이는 시트룰린의 증가는 신기능 감소를 반영한다.
[방법·수치] 급성신부전 5마리, 급성만성신부전 15마리 고양이 20마리를 전향적으로 등록하여 금식 혈액샘플에서 암모니아, pH, 음이온틈, 전해질, 젖산, 혈중요소질소, 크레아티닌, 인을 측정하고 아미노산 분석을 수행했다. 고암모니아혈증군(중앙값 252 μmol/l, 범위 113-886)에서 크레아티닌, 혈중요소질소, 인이 유의하게 높았고 음이온틈은 29.6(범위 27-40) vs 25.1(범위 11-34), 혈청중탄산염은 9 mEq/L(범위 4.8-13.5) vs 11.9(범위 8-24.2)로 나타났다. 시트룰린 중앙값은 47 nMol/mL(범위 31-128) vs 22(범위 12-37)이며 혈청크레아티닌과의 상관계수는 r=0.621, p=0.003이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 신부전 고양이에서 고암모니아혈증 발생 시 요소회로 아미노산 보충보다는 더 심한 질소혈증 및 산증 관리에 초점을 맞춰야 한다. 단일기관 소규모 연구(20마리)이며 초록에서 고암모니아혈증의 임상증상과 치료 결과에 대한 정보가 부족하다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Elbow luxation treatment in cats using external fixation.
papers.authors: Yener K, Hurma MS, Karadağ MS, Dikmen Ilginoğlu K, Hünerli H
papers.abstract: ObjectivesTo describe outcomes and complications of open reduction, collateral ligament repair and temporary epoxy resin Type Ia transarticular external skeletal fixation (TaESF) in cats with traumatic lateral elbow luxation after failed closed treatment.MethodsTen cats were referred 3-4 days after injury. Closed reduction failed in four cats and reluxation occurred in six after reduction and Robert Jones bandaging. All underwent open reduction, apposition of identifiable collateral ligament ends and four-pin epoxy resin Type Ia TaESF. Clinical and orthogonal radiographic examinations were performed weekly until frame removal at 3 weeks and at 6 weeks. Lameness was graded 0-3, and Campbell's test was performed after frame removal and at 6 weeks. At 6 months, three cats underwent orthopaedic examination and seven were assessed by structured owner telephone interview. Complications were classified according to Cook et al.ResultsReduction was maintained in all cats through 6 weeks. Grade 0/1 lameness was recorded in seven/three cats at 3 weeks and eight/two cats at 6 weeks (Cases 3 and 9). Functional outcome was full in eight cats (80%) and acceptable in two (20%). A contralateral proximal ulnar fracture contributed to residual lameness in Case 3. Case 1 required unplanned intervention for proximal humeral pin migration and seroma. The pin was repositioned under sedation without replacement or additional epoxy resin. Radiolucency and periosteal reaction surrounded the distal ulnar pin. The seroma resolved without recurrence, and the frame was removed as scheduled. No comparable pin-site radiographic abnormalities were identified in the other cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 외상성 측면 주관절 탈구에서 폐쇄 정복 실패 후 개방 정복, 측부인대 복구, 에폭시 레진 Type Ia 경관절 외부 골격 고정술을 적용하면 정복을 유지하고 만족할 만한 단기 임상 결과를 얻을 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 외상 후 3-4일 경과한 고양이 10마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구, 폐쇄 정복 실패 4예 및 정복 후 재탈구 6예를 개방 정복 및 외부 고정술로 치료. 주관절 정복은 6주까지 모든 증례에서 유지, 3주차 Grade 0/1 절뚝거림 각각 7/3마리, 6주차 8/2마리, 기능적 결과는 완전 회복 8마리(80%), 수용 가능 2마리(20%), 1마리에서 계획되지 않은 추가 중재 필요, 6개월 추적 시 모든 고양이에서 정상적인 보행·달리기·뛰기 보임(수치 제시 없음).
[임상 적용·한계] 폐쇄 정복에 실패한 고양이 주관절 탈구의 수술 치료법으로 적용 가능하며, 단기 추적 결과는 양호하나 본 연구는 소규모 후향적 증례 모음이고 객관적 장기 추적 및 비교 연구가 필요하다는 점이 한계이다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Feline granulocytic anaplasmosis in Europe: anamnesis, clinicopathological abnormalities, bacterial DNA load, treatment, and outcome.
papers.authors: Meyer L, Moritz A, Baneth G, Strube C, Jindal K
papers.abstract: Feline granulocytic anaplasmosis (FGA) is caused by Anaplasma (A.) phagocytophilum. Fever and thrombocytopenia are the most common clinicopathological abnormalities.ObjectivesThe aim was to investigate regionality, seasonality, clinicopathological parameters, treatment, and outcomes in cats with FGA.MethodsThe database of a commercial laboratory was retrospectively screened for A. phagocytophilum-polymerase chain (PCR)-results on EDTA-blood submitted by European veterinarians from 01/2022 to 12/2025. Hematological data and bacterial DNA loads quantified by digital droplet-PCR were analyzed. Questionnaires were sent to the veterinarians asking for underlying diseases, anamnesis, clinicopathological abnormalities, treatment, and outcome in cats with FGA.Results43/702 cats (6.1%) tested positive by A. phagocytophilum-PCR in Europe. Questionnaires were available for 29/43 cats (67.4%), all of which had outdoor access. Lethargy (23/29; 79.3%), anorexia (22/29, 75.9%), and fever (>39.5°C, 18/29, 62.0%) were the most reported findings. Thrombocytopenia was detected in 14/18 cats (77.8%) without concurrent diseases, anemia and leukopenia in 2/20 cats each (10.0%), eosinopenia in 10/17 (58.8%), and lymphopenia in 8/17 cats (47.1%). The bacterial DNA load was available for 27/43 cats (25 x 102-87 x 106, median 124 x 105/ml EDTA-blood), revealing no significant correlation with hematological parameters. 20/21 cats (95.2%) were treated with doxycycline and one (4.8%) with enrofloxacin. Uncomplicated course of disease was reported in 19/21 cats (90.5%). In one cat treated with doxycycline for 10 days, another positive PCR was recorded one month later. Clinical signs recurred immediately in another cat treated with doxycycline for five days only.Conclusions and relevanceFGA should be considered in cats with outdoor access, lethargy, inappetence, and most often mild thrombocytopenia and/or anemia, regardless of fever.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 과립구 아나플라스마증(FGA)은 야외활동 고양이에서 무기력, 식욕부진, 경미한 혈소판감소증 또는 빈혈을 보이며, 독시사이클린 치료에 반응이 좋으나 10일 이하 치료 시 재발 가능성이 있다.
[방법·수치] 유럽 상업 검사실 데이터베이스를 2022년 1월~2025년 12월 후향적으로 스크리닝하여 702마리 중 43마리(6.1%)가 A. phagocytophilum PCR 양성으로 판정되었고, 29마리(67.4%)에서 설문조사 완료. 주요 증상: 무기력(79.3%), 식욕부진(75.9%), 발열(62.0%), 혈소판감소증(77.8%), 호산구감소증(58.8%), 림프구감소증(47.1%). 세균 DNA 부하량 범위 25×10²~87×10⁶/ml (중앙값 124×10⁵). 독시사이클린 치료 95.2%, 무합병증 경과 90.5%.
[임상 적용·한계] 야외활동 고양이의 무기력, 식욕부진, 경미한 혈소판감소증이 있으면 FGA를 의심하고 독시사이클린 14일 치료를 권장하며 치료 후 PCR 추적검사 필요. 후향적 단일 검사실 데이터로 지역별 편향 가능성 있고, 29마리만 임상정보 확보로 소규모 연구.

papers.title: Angiography-Derived vs Wire-Based Fractional Flow Reserve to Guide Revascularization: The Randomized LIPSIA-STRATEGY Trial.
papers.authors: Majunke N, Desch S, Kister T, Buske M, Pöss J
papers.abstract: Wire-based physiological assessment is recommended to guide coronary revascularization but remains underused. Angiography-derived physiology offers a wire-free alternative; however, randomized comparisons with pressure wire fractional flow reserve (FFR) have yielded inconsistent findings. This study sought to determine whether angiography-derived vessel fractional flow reserve (vFFR)-guided revascularization is noninferior to pressure wire FFR guidance for intermediate coronary stenoses. The multicenter, investigator-initiated, randomized LIPSIA-STRATEGY trial included patients with acute or chronic coronary syndromes and at least 1 intermediate coronary stenosis at 8 German centers. Patients were randomized 1:1 to undergo revascularization based on vFFR or FFR. The primary outcome was major adverse cardiac events, defined as a composite of cardiac death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or unplanned clinically driven revascularization within 1 year, analyzed by modified intention to treat against a noninferiority margin of 3.5 percentage points. Between June 2020 and February 2025, 1,053 patients (median age: 69 years) underwent randomization (vFFR, n = 528; FFR, n = 525). At 1 year, major adverse cardiac events occurred in 15 of 493 patients (3.0%) in the vFFR group and in 20 of 493 (4.1%) in the FFR group (risk difference: -1.01 percentage points; P for noninferiority <0.001); the primary outcome was ascertainable in 986 of the 1,053 randomized patients. The upper boundary of the 1-sided 97.5% CI for the risk difference was 1.29 percentage points, below the prespecified margin (relative risk: 0.75; 95% CI: 0.39-1.45). Physiological values of 0.80 or less occurred in 43.1% vs 35.9% of patients, and the study lesion was revascularized in 41.2% vs 35.5%, respectively.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 중등도 관상동맥협착증에서 혈관조영술 기반 혈류예비력(vFFR)을 이용한 혈관재개통술이 압력선 기반 FFR 가이드 치료와 비교하여 1년 내 주요 심장 이상사건(사망, 심근경색, 계획되지 않은 혈관재개통술)에서 비열등성을 충족했다.
[방법·수치] 8개 독일 의료기관에서 2020년 6월~2025년 2월 중 급성/만성 관상동맥증후군 환자 1,053명(중앙값 69세)을 vFFR군(528명) 또는 FFR군(525명)에 1:1로 무작위배정. 1년 추적 결과 vFFR군 3.0%(15/493명) vs FFR군 4.1%(20/493명) 주요 이상사건 발생(위험차: -1.01 percentage points; 비열등성 P<0.001), 상대위험도 0.75(95% CI: 0.39-1.45), 생리적 수치≤0.80 발생률 43.1% vs 35.9%, 병변 혈관재개통술률 41.2% vs 35.5%.
[임상 적용·한계] vFFR은 압력선 삽입 없이 혈관조영상으로 중등도 협착증의 혈역학적 중증도를 평가할 수 있는 유용한 대안으로, 임상에서 선택적 재관류 결정을 돕는 도구로 활용 가능하다. 그러나 예상보다 낮은 사건률로 인해 절대값 기준에서는 비열등성을 보였으나 사후 분석에서 상대값 기준 비열등성 미충족, 추가 혈관재개통술의 이득 여부 미확인 등의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Comparison of lingual oscillometric and invasive blood pressure measurement in dogs under general anaesthesia.
papers.authors: Kyle C, Deutsch J
papers.abstract: The objective of the study was to evaluate agreement between tongue-based oscillometric and invasive arterial blood pressure in anaesthetised dogs, assess performance against American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine and Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation/European Society of Hypertension/International Organization for Standardization validation criteria and examine proportional bias overall and by body size and phenotype. Prospective observational study of 89 client-owned dogs undergoing general anaesthesia. Simultaneous tongue-based oscillometric and invasive arterial systolic, mean and diastolic pressures were recorded at 5-minute intervals (1780 paired observations). Agreement was assessed using Bland-Altman analysis and performance judged against American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine and Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation/European Society of Hypertension/International Organization for Standardization criteria. Proportional bias (difference vs. mean pressure) was evaluated with linear mixed-effects models with dogs as a random effect, with body size (≤10 kg vs. >10 kg) and phenotype (chondrodystrophic vs. non-chondrodystrophic) as interaction terms. American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine criteria were met for mean and diastolic but not systolic pressure; no measure met Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation/European Society of Hypertension/International Organization for Standardization thresholds. Limits of agreement for mean and diastolic pressures were wide. Systolic pressure showed magnitude-dependent underestimation, whereas mean and diastolic pressures did not. Underestimation increased with systolic pressure in dogs >10 kg and in non-chondrodystrophic dogs, whereas no clear pressure-dependent trend was seen in dogs ≤10 kg or in chondrodystrophic dogs. Transient tongue swelling occurred in one dog; no other tongue-related adverse events were recorded.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 혀 기반 진동식 혈압계는 미국수의내과학회 기준에서 평균·확장기 혈압은 수용 가능하지만 수축기 혈압은 불충분하며, 국제 기준(AAMI/ESH/ISO)은 모든 항목에서 미충족. 수축기 혈압에서 크기 및 체형에 따른 편향이 있음.
[방법·수치] 전향적 관찰 연구, 전신마취 개 89마리, 1780쌍의 동시 측정(5분 간격). 혀 진동식 혈압계 vs. 침습적 동맥 혈압 비교. Bland-Altman 분석으로 평가. 체중(≤10kg vs. >10kg)과 체형(연골이형성 유무)으로 비례 편향 분석. 혀 부종 1건 발생, 기타 부작용 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 침습적 모니터링 불가 상황에서 평균·확장기 혈압의 추세 추적에 유용하나, 수축기 혈압은 특히 >10kg 개 또는 비연골이형성 개에서 신중한 해석 필요. 임상 맥락과 함께 해석하되 침습적 측정의 직접 대체로는 부적절하고, 합의 범위가 넓다는 한계.

papers.title: "Up to and including death": understanding anaesthesia-related anxiety among pet owners in a tertiary-care setting.
papers.authors: Shuttleworth A, Adami C
papers.abstract: Preparing clients for their pet to undergo general anaesthesia is an important and common task for veterinary professionals. The aims of this study were to better understand referral client anxiety relating to general anaesthesia and to determine their level of knowledge in this area. Pet owners attending a UK referral centre whose dog or cat had undergone general anaesthesia between February 6, 2022 and February 6, 2025 were invited to take part in an online survey. The questionnaire comprised four sections: demographics, concerns regarding general anaesthesia, knowledge of this area and provision of consent. In total, 432 responses were included in analysis. 69.2% of respondents reported feeling "anxious" towards general anaesthesia, with 60.9% indicating that they had concerns. Of the categories of concern reported, anaesthetic death and contextual factors were cited in 31% and 30% of responses, respectively. The mean average mortality rate estimated by respondents for healthy dogs and cats was 16.2% (95% confidence interval: dogs 14.20 to 18.25, cats 14.01 to 18.35) compared to 9.7% (95% confidence interval: 8.17 to 11.26) for humans. 89.4% of respondents were happy with the level of information they received ahead of the anaesthetic and 88.5% reported that they provided informed consent. When provided with published statistics for anaesthetic mortality in UK dogs and cats, 63% of participants found this reassuring. Causes of owner anxiety regarding general anaesthesia are multifactorial and do not always relate to mortality. UK referral clients may perceive a higher rate of anaesthetic mortality in healthy dogs and cats than currently evidenced.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 반려동물 보호자의 69.2%가 전신마취에 대해 불안감을 느끼며, 이는 사망 위험(31%)과 상황적 요인(30%)이 주요 원인이고, 보호자들이 실제 위험보다 마취 사망률을 과대평가하는 경향이 있다.
[방법·수치] 영국 3차 의료기관에 내원한 개 또는 고양이 보호자 432명을 대상으로 2022년 2월 6일부터 2025년 2월 6일까지 온라인 설문을 실시했으며, 보호자들이 추정한 건강한 개/고양이의 평균 마취 사망률은 16.2%(95% CI: 개 14.20-18.25, 고양이 14.01-18.35)로 인간의 9.7%(95% CI: 8.17-11.26)보다 높았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 마취 전 충분한 정보 제공(89.4% 만족)과 공식 통계 제시(63%가 안심)를 통해 보호자 불안을 완화할 수 있으나, 단일 국가 3차 기관 대상의 단면 조사로 일반화의 제한이 있고 불안의 다면적 원인에 대한 더 심층적 분석이 필요하다.

papers.title: Predictive utility of computed tomography-derived renal parenchymal volume for long-term postoperative renal function in cats with hydronephrosis.
papers.authors: Nagumo T, Hoshino Y, Kobayashi S, Fujiwara R, Yamasaki M
papers.abstract: To evaluate the utility of preoperative feline renal parenchymal volume derived from computed tomography in predicting the serum creatinine concentration during the long-term postoperative period. In this retrospective clinical study, we included 13 client-owned cats with normal kidneys and 24 cats with hydronephrosis (16 with chronic kidney disease and 8 without chronic kidney disease). The renal parenchymal volume was derived from CT images and normalised to the body weight. The reference intervals for renal parenchymal volume/body weight and total renal parenchymal volume/body weight were calculated from the control group. We performed between-group comparisons of the preoperative hydronephrotic renal parenchymal volume, contralateral renal parenchymal volume and total renal parenchymal volume/body weight; additionally, we analysed the relationships among hydronephrotic renal parenchymal volume/body weight, contralateral renal parenchymal volume/body weight, total renal parenchymal volume /body weight and serum creatinine concentration during the preoperative and long-term postoperative periods (>3 months). The long-term postoperative chronic kidney disease stages were classified based on the International Renal Interest Society guidelines. The non-chronic kidney disease subgroup had a significantly greater hydronephrotic renal parenchymal volume/body weight than the control group. The non-chronic kidney disease subgroup had a significantly greater contralateral renal parenchymal volume/body weight than the control group and the chronic kidney disease subgroup. In the non-chronic kidney disease subgroup, contralateral renal parenchymal volume/body weight showed a strong negative relationship with postoperative serum creatinine concentration (r = -0.79). In the hydronephrosis group, total renal parenchymal volume /body weight showed a moderate negative correlation with postoperative serum creatinine concentration (r = -0.46).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 수술 전 CT로 측정한 대측 신장실질용적이 수신증 고양이의 술후 장기 혈청 크레아티닌 농도와 강한 음의 상관관계를 보이며, CT 기반 신장실질용적 정량화는 수신증 고양이의 술후 만성신장질환 병기 예측에 유용할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 정상신장 고양이 13마리, 수신증 고양이 24마리(만성신장질환 16마리, 비만성신장질환 8마리)를 대상으로 한 후향적 임상 연구; 비만성신장질환 군에서 대측 신장실질용적/체중이 술후 혈청 크레아티닌과 강한 음의 상관관계(r=-0.79), 전체 수신증 군에서는 중등도의 음의 상관관계(r=-0.46) 확인.
[임상 적용·한계] 수신증으로 인한 신손상의 가역성 평가와 술후 신기능 회복 예측에 활용 가능하나, 후향적 연구이고 샘플 크기가 24마리로 제한적이며 단일기관 데이터이므로 추가 전향적 대규모 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: The Animal Trauma Triage Score outperforms the VetCOT score in cats with high-rise syndrome.
papers.authors: Alemany A, Girol-Piner AM, Herrería-Bustillo V
papers.abstract: To evaluate the prognostic utility of the canine-derived Veterinary Committee on Trauma score in cats suffering from high-rise syndrome and to compare it with the Animal Trauma Triage Score. To date, no trauma score has been developed exclusively from feline-derived data, and existing systems are adaptations or validations of scores originally created for other or mixed species. Retrospective observational study of 60 cats with high-rise syndrome. Recorded variables on admission were age, breed, sex, weight, body condition score, height of fall, clinicopathological variables, Animal Trauma Triage Score and Veterinary Committee on Trauma score. Mortality and length of hospital stay were also recorded. Univariate and multivariate statistical analyses as well as receiver operating characteristic curves were used to compare the different variables. Sixty cats were included. Eight cats (13%) did not survive to discharge. The receiver operating characteristic curves showed that the Animal Trauma Triage Score predicted mortality significantly better (AUC = 0.85, P < .001, 95% CI 0.76 to 0.95) than the Veterinary Committee on Trauma score (AUC = 0.709, P = .038, 95% CI 0.51 to 0.91). Requirement for vasopressor therapy (P = .008, OR 0.10, 95% CI 0.02 to 0.56), higher height of fall (P < .005, OR 3.69, 95% CI 1.49 to 9.10), serum lactate (P = .013, OR 1.57, 95% CI 1.09 to 2.25) and the Animal Trauma Triage Score (P = .006, OR 1.90, 95% CI 1.20 to 3.00) were associated with a worse outcome. In cats with high-rise syndrome, the Animal Trauma Triage Score demonstrates significantly superior prognostic performance compared with the canine-derived Veterinary Committee on Trauma score. Species-specific physiological differences may influence the applicability of trauma scoring systems in cats, supporting the need for further feline-specific validation of trauma scoring systems.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 고층낙상증후군에서 Animal Trauma Triage Score(ATTS)가 개에서 유래한 Veterinary Committee on Trauma(VetCOT) score보다 사망률 예측에 유의하게 우수한 성능을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 고층낙상증후군 고양이 60마리의 후향적 관찰연구; 사망률 13%(8/60)이며, ATTS의 AUC 0.85(P<.001, 95% CI 0.76-0.95) vs VetCOT score AUC 0.709(P=.038, 95% CI 0.51-0.91); 혈관수축제 필요(OR 0.10, P=.008), 낙상높이 증가(OR 3.69, P<.005), 혈청 lactate 상승(OR 1.57, P=.013), ATTS 상승(OR 1.90, P=.006)이 나쁜 예후와 연관.
[임상 적용·한계] 고층낙상증후군 고양이의 초기 중증도 평가 및 예후 판정에 ATTS 사용을 권고하며, 품종 특이적 생리차이를 고려한 고양이 전용 trauma scoring system 개발의 필요성을 시사하나 단일기관 소규모 연구의 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Accuracy and agreement of a wearable device for heart rate and oxygen saturation monitoring in awake dogs.
papers.authors: Melek Ş, Orhun ÖT, Şenocak MG, Arslan T
papers.abstract: The present study evaluated the accuracy and agreement of heart rate and peripheral oxygen saturation measurements obtained using the Owlet Smart Sock in awake dogs with low activity levels, using a veterinary patient monitor as the reference method. Clinically healthy dogs underwent simultaneous heart rate and peripheral oxygen saturation measurements with Owlet Smart Sock and a veterinary patient monitor during routine preoperative evaluation. Method comparison was performed using Pearson correlation analysis and Bland-Altman agreement analysis. Clinical equivalence was assessed using the two one-sided tests procedure with predefined equivalence margins of ±10 bpm for heart rate and ±3% for peripheral oxygen saturation. A total of 237 paired measurements were analysed. Heart rate measurements obtained with Owlet Smart Sock showed a strong positive linear relationship between the two methods (r = 0.934, P < .001). Bland-Altman analysis demonstrated a mean bias of -0.46 bpm, with narrow limits of agreement. Two one-sided tests analysis indicated that the mean difference in heart rate measurements lay within the predefined equivalence margin (P < .001). In contrast, peripheral oxygen saturation measurements showed no significant correlation between devices (r = 0.038, P = .562), and Bland-Altman analysis revealed considerable variability at the individual measurement level. The Owlet Smart Sock demonstrated acceptable agreement with the reference monitor for heart rate measurement in awake dogs with low activity levels, whereas peripheral oxygen saturation measurements showed limited agreement and should be interpreted with caution in clinical practice.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Owlet Smart Sock은 저활동 각성 개에서 심박수 측정의 임상적 동등성을 보였으나, 말초산소포화도 측정은 제한적인 일치도를 보여 임상 해석에 주의가 필요하다.
[방법·수치] 임상적으로 건강한 개 237쌍의 동시 측정 비교 연구이며, 심박수는 강한 양의 상관관계(r=0.934, P<0.001)와 평균편향 -0.46 bpm을 나타냈고 등가성 검증에서 P<0.001로 통과했다; 말초산소포화도는 상관관계 없었다(r=0.038, P=0.562).
[임상 적용·한계] Owlet Smart Sock은 저활동 각성 개의 심박수 모니터링용 웨어러블로 활용 가능하지만, 산소포화도는 신뢰할 수 없으므로 중환자 모니터링에서는 표준 환자모니터와 병행하고 단독 의존은 피해야 한다.

papers.title: Transient marked reactive lymphocytosis in a puppy suspected to be secondary to recent vaccination.
papers.authors: Ruel J, Ternisien T, Conversy B, Bedard C, Lemieux C
papers.abstract: A 3-month-old male Bernese Mountain dog was presented with a 10-day history of vomiting, vocalisation and abdominal discomfort following vaccination. Physical examination revealed subtle peripheral lymphadenopathy. Haematological testing revealed borderline anaemia, thrombocytopenia and moderate lymphocytosis with a high proportion of reactive or atypical lymphocytes. Cytology of the spleen and lymph nodes showed lymphoid hyperplasia, and PCR for antigen receptor rearrangement confirmed a polyclonal lymphocyte population with no evidence of clonal rearrangements of immunoglobulin or T-cell receptor genes. No treatment was initiated. Follow-up testing demonstrated spontaneous resolution of haematological abnormalities and normalisation of cytology within 30 days. Although causality cannot be established, a transient antigenic stimulation temporally associated with recent vaccination was considered among the possible explanations. This report highlights the importance of recognising benign reactive lymphocytosis that may mimic lymphoproliferative disease in young dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 최근 예방접종 후 발생한 일시적인 반응성 림프구증가증은 림프증식질환과 유사하게 나타날 수 있지만 자발적으로 해결되는 양성 질환이다.
[방법·수치] 3개월령 버니즈 마운틴 독 1례, 예방접종 10일 후 구토·복부불편감·말초 림프절병증 발생, 혈액검사에서 경계성 빈혈·혈소판감소증·중등도 림프구증가증(반응성/비정형 림프구 비율 높음) 확인, 비장·림프절 세포학 검사에서 림프양 과형성 소견, PCR 검사에서 다클론성 림프구(면역글로불린·T세포수용체 유전자 클론 배열 없음) 확인, 30일 내 혈액학적 이상 및 세포학적 소견 완전 정상화.
[임상 적용·한계] 접종 후 일시적 림프구증가증은 치료 없이도 자발 해결되므로 불필요한 항암 치료를 피하기 위해 인식이 중요하며, 본 증례는 단일 사례 보고로 접종과의 인과관계 미확립, 소규모 증례이다.

papers.title: Evaluation of point-of-care versus laboratory antiglobulin-enhanced major crossmatch testing in cats.
papers.authors: Blois SL, Collier AJ, Sanz S, Chun I
papers.abstract: It is recommended that all cats, regardless of transfusion history, undergo major crossmatch prior to blood product administration to decrease the likelihood of immunological transfusion reactions. A reliable and user-friendly point-of-care crossmatch test would help make crossmatch testing more accessible. The primary objective of this study was to assess agreement between two antiglobulin-enhanced major crossmatch test methods, a laboratory-based tube crossmatch method and a point-of-care gel column crossmatch method, in cats in need of blood transfusion. Cats that had the potential to require blood transfusion were prospectively recruited. Each cat underwent major crossmatch using two methods concurrently: a laboratory-based tube crossmatch method performed by a reference laboratory, and a gel column crossmatch method performed in the clinic by a clinician and interpreted using guidelines supplied by the manufacturer. A total of 95 unique donor-recipient pairings were evaluated with both major crossmatch methods. Of the 95 pairings, 21 were incompatible using the laboratory-based tube crossmatch test while 18 were incompatible on the gel column crossmatch test; 13 pairings were incompatible on both methods. Kappa agreement between the laboratory-based tube crossmatch and gel column crossmatch methods was 0.581 (95% confidence interval: 0.378 to 0.785), showing significant agreement. The overall percent agreement between the tests was 86.3%; positive percent agreement was 93.2%, while negative percent agreement was 61.9%. The commercial antiglobulin-enhanced, point-of-care gel major crossmatch test had moderate agreement with the antiglobulin-enhanced tube crossmatch performed at a reference laboratory. Inclusion of larger numbers of incompatible pairings would help further evaluate the agreement between the two test methods.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 혈액수혈 전 적용하는 포인트오브케어 젤 칼럼 교혈검사는 기준 실험실의 튜브 교혈검사와 중등도의 일치를 보였으며, 임상 현장에서의 접근성을 개선할 수 있는 대안이 될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 수혈이 필요할 가능성이 있는 고양이 95쌍의 공여자-수혜자 혈액을 대상으로 튜브 교혈검사와 젤 칼럼 교혈검사를 동시에 수행했다. 카파 일치도 0.581(95% 신뢰구간: 0.378~0.785), 전체 일치율 86.3%, 양성 일치율 93.2%, 음성 일치율 61.9%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 포인트오브케어 젤 칼럼 검사는 임상현장에서 직접 수행 가능하여 교혈검사의 접근성을 높일 수 있으나, 음성 일치율이 61.9%로 낮아 불일치 사례가 많아 추가 검증이 필요하고, 임상적 의미 있는 불일치 사례를 더 포함한 추후 연구가 권장된다.

papers.title: Effect of vertical distance between the heart base and the cuff on arterial blood pressure measurements using PetMAP in anaesthetised dogs.
papers.authors: McConomy R, Pinnok H, Adami C
papers.abstract: To evaluate how variations in limb positioning, when compared with standard position at the heart base, affect oscillometric arterial blood pressure measurements in 22 anaesthetised healthy dogs. The thoracic vertical depth was measured in each dog from the caudal angle of the scapula to the body of the sternum caudal to the olecranon, and 20% of this length was used as deviation from the heart base level, identified by the humerus greater tubercle, for the arterial blood pressure measurement above and below the heart base. Measurements were taken in the thoracic and pelvic limbs with the cuff aligned with the heart base, and with the cuff positioned above and below the heart base by the deviation, always with the dogs in dorsal recumbency. Both systolic (P = .02) and mean arterial blood pressure (P = .047) values were significantly increased when the thoracic limb was lowered compared to heart base. The absolute difference in mean arterial blood pressure between heart base and values measured below the heart base was 3.7 (3.0 to 8.3) mmHg and positively correlated with the dogs' body weight (P < .001). For systolic (P = .030), mean (P = .015) and diastolic arterial blood pressure (P = .025), values were significantly decreased when the pelvic limb was elevated compared to heart base. The absolute difference in mean arterial blood pressure between heart base and values above the heart base was 6.1 (1.6 to 10.6) mmHg. Deviations as little as 3 cm above or below the heart base resulted in mean arterial blood pressure misreadings of up to 6 mmHg, representing a clinically relevant discrepancy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 마취 중 진동식 혈압계(PetMAP)로 측정할 때 커프 위치가 심장 기저부로부터 수직으로 단 3cm 벗어나도 평균동맥혈압이 최대 6mmHg의 임상적으로 의미 있는 오차가 발생한다.
[방법·수치] 마취된 건강한 개 22마리를 대등척 자세에서 흉지와 골반지에 커프를 적용하여 심장 기저부, 기저부 위쪽, 기저부 아래쪽(각각 흉곽 깊이의 20%)에서 혈압을 측정했다. 흉지를 낮췄을 때 수축기혈압과 평균동맥혈압이 유의하게 증가했고(P=0.02, P=0.047), 골반지를 올렸을 때 수축기/평균/이완기혈압이 유의하게 감소했다(모두 P<0.03). 평균동맥혈압의 오차는 체중과 양의 상관관계를 보였다(P<0.001).
[임상 적용·한계] 마취 중 혈압 측정 시 커프를 반드시 심장 기저부(상완골 대결절 높이)에 정렬하여 위치 편차를 최소화해야 한다. 단일 기관의 소규모 연구로 다양한 품종과 임상 상황에서의 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Echocardiographic prevalence and attachment-site patterns of left ventricular bands in cats.
papers.authors: Van den Noortgate G, Zablotski Y, Wess G
papers.abstract: The aim of the present study was to determine the echocardiographic prevalence and attachment-site patterns of left ventricular bands (LVBs) in cats and assess whether LVB counts differed by sex, sedation status, or echocardiographic group. In this prospective observational study, 200 cats undergoing complete transthoracic echocardiographic examination were evaluated for the presence, number, and attachment-site patterns of LVBs. LVBs were defined as discrete intracavitary linear structures connecting two myocardial structures within the left ventricle without insertion into the mitral valve leaflets. Each visible connection was classified according to predefined attachment-site categories. For the phenotype comparison, cats with normal left ventricular wall thickness or focal insertion-site thickening (n = 89) were compared with cats with a hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) phenotype (n = 86). A total of 884 LVBs were identified. At least one LVB was detected in 199/200 cats, yielding an echocardiographic prevalence of 99.5%. The median number was four LVBs per cat (range 0-10). The most frequently observed attachment patterns involved the interventricular septum and papillary muscle or accessory papillary muscle-like structures. Overall, 51.9% of LVBs had at least one septal attachment, and 94.3% involved a papillary muscle or accessory papillary muscle-like structure. LVB counts did not differ by sex (P = 0.47), sedation status (P = 0.26), or between the combined normal/focal insertion-site thickening group and HCM phenotype group (P = 0.98). LVBs were identified in nearly all cats examined and represent a common echocardiographic finding. Most involved septal and papillary muscle-related attachment sites. Sex and sedation status were not significantly associated with LVB number, and no significant difference was identified between the normal/focal insertion-site thickening and HCM phenotype groups.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 좌심실밴드(LVB)는 심초음파 검사에서 거의 모든 고양이(99.5%)에서 관찰되는 매우 흔한 소견으로, 중격 및 유두근 부착이 가장 흔한 부착 패턴이다.
[방법·수치] 200마리의 고양이를 대상으로 한 전향적 관찰 연구; 199/200마리에서 최소 1개 이상의 LVB 검출(99.5% 유병률), 중앙값 4개/마리(범위 0-10개), 884개의 LVB 총 확인; LVB 개수는 성별(P=0.47), 진정 상태(P=0.26), 정상/비후성심근증 집단 간(P=0.98)에서 유의미한 차이 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 심초음파 검사에서 LVB를 인식하고 분류하기 위한 기준을 제공하며, 정상 소견으로 간주해야 함; 다만 비정상적으로 두꺼운 밴드나 조밀한 네트워크가 심기능에 영향을 미치는지 여부는 미결정 상태이고, 초음파상 보이는 연결이 완전한 해부학적 밴드에 정확히 대응하는지 미확인.

papers.title: Surgical management of type I atresia ani using Heineke-Mikulicz-like anoplasty: A case series of 11 kittens (2022-2025).
papers.authors: Berlemont L, Bondonny L, Massinon J, Chanoit G, Taroni M
papers.abstract: Type I atresia ani is rare in cats, and there is limited published data on the surgical management and prognosis of this condition in feline patients. Appropriate surgical planning requires thorough examination of the rectum, anus, and perineum to accurately diagnose atresia ani and rule out the presence of a rectovaginal or rectourethral fistula. Type I atresia may be treated with balloon dilatation or bougienage but there may be recurrence, and several procedures may be required before complete resolution of the stenosis. The objective of this retrospective case series was to describe, for the first time, the clinical application and postoperative outcomes of a Heineke-Mikulicz-like anoplasty technique in kittens with type I atresia ani. The surgical technique was adapted from the Heineke-Mikulicz anoplasty technique described in humans. In total, 11 cats with a mean age of 12.3 weeks (range 8-20) were included in this study. Heineke-Mikulicz-like anoplasty was performed in all cases without intraoperative complications. Major postoperative complications occurred in 1/11 (9%) case, with wound dehiscence 2 days after surgery. However, complete healing was achieved after revision surgery. At long-term follow-up over 13.6 months (range 6-24), no recurrence was reported in 11/11 (100%) cases. Although permanent fecal incontinence was reported in 1/11 (9%) cat, long-term outcomes were excellent in 9/11 (81%) cats. These data suggest that Heineke-Mikulicz-like anoplasty is appropriate for the management of type I atresia ani in cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Heineke-Mikulicz 유사 항문성형술은 고양이의 제1형 항문폐쇄증 관리에 효과적이며, 100% 재발 없음을 보였고 81%의 고양이에서 장기 예후가 우수했다.
[방법·수치] 11마리 새끼고양이(평균 나이 12.3주, 범위 8-20주)를 대상으로 한 후향적 증례 모음연구로, Heineke-Mikulicz 유사 항문성형술을 시행했다. 수술 중 합병증 없었고, 술후 주요 합병증 1례(9%, 술후 2일 상처 개열), 장기 추적관찰 13.6개월(6-24개월) 결과 재발 0례(0%), 영구적 대변실금 1례(9%), 우수한 예후 9례(81%)였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 본 술식은 고양이 제1형 항문폐쇄증의 일차 치료법으로 적용 가능하며 풍선확장이나 부지니에주(bougienage) 반복보다 재발률이 낮다. 단일 기관의 소규모 증례 모음 연구이고 더 큰 규모의 비교 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Pull-out strength of cannulated compression headless screws and cortical screws in the feline sacrum.
papers.authors: Kornmayer M, Klement J, Zablotski Y, Thorwächter C, Wieser J
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to compare the pull-out strength of cannulated compression headless screws (CCHSs) of two different lengths with that of cortical screws in the feline sacrum.
