In this experimental study, 30 cadavers of adult domestic shorthair cats were randomly assigned to three groups: single 2.4 mm cortical screws engaging 60% of the sacral width (CS 60, n = 10), 2.5 mm CCHSs engaging 60% of the sacral width (CCHSs 60, n = 10), and 2.5 mm CCHSs engaging 40% of the sacral width (CCHS 40, n = 10). Screws were inserted into feline sacra and tested for pull-out strength using a universal testing machine at a constant displacement rate of 0.2 mm/s up to 20 mm. Peak pull-out force (PPF), displacement at PPF, and stiffness were calculated from the load-displacement curves and compared among groups using Fisher's ANOVA and the Welch test. Post-hoc pairwise comparisons were performed using Student's t-tests and the Games-Howell test. Statistical significance was set at P ⩽0.05. Pairwise comparison of PPF showed significant differences between the CS 60 and CCHS 60 groups (P = 0.05) and between the CS 60 and CCHS 40 groups (P = 0.05). No significant difference was detected between the CCHS 60 and CCHS 40 groups (P = 0.98). For displacement at PPF and stiffness, no significant differences were identified in the pairwise comparison. Fully threaded cortical screws provide greater holding strength than partially threaded CCHSs in cadaveric feline sacra. In addition, a single short CCHS offers holding strength comparable to that of a CCHS of the conventionally recommended length.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 천골에서 완전나선형 피질골나사(cortical screw)가 부분나선형 압축성 무두부나사(CCHS)보다 더 큰 뽑아내기강도를 제공하며, 짧은 CCHS 1개도 표준 길이 CCHS와 비슷한 고정강도를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 성묘 30마리 시체를 3개 군으로 나누어(각 10마리) 천골에 나사를 삽입하고 만능시험기로 뽑아내기강도를 측정했다. 최대뽑아내기력(PPF)에서 CS 60 vs CCHS 60 (P=0.05), CS 60 vs CCHS 40 (P=0.05)에서 유의한 차이가 있었고, CCHS 60 vs CCHS 40 (P=0.98)에서는 차이가 없었다. 변위와 강성에서는 모든 군 간 유의한 차이가 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 척추 고정 수술에서 천골 나사 선택 시 더 강한 고정력이 필요하면 완전나선형 피질골나사를 사용하고, 짧은 나사로도 충분한 경우 단일 짧은 CCHS를 고려할 수 있다. 단일 기관 시체 실험으로 임상 적용에는 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Radiographic findings of the femora and tibiae in cats affected by patella fracture and dental anomaly syndrome.
papers.authors: Boulton S, Hernon T, Dancer S, Dirrig H, Major AC
papers.abstract: The objective of the study was to describe radiographic skeletal changes in cats affected by patella fracture and dental anomaly syndrome (PADS), with particular focus on the femora and tibiae, including bone density alterations, evidence of stress fractures and femoral morphology. Cats were retrospectively selected from a database of PADS-affected cats. Radiographs were independently evaluated by five veterinary radiologists and three orthopaedic surgeons for cortical thickening, medullary opacity changes, the presence of osteopetrosis, degenerative joint disease and additional fractures, and subjective assessment of the femoral shape. A total of 126 cats met the inclusion criteria. All had patellar fractures and 28 (22.2%) had additional fractures, most commonly involving the proximal tibia in 17 (13.5%) cases, proximal fibula in 15 (11.9%) cases and the pelvis. Four cats showed an incomplete radiolucent line in the cranioproximal tibia with surrounding sclerosis, consistent with developing stress fractures. Medullary opacity changes in the femora and/or tibiae were present in 11/126 (8.7%) cats, more often patchy than diffuse in appearance. In five (4.0%) cases, a generalised increase in bone opacity compatible with osteopetrosis was identified. Femoral shape was assessed in 74 cats, with 26 (35%) having a normal morphology, and seven (9.5%) and two (2.7%) having a stovepipe or champagne-fluted morphology, respectively. Consensus was not reached in 39 (52.7%) cases. Most PADS-affected femora and tibiae appeared radiographically normal; however, a subset of cats demonstrated radiographic features of osteopetrosis, altered femoral morphology and proximal tibial fissure lines suggestive of early stress fractures.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 슬개골 골절 및 치아 이상 증후군(PADS) 고양이에서 대부분의 대퇴골과 경골은 방사선학적으로 정상이지만, 일부 개체에서 골밀도 증가, 대퇴골 형태 변화, 근위 경골 스트레스 골절 징후 등의 구조적 변화가 나타나 골절 소인에 영향을 미칠 수 있다. [방법·수치] 126마리 PADS 고양이를 대상으로 후향적 방사선 영상 검토; 모든 개체가 슬개골 골절 보유, 28마리(22.2%)에서 추가 골절 발생(근위 경골 17마리 13.5%, 근위 비골 15마리 11.9%), 4마리에서 경골 스트레스 골절 징후, 11마리(8.7%)에서 골수강 불투명도 변화, 5마리(4.0%)에서 골경화증 소견, 74마리 중 26마리(35%)에서 정상 대퇴골 형태, 7마리(9.5%)와 2마리(2.7%)에서 각각 파이프형 및 샴페인병 형태. [임상 적용·한계] 미묘한 방사선학적 특징 인식이 PADS 조기 진단 및 적절한 임상 관리에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 후향적 단일기관 연구이고 대퇴골 형태 평가 대상이 제한적이며 판독자 간 합의도달 실패율이 높아(52.7%) 임상 적용 시 주의가 필요하다.

papers.title: Agreement between point-of-care and external reference laboratory RT-qPCR testing for feline coronavirus in cats with suspected feline infectious peritonitis.
papers.authors: Knies M, Hofman N, Jackson-Onis J, Broens EM, Teske E
papers.abstract: The aim of the present study was to evaluate the agreement of a commercially available point-of-care (POC) feline coronavirus (FCoV) quantitative RT-PCR (RT-qPCR) assay and external laboratories' RT-qPCR testing in cats with effusive and non-effusive feline infectious peritonitis (FIP), and in cats with other diseases presenting with similar clinical signs. Client-owned cats suspected of having FIP were enrolled with owner consent. Effusions and ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspirates (FNAs) from the liver, spleen or mesenteric lymph nodes were collected, split and analysed using both a POC RT-qPCR and an external laboratory RT-qPCR. FIP was diagnosed based on American Association of Feline Practitioners/EveryCat guidelines. Sensitivity and negative predictive values were calculated, agreement assessed with Cohen's kappa, paired differences tested with McNemar's test and correlation of crossing point (Cp) values analysed using Pearson's coefficient and paired t-tests. A total of 100 cats were included (effusions n = 62, FNAs n = 38). Overall agreement between assays was substantial (κ = 0.73), with near-perfect concordance for effusions (κ = 0.81) and lower agreement for FNAs (κ = 0.61). Relative sensitivity was highest in effusions (98.1% POC, 92.3% external) and lower in FNAs (63.3-64.5%), with negative predictive values showing similar trends. Cp values were moderately correlated between assays, with minor mean differences (~1 cycle). The POC FCoV RT-qPCR assay is a practical and reliable tool and shows very good agreement with external reference laboratory RT-qPCR testing. FNAs remain useful when effusions are unavailable but carry a higher risk of false negatives, likely due to low viral loads and heterogeneous distribution. POC care testing offers rapid turnaround, supporting timely clinical decision-making, but results must be interpreted alongside clinical presentation and other diagnostics.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 포인트오브케어(POC) FCoV RT-qPCR 검사는 외부 참조 실험실의 RT-qPCR 검사와 실질적으로 좋은 일치도(κ=0.73)를 보이며, 특히 삼출액에서 거의 완벽한 일치(κ=0.81)를 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 100마리 고양이(삼출액 n=62, 세침흡인 n=38)를 대상으로 두 가지 RT-qPCR 방법을 비교했으며, 삼출액의 민감도는 POC 98.1%, 외부 92.3%, 세침흡인은 63.3-64.5%였고, Cp값은 약 1 사이클의 작은 평균 차이를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] POC 검사는 빠른 결과 제공으로 임상 의사결정을 신속히 지원하며 삼출액이 있을 때 특히 유용하지만, 세침흡인에서는 낮은 바이러스 양과 불균등한 분포로 인해 위음성 위험이 높으므로 임상 소견 및 다른 진단 검사와 함께 해석해야 한다.

papers.title: Renal health in cats with feline infectious peritonitis treated with GS-441524: Baseline findings and longitudinal effects.
papers.authors: de Witt Curtius CC, Meli ML, Crespo Bouzon A, Wenk J, Stachowski JM
papers.abstract: The aim of the present study was to assess renal health in cats with feline infectious peritonitis (FIP) undergoing antiviral treatment. GS-441524 is effective against FIP but its potential renal toxicity remains debated. Cats with confirmed FIP (n = 80) receiving oral GS-441524 for 42 days were assessed before (day 1; D1), during (D7, D42) and after treatment (D84, D183). Assessments included urine specific gravity (USG), urine protein:creatinine (UPC) ratio, urinary cystatin B (uCysB), urine protein electrophoresis, serum creatinine, urea and symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA). The term potential renal dysfunction was used for cats fulfilling the following criteria: creatinine ⩾140 µmol/l or SDMA ⩾18 µg/dl and USG <1.035. Serum amyloid A (SAA) and alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP) were assessed in serum, feline coronavirus (FCoV) RNA in blood and urine (D1-D42). At baseline, 97.5% of cats had creatinine concentrations <140 µmol/l; by D183, 23.8% exceeded this threshold (D1-D183: PD <0.0001). Potential renal dysfunction criteria were met in 2.5% of cats at baseline and 8.8% at D183. In contrast, uCysB was increased in 83.8% of cats at D1 and declined during treatment (D1-D183: PD <0.0001). Cats with uCysB >100 ng/ml had higher UPC values (PMWU <0.0001). Most cats had elevated AGP and SAA at baseline, which normalised during treatment (D1-D42: PD <0.0001). Proteinuria (UPC >0.2) was present in 91.3% on D1 and 3.8% on D183; urine protein electrophoresis at D1 revealed predominantly tubular and mixed patterns. Urine was more frequently FCoV RNA-positive than blood on D1 (68.8% vs 61.3%), but not on D7 (16.3% vs 45.0%). Treatment reversed FIP-associated renal abnormalities and inflammation observed at baseline. A small subset of cats met criteria compatible with potential renal dysfunction during the study.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] GS-441524로 치료받은 고양이 전염성 복막염(FIP) 환자에서 기저 신장 이상(단백뇨 91.3%, 증가된 요 시스타틴B 83.8%)은 치료 중 호전되었으나, 일부 고양이에서 혈청 크레아티닌 상승(D1 대비 D183에서 23.8%로 증가, P<0.0001)이 관찰되었다.
[방법·수치] FIP 확진 고양이 80마리를 대상으로 경구 GS-441524 42일 치료 전후(D1, D7, D42, D84, D183)에 요비중, 요단백-크레아티닌 비율, 혈청 크레아티닌, 대칭 디메틸아르기닌(SDMA), 요 시스타틴B, 염증지표(SAA, AGP)를 측정했다. 혈청 크레아티닌 ≥140 μmol/l 또는 SDMA ≥18 μg/dl + 요비중 <1.035를 잠재적 신장 기능 부전 판정 기준으로 적용했으며, 기저선에서 2.5%에서 D183에 8.8%로 증가했다.
[임상 적용·한계] FIP 치료 중 신장 기능을 모니터링할 때 혈청 크레아티닌 단독보다 SDMA, 요 시스타틴B, 요단백을 함께 평가해야 한다. 다만 상승된 크레아티닌이 약물의 직접 신독성인지 FIP의 지연된 신장 손상인지 불명확하므로, 항균제 사용 원칙에 따라 최단 유효 치료 기간으로 제한할 것을 권장한다.

papers.title: Prevalence and clinical relevance of hypocobalaminaemia and hypercobalaminaemia in cats.
papers.authors: Casas C, Dye C
papers.abstract: The aim of the present study was to investigate the prevalence of hypo- and hypercobalaminaemia in a cohort of cats with diverse disease pathologies and to assess associations with signalment and disease characteristics. Residual blood from cats presented to a large veterinary referral hospital during a 24-month period was used for serum B12 quantification. All cats requiring blood collection as part of diagnostic investigations were eligible for inclusion regardless of clinical presentation. Serum B12 concentration was assessed according to signalment, body weight, body condition score, primary affected body system and type of disease pathology as derived from the clinical notes. A total of 229 cats were enrolled: 128 male (119 neutered, 9 entire) and 101 female (88 neutered, 13 entire). Of these, 176 were domestic shorthair or longhair, and 53 were purebred. The median age was 9.9 years and median body weight 4.1 kg. Of the 229 cats, 80 (34.9%) had high serum B12, 86 (37.6%) had normal, 18 (7.9%) had borderline and 45 (19.7%) had low serum B12. Median serum B12 concentration was higher in cats aged <8.0 years than ⩾8.0 years, and there was a weak but significant negative correlation between age and serum B12. Median serum B12 concentration was lower in cats weighing <3.0 kg than in those ⩾3.0 kg, and a weak but significant positive correlation was found between body weight and serum B12 concentration. No associations were found between serum B12 and sex, breed, body condition score, affected body system or pathology type. Vitamin B12 aberrations were common in this cohort of cats, with approximately one-third and one-fifth having abnormally high and low serum concentrations, respectively. Serum vitamin B12 concentration declined with advancing age, and hypocobalaminaemia was more prevalent in cats with body weights <3.0 kg.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 비타민 B12 이상(고농도 또는 저농도)이 흔하며, 약 35%는 고코발라민혈증, 20%는 저코발라민혈증을 보였고, 특정 질환과의 연관성은 규명되지 않음.
[방법·수치] 24개월간 대형 2차 진료 병원 내원 고양이 229마리(수컷 128마리, 암컷 101마리, 중앙 나이 9.9년, 중앙 체중 4.1kg)를 대상으로 혈청 B12 농도 측정; 고농도 34.9%, 정상 37.6%, 경계역 7.9%, 저농도 19.7%; 나이 8세 이상에서 B12 농도 감소(음의 상관), 체중 3.0kg 미만에서 B12 농도 저하(양의 상관).
[임상 적용·한계] 고령 고양이 및 저체중(3.0kg 미만) 고양이에서 저코발라민혈증 모니터링 고려; 성별, 품종, 체형지수, 이환 장기계, 질병 유형과는 연관성 없음; 단일 2차 기관의 횡단 연구로 인과관계 규명 부족 및 일반화의 한계.

papers.title: Computed Tomography and Magnetic Resonance Imaging Findings in Cats With Occipitoatlantoaxial Malformation: A Retrospective Study of 25 Cases.
papers.authors: Aoki K, Murakami M
papers.abstract: Occipitoatlantoaxial malformation (OAAM) is a congenital malformation of the craniocervical junction that is incompletely characterized in cats. This retrospective single-center study characterized CT and MRI findings in 25 cats with OAAM, operationally defined as an osseous malformation involving one or more structures of the occipital bone, atlas, or axis identified on CT. CT was performed in all 25 cats and MRI in 24. Neurologic signs were present in 24/25 cats. Abnormal gait was present in 23 cats, including ataxia in 13/23 (56.5%) and paresis in 10/23 (43.5%); 8/10 paretic cats had tetraparesis, and 2/10 had left hemiparesis. CT findings included dens abnormalities (17/25), C1 hypoplasia (14/25), atlanto-occipital articulation abnormalities (13/25), occipital malformations (11/25), and osseous spinal cord compression (17/25). MRI demonstrated spinal cord compression in 15/24 cats and intramedullary T2 hyperintensity in 14/24; all intramedullary lesions involved C2. Seven prespecified imaging findings were compared between 9 cats with acute/subacute signs and 15 with chronic signs using two-sided Fisher's exact tests, conditional odds ratios, and two-sided 95% exact conditional confidence intervals. The analyses were exploratory; p-values were not adjusted for multiple comparisons, and multivariable modeling was not performed. None met the prespecified significance threshold, and wide confidence intervals indicated limited precision. Follow-up was available for 21 cats; excluding 2 unrelated deaths, neurologic signs resolved in 14/19 cats, persisted in 4, and progressed in 1. Feline OAAM comprised heterogeneous combinations of congenital osseous malformations. CT characterized osseous abnormalities, whereas MRI provided complementary information regarding spinal cord compression and intramedullary abnormalities.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 후두-환추-축추 기형(OAAM)은 여러 구조의 선천성 골성형 이상을 포함하는 이질적 질환이며, CT는 골성형 이상을 특징화하고 MRI는 척수압박과 척수내 이상을 보여주는 보완적 정보를 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 25마리 고양이에 대한 후향적 단일기관 연구로 모두 CT, 24마리가 MRI 검사를 받았다. 신경학적 징후는 24/25마리에서 나타났으며, 비정상 보행이 23마리에서 관찰되었다(운동실조 13/23마리, 56.5%; 운동마비 10/23마리, 43.5%). CT에서 치돌기 이상(17/25), C1 저형성증(14/25), 환후두 관절 이상(13/25), 척수 압박(17/25)이 확인되었고, MRI에서 척수압박(15/24)과 T2 고신호강도(14/24)가 나타났다.
[임상 적용·한계] 급성/아급성 증상군 9마리와 만성 증상군 15마리의 비교에서 통계적 유의성을 보이는 영상 소견이 없었으며, 신뢰구간이 넓어 정밀도가 제한적이다. 21마리 추적 관찰에서 신경학적 징후가 14/19마리에서 해소되었다. 본 연구는 소규모 단일기관 후향적 연구이며 다중비교에 대한 p값 보정이 없고 다변량 분석을 시행하지 않아 탐색적 성질이 강하다.

papers.title: Intraoperative Extracorporeal Irradiation of Craniotomy Bone Flap for Skull Reconstruction Following Brain Meningioma Resection in a Cat.
papers.authors: Pasierbińska M, Morris J, Chalmers AJ, Kaczmarska A, Gutierrez-Quintana R
papers.abstract: A 6-year-old male neutered domestic shorthair cat underwent rostro-tentorial biparietal craniotomy for meningioma resection. The bone flap was removed under sterile conditions and subjected to extracorporeal irradiation with 100 Gy before reimplantation using nonabsorbable sutures. Postoperative MRI confirmed gross total resection of the mass. Seven-month follow-up with CT showed no evidence of tumor recurrence and successful integration of the bone flap. To our knowledge, this is the first report of intraoperative extracorporeal irradiation of a craniotomy flap in veterinary medicine and suggests its potential as a viable alternative for skull reconstruction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 뇌수막종 제거 후 두개골 재건술에서 술중 두개골편의 체외 조사(100 Gy)는 종양 재발 방지와 골편 통합을 모두 달성할 수 있는 실행 가능한 방법이다.
[방법·수치] 6세 수컷 단모종 고양이에서 뇌수막종 제거를 위해 양쪽 두정부 두개절개술 시행, 무균 상태에서 제거한 골편을 100 Gy 조사 후 흡수되지 않는 봉합사로 재식립, 7개월 추적 검사 수행.
[임상 적용·한계] 수의학에서 처음으로 보고된 증례로서 두개골 재건의 새로운 대안을 제시하나, 단일 증례 보고이고 장기 추적 데이터 및 다른 종에서의 효과 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Enhancement of Lung Parenchyma and Pulmonary Lobar Vessels Following Iodinated Contrast Injection in Healthy Cats Undergoing Thoracic Computed Tomography.
papers.authors: Giron C, Benedetti IC, Juette T, Masseau I
papers.abstract: The pulmonary vasculature comprises large-, medium-, and small-caliber arteries and veins. Small pulmonary vessels (<20-25 µm), expected to enhance following iodinated contrast administration, may contribute to lung parenchymal enhancement during postcontrast computed tomography (CT) acquisition. The primary objective was to evaluate lung parenchymal enhancement and pulmonary vessel enhancement and size in anesthetized healthy cats during postcontrast CT acquisition. Phase 1 compared automated versus manual contrast injection in three cats. Phase 2 compared three maintenance anesthetic protocols (alfaxalone, isoflurane, alfaxalone-dexmedetomidine) in four cats. Linear mixed and generalized models with post hoc correction were used. Lung attenuation was not significantly different between the two injection methods (F value 0.23; CI: -0.43 to 0.28). Automated injection enabled simultaneous maximal enhancement of lung parenchyma and pulmonary arteries and veins immediately (T0) after contrast injection. There were no significant differences in global lung attenuation or in the size and attenuation of the pulmonary arteries and veins between the three anesthetic protocols (p > 0.25). Lung parenchymal enhancement was maximal at T0 for all anesthetic protocols, with increased attenuation compared with other time points (p ≤ 0.002). With alfaxalone and isoflurane, a dorsoventral lung attenuation gradient was maintained, but not with alfaxalone-dexmedetomidine. A caudocranial gradient was present for all anesthetic protocols. As with global lung enhancement, pulmonary arteries and veins showed maximal enhancement at T0 for all anesthetic protocols, with a significant increase in attenuation compared with other time points (p < 0.001). This study provides a basis for assessing lung parenchymal enhancement in healthy cats undergoing postcontrast thoracic CT.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 조영제 흉부 CT에서 자동 주입 방식이 폐 실질과 폐혈관의 동시 최대 강화를 즉시(T0) 달성하며, 마취 프로토콜(알팩살론, 이소플루란, 알팩살론-덱스메데토미딘)에 관계없이 폐 감쇠 패턴은 유사하게 나타난다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 마취 고양이 7마리 대상 2단계 연구(1단계: 자동 vs 수동 주입 비교 3마리, 2단계: 3가지 마취 프로토콜 비교 4마리); 자동 주입과 수동 주입 간 폐 감쇠 차이 없음(F값 0.23, CI: -0.43~0.28); 모든 마취 프로토콜에서 폐 실질과 폐동정맥 최대 강화는 T0에서 발생(p≤0.002, p<0.001); 알팩살론과 이소플루란에서는 등배측 폐 감쇠 경사 유지, 알팩살론-덱스메데토미딘에서는 유지 안 됨; 모든 프로토콜에서 미골두측 경사 현상.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 흉부 CT 조영 검사에서 자동 주입과 T0 시점의 이미징이 최적의 폐 실질과 혈관 강화를 제공하므로 폐 병변 평가에 유용하며, 소규모 단일기관 건강 고양이만 대상이고 임상 질환군 미포함이라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Ultrasound and CT Features of Isolated Gallbladder Torsion With a Suspected Congenital Anomaly in a Cat: An Imaging Diagnosis.
papers.authors: Moserová H, Dvořáková R, Lein F, Junášková M, Lorenzová J
papers.abstract: An 8-month-old domestic short-haired cat was presented to the emergency room with an episode of peracute vomiting and abdominal pain. Ultrasound and computed tomography (CT) examination revealed an abnormally positioned and distended gallbladder with a thickened gallbladder wall. A presumptive diagnosis of gallbladder torsion was made and subsequently confirmed during laparotomy. Although uncommon, gallbladder torsion should be considered a differential diagnosis in feline patients with clinical signs of abdominal pain and peracute vomiting.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 담낭염전은 드물지만 급성 구토와 복부통증을 보이는 고양이 환자에서 감별진단으로 반드시 고려해야 한다.
[방법·수치] 8개월령 국내 단모종 고양이 1례가 급성 구토 및 복부통증으로 응급실에 내원했으며, 초음파와 CT 검사에서 비정상적으로 위치한 확장된 담낭과 두꺼워진 담낭벽이 관찰되었고, 개복술로 담낭염전으로 확인되었다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 초음파와 CT는 담낭 위치 이상, 확장, 벽 비후를 통해 담낭염전을 진단하는 데 유용한 영상 검사법이다. 단일 증례 보고로서 고양이에서 담낭염전의 발생 빈도, 위험인자, 선천성 기형과의 연관성에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Age-Related Renal Hemodynamic Changes in Dogs: A Doppler Ultrasonographic Study.
papers.authors: García Álvarez F, Molina E, Pessina P, Cazzuli G
papers.abstract: The physiological effects of aging on renal hemodynamics in dogs are not yet well defined. This prospective analytical study aimed to evaluate renal aging using Doppler ultrasonography by comparing renal hemodynamic parameters between healthy young adult and healthy geriatric small-breed dogs. Fifty-eight healthy small-breed dogs (≤10 kg) were divided into two groups (young adult and geriatric) and underwent renal Doppler ultrasonography to compare renal hemodynamic parameters between groups. A total of 116 kidneys were evaluated. Age-related hemodynamic changes were identified. Geriatric dogs exhibited lower aortic peak systolic velocity (PSV) and main renal artery end-diastolic velocity, as well as higher intrarenal resistive and pulsatility indices, compared with young adults. In addition, a trend towards lower PSV and higher resistive index in the main renal arteries, along with a higher renal-to-aortic ratio, was observed in geriatric dogs. These findings may provide valuable complementary information during routine ultrasonographic evaluation, contributing to the early detection of renal vascular alterations, monitoring of disease progression, and assessment of therapeutic response in renal disorders. Furthermore, they may support future research into renal vascular physiology and pathology.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고령견에서 신동맥의 수축기 최고 속도는 낮아지고, 신내 저항지수와 박동성지수는 높아지는 연령 관련 신혈류역학 변화가 확인되었다.
[방법·수치] 소형견(≤10kg) 58마리를 청년층과 고령층으로 나누어 신동맥 도플러 초음파검사를 시행하였고, 총 116개 신장을 평가했다. 고령견은 청년견 대비 대동맥 수축기 최고 속도(PSV) 감소, 신동맥 말기 이완기 속도 감소, 신내 저항지수 및 박동성지수 증가를 보였으며, 신동맥 PSV 감소 경향과 저항지수 증가, 신장-대동맥 비율 증가가 관찰되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 도플러 초음파 검사 시 정상 고령견의 혈류역학 변화를 기준으로 활용하면 신혈관 이상의 조기 발견, 질병 진행 모니터링, 신장질환의 치료 반응 평가에 도움이 될 수 있다. 단일 소형견 품종의 소규모 연구이며 임상질환 동반 사례의 비교 평가가 부재하다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Imaging Features of Adrenal Glands Infiltration by Multicentric Lymphoma in Dogs and Cats.
papers.authors: Negro L, Pey P, Specchi S, Penninck D, Diana A
papers.abstract: Few case reports describe the imaging features of lymphoma involving the adrenal glands (AGs) in dogs and cats. This retrospective, descriptive, and multicentric study aimed to describe the ultrasound (US), computed tomography (CT), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings of confirmed lymphomatous AG infiltration in patients with multicentric lymphoma. The inclusion criteria required cytological or histological confirmation of AG lymphoma and at least one imaging study. Eleven patients were included. Abdominal US was available in 10/11 patients (90%), CT in 2/11 patients (18%), and MRI in 1/11 patient (9%). Six patients (6/11, 54%) (5 dogs and 1 cat) had a bilateral involvement of the AGs, whereas the rest (5/11 patients, 54%) (3 dogs and 2 cats) had a unilateral involvement. On US, the findings included unilateral or bilateral enlargement with a preserved shape, hypoechoic and heterogeneous parenchyma, ill-defined or well-defined margins of the AGs, increased echogenicity of the surrounding retroperitoneal fat, and retroperitoneal effusion. On CT, one patient (1/11, 9%) with bilateral involvement showed enlargement of the AGs with multiple hypoattenuating and hypoenhancing nodules, whereas another patient (1/11, 9%) with unilateral involvement showed a hypoattenuating, hypoenhancing nodule in a rounded, heterogeneously enhanced gland. MRI of one patient (1/11, 9%) revealed bilateral enlargement of the AGs with T2W iso/hyperintensity, T1W isointensity, STIR hyperintensity, and strong and heterogeneous enhancement. Detection of these imaging findings on US, CT, and MRI may support the suspicion of adrenal involvement in the case of multicentric lymphoma in both dogs and cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 다중심성 림프종에서 부신 침범은 초음파, CT, MRI에서 부신 비대, 저에코/저감쇠 병변, 이질성 강화, 후복막 지방 에코증가, 후복막액 등의 특징적 소견으로 진단을 지원할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 11례의 다중심성 림프종 환자(개 8례, 고양이 3례)를 대상으로 한 후향적 기술적 다기관 연구(초음파 10/11례 90%, CT 2/11례 18%, MRI 1/11례 9%)에서 양측 침범 6례(54%), 일측 침범 5례(54%)로 나타났다.
[임상 적용·한계] 다중심성 림paula프종 의심 환자에서 부신 비대와 이질성 강화 병변을 발견시 부신 침범을 의심하고 조직검사 고려가 필요하나, CT와 MRI 증례가 매우 제한적이고 단일기관 연구로 대표성이 부족하며 영상 소견만으로는 진단 확정이 불가능하다.

papers.title: Radiographic Comparison of Pulmonary Lobar Vasculature Dimensions in Medically Managed and Drug-Naive Dogs With Left Heart Failure Secondary to Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease.
papers.authors: Huguet E, Sleeper M, Robertson J, Berry C
papers.abstract: Myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD) is the most common acquired cause of left heart failure (LHF) in dogs, and radiographic identification of pulmonary venous enlargement is traditionally used to support the diagnosis of LHF. However, the absence of venous enlargement has been anecdotally observed after initiation of therapy. Therefore, we aimed to compare radiographic pulmonary vessel size in LHF patients with ongoing medical management ± receiving acute rescue therapy. Dogs with echocardiographically confirmed MMVD and radiographic cardiogenic pulmonary edema were retrospectively selected. Pulmonary lobar artery and vein widths were measured using standardized rib-to-vessel ratios: cranial vessels at the intersection with the fourth rib on lateral projections and caudal vessels at the ninth rib on ventrodorsal/dorsoventral projections. Pulmonary vein-to-artery (PV/PA) and vessel-to-rib ratios were calculated, with enlargement defined as >1.2 and small vessel size as <0.8, and treatment groups were compared using Welch-corrected t-tests. 200 radiographic studies from 163 dogs were reviewed. In all dogs, the veins measured larger than the arteries in all lung lobes. Chronically untreated dogs who received furosemide immediately before radiographs had no venous enlargement. All other groups had vascular asymmetry or venous enlargement in at least two lung lobes. All control dogs with reoccurrence of LHF had absence of venous enlargement after initiation of therapy. Pulmonary venous enlargement was most pronounced in the right caudal lung lobe. These findings indicate that dogs chronically managed for MMVD may decompensate into LHF without radiographic pulmonary venous enlargement and that furosemide administration prior to imaging can normalize vessel size.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 좌심부전(MMVD 이차성)에서 이뇨제 투여 직전 촬영한 흉부방사선 사진에서는 폐정맥 확대가 관찰되지 않을 수 있으며, 만성 치료 중인 개도 방사선학적 폐정맥 확대 없이 좌심부전으로 악화될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 심초음파로 확인된 MMVD와 방사선학적 폐부종을 가진 개 163마리의 200장 흉부방사선 사진을 후향적 분석; 폐엽 동맥과 정맥 너비를 늑골-혈관 비율로 측정(확대 기준: >1.2, 작은 혈관: <0.8); 모든 개에서 모든 폐엽의 정맥이 동맥보다 크게 측정되었으나, 이뇨제 투여 직전 촬영 개들은 정맥 확대 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] MMVD 환자의 방사선학적 평가 시 최근 이뇨제 투여 여부와 임상 상태를 함께 고려해야 하며, 정맥 확대 부재만으로 좌심부전을 배제할 수 없다; 후향적 연구이고 단일 기관 자료로 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Computed Tomographic Findings of Hepatic Rupture Associated With Amyloidosis in a Young Siamese Cat.
papers.authors: Jeong J, Chang J, Yu S, Lee S, Kim K
papers.abstract: A 3-year-old neutered male Siamese cat with chronic anorexia showed anemia and elevated liver enzyme levels. Ultrasonography disclosed multiple diffusely heterogeneous hepatic lesions and peritoneal effusion, which was identified as hemoabdomen upon fluid analysis. Computed tomography showed finger-like hypoattenuation extending from the left hepatic margin with focal margin loss in the delayed phase, suggesting hepatic rupture. Infiltrative hepatic diseases were considered, and amyloidosis was the top differential diagnosis given the patient's young age, breed predisposition, and suspected hepatic rupture. Blood oozing was confirmed via laparotomy, and Congo red staining established hepatic amyloidosis, though amyloid typing was not pursued.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 젊은 �이암 고양이에서 간 아밀로이드증으로 인한 간 파열이 발생했으며, 전산화단층촬영에서 지연 단계의 손가락 모양 저음영 소견과 국소적 간 경계 소실로 진단되었다. Congo red 염색으로 간 아밀로이드증이 확진되었다.
[방법·수치] 3세 중성화 �이암 수고양이 1례를 대상으로 초음파검사, 전산화단층촬영, 개복술, 조직검사를 수행했다. 초음파에서 미만성 이질 간병변과 복막액이 관찰되었으며, 액체 분석 결과 혈복강증으로 확인되었다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 간 파열을 동반한 젊은 고양이의 혈복강증에서 간 아밀로이드증을 감별진단으로 고려해야 하며, 전산화단층촬영이 진단에 도움이 될 수 있다. 단일 증례 보고로 일반화에 제한이 있으며, 아밀로이드 타입핑은 수행하지 않았다.

papers.title: Evaluation of Intracranial Lesions Using Deep Learning-Based Reconstruction in Canine Brain MRI: Comparison With Conventional Reconstruction on T2-Weighted and FLAIR Sequences.
papers.authors: Jin W, Na H, Lee SK, Choi H, Lee Y
papers.abstract: Obtaining high-resolution brain MRI in small animals is challenging due to the inherent trade-off between image quality and acquisition time. Deep learning-based reconstruction (DLR) has emerged as a solution to improve image quality without prolonging scan time; however, its clinical utility and potential risks, such as pseudolesions, remain insufficiently evaluated in veterinary patients. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of DLR on lesion assessment and image quality in canine brain MRI and to investigate potential limitations associated with its application. This retrospective study compared DLR with conventional reconstruction in 25 canine brain MRI examinations diagnosed with intracranial diseases. Transverse T2-weighted and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery sequences were reconstructed using both conventional and DLR methods. Quantitative analysis included signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and lesion edge sharpness. Two blinded radiologists assessed image quality, lesion conspicuity, artifacts, pseudolesions, and lesion masking. DLR images exhibited significantly higher SNR, CNR, and lesion edge sharpness than conventional images in both sequences (p < 0.05). DLR images also yielded significantly higher qualitative scores for image quality and lesion conspicuity (p < 0.05). Truncation artifact was significantly reduced, whereas motion and pulsation artifacts showed no improvement. No instances of pseudolesions or lesion masking were noted. DLR significantly improves image quality and lesion conspicuity in canine brain MRI and reduces truncation artifacts; however, it does not mitigate motion or pulsation interference. Collectively, these findings suggest that DLR has potential value for improving image quality and lesion visibility in canine brain MRI, whereas further studies are needed to determine its impact on diagnostic performance.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 딥러닝 기반 재구성(DLR)은 종래의 재구성 방법과 비교하여 개의 뇌 MRI에서 신호대잡음비, 대비대잡음비, 병변 가장자리 선예도를 유의하게 향상시키며, 절단 인공물을 감소시키고 의사 병변이나 병변 은폐 현상은 보이지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 대뇌내 질환 진단을 받은 개 25마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구이며, T2 강조 및 FLAIR 수열을 종래 재구성 및 DLR 방법으로 재구성하였다. DLR 이미지는 양쪽 수열 모두에서 유의하게 높은 SNR, CNR, 병변 가장자리 선예도를 나타냈으며(p<0.05), 이미지 질 및 병변 명확성에 대한 정성적 점수도 유의하게 높았다(p<0.05). 절단 인공물은 유의하게 감소했으나 움직임 및 맥동 인공물은 개선이 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] DLR은 개의 뇌 MRI에서 이미지 질과 병변 가시성을 개선하여 임상적 가치가 있지만, 종단면 절단 인공물만 감소시키고 움직임이나 맥동 간섭은 완화하지 못한다. 후향적 소규모 연구이며, 진단 성능에 대한 영향을 결정하기 위해 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Spleens With Disseminated Lymphoma Exhibit Higher Standardized Uptake Value Maximum, Metabolic Tumor Volumes, and Total Lesion Glycolysis on Fluorine-18 Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography/Computed Tomography.
papers.authors: Johnson J, Griffin L, Vickery K, Randall E
papers.abstract: Standardized uptake value maximum (SUVmax), metabolic tumor volumes (MTV), and total lesion glycolysis (TLG) are metabolic parameters used to quantify tumors detected on fluorine-18 fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (18F-FDG PET/CT). This is a subset project from a larger pilot study where dogs diagnosed with lymphoma via lymph node aspirates were staged and monitored with serial 18F-FDG PET/CT before, during, and after completion of standard of care chemotherapy. The aim of this prospective study was to evaluate metabolic parameters within the spleen in dogs with naive lymphoma and establish cutoff values for these metabolic parameters to predict lymphoma dissemination to the spleen (n = 7 dogs, 17 splenic samples). Splenic contours were performed at each time point to compare splenic cytology to splenic SUVmax, MTV, and TLG. Statistically significant receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve-derived cutoff values were found for SUVmax (cutoff > 3.55, p ≤ 0.05) and MTV with a threshold of 1.5 SUV (cutoff > 325.7, p ≤ 0.05). Additionally, there are significantly higher mean/median splenic SUV, MTV, and TLG among dogs with lymphoma in the spleen compared to those with benign splenic cytology. Therefore, certain cutoff values for SUVmax, MTV, and TLG may be able to predict splenic dissemination. These results may allow for noninvasive staging, monitoring of therapeutic response, and evaluation for recurrence of lymphoma following remission.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 림프종에서 18F-FDG PET/CT의 대사 지표(SUVmax, MTV, TLG)는 비장으로의 림프종 전이를 예측할 수 있으며, 비장 내 림프종이 있는 개에서 양성 세포학을 보이는 개보다 유의하게 높은 값을 보인다.
[방법·수치] 림프종 진단 개 7마리의 비장 샘플 17개를 대상으로 한 전향적 연구이며, 화학요법 전후 반복적 PET/CT를 시행했다. ROC 곡선 분석 결과 SUVmax 절단값 3.55 초과(p≤0.05), MTV 절단값 325.7 초과(1.5 SUV 역치, p≤0.05)에서 통계적 유의성을 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 비침습적 림프종 병기 결정, 치료 반응 모니터링, 관해 후 재발 평가에 활용 가능하다. 소규모 전향적 파일럿 연구이고 단일 기관 연구로서 더 큰 규모의 검증 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Computed Tomographic Findings of Ischemic Necrosis of the Accessory Carpal Bone in a Dog.
papers.authors: Isaya R, Gonzàlez-Gasch E, Sumping JC
papers.abstract: A 1-year-and-9-month-old Golden Retriever presented with a 9-month history of right thoracic limb lameness. Radiographs revealed a monostotic, expansile lesion of the right accessory carpal bone (ACB). A computed tomography (CT) confirmed the aggressive nature of the lesion, demonstrating multifocal moth-eaten osteolysis, sclerosis, periosteal reaction, and flexor carpi ulnaris tendinopathy. Differential diagnoses included the ischemic necrosis of the ACB, osteomyelitis, and primary bone neoplasia. Histopathology confirmed osteonecrosis. This case highlights the value of CT in evaluating aggressive carpal lesions and identifies ischemic necrosis as an important differential diagnosis. This case represents the first CT description of this disease in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 부족근골(accessory carpal bone)에서 허혈성 괴사가 발생하며, CT 영상이 이러한 공격적인 병변의 평가에 중요한 역할을 한다. 조직병리학으로 골괴사가 확인되었다.
[방법·수치] 1년 9개월령 골든 리트리버의 우측 흉부 사지 절음 케이스 보고. 방사선 사진에서 단일병소 확장성 병변을 보였고, CT에서 다초점 나방식 골용해, 경화, 골막 반응, 척골 굴곡근 건병증이 확인되었다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 수근골 부위의 공격적인 병변 평가 시 CT가 유용하며 허혈성 괴사를 감별진단에 포함해야 한다. 단일 케이스 보고로서 개에서의 첫 CT 기술 보고이므로 더 많은 사례 축적이 필요하다.

papers.title: Risk Factors for Pathologic Fracture in Dogs With Confirmed or Suspected Appendicular Osteosarcoma Treated With Low- or Standard-Dose-Rate Palliative External Beam Radiation Therapy.
papers.authors: Kurtzman A, Rappleyea E, Stewart M, Looper J, Billhymer A
papers.abstract: Pathologic fracture is a complication of bone cancer with probable increased risk following radiation therapy (RT). Low-dose-rate (LDR) RT can spare late-responding normal tissues by allowing intrafraction DNA repair, which could also impact tumor response. This retrospective cohort study evaluated efficacy and fracture rate in canine patients (n = 184) with confirmed or suspected appendicular osteosarcoma that received 10 Gy × 2 palliative RT on consecutive days with LDR (cobalt-60) or standard-dose-rate (SDR, linear accelerator). The overall fracture rate was 21.7%. Patients treated with SDR (600 cGy/min, n = 46) and LDR (range 21.9-83.29 cGy/min, n = 152) did not differ in pathologic fracture rates (22.4% vs. 17.4%, respectively, p = 0.54) or median survival times (231 vs. 248.5 days, respectively, p = 0.448). Pathologic fracture rates did not differ on the basis of weight (<35, 35-50, and >50 kg) or location (24% forelegs, 18% hindlegs, p = 0.44). However, no dog (n = 7) weighing less than 20 kg developed a fracture. Radiographs prior to RT were subjectively assessed for bone integrity. Dogs with predominantly lytic lesions did not have a significantly higher pathologic fracture rate (21.2%-31.69% lytic/mixed vs. 10%-12.5% proliferative, p = 0.054), suggesting that pretreatment radiographic appearance does not reflect fracture risk. Additionally, the presence of a pretreatment cortical bone defect was not associated with eventual fracture (p = 0.7). Adjunctive chemotherapy improved survival time significantly (p = 0.01). On the basis of our data, it is reasonable to compare response rates and survival outcomes in published studies using cobalt irradiation with reports using linear accelerators.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 부수 골육종에 대한 완화적 외부 방사선 치료에서 저선량률(LDR, 코발트-60)과 표준선량률(SDR, 직선가속기) 간 병적 골절률과 생존 시간에 유의한 차이가 없었으며, 개 체중 35kg 미만에서는 골절 발생이 없었다.
[방법·수치] 184마리의 개(SDR n=46, LDR n=152)를 대상으로 한 후향적 코호트 연구로, 10 Gy × 2 회(연속 2일)의 완화적 방사선 치료를 시행했다. 전체 병적 골절률 21.7%, SDR군 22.4% vs. LDR군 17.4%(p=0.54), 중앙 생존 시간 231일 vs. 248.5일(p=0.448), 용해성 병변 21.2%-31.69% vs. 증식성 병변 10%-12.5%(p=0.054), 보조 화학요법은 생존 시간 유의하게 개선(p=0.01).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상에서 선택하는 방사선 치료 선량률 종류는 병적 골절 위험도에 영향을 주지 않으므로 접근성과 비용 고려하여 선택 가능하다. 그러나 후향적 연구이고, 방사선 치료 전 방사선 사진의 주관적 평가, 소규모 체중군별 분석 등의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Qualitative and Quantitative Computed Tomography and Computed Tomography-Myelography Findings for Differentiating Thoracolumbar Intervertebral Disc Extrusion From Protrusion in Dogs.
papers.authors: Tragoulia IS, Patsikas MN, Kazakos GM, Papadopoulou PL, Mavropoulou EA
papers.abstract: Computed tomography (CT) and computed tomography-myelography (CT-myelography) are commonly used to evaluate intervertebral disc herniation in dogs. Qualitative CT and CT-myelography imaging criteria used to differentiate intervertebral disc extrusion (IVDE) from disc protrusion (IVDP) are often influenced by observer experience and subjective interpretation. Therefore, this prospective observational study aimed to assess qualitative imaging features, as well as quantitative morphometric indices, on CT and CT-myelography to provide more objective, measurable parameters for differentiating disc herniation type in 36 dogs with surgically confirmed thoracolumbar intervertebral disc disease. Qualitative characteristics, including extension of herniated material beyond the intervertebral disc space and lateralization of the lesion on both imaging modalities, were more frequently associated with IVDE. In contrast, midline disc herniation on both imaging modalities and degenerative bridging spondyloarthropathy on CT were more commonly observed in IVDP. The ratio of the maximum cross-sectional area of the herniated disc material to the area of the vertebral canal at the same level (area index) demonstrated moderate discriminatory ability on both imaging modalities, with high sensitivity, moderate accuracy, but lower specificity, especially on CT, reducing its reliability as a standalone classifier. The ratio of the total volume of herniated material to the total canal volume at the corresponding vertebral level (volume index) demonstrated excellent discriminatory ability with high sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy on both CT and CT-myelography. Overall, the V-index showed the highest diagnostic performance for differentiating disc herniation types, whereas the A-index was limited by lower specificity, with qualitative imaging features providing complementary information.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 흉요추 추간판 탈출증(IVDE)과 돌출증(IVDP)을 구분할 때 추간판 물질의 용적 비율(V-index: 탈출 물질 용적/척추관 용적)이 높은 민감도·특이도·정확도로 우수한 감별능을 보였으며, 면적 비율(A-index)은 낮은 특이도로 제한적이었다. 질적 영상 소견(탈출 물질의 추간판 범위 초과, 측방화)은 IVDE와 더 자주 관련되었고, 정중선 탈출과 퇴행성 척추유합은 IVDP와 더 자주 관련되었다.
[방법·수치] 수술로 확진된 흉요추 추간판질환이 있는 개 36마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 관찰 연구로, CT와 CT-척수조영을 시행하여 질적·정량적 형태계측 지수를 분석했다. V-index는 CT와 CT-척수조영 모두에서 높은 민감도·특이도·정확도를 보였고, A-index는 특히 CT에서 특이도가 낮았으며, 질적 소견은 보조적 정보를 제공했다.
[임상 적용·한계] V-index는 IVDE와 IVDP 감별의 객관적·정량적 지표로 활용할 수 있어 관찰자 경험의 영향을 줄일 수 있으나, 단일 기관의 소규모 연구(n=36)이고 질적 소견과 함께 종합적으로 해석해야 하는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Transthoracic lung ultrasound for perioperative assessment of dogs undergoing nonemergency anesthesia: a prospective observational study.
papers.authors: Wheeler EP, Hay Kraus BL, Mochel JP, Cai J, Handel A
papers.abstract: To explore whether lung ultrasound (LUS) findings suggestive of atelectasis in humans could be identified in dogs after anesthesia and to evaluate whether these findings were associated with clinical variables. Prospective, repeated-measures observational study with masked offline analysis. Forty-four client-owned dogs (American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status classification I-II) undergoing nonemergency surgical procedures in dorsal recumbency; 27 breathed spontaneously throughout anesthesia and 17 had intermittent positive-pressure ventilation. Dogs underwent a standardized LUS examination at two time points: immediately pre- (time point 1) and postanesthesia (time point 2). LUS examinations were performed by a single observer trained in a standardized protocol with dogs standing or in sternal recumbency. A curvilinear 8-5 MHz transducer probe was used to capture 4-second cineloops at eight sites (right and left caudal, perihilar, middle, and cranial). Images were assessed by an observer masked to dog and time point using a standardized scoring system (maximum score of 32) developed for the study that considered B-lines (vertical hyperechoic artefacts), irregular pleural line, and subpleural abnormalities. At time point 2, while dogs were receiving an FiO2 of 100%, arterial partial pressure of oxygen was measured using a point-of-care blood gas analyzer on samples collected from the dorsal pedal artery. LUS scores were compared between time points using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test. Animal, anesthetic, surgical, and respiratory variables were assessed for association with time point 2 LUS scores using univariable linear models adjusted for the time point 1 LUS score. LUS scores increased significantly (p < 0.001) from time point 1 to 2: median (range) 1 (0-5) versus 7 (0-18); Hodges-Lehmann median increase 6.5 points (95% confidence interval 5.0 to 8.5), p < 0.001.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 전신마취 후 폐초음파 점수가 유의하게 증가하였으며, 이는 인간에서 보이는 무기폐 소견과 유사한 패턴으로 나타났다.
[방법·수치] ASA 등급 I-II인 비응급 수술견 44마리(자발호흡 27마리, 간헐적 양압환기 17마리)를 대상으로 마취 전후 표준화된 폐초음파 검사를 시행하였다. 8개 부위에서 B-라인, 불규칙한 흉막선, 흉막하 이상을 평가한 점수(최대 32점)가 마취 전 중앙값 1점(범위 0-5)에서 마취 후 7점(범위 0-18)으로 유의하게 증가하였다(p<0.001, Hodges-Lehmann 중앙값 증가 6.5점, 95% CI 5.0-8.5).
[임상 적용·한계] 폐초음파는 마취 주변기간에 무기폐를 감지하는 접근 가능하고 경제적인 진단 방법으로서 추가 연구가 필요하다. 그러나 폐초mount 점수와 연령을 포함한 평가된 변수 간의 연관성을 발견하지 못하였으며(p=0.443), 소규모 단일기관 전향적 관찰 연구로서 임상 의의에 대한 추가 검증이 요구된다.

papers.title: Evaluation of opioid consumption using the quadratus lumborum block or intraperitoneal instillation with bupivacaine in dogs undergoing ovariohysterectomy in a teaching institution.
papers.authors: Quesada N, Mallea MJ, Miccio M, Martínez J, Bandelow S
papers.abstract: To compare postoperative opioid consumption between ultrasound-guided quadratus lumborum block (QLB) with bupivacaine and intraperitoneal bupivacaine instillation. Prospective, randomized, single-blinded, cross-sectional, clinical study. A total of 74 owned female dogs undergoing elective ovariohysterectomy. Dogs were premedicated with dexmedetomidine (5 μg kg-1) and methadone (0.3 mg kg-1) intramuscularly. Anesthesia was induced with intravenous propofol and maintained with isoflurane in oxygen. Carprofen (4 mg kg-1) was given subcutaneously after orotracheal intubation. Dogs underwent either a QLB with 0.3 mL kg-1 (1.5 mg kg-1) per side of 0.5% bupivacaine (group QLB) or intraoperative intraperitoneal instillation (group IP) of 0.5% bupivacaine (3 mg kg-1) as part of a multimodal analgesic protocol. Ovariohysterectomies were performed by undergraduate students under instructor supervision. Postoperative pain was assessed at 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 hours after extubation, using the short form of the Glasgow Composite Measure Pain Scale, and methadone (0.2 mg kg-1) was given as rescue analgesia if the pain score was ≥ 6/24. Opioid consumption was quantified by the number of rescue boluses required, using Poisson regression models. Methadone boluses were given at least once to 9/37 dogs (24%) in group QLB and 15/37 dogs (41%) in group IP. Dogs in group QLB were given 0-2 (range) methadone boluses, whereas those in group IP were given 0-3 boluses, with a total of 11 and 21 boluses, respectively. Methadone consumption was significantly reduced in group QLB versus group IP with a rate ratio of 0.42 (95% confidence interval = 0.19-0.92, p = 0.023). As part of a multimodal analgesic protocol, the QLB reduced postoperative opioid consumption compared with intraperitoneal instillation of bupivacaine in dogs undergoing ovariohysterectomy performed by veterinary students.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 난소자궁적출술을 받는 개에서 초음파 유도 사각요근블록(QLB)이 복강내 부피바카인 주입보다 술후 오피오이드 소비를 유의하게 감소시킨다.
[방법·수치] 선택적 난소자궁적출술을 받는 암컷 개 74마리 대상 전향적 무작위 단일맹검 임상 연구. QLB군(0.5% 부피바카인 편측 0.3 mL/kg, 1.5 mg/kg)과 복강내군(3 mg/kg) 비교. QLB군 37마리 중 9마리(24%)에서 메타돈 보충투여 필요, 복강내군 15마리(41%)에서 필요(메타돈 소비량 비율 0.42, 95% CI 0.19-0.92, p=0.023). QLB군 총 11회, 복강내군 총 21회 보충투여.
[임상 적용·한계] QLB는 특히 수술 시간이 길고 자극이 많은 교육기관 환경에서 복강내 부피바카인 주입의 대안이 될 수 있다. 단일 기관 연구이며 학생 수술 환경의 특수성 때문에 일반 임상 적용 시 추가 연구 필요.

papers.title: Effects of dexmedetomidine on the minimum alveolar concentration and its derivatives in sevoflurane-anesthetized cats.
papers.authors: Ide W, Murahata Y, Konishi Y, Tokunaga F, Yokono M
papers.abstract: To evaluate the effects of dexmedetomidine on the sevoflurane minimum alveolar concentration (SEVMAC), minimum alveolar concentration (MAC) for blocking adrenergic responses (SEVMAC-BAR), and MAC for tracheal extubation (SEVMAC-Extubation). Prospective randomized, crossover experimental study. Six healthy adult neutered cats [one female and five males; weighing 4.8 ± 1.1 kg (mean ± standard deviation)]. Cats were anesthetized with sevoflurane in oxygen. After endotracheal intubation, anesthesia was maintained with sevoflurane and mechanical ventilation was performed. Each cat was given all six treatments in a random order, which were saline or dexmedetomidine infusions at maintenance doses of 0.15, 0.3, 0.6, 1.5, or 6.0 μg kg-1 hour-1, following respective loading doses of 1, 2, 4, 10, and 40 μg kg-1 over 20 minutes, designed to achieve an estimated plasma concentration of 0.5-20.0 ng mL-1. SEVMAC-BAR, SEVMAC and SEVMAC-Extubation were measured in this order. Plasma dexmedetomidine concentrations were determined using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. A linear regression analysis was used to assess the plasma concentration-response relationships and estimate the half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50), defined as the plasma dexmedetomidine concentration producing a 50% reduction from the control value, separately for SEVMAC-BAR, SEVMAC, and SEVMAC-Extubation. The baseline SEVMAC-BAR, SEVMAC and SEVMAC-Extubation were 2.79 ± 0.86%, 2.65 ± 0.32%, and 1.60 ± 0.64%, respectively. These values significantly decreased in a plasma dexmedetomidine concentration-dependent manner. The IC50 values for SEVMAC-BAR, SEVMAC and SEVMAC-Extubation were 1.90 ng mL-1 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.51-6.99 ng mL-1], 1.38 ng mL-1 (95% CI: 0.35-5.39 ng mL-1), and 2.24 ng mL-1 (95% CI: 0.67-7.50 ng mL-1), respectively. Dexmedetomidine reduced the MAC and MAC derivatives in a plasma dexmedetomidine concentration-dependent manner in sevoflurane-anesthetized cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 덱스메데토미딘은 세보플루란 마취 고양이에서 MAC(최소폐포농도) 및 그 유도값들(SEVMAC-BAR, SEVMAC-Extubation)을 용량 의존적으로 감소시키며, 유해자극에 대한 운동반응과 교감신경반응 억제 및 기관내튜브 유지에 효과적이다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 성묘 6마리(암 1마리, 수 5마리, 체중 4.8 ± 1.1 kg)를 대상으로 한 전향적 교차 시험 설계로, 덱스메데토미딘 0.15-6.0 μg/kg/h 유지용량 또는 생리식염수를 투여하여 혈장농도 0.5-20.0 ng/mL를 유지했으며, SEVMAC-BAR의 IC50 1.90 ng/mL(95% CI: 0.51-6.99), SEVMAC의 IC50 1.38 ng/mL(95% CI: 0.35-5.39), SEVMAC-Extubation의 IC50 2.24 ng/mL(95% CI: 0.67-7.50)로 측정되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 덱스메데토미딘을 세보플루란 마취와 병용하면 필요한 마취제 농도를 줄일 수 있어 임상마취에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 소규모 단일종 연구로 다양한 환자군에 대한 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Pet owner understanding of anaesthetic risks and evaluation of preprocedural owner anxiety.
papers.authors: Soares BG, Jiménez CP
papers.abstract: To evaluate pet owners' awareness of and familiarity with anaesthetic risks, assess anxiety and information needs using the adapted Amsterdam Preoperative Anxiety and Information Scale (APAIS), and determine how perceived risks influence consent. Descriptive cross-sectional study. Owners of dogs and cats undergoing elective procedures requiring general anaesthesia. An anonymous online survey was distributed to owners at a tertiary referral small animal hospital between November 2024 and December 2025. The survey collected demographics, personal and pet anaesthetic experience, and APAIS scores. Owners reported awareness of, and familiarity with, anaesthetic risks and rated their influence on providing consent. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, nonparametric tests and Spearman's correlation. Qualitative data underwent thematic analysis. A total of 132 responses were included. Median APAIS anxiety and information scores were 10.5 (interquartile range 8-14) and 8 (6-9), respectively, with a positive correlation between anxiety and information needs (ρ = 0.35, p < 0.001). Death was the most recognised (67.9%) and familiar risk, whereas awareness of more specific complications was low. Personal anaesthesia experience was associated with greater familiarity with several risks (all p ≤ 0.002), while pet anaesthesia experience was associated with greater awareness but not familiarity (odds ratio 4.27, 95% confidence interval 1.49-12.23, p = 0.013). Most risks were unlikely to influence consent, with only 23.0% of owners reporting that the risk of death was likely or very likely to affect consent. Owners most frequently wished to discuss death (69.3%), postanaesthetic nausea and vomiting (49.6%) and prolonged recovery (48.0%). Owners had variable understanding of anaesthetic risks, with greater awareness of severe complications. Most risks were unlikely to influence consent.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 반려동물 주인들은 마취 관련 사망 위험에 대한 인식은 높지만, 오심·구토나 회복 지연 등 구체적인 합병증 인식은 낮으며, 대부분의 위험이 시술 동의에 큰 영향을 미치지 않는 것으로 나타났다.
[방법·수치] 개와 고양이 주인 132명을 대상으로 2024년 11월~2025년 12월 온라인 설문 조사를 실시하여 APAIS 점수(불안감 중앙값 10.5, 정보필요도 8), 인구통계학적 정보 및 위험 인식도를 수집했으며, 불안감과 정보필요도의 양의 상관(ρ=0.35, p<0.001)을 확인했다. 사망 위험 인식률 67.9%, 개인 마취 경험이 여러 위험 인식도 증가와 연관(p≤0.002), 반려동물 마취 경험이 인식도 증가와 연관(오즈비 4.27, 95% 신뢰도 1.49-12.23, p=0.013)했으며, 사망 위험만 23.0%의 주인에게 동의에 영향을 미칠 것으로 조사되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 적응형 APAIS는 불안감이나 정보필요도가 높은 주인을 선별하는 데 도움이 될 수 있으나, 수의학 집단에서의 추가 타당성 검증이 필요하다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이며, 주인의 주관적 인식에 의존한 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Removal of a lodged endotracheal tube in an anaesthetised French Bulldog using manual laryngeal stabilisation and neuromuscular blockade, and subsequent complications.
papers.authors: Benham-Crosswell F, Armour M, Martinez CP, Lee K, Barfield D
papers.abstract: A 5-year-old, female neutered French Bulldog presented under anaesthesia with an endotracheal tube (ETT) lodged in the larynx. Cuff inflation and deflation, application of lubricant, ETT rotation, and repeated traction did not allow ETT removal. The ETT was successfully removed under neuromuscular blockade with manual laryngeal stabilisation: the left thumb pressed against the epiglottis intraorally and the left index and middle fingers gripped the larynx externally to immobilise the larynx. The right-hand applied traction to the ETT, which could then be extracted. The dog's larynx obstructed on recovery from anaesthesia with suspected temporary laryngeal paralysis. The dog was managed with a tracheostomy tube for 3 days and made a good recovery. The dog presented in respiratory distress 4 weeks later with tracheal stenosis that was successfully treated with tracheal resection and anastomosis. This case report describes the use of neuromuscular blockade and manual laryngeal stabilisation to remove a lodged ETT and reflects on the subsequent complications.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 신경근 차단제와 수동 후두 고정을 이용하면 기관내 튜브가 후두에 박혀 있을 때 안전하게 제거할 수 있으나, 일시적 후두마비와 기관협착증 등의 합병증이 발생할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 5세 중성화된 프렌치 불독 1마리의 증례 보고로, 신경근 차단제 투여 후 좌손 엄지손가락으로 구강 내에서 후두개를 압박하고 좌손 검지와 중지로 외부에서 후두를 고정한 후 우손으로 튜브를 견인하여 제거했다. 술후 일시적 후두마비 의심 증상이 발생했으며, 4주 후 기관협착증으로 재발표했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 기존 방법(큐프 조절, 윤활제, 튜브 회전)으로 제거되지 않는 박힌 기관내 튜브 제거에 신경근 차단제와 수동 후두 고정 기법을 고려할 수 있으나, 단일 증례 보고로서 근거 수준이 낮고 합병증 발생 위험을 충분히 평가하기 어렵다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Use of a thermo-responsive hydrogel bupivacaine formulation to provide epidural analgesia in Beagle dogs.
papers.authors: Nam C, Lee I, Son WG
papers.abstract: To evaluate pharmacokinetics, epidural distribution, antinociceptive effects and motor blockade of bupivacaine incorporated into a thermo-responsive hydrogel (TRH) after lumbosacral epidural injection in dogs. Randomised, blinded, crossover experimental study. Five entire male Beagle dogs. Each dog underwent three assessment protocols: pharmacokinetics, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and antinociceptive and motor blockade assessment. Within each protocol, dogs received lumbosacral epidural bupivacaine (0.5%; 0.2 mL kg-1) alone and combined with TRH in a randomised crossover design. Treatments were separated by at least 2 weeks and consecutive protocols by at least 4 weeks, giving six general anaesthetic sessions per dog. Plasma bupivacaine concentrations were measured by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Epidural spread and spinal cord compression were assessed by MRI. Antinociceptive blockade was evaluated by mechanical nociceptive threshold with a digital pressure algometer, and motor blockade by a gait scoring system. Paired outcomes were compared using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Data are reported as median (interquartile range). Peak plasma bupivacaine concentrations were lower with bupivacaine-TRH than with bupivacaine alone [117.0 (96.8-126.5) versus 623.0 (422.5-1039.0) ng mL-1; p = 0.031]. MRI showed greater epidural retention and mild spinal cord compression with bupivacaine-TRH, without clinical neurological deficits. Cranial spread reached the thirteenth thoracic vertebra with both treatments, whereas bilateral spread varied among dogs. Antinociceptive blockade lasted longer with bupivacaine-TRH [7.0 (6.5-7.5) versus 4.0 (3.0-4.0) hours; p = 0.031]. Motor blockade was numerically shorter with bupivacaine-TRH [0.25 (0.12-0.75) versus 1.00 (0.75-1.00) hours], but the difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.063).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 온도반응형 하이드로겔(TRH)에 포함된 부피바카인은 단독 부피바카인 대비 혈장 약물 농도를 낮추면서 경막외 약물 유지 시간을 연장하고 진통 효과 지속 시간을 7시간까지 연장했다.
[방법·수치] 비글견 5마리를 대상으로 무작위 교차 설계로 요천추 경막외 주입 후 약동학, MRI, 진통·운동 차단을 평가했다. 최대 혈장 농도는 TRH 병용군 117.0(96.8-126.5) ng/mL 대 단독군 623.0(422.5-1039.0) ng/mL로 유의하게 낮았고(p=0.031), 진통 차단 지속시간은 TRH 병용군 7.0(6.5-7.5)시간 대 단독군 4.0(3.0-4.0)시간으로 유의하게 연장되었다(p=0.031). 운동 차단은 TRH 병용군에서 수치적으로 짧았으나 통계적 유의성은 없었다(p=0.063).
[임상 적용·한계] TRH 기반 경막외 약물 전달은 약물의 전신 노출을 감소시키면서 국소 진통 효과를 연장할 수 있어 수술 후 통증 관리에 임상 활용 가능하지만, 소규모 단일기관 연구이므로 대규모 안전성 평가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Cardiovascular effects of increasing doses of norepinephrine delivered by constant rate intravenous infusion in isoflurane-anesthetized cats.
papers.authors: Skelding AM, Valverde A
papers.abstract: To determine the cardiovascular effects of increasing doses of norepinephrine (NE) in healthy, isoflurane-anesthetized cats. Prospective experimental study. Eight healthy, 1-year-old, neutered male domestic shorthair cats with body masses of 4.7-6.8 kg. Cats were premedicated intramuscularly with butorphanol, midazolam and alfaxalone. Anesthesia was induced with intravenous alfaxalone and maintained with an end-tidal isoflurane concentration of 1.9-2.1% to cause hypotension, under volume-controlled ventilation. NE was administered to cats at three doses in the following order: low, 0.1 μg kg-1 minute-1, intermediate, 0.5 μg kg-1 minute-1 (INE), and high, 1.0 μg kg-1 minute-1 (HNE). Infusions lasted 15 minutes, followed by an interval of 10 minutes, to reach steady state at each phase. Cardiopulmonary variables recorded before (baseline) and during the NE dose included heart rate (HR), cardiac index (CI), and direct systolic, mean and diastolic arterial blood pressures (systolic arterial pressure [SAP], mean arterial pressure [MAP], diastolic arterial pressure [DAP]). Effects within each dose and between doses on cardiovascular variables were compared using one-way and two-way repeated-measures ANOVAs, respectively, followed by multiple pairwise comparisons with a Tukey's test (p < 0.05 was considered significant). From baseline, all three doses of NE caused significant increases in SAP, MAP, DAP and end-tidal CO2 at 7 and 15 minutes of infusion, and HNE caused a significant increase in CI at 15 minutes (61 ± 13 versus 102 ± 18 mL kg-1 minute-1, respectively; p = 0.002). HR increased significantly at 15 minutes with INE and throughout the infusion with HNE [123 ± 18 at baseline, 149 ± 10 at 7 minutes (p = 0.001) and 155 ± 10 beats minute-1 (p = 0.002)]. INE and HNE were associated with arrhythmias. Norepinephrine is effective in a dose-dependent fashion at treating isoflurane-induced hypotension in healthy cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 이소플루란 마취 중 저혈압이 유도된 건강한 고양이에서 노르에피네프린(NE)은 용량 의존적으로 혈압을 효과적으로 상승시키며, 고용량에서는 심박수 증가와 부정맥이 동반된다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 수컷 국내 단모종 고양이 8마리(체중 4.7-6.8 kg)를 대상으로 이소플루란 마취(1.9-2.1%) 하에서 NE를 저용량(0.1 μg/kg/분), 중용량(0.5 μg/kg/분), 고용량(1.0 μg/kg/분)으로 순차적으로 15분간 투여하고 심박수, 심박출량지수, 수축/평균/이완기 동맥혈압을 측정했다. 모든 용량에서 혈압이 유의하게 상승했으며, 고용량에서는 심박출량지수가 61±13에서 102±18 mL/kg/분으로 유의하게 증가(p=0.002)했고, 심박수는 기저치 123±18에서 7분 시점 149±10, 15분 시점 155±10 bpm으로 증가(p=0.001, p=0.002)했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 이소플루란 마취 중 저혈압 치료에 NE를 용량 반응적으로 사용할 수 있으나, 중·고용량에서 부정맥 위험이 증가하므로 심전도 모니터링이 필수적이다. 소규모(n=8) 단일기관 연구이고 건강한 고양이만 대상이므로, 질환 고양이나 임상 환자군에서의 효과·안전성은 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Effect of a single dose of tranexamic acid on perioperative blood loss in dogs undergoing spinal surgery.
papers.authors: De Celis Perez CM, Santos L, Bell A
papers.abstract: To determine whether a single preoperative injection of tranexamic acid (TXA) reduces blood loss in dogs undergoing spinal surgery. Prospective, randomised, blinded clinical study. One hundred and one dogs scheduled for spinal surgery at The Small Animal Hospital at The University of Glasgow were enrolled between November 2023 and November 2025. Anaesthesia technique was chosen by the attending anaesthetist and was not standardised. Dogs were randomly allocated to be administered either TXA (15 mg kg-1, intravenously) or an equivalent volume of Hartmann's solution (control). Block randomisation was based on surgical procedures (ventral slot, dorsal laminectomy, hemilaminectomy, or complex hemilaminectomy). Blood loss was estimated using an established gravimetric clinical system. The primary preregistered outcome measure was total blood loss in mL kg-1. Secondary outcomes were blood loss exceeding 10% of blood volume and clinical requirement for unblinding. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. Mean (± standard deviation) blood loss in the control group was 3.70 ± 4.49 mL kg-1versus 3.20 ± 5.03 mL kg-1 in the TXA group, without statistical or clinical differences (p = 0.459). Treatment allocation unblinding occurred in 11 dogs in the control group versus 12 in the TXA group. Blood loss exceeding 10% of estimated blood volume occurred in 13/101 dogs (seven control, six TXA group). A single preoperative injection of TXA at 15 mg kg-1 did not result in a significant reduction in blood loss during spinal surgery. Preoperative injection of TXA at 15 mg kg-1 did not reduce perioperative blood loss in this population. As such, routine use in all dogs undergoing spinal surgery is not supported by these data. Future work should focus on identifying the patient groups and dosing protocols in which TXA may offer measurable clinical advantage.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 척추 수술을 받는 개에서 술 전 트라넥삼산(TXA) 15 mg/kg 단회 투여는 수술 중 출혈량을 유의하게 감소시키지 못했다.
[방법·수치] 2023년 11월부터 2025년 11월까지 척추 수술 예정 개 101마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 무작위 맹검 임상 연구. 대조군 3.70±4.49 mL/kg 대 TXA군 3.20±5.03 mL/kg의 평균 출혈량으로 통계적 유의차 없음(p=0.459). 혈액량의 10% 이상 출혈은 101마리 중 13마리(대조군 7마리, TXA군 6마리)에서 발생.
[임상 적용·한계] 현재 데이터로는 척추 수술을 받는 모든 개에서 TXA의 일상적 사용을 지지하지 않으며, 향후 연구에서는 TXA의 임상적 이득을 나타낼 수 있는 특정 환자 군과 용량 프로토콜을 규명해야 한다. 마취 기법이 표준화되지 않은 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Ultrasound-guided thoracic erector spinae plane injections in cat cadavers: assessment of two injectate volumes using dissection and computed tomography.
papers.authors: de Lima IL, Serighelli-Junior G, Moresco M, Froes TR, Machado M
papers.abstract: To compare the distribution of two injectate volumes following thoracic erector spinae plane (ESP) injections in cat cadavers, using dissection and computed tomography (CT). Prospective, randomized, experimental cadaveric study. One formalin-preserved and 13 thawed cat cadavers. Ultrasound-guided ESP injections were performed at the fifth thoracic vertebra in thawed cat cadavers using high (HV, 0.5 mL kg-1) and low (LV, 0.3 mL kg-1) volumes, one per side. A total of 10 cadavers underwent dissection after methylene blue injection to assess staining of nerves and adjacent spaces. Three underwent CT following iohexol injections to evaluate craniocaudal spread within the epaxial musculature across vertebral segments, craniocaudal spread within the ESP, and involvement of adjacent structures. Craniocaudal injectate spread was similar between groups. HV and LV dye injections stained, respectively, a median (range) of 4 (2-6) and 3.5 (1-5) medial branches (p = 0.757), and 3 (2-4) and 2 (1-3) lateral branches (p = 0.013) of the dorsal branches of the spinal nerves (DBSN). HV dye injections stained the intercostal nerve (2/10 injections), intercostal space (3/10), and sympathetic trunk (1/10). LV stained the intercostal nerve (1/10), intercostal space (3/10), and sympathetic trunk (2/10). CT confirmed epaxial distribution over 10 (8-11) and 10 (5-10) vertebral segments for HV and LV, while spread specifically within the ESP was confined to 5 (5-6) and 5 (4-6) vertebral segments, respectively. Contrast reached the intervertebral foramina (3/3 HV, 2/3 LV), paravertebral and intercostal spaces (2/3 HV, 1/3 LV), and epidural space (1/3 in each group). CT demonstrated continuity between these structures. Thoracic ESP injections in cats consistently reached DBSN branches, with unpredictable spread to ventral branches and adjacent structures. Both volumes achieved similar craniocaudal spread, but the higher volume increased staining of the lateral branches of the DBSN.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 흉추 척추기립근평면(ESP) 초음파 유도 주입은 척추신경의 등쪽가지를 일관되게 도달하지만, 복측가지와 인접 구조물로의 확산은 예측 불가능하며, 고용량이 등쪽측가지의 측가지 염색을 증가시킨다.
[방법·수치] 고양이 사체 13구(해동) 및 1구(포르말린 보존)를 대상으로 T5에서 고용량(HV, 0.5 mL/kg)과 저용량(LV, 0.3 mL/kg)의 ESP 주입을 양측으로 시행하였다. 메틸렌블루 주입 후 해부를 통해 신경 염색을 평가하고, 아이오헥솔 주입 후 CT로 확산 범위를 평가했다. HV와 LV는 각각 척추신경의 등쪽가지 중앙가지 4개(범위 2-6)와 3.5개(1-5)를 염색하였고(p=0.757), 측가지는 3개(2-4)와 2개(1-3)를 염색하였다(p=0.013). HV는 늑간신경, 늑간강, 교감신경간에 도달하였고, LV도 유사한 확산을 보였다. CT에서 척추기립근 범위 내 확산은 HV와 LV 모두 5개 척추분절에 국한되었으며, 추간공, 척추주변강, 경막외강으로의 도달이 확인되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] ESP 주입은 흉부 통증 관리 시 도르설 신경가지 차단을 목표로 사용할 수 있으나, 늑간신경과 교감신경간으로의 불규칙한 확산으로 인해 예기치 않은 작용을 초래할 수 있다. 본 연구는 소규모 사체 연구로서 생체 반응 및 임상 효과의 평가가 필요하다.

papers.title: Influence of drug-induced nausea and opioid-associated behavioural alterations on pain scores in nonpainful cats: a prospective, randomised, experimental trial.
papers.authors: Rupp V, Kästner S, Foraita N, Delarocque J, Schütter AF
papers.abstract: To investigate whether pain scores (PS) obtained using the Feline Grimace Scale (FGS) or Glasgow Composite Measure Pain Scale - Feline (CMPS-F) are influenced by drug-induced nausea or opioid-associated behavioural alterations. Prospective, experimental, blinded, controlled, randomised, crossover trial. A group of seven healthy adult laboratory cats. Pain assessments (FGS followed by CMPS-F) were performed at baseline (BL) [three measurements (BL1-3), 20 minutes apart]. Ten minutes after BL3, cats were administered subcutaneous saline (0.5 mL), methadone (0.6 mg kg-1) or xylazine (0.5 mg kg-1). Assessments were repeated 10, 30 and 60 minutes after injection. At each time point, two blinded investigators determined PS before and after a standardised thermal nociceptive assay. Sedation, nausea and opioid-associated behaviours were recorded. Data were analysed using mixed linear models with time point and treatment as interacting predictors and Tukey-adjusted post hoc comparisons. Xylazine significantly increased CMPS-F and FGS scores at all post-treatment time points versus BL (all p < 0.001). CMPS-F increased from BL to T10-T60 (mean ± standard deviation, 2.0 ± 2.2, 6.6 ± 1.9, 8.3 ± 2.0 and 7.9 ± 2.2), respectively, whereas FGS increased from 1.4 ± 1.0 to 6.0 ± 1.4, 7.1 ± 2.1 and 6.3 ± 2.1. These increases coincided with nausea and/or emesis in six of seven cats and mild to moderate sedation. Methadone did not result in significant group-level changes over time (CMPS-F, 3.7 ± 3.2, 4.6 ± 0.8, 5.1 ± 2.3 and 4.7 ± 2.3; FGS, 2.6 ± 2.0, 3.9 ± 1.1, 3.7 ± 1.0 and 3.9 ± 2.3), although individual cats exceeded intervention thresholds. Drug-induced nausea was associated with clinically relevant increases in feline PS. Opioid-associated behavioural alterations may also influence individual assessments. These findings emphasise the importance of interpreting feline PS within the broader clinical context.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 약물 유도 오심이 Feline Grimace Scale(FGS)과 Glasgow Composite Measure Pain Scale-Feline(CMPS-F) 점수를 임상적으로 유의미하게 증가시키며, 마약성진통제 관련 행동 변화도 개별 통증 평가에 영향을 미칠 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 성묘 7마리 대상 전향적 무작위 교차 시험으로, 식염수, 메타돈(0.6 mg/kg), 질라진(0.5 mg/kg) 피하투여 후 10, 30, 60분에 FGS와 CMPS-F로 통증을 평가했다. 질라진은 모든 투여 후 시점에서 베이스라인 대비 CMPS-F와 FGS 점수를 유의미하게 증가(p<0.001)시켰으며, 질라진 투여 후 7마리 중 6마리에서 오심/구토와 경도~중등도 진정이 동반되었다. 메타돈은 군 수준에서 유의미한 변화를 보이지 않았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 진통 평가 시 약물 유도 오심과 행동 변화를 고려하여 임상 맥락 내에서 통증 점수를 해석해야 한다. 소규모 단일 연구이며 실험실 고양이를 대상으로 했으므로 임상 환자 적용 시 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Development and clinical implementation of a low-cost cloud-based electronic veterinary anesthesia record.
papers.authors: Cho YG, Kim J, Kim N, Oh S, Lee S
papers.abstract: To describe the development and clinical implementation of a low-cost, workflow-integrated, cloud-based electronic veterinary anesthesia record (EVAR) and to evaluate its association with changes in registry-level documentation completeness between preimplementation paper-based and postimplementation EVAR workflows. Pre-post implementation study. A total of 984 anesthesia or sedation episodes in dogs and cats recorded in a departmental anesthesia registry, including 489 episodes in the paper-based period (April-December 2024) and 495 episodes in the EVAR period (April-December 2025) at a veterinary medical teaching hospital. EVAR was developed using a cloud-based application suite. Case-linked spreadsheets integrated anesthesia requests, scheduling, consent documentation, perianesthetic recording, and postcase export. Registry-level completeness was assessed for 13 predefined variables comparable across periods. Variable-level differences were summarized as absolute percentage-point differences with 95% confidence intervals and Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted p values. Increased registry-level completeness was observed for documentation of diagnosis (83.0%-99.8%), American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status classification (83.8%-97.0%), endotracheal tube information (36.0%-96.2%), and fluid type (34.4%-93.5%) (all adjusted p < 0.001). Cardiac murmur grade documentation (85.5%-68.7%) and anesthesia duration documentation (98.2%-93.9%) were less complete after EVAR implementation (adjusted p < 0.001 and adjusted p = 0.002, respectively). No technical failures or data-loss events were documented in administrator records or during routine implementation monitoring. The remaining variables showed small absolute differences. EVAR use was associated with improved registry-level completeness of selected perianesthetic variables compared with the previous paper-based workflow.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 클라우드 기반 전자 마취 기록 시스템(EVAR)은 종이 기록 대비 진단, ASA 신체상태분류, 기관내튜브 정보, 수액 종류 등 주요 항목의 등록 수준 완성도를 유의하게 향상시킨다.
[방법·수치] 개와 고양이를 대상으로 한 후향적 비교 연구로, 종이 기록 기간 489건(2024년 4-12월)과 EVAR 기간 495건(2025년 4-12월) 총 984건의 마취·진정 사례를 분석했다. 진단(83.0%-99.8%), ASA 신체상태(83.8%-97.0%), 기관내튜브 정보(36.0%-96.2%), 수액 종류(34.4%-93.5%) 모두 p<0.001로 유의하게 개선되었으나, 심잡음 기록(85.5%-68.7%)과 마취 지속시간(98.2%-93.9%)은 감소했다(p=0.002).
[임상 적용·한계] EVAR는 워크플로우 통합 클라우드 플랫폼으로 임상 적용이 용이하며 데이터 손실 없이 운영되었다. 그러나 이 결과는 등록 수준의 문서 완성도 개선만 보여주며, 원본 기록 완성도, 데이터 입력 정확도, 사용자 경험, 임상 결과, 환자 안전 개선의 증거는 아니다.

papers.title: Tibial plateau leveling osteotomy surgical site infections: A systematic review with meta-analysis of prevalence and associated risk factors.
papers.authors: Bidjarano AC, Gordon-Evans W, Thomson C
papers.abstract: To determine the overall prevalence of surgical site infection (SSI) following tibial plateau leveling osteotomy (TPLO) in dogs and to evaluate associated risk factors across published studies. Systematic review with meta-analysis. Client-owned dogs that underwent TPLO as described in the published literature. A systematic review of studies reporting SSI following TPLO was conducted using PRISMA guidelines. Included studies were screened for quality, and pooled prevalence estimates were calculated using random-effects models. Subgroup and sensitivity analyses were performed. For risk factors, pooled ORs were calculated only when ≥3 comparable studies reported ORs with CIs (weight and postoperative antimicrobial administration). The meta-analysis included 30 studies encompassing 8820 dogs (9576 TPLOs). Only 5/30 studies were considered level I or II and then further divided into moderate and high level of evidence. The overall SSI rate, including superficial and deep infections, was 9.11% (range: 2.9%-25.9%) and an explant rate of 4.11% (range: 0%-33.36%). Heterogeneity was moderate to high across studies. In pooled analyses limited to comparable studies, postoperative antimicrobial administration was associated with lower odds of SSI, while bodyweight showed minimal association with SSI risk; both findings should be interpreted cautiously given limited comparability across studies. TPLO SSI rates are higher than other clean orthopedic procedures. Current literature is mostly retrospective in nature. These findings emphasize the need for standardized reporting and infection prevention strategies in clinical practice. While higher-quality (higher-level) evidence is needed, trends seen in this large population can be used to start quality control measures in hospitals to reduce TPLO SSI rates.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 경골 평탄화 절골술(TPLO) 후 수술부위감염(SSI) 발생률은 9.11%로 다른 정형외과 수술보다 높으며, 술후 항생제 투여가 감염 위험을 낮추는 것으로 나타났다.
[방법·수치] 30개 연구, 8820마리 개, 9576건의 TPLO 시술을 포함한 체계적 문헌고찰 및 메타분석; SSI 발생률 9.11%(범위: 2.9%-25.9%), 임플란트 제거율 4.11%(범위: 0%-33.36%), 술후 항생제 투여 시 SSI 발생 위험도 감소, 체중은 최소한의 연관성 보임.
[임상 적용·한계] TPLO 시술 후 감염 예방 전략 수립과 품질 관리 조치 시행이 필요하며, 술후 항생제 투여를 임상 프로토콜로 고려할 수 있다. 그러나 대부분의 포함 연구가 후향적 설계이고 연구 간 비교성이 제한적이므로 더 높은 수준의 전향적 증거가 필요하다.

papers.title: Staged caval occlusion enabling en bloc right divisional hepatectomy in two dogs with hepatocellular carcinoma.
papers.authors: Ishigaki K, Asano K
papers.abstract: To describe staged pre-renal caudal vena cava (CVC) occlusion before en bloc right divisional hepatectomy with segmental caval resection in two dogs with right divisional hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) involving the CVC. Two client-owned, 11-year-old neutered male dogs (Siberian Husky and Shih Tzu). Short case series. Dog 1 (Siberian Husky) had prior hemoperitoneum and biopsy-confirmed HCC; dog 2 (Shih Tzu) had persistent liver enzyme elevations and a suspected hepatic tumor. Computed tomography (CT) showed right divisional masses (91.8 × 122.3 × 101.4 mm; 77.0 × 94.8 × 70.2 mm) with CVC compression or involvement and no pre-existing collateral venous return. A percutaneously controlled hydraulic occluder was placed around the pre-renal CVC. Gradual outpatient occlusion was performed over 79 and 44 days while monitoring saphenous venous pressure, renal values, and hindlimb edema. Complete CVC occlusion and collateralization were confirmed by CT before en bloc right divisional hepatectomy with segmental CVC resection. Macroscopically complete resection was achieved in both dogs. Complete HCC resection was confirmed histopathologically. Morbidity was limited to transient wound exudation in dog 1 and transient ascites in dog 2. No recurrence or metastasis was identified in dog 1 during follow-up. In dog 2, no clinical signs suggestive of recurrence or metastasis were reported. Survival after hepatectomy was 352 and 2467 days. Staged pre-renal CVC occlusion may establish collateral venous return and permit planned en bloc right divisional hepatectomy with segmental CVC resection in carefully selected dogs with right divisional HCC involving the CVC.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 단계적 후신장 대정맥 폐색은 측부 순환을 형성하여 대정맥 침범이 있는 우엽 간세포암종 환자에서 완전 절제술을 가능하게 한다.
[방법·수치] 2마리의 11세 수컷 개(시베리안 허스키, 시추)를 대상으로 경피적 유압 폐색기로 79일 및 44일에 걸쳐 단계적 대정맥 폐색을 시행한 후 우엽 간절제술 및 분절 대정맥 절제술을 수행; 종양 크기 91.8×122.3×101.4mm 및 77.0×94.8×70.2mm; 절제술 후 생존기간 352일 및 2467일.
[임상 적용·한계] 대정맥 침범이 있는 우엽 간세포암종의 완전 절제를 위한 수술 전 준비 방법으로 적용 가능하나, 소규모 증례보고이며 신중한 환자 선택이 필요한 한계가 있다.

papers.title: A retrospective multicenter study of outcomes and complications in dogs undergoing total hip replacement with a BFX collared stem.
papers.authors: Brandstetter V, Matis U, Schuenemann R, Arndt C, Pozzi A
papers.abstract: To evaluate outcomes and complications of the cementless BFX collared (BFX-C) stem in canine total hip replacement (THR) and identify risk factors for complications and subsidence. Retrospective multicenter study. A total of 104 dogs undergoing 134 THR at four referral institutions (2019-2024). Medical records and radiographs of dogs receiving a BFX-C stem were reviewed. Radiographic measurements included canal fill, canal flare index, stem alignment and subsidence. Clinical outcomes were assessed by orthopedic examination and owner questionnaire. Associations between putative risk factors and stem-specific complications and subsidence were assessed using univariable and multivariable analysis. Major stem-specific complications occurred in 15 (11.2%) procedures: intraoperative femoral fissures (7; 5.2%), intraoperative greater trochanter fractures (4; 3.0%), postoperative femoral fractures (3; 2.2%), subsidence requiring revision surgery (1; 0.8%). Median subsidence was 1.0 mm (range: -1.8-10.8). Subsidence of >3 mm in five (3.7%) cases, with one associated major complication. Increasing age was associated with greater subsidence (p = .04), but not with the likelihood of subsidence >3 mm (p = .08). At clinical follow-up (>3 months), 88/100 (88.0%) cases showed no lameness. Owners reported full limb function in 122 (91.0%) and acceptable function in 12 (9.0%) cases. The use of the BFX-C stem resulted in low rates of stem-specific complications and clinically relevant subsidence in this cohort. Subsidence ≤3 mm was common but not associated with stem-specific complications. The BFX-C stem is an acceptable option for cementless THR in dogs, providing high rates of full function and owner satisfaction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 전고관절 치환술에서 BFX collared stem 사용은 낮은 줄기 특이 합병증율(11.2%)과 임상적으로 유의한 가라앉음(subsidence >3mm, 3.7%)을 보였으며, 88%의 사례에서 추적관찰 시 절뚝거림이 없었고 91%의 주인이 완전한 사지 기능을 보고했다.
[방법·수치] 4개 의뢰 기관에서 2019-2024년에 시행된 개 104마리의 134건 전고관절 치환술에 대한 후향적 다기관 연구이며, 중앙값 가라앉음 1.0mm(범위: -1.8-10.8mm), 가라앉음 >3mm는 5건(3.7%), 주요 합병증은 15건(11.2%: 수술 중 대퇴골 균열 7건, 수술 중 대전자 골절 4건, 수술 후 대퇴골 골절 3건, 수정 필요한 가라앉음 1건)이었으며 연령 증가가 더 큰 가라앉음과 연관(p=.04)되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] BFX collared stem은 개의 무시멘트 전고관절 치환술에서 높은 기능 회복율과 주인 만족도를 제공하는 허용 가능한 선택지이지만, 본 연구는 후향적 설계이고 3개월 이상의 추적관찰 기간만 제시했으며 장기 추적 데이터 부족이 한계다.

papers.title: Intraoperative cholangiography during open cholecystectomy in 73 dogs with benign gallbladder disease.
papers.authors: Konno R, Kaneko Y, Matsunaga M, Osuga T, Okadera R
papers.abstract: To evaluate intraoperative cholangiography (IOC) during open cholecystectomy in dogs with benign gallbladder disease, including cases with preoperative common bile duct (CBD) obstruction, and to describe the short-term outcomes. Retrospective case series. A total of 73 client-owned dogs. Medical records (2014-2022) were reviewed. All dogs underwent open cholecystectomy, bile duct flushing (BDF) with saline, and IOC under subtraction fluoroscopy. Cholangiograms were assessed for complete CBD obstruction (no duodenal passage), partial obstruction (CBD filling defects indicating retained debris), and filling defects in hepatic ducts. Perioperative mortality (≤14 days) and post-discharge findings during 3 months of follow-up were recorded. IOC was evaluable in 72 of 73 dogs; assessment was precluded by catheter perforation in one dog. Complete CBD obstruction was identified in 12.5% (9/72). Partial obstruction with retained debris occurred in 20.8% (15/72); debris migrated to transiently obstruct the distal CBD during contrast injection in four of 15. Among the 66 dogs in which IOC opacified the right and left hepatic ducts, seven (10.6%) had filling defects in the hepatic ducts. One dog developed suspected contrast-associated shock that resolved with treatment. Perioperative mortality was 6.8% (5/73) in the total cohort; 0% (0/29) in dogs without jaundice, and 11.4% (5/44) in dogs with jaundice. Among 61 dogs with follow-up, no deaths occurred within 3 months. During open cholecystectomy, IOC frequently identified retained debris and other biliary abnormalities. IOC may be a useful adjunct to BDF when CBD or hepatic duct obstruction or retained debris is suspected. Routine IOC may improve surgical outcomes, particularly in dogs with preoperative CBD obstruction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 양성 담낭질환에서 개복 담낭절제술 중 술중담도조영술(IOC)은 완전폐색 12.5%, 부분폐색 20.8%, 간내담도 충전결손 10.6%를 진단하여 담즙관 플러싱만으로는 발견하기 어려운 담도 이상을 효과적으로 파악할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 2014-2022년 의무기록 검토 대상 73마리의 개(IOC 평가 가능 72마리)에서 개복 담낭절제술, 생리식염수 담즙관 플러싱, 감산형 형광투시 하 술중담도조영술 시행; 술후 14일 이내 사망률 6.8%(5/73), 황달 없는 개 0%, 황달 있는 개 11.4%(5/44).
[임상 적용·한계] 술중담도조영술은 담즙관 플러싱 보조수단으로 담낭질환 수술 시 특히 황달이나 담도폐색이 있는 개에서 임상성적 개선에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 단일기관 후향적 사례 수집연구로 대조군 비교와 장기추적관찰이 제한적이다.

papers.title: An exploratory evaluation of the frequency of perioperative changes in electrolyte, acid-base, creatinine, glucose, and lactate variables in dogs and cats undergoing cranial surgery for tumor resection.
papers.authors: Weiss ZE, Murthy VD, Epstein SE, Hopper K, Hoehne SN
papers.abstract: To explore the frequency and severity of abnormalities in perioperative point-of-care bloodwork in dogs and cats undergoing cranial surgery for tumor resection with particular emphasis on dyskalemia development. Retrospective observational study. A total of 61 dogs and 14 cats undergoing cranial surgery for tumor resection between 2009 and 2023. Medical records and point-of-care blood variables of dogs and cats undergoing surgical tumor resection were reviewed. Electrolyte, acid-base, creatinine, glucose, and lactate concentrations were recorded preoperatively, intraoperatively, and immediately postoperatively and compared to reference intervals. Medications and IV fluids administered were recorded. Intraoperative mannitol was administered to 24/61 (39%) dogs and 5/14 (36%) cats, and hypertonic saline to 1/61 dog. Two of 75 (3%) animals experienced mild intraoperative hyperkalemia (<5.9 mmol/L), none experienced moderate or severe hyperkalemia. Intraoperative hypokalemia was present in 6/75 (8%) animals. Mean (±SD) preoperative potassium concentration ([K+]; mmol/L) was 3.75 (±0.45), increasing to 3.91 (±0.46) intraoperatively, and decreasing postoperatively to 3.74 (±0.46). Intraoperative [K+] was significantly higher than postoperative (p < .001).
