Intraoperative bicarbonate, sodium, and ionized calcium concentrations were lower than preoperative concentrations but returned to baseline postoperatively and largely remained within institutional reference intervals. Intraoperative alterations in [K+], bicarbonate, sodium, and ionized calcium concentrations occurred during cranial surgery in dogs and cats, but were generally mild and transient. Clinically relevant hyperkalemia was not observed in this cohort. Clinically significant hyperkalemia may be uncommon in veterinary cranial surgery, but routine perioperative point-of-care bloodwork remains advised to monitor electrolyte and acid-base status.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 뇌종양 적출 수술 중 칼륨, 중탄산염, 나트륨, 이온화 칼슘 농도의 경미한 일시적 변화가 발생하지만 임상적으로 유의한 고칼륨혈증은 관찰되지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 2009-2023년 뇌종양 적출 수술을 받은 개 61마리, 고양이 14마리(총 75마리)를 대상으로 한 후향적 관찰 연구로, 수술 전후 및 수술 중 혈액가스분석을 비교했다. 칼륨 농도는 수술 전 3.75(±0.45) mmol/L에서 수술 중 3.91(±0.46)로 증가, 수술 후 3.74(±0.46)로 감소했으며(p<0.001), 경증 고칼륨혈증은 2/75(3%), 저칼륨혈증은 6/75(8%)에서 관찰되었다. 마니톨은 39%의 개와 36%의 고양이에 투여되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 뇌수술 중 전해질과 산염기 상태 모니터링을 위해 정기적인 포인트 오브 케어 혈액검사를 권장하나, 본 연구는 단일기관의 후향적 연구로 소규모 고양이 표본(14마리)이 포함되어 있다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Temporary caval occlusion technique during right divisional hepatectomy for massive hepatocellular carcinoma with caudal vena cava compression/involvement in dogs.
papers.authors: Ishigaki K, Asano K, Tamura K, Heishima T, Hayakawa T
papers.abstract: To describe the perioperative and long-term outcomes of dogs with massive hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in the right hepatic division causing compression or involvement of the caudal vena cava (CVC) treated with right divisional hepatectomy using temporary caval occlusion (TCO). Retrospective case series. Nineteen client-owned dogs. Medical records were reviewed. Data collected included signalment, preoperative imaging findings, operative details, adjunct procedures, transfusion requirements, histopathological diagnosis and surgical margin status, perioperative complications, and survival to discharge. Long-term outcome information was obtained from recheck examinations when available and from telephone interviews with referring veterinarians and/or owners. Right divisional hepatectomy with TCO was completed in all dogs; a Pringle maneuver was used in two of 19 dogs. Median TCO duration was 17.6 min (range, 7.0-25.7) and median operative time was 82 min (range, 69-127). Primary suture repair of the CVC was required in six of 19 dogs. R0 resection was achieved in 14 of 19 dogs. One dog died on postoperative day 2; 18/19 dogs were discharged. Of these dogs, seven were alive without reported recurrence or intrahepatic metastasis at the last follow up, 95-1355 days after surgery, whereas 11 had died at a median of postoperative day 729 (range, 204-1154). Postoperative intrahepatic metastasis was suspected in two dogs. Temporary caval occlusion-assisted right divisional hepatectomy provided venous control in selected dogs with massive right-sided HCC and compression or involvement of the CVC, with no intraoperative mortality, one in-hospital death, and postoperative complications in six of the 18 discharged dogs. Temporary caval occlusion facilitates controlled dissection of the right hepatic veins and repair of small caval defects when present.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 대량 우측 간세포암종으로 인한 미주정맥 압박/침범에서 임시 미주정맥 폐쇄 기법을 이용한 우측 간엽절제술은 수술 중 사망 없이 안전하게 시행 가능하며 종양의 완전 절제를 용이하게 한다.
[방법·수치] 개 19마리 대상 후향적 사례 연구로 우측 간엽절제술 및 임시 미주정맥 폐쇄 시행. 평균 미주정맥 폐쇄 시간 17.6분(범위 7.0-25.7분), 평균 수술 시간 82분(범위 69-127분), R0 절제 달성률 14/19마리(73.7%), 완전 절제 6/19마리에서 미주정맥 1차 봉합 필요.
[임상 적용·한계] 미주정맥 침범이 있는 우측 간세포암종의 외과적 치료에서 종양 절제 범위 확대 및 혈관 손상 최소화에 임상적으로 적용 가능하나, 단일기관 후향적 사례 연구이고 샘플 크기가 작으며 추적관찰 기간이 불균일하다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Laparoscopic typhlectomy in a dog with a gastrointestinal stromal tumor.
papers.authors: Poggi E, Izzo F, Piana F
papers.abstract: To describe the surgical technique, perioperative course, and outcome of laparoscopic typhlectomy (LT) in a dog with an isolated cecal mass. Case report. A 12-year-old male Labrador retriever. A dog presented with a 3 week history of gastrointestinal signs and weight loss. Advanced imaging identified a 1.7 cm cecal mass without evidence of lymphadenopathy or metastasis. A four-portal laparoscopic approach was used. The ileocecal fold was dissected using ultrasonic and monopolar energy devices, and the cecum was resected with a 60 mm endoscopic linear stapler fitted with a 2.5 mm cartridge. The specimen was retrieved in a laparoscopic bag. Total surgical time was 66 min. Laparoscopic typhlectomy was completed and the dog recovered without intraoperative complications, resumed voluntary feeding within 6 h, and was discharged after 36 h. Histopathology confirmed a gastrointestinal stromal tumor with tumor-free margins. No recurrence or gastrointestinal complications were observed during 6 months of clinical and ultrasonographic follow up. Survival time was 365 days; euthanasia was performed because of an unrelated neurological condition. Although typhlectomy is an established procedure, this report shows the feasibility of a totally laparoscopic approach for selected cecal lesions in dogs. Laparoscopic typhlectomy may provide a minimally invasive alternative to open typhlectomy in selected patients.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 맹장 종양(위장관 간질성 종양)에 대해 완전 복강경 맹장절제술이 성공적으로 수행되었으며, 종양 절제 후 재발 없이 6개월간 임상적, 초음파적 추적 관찰에서 합병증이 없었다.
[방법·수치] 12세 래브라도 리트리버 1마리에서 1.7 cm 크기의 맹장 종양에 대해 4개의 포트를 이용한 복강경 접근법을 시행했으며, 초음파와 단극 에너지 장치로 회맹장 주름을 절제하고 60 mm 내시경 선형 스테이플러(2.5 mm 카트리지)로 맹장을 절제했다(수술 시간 66분). 조직검사에서 종양 경계가 확실한 위장관 간질성 종양으로 확진되었고, 수술 후 6시간 내 자발적 섭식 재개, 36시간 내 퇴원하였으며 365일 생존했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 선택된 개의 맹장 병변에 대해 완전 복강경 맹장절제술은 개방 절제술의 최소침습적 대안이 될 수 있으나, 단일 증례 보고로서 광범위한 적용의 근거로는 제한적이다.

papers.title: Closure of a massive truncal defect post sarcoma resection by using the preserved skin from the amputated forelimb in a cat.
papers.authors: Maskell KA, Bacon NJ
papers.abstract: To describe a surgical technique for extensive wound closure following radical excision of a feline injection-site sarcoma (FISS) using skin harvested from an amputated limb, adopting the "spare parts" concept from human oncologic surgery. One cat diagnosed with a feline injection-site sarcoma involving the thoracic limb region. Case report. Following diagnosis of a large, infiltrative FISS requiring radical excision and limb amputation, the resected limb was used to harvest viable skin for wound closure. A limb fillet flap technique, adapted from human reconstructive surgery, was used to achieve tension-free closure of the extensive surgical defect without the need for additional donor sites. The wound healed uneventfully, with satisfactory cosmetic and functional outcomes. No major postoperative complications were observed, and the use of filleted limb skin provided adequate coverage of the resection site. Successful adaptation of a limb fillet flap technique from human reconstructive oncology for wound closure following radical FISS excision was achieved. To the authors' knowledge, this approach has not been previously reported in the veterinary literature and represents a practical option for reconstruction of large oncologic defects in cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 주사부위육종(FISS) 광범위 절제 후 절단된 사지의 피부를 이용한 사지 필렛 플랩(limb fillet flap) 기법으로 대규모 흉부 결손을 성공적으로 봉합할 수 있으며, 이는 수의학 문헌에 처음 보고되는 기법이다.
[방법·수치] 흉부 사지 부위 대형 침윤성 FISS 진단 고양이 1례를 대상으로 한 증례보고로, 근치적 절제 및 사지절단술 후 절단된 사지에서 채취한 생존 피부를 이용하여 긴장 없는 봉합(tension-free closure)을 달성했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 광범위 종양성 결손의 재건이 필요한 고양이에서 추가 공여부위 없이 절단된 사지의 피부를 활용하여 미용적, 기능적으로 우수한 결과를 얻을 수 있다. 단일 증례보고로서 장기 추적 관찰 및 다수 사례에 대한 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Clinical outcomes of laparoscopic hepatectomy using en bloc hilar pedicle control in dogs with hepatic masses.
papers.authors: Ehara I, Aihara N, Kimura Y, Hayabe Y, Hoshi K
papers.abstract: To describe the surgical techniques and evaluate outcomes of laparoscopic hepatectomy using en bloc hilar pedicle control (EHPC) in dogs with hepatic masses. Prospective study. A total of 10 client-owned dogs. Dogs with hepatic masses not involving the hilar pedicle (portal vein, hepatic artery, and bile duct), hepatic veins at the hilus, and caudal vena cava (CVC) underwent laparoscopic hepatectomy using EHPC. Data on signalment, blood tests, imaging, intraoperative findings, histopathology, and clinical outcomes were collected. Masses were located in the right lateral, right medial, left medial, and left lateral lobes, or the caudate process of the caudate lobe. All dogs completed laparoscopic hepatectomy without conversion to laparotomy. Median operation time was 165 min (range: 90-230 min). Histopathology revealed hepatocellular carcinoma (n = 9) and adenoma (n = 1) and nodular hyperplasia (n = 2). Median hospital stay was 3 days (range: 2-4 days). One dog developed tension pneumothorax from an iatrogenic diaphragmatic injury, and three were diagnosed with bradycardia and hypotension following the Pringle maneuver. Disseminated hepatocellular carcinoma lesions were detected on the greater omentum in one dog 724 days post-surgery. All dogs were discharged. Laparoscopic hepatectomy using EHPC was safely performed in dogs with liver masses, with favorable short- and long-term outcomes. Laparoscopic hepatectomy using EHPC is a viable option for dogs with liver masses, provided there is no involvement of the hilar pedicle, hepatic veins at the hilus, and CVC.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 간질량에 대한 복강경 간절제술에서 en bloc hilum 혈관다발 제어(EHPC) 기법을 적용하면 개복술로의 전환 없이 안전하게 시행할 수 있으며, 양호한 단기 및 장기 임상 결과를 얻을 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 개 10마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 연구이며, hilar pedicle, hepatic vein, caudal vena cava를 침범하지 않은 간질량에 대해 복강경 간절제술을 시행했다. 중앙 수술 시간 165분(범위: 90-230분), 중앙 입원 기간 3일(범위: 2-4일), 조직병리학적으로 간세포암종 9예, 선종 1예, 결절성 과형성 2예가 확인되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] Pringle 조작 후 서맥과 저혈압이 3예에서 발생했고, 1예에서는 의인성 횡격막손상으로 긴장성 기흉이 발생했으나 모든 개가 퇴원했다. 소규모 전향적 단일기관 연구이며, hilar pedicle, hepatic vein, caudal vena cava 침범이 없는 간질량을 가진 개에서만 적용 가능하다.

papers.title: Pharmacological cardioversion of atrial flutter with oral sotalol in a dog.
papers.authors: Cavalleri G, Oricco S, Quintavalla C, Apolloni I, Crosara S
papers.abstract: A nine-year-old male Cane corso was referred for a tachyarrhythmia in the absence of symptoms. The electrocardiogram showed a narrow-QRS tachycardia with regular rhythm at 360 beats per minute. A positive atrial deflection in the ST segment was evident in leads I, II, III, augmented Vector Foot (aVF), and V2-V6. Based on these findings, typical reverse or atypical atrial flutter with 1:1 conduction was suspected. After oral administration of sotalol, the ventricular rate decreased, and flutter waves were evident with a ventricular conduction ratio varying from 2:1 to 6:1, confirming atrial flutter. Five hours later, sinus rhythm was restored. Echocardiography revealed global hypokinesia and systolic dysfunction. The dog was discharged on pimobendan and sotalol and maintained sinus rhythm until the final follow-up, several months later.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경구 소탈롤 투여로 심방세동(atrial flutter)을 약물학적으로 복귀시켜 정상 동율동을 회복한 사례이며, 추적 관찰 기간 중 정상 리듬이 유지되었다.
[방법·수치] 9세 수컷 케인 코르소 1마리에서 360회/분의 협소 QRS 빈맥을 보였고, ST 분절에서 양성 심방 편향(I, II, III, aVF, V2-V6 유도)이 관찰되어 전형적 역방향 또는 비전형적 심방세동 1:1 전도를 의심했다. 경구 소탈롤 투여 후 심실율 감소 및 심방세동파 확인(2:1~6:1 전도비)되었으며 5시간 후 동율동 복귀, 초음파에서 전역 저수축성 및 수축 기능 부전 확인되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 약물 복귀가 불가능한 심방세동에 경구 소탈롤이 효과적인 약물학적 선택지가 될 수 있으며, 피모벤단 병용으로 장기간 리듬 조절이 가능하다. 그러나 단일 증례 보고로 광범위한 임상 적용에는 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Left Atrial Appendage Closure in Patients Considered Unsuitable for Oral Anticoagulation: Randomized Outcomes Through 5 Years in ASAP-TOO.
papers.authors: Reddy VY, Buchbinder M, Nair DG, Issa ZF, Betts TR
papers.abstract: Oral anticoagulation (OAC) use in atrial fibrillation is suboptimal due to real or perceived bleeding risks. Left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) is an alternative to OAC, but pivotal trials used OAC comparators. The study sought to assess the long-term safety and effectiveness of LAAC in patients deemed unsuitable for OAC. The ASAP-TOO trial was a multinational randomized trial of patients with atrial fibrillation, CHA2DS2-VASc (congestive heart failure, hypertension, age ≥75 years, diabetes mellitus, prior stroke or transient ischemic attack or thromboembolism, vascular disease, age 65-74 years, sex category) score ≥2, and OAC unsuitability; target enrollment was 888 patients. Patients were assigned 2:1 to LAAC with a Watchman device or control treatment-single antiplatelet therapy or no therapy. Device patients received dual antiplatelet therapy for 3 months and aspirin through 12 months. The primary effectiveness endpoint was ischemic stroke or systemic embolism; the primary safety endpoint was death, ischemic stroke, systemic embolism, or 7-day device/procedure-related events requiring major intervention. Enrollment stopped early because of slow accrual, accentuated by the COVID-19 pandemic: only 481 patients were randomized (320 LAAC, 161 control treatment) and withdrawal was significant (7.8% LAAC, 24.2% control treatment), with disparate follow-up durations (median 876 days and 440.1 total patient-years of follow-up for control patients; median 1,768 days and 1,154.6 total patient-years of follow-up for LAAC patients), reducing statistical power. Patients were 75 ± 8 years of age, the CHA2DS2-VASc score was 4.6 ± 1.7, and 34% had prior intracranial/subdural hemorrhage. Implantation success was 97.8%. Only 31 of the 101 planned primary effectiveness events occurred, fewer than the 34 events required to trigger the first planned interim analysis.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경구 항응고제 부적합 판정 심방세동 환자에서 좌심방이(LAA) 폐쇄술은 97.8%의 높은 시술 성공률과 1.0%의 수용 가능한 안전성 프로파일을 보였으며, 5년 추적에서 뇌졸중/전신색전증은 LAAC 7.8% vs 대조군 11.4%(HR 0.73, P=0.39)로 수치상 유리했으나 통계적으로 유의하지 않았다.
[방법·수치] ASAP-TOO 다기관 무작위 비교 시험으로 심방세동과 CHA2DS2-VASc 점수≥2인 OAC 부적합 환자 481명(LAAC 320명, 대조군 161명)을 2:1로 배정하였고, 평균 연령 75±8세, CHA2DS2-VASc 4.6±1.7, 34%가 뇌내/경막하 출혈 기왕력을 가졌다. 주요 안전성 종료점(사망·뇌졸중·색전증·중재 필요 device 관련 사건)은 1.0% (P<0.0001), 주요 출혈은 LAAC 22.1% vs 대조군 15.7%(HR 1.64, P=0.067)로 처음 3개월에 집중되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] OAC 금기인 고령 심방세동 환자의 혈전색전증 예방 옵션으로 고려할 수 있으나, COVID-19로 인한 조기 종료로 481/888 목표 환자만 등록되어 통계적 검정력이 부족하고 대조군 추적 중단율이 24.2%로 높으며, 조기 출혈 증가는 항혈소판제 용법과 관련 가능하므로 현재의 근거는 탐색적이고 임상 의사결정에 동료 의료진 협의가 필요하다.

papers.title: High Bleeding Risk and Aspirin Omission at the Time of Primary PCI in STEMI: A Post Hoc Analysis of the PREMIUM Trial.
papers.authors: Inaba S, Ogita M, Suwa S, Kashiwabara K, Wada H
papers.abstract: Patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) at high bleeding risk (HBR) are also at increased risk of ischemic events, making the optimal antiplatelet therapy challenging. Whether HBR identifies patients who may benefit from upfront aspirin omission at the time of primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) remains unclear. In this study, we sought to evaluate whether HBR modifies the effect of aspirin omission in STEMI patients undergoing primary PCI. The PREMIUM trial randomized patients with STEMI before primary PCI to low-dose prasugrel monotherapy or dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) with aspirin plus prasugrel. In the DAPT group, patients meeting Academic Research Consortium (ARC) for HBR criteria were permitted to discontinue aspirin at 3 months, whereas non-HBR patients were intended to continue DAPT for 12 months. This post hoc analysis assessed the primary outcome of a 12-month composite of all-cause death, stroke, or myocardial infarction and the major secondary outcome of Bleeding Academic Research Consortium type 3 or 5 bleeding according to HBR status. Among 2,189 patients, 786 (35.9%) met ARC-HBR criteria. HBR patients had higher rates of the primary outcome (16.2% vs 6.2%; HR: 2.68; 95% CI: 2.05-3.52) and the major secondary outcome (10.9% vs 4.9%; HR: 2.28; 95% CI: 1.65-3.14). The primary outcome occurred with monotherapy vs DAPT in 18.0% vs 14.5% of HBR patients (HR: 1.29; 95% CI: 0.91-1.82) and 7.4% vs 5.0% of non-HBR patients (HR: 1.55; 95% CI: 1.01-2.37; P for interaction = 0.51). The major secondary outcome occurred in 9.2% vs 12.5% of HBR patients (HR: 0.71; 95% CI: 0.46-1.11) and 3.8% vs 6.1% of non-HBR patients (HR: 0.62; 95% CI: 0.38-1.00; P for interaction = 0.67). ARC-HBR identified patients with a substantially higher overall risk after primary PCI for STEMI, but did not identify a subgroup with a more favorable treatment effect of upfront aspirin omission.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] STEMI 환자에서 고출혈위험(HBR) 상태는 허혈성 사건과 출혈 위험 모두 증가를 나타내지만, 초기 아스피린 제외가 HBR 환자에서 더 유리한 치료 효과를 보이지 않았다.
[방법·수치] PREMIUM 시험의 사후 분석으로 2,189명의 STEMI 환자(HBR 기준 충족 786명, 35.9%) 중 prasugrel 단독요법 vs DAPT 비교. HBR 환자의 12개월 주요 평가변수(사망/뇌졸중/심근경색) 발생률 16.2% vs 6.2%(비HBR, HR 2.68, 95% CI 2.05-3.52), 대출혈 발생률 10.9% vs 4.9%(비HBR, HR 2.28, 95% CI 1.65-3.14). 단독요법 vs DAPT 비교에서 HBR 환자 18.0% vs 14.5%(HR 1.29, 95% CI 0.91-1.82), 비HBR 환자 7.4% vs 5.0%(HR 1.55, 95% CI 1.01-2.37, 상호작용 P=0.51).
[임상 적용·한계] HBR 상태만으로는 STEMI 환자의 초기 아스피린 제외를 결정하기에 충분하지 않으며, 일본에서 사용된 저용량 prasugrel 단독요법이라는 특수한 임상 맥락에서 해석해야 한다. 소수집단 분석으로 인한 정밀도 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Neurokinin-1 receptor antagonist (maropitant) for treatment of chronic idiopathic rhinitis in dogs: a pilot study.
papers.authors: Neittaanmäki H, Rajamäki M, Airas N, Tilamaa A, Viitanen S
papers.abstract: Chronic idiopathic rhinitis is a common canine nasal disease with unknown aetiology and poor response to treatment. Neurokinin-1 receptor activation has been associated with rhinitis in experimental animals. The aim of this pilot study was to compare the effects of oral neurokinin-1 receptor antagonist (maropitant) with placebo on clinical signs of chronic idiopathic rhinitis in dogs. Prospective randomised placebo-controlled double-blinded pilot trial. Eighteen privately owned dogs diagnosed with chronic idiopathic rhinitis based on clinical presentation, CT, rhinoscopy and histopathological findings were randomised to receive either maropitant 2 mg/kg (n = 9) or placebo (n = 9) orally, every other day for 4 weeks. Disease severity was assessed using study-specific scoring systems for CT and histopathological findings and derived from a validated questionnaire for nasal and gastrointestinal clinical signs. Each score was compared between groups at baseline. Response to treatment was assessed weekly by comparing the nasal and gastrointestinal scores between groups. Severity scores were similar between groups at baseline. Nasal scores did not differ significantly between treatment and placebo groups at the end of the trial [week 4; difference in least square means: -0.59, 95% CI -2.9 to 1.7]. The treatment group's mean score was 5.7 (range 1 to 11) at week 0 and 4.9 (range 0 to 12) at week 4, with no statistically significant change (least square means: -0.9, 95% CI -2.6 to 0.74). Alternate-day oral administration of maropitant 2 mg/kg in dogs with chronic idiopathic rhinitis did not result in a clinically relevant reduction in clinical signs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 만성 특발성 비염에 대한 뉴로키닌-1 수용체 길항제(마로피탄트) 경구 투여는 임상 증상의 임상적으로 유의미한 개선을 나타내지 못했다.
[방법·수치] 만성 특발성 비염으로 진단된 개 18마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 무작위 위약 대조 이중맹검 시험으로, 마로피탄트 2mg/kg 격일 투여군(n=9) 또는 위약군(n=9)에 4주간 배정했다. 4주차 비강 점수는 치료군과 위약군 간 유의미한 차이가 없었으며(차이: -0.59, 95% CI -2.9~1.7), 치료군 내에서도 주차 0에서 평균 5.7점(범위 1~11)에서 주차 4에 4.9점(범위 0~12)으로 통계적으로 유의미한 변화를 보이지 않았다(최소제곱 평균: -0.9, 95% CI -2.6~0.74).
[임상 적용·한계] 만성 특발성 비염의 치료로 마로피탄트 경구 투여는 현재 권장되지 않으며, 소규모 파일럿 연구로 대규모 임상시험이 필요하다.

papers.title: In vivo minimally invasive reduction and fixation of sacroiliac luxation using a dedicated novel instrument system.
papers.authors: Meilleur SJ, Podsiedlik M, Dejardin LM
papers.abstract: To evaluate the clinical safety and efficacy of a dedicated sacroiliac luxation instrument system (SILIS) featuring a minimally invasive lucent aiming device (MILAD) during osteosynthesis of sacroiliac luxation/fracture (SIL/F). We hypothesized that SILIS-MILAD assisted surgeries would be safe and as or more accurate than reported minimally invasive osteosynthesis (MIO) and open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) techniques. Prospective, observational case series. A total of 10 client owned dogs with traumatic SIL/F. Dogs with SIL/F were treated using SILIS-MILAD assisted techniques. Outcome measures included shallow dose equivalent (SDE [mrem]), percent of reduction (PoR) and hemipelvic canal width ratio (HCWR), and sacral screw orientation angles in the transverse (dorsoventral angle, DVA) and dorsal (craniocaudal, CCA) planes. Data were reported as mean ± SD using descriptive statistics. A total of 10 dogs with 13 SIL/Fs were included. Mean patient SDE was ~122 mrem ± 55 mrem. In contrast, operating room (OR) personnel SDEs were negligible (~0.8 mrem ± 0.4 mrem). Mean PoR and HCWR were 95.6% ± 5.0% and 0.9 ± 0.2, respectively. Mean DVA and CCA were 1.1° ± 0.8° and 2.3° ± 1.8°, respectively. All patients were ambulatory when discharged. Clinical SILIS-MILAD assisted SIL/F fixation eliminated surgeon and OR personnel exposure to radiation and consistently provided near anatomical reduction and as or more accurate sacral screw placement than previously reported in ORIF and MIO studies. This study demonstrates that SILIS-MILAD assisted surgeries can be safe and accurate and therefore provide a valid alternative to current open and minimally invasive techniques.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 전용 sacroiliac luxation 기구 시스템(SILIS)과 최소침습 루센트 조준 장치(MILAD)를 이용한 sacroiliac luxation/fracture 고정술은 외과의와 수술실 직원의 방사선 노출을 완전히 제거하면서도 정확한 정복과 나사 배치를 달성했다.
[방법·수치] 외상성 sacroiliac luxation/fracture를 가진 개 10마리, 13개 병변을 대상으로 한 전향적 관찰 증례 연구. 환자 평균 선량당량 122 mrem ± 55 mrem, 수술실 직원 0.8 mrem ± 0.4 mrem, 정복률 95.6% ± 5.0%, 반골반 관 너비 비율 0.9 ± 0.2, 횡단면 나사 각도 1.1° ± 0.8°, 등쪽 나사 각도 2.3° ± 1.8°.
[임상 적용·한계] SILIS-MILAD 보조 기술은 개의 sacroiliac luxation/fracture 치료 시 현재의 개방성 및 최소침습 기법의 유효한 대안이 될 수 있으며, 모든 환자가 퇴원 시 보행 가능했다. 그러나 소규모 증례 연구(n=10)로 장기 추적 결과 없다.

papers.title: Efficacy of Oral Lotilaner in Controlling Clinical Signs in Cats Naturally Infested With Lynxacarus radovskyi.
papers.authors: da Mota de Magalhães Y, Marques DM, Christ LX, Campos DR, Fernandes JI
papers.abstract: Lynxacarus radovskyi is a pilicolous mite that may cause pruritus and coat or skin lesions in cats. Evidence regarding the efficacy of oral lotilaner for the treatment of feline lynxacariasis remains limited. To evaluate the parasitological and clinical efficacy of oral lotilaner in cats naturally infested with L. radovskyi. Twenty client-owned cats naturally infested with L. radovskyi. A prospective, longitudinal, parallel-group study was conducted with 20 cats allocated to a treated group (n = 10) or an untreated control group (n = 10). Treated cats received oral lotilaner on Day (D)0 and D30. Parasitological assessment was performed every 7 days from D0 to D63 using trichograms obtained from three anatomical sites and scored using a semi-quantitative scale. Pruritus and clinical lesion scores also were recorded. Treatment with lotilaner resulted in a significant reduction in parasitological scores from D7 onwards (p = 0.0033), while untreated cats remained persistently infested. Mite-count reduction increased progressively, reaching 98.0% at D35 and 100% from D42 onwards after the second administration. Pruritus and clinical lesion scores also decreased significantly compared with baseline (p = 0.0117). Oral lotilaner administered twice (D0 and D30) was effective for the treatment of feline lynxacariasis under natural infestation conditions, resulting in rapid parasite reduction and significant clinical improvement.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경구 로틸라네르는 고양이 린크스진드기 감염증에서 D7부터 기생충 점수의 유의미한 감소를 보였으며, D42부터 100% 제거율을 달성하고 가려움증 및 임상 병변도 유의미하게 개선시켰다.
[방법·수치] 자연 감염된 고양이 20마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 종단 평행군 연구(처치군 10마리, 대조군 10마리)로, D0과 D30에 경구 로틸라네르 투여 후 D0부터 D63까지 7일 간격으로 삼모검사를 통해 평가했다. 처치군에서 D7부터 기생충 점수 감소(p=0.0033), D35에서 98.0% 제거율, D42부터 100% 제거율 달성, 가려움증 및 임상 병변 점수 유의미한 감소(p=0.0117).
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 린크스진드기 감염증의 치료로 2회 경구 투여 용법이 임상적으로 효과적이며 빠른 기생충 제거와 임상 개선을 제공한다. 단일 연구기관의 소규모 자연 감염 사례 연구이며 장기 재감염 예방 효과는 평가되지 않았다.

papers.title: Characterization and in Vitro Radiation Response Analysis of Patient-Derived Heterogeneous Cells From Canine Oral Melanoma.
papers.authors: Hwang G, Oh SJ, Hong IH, Choi MY, Lee SL
papers.abstract: Conventional cancer cell lines often fail to capture tumour heterogeneity, limiting their translational relevance for radiation response studies. This study aimed to establish a low-passage, patient-derived heterogeneous culture and to evaluate its radiation response characteristics. Tumour tissue obtained from a canine oral melanoma patient was used to generate the culture. Cellular heterogeneity was confirmed by morphological features and the expression of stem cell-associated markers (CD133+CD44+: 50.53% ± 5.05%, CD133-CD44+: 30.93% ± 7.21%). Tumorigenicity was validated using a xenograft model. Radiation responses to 2 and 10 Gy were assessed using clonogenic survival, viability, proliferation, apoptosis, DNA damage, migration, and invasion assays. The culture demonstrated morphological heterogeneity, expression of stem cell-associated markers, and tumorigenic potential in vivo. Compared with the 0 Gy control, 10 Gy irradiation significantly reduced cell viability, proliferative activity, and migration, while increasing early apoptosis and DNA damage (all p < 0.006). These effects were generally more pronounced after 10 Gy than after 2 Gy. Notably, clonogenic survival curves deviated from the linear-quadratic model, indicating non-classical radiation response behaviour in heterogeneous cell populations. This proof-of-concept study suggests that a low-passage, patient-derived heterogeneous culture may serve as a practical and biologically informative in vitro platform for investigating radiation responses in canine oral melanoma. Further validation using additional patient-derived cultures and comparisons with corresponding clinical radiation responses is needed.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 구강흑색종에서 유래한 저계대 이종 세포 배양물은 형태학적 이질성, 줄기세포 표지자 발현, 생체 내 종양형성능을 보유하며, 10 Gy 방사선 조사 시 고전적 선형-이차 모델에서 벗어난 비고전적 방사선 반응을 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 개 구강흑색종 종양 조직으로부터 저계대 이종 배양물을 확립하였고, 형태학적 특성과 줄기세포 표지자(CD133+CD44+: 50.53%±5.05%, CD133-CD44+: 30.93%±7.21%) 발현으로 이질성을 확인하였으며, 2 Gy와 10 Gy 방사선 조사에 대한 반응을 평가하였다. 10 Gy 조사 시 세포 생존력, 증식 활성, 이동성이 유의하게 감소하고 조기 세포자멸사와 DNA 손상이 증가하였다(모두 p<0.006).
[임상 적용·한계] 이 모델은 개 구강흑색종의 방사선 반응을 조사하기 위한 실용적이고 생물학적으로 정보가 풍부한 생체 외 플랫폼으로 활용될 수 있으나, 추가 환자 유래 배양물을 이용한 검증과 임상 방사선 반응과의 비교가 필요한 개념증명 단계의 연구이다.

papers.title: Medial Tympanic Membrane Displacement in Five Dogs Resembling Tympanic Membrane Retraction in Humans.
papers.authors: Botelho CB, Ferreira TS, Gmyterco VC, Alves C, Nuttall T
papers.abstract: Five dogs with head tilt, ataxia, incoordination or deafness without a history of otitis externa (OE) were diagnosed with otitis media by computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Otoendoscopy showed possible tympanic membrane retraction with opaque, fibrotic membranes and advanced imaging showed middle ear involvement. The clinical significance requires further investigation.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 외이염 병력이 없는 5마리 개에서 두부기울임, 운동실조, 협응불능, 청력소실 등의 임상증상이 중이염과 연관되었으며, 고막이 함몰되고 불투명하고 섬유화된 양상을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 증상을 보인 개 5마리를 대상으로 CT 또는 MRI로 중이염을 진단했고, 이내시경으로 고막 함몰과 섬유화 소견을 확인했으며, 첨단영상검사로 중이강 침범을 확인했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 외이염 없이 신경학적 증상만 나타나는 개에서 중이염을 의심하고 영상진단을 고려할 필요가 있으나, 임상적 의의는 추가 조사가 필요하며 증례보고로 일반화에 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Left Atrial Appendage Closure in Atrial Fibrillation Patients With High Risk of Stroke and Bleeding: An Individual Participant Data Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
papers.authors: Skurk C, Eitel I, Thevathasan T, Neuzil P, Kirchhof P
papers.abstract: Percutaneous left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) is increasingly used as an alternative to oral anticoagulation for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation. Its comparative effectiveness and safety in patients at a high risk of both stroke and bleeding remain uncertain. We evaluated the efficacy and safety of LAAC vs contemporary medical therapy in a high-risk population using individual participant data from randomized trials. Bibliographic databases and trial registries through August 5, 2026, were searched for randomized trials comparing percutaneous LAAC with contemporary medical therapy in populations with a trial-level mean CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥4. A 1-stage common-effect analysis used Cox models stratified by trial and adjusted for age, sex, CHA2DS2-VASc score, and HAS-BLED score. Both primary outcomes were time to first stroke, systemic embolism, or cardiovascular/unknown death (efficacy) and time to first major bleeding (safety). A flexible time-varying Cox model was used for major bleeding. The protocol was submitted to PROSPERO (CRD420261335972). CLOSURE-AF (Left Atrial Appendage CLOSURE in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation Compared to Medical Therapy) and PRAGUE-17 (Left Atrial Appendage Closure vs. Novel Anticoagulation Agents in Atrial Fibrillation) contributed 1,290 participants (647 assigned to LAAC and 643 to control). Median age was 77.3 years (Q1-Q3: 71.4-81.9 years), and 809 participants (62.7%) were men. The primary efficacy outcome occurred in 142 LAAC participants (21.9%) and 133 control subjects (20.7%) (adjusted HR: 0.98; 95% CI: 0.77-1.24; P = 0.842). Major bleeding occurred in 86 LAAC participants (13.3%) and 80 control subjects (12.4%) (adjusted HR: 1.03; 95% CI: 0.75-1.39; P = 0.874).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고위험 심방세동 환자에서 좌심방귀 폐쇄술(LAAC)은 현대적 약물치료와 비교하여 뇌졸중/전신색전증/심혈관사망의 일차 유효성 결과에서 통계적으로 유의미한 차이를 보이지 않았으며, 대출혈도 비슷한 수준이었다.
[방법·수치] CLOSURE-AF와 PRAGUE-17 두 무작위 임상시험의 개별 참가자 데이터 메타분석으로 1,290명(LAAC 647명, 대조군 643명, 평균연령 77.3세, 남성 62.7%)을 분석하였다. 일차 유효성 결과: LAAC 21.9% vs 대조군 20.7%(보정 HR 0.98, 95% CI 0.77-1.24, P=0.842), 대출혈: LAAC 13.3% vs 대조군 12.4%(보정 HR 1.03, 95% CI 0.75-1.39, P=0.874), 1년 시점의 누적 대출혈 발생률은 LAAC 9.4% vs 대조군 6.0%(절대위험도차 3.4 percentage points)였다.
[임상 적용·한계] LAAC은 고위험 심방세동 환자에서 항응고제 치료의 대안으로 고려될 수 있으나, 뇌졸중 예방 효과가 증명되지 않았고 초기 대출혈 위험이 증가하는 경향을 보여 더 장기간의 무작위 대조시험 데이터가 필요하다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Great debate: a dual biomarker strategy improves the triage of patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome.
papers.authors: Giannitsis E, Mueller C, Huber K, Möckel M, Schröder M
papers.abstract: Suspected myocardial infarction in patients with acute chest pain at rest is one of the most common diagnostic categories leading to emergency hospital admission and emergency department overcrowding worldwide. Efforts are being made to improve the efficiency of currently used triage and diagnostic work-up strategies. Despite major advances in recent years with the use of high-sensitivity cardiac troponin, challenges still exist regarding how to accurately and rapidly rule out or rule in myocardial infarction, as current strategies are relatively slow due to the need for serial troponin measurements. The 2023 European Society of Cardiology (ESC) guidelines recommend a 0 h/1 h or a 0 h/2 h high-sensitivity troponin diagnostic algorithm, instead of the previously suggested 0 h/3 h diagnostic protocol, to reduce the time required to discharge patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome/myocardial infarction. The ESC endorsed algorithms are not without difficulty, and alternative ways of improving triaging have been proposed, particularly a dual biomarker rule-out strategy involving the combined measurement of copeptin and troponin. Supporters of the dual biomarker strategy argue that a timely optimized algorithm can potentially allow the safe rule-out of myocardial infarction earlier than currently used strategies. In the present Great Debate article, two expert teams discuss the 'pros' and 'cons' of implementing single vs dual biomarker strategies for the rule-in and rule-out of myocardial infarction, under the moot topic 'A dual biomarker strategy improves the triage of patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome'. They address in detail many of the controversial issues currently affecting everyday clinical practice and provide insightful comments on how to best triage patients presenting with suspected acute myocardial infarction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 급성 흉통 환자의 급성 관상동맥증후군 선별에서 고감도 심장 트로포닌 단독 전략보다 코페프틴과 트로포닌의 이중 바이오마커 전략이 더 빠른 배제 진단을 가능하게 할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 2023 ESC 가이드라인에서 권장하는 0h/1h 또는 0h/2h 고감도 트로포닌 알고리즘과 이중 바이오마커 전략(코페프틴+트로포닌)을 비교한 전문가 토론 형식의 검토; 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 응급실 혼잡 완화와 환자 조기 퇴원을 위해 이중 바이오마커 전략의 도입 타당성을 검토하는 자료이나, 실제 임상 적용 효과에 대한 직접적인 임상 증거는 토론 형식이므로 추가 연구 필요.

papers.title: Antimicrobial resistance and molecular characterization of extended-spectrum β-lactamase/AmpC β-lactamase-producing Proteus mirabilis isolates from companion dogs in South Korea (2018-2024).
papers.authors: Hwang YJ, Lee YH, Ali MS, Choi JH, Park SC
papers.abstract: To investigate antimicrobial resistance profiles and molecular characteristics of third-generation cephalosporin- and cephamycin-resistant Proteus mirabilis isolated from clinically ill dogs across South Korea from 2018 through 2024. Antimicrobial susceptibility of isolates was assessed by broth microdilution. Molecular characteristics were determined by polymerase chain reaction and multilocus sequence typing. In total, 667 P mirabilis were isolated from skin/ear, feces, and urine/reproductive systems of companion dogs. Among them, 27.3% of isolates exhibited a multidrug-resistant (MDR) phenotype. Molecular characterization of 38 extended-spectrum β-lactamase (5.7%)/AmpC β-lactamase-carrying strains revealed a high prevalence of β-lactamase cephamycinase-2 gene blaCMY-2 (65.8%) and β-lactamase cefotaximase gene blaCTX-M variants, including blaCTX-M-65, blaCTX-M-15, and blaCTX-M-90. Multilocus sequence typing identified 16 distinct sequence types (STs), with ST135 (39.5%) and ST212 (21.1%) emerging as the most prevalent lineages. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that the first major cluster contains 31 isolates (81.6%) across 10 STs centered around ST135, whereas the second cluster comprises 7 isolates (18.4%) across 6 STs centered on ST292. Notably, the ST135-centered cluster was associated with robust MDR phenotypes. These findings indicate that companion dogs harboring MDR P mirabilis are among several potential reservoirs within the One Health context. Especially, clone ST135 may serve as a primary evolutionary axis and a high-risk endemic clone within the Korean canine population. Our study highlights the critical role of dominant lineages in dissemination of extended-spectrum β-lactamase/AmpC β-lactamase genes and emphasizes the urgent need for continuous One Health surveillance to monitor potential transmission of these clones between companion animals and humans.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 한국의 반려견에서 분리된 Proteus mirabilis의 27.3%가 다제내성(MDR) 표현형을 보였으며, ESBL/AmpC β-lactamase 생성 균주(5.7%)에서 blaCMY-2(65.8%)와 blaCTX-M 변이가 주로 검출되었고, ST135 클론이 강한 MDR 표현형과 연관되어 있었다. [방법·수치] 2018-2024년 한국의 반려견에서 분리된 Proteus mirabilis 667주를 대상으로 액체미량희석법으로 항균제 감수성 검사를 수행하고, PCR과 다위치염기서열분석법으로 분자특성을 분석했으며, 38개 ESBL/AmpC β-lactamase 생성 균주(5.7%)에서 16개의 서열형(ST)을 확인했고 ST135(39.5%)와 ST212(21.1%)가 가장 우세했다. [임상 적용·한계] 반려견의 다제내성 P. mirabilis는 One Health 관점에서 인수공통감염 가능성이 있으므로 지속적인 역학조사와 감시가 필요하며, ST135 클론의 추적관리가 중요하다. 다만 단일 국가 데이터이고 임상 감염과 보균의 구분이 명확하지 않을 수 있다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Comparing traditional, strain and ellipsoid model indices of right ventricular function with real-time three-dimensional echocardiographic ejection fraction in dogs.
papers.authors: Tagg BE, Ciardullo R, Mintz SB, Pariaut R, Hsue W
papers.abstract: Ejection fraction (EF) provides a global assessment of right ventricular (RV) function but is challenging to calculate because of complex geometry. The ellipsoid model enables estimation of EF from two-dimensional echocardiography using area-based or linear-based formulas (AEM-EF and LEM-EF). The objective of the present study was to compare AEM-EF, LEM-EF and other indices of RV function against real-time three-dimensional echocardiographic EF (RT3D-EF). Seventy-three dogs (23 healthy, 50 with right-sided heart disease) were prospectively imaged. Measurements included basal, mid-cavity, longitudinal and outflow tract fractional shortening; body weight-normalized tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion (TAPSEn); body weight-normalized tissue Doppler-derived tricuspid annular peak systolic myocardial velocity (S'n); fractional area change (FAC); free wall strain and global longitudinal strain; AEM-EF and LEM-EF; and RT3D-EF. All indices except TAPSEn and S'n correlated with RT3D-EF. Systematic biases for AEM-EF and LEM-EF relative to RT3D-EF were minimal (mean difference [95% confidence interval]: 2.8% [0.4-5.2%] and -1.0% [-3.5 to 1.5%]), although agreements were poor (rc [95% confidence interval] = 0.627 [0.476-0.742] and 0.588 [0.420-0.718]). The FAC and free wall strain were the strongest independent predictors of RT3D-EF in multivariate regression (R2 adjusted = 0.519). The main limitation of the present study is the absence of a true reference standard for RV function. Although AEM-EF and LEM-EF can estimate EF from two-dimensional images, they show poor agreement with RT3D-EF and do not outperform FAC. Additionally, neither TAPSEn nor S'n correlated with RT3D-EF, highlighting the need for further validation of these indices against robust reference standards.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 우심실 기능 평가를 위한 2D 기반 타원체 모델(AEM-EF, LEM-EF)은 실시간 3D 심초음파 EF와 최소한의 계통오차를 보이지만 일치도가 불량하며, FAC와 free wall strain이 RT3D-EF의 가장 강력한 독립 예측인자이다.
[방법·수치] 개 73마리(정상 23마리, 우심질환 50마리)를 전향적으로 영상 검사하여 다양한 우심실 기능 지표(FS, TAPSEn, S'n, FAC, strain, AEM-EF, LEM-EF)를 RT3D-EF와 비교 분석; AEM-EF와 LEM-EF의 평균차이는 각각 2.8%[-0.4-5.2%]와 -1.0%[-3.5-1.5%]이나 일치도(rc)는 0.627과 0.588으로 불량; FAC와 free wall strain의 조정 R2 = 0.519.
[임상 적용·한계] FAC와 free wall strain을 2D 심초음파에서 우심실 기능 평가에 선호할 수 있으나, TAPSEn과 S'n은 RT3D-EF와 상관관계가 없어 임상 적용에 주의 필요; 본 연구는 참고표준 부재가 주요 한계이며 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Monocortical locking screws in the tibial diaphysis maintain tibial plateau angle and support osteotomy union after tibial plateau leveling osteotomy in dogs.
papers.authors: Wong N, Eckart LH, Yu J, Bleakley S, Jermyn K
papers.abstract: To evaluate the effect of distal monocortical locking screw fixation on construct stability and bone healing following tibial plateau leveling osteotomy (TPLO) in dogs. We hypothesized that monocortical fixation would result in acceptable maintenance of tibial plateau angle (TPA) of < 5° and satisfactory osteotomy union. Medical records from a companion animal referral hospital between December 8, 2021, and February 23, 2024, were retrospectively reviewed. Dogs were included if TPLO was performed for cranial cruciate ligament insufficiency using monocortical screws in the distal tibial segment and complete radiographic follow-up was available. Change in TPA between postoperative and follow-up radiographs were recorded. Bone healing was assessed using the modified Radiographic Union Scale for Tibial Fractures. Associations between outcomes and clinical variables were evaluated with linear regression models. A total of 117 dogs met the inclusion criteria. Median change in TPA during healing was 2.15° (95% CI, 1.70° to 2.65°), and no evaluated variables were associated with TPA change. Median modified Radiographic Union Scale for Tibial Fractures score was 10 (range, 4 to 12), consistent with satisfactory radiographic union at a mean follow-up time of 43 days. The overall complication rate was 8.5%, including an infection rate of 2.6%. Use of monocortical distal tibial screws within a titanium alloy conical locking TPLO system was associated with acceptable maintenance of TPA and satisfactory radiographic union scores. Monocortical distal tibial fixation may provide sufficient stability to support osteotomy healing per manufacturer recommendations. Additional studies are needed to evaluate outcomes for different locking systems, patient size categories, screw combination, and longer-term follow-up periods.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경골 관상면 수평각(TPA)이 5도 이상 변할 위험이 낮으며 단피질 고정 나사를 사용한 경골 관상면 수평화 골절단술(TPLO) 후 골유합이 만족스러웠다.
[방법·수치] 2021년 12월부터 2024년 2월까지 전향적 동반동물 병원에서 TPLO 수술을 받은 개 117마리 대상, 단피질 나사로 원위부 경골 분절 고정. 수술 후 추적 방사선 사진 사이의 TPA 변화는 중앙값 2.15도(95% 신뢰구간 1.70~2.65도), 수정된 경골 골절 방사선학적 유합 척도 중앙값 10점(범위 4~12점), 평균 추적 관찰 기간 43일, 전체 합병증율 8.5%, 감염률 2.6%.
[임상 적용·한계] 티타늄 합금 원뿔형 고정 TPLO 시스템에서 단피질 원위부 경골 나사 사용은 경골 관상면 수평각 유지와 골유합에 충분한 안정성을 제공하므로 임상 권장사항에 따른 사용이 가능하다. 그러나 다양한 고정 시스템, 환자 크기별 범주, 나사 조합, 장기 추적 관찰에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Extreme morphologies compromise canine health and welfare and require evidence-based breeding reform.
papers.authors: Hekman JP, Barton SA, Hecht EE, and the Canine Morphology and Welfare Working Group
papers.abstract: In recent years, morphology-driven welfare issues in the domestic dog have moved from the periphery to the center of public and professional attention, driven by breed-specific legislation and bans, dedicated sessions at major welfare conferences, and sustained scrutiny on social media. While these concerns are supported by a growing body of evidence linking extreme traits to chronic disease and compromised welfare, most research has asked only whether 1 breed or trait extreme differs from another. These approaches leave a critical question unanswered: which range of a given morphological trait is actually healthiest? Advice to "breed away from extremes" therefore lacks an evidence-based target. This review surveys common canine morphological phenotypes, including body size, skull shape (brachycephaly), chondrodysplasia and chondrodystrophy, thoracic depth, tail and vertebral conformation, skin folds, and coat color and hairlessness. For each, we summarize the associated disorders, the underlying biological mechanisms where known, and the welfare consequences. Examining these phenotypes in aggregate rather than trait by trait reveals insights that single-trait studies cannot. Shared mechanisms (eg, accelerated growth, soft tissue / skeleton mismatch, melanocyte loss) drive multiple disorders simultaneously, and trade-offs across body systems become apparent. We argue that meaningful progress-the kind these legislative, professional, and public efforts are ultimately seeking-requires reframing canine welfare research toward optimization, namely, identifying the phenotypic range that minimizes total morbidity. Such targets are prerequisites for evidence-based breeding goals, revised breed standards, and informed public decision-making. This manuscript is signed by over 30 canine biology and welfare experts who support its content.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 극단적 형태학적 특징(단두종, 왜소증, 극단적 체형 등)은 만성질환 및 복지 문제와 연관되어 있으며, 번식 개선을 위해서는 단일 특징 비교가 아닌 각 형질별 최적 범위 규명이 필수적이다.
[방법·수치] 체형 크기, 두개골 형태(단두증), 연골이형성증, 흉부 깊이, 꼬리 및 척추 구조, 피부 주름, 털 색상 및 무모증 등 개의 형태학적 표현형 전반을 종설적으로 검토했으며, 각 표현형별 연관 질환, 생물학적 기전, 복지 결과를 정리했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 각 형태학적 특징이 공유된 기전(가속화된 성장, 연부 조직/골격 부조화, 멜라닌세포 손실)을 통해 복합 질환을 초래하므로, 임상의는 단일 특징이 아닌 개별 개의 전체 이환율을 최소화하는 최적 표현형 범위를 번식 목표 설정 시 고려해야 한다. 이는 종설 논문으로 직접 임상 증거보다는 근거 기반 번식 개선의 방향 제시에 제한된다.

papers.title: Predicting the presence of an enlarged pituitary gland in ACTH-dependent hyperadrenocorticism in dogs using T4, TSH and ACTH concentrations.
papers.authors: Chamagne A, Desquilbet L, Pichard D, Rosenberg D, Benchekroun G
papers.abstract: ACTH-dependent hyperadrenocorticism (ADHAC) can be subclassified based on the pituitary height-to-brain area ratio (P/B), a P/B ≥ 0.31 defining an enlarged pituitary gland. We aimed to identify dogs with ADHAC and an enlarged pituitary gland using plasma ACTH and serum T4, TSH and IGF-1 concentrations. Twenty-three dogs with ADHAC were retrospectively included (12 with P/B < 0.31, 11 with P/B ≥ 0.31). ACTH concentration was significantly higher and T4/TSH ratio significantly lower in dogs with P/B ≥ 0.31 (both P < 0.01), whereas IGF-1 was not discriminant. An ACTH cut-off of 44.3 pg/mL showed a sensitivity of 72.7% and a specificity of 100%, and a T4/TSH cut-off of 107.2 a sensitivity of 100% and a specificity of 75% (AUC 0.87 for both). A prediction score combining these cut-offs was calculated for each dog; a score of 0 was associated with a negative predictive value of 100% (95% CI 66-100%) for pituitary enlargement. In a validation cohort of 9 dogs with pituitary enlargement, 8 had a score ≥ 1 and 1 a score of 0. Plasma ACTH concentration and T4/TSH ratio may help identify dogs with ADHAC at low risk of pituitary enlargement, although validation in larger cohorts is required.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] ACTH 농도와 T4/TSH 비율을 조합한 예측 점수가 뇌하수체 비대를 동반한 ACTH 의존성 부신피질항진증(ADHAC) 개를 선별하는 데 도움이 될 수 있으며, 점수 0은 뇌하수체 비대 부재에 대해 100%의 음성 예측값을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 23마리의 ADHAC 개(P/B < 0.31: 12마리, P/B ≥ 0.31: 11마리)를 후향적으로 분석했다. ACTH 농도 44.3 pg/mL 기준값에서 민감도 72.7%, 특이도 100%를 보였고, T4/TSH 비율 107.2 기준값에서 민감도 100%, 특이도 75%를 보였다(둘 다 AUC 0.87). 뇌하수체 비대 그룹에서 P < 0.01의 통계적 유의성이 확인되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상에서 혈장 ACTH와 T4/TSH 비율로 뇌하수체 비대 저위험 개를 선별할 수 있으나, 후향적 소규모 연구(23마리)로 대규모 코호트에서의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: A 3D mitral valve interstitial cell model recapitulates selected transcriptomic signatures of degenerative mitral valve disease.
papers.authors: Zhao Y, Chen Y, Ding R, Zhang M, Chen S
papers.abstract: Degenerative mitral valve disease (DMVD) is a highly prevalent cardiovascular disorder in humans, dogs and pigs. However, the molecular mechanisms driving mitral valve interstitial cell (VIC) activation and extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling remain incompletely understood. In this study, we established a three-dimensional (3D) VIC-collagen model (VIC-COL) to investigate the cellular changes of VIC activation and ECM remodeling in response to transforming growth factor-β1 (TGF-β1) stimulation. The results revealed that upregulation of α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA), fibronectin and matrix metalloproteinase 2 (MMP2) was induced by TGF-β1 in the VIC-COL model; subsequent transcriptomic profiling identified a significant phenotypic shift toward pro-inflammatory and matrix remodeling pathways. Crucially, comparative transcriptomic analysis with naturally occurred DMVD public datasets identified 120 shared Gene Ontology (GO) biological process pathways and 111 conserved differentially expressed genes. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analysis confirmed that TGF-β1 treatment in the porcine in vitro model recapitulates a subset of the transcriptional features of DMVD, including the cell adhesion molecules, ECM-receptor interactions, tumor necrosis factor (TNF) signaling and cytokine-cytokine receptor interactions. Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) further corroborated concordant Hallmark inflammatory signatures, including TNF-α signaling via nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-κB), and interleukin-6/Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (IL-6/JAK/STAT3) signaling. These shared transcriptomic features indicate that TGF-β1 stimulation captures certain molecular aspects of ECM remodeling, VIC activation, and inflammatory-related signaling seen in naturally occurring DMVD. Collectively, the 3D VIC-COL system provides a reproducible in vitro platform for investigating selected molecular mechanisms of DMVD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 3차원 판막 간질세포-콜라겐 모델에서 TGF-β1 자극으로 α-SMA, 피브로넥틴, MMP2 발현 상향조절이 유도되며, 이는 자연발생 퇴행성 승모판막질환의 전사체 특성 일부를 재현한다.
[방법·수치] 돼지 판막 간질세포 3D 모델에서 TGF-β1 처리 후 전사체 분석 수행; 자연발생 질환 데이터와의 비교분석에서 120개의 공유 유전자온톨로지 경로와 111개의 보존된 차등발현유전자 확인, TNF/NF-κB 및 IL-6/JAK/STAT3 신호전달 경로 활성화 확인.
[임상 적용·한계] 본 3D 모델은 퇴행성 승모판막질환의 분자 메커니즘 연구를 위한 재현성 있는 시험관내 플랫폼을 제공하나, 개와 돼지의 자연발생 질환 모델과의 직접적 임상 검증이 필요하고 복잡한 판막 미세환경의 모든 측면을 완전히 반영하지 못한다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Clinical, hematological, biochemical, and biomarker alterations in neonatal canine sepsis.
papers.authors: da Mata Fuchs K, Pereira KHNP, Xavier GM, Mendonça JC, da Cunha RA
papers.abstract: Sepsis is one of the leading causes of mortality during the first weeks of life in canine neonates, and early diagnosis is essential to reduce these rates. This study aimed to evaluate changes in clinical, hematological, biochemical, and biomarker parameters (procalcitonin, C-reactive protein, and troponin I levels) in neonatal sepsis in dogs. Descriptive statistics, normality testing, group comparisons, and Pearson or Spearman correlations were performed, with significance set at p < 0.05. Biomarker cut-off values were determined using ROC curve analysis based on sensitivity and specificity above 80%. Thirty-one neonates were included, with 17 animals in the sepsis group (SG) and 14 in the control group (CG). In the assessment of clinical parameters, signs of systemic infection, such as diarrhea, erythema of the body, omphalitis, ecchymoses or hematomas, and cyanosis or necrosis of the extremities, were observed. Neonates in the SG showed bradycardia (p < 0.05), hypothermia (p < 0.05), and reduced neurological reflexes (p < 0.05). Leukopenia (p < 0.05), hyperlactatemia (p < 0.01), hyperkalemia (p < 0.05), and increased cardiac troponin I (p < 0.01) were observed in the SG. A negative correlation was detected between the leukocyte count and the lactate concentration (r = -0.59; p < 0.01) and between the neutrophil count and the troponin I concentration (r = -0.57; p < 0.01). A positive correlation was observed between body temperature and leukocytes (r = 0.54, p < 0.01). Additionally, there was a trend toward thrombocytopenia, hypoglycemia, and increased CRP in the SG, although these findings did not reach statistical significance. The origin of the infections was predominantly maternal (intrauterine or via mastitis), with isolation of beta-hemolytic Streptococcus from uterine swabs (41.2%), Staphylococcus sp. from uterine swabs and milk (35.3%), and Streptococcus sp. from milk only (23.5%).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 신생 자견 패혈증은 백혈구감소증, 고락테이트혈증, 고칼륨혈증, 심장트로포닌I 상승을 특징으로 하며, 모체 유래 감염(자궁 내 또는 유선염)이 주요 원인이다.
[방법·수치] 신생 자견 31마리(패혈증군 17마리, 대조군 14마리)를 대상으로 임상·혈액학·생화학·바이오마커(프로칼시토닌, CRP, 심장트로포닌I) 변화를 평가했다. 패혈증군에서 서맥(p<0.05), 저체온(p<0.05), 신경반사 감소(p<0.05), 백혈구감소증(p<0.05), 고락테이트혈증(p<0.01), 고칼륨혈증(p<0.05), 심장트로포닌I 상승(p<0.01)이 관찰되었다. 백혈구와 락테이트의 음의 상관(r=-0.59, p<0.01), 호중구와 트로포닌I의 음의 상관(r=-0.57, p<0.01) 발견되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 신생 자견 패혈증의 조기 진단은 산자 모니터링, 임상 징후(설사, 제대염, 극단부 괴사), 백혈구감소증, 세균배양, 락테이트(≥3 mmol/L), 심장트로포닌I(≥0.1 ng/dL)에 의존하며, 소규모 단일 기관 연구로 추후 직렬 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Seventeen Cases of Fungal Otitis Externa in Dogs and Cats.
papers.authors: Tang X, Luo X, Liu X, Zhao B, Wang F
papers.abstract: Otitis externa (OE) is common in dogs and cats. Fungal OE (FOE) caused by non-Malassezia species fungi is relatively uncommon. Comprehensive information on clinical manifestations, risk factors and breeds or species predispositions remains sparse. In this case series, we describe 17 companion animals in China with FOE. To describe the clinical signs, potential risk factors and treatment of FOE in dogs and cats. Seventeen cases: four dogs and 13 cats. Retrospective review of medical records of cases presented to dermatology specialty practices for OE between 2022 and 2024 was performed. Records with positive fungal culture results were included. Case demographic, diagnostic and treatment information was extracted. Aspergillus spp. was isolated from 13 animals (three dogs, 10 cats), Microsporum canis from one dog and two cats, and one cat had a mixed infection with M. canis in the left ear and Aspergillus spp. in the right. The most common clinical signs were excessive cerumen and pruritus. Of 16 cases that received antifungal treatment, 13 received combined oral and topical therapy, and three received only oral therapy. Aspergillus spp. or dermatophyte infection should not be overlooked in cases of chronic or recurrent OE. Cytological examination of exudates and fungal culture are useful for establishing the diagnosis of FOE. Larger prospective studies are needed to elucidate risk factors and appropriate treatment for FOE.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 외이염 중 Aspergillus spp.와 Microsporum canis 등 비-Malassezia 진균 감염은 상대적으로 드물지만 만성 또는 재발성 외이염에서 간과하지 말아야 한다.
[방법·수치] 중국의 피부과 전문 클리닉에 2022~2024년 내원한 외이염 환자 중 진균 배양 양성인 17례(개 4례, 고양이 13례)의 의료 기록을 후향적으로 검토했다. Aspergillus spp. 13례(개 3, 고양이 10), Microsporum canis 3례(개 1, 고양이 2), 혼합감염 1례(고양이). 가장 흔한 임상 증상은 과도한 이지와 가려움증이었으며, 치료받은 16례 중 13례는 경구 및 국소 항진균제 병용, 3례는 경구 단독 치료를 받았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 세포진 검사와 진균 배양이 진균성 외이염 진단 확립에 유용하다. 후향적 소규모 사례 보고로 위험 인자와 적절한 치료법 규명을 위한 대규모 전향적 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Interpreting High-Sensitivity Cardiac Troponin in Clinical Practice and Emerging Directions: Detection Is No Longer Diagnosis.
papers.authors: Spanos M, Januzzi JL Jr
papers.abstract: High-sensitivity cardiac troponin (hs-cTn) assays have solved the problem of detecting myocardial injury and, in doing so, created the problem of classifying it. Abnormal troponin concentrations are now known to be common across a wide spectrum of cardiac and systemic disease, and the central challenge of contemporary practice is no longer whether myocardial injury can be detected, but whether it can be correctly classified. Misclassification occurs in both directions and with real consequence: nonischemic myocardial injury is frequently mislabeled as secondary myocardial infarction (MI), contributing to the overdiagnosis of MI, and chronic myocardial injury, which carries a risk of subsequent MI or cardiovascular death approaching that of primary MI, is routinely dismissed once infarction has been excluded. This narrative review argues that accurate classification cannot be delegated to an algorithm and instead requires integrated, context-aware interpretation grounded in 4 domains: 1) the analytical and biological properties of hs-cTnI and hs-cTnT, including assay-specific and sex-specific thresholds, clearance kinetics, and sources of analytical interference and false-positive results; 2) the capabilities and limitations of guideline-endorsed serial testing, including the European Society of Cardiology 0/1h and 0/2h algorithms, point-of-care platforms, and artificial intelligence-based decision support; 3) rigorous application of the Fifth Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction, in particular the distinctions between myocardial injury, necrosis, and infarction, and between diagnosis and risk stratification; and 4) recognition of the non-acute coronary syndrome conditions-chronic kidney disease, heart failure, sepsis, tachyarrhythmias, pulmonary embolism, takotsubo syndrome, and others-in which troponin elevation is expected rather than anomalous.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고감도 심장트로포닌(hs-cTn)은 심근손상 검출은 우수하나, 심근경색과 비허혈성 심근손상의 정확한 분류가 현대 임상의 중심 과제이며, 알고리즘만으로는 정확한 분류가 불가능하고 임상의의 통합적 해석이 필수이다.
[방법·수치] 내러티브 리뷰로서 hs-cTnI/hs-cTnT의 분석적·생물학적 특성(성별·검사법별 기준값, 청소동역학, 위음성 원인), ESC 0/1h·0/2h 알고리즘 등 연속 검사 방법, 제5차 심근경색 보편정의(심근손상·괴사·경색의 구분)를 종합하여 분석하였으며, 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상의는 이차 심근경색 의심, 관찰 구간, 동적 변화 없는 트로포닌 상승 등 어려운 상황에서 만성신질환·심부전·패혈증·빈맥부정맥·폐색전증·tako-tsubo증후군 등 트로포닌 상승이 예상되는 질환들을 고려하여 맥락 기반 해석이 필요하며, 현재로서는 임상의가 최종적 해석 책임을 져야 한다.

papers.title: Factors associated with the development of gastrointestinal adverse events in dogs with multicentric lymphoma treated with CHOP- or CEOP-based protocols: a multi-institutional, retrospective study.
papers.authors: Treggiari E, Catania E, Valenti P, Boyd K, Finotello R
papers.abstract: Canine multicentric lymphoma is treated with multidrug protocols that include an anthracycline, namely doxorubicin, epirubicin or mitoxantrone. Both epirubicin and doxorubicin are known to cause gastrointestinal adverse events; however, very few reports have focused on comparing adverse events of the two drugs. The aim of this study was to report the frequency and severity of gastrointestinal adverse events in dogs with lymphoma treated with a multi-agent protocol including either doxorubicin or epirubicin, and to identify clinical and treatment-related factors associated with the development of adverse events. The medical databases of four institutions were retrospectively searched for dogs with a confirmed diagnosis of lymphoma that had received a multi-agent protocol including either doxorubicin or epirubicin. Dogs with detected gastrointestinal involvement, suspected gastrointestinal lymphoma or that did not undergo abdominal imaging at presentation were excluded. Variables included breed, sex, age, body weight, clinical stage, substage, immunophenotype, use of corticosteroids, chemotherapy dosing strategy and remission status following the first administration of anthracycline. A total of 178 dogs were included, 114 dogs (64%) received epirubicin and 64 (36%) received doxorubicin. Dogs treated with doxorubicin had a significantly higher incidence of gastrointestinal adverse events compared with those receiving epirubicin (56.3% vs. 34.2%, OR 2.47, 95% CI 1.33 to 4.67; P = .005). In multivariable analysis, doxorubicin was independently associated with an increased risk of gastrointestinal toxicity (OR 2.70, 95% CI 1.39 to 5.38; P = .004) as were increasing age and female sex. Stage V disease was associated with a reduced risk.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 다중심성 림프종 치료에서 독소루비신 사용 시 에피루비신 대비 위장관계 부작용 발생률이 유의하게 높으며(56.3% vs 34.2%), 고령과 암컷에서 위험도가 증가하고 5기 질환에서는 감소한다.
[방법·수치] 4개 기관의 후향적 조사로 림프종 확진 견 178마리(독소루비신 64마리 36%, 에피루비신 114마리 64%)를 분석했다. 독소루비신군에서 위장관계 부작용 OR 2.47(95% CI 1.33-4.67, P=.005), 다변량 분석에서 OR 2.70(95% CI 1.39-5.38, P=.004)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 다중 약물 프로토콜 사용 시 에피루비신 선택이 위장관계 독성 감소에 유리할 수 있으나, 후향적 단일 프로토콜 분석이고 전향적 연구 필요성을 명시하고 있다.

papers.title: Efficacy of Heat-Killed Lactobacillus plantarum L-137 Supplementation in Treatment of Canine Atopic Dermatitis.
papers.authors: Kiewsiri C, Patumcharoenpol P, Kovitvadhi A, Chermprapai S
papers.abstract: Canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) is a chronic inflammatory skin disease and has been associated with gut dysbiosis. To evaluate the efficacy of heat-killed Lactobacillus plantarum L-137 (HK L-137), a postbiotic supplementation in managing cAD. Twelve client-owned dogs with cAD. A randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blinded crossover trial. Dogs were divided into two groups (n = 6) and received oral HK L-137 or placebo once daily for 12 weeks. After a 2-week washout period, they received the alternative treatment. Oral oclacitinib (0.4-0.6 mg/kg once daily) was permitted throughout the study. Clinical severity was assessed with the 4th iteration of the cAD Extent and Severity Index (CADESI-04) and owner-evaluated pruritus Visual Analog Scale (PVAS) and faecal scoring at 0, 12, 14 and 26 weeks. Serum concentrations of C-reactive protein (CRP), interleukin (IL)-4, interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) and C-C motif chemokine ligand 17 (CCL17), and haematological and biochemical findings were analysed at the same time points. Faecal microbiota composition (genomic DNA) was assessed at 12 and 26 weeks. PVAS scores mildly improved in both groups, with greater reduction in the HK L-137 group, yet this was not statistically significant. Serum CRP concentrations increased significantly in the control group (p = 0.02). Serum CCL17 concentrations decreased significantly in the HK L-137 group (p = 0.01). No significant changes were observed in CADESI-04, IL-4, IFN-γ or faecal scores or faecal microbiota diversity and composition. HK L-137 represents a potential, well-tolerated adjunctive therapy for dogs with cAD. Therapy was associated with reduced CCL17. Further studies with fewer variables are indicated.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 열처리된 Lactobacillus plantarum L-137(HK L-137) 보충은 개의 아토피성 피부염(cAD) 치료에서 잘 견딜 수 있는 보조 치료로 작용하며, 혈청 CCL17 농도 감소와 관련이 있다.
[방법·수치] 무작위배정 위약대조 이중맹검 교차시험으로 cAD를 가진 개 12마리(각 그룹 6마리)를 대상으로 HK L-137 또는 위약을 1일 1회 12주간 투여 후 2주 휴약 후 교대 투여. CADESI-04, 소양증 시각적 상사척도(PVAS), 혈청 CRP/IL-4/IFN-γ/CCL17, 분변점수를 0, 12, 14, 26주에 평가. 혈청 CRP는 대조군에서 유의하게 증가(p=0.02), HK L-137군에서 CCL17이 유의하게 감소(p=0.01). PVAS는 양 그룹에서 경미하게 개선되었으나 통계적 유의성 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 오클라시티닙과 병용하여 cAD 환자에서 보조 치료로 사용 가능하나, 소규모(12마리), 단일기관 연구이고 많은 변수를 포함하여 더 많은 연구가 필요함. CADESI-04, IL-4, IFN-γ, 분변 미생물군집에서 유의한 변화가 없어 추가 검증 필요.

papers.title: Pyelonephritis in cats and dogs - a scoping review.
papers.authors: Pelander L, Ekstrand C, Scahill K
papers.abstract: There is a lack of consensus regarding the diagnosis and treatment of bacterial pyelonephritis (PN) in dogs and cats. The aim of this scoping review was to increase knowledge by describing published scientific literature on the subject, specifically to collate definitions and diagnostic criteria, antimicrobial regimens, reported outcomes, and to identify knowledge gaps. A structured search was performed of the bibliographic databases Biosis, CAB Abstracts, Medline, Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus. We included 176 original studies written in English or German that reported on any aspect of spontaneous PN (risk factors, signalment, history, clinical findings, diagnostic criteria, treatment, prognosis, and outcome) in cats or dogs. Three types of PN were identified in the literature: histologically diagnosed PN, clinically diagnosed PN, and pyonephrosis. Multiple information gaps regarding clinical aspects of PN in dogs and cats were detected. There were no universally accepted clinical criteria for clinical diagnosis of PN and no clinical trials evaluating antimicrobial or other treatment options. Information about short-term outcomes for dogs and cats with PN was scarce, and there were no data regarding long-term outcomes. More information regarding all aspects of clinical PN in dogs and cats is needed.The study protocol was registered prospectively in 2023 ( https://syreaf.org/protocols/ ).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 세균성 신우신염 진단과 치료에 대한 의학적 합의가 부족하며, 조직학적 진단, 임상적 진단, 화농성신우신염 등 세 가지 유형이 문헌에서 식별되었으나 임상적 진단기준이 통일되지 않았음.
[방법·수치] 176개의 영어 또는 독일어 원문 연구를 Biosis, CAB Abstracts, Medline, Web of Science Core Collection, Scopus 데이터베이스에서 체계적으로 검색하여 개와 고양이의 자발적 신우신염의 위험인자, 임상소견, 진단기준, 치료, 예후를 분석; 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상의는 현재 신우신염의 진단과 항균제 치료에 대한 근거기반 지침이 부족하므로 개별 사례별 판단이 필요하며, 본 검토는 단기 및 장기 예후 데이터의 심각한 부족을 지적하고 모든 임상적 측면에서 추가 연구의 필요성을 강조함.

papers.title: EXPRESS:Management of Distal Hindlimb Injuries in Cats Using an Exvet External Skeletal Fixation System: A Multicenter Retrospective Study.
papers.authors: Uygur S, Dogan A, Yardımcı C, Ulusan S, Beale BS
papers.abstract: To evaluate the clinical use of an Exvet external skeletal fixation (ESF) system applied using minimally invasive techniques for the management of distal hindlimb injuries in cats. Cats with distal hindlimb injuries treated using the Exvet Tarsal Fixator (ETF) at four institutions between September 2022 and January 2026 were included. Data collected included fracture type, surgical approach, postoperative complications and additional treatments, time to first limb use, time to fixator removal, radiographic findings, and clinical outcome. Of 73 cats evaluated, 35 cats with 36 distal hindlimb injuries met the inclusion criteria. Twenty-four cats (68.6%) were managed with a closed reduction, while 11 cats (31.4%) were managed with a limited open surgical fashion. Thirty-two of 35 cats (91.4%) started weight bearing immediately after surgery. Complications were recorded in 7 of 35 cases (20.0%), of which 5 cases (14.3%) were classified as minor and 2 cases (5.7%) as major complications. At a mean ESF removal time of 34 days (median: 28 days; range: 21-56 days), a full functional outcome was achieved in 25 of 35 cases (71.4%), while 10 cases (28.6%) showed an acceptable functional outcome. The ETF is an anatomically designed ESF implant specifically developed for feline distal hindlimb injuries. The findings of this multicenter retrospective study support its safe and effective use for the management of feline distal hindlimb injuries.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 원위 후지 손상 치료에 Exvet Tarsal Fixator(ETF)를 최소침습 기법으로 적용하면 안전하고 효과적이며, 71.4%에서 완전 기능적 회복을 달성할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 4개 기관의 다중심 후향적 연구로 2022년 9월부터 2026년 1월까지 원위 후지 손상을 치료받은 35마리의 고양이 36례를 대상으로 했다. 68.6%는 폐쇄정복, 31.4%는 제한적 개방정복으로 관리했으며, 91.4%가 수술 직후 체중부하를 시작했다. 합병증 발생률은 20.0%(경미 14.3%, 중증 5.7%)이고, 평균 고정 제거 시간은 34일(중앙값 28일, 범위 21-56일)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] ETF는 고양이 원위 후지 손상을 위해 특별히 설계된 해부학적 고정 임플란트로서 최소침습 접근법의 장점을 활용할 수 있다. 단일 임플란트 타입만 평가했고 다른 고정 방식과의 비교가 없으며, 추적 관찰 기간이 명시되지 않아 장기 결과는 불명확하다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: BENEFITS OF CONTRAST-ENHANCED COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY OVER PLAIN COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY FOR HEAD TRAUMA IN 41 CATS.
papers.authors: Mariaud V, Arinal P, Masson A, Mortier J
papers.abstract: The aim of this study is to evaluate whether contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) provides clinically useful information beyond Plain computed tomography (PCT) in cats with head trauma, and whether this benefit is influenced by the radiologist's level of experience. Forty-one cats that underwent head CT with both pre- and post-contrast sequences were included. Images were independently reviewed by three radiologists with different experience levels, assessing extracranial soft tissue injuries, bone fractures, and intracranial abnormalities. Intra- and interobserver agreements were analyzed using Cohen's kappa statistics. Substantial to almost perfect agreement was obtained for extracranial soft tissue injuries and bone fractures. The most commonly fractured sites were the temporomandibular joints, hard palate, mandibular bones, and pterygoid bones. For intracranial lesions such as hemorrhage and cerebral edema, intra- and interobserver agreements were low and variable, regardless of contrast use or reviewer experience. There was no significant difference found between PCT and CECT for any of the three categories. These results suggest that contrast medium injection is not useful for assessment of bone fractures and extracranial soft tissue and that computed tomography of the head is poorly reliable for intracranial lesions in cats presented for trauma.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 두부 외상에서 조영제 증강 CT는 단순 CT와 비교하여 골절, 두개외 연부조직 손상, 두개내 병변 평가에서 임상적 추가 이점을 제공하지 않는다.
[방법·수치] 두부 CT를 받은 고양이 41마리를 대상으로 전후 조영제 주입 영상을 비교 분석하였다. 3명의 경험 수준이 다른 방사선 의학과 의사가 독립적으로 검토하였으며, Cohen의 kappa 통계로 관찰자 내·간 일치도를 분석하였다. 두개외 연부조직 손상과 골절은 실질적에서 거의 완벽한 일치도를 보였고, 측두하악관절, 경구개, 하악골, 익돌골이 가장 흔한 골절 부위였으나, 출혈과 뇌부종 같은 두개내 병변은 조영제 사용 여부나 검토자 경험 수준과 관계없이 일치도가 낮고 가변적이었으며 PCT와 CECT 간 유의한 차이가 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 두부 외상 환자에서 조영제 주입을 생략하고 단순 CT만으로 골절 및 연부조직 손상 평가가 가능하며, 비용 절감 효과가 있으나 CT 자체의 낮은 신뢰도로 두개내 병변 평가는 제한적이다. 단일 기관 연구이고 샘플 크기가 제한적이다.

papers.title: Comparative Effectiveness of COP and CHOP Chemotherapy Protocols in Feline Intermediate- to Large-Cell Lymphoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.authors: Lam YWS, Pimentel PAB, Nekouei O, Giuliano A
papers.abstract: Feline intermediate- to large-cell lymphoma is commonly treated with COP or CHOP chemotherapy, but the clinical benefit of adding doxorubicin (CHOP) remains controversial given its associated toxicity profile and cost. This systematic review and exploratory meta-analysis summarized response and survival outcomes reported for COP- and CHOP-based protocols in feline intermediate- to large-cell lymphoma. Searching PubMed, Scopus, and CAB Abstracts (2000-2024), we included 21 studies comprising 1054 cats. An exploratory random-effects meta-analysis utilizing Restricted Maximum Likelihood (REML) estimation was conducted to evaluate overall (ORR), complete (CR), and partial response (PR) rates. The overall pooled ORR was 81.0%. Subgroup meta-regression revealed no statistically significant differences between COP and CHOP for ORR (83.0% vs. 77.0%, p = 0.360), CR (57.0% vs. 49.0%, p = 0.350), or PR (28.0% vs. 22.0%, p = 0.468). Profound heterogeneity (overall I2 = 85.4%-89.6%) persisted across all analyses, driven primarily by the pooling of diverse anatomical subtypes and uncontrolled confounding by Feline Leukaemia Virus (FeLV) status. Furthermore, inadequate variance reporting and a widespread lack of standardized response criteria (e.g., VCOG-RECIST) precluded a formal meta-analysis of survival outcomes. Descriptively, reported median survival times ranged broadly (COP: 108-610 days; CHOP: 62-973 days) without a clear advantage for CHOP. A custom weighted risk-of-bias assessment highlighted significant methodological deficiencies across the literature. In conclusion, current aggregate evidence does not demonstrate a statistically detectable difference in response rates between CHOP- and COP-based protocols. Severe methodological heterogeneity and retrospective selection bias prevent definitive conclusions regarding long-term survival, emphasizing the critical need for homogeneous, prospective randomized trials utilizing standardized reporting guidelines.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 중간~대형 림프종에서 COP와 CHOP 화학요법의 반응률에 통계적 차이가 없었으며, 생존 기간에서도 CHOP의 명확한 우위가 입증되지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 2000-2024년 21개 논문, 1054마리 고양이를 체계적 검토 및 메타분석(REML 추정)한 결과, 전체 반응률(ORR) 81.0%, COP vs CHOP 비교에서 ORR 83.0% vs 77.0%(p=0.360), 완전반응(CR) 57.0% vs 49.0%(p=0.350), 부분반응(PR) 28.0% vs 22.0%(p=0.468)이었으나 이질성이 심함(I2=85.4%-89.6%).
[임상 적용·한계] 현재 근거상 독소루비신 추가의 임상적 이점이 명확하지 않으므로 비용과 독성을 고려한 선택적 사용이 가능하나, 대부분의 논문이 후향적이고 FeLV 상태 미보정, 표준화된 반응 평가 기준 부재로 인해 생존 예후 결론을 내릴 수 없으며 전향적 무작위 대조 시험이 필요하다.

papers.title: Differences in DNA Methylation Status Between Epithelial and Mesenchymal Phenotypes in Canine Malignant Mucosal Melanoma.
papers.authors: Ishizaki T, Yamazaki J, Aoshima K, Kimura T
papers.abstract: Canine malignant mucosal melanoma is one of the common cancers with a high mortality rate. Pathologically, malignant melanomas show multiple morphological patterns including epithelioid, spindle and round, indicating that neoplastic cells change their morphology. Regarding morphological change, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) has been considered to be an important mechanism. EMT is a reversible biologic process being suggested the correlation with DNA methylation in human cancer. The aim of this study was to assess the difference in DNA methylation status between epithelial and mesenchymal phenotypes and correlation with EMT in canine oral malignant melanoma. Sixteen samples were classified into epithelial phenotype and eight samples were classified into mesenchymal phenotype based on E-cadherin expression using immunohistochemistry or western blotting. We analysed DNA methylation level of 46 673 cytosine-guanine dinucleotides (CpG sites) in all samples and compared average DNA methylation level between epithelial and mesenchymal phenotypes. In a comparison of average DNA methylation level at each site in CpG island promoters (3089 sites), 17 and 6 hypermethylated sites were identified in epithelial phenotype and mesenchymal phenotype, respectively. Finally, 10 out of 23 sites showed de novo hypermethylation, and two genes, NEUROG1 and ITGAV, which are associated with cell adhesion, were found to be hypermethylated in epithelial phenotype. This study revealed the difference of DNA methylation status between epithelial and mesenchymal phenotypes suggesting the influence of DNA methylation on EMT in canine malignant mucosal melanoma.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 악성 점막 흑색종에서 상피형과 간엽형 표현형 사이에 DNA 메틸화 상태의 차이가 존재하며, NEUROG1과 ITGAV 유전자가 상피형에서 과메틸화되어 상피-간엽 전이(EMT)에 DNA 메틸화가 영향을 미친다.
[방법·수치] 개 구강 악성 흑색종 샘플 24개(상피형 16개, 간엽형 8개)를 E-cadherin 발현으로 분류하고, 46,673개 CpG 부위의 DNA 메틸화 수준을 분석했다. CpG 아일랜드 프로모터 3,089개 부위 중 상피형에서 17개, 간엽형에서 6개의 과메틸화 부위를 확인했으며, 23개 부위 중 10개가 새로운 과메틸화를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] DNA 메틸화는 개의 악성 점막 흑색종의 형태학적 변화와 생물학적 행동을 이해하는 바이오마커로 활용될 수 있으나, 소규모 샘플 크기(24개)와 단일 종양 유형에 대한 연구로 임상적 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Placebo-controlled randomized clinical study using a collagen hydrolysate-enriched diet in dogs with osteoarthritis.
papers.authors: Blees NR, Teunissen M, Smit IH, Verseijden F, Meij BP
papers.abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent cause of chronic pain in dogs. Previous clinical studies suggest potential benefits of collagen hydrolysate (CH) supplementation, yet limitations in patient selection and study design have hindered definitive conclusions. This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study evaluated the efficacy of a CH-enriched diet compared to an isocaloric placebo diet over 12 weeks in dogs with radiographically confirmed OA and mild clinical signs. Clinical efficacy was assessed at weeks 0, 3, 6, 9, and 12 using client-reported outcome measures, including the Liverpool OsteoArthritis in Dogs (LOAD) and Canine Brief Pain Inventory (CBPI) questionnaires, alongside kinetic gait analysis using a force-plate at weeks 0, 6, and 12. The primary endpoint was the difference in baseline-corrected LOAD scores between the CH and placebo diet at week 12. Forty-five dogs enrolled; nine discontinued, with three dropouts related to osteoarthritis severity or the provided food. Rescue analgesia was used equally in both groups (CH: 5/17 dogs and Placebo: 4/19 dogs). Complete-case analysis revealed no differences between groups for LOAD, CBPI scores, or gait analysis. Both groups showed improvement, indicating a caregiver placebo effect. These results indicate no short-term benefit of CH on the assessed clinical and objective outcomes, potentially due to the relatively small and heterogeneous cohort and limited study duration. Further studies with larger populations, longer follow-up, and patient stratification are warranted.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 12주간의 콜라겐 가수분해물(CH) 강화 식이는 방사선학적으로 확진된 경증 골관절염 개에서 위약 식이 대비 임상 증상 개선의 단기적 이점을 보이지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 무작위 이중맹검 위약 대조 임상 시험으로 경증 골관절염 개 45마리 중 완성된 36마리(CH군 17마리, 위약군 19마리)를 대상으로 12주간 평가했다. 평가 지표는 LOAD 점수, CBPI 질문지, 포스 플레이트 보행 분석을 사용했으며, 구제 진통제 사용은 CH군 5/17마리, 위약군 4/19마리로 동등했다. LOAD, CBPI 점수 및 보행 분석에서 군 간 차이 없음(수치 제시 없음).
[임상 적용·한계] 경증 골관절염 개에서 단기 CH 보충은 권장되지 않으나, 양쪽 군이 모두 개선을 보여 보호자 위약 효과가 작용했을 가능성이 있다. 본 연구는 소규모 이질적 집단, 제한된 연구 기간, 환자 층화 부재 등의 한계가 있어 더 큰 규모의 장기 추적 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Tablet crushing, but not splitting, alters the pharmacokinetics of extended-release levetiracetam in dogs.
papers.authors: Mondino A, Nettifee JA, Simon KE, Papich MG, Muñana KR
papers.abstract: To compare the pharmacokinetics of intact, split, and crushed levetiracetam (LEV) extended-release (LEV-XR) tablets in dogs. We hypothesized that splitting produces a pharmacokinetic profile similar to intact tablets, whereas crushing results in earlier and higher maximum concentrations. Healthy research dogs were administered 500 mg LEV-XR orally as intact, split, or crushed tablets in a randomized crossover design. Plasma LEV concentrations were measured over 12 hours by high-pressure liquid chromatography. Pharmacokinetic parameters were estimated using noncompartmental analysis and supplementary compartmental analysis and compared using linear mixed-effects models. The study utilized 7 Beagles. Compared with intact tablets, crushed tablets resulted in higher maximum concentration (Cmax) values (61.5 vs 46.0 µg/mL; geometric mean ratio, 1.34; 95% CI, 1.08 to 1.65) and lower 8- to 12-hour exposure (30.0 vs 49.8 µg·h/mL; geometric mean ratio, 0.60; 95% CI, 0.47 to 0.77). Duration above the targeted concentration of 10 µg/mL was longer with intact than crushed tablets (10.9 vs 8.5 hours; mean difference, 2.37 hours; 95% CI, 1.02 to 3.72). Exploratory compartmental analysis estimated an earlier time to maximum concentration (Tmax) for crushed compared with intact tablets. No statistically significant differences were observed between intact and split tablets. Splitting LEV-XR tablets did not significantly alter the evaluated pharmacokinetic parameters, whereas crushing resulted in a higher Cmax, an earlier model-estimated Tmax, and reduced late exposure. Splitting LEV-XR tablets may provide a practical option for dose adjustment in smaller dogs. Crushed LEV-XR warrants further evaluation as adjunct therapy during cluster seizures when immediate-release LEV is unavailable.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개에서 서방정 레비티라세탐(LEV-XR) 정제를 분할(split)해도 약동학 프로필이 유지되지만, 분쇄(crush)하면 최고혈중농도는 높아지고 후기노출은 감소한다.
[방법·수치] 7마리 비글에서 500mg LEV-XR을 무손상, 분할, 분쇄 형태로 무작위 교차설계로 경구투여하고 12시간 동안 혈장농도를 측정했다. 분쇄 대비 무손상: Cmax 61.5 vs 46.0 μg/mL(기하평균비 1.34, 95% CI 1.08-1.65), 8-12시간 노출 30.0 vs 49.8 μg·h/mL(기하평균비 0.60, 95% CI 0.47-0.77), 10 μg/mL 이상 지속시간 8.5 vs 10.9시간(평균차이 2.37시간, 95% CI 1.02-3.72). 분할과 무손상 정제 간 통계적 유의차 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 소형견의 용량조절을 위해 LEV-XR 정제 분할이 실용적 선택지가 될 수 있다. 분쇄 LEV-XR은 집단 발작 중 속방정제 부재 시 보조요법으로 추가 평가가 필요하다. 단일 개 종, 소규모 연구로 임상 외삽 시 주의 필요.

papers.title: Systematic review supports the idea that no alternative test presently replaces elimination diet test and oral food challenge to diagnose canine adverse food reactions.
papers.authors: Morales-Romero R, Gonzalez-Dominguez MS, Roldán-Villalobos W, Correa-Valencia NM
papers.abstract: Adverse food reactions in dogs are clinically heterogeneous and overlap with canine atopic dermatitis, and diagnosis still relies on an elimination diet test followed by oral food challenge (EDT+OFC). Numerous allergen-specific tests have been proposed, but their diagnostic value remains controversial. Our objective was to identify, synthesize, and critically evaluate the diagnostic tests used or investigated for canine food allergy, with emphasis on their clinical validity, applicability, and agreement with the EDT+OFC reference standard. In accordance with PRISMA (ie, Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) 2020 guidelines, Scopus and PubMed were searched without publication-year restrictions, and records were independently screened in duplicate at the title, abstract, and full-text stages. A meta-analysis was not feasible owing to heterogeneity. Fifty-nine studies (1986 to 2025) from 16 countries were included and grouped into elimination/provocation diets and serological, cutaneous, cellular, and molecular tests. The most consistently validated approach remained EDT+OFC. Serological IgG/IgE (and salivary) tests were poorly correlated with clinical outcome; the standardized patch test showed the best cutaneous performance (high negative predictive value), cellular tests (lymphocyte proliferation) showed the closest concordance with the OFC, and molecular/proteomic methods advanced allergen characterization and the understanding of cross-reactivity. No alternative test reliably replaces EDT+OFC. Although patch testing may seem beneficial, its practical value is limited, and cellular assays represent a promising area for future biomarker research; standardized protocols and well-designed prospective studies are needed.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 불리한 식이 반응 진단에서 제거식이 시험 후 경구 식이 유발시험(EDT+OFC)을 대체할 수 있는 대체 검사는 현재 없으며, 이것이 여전히 금표준이다.
[방법·수치] 1986년부터 2025년까지 16개국의 59개 연구를 체계적 문헌고찰했다. 혈청학적 검사(IgG/IgE, 타액), 피부 검사(표준화 첩포시험), 세포 검사(림프구 증식), 분자/단백체학 검사를 포함했으며, 메타분석은 이질성으로 인해 불가능했다. 표준화 첩포시험은 높은 음성 예측도를 보였고, 세포 검사가 OFC와 가장 높은 일치도를 나타냈다.
[임상 적용·한계] 첩포시험은 유용해 보이지만 임상 실제 가치는 제한적이며, 세포 검사가 향후 바이오마커 연구의 유망한 영역이다. 임상 현장에서는 여전히 EDT+OFC를 기본 진단 방법으로 사용해야 하며, 추가 검사의 표준화된 프로토콜과 전향적 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Diagnosis of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency in dogs requires use of a newly adjusted reference range and diagnostic cutoff for measurement of trypsin-like immunoreactivity.
papers.authors: Chuang WH, Wu YA, Lidbury JA, Fosgate GT, Chang CH
papers.abstract: To adjust the reference interval (RI) for a commercially available canine trypsin-like immunoreactivity (cTLI) assay and the cutoff value for the diagnosis of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI). Lower limit of the RI was calculated based on the fifth percentile of cTLI concentrations in 102 clinically healthy dogs. Questionnaires were sent to clinicians for cases with serum cTLI concentrations ≤ 10 µg/L. Five board-certified small animal internists blinded to serum cTLI concentration individually reviewed questionnaire responses to clinically classify each dog. Dogs were classified as "EPI" or "not EPI" based on the consensus when ≥ 4 internists assigned the same classification. The cutoff was determined by maximizing the weighted Youden index (1.34 × sensitivity + 0.67 × specificity - 1).
