Sensitivity was prioritized, as false negatives were considered more deleterious than false positives. The calculated lower RI limit was ≥ 11.8 µg/L. Forty-seven dogs each were classified as EPI and not EPI. The median (range) serum cTLI concentrations were 1.5 µg/L (0.9 to 7.2) for the EPI dogs and 8.3 µg/L (2.2 to 10.0) for the not EPI dogs. The optimal diagnostic cutoff was 5.5 µg/L, with a sensitivity of 95.7% and specificity of 83.0%. Use of the updated RI (≥ 11.8 µg/L) and diagnostic cutoff value for EPI (5.5 µg/L) should reduce false-negative results when using this commercial assay. There has been an upward shift in serum cTLI measurements with this commercial assay, consistent with clinical observations.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 트립신유사면역반응성(cTLI) 측정 기준범위를 11.8 μg/L 이상으로 상향 조정하고, 외분비췌장부전증(EPI) 진단 임계값을 5.5 μg/L로 설정하여 위음성 결과를 감소시킬 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 임상적으로 건강한 개 102마리에서 cTLI 농도의 5백분위수로 기준범위 하한을 산출하고, 혈청 cTLI ≤10 μg/L인 개들에 대해 5명 이상의 소동물 전문의의 임상 분류 합의를 통해 진단 임계값을 결정했다. 최적 진단 임계값 5.5 μg/L에서 민감도 95.7%, 특이도 83.0%; EPI군 중앙값 1.5 μg/L(0.9~7.2), 비EPI군 중앙값 8.3 μg/L(2.2~10.0).
[임상 적용·한계] 기존 상용 검사의 cTLI 측정값이 상향 이동하였으므로 임상의는 반드시 새로운 기준범위와 임계값을 적용하여 EPI 진단 정확도를 높여야 한다. 연구는 단일 상용 검사 방법에 국한되어 있고 거꾸로 된 질문지 분류에 의존하고 있다.

papers.title: Development and Validation of a New Online Tool for Monitoring Clinical Signs of Canine Atopic Dermatitis.
papers.authors: Harvey N, Watson A, Laxalde J, England G, Gow D
papers.abstract: The aim of the study was to develop a simple, reliable and validated patient-reported outcome tool for use in monitoring the severity of clinical signs in dogs with confirmed or suspected atopic allergies and recurrent otitis externa. The tool is called the Dog-Orientated Severity of Atopy Scale (DOSAS). The human Patient-Oriented Eczema Measure (POEM) was adapted for relevance to the owner-observable clinical signs of canine atopic dermatitis (cAD). Refinements were made via consultation with dog owners and veterinary surgeons to ensure applicability and ease of use. Relevant features of reliability (including internal consistency, intrarater reliability and test-retest reliability) were evaluated. The tool was then tested by owners and clinicians for performance against established clinical sign assessment methods. The DOSAS was shown to be both reliable and valid with psychometric properties above acceptable guidelines for the development of such tools. Guidelines are presented for score creation and stratification of the score to enable interpretation. When compared to how severity assessment scores from Canine Atopic Dermatitis Extent and Severity Index, 4th iteration (CADESI-04) and pruritus Visual Assessment Scale (PVAS) responded to change, the DOSAS performed particularly strongly, although it performed less well when compared to the 0-3 Otitis Index Score (OTIS-3). The DOSAS is presented as a supplementary tool for use in veterinary practice and clinical research programmes alongside existing clinical measurements such as CADESI-04, providing a focus on the disease as it is experienced by the dog and their owner. Unlike clinical measurement, the DOSAS is accessible and interpretable for dog owners, which is important for the management of chronic pruritic conditions, and will enable dog owners to be more actively involved with their dog's disease management.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 아토피성 피부염 임상증상 모니터링을 위해 개발된 Dog-Orientated Severity of Atopy Scale(DOSAS)은 신뢰도와 타당도가 높으며, 기존 평가도구(CADESI-04, PVAS)와 비교하여 변화에 대한 반응성이 우수한 보조 평가도구이다.
[방법·수치] 인간의 POEM(Patient-Oriented Eczema Measure)을 개 아토피성 피부염의 주인 관찰 가능 임상증상에 맞게 개작하였으며, 견주와 수의사 상담을 통해 정제하였다. 신뢰도(내적일관성, 평가자내 신뢰도, 검사-재검사 신뢰도)를 평가하고 CADESI-04, PVAS, OTIS-3과 비교하여 성능을 검증하였다. DOSAS는 CADESI-04 및 PVAS 대비 변화 반응성에서 우수한 성능을 보였으나 OTIS-3 대비 성능은 낮았다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] DOSAS는 견주가 접근 가능하고 해석 용이하여 만성 가려움증 질환 관리 시 견주의 적극적 참여를 가능하게 하며, 기존 임상 측정도구(CADESI-04)와 함께 임상 진료 및 임상연구에서 보조 도구로 사용될 수 있다. 초음파 연구로 중이염 평가 성능이 상대적으로 낮은 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Retrospective Application of the Current International Myeloma Working Group Disease Definitions in 20 Cats With Immunoglobulin Secreting Neoplasms.
papers.authors: Jeffries CM, Harris RA, Vickery K, Avery PR, Rao S
papers.abstract: Studies describing feline myeloma related diseases (MRD) are limited and reported prognostic indicators are inconsistent. Cats more commonly exhibit visceral plasma cell tumours (PCTs) than marrow-predominant disease, suggesting that diagnostic approaches adapted from the International Myeloma Working Group (IMWG) criteria, incorporating extramedullary involvement and myeloma defining events (MDEs), may better capture clinically relevant disease. We sought to evaluate cats with serum protein electrophoresis (SPE) and immunofixation (IF) confirmed M-proteins using IMWG-adapted criteria, determine how often cases satisfy IMWG-adapted versus classic multiple myeloma (MM) definitions, compare outcomes, characterize clinical and laboratory findings and assess prognostic indicators. A retrospective cohort of 20 cats with SPE/IF-confirmed M-proteins and clinical data was included in the study applying IMWG-adapted and classic MM criteria using available clinical records, laboratory data and cytologic or histologic findings. Survival was evaluated using the log-rank test. 14/20 cats met IMWG-adapted MM criteria, whereas 7 cats met classic criteria. Median survival time did not differ between classic MM (226.5 days) and IMWG-reclassified MM (141 days; p = 0.99). Visceral organ involvement was common; splenic PCTs occurred in 71.4% (10/14) and hepatic PCTs in 87.5% (7/8) of sampled organs. Lytic bone lesions were infrequent (3/14). IgG M-proteins predominated (71.4%). No clinicopathologic variable was significantly associated with survival. IMWG-adapted criteria reclassified MM without altering survival, supporting their diagnostic utility in feline MRD. The predominance of visceral PCTs and infrequent bone involvement highlights species-specific disease patterns and the diagnostic value of extramedullary sampling. Larger prospective studies should refine feline-specific biomarkers and validate MDEs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 면역글로불린 분비 종양에서 국제골수종연구그룹(IMWG) 적응형 기준을 적용하면 고전적 다발성골수종 진단기준보다 더 많은 환자를 포착할 수 있으며, 고양이의 질병 특성을 더 잘 반영한다.
[방법·수치] 혈청 단백 전기영동과 면역고정화로 확인된 M단백질을 가진 고양이 20마리의 후향적 코호트 연구로, IMWG 적응형 기준 적용 시 14/20마리(70%)가 진단 기준을 충족했으나 고전적 기준에서는 7마리(35%)만 충족했다. 중앙생존시간은 고전적 다발성골수종 226.5일 대 IMWG 재분류군 141일로 유의차 없음(p=0.99). 내장기 침범은 비장 71.4%, 간 87.5%로 흔했으나 골용해병변은 14.3%로 드물었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이에서 내장기 형질세포종양 표본 채취의 진단적 가치를 강조하며 고전적 골수종 진단 기준만으로는 고양이 질병을 과소진단할 위험이 있다. 연구 제한점은 소규모 후향적 연구로서 대규모 전향적 연구와 고양이 특이 바이오마커 개발이 필요하다.

papers.title: Cytoreduction combined with cryosurgery for the treatment of eyelid neoplasms in dogs: Clinical outcomes and histopathological characterization.
papers.authors: de Oliveira R, de Vargas Arigony Braga F, de Moraes LAM, Bohm BC, Valente CL
papers.abstract: Eyelid neoplasms are among the most common periocular conditions in dogs and can lead to significant ocular morbidity if left untreated. Although surgical excision with blepharoplasty remains the standard of care, cytoreduction combined with cryosurgery has emerged as a less invasive alternative that preserves eyelid integrity. This prospective study evaluated 30 dogs with eyelid masses treated by cytoreductive excision followed by two freeze-thaw cycles delivered via a contact CO₂ cryosurgical unit. Risk factors, tumor types, pre- and postoperative ophthalmic signs were assessed and graded according to severity. Preoperative and postoperative findings included ocular discharge, conjunctival hyperemia, and blepharospasm. Postoperative ophthalmic signs were transient, resolving within 72 h. Depigmentation changes (leukoderma and leukotrichia) resolved spontaneously within 30 days. Histopathological analysis identified melanoma (30%), squamous cell carcinoma (16.7%), and sebaceous adenoma (16.7%) as the most prevalent tumor types. Tumor recurrence was observed in only one case (3.3%), involving a melanoma. These results suggest that cytoreduction combined with cryosurgery is a safe, time-efficient, and effective option for canine eyelid neoplasms, particularly for small or superficial tumors where preserving eyelid structure is a priority.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 세포감축술과 냉동수술의 조합은 개의 눈꺼풀 종양 치료에 안전하고 효과적이며, 눈꺼풀 구조 보존이 필요한 소형 또는 표재성 종양에 특히 유용하다.
[방법·수치] 개 30마리의 눈꺼풀 종양을 세포감축술 후 접촉식 CO2 냉동수술기로 2회 동결-해동 시행. 조직병리 결과 흑색종(30%), 편평상피암종(16.7%), 지선선종(16.7%)이 가장 흔했으며, 종양 재발은 1건(3.3%)뿐이었다. 술후 눈물 흘림, 결막충혈, 안검경련은 72시간 내 소실되고 탈색변화는 30일 내 자연 회복되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 표준 수술(안검성형술 동반 절제)의 덜 침습적 대안으로 눈꺼풀 기능 보존이 중요한 경우 우선 고려할 수 있다. 단일기관 전향적 연구이며 소규모 샘플이므로 대규모 다기관 연구로 확증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Efficacy and Safety of Allogeneic Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Versus Lokivetmab in Mild-To-Moderate Canine Atopic Dermatitis: A Single-Blind Randomised Study.
papers.authors: Pasikowska M, Ciszewska-Ceran J, Cekiera A, Gocek E, Grzesiak J
papers.abstract: Canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) is a chronic allergic inflammatory skin disease that requires multimodal management. Allogeneic mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) have emerged as a potential therapeutic option. To evaluate the efficacy and safety of an investigational allogeneic adipose-derived MSC product (PK/CM-1) in dogs with cAD. Dogs with mild-to-moderate cAD were enrolled in a single-blind, randomised study and allocated in a 2:1 ratio either to an experimental group (receiving a single intravenous dose of PK/CM-1) or a control group (receiving three monthly subcutaneous doses of lokivetmab). Clinical outcomes were assessed using the Canine Atopic Dermatitis Extent and Severity Index, 4th iteration (CADESI-04) and pruritus Visual Analog Scale (PVAS) scores on Day (D)28 (primary end-point) and D7, D56 and D84. Safety assessments included haematological and biochemical analyses on D84, along with monitoring for adverse events. Thirty-two dogs were included. By D28, both CADESI-04 and PVAS scores had significantly decreased from baseline in both groups. No significant differences between groups were observed on D28 (p = 0.696 and p = 0.088, respectively). Clinical improvement was sustained up to D84. In the experimental group, CADESI-04 and PVAS scores were lower on D84 than on D28 (p = 0.0074 and p = 0.0015, respectively). Two adverse events (one severe and one mild) occurred during PK/CM-1 administration. No clinically significant haematological or biochemical abnormalities were observed. PK/CM-1 demonstrated comparable efficacy and safety to those of lokivetmab over a 3 month period. Careful monitoring is recommended during intravenous administration of PK/CM-1.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 경증-중등도 아토피성 피부염에서 동종이계 중간엽줄기세포(PK/CM-1)는 국소키베트마브와 비교하여 비슷한 임상 효과와 안전성을 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 단일맹검 무작위배정 연구, 경증-중등도 개 아토피성 피부염 환자견 32마리(2:1 비율로 배정), CADESI-04와 PVAS 점수 평가, D28 주요결과: CADESI-04 p=0.696, PVAS p=0.088(군 간 유의차 없음), D84에서 PK/CM-1군의 CADESI-04(p=0.0074)와 PVAS(p=0.0015) 점수 추가 개선.

papers.title: Sugammadex at 2 mg/kg provides rapid and sustained reversal of moderate rocuronium-induced neuromuscular blockade in isoflurane-anesthetized dogs.
papers.authors: Chang RN, Wang HC, Chang CC, Chen IY
papers.abstract: To investigate the efficacy of 2 mg/kg sugammadex in reversing moderate rocuronium-induced neuromuscular blockade (NMB) in dogs, focusing on recovery time and recurarization. In this prospective, nonrandomized, unblinded experimental study, 12 healthy adult mixed-breed dogs were evaluated before elective surgery and assigned to a control group (spontaneous recovery; n = 6) or a reversal group (2 mg/kg sugammadex; n = 6). Anesthesia was induced with propofol and maintained with isoflurane without premedication. Neuromuscular function was monitored using train-of-four (TOF) acceleromyography. Moderate NMB was defined as TOF count 1 to 3, and complete NMB recovery was defined as a normalized TOF ratio (TOFR; measured TOFR/baseline TOFR) ≥ 0.9. Rocuronium (0.6 mg/kg IV) was administered, followed in the reversal group by sugammadex (2 mg/kg IV) at first-twitch (T1) reappearance. Dogs in the reversal group were monitored for 60 minutes after complete NMB recovery. Recovery time was defined as T1 reappearance to normalized TOFR ≥ 0.9; recurarization was defined as a subsequent decrease in normalized TOFR to < 0.9 after complete NMB recovery. Recovery time was significantly shorter in the reversal group (median [range], 1.3 [0.8 to 3.0] minutes) than in the control group (18.6 [12.3 to 35.5] minutes). No recurarization was observed. Sugammadex at 2 mg/kg provided rapid reversal of moderate rocuronium-induced NMB in isoflurane-anesthetized dogs. No recurarization was observed during the 60-minute monitoring period after complete NMB recovery. Sugammadex at 2 mg/kg may be considered for reversal of moderate rocuronium-induced NMB at T1 reappearance in dogs. However, objective neuromuscular monitoring remains essential to guide reversal decisions and confirm neuromuscular recovery.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 2 mg/kg 수가맥스는 이소플루란 마취 개에서 로쿠로늄 유도 중등도 신경근차단을 신속하게 역전시키며, 60분 모니터링 기간 동안 재차단이 발생하지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 혼종 성견 12마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 비무작위 맹검 미시험. 대조군(자발회복; n=6) vs 역전군(2 mg/kg 수가맥스; n=6). 근육신경 기능은 TOF 가속도근전도로 모니터링. 역전군의 회복시간 중앙값 1.3분(범위 0.8-3.0) vs 대조군 18.6분(12.3-35.5); 재차단 발생 0건.
[임상 적용·한계] 2 mg/kg 수가맥스는 개의 중등도 로쿠로늄 신경근차단 역전에 T1 재출현 시점에 사용할 수 있으나, 객관적 근육신경 모니터링이 역전 결정 및 회복 확인에 필수적이다. 소규모 단일기관 연구로 추가 임상검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Acute postoperative hypophosphatemia is a potential sequela following hepatectomy in dogs.
papers.authors: Bryant RE, Skinner OT, Barchilon M
papers.abstract: To describe posthepatectomy hypophosphatemia in dogs and evaluate whether the extent of hepatectomy was associated with postoperative hypophosphatemia. This was a retrospective, observational study of dogs that underwent hepatectomy from January 1, 2019, through December 15, 2025, with serum phosphorus concentrations recorded preoperatively and within 72 hours postoperatively. Dogs with comorbidities or complications expected to influence serum phosphorus were excluded. Data included extent of hepatectomy (division/subdivisional) and change in serum phosphorus concentration (ΔP). Phosphorus and the proportions of dogs with recorded hypophosphatemia were compared between dogs undergoing division hepatectomy and subdivisional hepatectomy using the Mann-Whitney test and Fisher's exact test, respectively. 42 dogs were included (19 subdivisional, 23 division hepatectomy). Median ΔP was -0.8 mg/dL (range, -3.8 to 3.4). ΔP was greater in dogs with division hepatectomy (-0.9 mg/dL; range, -3.8 to 3.4) than subdivisional hepatectomy (-0.5 mg/dL; range, -1.7 to 1.2). Seven of 42 dogs (16.7%) developed postoperative hypophosphatemia at a median of 20 hours (range, 16 to 43); all dogs had undergone division hepatectomy (7 of 23 [30.4%]). Three dogs were treated with IV potassium phosphate. No dogs (0 of 19 [0%]) with subdivisional hepatectomy had recorded hypophosphatemia. Hypophosphatemia can arise in dogs after liver resection, primarily following division hepatectomy or greater. There was an overall decrease in phosphorus for both divisional and subdivisional hepatectomy groups. Routine assessment of phosphorus following hepatectomy may be considered to minimize the risk of consequential hypophosphatemia.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 간절제술 후 급성 저인산혈증이 발생할 수 있으며, 특히 광범위 절제(division hepatectomy)에서 더 빈번하게 나타난다.
[방법·수치] 2019년 1월부터 2025년 12월까지 간절제술을 받은 개 42마리(광범위 절제 23마리, 제한적 절제 19마리)에 대한 후향적 관찰 연구로, 술 전후 72시간 내 혈청 인산염 측정. 중앙값 인산염 변화는 -0.8 mg/dL(범위 -3.8~3.4)였고, 광범위 절제군에서 -0.9 mg/dL, 제한적 절제군에서 -0.5 mg/dL였으며, 저인산혈증은 7마리(16.7%)에서 발생(모두 광범위 절제군, 30.4%)하였고 중앙값 20시간(범위 16~43시간)에 나타났다.
[임상 적용·한계] 간절제술 후 특히 광범위 절제 시 인산염을 주기적으로 측정하여 저인산혈증을 조기에 발견하고 필요시 IV 인산칼륨 투여로 치료할 수 있다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이고 샘플 크기가 제한적이며, 저인산혈증의 임상적 영향이나 장기 예후에 대한 정보는 부족하다.

papers.title: Intra-articular 2.5% polyacrylamide hydrogel provides sustained clinical improvement over 1 year in canine elbow osteoarthritis.
papers.authors: Corral JA, Levine D, Barnhard JA, Tringali AA, Green MM
papers.abstract: To evaluate the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of IA 2.5% injectable polyacrylamide hydrogel (iPAAG) in dogs with elbow osteoarthritis (OA). We hypothesized that treatment would improve pain and function, with minimal adverse events. This prospective single-site clinical study enrolled client-owned dogs from October 2023 to October 2024. Dogs with elbow OA confirmed by CT received unilateral or bilateral IA injections with 1 mL of 2.5% iPAAG. Assessments were conducted on day 0 (baseline) and at 2 weeks, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, and 12 months after injection using the Canine Brief Pain Inventory (CBPI) Pain Severity Score, CBPI Pain Interference Score, modified Glasgow Composite Pain Scale, Numerical Rating Score, elbow goniometry, thoracic limb girth, and joint effusion. Complete blood count and serum biochemistry were performed at baseline and 3 months after injection. 18 dogs were treated; 16 completed the study. There were significant improvements in all measures between baseline and 3 to 12 months. The CBPI Pain Severity Score, CBPI Pain Interference Score, modified Glasgow Composite Pain Scale, Numerical Rating Score, elbow flexion, elbow extension, thoracic limb girth, and joint effusion had an overall effect size of 0.44, 0.53, 0.69, 0.63, 0.31, 0.64, 0.53, and 0.64, respectively. There were minimal, self-limiting adverse events and no clinically significant changes in blood work. 2.5% iPAAG appears to be well tolerated, safe, and effective for the IA treatment of canine elbow OA. Study limitations included a small sample size and lack of control group. These findings support 2.5% iPAAG as a targeted therapy for canine elbow OA. Further research is warranted to evaluate histological effects.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 2.5% 주입형 폴리아크릴아마이드 하이드로겔(iPAAG)의 관절내 주입은 개의 팔꿈치 골관절염에서 12개월까지 지속적인 임상 개선과 안전성을 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 2023년 10월~2024년 10월 CT로 확인된 팔꿈치 골관절염을 가진 임상 견주견 18마리(완료 16마리)에 1mL 2.5% iPAAG를 편측 또는 양측 주입. CBPI Pain Severity Score(효과크기 0.44), CBPI Pain Interference Score(0.53), modified Glasgow Composite Pain Scale(0.69), Numerical Rating Score(0.63), 팔꿈치 굴곡(0.31), 신전(0.64), 흉부 사지 둘레(0.53), 관절액(0.64)에서 기저선 대비 3~12개월에 유의한 개선.
[임상 적용·한계] iPAAG는 팔꿈치 골관절염의 표적치료 옵션으로 임상 적용 가능하며 최소한의 자제한 부작용과 혈액검사상 유의한 변화 없음. 제한점은 소규모 표본(18마리), 대조군 부재, 조직학적 효과 미평가.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Experimental Evaluation of the Immunogenicity of Feline Erythrocyte Antigen 6 (FEA 6) in Transfusion-Naive FEA 6-Negative Cats.
papers.authors: Bangash MY, Blais MC
papers.abstract: ObjectivesFeline Erythrocyte Antigen 6 (FEA 6) is a newly identified red blood cell (RBC) antigen in cats discovered following an unintentional sensitization event, suggesting it can be immunogenic. Its ability to consistently induce alloimmunization remains unknown. This prospective study evaluated FEA 6 immunogenicity in transfusion-naive, FEA 6-negative cats by assessing anti-FEA 6 alloantibody production and plasma levels. A secondary objective was to bank polyclonal anti-FEA 6 antibodies.MethodsFifty-three cats underwent AB and extensive blood typing for FEAs 1-6, naturally occurring alloantibody (NOAb) screening, and compatibility testing to select donor-recipient pairs. FEA 6 prevalence was assessed in 82 type A cats. Two transfusion-naive, FEA 6-negative cats received FEA 6-positive, otherwise compatible RBC transfusions and were monitored for anti-FEA 6 alloantibody production by gel column agglutination. Repeat transfusions were performed if alloantibodies became undetectable. Agreement between recipient-derived and reference anti-FEA 6 alloantibodies was evaluated in 51 type A cats using kappa statistics.ResultsFEA 6 prevalence among type A cats was 75.6% (62/82); NOAb were detected in 10.3% of screened type A cats, but none were directed against FEA 6. Both recipients developed anti-FEA 6 alloantibodies. Recipient 1 responded after two sensitizations, whereas recipient 2 responded after a single transfusion. Both reached peak titers of 1:8, with alloantibodies detectable through days 372 and 200, respectively.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] FEA 6 양성 적혈구 수혈은 수혈 경험이 없는 FEA 6 음성 고양이 모두에서 항-FEA 6 동종항체를 유도하여 FEA 6의 면역원성을 입증하며, 고양이의 설명되지 않는 수혈 후 동종항체 반응에 기여할 가능성이 있다.
[방법·수치] 53마리 고양이를 대상으로 AB형 및 FEA 1-6 혈액형 검사를 수행하고, 2마리의 수혈 경험이 없는 FEA 6 음성 고양이가 FEA 6 양성 적혈구를 수혈받았으며, 젤 컬럼 응집검사로 항체를 모니터링했다. FEA 6 유병률은 A형 고양이의 75.6% (62/82), 동종항체 반응은 수신자 1은 2회 감작 후, 수신자 2는 1회 수혈 후 나타났으며 최고 역가는 1:8이었고 각각 372일, 200일까지 검출되었다. 수신자 유래 항체와 참조 항체 간 일치도는 카파값 0.64-0.78 (P<.001)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] FEA 6 혈액형 검사 및 수혈 적합성 검사에 활용 가능하며, 획득한 다클론 항체는 향후 FEA 6 혈액형 검사와 수혈 연구를 지원할 수 있다. 그러나 더 안정적인 시약 개발이 필요하고, 소규모 전향적 연구이며 고양이만을 대상으로 한 제한점이 있다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Mineral Analysis of Feline Treats: Unrecognized Sources of Phosphorus and Calcium in the Management of Chronic Kidney Disease.
papers.authors: Harris AN, Harris T, Vaden S
papers.abstract: Dietary phosphorus restriction is a cornerstone of chronic kidney disease (CKD) management in cats. While therapeutic renal diets are formulated to limit phosphorus intake, treats also contribute to total dietary phosphorus and calcium intake. The objective of this study was to quantify the phosphorus and calcium content of some feline purée-style treats and evaluate their potential contribution to dietary mineral intake in cats with CKD. A convenience sample comprising four flavors of commercially available Inaba Churu purée treats and three flavors of Weurva low-phosphorus purée treats were analyzed. Phosphorus and calcium concentrations were quantified using inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry and reported descriptively as milligrams per sachet and milligrams per 100 kcal. Phosphorus content varied widely across products, ranging from 9 to 36 mg per sachet (64-600mg/100kcal). The evaluated Churu treats contained higher phosphorus concentrations (29-36 mg/ sachet) than the evaluated Weruva low-phosphorus formulations (9-10 mg/sachet). Calcium concentrations ranged from 0.14 to 4.06 mg per sachet (2.3-67.7 mg/100 kcal), with corresponding calcium-to-phosphorus (Ca:P) ratios ranging from 0.004 to 0.119. Phosphorus and calcium content, including Ca:P ratios, varied substantially among the products evaluated. These differences should be considered as part of the overall dietary management of cats with CKD, particularly when treats are administered routinely.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이용 페이스트형 간식의 인 함량이 제품마다 광범위하게 변동하며, 특히 Churu 제품이 저인 포뮬레이션보다 높은 인 함량을 함유하고 있어 만성신장질환 관리에서 간식의 인 제한이 중요함을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] Inaba Churu 4종과 Weurva 저인 포뮬레이션 3종의 페이스트형 간식을 유도결합플라즈마-광학방출분광법으로 분석했다. 인 함량은 1개 패키지당 9-36mg(100kcal당 64-600mg), 칼슘 함량은 0.14-4.06mg(100kcal당 2.3-67.7mg)이었으며, 칼슘:인 비율은 0.004-0.119로 광범위하게 변동했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 만성신장질환 고양이의 식이 관리 시 치료식의 인 제한뿐만 아니라 일상적으로 투여되는 간식의 인·칼슘 함량도 고려해야 한다. 편의표본추출로 제한된 제품만 분석되어 모든 시판 간식을 대표하지 못하며, 더 광범위한 제품 분석이 필요하다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Assessment of an educational social media campaign on improving feline osteoarthritis pain awareness and knowledge among cat owners.
papers.authors: Wong WS, Alcântara H, Bukhari SSUH, Murrell J, Steagall P
papers.abstract: Objectives - Feline osteoarthritis (OA) is highly prevalent but often underdiagnosed, largely owing to owners' difficulty recognising subtle clinical signs. This study evaluated the effects of an evidence-based, peer-reviewed educational social media campaign on cat owners' knowledge and awareness of feline OA.Methods - A prospective, interventional study was conducted with a convenience sample of adult, non-veterinary cat owners recruited via social media. Participants completed a validated online survey assessing knowledge and attitudes about feline OA before and after viewing an evidence based social media campaign (i.e., the intervention) covering 4 domains (introduction, clinical signs, diagnosis, management). Paired non parametric tests compared pre- and post-intervention total knowledge scores, individual knowledge items and Likert scale attitude items.Results - A total of 53 participants completed both surveys. Mean total knowledge scores increased from 19.9 ± 3.1 to 23.6 ± 2.8 (p < 0.001). Correct identification of OA as non-curable increased from 49.1% to 83% (p < 0.001), and the misconception that OA only affects senior cats decreased from 13.2% to 0% (p = 0.02). Recognition of key risk factors improved: neutering after 6 months of age (9.4% to 60.4%, p < 0.001) and outdoor access (28.3% to 73.6%, p < 0.001). Recognition of scratching posts as an option for environment changes increased from 24.5% to 60.3% (p <0.001). The owners' confidence in their ability to contribute to diagnosis increased (Hodges-Lehmann shift +0.99, p = 0.04), knowledge of environmental modifications increased (+1.49, p <0.001), and stress about lifelong management decreased (-0.99, p = 0.01).
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 근거기반 사회관계망서비스(SNS) 교육 캠페인이 고양이 주인들의 고양이 골관절염에 대한 인식과 지식을 유의하게 향상시켰으며, 전통적 수의사-보호자 소통을 보완할 수 있는 확장성 있는 플랫폼임을 입증했다.
[방법·수치] 편의표본추출로 모집한 성인 비수의학 고양이 주인 53명을 대상으로 한 전향적 중재 연구로, 4개 영역(소개, 임상징후, 진단, 관리)의 SNS 캠페인 시청 전후 지식점수를 비교했다. 평균 지식점수는 19.9±3.1에서 23.6±2.8로 증가(p<0.001), 골관절염 비치유성 인식 49.1%에서 83%(p<0.001), 중성화 후 6개월령 위험인자 인식 9.4%에서 60.4%(p<0.001), 실외활동 위험인자 인식 28.3%에서 73.6%(p<0.001)로 향상되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] SNS를 통한 교육이 보호자의 진단 참여 신뢰도, 환경 개선 지식, 장기 관리에 대한 스트레스 개선에 효과적이므로 임상 현장에서 보호자 교육 도구로 활용할 수 있다. 그러나 편의표본추출로 인한 선택편향, 소규모 표본(n=53), 단기 추적 조사로 인한 지식 유지 평가 미흡이 한계이다.

papers.title: Target-controlled infusion of propofol induces rapid hypertriglyceridemia in healthy cats.
papers.authors: Arboit F, Mangini LT, Gasparotto JC, Griebeler LB, Oliveira JO
papers.abstract: To evaluate serum triglyceride concentrations during target-controlled infusion (TCI) of propofol in healthy cats undergoing elective orchiectomy and to investigate the relationship between cumulative propofol dose and triglyceride concentrations. 8 healthy male cats were anesthetized using propofol administered via a TCI system targeting a plasma concentration of 7 µg/mL for 45 minutes. Blood samples were collected at baseline, after premedication, immediately after induction, and at 20 and 40 minutes of infusion for determination of serum triglyceride concentrations. Serum triglycerides increased significantly following propofol administration, with elevations detectable immediately after induction. Median concentrations were 41 mg/dL (range, 31 to 75) at baseline, 32 mg/dL (range, 20 to 99) after premedication, 128 mg/dL (range, 72 to 215) immediately after induction, 132 mg/dL (range, 106 to 227) at 20 minutes of infusion, and 143 mg/dL (range, 57 to 230) at 40 minutes of infusion. During anesthesia, 75% of the animals exceeded the reference interval for triglycerides. No significant correlation was observed between propofol cumulative doses and triglyceride concentrations. Target-controlled propofol infusion is associated with a rapid increase in serum triglyceride concentrations in cats even during short anesthetic procedures. Given the use of prolonged propofol infusions in veterinary anesthesia, these findings highlight the importance of considering potential changes in serum triglyceride concentrations, particularly in patients with underlying lipid or metabolic dysfunction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 프로포폴의 표적농도주입(TCI)은 급속한 혈청 중성지방 상승을 유발하며, 마취 중 75%의 동물이 정상 범위를 초과했다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 수컷 고양이 8마리를 대상으로 프로포폴 TCI(목표 혈장농도 7 μg/mL, 45분)를 적용했다. 중성지방 중앙값은 기저선 41 mg/dL에서 유도직후 128 mg/dL, 주입 20분 후 132 mg/dL, 40분 후 143 mg/dL로 상승했으며, 프로포폴 누적용량과 중성지방 농도 간 유의한 상관관계는 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 프로포폴의 단기 마취에서도 중성지방 상승이 발생하므로, 장시간 프로포폴 주입이 필요한 경우 특히 대사질환이나 지질 이상이 있는 환자에서 혈청 중성지방 변화를 모니터링해야 한다. 소규모 단일종 연구이며 장시간 마취에서의 영향은 불명확하다.

papers.title: Target-controlled infusion of propofol induces rapid hypertriglyceridemia in healthy cats.
papers.authors: Arboit F, Mangini LT, Gasparotto JC, Griebeler LB, Oliveira JO
papers.abstract: To evaluate serum triglyceride concentrations during target-controlled infusion (TCI) of propofol in healthy cats undergoing elective orchiectomy and to investigate the relationship between cumulative propofol dose and triglyceride concentrations. 8 healthy male cats were anesthetized using propofol administered via a TCI system targeting a plasma concentration of 7 µg/mL for 45 minutes. Blood samples were collected at baseline, after premedication, immediately after induction, and at 20 and 40 minutes of infusion for determination of serum triglyceride concentrations. Serum triglycerides increased significantly following propofol administration, with elevations detectable immediately after induction. Median concentrations were 41 mg/dL (range, 31 to 75) at baseline, 32 mg/dL (range, 20 to 99) after premedication, 128 mg/dL (range, 72 to 215) immediately after induction, 132 mg/dL (range, 106 to 227) at 20 minutes of infusion, and 143 mg/dL (range, 57 to 230) at 40 minutes of infusion. During anesthesia, 75% of the animals exceeded the reference interval for triglycerides. No significant correlation was observed between propofol cumulative doses and triglyceride concentrations. Target-controlled propofol infusion is associated with a rapid increase in serum triglyceride concentrations in cats even during short anesthetic procedures. Given the use of prolonged propofol infusions in veterinary anesthesia, these findings highlight the importance of considering potential changes in serum triglyceride concentrations, particularly in patients with underlying lipid or metabolic dysfunction.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 프로포폴의 목표농도주입(TCI)은 급속한 혈청 중성지방 상승을 유발하며, 마취 중 75%의 동물이 기준치를 초과했다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 수컷 고양이 8마리를 대상으로 목표 혈장농도 7 μg/mL로 45분간 프로포폴 TCI 마취 후 혈청 중성지방 측정(기저값: 중앙값 41 mg/dL, 범위 31-75 → 유도 직후: 128 mg/dL, 범위 72-215 → 주입 40분: 143 mg/dL, 범위 57-230). 누적 프로포폴 용량과 중성지방 농도 간 유의한 상관관계 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 단기 마취 절차에서도 프로포폴 사용 시 중성지방 상승을 모니터링하고, 특히 이상지혈증이나 대사 질환 동반 환자에서 주의가 필요하다. 단일 소규모 연구(n=8)로 장시간 주입 시 임상적 의미는 추가 평가 필요.

papers.title: Doxorubicin-induced Cardiotoxicity in Dogs: A Narrative Review.
papers.authors: Sunpongsri S, Roos T, Gerhing R, Zandvliet M, Santarelli G
papers.abstract: Doxorubicin, an anthracycline widely used in both human and veterinary oncology, is highly effective against a variety of malignancies in dogs, including lymphomas, sarcomas and carcinomas. Despite its efficacy, doxorubicin exposure can be associated with cardiotoxicity, which may present acutely or chronically, potentially leading to severe cardiac arrhythmia and congestive heart failure. Mechanisms underlying cardiotoxicity are multifactorial, including oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, DNA damage via topoisomerase IIβ, inflammation and dysregulated cell death pathways such as apoptosis, pyroptosis and ferroptosis. In dogs, known risk factors include higher cumulative dose, breed predisposition to idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy, and higher body weight. Cardiac biomarkers, electrocardiography, echocardiography and other advanced imaging techniques have been employed to detect cardiac changes that can be seen also in the absence of clinical signs. However, current evidence is predominantly derived from experimental and retrospective research, highlighting the need for large prospective clinical studies to strengthen recommendations for monitoring and prevention. A deeper understanding of doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity in dogs is needed to identify factors influencing individual susceptibility, clarify the progression from subclinical damage to clinical cardiac dysfunction, and guide future research. Emerging approaches, including advanced echocardiography, microRNAs, proteomic biomarkers and pharmacokinetic modelling, may help improve early detection and guide more individualised dosing to minimise toxicity.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 독소루비신은 개의 림프종, 육종, 암종에 대해 높은 효과를 보이지만 급성 또는 만성 심독성을 유발할 수 있으며, 이는 산화스트레스, 미토콘드리아 기능장애, DNA 손상, 염증 및 비정상 세포사멸(자살사, 파이롭토시스, 철분해)을 통해 발생한다.
[방법·수치] 내러티브 리뷰로서 개에서의 독소루비신 심독성에 관한 문헌을 종합하였으며, 위험요인으로 누적 용량 증가, 특정 견종의 특발성 확장성 심근병증 소인, 높은 체중이 확인되었다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 심장 바이오마커, 심전도, 심초음파 및 첨단 영상기법으로 임상증상이 없는 단계에서도 심장 변화를 감지할 수 있으나, 현재 근거는 주로 실험 및 후향적 연구에서 비롯되어 모니터링 및 예방 권고를 강화하기 위한 대규모 전향적 임상연구가 필요하다. 개별 감수성에 영향을 미치는 요인, 무증상 손상에서 임상적 심장기능부전으로의 진행과정 규명이 필요하며, 첨단 심초음파, 마이크로RNA, 단백질체학 바이오마커, 약물동력학 모델링 등이 조기 진단 및 개인맞춤형 용량 조절에 도움이 될 수 있다.

papers.title: Urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein in cats with lower urinary tract disease.
papers.authors: Culha N, Acar A, Ulutas B, Dinler Ay C
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein levels in both obstructive and non-obstructive feline lower urinary tract disease. In addition, urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein levels were investigated in cats experiencing short-term (<36 hours) and long-term (≥36 hours) urethral obstruction. The study included 32 cats, classified into two main groups: cats with feline lower urinary tract disease (n = 24) and healthy controls (n = 8). The feline lower urinary tract disease group was subdivided into obstructive (n = 16) and non-obstructive (n = 8) forms. The obstructive group was further divided based on urethral obstruction duration into short-term (n = 8) and long-term (n = 8) sub-subgroups. Serum creatinine, blood urea nitrogen and potassium were measured in blood samples. Urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein and urinary creatinine concentrations were measured in urine supernatant samples. Urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein concentrations were indexed to urinary creatinine and expressed as the urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein/creatinine ratio. The mean urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein/creatinine values of cats with obstructive feline lower urinary tract disease were statistically higher than those in cats with non-obstructive feline lower urinary tract disease and healthy controls. The difference between the mean urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein/creatinine values of cats with long-term and short-term obstruction was not statistically significant. In addition, moderately positive correlations were calculated between urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein/creatinine and serum creatinine (r = .646; P < .001; 95% CI = 0.264 to 0.863) and between urinary liver-type fatty acid-binding protein/creatinine and blood urea nitrogen (r = .549; P < .01; 95% CI = 0.081 to 0.791) in the study population.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 폐색성 하부요로질환에서 뇨중 간형 지방산결합단백질/크레아티닌 비율이 비폐색성 질환 및 건강한 대조군보다 통계적으로 유의하게 높으며, 폐색성 신손상의 바이오마커로서의 잠재력을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 32마리 고양이(하부요로질환 24마리, 건강 대조군 8마리)를 대상으로 혈청 크레아티닌, 요소질소, 칼륨 및 뇨중 간형 지방산결합단백질을 측정했다. 폐색성 질환의 뇨중 간형 지방산결합단백질/크레아티닌은 비폐색성 질환보다 높았고, 장기폐색(≥36시간)과 단기폐색(<36시간) 간 차이는 통계적으로 유의하지 않았다. 뇨중 간형 지방산결합단백질/크레아티닌과 혈청 크레아티닌 간 중등도 양의 상관(r=0.646, P<0.001)이 있었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 폐색성 하부요로질환 환자에서 폐색성 급성신손상 감별을 위한 보조 바이오마커로 활용 가능하나, 소규모 단일기관 연구이며 초록에서 민감도·특이도 등 진단능은 제시되지 않았다.

papers.title: Use of plasma chromogranin a epitopes vasostatin and catestatin as biomarkers for catecholamine-producing tumours in dogs.
papers.authors: Prabert J, Hanson J, Ishigaki K, Asano K, Höglund K
papers.abstract: Differentiation of catecholamine-producing tumours from other adrenal tumours remains difficult. Chromogranin A (CgA) is a marker for catecholamine secretion in the body. An assay for quantification of the CgA epitopes vasostatin and catestatin has been validated for use in dogs but not yet evaluated in dogs with catecholamine-producing tumours. The aims were to evaluate the assays foranalysis of plasma concentrations of the CgA epitopes vasostatin and catestatin in dogs with adrenal tumours and to compare concentrations between catecholamine-producing tumours and adrenocortical tumours in dogs that were subjected to adrenalectomy. Twelve dogs with histopathologically confirmed catecholamine-secreting tumours (eleven pheochromocytomas (PCCs), one extra-adrenal sympathetic paraganglioma (PGL)) and twelve with adrenocortical tumours were included in the study. Plasma concentrations of the CgA epitopes vasostatin and catestatin were determined byradioimmunoassay (RIA), before adrenalectomy in 23 out of 24 dogs and after adrenalectomy in six of the dogs with catecholamine-secreting tumours (five PCC, one PGL). Tumour diagnosis was made by histopathology in all cases. Overall, median plasma concentration of the CgA epitopevasostatin in dogs with catecholamine-secreting tumours was 0.82 nmol/L (interquartile range (IQR) 0.52 to 1.60 nmol/L), which was significantly higher(Wilcoxon rank sum exact test, P= 0.0374) than the vasostatin concentration in adrenocortical tumours (median 0.50; IQR 0.34 to 0.59 nmol/L). A subsetof dogs (5/12) with catecholamine-secreting tumours had elevated plasma vasostatin concentrations preoperatively. After successful surgery, thepreoperatively elevated plasma vasostatin concentrations decreased numerically, however without reaching statistical significance. Catestatin concentrationdid not differ between tumour types.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 카테콜아민 분비 종양(갈색세포종/부신경절종)이 있는 개에서 chromogranin A epitope인 vasostatin의 혈장 농도가 부신피질종양보다 유의하게 높으며, vasostatin이 카테콜아민 분비 종양의 생물표지자로 잠재력을 가진다.
[방법·수치] 조직병리학적으로 확인된 카테콜아민 분비 종양 12마리(갈색세포종 11마리, 부신경절종 1마리)와 부신피질종양 12마리를 대상으로 방사면역분석법으로 혈장 vasostatin과 catestatin을 측정했다. 카테콜아민 분비 종양에서 vasostatin 중앙값 0.82 nmol/L(사분위수범위 0.52-1.60)로 부신피질종양 0.50 nmol/L(0.34-0.59)보다 유의하게 높았다(P=0.0374). 카테콜아민 분비 종양의 5/12마리에서 술전 vasostatin이 상승했고, 술후 수치는 감소 경향을 보였으나 통계적 유의성은 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] vasostatin은 카테콜아민 분비 종양의 감별진단에 보조적 생물표지자로 활용될 수 있으나, 소규모 단일기관 연구이고 술후 수치 변화의 통계적 유의성이 없으며 catestatin은 판별능이 없는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Clinical Characteristics of Hair Cycle Arrest in Toy Poodles: A Retrospective Comparison With Pomeranians.
papers.authors: Ueyama A, Amatuji H, Iyori K, Hsiao YH
papers.abstract: Hair cycle arrest (HCA), known as alopecia X, is an alopecia disorder most commonly reported in Nordic breeds-particularly Pomeranians. Toy poodles (TPs) also are frequently affected, yet their clinical characteristics have not been reviewed systematically. The aim of this retrospective case series was to compare the clinical characteristics of HCA in TPs and Pomeranians. Medical records of client-owned dogs diagnosed with HCA between 2018 and 2024 were reviewed. Signalment, including age of onset and age at diagnosis, clinical features, skin barrier function (transepidermal water loss [TEWL], stratum corneum hydration [SCH]) and treatment outcomes were analysed. Fifty dogs (19 TPs, 31 Pomeranians) met the inclusion criteria. TPs were significantly older than Pomeranians both at disease onset and at the first presentation (p = 0.003 and p = 0.001, respectively). Both breeds exhibited similar bilateral symmetrical alopecia presentations; however, Pomeranians mainly presented with a single alopecic site, while nearly half of the TPs had multiple affected sites (p = 0.032). Pruritus and superficial pyoderma were common in both breeds. TEWL and SCH values frequently deviated from reference ranges (increased TEWL and decreased SCH), indicating impaired skin barrier function. TEWL was significantly higher in TPs with pyoderma than in those without (p = 0.025). Regarding outcomes, > 70% of patients showed partial or complete regrowth, despite various treatment regimens. HCA in TPs closely resembles that in Pomeranians, despite genetic divergence, suggesting a conserved pathogenesis across their breeds. Frequent pruritus and pyoderma, together with abnormal TEWL and SCH, indicate secondary skin barrier dysfunction. Clinical management should address both hair regrowth and restoration of skin barrier function.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 토이 푸들과 포메라니안의 모발주기휴지증(alopecia X)은 유전적 차이에도 불구하고 임상양상이 유사하며, 모두 이차적 피부장벽 기능장애를 나타낸다.
[방법·수치] 2018~2024년 HCA 진단 개 50마리(토이 푸들 19마리, 포메라니안 31마리) 대상 후향적 비교분석. 토이 푸들이 포메라니안보다 발병 및 내원 시 나이가 유의하게 많았음(p=0.003, p=0.001). 포메라니안은 단일 부위 탈모가 주였으나 토이 푸들은 약 50%가 다중 부위 침범(p=0.032). 양견 모두에서 증가된 TEWL과 감소된 SCH 관찰되었으며, 토이 푸들의 화농증 동반 시 TEWL이 유의하게 높았음(p=0.025). 70% 이상에서 부분 또는 완전 모발재생 달성.
[임상 적용·한계] 토이 푸들 HCA 환자의 모발재생뿐 아니라 피부장벽기능 복원을 함께 관리해야 한다. 소양증과 표재성 화농증이 흔하므로 이에 대한 적극적 대응이 필요하다. 후향적 단일기관 사례연구이며 치료 프로토콜이 다양하여 표준화된 치료효과 평가에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Medetomidine-vatinoxan is associated with a higher proportion of hypotension than dexmedetomidine in anesthetized dogs: a retrospective, matched-cohort study.
papers.authors: Rouse S, Muñoz K, Lerche P, Ballash G, Midon M
papers.abstract: To compare clinical parameters and medical interventions during the first hour of inhalant anesthesia in dogs administered medetomidine-vatinoxan (Zenalpha [ZEN]) versus dexmedetomidine (DEX) as IM preanesthetic agents. Medical records were searched to identify dogs premedicated with ZEN between August 2022 and January 2025. Dogs administered DEX between July 2021 and May 2026 were then identified and matched with α2-adrenergic receptor agonist dose equivalence prioritized. Generalized estimating equation models were constructed to assess associations between variables of interest and premedication type, while accounting for repeated measurements within paired matched sets. The ZEN group included 24 dogs (ZEN dose median, 10 μg/kg; range, 5 to 26 μg/kg), whereas the DEX group included 48 dogs (DEX dose median, 5 μg/kg; range, 3 to 10 μg/kg), with no differences between groups. Compared with DEX, premedication with ZEN was associated with an 18 beats/min higher heart rate, whereas mean arterial pressure was 19 mm Hg lower. Dogs receiving ZEN had 9.3-fold greater odds of receiving an IV fluid bolus and 6.8-fold greater odds of vasopressor administration. No differences were detectable between groups in IV interventions administered for a light plane of anesthesia. Findings indicated ZEN was associated with intraoperative hypotension in dogs during the first hour of volatile anesthesia, despite significantly higher heart rates. This effect translated into a significantly greater need for hemodynamic intervention. The effects of ZEN on arterial blood pressure warrant careful hemodynamic monitoring and preparedness to provide blood pressure support in dogs undergoing inhalant anesthesia.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 메데토미딘-바티녹산(Zenalpha)은 덱스메데토미딘 대비 흡입마취 중 저혈압 발생 비율이 유의하게 높으며, 더 적극적인 혈역학적 중재가 필요하다.
[방법·수치] 개 24마리(Zenalpha, 중앙값 10 μg/kg)와 개 48마리(덱스메데토미딘, 중앙값 5 μg/kg)의 후향적 매칭 코호트 연구로, 흡입마취 첫 1시간 동안 심박수는 18회/분 높았으나 평균동맥압은 19 mmHg 낮았으며, IV 수액 볼루스 필요 확률 9.3배, 혈관수축제 사용 확률 6.8배 증가했다.
[임상 적용·한계] Zenalpha 사용 시 저혈압 대비 신중한 혈역학적 모니터링과 혈압 지지 요법의 준비가 필수적이다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이며 작은 표본 크기의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Use of a cost-effective specimen retrieval bag for canine laparoscopic ovariectomy: a clinical prospective study (2021-2024).
papers.authors: Boullenger J, Gougeon E, Dunié-Mérigot A, Poncet C
papers.abstract: To assess the feasibility and safety of a cost-effective non-medical plastic bag used as a specimen retrieval bag during laparoscopic ovariectomy. Thirty-one client-owned dogs having laparoscopic ovariectomy with a non-medical specimen retrieval bag were prospectively enrolled. A disposable liner for baby feeding bottles was used as a specimen retrieval bag. Each bag cost $1.3. Incision enlargement, surgical and retrieval times, retrieval easiness score, size of specimens, surgeon's status (resident or diplomate) and complications were recorded. Owner-assessed comfort score of their dogs and owners' satisfaction score were collected at 2 weeks postoperatively. The mean surgical time was 45.6 ± 13.4 minutes, and the mean retrieval time was 6.2 ± 4.4 minutes. The mean size of the specimens was 31.4 ± 19.2 mm. The median retrieval easiness score was 8.0 (IQR = 8.0 to 10.0) and was significantly lower for residents than diplomates (median difference = -1). Incision enlargement was required in three cases. Three minor intraoperative complications occurred. The median owner-assessed comfort score was 9.0 (IQR = 7.5 to 10.0) and the median owners' satisfaction score was 10.0 (IQR = 9.0 to 10.0). Use of a sterilized non-medical plastic bag as specimen retrieval bag for canine laparoscopic ovariectomy was easy with limited minor complications, and excellent dogs' comfort and owners' satisfaction. It may be a suitable cost-effective alternative to commercial specimen retrieval bags for use in canine laparoscopic ovariectomy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 복강경 난소절제술에서 멸균 처리한 비의료용 플라스틱 백(아기 젖병 라이너, 개당 $1.3)을 검체 회수낭으로 사용하는 것이 안전하고 용이하며 경제적이다.
[방법·수치] 개 31마리를 대상으로 전향적 임상 연구 진행. 평균 수술 시간 45.6±13.4분, 평균 회수 시간 6.2±4.4분, 검체 크기 31.4±19.2mm. 회수 용이성 점수 중앙값 8.0 (사분위수 8.0-10.0), 전공의가 전문의보다 유의하게 낮음(중앙값 차이 -1). 절개 확대 필요 3례, 경미한 술중 합병증 3례 발생. 보호자 평가 반려견 편안함 점수 중앙값 9.0, 보호자 만족도 점수 중앙값 10.0.

papers.title: Clinical Presentation, Acute Clinical Response, Drug Tolerability, and Short-Term Outcome of Cats Treated for Acute Congestive Heart Failure With Pimobendan (2017-2022): 71 Cases.
papers.authors: Murphy LA, Stepien RL, Loeber S, Tjostheim SS, Kellihan HB
papers.abstract: To describe clinical effects, drug tolerability, and short-term outcomes of cats treated with pimobendan (PB) in conjunction with other therapies for acute congestive heart failure (CHF). Retrospective single-center study (2017  to 2022). Academic teaching and referral hospital. Seventy-one cats with acute CHF treated with PB and furosemide. Treatment included dobutamine (DB) in 15 cases. Physical examination results, laboratory results, and radiographic pulmonary infiltrate scoring were assessed in all cats at admission and 24 h later. Respiratory rate and radiographic pulmonary infiltrate scores decreased after 24 h of therapy (p < 0.0001 for both values). Anemia and hypochloremia were more common than azotemia, hyponatremia, and hypokalemia on Day 1. Serum chloride and potassium concentrations decreased, and serum creatinine concentration increased after therapy (p < 0.05), but none of these values was associated with prolonged hospitalization or reduced survival. Cats receiving PB exhibited few adverse clinical signs. Seven of 15 cats (47%) that received concurrent DB therapy were suspected of having adverse effects that responded to decreased dosage or discontinuation of the medication. There was no difference in survival to discharge (p = 0.17) or days of hospitalization (p = 0.78) between cats receiving DB therapy and those that did not. Overall survival to discharge was 76%, and 75% of cats discharged alive were discharged in ≤3 days. The short-term prognosis for cats treated for acute CHF was good, and PB therapy appeared to be well tolerated. Most cats showed clinical and radiographic improvement in the first 24 h of therapy and were hospitalized for ≤3 days. The addition of DB to therapy in some cats did not alter survival and was associated with adverse clinical signs in 7/15 cats (47%) treated with DB.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 급성 울혈성 심부전 고양이에서 피모벤단 치료는 잘 견디어지며 좋은 단기 예후를 보였고, 72시간 이내 대부분 퇴원했다. 도부타민 병용은 생존율을 개선하지 못했으며 47%에서 부작용을 유발했다.
[방법·수치] 2017-2022년 단일 학술기관 후향적 연구, 급성 울혈성 심부전 고양이 71마리, 피모벤단과 푸로세미드 병용 치료(15마리는 도부타민 추가). 24시간 후 호흡수와 흉부방사선 폐침윤 점수 감소(p<0.0001), 퇴원생존율 76%, 도부타민 병용군과 비병용군 간 생존율 차이 없음(p=0.17).
[임상 적용·한계] 급성 울혈성 심부전 고양이의 초기 치료로 피모벤단이 안전하고 효과적이며, 도부타민 추가는 임상 개선을 제공하지 않으므로 선택적 사용 권장. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이고 도부타민 적응증 명시 부재로 약물 선택 기준 불명확.

papers.title: Resolution of suspected neuraxial morphine-induced myoclonus and hyperalgesia in two dogs following intravenous ketamine.
papers.authors: Ching-Wai Lau D, Ishihara T, Mascarenhas C, Castro D, Hofmeister EH
papers.abstract: This report describes the successful treatment with intravenous (IV) ketamine of two dogs that developed suspected neuraxial morphine-induced myoclonus and hypersensitivity following intended epidural injection of preservative-free morphine. A 6-year-old, 30 kg, entire female Labrador Retriever presented for an elective ovariohysterectomy and a 4-year-old, 7.5 kg, castrated male Shih Tzu was admitted for surgical attenuation of an extrahepatic portosystemic shunt. The first dog developed focal, repetitive, rhythmic dorsoventral tail movements shortly after epidural morphine injection; these movements spontaneously resolved after 10 minutes but returned intraoperatively. During recovery, involuntary muscle contractions involving the tail, pelvic limbs, trunk and thoracic limbs were observed. The dog also exhibited marked hypersensitivity, evidenced by vocalisation and biting of the tail and pelvic limbs in response to tactile stimulation. Marked hypersensitivity and the involuntary muscle contractions were refractory to dexmedetomidine (total 3 μg kg-1 IV), hydromorphone (0.1 mg kg-1 IV), butorphanol (0.2 mg kg-1 IV) and midazolam (0.2 mg kg-1 IV) but resolved with ketamine (1 mg kg-1 IV). Ketamine was then administered by constant rate infusion (0.2 mg kg-1 hour-1) until the following morning. The second dog exhibited intense vocalisation, repeated turning toward the tail and tail twitching 207 minutes after epidural injection of morphine. Ketamine (2 mg kg-1 IV) was subsequently administered, resulting in complete resolution of all clinical signs within 2 minutes. These are the first two reported cases to demonstrate successful management of neuraxial morphine-induced myoclonus and hyperalgesia with ketamine. The adverse clinical signs associated with probable inadvertent subarachnoid morphine injection resolved rapidly and completely following intravenous ketamine.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경막외 모르핀 주입 후 발생한 근간대경련과 과민통증이 정맥 케타민으로 성공적으로 치료되었으며, 이는 신경축 오피오이드 관련 신경흥분에 NMDA 수용체 매개 기전이 관여함을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 경막외 모르핀 주입 후 근간대경련과 과민통증을 보인 개 2례(래브라도 리트리버 30kg, 시츄 7.5kg)를 대상으로 했으며, 첫 번째 개는 덱스메데토미딘(총 3μg/kg IV), 하이드로몰폰(0.1mg/kg IV), 부토르파놀(0.2mg/kg IV), 미다졸람(0.2mg/kg IV)에 불응하였으나 케타민(1mg/kg IV)으로 해결되었고 지속 주입(0.2mg/kg/hour) 계속; 두 번째 개는 케타민(2mg/kg IV) 투여 후 2분 내 완전 해소됨.
[임상 적용·한계] 경막외 오피오이드 주입 후 신경흥분 증상 발생 시 케타민을 구조 치료제로 고려할 수 있다. 그러나 2례의 증례 보고로 추가 연구와 더 큰 규모의 임상시험이 필요하며, 의도하지 않은 지주막하 주입과의 연관성을 완전히 규명하지 못했다.

papers.title: Polarization Sensitive Optical Coherence Tomography for Surgical Margin Assessment for Canine Soft Tissue Sarcoma.
papers.authors: Patel N, Fontes G, Dornbusch J, Biggo M, Erickson A
papers.abstract: Soft tissue sarcomas (STSs) and skeletal muscle both appear high scattering on spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT) imaging, which resulted in instances of misclassification by observers in prior soft tissue sarcoma margin assessment studies. Polarization-sensitive optical coherence tomography (PS-OCT) is an extension of OCT that provides additional information about tissue polarization contrast. In this prospective study we wanted to evaluate whether PS-OCT improves tissue differentiation and diagnostic accuracy compared to spectral-domain OCT (SD-OCT) alone. PS-OCT images from surgical margins of 10 resected STS were compared with histopathology to identify characteristic features of normal and neoplastic tissues. Then, six observers of varying OCT image interpretation experience assessed surgical margins from 30 resected STS using SD-OCT alone and SD-OCT combined with PS-OCT. PS-OCT images demonstrated distinct birefringence (optical patterns), corresponding to tissue organization: skeletal muscle exhibited alternating high and low birefringence bands, fascia showed variable birefringence and STS had uniformly low birefringence. Overall diagnostic accuracy was high for both modalities [correct classification rate: SD-OCT alone 93.7% (95% confidence interval (CI): 90.1, 96.0) vs. SD-OCT combined with PS-OCT 92.6% (95% = CI: 89.3, 95.4)]; adding PS-OCT did not significantly improve accuracy across all observers (p = 0.82), though expert observers benefited significantly (p = 0.0018). Interobserver and intraobserver agreement ranged from substantial to near perfect. These findings suggest PS-OCT can be interpreted reliably after brief training and may enhance accuracy for experienced users. Further research should explore structured training and real-time applications for comprehensive surgical margin evaluation.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 편광 감응 광학간섭단층촬영(PS-OCT)은 정상 근육, 근막, 연부조직육종을 편광 이방성(birefringence) 패턴으로 구별할 수 있으며, 숙련된 관찰자에게 진단 정확도를 향상시킨다.
[방법·수치] 개의 절제된 연부조직육종 30개에서 SD-OCT 단독 대비 PS-OCT 병용 비교 평가, 6명의 관찰자(경험도 다양) 참여. 정확한 분류율: SD-OCT 93.7% (95% CI: 90.1-96.0) vs PS-OCT 병용 92.6% (95% CI: 89.3-95.4); 전체 관찰자에서 유의미한 개선 없음(p=0.82)이나 숙련된 관찰자에서 유의미한 개선(p=0.0018).
[임상 적용·한계] PS-OCT는 간단한 훈련 후 신뢰할 수 있게 해석 가능하며 경험 많은 외과의에게 술중 절제연(surgical margin) 평가 보조 도구로 활용 가능하나, 소규모 전향적 연구이고 실시간 임상 적용에 대한 추가 연구 필요.

papers.title: A New Application of (64)CuCl(2) PET/CT: Imaging of Cats With Mammary Carcinoma.
papers.authors: Yang VA, Lunceford JM, Garrett C, Lattimer JC, Papageorgiou C
papers.abstract: Feline mammary carcinoma (FMC) is an aggressive and highly metastatic cancer that shares molecular and clinical characteristics with human triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), making it a relevant comparative model for a disease lacking targeted therapies. This study investigated the feasibility and clinical utility of 64CuCl2 PET/CT imaging in cats with naturally occurring mammary carcinoma. Eight cats (seven tumour-bearing, one healthy control) were administered an intravenous dose of 64CuCl2 and underwent whole-body PET/CT imaging. Semi-quantitative analysis was performed using standardized uptake values (SUVs), and tumour-to-muscle ratios were calculated to assess lesion conspicuity. Serum ceruloplasmin concentrations were measured as a marker of systemic copper metabolism. All primary masses were 64Cu-avid and conspicuous, with consistently elevated tumour-to-muscle ratios across tumour-bearing cats, allowing clear differentiation between neoplastic and normal tissue. Imaging provided additional staging information by identifying locally invasive and metastatic disease that was not fully evident on physical examination. Physiologic tracer distribution was characterized by high uptake in the liver and gallbladder and low uptake in skeletal muscle, which served as a reliable reference tissue. Serum ceruloplasmin concentrations varied widely and did not correlate with tumour uptake. These findings suggest that 64CuCl2 PET/CT is a feasible functional imaging modality for FMC, potentially aiding in tumour detection. This was an exploratory study, and not all imaging results could be confirmed by cytology or histopathology. Nonetheless, our findings suggest that 64CuCl2 PET/CT should be investigated further as a method for probing copper utilization in FMC.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 64CuCl2 PET/CT는 고양이 유선암종의 기능성 영상진단 방법으로 가능성이 있으며, 원발 종양의 검출과 국소 침습 및 원격 전이 질환의 병기 결정에 도움이 될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 유선암종을 가진 고양이 7마리와 대조군 1마리(총 8마리)를 대상으로 64CuCl2를 정맥주사한 후 전신 PET/CT 영상을 획득했으며, 표준화섭취값(SUV)과 종양-근육 비율로 반정량 분석을 수행했다. 모든 원발 종양에서 64Cu 집적을 보였고, 종양-근육 비율이 일관되게 상승하여 신생물과 정상 조직의 명확한 감별이 가능했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 신체검진으로 발견되지 않은 국소 침습성 및 전이성 질환을 추가로 확인할 수 있어 임상적 병기 결정에 유용할 수 있으나, 이는 탐색적 연구로서 모든 영상 소견이 세포학 또는 조직병리학적으로 확인되지 않았으며 소규모 단일 기관 연구의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Exercise Prescriptions for Cardiovascular Health in Adults: 2026 ACC Scientific Statement: A Report of the American College of Cardiology.
papers.authors: Myers J, Beckie TM, Chastin S, Fleg JL, Kitzman DW
papers.abstract: Regular physical activity and structured exercise are foundational for cardiovascular prevention and treatment, yet exercise prescription remains inconsistently integrated into routine cardiovascular care. This American College of Cardiology scientific statement provides contemporary, practical guidance for clinicians on prescribing exercise across the spectrum of cardiovascular health and disease. The statement reviews evidence supporting physical activity, exercise training, and cardiorespiratory fitness as powerful determinants of cardiovascular outcomes, emphasizing that the greatest absolute benefits occur when inactive individuals begin moving and that additional benefits accrue with higher volumes and intensity, within appropriate clinical limits. It summarizes approaches to aerobic, resistance, balance, and flexibility training; highlights the role of cardiac rehabilitation and supervised, home-based, hybrid, and virtual models; and addresses individualized exercise prescription for patients with coronary artery disease, peripheral artery disease, heart failure, cardiomyopathies, hypertension, overweight and obesity, adult congenital heart disease, and older age. The statement also discusses when exercise testing is useful to assess safety, guide intensity, establish baseline fitness, and monitor responses, while recognizing that routine preparticipation testing is not required for most asymptomatic individuals. Wearable devices and digital tools are reviewed as adjuncts to self-monitoring, goal setting, and cardiac rehabilitation extension, with attention to equity, access, and digital literacy. Key implementation priorities include improving clinician training, embedding physical activity counseling into cardiovascular care, tailoring prescriptions to patient goals and functional capacity, and expanding research on long-term adherence, clinical outcomes, diverse populations, and scalable delivery models.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 규칙적 신체활동과 운동은 심혈관 질환 예방 및 치료의 기초이며, 특히 비활동적인 개인이 운동을 시작할 때 절대적 이득이 가장 크고, 임상적 한계 내에서 운동량과 강도가 증가할수록 추가 이득이 발생한다.
[방법·수치] 미국심장학회의 과학 성명서로, 유산소·저항·균형·유연성 운동 접근법과 심장 재활의 다양한 모델(감시형, 가정형, 혼합형, 가상형)을 검토하였으며, 관상동맥질환·말초동맥질환·심부전·심근병증·고혈압·과체중 및 비만·성인 선천성 심장질환·고령 환자에 대한 개별화된 운동 처방을 제시한다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 운동 검사는 안전성 평가와 강도 설정에 유용하나 무증상 개인의 일상적 사전 검사는 불필요하며, 착용형 기기와 디지털 도구는 자가 모니터링과 심장 재활 확대에 활용할 수 있다. 임상의 교육 개선, 심혈관 진료에 신체활동 상담 통합, 개별 환자 목표에 맞춘 처방 맞춤화, 다양한 인구집단과 확장 가능한 전달 모델에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Point-of-care troponin I assay has acceptable performance detecting clinically important canine myocardial injury but reduced precision at low concentrations.
papers.authors: Ditzler B, Saunders AB, Wesselowski S, Guadiano P, Dunham JW
papers.abstract: To perform a partial validation of a point-of-care assay (Vcheck cardiac troponin I [VC-cTnI; cTnI]) for measurement of cTnI in canine serum and to perform a method comparison between the VC-cTnI and an established chemiluminescent assay (ADVIA Centaur XP High-Sensitivity Troponin I [AC-cTnI-HS]). From September 4, 2024, through August 21, 2025, surplus canine serum was collected from a diagnostic laboratory, and within-day variability, dilutional parallelism, spiking recovery, and the effect of common interferents (hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia) were analyzed for the VC-cTnI assay. A method comparison of the VC-cTnI and AC-cTnI-HS assays was performed with 121 canine serum samples. The within-day coefficient of variation ranged from 8.1% to 43.8%, decreasing as cTnI concentrations increased. Dilutional parallelism and spiking recovery assessments had mean ± SD observed-to-expected ratios of 80.5 ± 33.2% (range, 21.1% to 122.2%) and 112.8 ± 35.6% (range, 46.0% to 173.9%), respectively. There was no interference from icterus, hemolysis, or lipemia. There was a positive correlation between the VC-cTnI and AC-cTnI-HS assays (Spearman ρ, 0.742), though 16 of 121 samples (13.2%) were below the VC-cTnI detectable limit. The VC-cTnI assay lacked precision for measurement of concentrations below 0.2 ng/mL, but within-day variability was acceptable for higher concentrations. The VC-cTnI assay is more precise when measuring higher cTnI concentrations and can detect myocardial injury in dogs. Results in the normal and equivocal range of the manufacturer's reference interval may be more challenging to interpret because of suboptimal precision in this range.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 휴대용 트로포닌 I 검사(VC-cTnI)는 개의 임상적으로 중요한 심근손상 진단에 충분한 성능을 보이지만, 0.2 ng/mL 이하의 저농도 범위에서 정밀도가 감소한다.
[방법·수치] 개 혈청 121개 샘플로 휴대용 검사(VC-cTnI)와 고감도 화학발광면역검사(AC-cTnI-HS)를 비교 검증했다. 일중 변이계수는 8.1~43.8%(농도 증가에 따라 감소), 희석 평행성 80.5±33.2%, 스파이킹 회수 112.8±35.6%, 두 검사 간 상관계수(Spearman ρ) 0.742, 13.2%(16/121)는 검출 한계 이하였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 휴대용 검사는 중등도 이상의 트로포닌 농도 측정에 적합하며 심근손상 진단에 유용하나, 정상 및 애매한 범위(0.2 ng/mL 이하)의 결과는 해석이 어려울 수 있다. 단일 시점 혈청 샘플 검증이므로 임상적 추적 추적이나 연속 측정 성능에 대한 추가 평가가 필요하다.

papers.title: The prevalence of MDR1/ABCB1 c.1930_1931delTC variant is rare in US domestic cats.
papers.authors: Joshi A, Fankhauser B, Hansen SA, Livingston RS, Young P
papers.abstract: To determine the prevalence of the 2-bp deletion genetic variant (ABCB1 c.1930_1931delTC) in the feline multidrug resistance ABCB1 (previously MDR1) gene, which has been associated with sensitivity to P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrate drugs in cats with homozygous mutations, utilizing a large population screen of genomic DNA samples from purebred and mixed-breed domestic cats in the US. This cross-sectional epidemiological study utilized conveniently available, unbiased, residual whole blood samples that were obtained from 12,000 US domestic cats and submitted to Idexx Laboratories between March and October 2025. Variant detection was performed with a validated dual-probe real-time PCR assay to detect 3 potential genotypes: wild type, homozygous mutant for variant allele, or heterozygous. A majority of the cats tested were wild type (> 98%), while 1.5% (181 cats) had the heterozygous genotype. Only 0.025% (3 cats) were homozygous for the ABCB1 c.1930_1931delTC variant. The variant allele frequency was 0.8%. This survey of domestic pet cats in the US demonstrated that the prevalence of the homozygous ABCB1 c.1930_1931delTC variant is rare. The low prevalence of homozygous mutations in cats in this large-scale survey provides veterinarians confidence in prescribing products that are P-gp substrates, such as cyclosporine, loperamide, emodepside, and macrocyclic lactones (ivermectin, eprinomectin, selamectin, milbemycin oxime, and moxidectin). If concerns arise for individual cats, veterinarians can consider ABCB1 genotyping prior to administering P-gp substrates. While these results provide information on the prevalence of ABCB1 c.1930_1931delTC, future research on other known polymorphisms will help us fully understand ABCB1/MDR1 mutations in cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 미국 국내 고양이에서 ABCB1 c.1930_1931delTC 2염기 결실 변이의 동형접합 유전자형은 매우 드물어(0.025%), P-글리코프로틴 기질 약물 처방 시 임상적 우려가 낮다.
[방법·수치] 2025년 3월~10월 미국 12,000마리의 순종 및 잡종 고양이의 혈액 샘플을 대상으로 한 단면 역학 조사; 이중 프로브 실시간 PCR로 유전자형 검출; 야생형 98% 이상, 이형접합 1.5%(181마리), 동형접합 0.025%(3마리), 변이 대립유전자 빈도 0.8%.
[임상 적용·한계] 사이클로스포린, 로페라마이드, 에모데펩시드, 거대환내분자(이버멕틴, 에프리노멕틴, 셀라멕틴, 밀베마이신 옥심, 목시덱틴) 등 P-글리코프로틴 기질 약물 처방 시 일반적으로 안전하며, 개별 고양이의 우려 시 ABCB1 유전자형 검사를 고려할 수 있음; 다른 다형성에 대한 추가 연구 필요.

papers.title: Shelter dogs harbor diverse tick species and demonstrate high exposure to tick-borne pathogens in a zone of tick range expansion.
papers.authors: Shockling Dent CE, Henning J, Bai N, Koser T, Wilson S
papers.abstract: To characterize ticks and tick-borne pathogens (TBPs) among Ohio shelter dogs and identify factors associated with canine exposure. This cross-sectional study included dogs admitted to an Ohio shelter partner between January 2020 and January 2021. Paired tick and blood samples were collected at intake. Ticks were identified and tested for TBPs by PCR; dogs underwent serologic testing and PCR. Logistic regression assessed associations between demographic and clinical variables and seropositivity. A total of 273 dogs were enrolled. Four tick species, including Haemaphysalis longicornis, were found on 22% of dogs. Overall, 43.9% were seropositive for ≥ 1 TBP and 24% for multiple TBPs. Seroprevalence was highest for Borrelia burgdorferi (33.5%) followed by Ehrlichia spp (24.4%) and Rickettsia spp (19.8%). Few dogs were PCR positive, and clinical signs were uncommon (3.7%). Tick PCR detected several relevant pathogens. Tick presence and host factors were associated with increased odds of seropositivity. Ohio shelter dogs demonstrate high exposure to diverse TBPs despite few PCR-positive results and infrequent clinical signs. Paired testing of dogs and attached ticks provides integrated information relevant to veterinary and public health surveillance in a region experiencing increasing tick abundance and pathogen prevalence. Tick presence at intake may help prioritize testing when universal screening is infeasible. Rickettsia seropositivity should be interpreted cautiously because serologic cross-reactivity complicates clinical interpretation and species-level attribution.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 오하이오주 보호소 개들에서 43.9%가 1개 이상의 진드기 매개 병원체(TBP)에 혈청양성이었으며, 가장 높은 감염률은 Borrelia burgdorferi(33.5%), Ehrlichia spp(24.4%), Rickettsia spp(19.8%) 순서였다. 임상 증상은 3.7%에서만 나타났으나 진드기 PCR 검사에서 여러 관련 병원체가 검출되었다.
[방법·수치] 2020년 1월~2021년 1월 오하이오 보호소에 입소한 개 273마리를 대상으로 한 횡단면 연구. 입소 시 진드기와 혈액 샘플을 채취하여 진드기는 PCR로 병원체 검사, 개는 혈청검사와 PCR 수행. 진드기 발견률 22%, 다중 TBP 혈청양성률 24%, PCR 양성 개는 소수에 불과.
[임상 적용·한계] 진드기 존재 여부가 TBP 혈청양성의 증가된 위험과 연관되어 있으므로 전체 선별이 불가능한 상황에서 진드기 보유 개를 우선 검사 대상으로 삼을 수 있다. 그러나 Rickettsia 혈청양성은 혈청 교차반응성으로 인해 신중하게 해석해야 하며, 단일 보호소 대상의 연구로서 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Silicon surface multiplex immunoassay (Accuplex) for antibodies against Anaplasma spp and Ehrlichia spp is a robust option for tick-borne pathogen screening in dogs.
papers.authors: Evason MD, Bilbrough G, Willcox JL, Freeman G, McBride JW
papers.abstract: To evaluate the diagnostic performance of a point-of-care (POC) test (SNAP 4Dx Plus; Idexx Laboratories Inc) versus a proprietary silicon surface multiplex immunoassay (SSMIA) test (Accuplex; Antech Diagnostics Inc) with indirect fluorescent antibody as the reference method (REFERENCE) for detecting antibodies against Anaplasma spp and Ehrlichia spp in dogs and to compare SSMIA test results with period prevalences reported by the Companion Animal Parasite Council (CAPC). Anonymized retention-released serum samples from dogs in the US submitted to a commercial laboratory between July 1, 2023, and September 30, 2024, were classified as true positive or true negative for each antibody via REFERENCE. Performance metrics (sensitivity, specificity, and Cohen κ) were calculated (REFERENCE as the standard) for SSMIA versus POC. Additional separate serum samples from dogs in Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania underwent SSMIA testing alone in July 2024, and results were compared with respective period prevalence data reported by the CAPC. Test methods did not differ significantly for detection of antibodies against Anaplasma spp (n = 310 samples). Silicon surface multiplex immunoassay was significantly more sensitive than POC for Ehrlichia spp antibody detection (n = 309 samples). Another 2,031 samples underwent SSMIA testing alone, and positivity rates were generally higher for SSMIA detection as compared to CAPC reporting. These findings support SSMIA as a robust option for routine tick-borne pathogen exposure screening in dogs. Our work provides veterinarians with field and comparative performance data on 2 commercially available tests, informing evidence-based contextualized diagnostic options.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 실리콘 표면 멀티플렉스 면역분석(SSMIA, Accuplex)은 개의 Anaplasma spp 및 Ehrlichia spp 항체 검출에서 현장용 신속검사(POC, SNAP 4Dx Plus)와 동등하거나 우수한 성능을 보이며, 진드기 매개 병원체 선별 검사의 견고한 선택지임을 확인했다.
[방법·수치] 2023년 7월~2024년 9월 미국 상업 검사실에 제출된 개의 혈청 샘플을 간접형광항체법(REFERENCE)으로 검증하여 비교 평가했다. Anaplasma spp 항체 검출에서는 두 검사법 간 유의한 차이 없음(n=310), Ehrlichia spp 항체 검출에서는 SSMIA가 POC보다 유의하게 높은 민감도를 나타냄(n=309). 별도로 5개 주(코네티컷, 매사추세츠, 뉴저지, 뉴욕, 펜실베이니아)에서 2,031개 샘플을 SSMIA로 검사했을 때 양성률이 CAPC 보고 데이터보다 일반적으로 높음.
[임상 적용·한계] SSMIA는 개의 일상적인 진드기 매개 병원체 노출 선별에 근거기반 선택지를 제공하나, 연구는 상업 검사실 샘플을 활용한 단일기관 검증이며 지역별 유병률 차이와 검사법 간 양성률 불일치에 대한 추가 해석이 필요하다.

papers.title: Osteogenic priming of canine perivascular mesenchymal stromal cells enhances extracellular vesicle yield and in vitro activity for bone regeneration.
papers.authors: Hertel FC, da Silva AS, Spachi NB, Martins LMA, Rocha CC
papers.abstract: The therapeutic efficacy of mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) is intrinsically linked to their response to the host microenvironment by the interplay with resident cells. While MSC-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) offer a promising cell-free alternative, optimizing their production and cargo for specific clinical applications remains a challenge. We investigated the impact of in vitro osteogenic priming on the yield, molecular profile, and functional activity of EVs derived from canine umbilical cord perivascular MSCs (cPMSCs). The EVs secreted by osteogenic primed and naïve cPMSC were isolated by ultracentrifugation and characterized by nanoparticle tracking analysis, western blotting, and electronic transmission microscopy. In vitro functional assays of cellular uptake, proliferation, migration, and mineralization were performed. MicroRNAs known to participate in osteogenesis (cfa-miR-21, cfa-miR26a, cfa-miR-27a and cfa-miR-29a) were evaluated in EV samples of both groups through RT-qPCR. Notably, osteogenic priming led to a 1.5-fold increase in vesicle yield (5.6 ± 0.5 ×1010 particles/mL) compared to naïve MSCs (3.7 ± 0.7 ×1010 particles/mL), without altering vesicle distribution nor TSG101 expression (similar expression for both groups). Functional assays revealed that while both EV populations were efficiently internalized, osteogenic priming significantly improved extracellular matrix mineralization (P = 0.0003) and enhanced EV-mediated cell migration (P = 0.005). Molecular analysis confirmed the enrichment of key osteogenic microRNAs, including cfa-miR-21, cfa-miR-26a, cfa-miR-27a, and cfa-miR-29a, in both groups. These findings demonstrate that osteogenic priming is a robust strategy to improve EV production efficiency and migratory potential, providing a molecularly characterized foundation for advanced cell-free orthopedic therapies in veterinary medicine.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 개의 제대 주변 중간엽 기질 세포(cPMSCs)를 골생성 조건으로 준비하면 세포외 소낭(EVs) 수율이 1.5배 증가하고, 골기질 광물화와 세포 이동 능력이 유의하게 향상되어 골재생 치료에 최적화된 세포 무함유 치료제를 제공할 수 있다. [방법·수치] 개 제대 주변 중간엽 기질세포를 골생성 유도 조건과 대조군으로 배양하고 초원심분리로 EVs를 분리하여 나노입자 추적 분석, 웨스턴 블롯, 전자현미경으로 특성화했다; 골생성 준비 그룹의 EV 수율은 5.6±0.5×10¹⁰ particles/mL로 대조군 3.7±0.7×10¹⁰ particles/mL 대비 1.5배 증가, 골기질 광물화 개선(P=0.0003), EV 매개 세포 이동 증가(P=0.005)를 보였으며, 골생성 관련 마이크로RNA(cfa-miR-21, -26a, -27a, -29a)가 두 그룹 모두에서 풍부했다. [임상 적용·한계] 골생성 준비는 정형외과 질환 치료를 위한 수의학 세포 무함유 치료제의 EV 생산 효율성을 개선하는 견고한 전략으로, 개의 골재생 임상 응용에 활용할 수 있으나 동물 모델에서의 효능 검증이 추가로 필요하고 임상 적용 전 더 큰 규모의 연구가 요구된다.

papers.title: Comparison of peribulbar anesthesia with neosaxitoxin or bupivacaine in dogs undergoing reconstructive keratoplasty.
papers.authors: Ribeiro MR, Ariga BK, Gomes DR, Alves DS, Andrade SF
papers.abstract: This study compared the analgesic efficacy of peribulbar anesthesia using neosaxitoxin versus bupivacaine in dogs undergoing reconstructive keratoplasty. Of 28 dogs, four were excluded for not meeting the inclusion criteria. The anesthetic protocol included dexmedetomidine and methadone, propofol and isoflurane. Immediately after intubation, 24 dogs were randomly assigned (12 per group) to receive peribulbar block with either neosaxitoxin (3.5 µg; NeoSTX group) or 0.5% bupivacaine (0.2 mL/kg, Bupi group). Intraoperatively, cardiopulmonary variables and end-tidal isoflurane concentration (FE'ISO) were recorded at predefined time points. Pain, corneal esthesiometry, blepharospasm, and sedation were assessed preoperatively and up to 24 h post-extubation. Methadone was administered as rescue analgesia. The duration of analgesia, defined as the interval between block administration and the first rescue analgesia, was also recorded. Cardiopulmonary parameters, blepharospasm, duration of analgesia and sedation scores did not differ between treatments. The area under the curve (AUC) of Fe´ISO and esthesiometry were lower in the NeoSTX group compared to the Bupi group (P = 0.004; P = 0.009, respectively). Pain was lower in the Bupi group at 12 h post-extubation compared with the NeoSTX group (P = 0.012). Methadone was required in 4/12 dogs in each group, administered at 4-6 h post-extubation in the Bupi group and at 12-18 h in the NeoSTX group. In conclusion, at the dose and concentrations used in this study, peribulbar NeoSTX was associated with lower isoflurane and corneal esthesiometry AUCs, but did not provide additional postoperative analgesic benefit compared with bupivacaine.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 각막 재건성 수술에서 neosaxitoxin 주변안와차단(peribulbar block)은 부피바카인 대비 술중 이소플루란 필요량과 각막 감각이 더 낮았으나, 술후 진통 효과는 차이가 없었다.
[방법·수치] 개 24마리를 neosaxitoxin(3.5μg) 또는 0.5% 부피바카인(0.2mL/kg) 주변안와차단으로 무작위배정(각 12마리). 술중 등척성 이소플루란 농도(FE'ISO) 곡선하면적(AUC)이 neosaxitoxin군에서 낮았고(P=0.004), 각막 에스테시오메트리 AUC도 더 낮았다(P=0.009). 술후 12시간에 부피바카인군에서 통증이 더 낮았다(P=0.012). 각 군 4/12마리에서 rescue methadone 필요(부피바카인군: 4-6시간, neosaxitoxin군: 12-18시간).
[임상 적용·한계] 술중 이소플루란 용량 감소 가능성이 있으나, 술후 진통 개선은 제한적이므로 neosaxitoxin의 임상적 우월성이 입증되지 않았다. 소규모 단일기관 연구이며, 실제 임상 적용 전 대규모 추가 연구 필요.

papers.title: Evaluation of nanofibrillated cellulose as a urethral bulking agent in female dogs with acquired urethral sphincter mechanism incompetence: a prospective clinical study.
papers.authors: Peltokallio NMM, Bolen G, Gordin E, Lepajõe J, Hamaide A
papers.abstract: Urethral bulking agent (UBA) implantation is a minimally invasive, effective and safe alternative treatment for refractory urethral sphincter mechanism incompetence (USMI). However, repeated implantations are frequently needed to maintain continence. Therefore, a prospective interventional clinical study with eight client-owned neutered female dogs was designed to evaluate the clinical efficacy and 12-month outcome of nanofibrillated cellulose (NFC), a novel biomaterial as a UBA. Concurrent causes of urinary incontinence were excluded with clinical and neurological assessment, blood and urine sampling, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), retrograde vaginourethrography, cystoscopy, and urodynamic testing. A continence score (CS) was assigned before and after treatment, and monthly thereafter. Furthermore, the dogs were followed with MRI, retrograde vaginouretrography, and urethroscopy at 1 and 12 months or at the time of euthanasia or recurrence. All dogs were continent (CS ≥ 8/10) at 1 month with a significant increase in mean CS (p < 0.0001, difference 5.4, 95% CI 4.1-6.6). Median duration of continence was 8 months (IQR 4 - not estimable). At 12 months, the treatment response was still significant (p = 0.0010) with (n = 4/7) or without (n = 3/7) medical intervention. The imaging and urethroscopy findings suggest that flattening of the deposits with or without mucosal ulceration may contribute to recurrence. Sporadic bacterial cystitis was diagnosed in two dogs and recurrent cystitis in one. In conclusion, NFC showed promising short-term effect and a low complication rate when used as a UBA. Urinary incontinence resolved after single NFC implantation in all dogs for a median of 8 months without adjunctive treatment.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 나노피브릴화 셀룰로오스(NFC)는 요도괄약근부전증 치료용 요도팽창제로서 단일 주입으로 모든 개에서 단기 대륙성을 획득했으며, 중앙값 8개월간 지속되었고 합병증이 적었다.
[방법·수치] 중성화된 암컷개 8마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 임상 중재 연구이며, MRI, 역행성 질요도조영술, 방광내시경, 요역동학검사로 다른 원인을 배제하고 치료 전후 대륙성점수(CS)를 평가했다. 1개월 후 모든 개가 대륙성 달성(CS≥8/10)하였고 평균 CS는 유의하게 증가했다(p<0.0001, 차이 5.4, 95% CI 4.1-6.6). 대륙성 중앙 지속 기간은 8개월(IQR 4-미추정)이었고, 12개월 후에도 치료반응이 유의했다(p=0.0010, 약물치료 동반 4마리/없음 3마리).
[임상 적용·한계] NFC 단일 주입으로 추가치료 없이 중앙값 8개월의 대륙성 회복을 기대할 수 있으나, 소규모(n=8) 단일기관 연구이고 장기 효과 확인이 필요하며, 침착물의 편평화와 점막궤양이 재발에 기여할 수 있음을 고려해야 한다.

papers.title: A novel 3D-printed patient-specific limb-sparing radial endoprosthesis for treatment of primary osteosarcoma in a Great Dane.
papers.authors: Tavola F, Kaczmarek J, Oxley B, Troedson K
papers.abstract: To describe a novel titanium three-dimensional-printed patient-specific radial endoprosthesis (3D-PSE) for the successful treatment of a primary osteosarcoma in a 7-year-old female Great Dane. Case report. The dog presented with a 10-day history of swelling of the right distal radius. Computed tomography (CT) revealed an osteolytic lesion involving the distal metaphysis and diaphysis of the radius which was highly suspicious for an osteosarcoma (OSA). Thoracic CT showed no metastases. CT data was used to create a virtual 3D-model of the affected limb within computer-aided design software which was used for virtual osteotomy planning and the design of the 3D-PSE. During surgery 3D-printed patient-specific guides were used to execute osteotomies. The 3D-PSE comprised plate sections for attachment to the proximal radius and metacarpals 3, 4 and 5, and an integrated cage for bone graft to replace the radial defect. Histopathology demonstrated OSA, and postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy comprised five IV infusions of carboplatin every 3 weeks. The Liverpool Osteoarthritis in Dogs (LOAD) questionnaires were completed by the owner preoperatively and for each follow-up until the 6-month re-evaluation. No complications occurred intra-/post- or perioperatively. LOAD scores preoperatively, and at 6, 12 and 24 weeks postoperatively were 19, 13, 11 and 10. Ten months after surgery thoracic radiographs revealed multiple pulmonary metastases, but the dog remained asymptomatic for a further 6 weeks when progressive dyspnea and lethargy prompted euthanasia. Lameness was absent at that time. The described novel 3D-PSE provided an effective function-preserving solution as part of a multimodal treatment of a giant breed dog with OSA of the distal radius.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 3D 프린팅 환자맞춤형 요골 내인공 관절(3D-PSE)은 대형견의 원발성 요골 골육종에서 사지보존 수술의 효과적인 함수보존 치료법을 제공했다.
[방법·수치] 7세 그레이트 데인의 우측 원위 요골 종괴에 대해 CT 기반 3D 가상 모델링을 이용한 환자맞춤형 티타늄 임플란트 설계 및 3D 프린팅 가이드를 활용한 수술적 절제를 시행했다. 수술 후 카보플라틴 보조화학요법(3주 간격 5회 IV) 실시, LOAD 평가점수는 수술 전 19점에서 24주 후 10점으로 개선, 24주까지 절뚝거림 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 대형견의 사지보존 골육종 치료에서 고기능 임플란트 설계가 가능하며 수술 후 보행 기능 개선을 기대할 수 있다. 단일 증례 보고로서 장기 추적 데이터 부재, 폐 전이로 인한 최종 예후에 대한 판단 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Low complication rates are reported in cats presenting for neurological complaints and undergoing cerebrospinal fluid collection.
papers.authors: Spinoglio GJ, Korman R, Thompson AL
papers.abstract: To assess complications, outcomes, and associated risk factors of cats undergoing CSF collection. This was a single-center retrospective cohort study of client-owned cats presenting to 3 referral hospitals for CSF collection from January 2012 through December 2022. Cats were excluded for nonspecific and/or extraneural presenting complaints. If cats had multiple CSF collection presentations, only the first was included. Records were retrospectively assessed for signalment, physical examination findings, modified Glasgow coma scale, general anesthesia (GA) records, diagnostic imaging, clinical pathology results, and suspected or confirmed final diagnosis. Outcomes included complications and nonsurvival > 24 hours following CSF collection. Univariable logistic regression included breed, sex, body weight, age, modified Glasgow coma scale, evidence of herniation, evidence of intracranial hypertension (ICH) without herniation, GA protocol, GA duration, CSF analysis, collection site, inflammatory/infectious, and neoplasia diagnosis. P values were adjusted for multiple comparisons using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. 120 cats were identified, with 2 excluded for nonspecific and/or extraneural presenting complaint, leaving 118 cats. Seven (5.9%) did not survive > 24 hours following CSF procedure, and 9 (7.6%) reported complications, including apnea, suspected iatrogenic spinal cord trauma, and Cushing reflex. After multiple-comparison correction, no variable was significantly associated with outcome. Evidence of ICH without herniation and nonsurvival reported the largest effect estimate (OR, 36.99). Estimates are imprecise and reported as hypothesis generating. Feline CSF collection in this cohort reported low complication rates, and the majority survived > 24 hours after CSF collection. Imaging review for abnormalities associated with ICH is recommended prior to CSF collection.
papers.summary_ko:
