[핵심 결론] 고양이의 뇌척수액(CSF) 채취술은 합병증 발생률이 낮으며(7.6%), 대부분의 환자가 술 후 24시간 이상 생존했다. 뇌척수액 채취 후 24시간 이상 생존하지 못한 경우는 5.9%였다.
[방법·수치] 단일 센터 후향적 코호트 연구로 2012년 1월부터 2022년 12월까지 신경학적 증상으로 CSF 채취를 받은 고양이 118마리를 분석했다. 합병증으로는 무호흡, 의인성 척수손상, Cushing 반사 등이 보고되었으며, 뇌척수압 상승 증거가 있는 환자에서 가장 높은 효과 크기(OR 36.99)를 보였으나 통계적 유의성은 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] CSF 채취 전에 뇌척수압 상승과 관련된 이상 소견을 확인하기 위해 영상검사를 권장한다. 본 연구는 단일 센터의 후향적 분석이며, 다중비교 보정 후 통계적으로 유의한 위험인자를 도출하지 못했으므로 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Two headless cannulated screws have a higher maximum failure load than screw-and-pin fixation at a 70° fracture angle in 3-dimensionally printed canine femoral neck models.
papers.authors: Song I, Kim S, Kim HY, Kim JM
papers.abstract: To compare maximum failure load among 3-D-printed canine femoral neck models differing in fracture angle and fixation configuration. This experimental biomechanical study was conducted in a university research laboratory from September 10, 2025, through March 10, 2026. Polycarbonate 3-D-printed models were created using left femoral CT data from a 2-year-old 11.9-kg Shiba Inu. The group configurations were a 50° femoral neck fracture stabilized with one 2.5-mm fully threaded headless cannulated screw (HCS) and an antirotation pin (1S1P50), a 70° fracture with the same fixation (1S1P70), and a 70° fracture stabilized with 2 parallel 2.5-mm HCSs (2S70). Initial construct stiffness was estimated from load-crosshead displacement curves. Maximum failure load, the primary outcome, was determined under single axial compression of the femoral head. 18 models were analyzed, with 6 in each group. There was no difference in initial construct stiffness among groups. Mean maximum failure loads were 511.5 N (SD, 81.9) in 1S1P50, 502.0 N (SD, 47.2) in 1S1P70, and 679.2 N (SD, 102.5) in 2S70. Maximum failure load was higher in 2S70 than in 1S1P70 (estimated difference, 176 N; Bonferroni-adjusted 98.3% CI, 31 to 301 N). Under static axial loading, 2S70 had a higher maximum failure load than 1S1P70, with no difference between 1S1P50 and either of the other 2 groups. Under static axial loading, 2 HCSs had a higher maximum failure load than did 1 HCS with an antirotation pin at a 70° fracture angle in 3-D-printed canine femoral neck models.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 70° 대퇴골경부 골절에서 2개의 무두 나선못(HCS) 고정이 1개의 나선못+회전방지핀 고정보다 최대 파괴 하중이 높다.
[방법·수치] 3D 프린팅된 개 대퇴골경부 모델에서 골절각 50°와 70°, 고정 방법(1S1P50, 1S1P70, 2S70)별로 생체역학 실험 수행(각 군 6개 모델, 총 18개). 최대 파괴 하중: 1S1P50 511.5 N, 1S1P70 502.0 N, 2S70 679.2 N. 2S70이 1S1P70보다 176 N 높음(98.3% CI, 31~301 N).
[임상 적용·한계] 70° 이상의 가파른 대퇴골경부 골절에서는 2개의 무두 나선못 고정이 더 강한 초기 고정을 제공할 수 있다. 그러나 정적 축성 압박만 평가하였으며, 단일 개체 기반 모델 연구이므로 임상 적용 전 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Clinical features, management, short- and long-term outcomes for cats and dogs diagnosed with pyothorax: 103 cases (2015-2021).
papers.authors: Bartlett AJ, Dordio AM, Jerabkova P, Sparks T, Herrtage M
papers.abstract: To describe canine and feline pyothorax cases, comparing bacteriology, aetiologies and short- and long-term outcomes of medical versus surgical treatment. Clinical records of canine and feline pyothorax cases from two UK referral centres (2015 to 2021) were retrospectively reviewed. Follow-up was obtained from referring practices' records. Sixty-five dogs and 38 cats were included. Medical management was used in 62% of dogs (40/65) and 76% of cats (29/38); survival to discharge was 88% (35/40) and 90% (26/29), respectively. Surgery was performed in the remainder; survival to discharge was 80% (20/25) in dogs and 78% (7/9) in cats. Among cases with follow-up, recurrence was 8% (4/51) in dogs: 5% (1/19) surgically and 9% (3/32) medically managed; and 8% (2/24) in cats: 12% (2/17) medically managed. All dogs medically managed with thoracostomy tubes receiving pleural lavage survived: 100% (16/16) versus 73% (8/11) without. Pasteurella multocida was the predominant feline isolate, in contrast to dogs that had no single dominant species. Multidrug-resistant organisms were identified in 29% (7/24) and 21% (5/24) of culture-positive canine and feline patients. Aetiologies were mostly unknown (dogs: 51%, 33/65; cats: 61%, 23/38), followed by parapneumonic spread (dogs: 17%, 11/65; cats: 16%, 6/38) and migrating foreign bodies (dogs: 17%, 11/65; cats: 8%, 3/38). In selected cases, medical management of canine and feline pyothorax with thoracic drains yields survival to discharge and recurrence rates comparable to surgery, including cases with suspected migrating plant material. Pleural lavage during medical management is associated with improved survival in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 농흉증에서 흉강드레인을 이용한 내과적 관리는 외과적 치료와 비교하여 유사한 생존율(개 88%, 고양이 90%)과 재발률(개 8%, 고양이 8%)을 보였으며, 흉강세척을 병행한 개의 경우 생존율이 100%로 향상되었다.
[방법·수치] 영국 2개 referral center의 후향적 연구(2015-2021)로 개 65마리, 고양이 38마리 대상; 개에서 내과 치료 62%, 외과 치료 38% 시행; 고양이에서 Pasteurella multocida가 주요 분리균이었고 개는 단일 우세종 없음; 다제내성균 개 29%, 고양이 21%에서 확인; 원인 미상 개 51%, 고양이 61%.
[임상 적용·한계] 선택된 경우 흉강드레인을 이용한 내과적 관리로 외과 수술 없이 감염된 식물 이물까지 치료 가능하며, 흉강세척 병행 시 치료 성공률 향상이 기대된다. 다만 원인이 대부분 미상이고 단일 기관 또는 소규모 집단 연구로서 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Thoracolumbar versus lumbosacral epidural anaesthesia in dogs: a single-centre retrospective study.
papers.authors: Molins AG, Sambugaro B, Corletto F
papers.abstract: To compare both vasopressor and intraoperative rescue fentanyl administration after thoracolumbar (TL) and lumbosacral (LS) epidural (extradural) anaesthesia in dogs undergoing cranial abdominal surgery. Retrospective cohort, single-centre, observational study. Eighty-nine client-owned dogs undergoing cranial abdominal surgery. Medical records of dogs undergoing TL or LS epidural anaesthesia for cranial abdominal surgery between 2014 and 2021 were retrieved. Selected demographic variables, mean arterial blood pressure, anaesthetic and epidural drugs and their dosage, volume and injection site, vasopressor and intraoperative rescue fentanyl administration were compared between groups. Intraoperative haemodynamic stability was assessed using generalised average real variability (GenARV). Univariate analysis was used to compare groups. Forty-three dogs were enrolled in the TL group and 46 in the LS group. Vasopressors were required more frequently [p = 0.030; odds ratio 2.67 (1.09-6.53)] in the LS group, but GenARV was not different (p = 0.706; 1.51 ± 0.60 and 1.46 ± 0.68 mmHg minute-1 in the LS and TL groups, respectively]. The number of dogs requiring intraoperative rescue fentanyl did not differ between groups (p = 0.992); however, the median (range) amount of fentanyl per hour of surgery was lower in the TL group [1.31 (0.75-7) and 2.87 (0.75-14) μg kg-1 hour-1 in the TL and LS groups, respectively; p = 0.019]. The volume of epidural injectate was lower in group TL (p < 0.001). In dogs undergoing cranial abdominal surgery, TL epidural anaesthesia was associated with reduced vasopressor use compared to LS epidural anaesthesia, while providing comparable intraoperative analgesia with a reduced volume of injectate. Thoracolumbar epidural anaesthesia may result in a more targeted neuraxial blockade with fewer cardiovascular adverse effects, supporting its use for cranial abdominal surgeries.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 두부 복부 수술에서 흉요추 경막외 마취가 요추 경막외 마취에 비해 혈관수축제 사용 빈도를 줄이면서 비슷한 수술 중 진통을 제공하고 주입액 용량을 감소시킨다.
[방법·수치] 2014~2021년 두부 복부 수술을 받은 개 89마리 대상 후향적 단일기관 연구(흉요추군 43마리, 요추군 46마리). 혈관수축제 필요성 p=0.030, 오즈비 2.67(1.09-6.53), 시간당 펜타닐 용량 흉요추군 1.31 μg/kg/hr vs 요추군 2.87 μg/kg/hr(p=0.019), 혈역학적 안정성은 차이 없음(p=0.706).
[임상 적용·한계] 두부 복부 수술 시 흉요추 경막외 마취가 보다 표적화된 신경축 차단으로 심혈관 부작용을 줄일 수 있어 임상 선택으로 권장된다. 단일기관 후향적 연구이며 개의 체중, 마취약 용량 등 혼동변수 조정 여부 명확하지 않음.

papers.title: Biomechanical evaluation of cerclage fixation constructs in a 3-dimensionally printed canine tibial long-oblique fracture model.
papers.authors: Park J, Kim JM, Kim HY
papers.abstract: To compare the biomechanical performance of cerclage fixation constructs in a standardized 3-D-printed canine tibial long-oblique fracture model. 3 fixation constructs-stainless steel wire cerclage (SSW), FiberWire cerclage (FW), and paraosseous clamp-cerclage stabilization (PCCS)-were compared in a standardized 3-D-printed canine tibial long-oblique fracture model. A standardized mid-diaphyseal long-oblique fracture was created in each specimen. Axial compression testing was performed until failure. Loads required to reach predefined displacement levels (1, 2, and 3 mm), maximum failure load, and failure mode were recorded. Data were analyzed using one-way ANOVA with the Tukey post hoc test. 21 tibial models (7/group) were evaluated. At all displacement levels, the FW group required significantly lower loads than both the SSW and PCCS groups, whereas no significant difference was observed between the SSW and PCCS groups. Mean loads at 1 mm displacement were 194.5 ± 32.2 N (SSW), 94.4 ± 21.0 N (FW), and 207.3 ± 64.0 N (PCCS). Maximum failure load was highest in the FW group (974.3 ± 77.0 N), followed by the PCCS group (879.0 ± 66.6 N) and SSW group (567.6 ± 63.2 N). PCCS demonstrated resistance to axial compression comparable to SSW fixation, whereas FW cerclage demonstrated the highest maximum failure load. These findings provide biomechanical information that may assist surgeons in selecting cerclage fixation methods for long-oblique tibial fractures in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 경골 장사각 골절에서 FiberWire 서클리지가 최고의 최대 실패 하중(974.3±77.0 N)을 보였으며, 부골막 클램프-서클리지 안정화(PCCS)는 스테인리스강 와이어(SSW)와 비슷한 압축 저항성을 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 3D 프린팅된 개의 경골 장사각 골절 모델에서 SSW, FiberWire(FW), PCCS 3가지 서클리지 고정 방법을 비교한 생체역학 연구로, 7개 모델씩 총 21개 표본을 축압축 시험으로 평가했다. 1mm 변위 시 필요한 하중은 SSW 194.5±32.2 N, FW 94.4±21.0 N, PCCS 207.3±64.0 N이었고, 최대 실패 하중은 FW(974.3±77.0 N) > PCCS(879.0±66.6 N) > SSW(567.6±63.2 N) 순이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 경골 장사각 골절의 서클리지 고정 방법 선택 시 생체역학적 근거를 제공하나, 3D 프린팅 모델을 사용한 체외 연구로 생체 내 환경에서의 임상 성능 차이가 있을 수 있으며, 실제 임상 결과와의 비교 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Multicenter, retrospective study of balloon valvuloplasty-associated pulmonary artery dissection in dogs with pulmonary valve stenosis.
papers.authors: Wesselowski S, Saunders AB, Scansen BA, Potter BM, Abbott-Johnson K
papers.abstract: Pulmonary artery dissection (PAD) is a rare complication in dogs with pulmonary valve stenosis (PS) that undergo balloon valvuloplasty (BVP). This study aimed to describe demographic, interventional, and survival data in a cohort of dogs with PS that experienced PAD during BVP. Fifty-three dogs were included in this retrospective, multicenter study, with medical records and available stored images reviewed. Dogs that developed PAD during BVP had a median body weight of 12.5 kg (range: 1.1-50.7 kg), median age of 0.8 years (range: 0.2-8.1 years), and 30/53 (56.6%) were male. Pit Bull terriers, Pit Bull terrier mixes, and 'Bully breeds' represented 23 of 53 dogs in the study (43.4%). The median angiographic balloon diameter to pulmonary valve annulus ratio of the largest balloon utilized during BVP was 1.4 (range: 1.0-1.58). High-pressure balloons (>6 atm) were utilized in 27 dogs (50.9%). Post-BVP transthoracic echocardiographic imaging clearly demonstrated the PAD in 62.2% of dogs, while 90.3% and 84.0% of available post-BVP angiography and transesophageal echocardiographic studies did, respectively. Forty-eight dogs (90.6%) survived to discharge. Median time from BVP to last follow-up or death (if applicable) was 2.0 years (range: 0.2-10.5 years), with all 27 dogs for whom ≥1 year of follow-up data were available confirmed alive at that time. Retrospective study design. Dogs experiencing PAD during BVP have a high likelihood of survival in the immediate and long-term periods. Immediate post-BVP imaging with angiography or transesophageal echocardiography appears more sensitive than transthoracic echocardiography for diagnosis of PAD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 풍선판막성형술 중 발생한 폐동맥 박리는 드문 합병증이지만, 즉시 및 장기 생존율이 높으며(90.6% 생존 퇴원), 1년 이상 추적 관찰된 모든 개(27마리)가 생존했다.
[방법·수치] 폐동맥판막협착증으로 풍선판막성형술을 받은 53마리 개를 대상으로 한 다기관 후향적 연구. 중앙값 체중 12.5kg, 중앙값 나이 0.8년, 수컷 56.6%(30/53). 가장 큰 풍선의 중앙값 직경-판막고리 비율은 1.4, 고기압 풍선(>6atm) 사용 50.9%(27/53). 중앙값 추적 기간 2.0년(범위: 0.2-10.5년).
[임상 적용·한계] 경식도 심초음파 90.3%와 혈관조영술 84.0%의 진단 민감도로 흉부 초음파(62.2%)보다 폐동맥 박리 진단에 우수하다. 후향적 단일 연구로 인과관계 추론의 한계가 있으며, 판막성형술 중 고기압 풍선 사용이나 과도한 확장이 박리 위험을 증가시키는 기전은 명확하지 않다.

papers.title: Sotalol and flecainide dual therapy in a dog with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
papers.authors: Mishra SU, Seo J
papers.abstract: A four-year-old Doberman pinscher was diagnosed with atrial fibrillation (AF) and equivocal dilated cardiomyopathy phenotype. Electrical cardioversion (ECV) was performed following two weeks of amiodarone treatment; however, the dog developed recurrent AF within one week post ECV. Following two additional months of amiodarone therapy, the dog represented with sinus rhythm and new hepatopathy. In-hospital electrocardiographic monitoring identified paroxysmal AF during sleep. Amiodarone therapy was transitioned to sotalol therapy, which prevented further paroxysmal AF episodes. However, episodes of atypical AFL were frequently observed during sleep at follow-ups over five months. Flecainide was added to the sotalol therapy, and no further occurrence of AF or AFL was observed at follow-ups over 10 months. This report highlights that dogs may present with paroxysmal AF post ECV. When the paroxysmal AF is likely vagally mediated, sotalol and flecainide dual therapy may be effective in preventing further occurrence of AF and AFL.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 전기적 심율동 복구 후 발생한 발작성 심방세동을 가진 개에서 솔탈올과 플레카이나이드 병용 치료가 10개월 이상 심방세동 및 심방조동 재발을 예방했으며, 미주신경 매개 발작성 심방세동에서 효과적일 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 4세 도베르만 핀셔 1마리에서 심방세동 및 확장성 심근병증 진단 후 아미오다론 2주 치료 후 전기적 심율동 복구 시행, 복구 후 1주일 내 심방세동 재발, 2개월 추가 아미오다론 투여 후 솔탈올로 전환, 최종적으로 플레카이나이드 추가 투여, 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 전기적 심율동 복구 후 발작성 심방세동이 발생할 수 있으며, 미주신경 매개 발작성 심방세동 의심 시 솔탈올과 플레카이나이드 병용 치료를 고려할 수 있다. 단일 증례 보고이므로 더 많은 개체군에서의 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Third-degree atrioventricular block secondary to intracardiac paraganglioma in a dog.
papers.authors: Corda A, Pentcheva P, Corda F, Pinna Parpaglia ML, Perego M
papers.abstract: A 14-year-old, 6-kg dog was referred for lethargy, exercise intolerance, and syncope. Electrocardiography revealed complete atrioventricular (AV) block with a narrow QRS escape rhythm at 40 bpm. Echocardiography identified a solitary mass involving the interatrial septum with extension into the interventricular septum, associated with valvular regurgitation and chamber enlargement. Despite medical management of congestive heart failure, the dog died suddenly 10 days later. Necropsy revealed a large mass infiltrating the interatrial and AV septa, including Koch's triangle and the septal vestibule. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry supported the diagnosis of an intracardiac paraganglioma exhibiting locally invasive histological features. This case describes an intracardiac paraganglioma associated with an AV block and illustrates that intracardiac neoplasia is a rare differential diagnosis for AV conduction disturbances in older dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심장 내 부신경절종(paraganglioma)이 방실결절(AV node)을 직접 침범하여 3도 방실전도차단을 유발한 증례로, 고령견의 방실전도장애 감별진단에 심장 종양을 고려해야 함을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 14세, 6kg 개에서 심전도검사 시 완전 방실전도차단(QRS 폭이 좁은 탈출리듬 40 bpm) 확인, 심초음파에서 중격 침범 종괴 발견, 부검 및 면역조직화학검사로 부신경절종 확진. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 운동불내성과 실신을 동반한 고령견에서 완전 방실전도차단이 확인될 경우 심장 신생물을 감별진단에 포함해야 하며, 의약 치료에 반응하지 않는 울혈성심부전은 종양의 신호일 수 있다. 단일 증례 보고로 발생 빈도나 예후 관련 정보는 제한적이다.

papers.title: Usefulness of serum amyloid A to differentiate feline inflammatory lower respiratory tract diseases from cardiac or neoplastic disease: a retrospective study of 22 cats (2021-2024).
papers.authors: Berro E, Fastrès A, Lamoureux A
papers.abstract: To evaluate the usefulness of serum amyloid A concentration in differentiating inflammatory lower respiratory tract diseases from cardiac/neoplastic respiratory diseases in cats. A retrospective analysis of medical records of cats presented between 2021 and 2024 to a single referral centre was performed. Cats in respiratory distress with serum amyloid A assay performed within 48 hours after admission were included and divided into two groups (inflammatory and cardiac/neoplastic). The inflammatory group included infectious or non-infectious inflammatory lower respiratory tract diseases, and the cardiac/neoplastic group was subdivided into cardiac and neoplastic subgroups. Signalment, clinical signs and diagnostic testing results, including serum amyloid A concentration, were recorded and compared between groups (P < .05). Twenty-two cats were included. Median serum amyloid A concentration was significantly higher in the inflammatory group (57.5 μg/mL (12.2 to 70.3); n = 15) compared to the cardiac/neoplastic group (5 μg/mL (5); n = 7; P = .003). There was also a significant difference among the inflammatory, cardiac (5 μg/mL (5); n = 3) and N (5 μg/mL (5); n = 4) subgroups (P = .01); however, pairwise comparisons were not statistically significant. The optimal serum amyloid A concentration cut-off to differentiate between inflammatory and cardiac/neoplastic groups was 8.6 μg/mL (sensitivity of 80% (95% confidence interval: 59.5 to 91.6) and specificity of 100% (95% confidence interval: 84.6 to 100)). Cardiac and neoplastic diseases were associated with low serum amyloid A concentration. Serum amyloid A concentration could be a potential diagnostic tool but larger studies are needed to validate the proposed cut-off value. Further prospective studies are also needed to establish the usefulness of serum amyloid A concentration in distinguishing between infectious and non-infectious inflammatory diseases.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 호흡기 질환에서 혈청 아밀로이드 A(SAA)는 염증성 하부호흡기질환을 심장질환 또는 종양성질환과 구별하는 데 유용할 수 있으며, 염증성 질환에서 유의하게 높은 농도를 보인다.
[방법·수치] 2021년부터 2024년까지 단일 2차 병원에 내원한 호흡곤란 고양이 22마리의 의무기록을 후향적으로 분석했다(입원 48시간 이내 SAA 검사 시행). 염증성군 15마리의 중앙값 SAA는 57.5 μg/mL(범위 12.2-70.3)로, 심장/종양군 7마리의 5 μg/mL(범위 5)보다 유의하게 높았다(P=0.003). 최적 판정값 8.6 μg/mL에서 민감도 80%(95% CI: 59.5-91.6), 특이도 100%(95% CI: 84.6-100)를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 호흡곤란 고양이에서 SAA 측정이 염증성과 심장/종양성 질환 감별 진단의 보조 도구로 사용될 수 있으나, 소규모 단일기관 후향적 연구이고 감염성과 비감염성 염증질환의 구별에 대해서는 추가 전향적 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Long-term outcomes following modified Blalock-Taussig-Thomas shunt placement in 13 dogs with cyanotic congenital heart disease.
papers.authors: Rossanese M, Hannabuss J, Brockman D
papers.abstract: To describe long-term outcome and owner-perceived quality of life in dogs with cyanotic congenital cardiac disease undergoing modified Blalock-Taussig-Thomas shunt procedure. Medical records of dogs that underwent Blalock-Taussig-Thomas shunt between 2009 and 2025 at a small animal referral hospital were retrospectively reviewed. Complications, long-term outcomes and quality of life were assessed via clinical examination and/or contact with owners or referring veterinarians. Thirteen dogs were included. The predominant clinical signs were exercise intolerance, cyanosis and a heart murmur. Diagnosis included tetralogy of Fallot (n = 8), double outlet right ventricle (n = 3); tetralogy of Fallot-double outlet right ventricle spectrum (n = 1) and tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia spectrum (n = 1). All dogs survived surgery. Follow-up was available for 12 dogs, ranging from 58 to 2094 days. Eight dogs died or were euthanased for cardiac-related reasons, three were alive at follow-up and one dog was alive 278 days after surgery at last point of contact. All dogs showed a marked postoperative clinical improvement. Shunt obstruction or partial obstruction was documented in three of 12 dogs at 265, 587 and 693 days. Postoperative balloon valvuloplasty was performed in three of the 12 dogs, one died during the procedure and two dogs showed clinical improvement and extended good quality survival. Owners' perception of the procedure outcome and quality of life was described as good, with only mild adjustments needed for exercise. Blalock-Taussig-Thomas shunt is an effective palliative option for dogs with cyanotic congenital cardiac diseases associated with reduced pulmonary blood flow, providing sustained clinical improvement and quality of life. Recurrence of clinical signs could indicate shunt obstruction and warrants prompt assessment.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Modified Blalock-Taussig-Thomas shunt는 폐혈류 감소와 관련된 청색증 선천성 심장질환 개에서 효과적인 고식적 치료법으로, 지속적인 임상 개선과 양호한 삶의 질을 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 2009-2025년 소동물 전문병원에서 Blalock-Taussig-Thomas shunt를 받은 13마리 개의 의료기록을 후향적으로 검토했다(Fallot 사중증 8마리, 우심실 이중출구 3마리, 혼합형태 2마리). 모든 개가 수술을 견디었고, 추적관찰은 12마리에서 58-2094일간 이루어졌다. 12마리 중 8마리는 심장 관련 사유로 폐사/안락사, 3마리는 추적관찰 시점에 생존, 1마리는 마지막 연락 시점 수술 후 278일에 생존했다. 12마리 중 3마리에서 각각 수술 후 265, 587, 693일에 shunt 폐색 또는 부분 폐색이 기록되었고, 12마리 중 3마리가 술 후 풍선판막성형술을 받았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 술 후 운동불내증, 청색증, 심잡음의 현저한 개선이 모든 개에서 관찰되었으며, 주인들은 경증의 운동 조절만 필요한 양호한 치료 결과와 삶의 질을 보고했다. 임상징후의 재발은 shunt 폐색을 시사하므로 신속한 평가가 필요하다. 후향적 소규모 단일기관 연구이며, 추적관찰 기간이 불균등하다.

papers.title: Clinical features, survival, and associated factors for canine mast cell tumors: The role of neutering.
papers.authors: da Silva EMG, Mantovani MM, Silva MJB
papers.abstract: Canine mast cell tumors are among the most common skin neoplasms in dogs and exhibit highly variable biological behavior. Several factors have been associated with their development and prognosis, including breed, body size, and histological grade; however, the influence of neutering status, particularly age at neutering, on the odds of tumor diagnosis and survival remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate clinical features, factors associated with diagnosis, and survival outcomes in dogs with mast cell tumors (MCTs), with emphasis on neutering status and age at neutering. A retrospective case-control and survival study was conducted using medical records of dogs treated at a university veterinary hospital from 2015 to 2024. Dogs diagnosed with MCT were included as cases and compared with tumor-free controls matched by age category. Epidemiological, clinical, and pathological variables were analyzed, and agreement between cytological and histopathological grading was assessed. Among 56,254 dogs evaluated during the study period, 313 were diagnosed with MCT. Neutering before 24 months of age was associated with increased odds of MCT diagnosis compared with intact dogs, whereas neutering after 24 months of age was not. Medium and large body size, overweight body condition score, and specific breeds, particularly American Pit Bull Terriers and Boxers, were also associated with tumor diagnosis. In survival analysis, histological grade and tumor size were associated with survival time, whereas neutering status was not.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 24개월 이전의 조기 중성화는 개의 비만세포종 진단 위험을 증가시키지만, 중성화 상태 자체는 생존 시간에 영향을 주지 않으며, 조직학적 등급과 종양 크기가 생존을 결정하는 주요 인자이다.
[방법·수치] 2015~2024년 대학 동물병원 의료기록을 이용한 후향적 케이스-대조 및 생존분석 연구로, 56,254마리 중 313마리의 비만세포종 진단 개를 포함했으며, 24개월 이전 중성화는 미중성화 개 대비 종양 진단 위험 증가와 관련이 있었고, 중형 및 대형 체형, 과체중 체형지수, 미국 핏불테리어와 복서 품종이 진단과 연관되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 24개월 이전 조기 중성화 계획 시 비만세포종 발생 위험을 고려하여 소유자와 상담해야 하며, 비만세포종 진단 후 예후 평가는 중성화 여부보다는 조직학적 등급과 종양 크기에 집중해야 한다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이고 초록에 통계적 P값 제시가 없다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Pitfalls of M-mode echocardiography end-diastolic and end-systolic measurements: a study of 154 dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease.
papers.authors: Lobo L, Pereira GGCM, Pires MJ
papers.abstract: Echocardiographic assessment of myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD) includes measurement of the left ventricular internal dimension at the end-diastole (LVIDd) and at the end-systole (LVIDs), using established cardiac cycle markers. The LVIDd is measured at the QRS onset, which may not coincide with the maximal internal dimension. The LVIDs is obtained at maximum septal contraction, which in dogs with non-synchronous contraction (NSC) between the septal and free wall, may not correspond to the minimal internal dimension. This study investigates alternative measurement methods and their potential impact on MMVD staging. A retrospective analysis of echocardiographic examinations from 154 dogs with MMVD was performed. Twenty-five dogs displayed NSC and were selected for LVIDs assessment. The LVIDd was measured at the onset of the QRS complex (method D1, recommended by the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine [ACVIM]) and at the largest chamber diameter (method D2). In dogs with NSC, the LVIDs was measured using maximum septal contraction point (method S1) and minimum septal-to-free wall distance (method S2). The LVIDd values were significantly lower with method D1 in 152 dogs (P<0.001). Using method D2, 12 dogs exceeded the the body-weight-normalized LVIDd threshold of 1.7. In NSC dogs, LVIDs values were significantly higher with method S1 (P<0.001). Limitations included operator subjectivity and observational NSC. The measurement method influences LVIDd and LVIDs values. Although method D2 is not ACVIM- recommended, its application could hypothetically alter staging outcomes, highlighting the effect of measurement timing.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] M-mode 심초음파에서 좌심실 내경 측정 시점이 판막 질환 등급 판정을 변경할 수 있으며, 특히 심실 중격과 자유벽의 비동기 수축 시에는 현재 권장 방법이 최소/최대 내경을 정확히 반영하지 못할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 점액종성 승모판 질환(MMVD) 개 154마리의 후향적 심초음파 분석; 비동기 수축 25마리에서 좌심실 이완기 내경(LVIDd) 측정은 QRS 시작점(D1, ACVIM 권장)과 최대 내경(D2)에서 비교, 수축기 내경(LVIDs)은 최대 중격 수축점(S1)과 최소 중격-자유벽 거리(S2)에서 비교; D1 방법에서 LVIDd 유의하게 낮음(P<0.001), D2 사용 시 12마리가 체중 보정 임계값 1.7 초과, NSC 개에서 S1 방법이 LVIDs 유의하게 높음(P<0.001).
[임상 적용·한계] 측정 시점 변화가 MMVD 임상 등급을 변경할 가능성이 있으므로 치료 방침 결정 시 측정 방법의 일관성이 중요하나, 본 연구는 후향적 관찰 연구이며 연산자의 주관성과 NSC 판정의 객관성 부족이 한계다.

papers.title: Oral trazodone alone or in combination with gabapentin reduces the expression of stress-related behaviors in a randomized controlled trial with shelter dogs.
papers.authors: Delabar A, Koch CS, Burling A, Wallace L, Middleton JR
papers.abstract: To determine the effects of oral trazodone and gabapentin on the expression of stress-related behaviors (SRBs) in shelter dogs. SRBs were compared among shelter dogs treated orally with trazodone (8 mg/kg), gabapentin (25 mg/kg), trazodone (8 mg/kg) with gabapentin (25 mg/kg), or neither (control) the evening before and the morning of surgical neuter (ovariohysterectomy or castration). Dogs were enrolled between September 2020 and October 2021. Video recordings captured the behavior at baseline, 14 hours after the first treatment, and 1.5 hours after the second treatment. Fifteen SRBs were scored independently by blinded observers as present (1) or absent (0). Minute 1 recordings were in the absence of a person, and minute 2 recordings were in the presence of a person. The final SRB score was the sum of scores assigned by each observer at each time point, ranging from no SRB to 15 SRBs. 60 dogs and 13 SRBs were included in the final analysis. Mean behavior score was lower at minute 1 than minute 2 at baseline, the trazodone and combination groups had a significant reduction in mean behavior score, and the gabapentin group had an increase in mean behavior score. Mean scores in the control group did not differ over time. Oral trazodone alone or with gabapentin prior to surgery may be beneficial in reducing SRBs in shelter dogs. Oral trazodone alone or in combination with gabapentin may be useful in mitigating SRBs in dogs during veterinary care and related procedures.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경구 트라조돈 단독 또는 가바펜틴 병용 투여가 보호소 개의 스트레스 관련 행동을 유의하게 감소시키는 반면, 가바펜틴 단독은 오히려 증가시키는 경향을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 무작위 대조 시험으로 수술 전날 저녁과 당일 아침에 트라조돈(8 mg/kg), 가바펜틴(25 mg/kg), 트라조돈+가바펜틴 병용, 또는 무처치 대조군을 투여한 보호소 개 60마리를 대상으로 하였고, 15가지 스트레스 관련 행동을 사람 부재 시와 존재 시에 각각 측정하여 0-15점으로 채점했다. 트라조돈 그룹과 병용 그룹은 행동 점수가 유의하게 감소했으며, 가바펜틴 단독 그룹은 증가했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 수술 전 경구 트라조돈 단독 또는 가바펜틴 병용은 보호소 개와 임상 처치 시 스트레스 관련 행동 완화에 유용할 수 있다. 단일 보호소 시설에서 수행된 연구이며 더 많은 개체 수와 다양한 환경에서의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Development of a feline Cetuximab with therapeutic potential against feline oral squamous cell carcinoma.
papers.authors: Altamura G, Finizio A, Napolano A, Capasso C, Raia M
papers.abstract: Cetuximab is a chimeric murine-human anti-epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) monoclonal antibody (mAb) employed in the therapy of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Feline oral squamous cell carcinoma (FOSCC), the counterpart of HNSCC, is unresponsive to standard treatments and often lethal for affected cats. As EGFR is highly conserved between humans and cats, our research group attempted to test anti-cancer properties of Cetuximab in EGFR-positive FOSCC preclinical models, obtaining encouraging results in recent work. With the present study, we aimed at generating a "felinized" version of Cetuximab suitable for conducting future clinical trials in cat. A chimeric murine-feline IgG composed of variable regions of clinical Cetuximab fused with feline κ and γ constant regions was successfully generated with molecular biology methods. Immunofluorescence assays showed that the purified feline Cetuximab (f-Cetuximab) efficiently bound to human target in transfected cells (J-EGFR) as well as cancer cells endogenously overexpressing EGFR (MDA-MB-231, CAL-27); additionally, flow cytometry demonstrated that the engineered mAb bound feline EGFR in FOSCC cell lines SCCF1/2/3. Most importantly, f-Cetuximab impaired EGFR activity and inhibited cell proliferation in feline (SCCF1/3) and human (CAL-27) oral SCC cell lines. Moreover, LDH-based assays conducted by co-culturing SCCF3 cells and feline peripheral blood mononuclear cells revealed that f-Cetuximab elicited antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity, which might be pivotal for therapeutic efficacy of this mAb in vivo. In conclusion, with this study we established a highly specific and effective candidate for an innovative mAb-based therapeutic approach against FOSCC, paving the way for the introduction of molecular targeted therapy in veterinary oncology.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 EGFR에 특이적으로 결합하는 페린화 세툭시맙(f-Cetuximab)을 개발하였으며, 고양이 및 인간 구강 편평상피암종 세포주에서 EGFR 활성을 억제하고 세포 증식을 저해하며 항체-의존성 세포매개 세포독성(ADCC)을 유도함을 확인했다.
[방법·수치] 임상용 세툭시맙의 가변영역과 고양이 κ, γ 불변영역을 융합한 키메릭 단일클론항체를 분자생물학적 방법으로 생성했다. 면역형광검사와 유세포분석으로 f-Cetumozambab이 인간 EGFR 발현 세포(J-EGFR, MDA-MB-231, CAL-27)와 고양이 FOSCC 세포주(SCCF1/2/3)에 효율적으로 결합함을 입증했으며, LDH 검사로 SCCF3 세포와 고양이 말초혈액 단핵구의 공배양에서 ADCC 유도를 확인했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 표준 치료에 반응하지 않는 고양이 구강 편평상피암종의 새로운 분자표적치료법으로 임상시험 진행이 가능할 것으로 기대되나, 본 연구는 세포주 기반 전임상 모델 단계이므로 향후 생체 내 효과 및 안전성 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Predictors of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales enteric colonization among patients admitted to a companion animal intensive care unit.
papers.authors: Hidalgo Montealegre D, King CA, Mollenkopf DF, Van Balen JC, Cooper ES
papers.abstract: To estimate prevalence and identify factors associated with carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales (CRE) enteric colonization in companion animals admitted to an ICU. The study population included canine and feline patients admitted to The Ohio State University Veterinary Medical Center ICU between January 2024 and June 2025. In total, 5,552 rectal swabs were collected from 3,834 patients during routine screening. A retrospective case-control study included all CRE-positive patients (n = 61) and randomly selected CRE-negative controls (137). Cases were defined as ICU patients with at least 1 positive CRE fecal culture during hospitalization, whereas controls had no positive CRE fecal cultures during their hospitalization. Prevalence of CRE colonization was 1.59% (61 of 3,834 patients; 95% CI, 1.24% to 2.04%). Escherichia coli carrying blaNDM was the most frequently identified isolate, accounting for 78.7% (48 of 61 patients; 95% CI, 66.9% to 87.1%). Predictors of CRE colonization included increased comorbidity burden (unit OR, 1.96; 95% CI, 1.43 to 2.75), intact reproductive status (OR, 4.39; CI, 1.47 to 11.03), longer hospitalization (unit OR, 1.31; CI, 1.14 to 1.53), recent surgery (OR, 2.72; CI, 1.29 to 5.87), and antimicrobial use within the previous 3 months (OR, 2.71; CI, 1.23 to 6.07). These predictors suggest targets for infection prevention and control measures to protect patients and staff. The association between recent antimicrobial exposure and CRE colonization reinforces the importance of antimicrobial stewardship in veterinary medicine. Although uncommon, CRE-colonized patients can serve as reservoirs for transmission and are at risk of subsequent infection.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 반려동물 ICU 입원 환자에서 카바페넴 내성 장내세균(CRE) 집락화율은 1.59%이며, blaNDM을 보유한 대장균이 78.7%로 가장 흔한 분리균이다. CRE 집락화의 위험 인자는 높은 동반질환 부담, 번식능력 유지(중성화 미시행), 장기 입원, 최근 수술, 지난 3개월 내 항균제 사용이다.
[방법·수치] Ohio State University 수의학교육병원 ICU에 2024년 1월~2025년 6월 입원한 개와 고양이 대상 후향적 증례-대조군 연구(CRE 양성 61명, CRE 음성 대조군 137명, 총 3,834명 환자에서 5,552건 직장 도말 검체). 위험도 비(OR): 동반질환 1.96, 미중성화 4.39, 입원 기간당 1.31, 최근 수술 2.72, 최근 3개월 항균제 사용 2.71.
[임상 적용·한계] CRE 집락화 고위험 환자(특히 미중성화, 최근 수술, 항균제 노출력)에 대한 감염관리 강화와 항균제 절약이 필수적이다. 단일기관 연구이고 CRE 감염(집락화 아님)으로의 진행률이 제시되지 않아 임상적 중요성을 평가하기 위한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Gastrointestinal transit time of healthy dogs before and after enema assessed by contrast radiographs with barium-impregnated polyethylene spheres.
papers.authors: de Souza MR, da Silva WPR, Xavier RAL, da Silva CCL, Ruiz KC
papers.abstract: In this prospective experimental study, we aimed to assess the gastrointestinal (GI) transit of healthy dogs with and without an enema, using barium-impregnated polyethylene spheres (BIPS). Six healthy dogs underwent two experimental steps: evaluation of the GI transit using BIPS (BIPS group) before and after enema (BIPS+ENEMA group). All animals were fasted for 12 h, the transit was assessed in serial radiographs from 0 to 12 h, and BIPS were counted in each segment of the GI tract, calculating the gastric emptying time and the time the spheres reached the descending colon. Blood cell count, serum biochemistry, electrolytes, and blood glucose levels were assessed during the experiment to evaluate the safety of both BIPs and enema. BIPS were easily identified in all segments of the GI tract. The BIPS group presented gastric emptying starting at H0 and H1, ending around H8. BIPS + ENEMA group showed a delayed gastric emptying, which began around H1 and extended to more than H12, and had a lower percentage of spheres in the descending colon at the end of the evaluation; however, the differences were not statistically significant. BIPS and enema did not cause changes in laboratory evaluation, and the 12-hour fast did not cause hypoglycemia. Based on the findings, when using BIPS for radiographic contrast, an enema is not a required procedure. The use of the enema and BIPS can be considered safe, with no apparent adverse effects in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 건강한 개에서 바륨 함침 폴리에틸렌 구(BIPS)를 이용한 위장관 통과시간 평가에서 관장(enema)은 필수 절차가 아니며, BIPS와 관장 모두 안전한 조영 방법이다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 개 6마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 실험 연구로, BIPS 단독군(BIPS group)과 BIPS+관장군(BIPS+ENEMA group)에서 0-12시간 연속 방사선촬영으로 위장관 통과시간을 평가하였다. BIPS군은 위배출이 H0-H1부터 시작하여 H8 경에 종료되었으나, BIPS+관장군은 위배출 지연을 보였고(H1부터 H12 이상까지 연장) 평가 종료 시 하행결장 내 구의 비율이 낮았으나 통계적으로 유의미하지 않았다.
[임상 적용·한계] BIPS는 위장관의 모든 구획에서 쉽게 확인 가능하며 조영용으로 임상 적용 가능하다. 그러나 소규모 표본(n=6)과 단일 조영 방법만 평가한 점, 그리고 개별 개체의 변이에 대한 분석 부재가 한계이다.

papers.title: Echocardiographic changes in hyperthyroid cats: Comparison of subclinical disease and congestive heart failure.
papers.authors: Greil S, Utzinger H, Maerz I
papers.abstract: Hyperthyroidism induces a wide spectrum of cardiovascular changes in cats, yet the factors distinguishing subclinical cardiac involvement from congestive heart failure (CHF) remain poorly defined. Previous studies have focused primarily on structural changes, with limited evaluation of atrial function or right-sided involvement. To compare echocardiographic variables between hyperthyroid cats with subclinical cardiac disease and those presenting in CHF, with emphasis on left atrial remodelling, left atrial function, and left ventricular dimensional changes, and right-sided involvement assessed by right atrial diameter. The comparison of clinical and biochemical variables was a secondary objective. A retrospective case-control study was performed using medical records of 51 hyperthyroid cats with subclinical cardiac disease and 47 hyperthyroid cats presenting in CHF. All cats underwent standard echocardiography, serum biochemistry including total thyroxine (TT4). Type of congestion was determined by thoracic radiography or point-of-care ultrasound, and CHF cats were classified as having pulmonary oedema only or pleural/mixed effusion. Cats with CHF had significantly larger atrial dimensions and increased left ventricular internal diameter compared with subclinical cats. Left atrial dysfunction was the most robust discriminator between groups. Pleural or mixed effusion was the predominant CHF phenotype and, compared with pulmonary oedema alone, was associated with greater right-sided and global volume overload. TT4 concentrations did not differ significantly between cats with and without CHF. Similarly, biochemical variables showed no significant differences between subclinical or CHF cats or between CHF subtypes. Atrial remodelling - particularly impaired atrial function and biatrial enlargement - represents the clearest echocardiographic marker of decompensation in hyperthyroid cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 갑상선기능항진증 고양이에서 좌심방 기능 장애와 양심방 확대가 임상적 심부전으로의 진행을 가장 잘 구분하는 초음파 지표이며, 흉수/혼합액은 폐부종보다 더 흔한 임상 양상이고 우심계 용적 과부하를 반영한다.
[방법·수치] 후향적 증례-대조군 연구로 임상적 심장질환이 있는 갑상선기능항진증 고양이 51마리와 울혈성심부전으로 내원한 갑상선기능항진증 고양이 47마리를 비교하였으며, 모든 고양이에서 표준 심초음파 검사와 혈청 T4를 측정하였다. 심부전군에서 심방 크기와 좌심실 내경이 유의하게 증가했고, 혈청 T4 농도는 집단 간 유의한 차이가 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 종합 심초음파 검사는 심부전 위험 고양이의 조기 발견에 필수적이지만, T4 농도 단독으로는 심장 상태를 예측할 수 없다. 후향적 단일 기관 연구로 추적 조사 데이터가 없고, 초음파 측정의 재현성 평가가 제시되지 않았다.

papers.title: Transdiaphragmatic video-assisted lobectomy of caudal and accessory lung lobes: A canine cadaveric feasibility study.
papers.authors: Rico-Holgado S, Garcia-Pertierra S, Martinez-Trapero A, Pera-Serrano M, Fontalba-Navas JL
papers.abstract: To evaluate the feasibility and technical outcomes of a video-assisted transdiaphragmatic (VATD) approach to perform total lung lobectomy of the caudal and accessory pulmonary lobes in canine cadavers. Cadaveric study. A total of 12 canine cadavers. Cadavers were randomly assigned to left caudal, right caudal or accessory lung lobectomy (n = 4/group). A cranial midline celiotomy and transdiaphragmatic approach were performed with rigid videoendoscopic assistance under standardized procedural conditions. Lobectomies were completed using an endoscopic linear stapler. Recorded variables included achievement of complete pulmonary lobectomy, surgical times, incision length, and intraoperative technical events. Staple-line integrity was assessed using an air leak test. Descriptive statistics and logistic regression were used to evaluate results and associations with cadaver weight and body condition score (BCS). Total lobectomy was achieved in 11/12 cadavers (91.7%), including all caudal lobes (100%) and three accessory lobes (75%). Mean total surgical time was 65.6 ± 26.8 min and incision length represented approximately one-third of abdominal midline length. Air leaks were identified in two accessory lung lobe lobectomies. No other intraoperative technical events were recorded. Two staple cartridges were required in 4/12 procedures (33.3%). Procedural success was not associated with cadaver weight or BCS. A VATD approach was feasible in canine cadavers and allowed total resection of caudal lung lobes, with slightly lower success for the accessory lung lobe. A VATD approach provided effective hilar exposure and acceptable procedural times in this cadaveric model. Further investigation in clinical patients is required to determine safety and clinical applicability and perioperative outcomes in dogs accurately.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경횡격막 비디오보조 접근법(VATD)을 이용한 개의 미측 및 부폐엽 절제술은 기술적으로 실행 가능하며, 미측 폐엽은 100% 성공률을 보였으나 부폐엽은 75%의 성공률을 나타냈다.
[방법·수치] 개 사체 12마리를 좌측 미측, 우측 미측, 부폐엽 절제술에 무작위 배정(각 군 4마리)하여 경험골 중앙선 절개 후 경횡격막 접근법으로 선형 스테이플러를 이용해 폐엽절제를 수행했다. 완전 폐엽절제 달성률 91.7%(11/12), 평균 수술시간 65.6±26.8분, 절개 길이는 복부 중앙선의 약 1/3이었으며, 부폐엽 2례에서 공기 누수가 확인되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] VATD 접근법은 최소침습적 폐엽절제술의 대안이 될 수 있으나, 본 연구는 사체 모델에 한정되어 임상환자에서의 안전성, 적용 가능성, 수술 후 결과에 대한 추가 조사가 필수적이다.

papers.title: Effects of a Dietary Supplementation of Bovine Colostrum in Dogs With Atopic Dermatitis.
papers.authors: Schäfer L, Büttner K, Paßlack N
papers.abstract: Bovine colostrum (BC) shows immunomodulatory properties, which could be beneficial in the management of chronic immune-mediated diseases such as canine atopic dermatitis (cAD). To assess if a BC supplementation affects selected immune variables and clinical signs in cAD. Twenty client-owned dogs with non-seasonal, environmentally induced cAD were enrolled in this prospective, double-blinded, placebo-controlled study. After a 2-week adaptation to standardised feeding, the dogs were divided into two groups, receiving either a placebo or BC at 0.2% in dietary dry matter for 4 weeks. Afterwards, the dogs remained on their diets for another 4 weeks, without placebo and BC supplementation. Blood and faecal samples were collected on Day (D)14, D42 and D70 for immunological measurements (proliferative and phagocytic activity of blood leukocytes, faecal immunoglobulin [Ig]A, plasma concentrations of Igs, C-reactive protein [CRP] and serum amyloid A [SAA]). Additionally, the Canine Atopic Dermatitis Extent and Severity Index, 4th iteration (CADESI-04) was assessed. The owners evaluated pruritus (Visual Analog Scale) of their dogs retrospectively and daily (r-/d-pVAS), as well as quality-of-life (QoL), global assessment and quality-of-coat. No significant diet effects were detected for the clinical and immunological parameters evaluated. A slight improvement in QoL could be observed in both feeding groups over time. An oral administration of BC did not alter relevant clinical and immune parameters in patients with cAD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소 초유(bovine colostrum) 0.2% 식이 보충은 개의 환경성 비계절성 아토피성 피부염 환자에서 임상 증상과 면역학적 매개변수에 유의미한 영향을 미치지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 20마리의 환경성 비계절성 아토피성 피부염을 가진 개를 대상으로 한 전향적, 이중맹검, 위약 대조 연구로, 2주 적응 후 4주간 위약 또는 초유 보충을 받았고 이후 4주간 추적 관찰했다(D14, D42, D70에 샘플 채취). CADESI-04, 소양증 평가, 삶의 질 및 혈액·분변 면역글로불린 A, 혈장 면역글로불린, CRP, SAA 등을 측정했으며 수치적으로 유의미한 차이는 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 경구 초유 보충은 환자 삶의 질에 미미한 개선만 보였으므로 아토피성 피부염 관리에 임상적 효과를 기대하기 어렵다. 단일 기관 소규모 연구이고 단기(8주) 추적 기간이 한계이다.

papers.title: Incidence, risk factors, and clinical features of postoperative new-onset atrial fibrillation in dogs undergoing mitral valve repair surgery.
papers.authors: Kurogochi K, Nishiyama M, Furusato S, Nii Y, Mizuno M
papers.abstract: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is a potential complication following cardiac surgery. This study aims to identify POAF risk factors and describe its clinical features following mitral valve repair (MVR) in dogs. Dogs that underwent MVR between January 2020 and December 2023 were included in the study. Dogs with pre-operative atrial fibrillation or those that died intra-operatively were excluded. Potential risk factors for new-onset POAF were assessed based on selected parameters, and POAF duration was documented. Postoperative atrial fibrillation occurred in 100 of 1,577 dogs. Possible independent risk factors included male sex (vs. female sex; risk ratio [RR], 1.84; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.22-2.78), body weight (per 1.0 kg; RR, 1.17; 95% CI, 1.04-1.30), left ventricular end-diastolic internal diameter normalized to body weight (per 0.1 unit; RR, 1.28; 95% CI, 1.11-1.47), and left ventricular systolic internal diameter normalized to body weight (per 0.1 unit; RR, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.56-0.94). Postoperative atrial fibrillation lasted <24 h in 88 of 100 dogs and returned to sinus rhythm between 24 h and 7 days in eight dogs and between 7 days and 1 month in one dog. Postoperative atrial fibrillation persisted for >1 month in three dogs. The retrospective design and predominance of small-breed dogs may limit generalizability. New-onset POAF occurred in 6.3% of dogs undergoing MVR at our institution. Male sex, greater body weight, and pre-operative left ventricular remodeling may be associated with onset of POAF. The majority of POAF returned to sinus rhythm within 24 h postoperatively.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 승모판 수술 후 새로운 심방세동(POAF)이 개에서 발생했으며, 수술 후 대부분의 환자가 24시간 이내에 동율동으로 복귀했다. [방법·수치] 2020년 1월부터 2023년 12월 사이에 승모판 복구술을 받은 개 1,577마리 중 100마리(6.3%)에서 POAF가 발생했다. 독립적 위험인자는 수컷(위험비 1.84, 95% CI 1.22-2.78), 체중 증가(체중 1kg당 위험비 1.17, 95% CI 1.04-1.30), 체중 정규화 좌심실 이완기 내경 증가(단위당 위험비 1.28, 95% CI 1.11-1.47)였으며, 좌심실 수축기 내경 증가는 보호효과를 보였다(체중 정규화, 단위당 위험비 0.72, 95% CI 0.56-0.94). POAF 환자 중 88마리는 24시간 이내 복구되었고, 8마리는 24시간~7일, 1마리는 7일~1개월에 복구되었으며, 3마리만 1개월 이상 지속되었다. [임상 적용·한계] 수컷, 고체중, 수술 전 좌심실 리모델링이 있는 개에서 POAF 발생을 더 주의깊게 모니터링해야 한다. 대다수 POAF는 자연적으로 24시간 내에 해결되어 적극적 치료를 필요로 하지 않을 수 있다. 그러나 후향적 연구이고 소형견이 대다수로 구성되어 있어 결과의 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Vitamin D supplementation in dogs with chronic biliary tract diseases.
papers.authors: Habermaass V, Cogozzo A, Bartoli F, Rocca DJ, Dini R
papers.abstract: Extrahepatic cholestasis in dogs is frequently associated with reduced intestinal absorption of fat-soluble vitamins, resulting in suboptimal vitamin D status. This prospective longitudinal study assessed the effects of six-week oral cholecalciferol supplementation (40 IU/kg/day) on serum 25-hydroxycholecalciferol [25(OH)D] in fourteen dogs with chronic biliary disease. Median baseline 25(OH)D concentration was 2.3 ng/mL (0.3-11.2), increasing to 4.3 ng/mL (2.4-14.0) after treatment, whereas healthy controls (n = 31) showed 11.68 ng/mL (2.65-37.93). Statistical analyses (paired Wilcoxon tests) confirmed a significant increase post-supplementation (p = 0.003). Ionized calcium and phosphorus levels were stable, and no hypercalcemia occurred. Biochemical parameters (alkaline phosphatase, alanine aminotransferase, gamma-glutamyl transferase, cholesterol, total bilirubin) showed nonsignificant downward trends, indicating good hepatic tolerance. Cholecalciferol supplementation was thus safe and effectively improved vitamin D status, although concentrations remained lower than those observed in the study's healthy controls. The heterogeneous response suggests variable intestinal absorption or disease severity. Further controlled, long-term studies are needed to refine dosing strategies and clarify potential hepatic and clinical benefits.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 만성 담도질환 개에서 6주간 콜레칼시페롤 보충(40 IU/kg/day)은 혈청 25(OH)D 농도를 유의하게 증가시켰으며, 간 독성 없이 안전하게 사용할 수 있다. 그러나 보충 후에도 건강한 대조군보다 25(OH)D 농도가 낮게 유지되었다.
[방법·수치] 만성 담도질환 개 14마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 종단 연구로, 6주간 경구 콜레칼시페롤 투여 전후 혈청 25(OH)D 농도를 측정했다. 기저치 중앙값 2.3 ng/mL(범위 0.3-11.2)에서 치료 후 4.3 ng/mL(2.4-14.0)로 증가(p=0.003), 건강한 대조군(n=31)은 11.68 ng/mL(2.65-37.93)였다. 혈중 칼슘, 인, 간기능 지표는 모두 안정적이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 만성 담도질환 개의 지용성 비타민 흡수 저하로 인한 비타민 D 결핍 개선에 콜레칼시페롤 보충을 사용할 수 있으나, 개별 반응의 이질성이 있어 최적 용량 결정을 위한 대조, 장기 연구가 필요하고 임상적 혜택 명확화가 추가로 요구된다.

papers.title: Longitudinal assessment of left and right ventricular systolic function in dogs undergoing chemotherapy with doxorubicin.
papers.authors: Wolf M, Lucina SB, Silva VBC, Silveira MF, Silva VG
papers.abstract: Cardiotoxicity is a recognized complication of chemotherapy with doxorubicin and is classically associated with left ventricular dysfunction; however, evidence from human cardio-oncology suggests that global cardiac function, including the right ventricle, may also be affected, and that advanced echocardiographic techniques such as global longitudinal strain (GLS) and tissue motion annular displacement (TMAD) may detect subtle myocardial dysfunction earlier than conventional indices. This prospective longitudinal study evaluated 25 dogs with cancer undergoing doxorubicin chemotherapy, administered alone or in combination with other drugs, using conventional echocardiography and speckle tracking before treatment and at 7, 21, 60, 120 and 180 days after the first dose. Twelve dogs completed all evaluations. No significant changes were observed over time in left ventricular volumes, fractional shortening, ejection fraction, global circumferential strain or GLS. However, reductions in MAPSEi lateral (P = 0.002), MAPSEi septal (P = 0.0293) and global TMAD% (P = 0.046) were observed at 180 days compared with baseline, along with decreased E' wave velocity and a negative correlation between cumulative doxorubicin dose and the E:A ratio, suggesting a dose-dependent effect on diastolic function. In the right ventricle, progressive reductions in TAPSEi (P < 0.001), RV S'n wave (P = 0.036), FAC (P = 0.04), RV GLS (P = 0.002) and RV TMAD (P = 0.019) were observed over time. These findings indicate subclinical reductions in indices of systolic function of both ventricles, highlighting the sensitivity of MAPSE, TAPSE and TMAD for early detection of myocardial alterations. papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 독소루비신 항암치료는 좌심실뿐만 아니라 우심실의 수축 기능도 손상시키며, 조직 운동 환위 변위(TMAD)와 첨판 평면 수축기 변위(MAPSE, TAPSE) 같은 고급 초음파 기법이 기존 지표보다 조기에 심근 기능 장애를 감지할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 독소루비신 치료를 받는 암환자 개 25마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 종단 연구로, 치료 전과 1, 7, 21, 60, 120, 180일에 종래 심초음파와 스펙클 추적 기법을 적용했다(완료 12마리). 180일차에 좌심실 MAPSEi 측면(P=0.002), MAPSEi 중격부(P=0.0293), 전역 TMAD%(P=0.046) 감소 및 E' 파 속도 감소가 관찰되었고, 우심실에서는 TAPSEi(P<0.001), RV S'n 파(P=0.036), FAC(P=0.04), RV GLS(P=0.002), RV TMAD(P=0.019)의 점진적 감소가 시간 경과에 따라 나타났다.
[임상 적용·한계] 독소루비신 치료 중인 개에서 좌우 심실 기능을 모니터링할 때 MAPSE, TAPSE, TMAD를 포함한 고급 초음파 지표 사용을 권장하나, 완료율 48%(12/25마리)로 소규모이고 단일기관 연구라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Metagenomic Oxford Nanopore sequencing of feline aural inflammatory polyps for pathogen discovery.
papers.authors: Noland E, Conner K, Brame B, Petersen A, Thaiwong-Nebelung T
papers.abstract: ObjectivesFeline aural inflammatory polyps (FIAP) have been proposed to be induced by chronic viral or bacterial infections; however, the cause is still unknown. The aim of this study was to investigate potential etiologies of these polyps using metagenomic sequencing.MethodsPolyp tissue was collected from 13 cats following routine traction and avulsion procedures. Total nucleic acid was extracted and subjected to a host (feline) nucleic acid depletion protocol. Additionally, the Sequence-Independent Single-Primer Amplification (SISPA) method was used to enrich for low-abundance RNA viral genomes. Sequencing was conducted on the Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencing platform. Non-feline sequencing reads were taxonomically classified against custom bacterial/viral databases to calculate relative genus-level abundances.ResultsTaxonomic classification of sequencing reads identified various bacteria across samples and, in some samples, rare viruses. However, no common microbial sequences were associated with polyps to suggest a specific infectious etiology. Bacterial communities were dominated by Pseudomonadota, Actinomycetota, and Bacillota phyla, with Pseudomonadota and Actinomycetota being more frequently dominant. Lasallevirus was detected in few samples with unknown clinical relevance. Culture and sequencing showed partial concordance in identifying bacteria in some cases.Conclusions and relevanceNo common microbial-associated sequences found to be associated with polyp samples; therefore, no suspect causative agent was identified. 16S and ITS metagenomic sequencing on FIAP may help further elucidate if microbial population shifts have a role in polyp development and recurrence and/or persistence of inflammation leading to polyp development.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 메타게노믹 시퀀싱으로 고양이 귀 염증성 용종 조직을 분석한 결과 특정 감염병원체와 일관되게 연관된 미생물이 발견되지 않아, 현재까지 명확한 감염성 원인은 규명되지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 귀 용종 절제술을 받은 고양이 13마리에서 용종 조직을 채취하고 Oxford Nanopore MinION 플랫폼으로 메타게노믹 시퀀싱을 수행했다. 샘플에서 Pseudomonadota, Actinomycetota, Bacillota 계통이 우점했으며, 일부 샘플에서 Lasallevirus가 검출되었으나 임상적 의의는 불명확했다. 배양과 시퀀싱의 일치도는 부분적이었다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 귀 염증성 용종의 발생 및 재발 기전에 미생물 군집 변화의 역할이 있는지 규명하기 위해 추가 16S 및 ITS 메타게노믹 시퀀싱이 필요하다. 본 연구는 소규모(13마리) 단일 기관 연구로 모든 용종이 감염성 원인을 가지지 않을 가능성을 시사한다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Assessment of caregiver burden in feline chronic kidney disease.
papers.authors: Lim L, Quimby JM, Caney S
papers.abstract: ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to investigate caregiver burden associated with management of cats with chronic kidney disease (CKD).MethodsCaregivers who had experience managing a cat with CKD were recruited through social media to anonymously participate in an online Qualtrics survey. The modified Zarit Burden Interview (mZBI) was incorporated into the survey to objectively assess caregiver burden. An mZBI score of ≥ 18 represents clinically significant burden.ResultsA total of 339 surveys were completed. 46% of caregivers reported an mZBI score of ≥ 18. Caregivers of cats with IRIS stages 3/4 had significantly higher mZBI scores (median 20.0, range 3 - 50) than caregivers of cats with IRIS stages 1/2 (median 14.5, range 0 - 58; P = 0.0007). Caregivers who reported never to rarely sharing care responsibilities had significantly higher mZBI scores (median 20.0; range 0 - 50) than those who reported sometimes to always sharing care responsibilities (median 15.0; range 2 - 58) (P = 0.0007). Caregivers who reported the need to coax their cat to eat on a daily basis had higher mZBI scores (median 22.8, range 2 - 50) than those who never coaxed their cat to eat (median 14.5, range 0-49) or coaxed their cat 1-2 days/week (median 19.2, range 3 - 42) (both P < 0.001). Caregivers who always felt supported by the veterinary care team had lower mZBI scores (median 13; range 0-58) than those that only felt supported sometimes to never (median 23; range 5-45) (P < 0.001).Conclusions and clinical importanceSignificant caregiver burden is present in feline CKD, emphasizing the need to for clinicians to provide empathetic advice and practical support.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 만성신장질환(CKD) 관리 중 보호자의 46%가 임상적으로 유의한 수준의 부담을 경험하며, 질환 진행 정도와 일상적 관리 부담이 보호자 스트레스를 크게 증가시킨다.
[방법·수치] 소셜미디어를 통해 모집한 CKD 고양이 보호자 339명을 대상으로 온라인 설문(수정된 Zarit 부담 척도 mZBI 포함)을 실시했다. mZBI 점수 18점 이상은 임상적 유의한 부담으로 정의되었으며, IRIS 3/4단계 고양이 보호자의 mZBI 중앙값은 20.0(범위 3-50)으로 1/2단계 14.5(범위 0-58)보다 유의하게 높았다(P=0.0007). 보호자 지원이 없는 경우 mZBI 20.0, 있는 경우 15.0으로 유의한 차이를 보였고(P=0.0007), 매일 식이 유도가 필요한 경우 mZBI 22.8로 가장 높았다(P<0.001). 수의료팀의 지속적 지원을 받는 보호자는 mZBI 13으로 가장 낮았다(P<0.001).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상의는 CKD 고양이 보호자의 심리사회적 부담을 인식하고 공감적 조언과 실질적 지원(가족 간 역할 분담, 식이 관리 전략, 지속적 소통)을 제공해야 한다. 다만 본 연구는 소셜미디어 모집으로 인한 선택편향이 있을 수 있고 횡단적 설계이다.

papers.title: The Role of Comorbidities in Pyoderma Among Canine and Feline Diabetic Patients.
papers.authors: Wixon V, Pieper JB, Bachtel J
papers.abstract: Pyoderma is considered a secondary complication of diabetes mellitus (DM), yet the relationship remains unclear. One study found 22% of diabetic dogs with dermatopathy had no other comorbidities while cats have not been evaluated. This study evaluated the association of DM and pyoderma in dogs and cats by identifying comorbidities. This retrospective study analysed canine and feline DM cases from August 2019 to November 2022 at Iowa State University and Colorado State University. We analysed cytologically confirmed pyoderma and assessed the prevalence of comorbidities, including allergies, thyroid and adrenal disease, neoplasia and other dermatological disorders. Pyoderma was prevalent in 7.6% (61 of 805) dogs and 4.0% (15 of 372) cats with concurrent DM. Of 61 dogs, two (3.3%) lacked comorbidities which was considered protective (odds ratio [OR] = 0.06; 95% CI 0.01-0.29; p < 0.001). Allergic dermatitis was the most common comorbidity (70.5%) in dogs with increased odds (OR = 9.15; 95% CI 4.25-19.72; p < 0.001). Among 15 cats, one (6.7%) lacked comorbidities (OR = 0.04; 95% CI 0.01-0.34; p = 0.003), while allergic dermatitis appeared most frequent and increased odds (73.3%; OR = 18.67; 95% CI 4.81-72.44; p < 0.001). West Highland white terriers (OR = 4.59; 95% CI 1.43-14.77; p = 0.011) and domestic medium hair cats (OR = 7.31; 95% Cl 1.05-50.68; p = 0.044) had increased odds of pyoderma. This study suggests that pyoderma in DM cats and dogs is uncommon as pyoderma owing to DM alone being seen in only 0.25% of dogs and 0.27% of cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 당뇨병 개와 고양이에서 농피증은 드문 합병증이며, 당뇨병 단독으로 인한 농피증은 개 0.25%, 고양이 0.27%에 불과하고, 대부분 알레르기성 피부염 등의 동반질환이 주요 위험인자임을 밝혔다.
[방법·수치] 2019년 8월~2022년 11월 두 대학 병원의 후향적 연구로 개 805마리(농피증 61마리, 7.6%), 고양이 372마리(농피증 15마리, 4.0%)를 대상으로 세포학적으로 확진된 농피증과 동반질환(알레르기, 갑상선/부신질환, 종양 등)을 분석하였다. 개에서 동반질환 없는 경우 오즈비 0.06(95% CI 0.01-0.29, p<0.001), 알레르기성피부염 오즈비 9.15(95% CI 4.25-19.72, p<0.001)였고, 고양이에서 동반질환 없는 경우 오즈비 0.04(95% CI 0.01-0.34, p=0.003), 알레르기성피부염 오즈비 18.67(95% CI 4.81-72.44, p<0.001)이었다.

papers.title: Should veterinarians apply a 2-step framework to classify adiposity and diagnose clinical obesity in dogs and cats?
papers.authors: Ward E, Churchill J
papers.abstract: Obesity drugs are entering veterinary trials, and prescribing them should follow a diagnosis. Body condition score is not a diagnosis; it describes a patient's adiposity, not whether it is causing illness. This Viewpoint proposes 2 steps for diagnosing clinical obesity in dogs and cats: describe, then diagnose. Step 1 describes adiposity as overweight or obesity. Step 2, applied only when obesity is documented, assigns a disease stage; clinical obesity requires a documented, clinically meaningful abnormality attributed to adiposity. The framework is proposed for consensus and validation. Structured weight loss begins at overweight; nutritional assessment applies to every patient.
