[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 임상적 비만 진단을 위해 2단계 프레임워크를 적용해야 한다: 1단계에서 체지방도를 과체중 또는 비만으로 기술하고, 2단계에서 체지방도로 인한 임상적으로 의미 있는 이상이 증명될 때만 질병 단계를 진단한다.
[방법·수치] 이 연구는 현행 체형점수 평가의 한계를 분석한 관점 논문으로, 비만 치료제의 수의학적 임상시험 도입을 배경으로 2단계 진단 프레임워크를 제시한다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 체형점수는 비만 진단이 아닌 체지방도 기술이므로, 구조화된 감량 프로그램은 과체중 단계부터 시작하고 모든 환자에 영양 평가를 적용해야 한다. 이 프레임워크는 합의와 검증이 필요한 제안이며, 한계는 현재 임상 실습에서의 적용 가능성이 미검증된 관점 논문이다.

papers.title: Contrast-enhanced echocardiographic assessment of left ventricular wall measurements in cats.
papers.authors: Novo Matos J, Harding I, Partington C
papers.abstract: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is defined by increased left ventricular wall thickness (LVWT), making accurate measurement essential. Contrast-enhanced echocardiography (C-ECHO) improves myocardial border delineation. We aimed to evaluate whether C-ECHO provides more reliable LVWT measurements in cats than standard echocardiography (S-ECHO). Forty-five cats (32 with an LVWT <6 mm and 13 with an LVWT ≥6 mm) were prospectively enrolled in the study. Two-dimensional right parasternal short-axis images were acquired before and after contrast administration (SonoVue: 0.05 mL/kg [0.04-0.14 mL/kg]). Septal and posterior wall thickness values were measured using both modalities. Agreement and reliability were assessed using Bland-Altman analysis, Kappa statistics, and intraclass correlation coefficients. Left ventricular wall thickness was greater with S-ECHO than C-ECHO (maximal LVWT: 5.0 mm [2.8-9.5 mm] vs. 4.2 mm [2.5-8.9 mm], P < 0.0001). On average, the LVWT measured by S-ECHO was 0.61 mm greater than that obtained by C-ECHO. Agreement between S-ECHO and C-ECHO for HCM diagnosis was only moderate (Kappa: 0.50). The Bland-Altman analysis showed fixed biases and wide 95% limits of agreement (LoA) for LVWT (septum: bias: 0.8 mm, LoA: -0.7-2.3 mm; posterior wall: bias: 0.4 mm, LoA: -1.1-2.0 mm). Contrast-enhanced echocardiography demonstrated higher measurement reliability (intraclass correlation coefficient: 0.99 vs. 0.96). A low-mechanical index preset was not used, and measurements were not timed using an electrocardiogram (ECG). Standard echocardiography seems to overestimate LVWT compared to C-ECHO, consistent with findings reported in human studies. Contrast-enhanced echocardiography improves measurement reliability. These findings support its use to enhance HCM assessment in cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 조영제 강화 심초음파(C-ECHO)가 표준 심초음파(S-ECHO)보다 좌심실벽 두께 측정의 신뢰성이 높으며, S-ECHO는 C-ECHO 대비 평균 0.61 mm 과대평가하는 경향을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 좌심실벽 두께 6 mm 미만 32마리, 6 mm 이상 13마리 고양이 총 45마리를 대상으로 전향적 연구를 수행했다. SonoVue 조영제(0.05 mL/kg) 투여 전후 2D 우측 흉골단락 단축축상면 영상을 획득하여 측정했으며, 최대 좌심실벽 두께는 S-ECHO 5.0 mm vs C-ECHO 4.2 mm (P < 0.0001), 심실중격 편향 0.8 mm (95% LoA: -0.7~2.3 mm), 후벽 편향 0.4 mm (95% LoA: -1.1~2.0 mm)이었다. 급성심근병 진단 일치도는 중등도(Kappa 0.50), 측정 신뢰성은 C-ECHO가 더 우수했다(급내상관계수: 0.99 vs 0.96).
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 비후성심근병 평가 시 C-ECHO 사용을 권장하나, 저기계지수 프리셋 미사용과 심전도 동기화 미시행으로 인한 측정 조건의 최적화 부족이 한계이다.

papers.title: Echocardiographic assessment of mitral regurgitation severity in dogs.
papers.authors: Visser LC, Potter BM
papers.abstract: Mitral regurgitation (MR) is the most important cardiovascular problem affecting dogs. Transthoracic echocardiography is the most practical imaging modality to characterize the fundamental features of MR, including an assessment of MR severity. The diversity of MR severity in subclinical dogs and advancements in treatments directed at the cause of MR have (re)ignited interest in more comprehensive and quantitative methods of assessing MR severity. This review focuses on evaluating the severity of chronic MR in dogs. It discusses when a comprehensive assessment of MR severity is indicated. It highlights the strengths, limitations and challenges associated with the numerous structural, qualitative, semiquantitative and quantitative variables available to assess MR severity. The methods involved in determining the important quantitative variables of MR severity such as effective orifice area, regurgitant volume and regurgitant fraction are reviewed in detail. This paper advocates for an integrative approach, ideally from guidelines generated by an expert panel, where multiple echocardiographic variables from multiple categories are incorporated to assess MR severity and grade the MR as mild, moderate or severe. It summarizes the work on assessing MR severity in dogs to date and highlights shortcomings where there is much work to be done.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 만성 승모판 역류 중증도 평가는 단일 변수보다는 구조적, 정성적, 반정량적, 정량적 지표를 통합한 다층적 접근이 필요하며, 전문가 패널 가이드라인 수립이 권장된다.
[방법·수치] 흉부 초음파를 이용한 만성 승모판 역류의 중증도 평가에 관한 문헌 검토; 유효 개구면적(effective orifice area), 역류량(regurgitant volume), 역류분획(regurgitant fraction) 등의 정량적 변수 중심 검토; 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 무증상 환자에서의 포괄적 중증도 평가 필요성이 증가하고 있으며, 초음파를 통한 MR 중증도 분류(경증/중등증/중증)가 임상 의사결정에 중요함; 현재까지의 평가 방법들은 한계가 있으며 추가 연구가 필요한 상태이고, 다양한 변수들 간의 표준화된 통합 평가 기준이 아직 완전히 확립되지 않음.

papers.title: The use of contrast-enhanced echocardiography in the evaluation of feline left ventricular wall thickness.
papers.authors: Javery E, Kadotani S, Toborowsky C, Prabhakar S, Sumerfield T
papers.abstract: Accurate measurement of feline left ventricular wall thickness (LVWT) is challenging due to endocardial and myocardial irregularities, false tendons, and prominent papillary muscles. In human medicine, contrast-enhanced echocardiography (C-Echo) is used to improve left ventricular wall delineation and is more accurate, repeatable, and reliable than standard echocardiography (S-Echo). Our objective was to compare C-Echo and S-Echo measurements of feline LVWT and determine repeatability, reproducibility, and reliability of each modality. Fifty client-owned cats were prospectively enrolled in the study. Cats underwent S-Echo and C-Echo after intravenous injection of contrast agent. Methods were compared using Bland-Altman and Passing-Bablok regression. Interoperator and intra-operator reproducibility, repeatability, and reliability were quantified using intraclass correlation coefficients, repeatability coefficients, and coefficients of variation. Standard echocardiography and C-Echo differed significantly for all segments with a median difference of 0.56 mm (range: -1.4 to 4.9 mm; P<0.0001). Regression showed proportional bias (slope: 1.21, confidence interval: 1.11-1.31) with minimal systematic bias (intercept: -0.26, confidence interval: -0.64 to 0.12). Intra-operator and interoperator reproducibility was excellent for both modalities (intraclass correlation coefficient: 0.90-0.94 for S-Echo; 0.86-0.99 for C-Echo), while repeatability coefficients were lower for C-Echo (0.28-0.61 mm) than for S-Echo (0.89-1.03 mm), and coefficients of variation were lower for C-Echo (intra-observer: 5.86%, inter-observer: 3.03%) than for S-Echo (7.43% and 7.64%). Accuracy of S-Echo and C-Echo compared with a reference standard was not assessed. Contrast-enhanced echocardiography is feasible and provides excellent left ventricular wall visualization with lower LVWT measurements and superior repeatability, reproducibility, and reliability.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이에서 조영제 강화 심초음파(C-Echo)는 표준 심초음파(S-Echo)보다 좌심실벽 두께 측정 시 재현성, 반복성, 신뢰도가 우수하며 더 명확한 좌심실벽 시각화를 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 50마리 클라이언트 소유 고양이를 대상으로 전향적 연구 수행. S-Echo와 C-Echo 측정값 비교 결과 모든 부위에서 유의한 차이(중앙값 0.56 mm, 범위: -1.4~4.9 mm; P<0.0001). C-Echo의 반복성 계수(0.28-0.61 mm)가 S-Echo(0.89-1.03 mm)보다 낮고, 변동 계수도 C-Echo(관찰자내 5.86%, 관찰자간 3.03%)가 S-Echo(7.43%, 7.64%)보다 낮음. 두 방법 모두 관찰자내 및 관찰자간 재현성 우수(급내상관계수: S-Echo 0.90-0.94, C-Echo 0.86-0.99).
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 좌심실벽 두께 측정의 정확도 향상이 필요한 경우 조영제 강화 심초음파 사용을 고려할 수 있다. 그러나 기준 표준과의 정확도 비교가 이루어지지 않았으며, 단일기관 전향적 연구로서 임상 적용 전 추가 검증 필요.

papers.title: Short-term changes in photographed dental calculus coverage and pooled supragingival microbiota after baked dental treats containing a pomegranate-propolis blend or sodium hexametaphosphate in dogs.
papers.authors: Baptista LSM, Santos MKR, Soratto TAT, Wagner G, Hauptli L
papers.abstract: To compare short-term changes in the photographed percentage of visible tooth surface covered by pre-existing dental calculus among dogs receiving additive-free baked treats, sodium hexametaphosphate-containing treats or pomegranate-propolis-containing treats, and to describe pooled supragingival bacterial profiles before and after the intervention. A fixed-side brushing procedure was additionally explored from day 9 onward. Twelve adult dogs (four per group) were enrolled in a 19-day exploratory pilot study and randomly allocated to one of three treatment groups: additive-free baked dental treats, baked dental treats containing 0.6% sodium hexametaphosphate or baked dental treats containing a 0.6% pomegranate-propolis blend. Dogs received two treats daily throughout the study. A fixed-side tooth-brushing protocol was applied from day 9 onwards, with the right dental arch brushed daily and the left arch left unbrushed for within-dog comparison. Photographed dental calculus coverage was assessed at predefined time points using standardised image analysis. Pooled supragingival bacterial profiles were descriptively characterised at baseline and day 19 by 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Photographed dental calculus coverage declined in all treatment groups over the 19-day study. The largest mean descriptive reduction was observed in dogs receiving baked dental treats containing the pomegranate-propolis blend, followed by sodium hexametaphosphate and additive-free baked dental treats. A greater descriptive reduction in photographed dental calculus coverage was observed on the brushed right dental arch after day 9. Exploratory analysis of pooled supragingival bacterial profiles showed descriptive differences in the relative abundance of bacterial taxa between baseline and day 19. In this 19-day exploratory study, photographed dental calculus coverage declined in dogs receiving all three baked-treat formulations.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 19일간 하루 2회 급여한 베이킹된 치료용 간식 모두에서 시각적 치석 감소가 관찰되었으며, 석류-프로폴리스 혼합물 함유 간식이 가장 큰 감소를 보였고, 그 다음 헥사메타인산나트륨, 첨가제 미함유 간식 순이었다.
[방법·수치] 성견 12마리(군당 4마리)를 3개 군(첨가제 미함유, 0.6% 헥사메타인산나트륨, 0.6% 석류-프로폴리스 혼합물 함유)으로 무작위 배치하여 19일간 진행한 조사적 파일럿 연구; 9일부터 우측 치아궁만 일일 칫솔질하고 좌측은 무처치 대조로 사용; 16S rRNA 유전자 염기서열분석으로 기저선과 19일차 세균 프로파일 분석; 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 석류-프로폴리스 함유 간식이 개의 치석 제거에 유망한 선택지로 보이나, 군당 4마리의 소규모 표본, 베이킹 간식만을 사용한 무처치 대조군 부재, 풀링된 마이크로바이옴 샘플로 생물학적 복제가 없다는 제한점이 있으므로 치과 전문가치료 후 더 큰 규모의 무작위 대조군 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Sodium Administration and the Contribution of Fluid Creep to the Sodium Burden of Hospitalized Dogs in the ICU.
papers.authors: McNally AE, Llewellyn E
papers.abstract: To assess the fluid volume and quantity of sodium administered each day to a population of hospitalized dogs and evaluate the major sources of administered fluid volume and sodium. Prospective, observational study. University teaching hospital. Twenty-nine dogs expected to require ICU hospitalization for at least 24 h. All sources, types, and volumes of fluid administered were recorded. The volume and sodium content of each fluid source administered daily were calculated. Fluid creep was defined as fluid given as drugs, diluents, and intravenous flush. The mean (SD) daily fluid volume (mL/kg/day) and mean (SD) sodium administered (mEq/kg/day) for all dogs were 64.6 (±36.9) mL/kg/day and 8 (±4.6) mEq/kg/day (Day 1), 48.6 (±36.3) mL/kg/day and 6.2 (±4.5) mEq/kg/day (Day 2), and 43.1 (±32.1) mL/kg/day and 5.7 (± 4.2) mEq/kg/day (Day 3), respectively. Total fluid volume and sodium administration significantly decreased during hospitalization (p = 0.002 and p = 0.002, respectively). Fluid creep accounted for a median volume of 5.6, 4.6, and 2.7 mL/kg/day, and a median sodium content of 0.35, 0.28, and 0.22 mEq/kg/day on Days 1, 2, and 3, respectively. Daily total fluid creep volume decreased during hospitalization (p = 0.016), while daily fluid creep sodium content did not change (p = 0.06). There was no difference in proportional contribution of fluid creep to volume or sodium burden from Day 1 to 3 (p = 0.8, p = 0.6). Critically ill dogs have a clinically important sodium burden during hospitalization. Fluid creep accounts for a small but constant source of sodium administration despite significantly reduced fluid volumes over the course of hospitalization.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 중환자실 입원 개에서 하루 평균 8 mEq/kg의 나트륨이 투여되며, 약물·희석액·정맥주입선 세척 등의 '유체 누출(fluid creep)'이 작지만 지속적인 나트륨 공급원으로 작용한다.
[방법·수치] 개 29마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 관찰 연구로 모든 수액 투여 경로를 기록했다. 1일차 64.6 mL/kg/day, 2일차 48.6 mL/kg/day, 3일차 43.1 mL/kg/day 투여되었으며(p=0.002), 나트륨은 각각 8, 6.2, 5.7 mEq/kg/day였다(p=0.002). 유체 누출은 1일차 5.6 mL/kg/day(0.35 mEq/kg/day)에서 3일차 2.7 mL/kg/day(0.22 mEq/kg/day)로 감소했다(p=0.016).
[임상 적용·한계] ICU 입원 개의 나트륨 과부하 위험을 인식하고 약물·희석액·세척액 등 간과하기 쉬운 나트륨 공급원을 모니터링할 필요가 있다. 단일 대학 동물병원의 소규모 전향적 연구이며, 장기 임상 결과와의 연관성은 미확인이다.

papers.title: Comparison of Outcomes Between Men and Women Treated With Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Oral Anticoagulation After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: An OPTION Subanalysis.
papers.authors: Mdaihly M, Phillips KP, Tabaja C, Nair D, Saliba WI
papers.abstract: Women sex is an established, nonmodifiable risk factor for adverse outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) has been proposed as an alternative to oral anticoagulation (OAC) for stroke prevention in patients with AF; however, there are limited data on sex-based outcomes of LAAC following catheter ablation. This study sought to compare outcomes of LAAC vs OAC after AF ablation in men and women. Patients with AF and CHA2DS2-VASc ≥2 in men and ≥3 in women were randomized 1:1 to either ablation + LAAC or ablation + OAC. The primary safety endpoint was nonprocedural major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding at 36 months. The primary efficacy endpoint was a composite of all-cause death, stroke, or systemic embolism at 36 months. The study included 1,053 men and 546 women. LAAC and OAC demonstrated comparable primary efficacy events in men (HR: 0.96; 95% CI: 0.56-1.65; P = 0.88) and women (HR: 0.81; 95% CI: 0.41-1.62; P = 0.55), with no treatment-by-sex interaction (P interaction = 0.71). Procedural complication rates were similar at 2.3% in men and 3.7% in women with only 1 pericardial effusion in each group, not related to the index LAAC procedure. At 36 months, the primary safety endpoint was significantly lower in the device group among men (HR: 0.34; 95% CI: 0.23-0.50; P < 0.0001). In women, a similar but nonsignificant trend was observed (HR: 0.68; 95% CI: 0.42-1.09; P = 0.11), with a significant treatment-by-sex interaction (P interaction = 0.02). No significant difference was seen in the secondary safety endpoint across both treatment arms for either sex. In this prespecified analysis of the OPTION (Comparison of Anticoagulation With Left Atrial Appendage Closure After AF Ablation [OPTION]) trial, stroke, systemic embolism, and mortality outcomes were not significantly different between LAAC and OAC following AF ablation in either men or women.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 심방세동 절제술 후 좌심방귀 폐쇄(LAAC)와 경구항응고제(OAC)는 남성과 여성 모두에서 뇌졸중, 색전증, 사망률에서 유의한 차이가 없었으나, 출혈 감소 효과는 남성에서 더 뚜렷했다.
[방법·수치] OPTION 시험의 사전 계획된 하위분석으로 1,053명의 남성과 546명의 여성을 대상으로 절제술+LAAC 또는 절제술+OAC에 1:1로 무작위 배정하였다. 36개월 추적 결과, 주요 효능 평가 지표는 남성(HR 0.96, 95% CI 0.56-1.65, P=0.88)과 여성(HR 0.81, 95% CI 0.41-1.62, P=0.55)에서 비슷했고, 주요 안전성 평가 지표(출혈)는 남성에서 LAAC 군이 의미있게 낮았으나(HR 0.34, 95% CI 0.23-0.50, P<0.0001) 여성에서는 비유의성 경향(HR 0.68, 95% CI 0.42-1.09, P=0.11)을 보였다. 성별 치료 상호작용은 유의했다(P=0.02).
[임상 적용·한계] 심방세동 절제술 후 고위험군 환자의 뇌졸중 예방 전략 선택 시 성별을 고려해야 하며, 특히 남성에서 LAAC의 출혈 감소 이점이 더 크다. 단일 임상시험의 사후분석이고 여성 환자 수가 남성보다 적은 한계가 있다.

papers.title: The canine tumour micro-environment and advances in antitumour therapy in canine melanoma.
papers.authors: Hindriks E, Zandvliet MMJM, Sijts AJAM, Broere F
papers.abstract: Cancer poses a substantial health burden in both humans and dogs. Despite significant advances, durable tumour control is often not achieved, highlighting the need for novel targeted therapies and immunotherapies. However, translation of these approaches into human and veterinary oncology has been slow. Comparative oncology offers a valuable translational strategy, as naturally occurring cancers in dogs share significant clinical, molecular, and genetic similarities with human malignancies. This review provides an overview of the canine tumour microenvironment (TME), with a primary focus on melanoma as an aggressive and immunogenic tumour model. Key immune components, including T cells, B cells, natural killer cells, tumour-associated macrophages, and myeloid-derived suppressor cells, are discussed in the context of tumour progression and immune evasion. Furthermore, current advances in immunotherapeutic strategies, such as immune checkpoint inhibitors and therapeutic cancer vaccines, as well as receptor tyrosine kinase-targeted therapies, are evaluated in canine cancers. While these approaches have shown promise, challenges such as tumour heterogeneity, immunosuppressive TMEs, and therapeutic resistance are difficult to overcome, resulting in limited clinical efficacy. Integrating insights from human and veterinary oncology underscores the potential of comparative approaches to improve translational success and develop more effective combination therapies for both species.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 흑색종은 인간 악성종양과 임상적·분자생물학적·유전적 유사성을 공유하는 공격적이고 면역원성이 높은 종양으로, 비교종양학을 통한 면역항암치료 및 표적치료 개발의 가치있는 모델을 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 개의 종양 미세환경(TME) 및 흑색종에서 T세포, B세포, NK세포, 종양연관대식세포, 골수유래억제세포 등 주요 면역구성요소와 면역 회피 메커니즘을 검토하고, 면역관문억제제, 치료용 암백신, 수용체 티로신키나아제 표적치료 등 현재 진행 중인 면역치료 전략을 평가했다(수치 제시 없음).
[임상 적용·한계] 비교종양학적 접근을 통해 인간과 수의학 종양학의 통합은 번역적 성공을 개선하고 양 종에서 더 효과적인 병합치료 개발을 가능하게 할 수 있으나, 종양 이질성, 면역억제 TME, 치료 저항성 등의 과제로 인해 현재 임상 효능이 제한적이다.

papers.title: Procedural sedation with subcutaneously administered medetomidine-vatinoxan-butorphanol in dogs - A randomized, controlled, clinical dose-finding study.
papers.authors: Honkavaara J, Lindh E, Turunen H, Mäki T, Välimäki E
papers.abstract: Subcutaneous (SC) drug administration may be better tolerated when compared with the intramuscular (IM) route in some dogs. This study investigated the dose-response to subcutaneously administered medetomidine-vatinoxan-butorphanol in producing sedation for orthopedic radiography. Fifty-three privately-owned, healthy dogs were randomly allocated to receive IM medetomidine 0.6 mg/m2 (M0.6-IM), IM medetomidine/vatinoxan 0.6/12 mg/m2 (Z0.6-IM), SC medetomidine/vatinoxan 0.6/12 (Z0.6-SC), 0.9/18 (Z0.9-SC) or 1.2/24 mg/m2 (Z1.2-SC). All treatments included 0.2 mg/kg of butorphanol. Sedation onset and rescue sedation for radiography were recorded. Mean arterial pressures (MAP) and heart rates (HR) were measured and oral mucosal microcirculation quantified with Laser Doppler Flow (LDF) and tissue hemoglobin saturation percentage (T-HbO2). Compared with the SC groups, sedation occurred earlier after both IM treatments. Rescue sedation was administered for 4/11 (Z0.6-SC), 2/10 (Z0.9-SC), 1/10 (Z1.2-SC), 0/11 (Z0.6-IM) and 1/11 dogs (M0.6-IM), respectively. HR decreased significantly from baseline after all treatments while hypotension (MAP < 60 mmHg) was not observed. After M0.6-IM, median (range) LDF 55 (36 - 113) perfusion units (PU) and T-HbO2 64 (49 - 79) % were significantly lower than after Z0.6-IM: 155 (105 - 312) PU and 81 (67 - 87) %; Z0.9-SC: 196 (126 - 492) PU and 79 (72-94) %; Z0.9-SC: 163 (68 - 465) PU and 77 (72 - 84) % and Z1.2-SC: 146 (82 - 422) PU and 77 (69 - 85) %, with no significant differences between the vatinoxan-treatments. Subcutaneously administered medetomidine-vatinoxan-butorphanol appeared efficacious albeit less potent than the IM route in producing sedation in healthy dogs. The hemodynamic improvement by vatinoxan extended to SC co-administration with medetomidine-butorphanol.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 피하 투여 메데토미딘-바티녹산-부토르파놀 조합은 건강한 개에서 진정 효과를 나타내었으나 근육주사 투여보다는 효력이 약했으며, 바티녹산의 혈역학 개선 효과는 피하 투여에서도 유지되었다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 개 53마리를 대상으로 근육주사 메데토미딘 0.6mg/m2(M0.6-IM), 근육주사 메데토미딘/바티녹산 0.6/12mg/m2(Z0.6-IM), 피하주사 0.6/12, 0.9/18, 1.2/24mg/m2 그룹(Z0.6-SC, Z0.9-SC, Z1.2-SC)에 모두 부토르파놀 0.2mg/kg을 병용 투여하였다. 근육주사 그룹에서 더 빠른 진정 발현을 보였고, 추가 진정이 필요한 개는 Z0.6-SC에서 4/11마리, Z0.9-SC에서 2/10마리, Z1.2-SC에서 1/10마리, Z0.6-IM에서 0/11마리, M0.6-IM에서 1/11마리였다. 모든 그룹에서 심박수 감소가 있었으나 저혈압(MAP<60mmHg)은 관찰되지 않았고, M0.6-IM 그룹의 레이저 도플러 혈류량(LDF) 및 조직 헤모글로빈 산소포화도(T-HbO2)가 바티녹산 함유 그룹들보다 유의하게 낮았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 피하 투여는 근육주사가 어렵거나 내약성이 문제인 개에서 정형 방사선촬영 진정의 대안이 될 수 있으나, 같은 진정 깊이를 얻으려면 더 높은 용량이 필요할 수 있다. 건강한 개 53마리만 대상으로 한 단일 연구로, 질환을 가진 개나 다른 병용 진정제에서의 효과·안전성은 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Cat Stress Score and hair cortisol concentrations are not associated with subclinical hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in cats.
papers.authors: Seo J, Williams M, Munday JS, Connolly DJ, Hunt H
papers.abstract: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a common heart disease in domestic cats, but most lack an identifiable cause. This prospective case-control study tested the hypothesis that chronic stress predisposes cats to HCM. Ten cats with echocardiographically confirmed subclinical HCM were compared with 10 healthy cats, HCM-negative cats matched for husbandry, age, sex, and neuter status. Stress was assessed via visual Cat-Stress-Score and hair cortisol concentrations, measured using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay from full-length hair samples collected from the lumbar region. Cat-Stress-Scores did not differ between groups across four time points (median 23.3 in the HCM group [range: 17.8-34.0] versus median 25.5 in the control group [range: 21.8-29.2], P = 0.241). Likewise, hair cortisol concentrations did not differ between groups (median 0.25 ng/mL [range: 0.15-0.35] in the HCM group and median 0.19 ng/mL [range: 0.09-0.29] in the control group, P = 0.267). In conclusion, cats with pre-existing subclinical HCM did not display greater stress than healthy controls on the measures of stress assessed.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 임상 전 단계의 비후성 심근병증(HCM)이 있는 고양이에서 만성 스트레스와의 연관성이 없으며, 스트레스가 HCM의 위험요인이 아님을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 초음파로 확진된 임상 전 HCM 고양이 10마리와 나이·성별·중성화 상태가 일치하는 건강한 고양이 10마리의 전향적 대조군 연구로, Cat-Stress-Score(HCM군 중앙값 23.3 대 대조군 25.5, P=0.241)와 모낭 코르티솔 농도(HCM군 중앙값 0.25 ng/mL 대 대조군 0.19 ng/mL, P=0.267)를 비교하였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 현장에서 HCM 발생 예측 시 스트레스 관리의 우선순위를 낮출 수 있으나, 소규모 표본(각 군 10마리)이고 단일 기관 연구이며 임상 전 단계만 대상으로 하였다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Assessment of bowel preparation quality in dogs undergoing colonoscopy using the Boston Bowel Preparation Scale.
papers.authors: Ruedi GL, Kook PH
papers.abstract: To evaluate the efficacy of a bowel preparation protocol consisting of at-home administration of clear broth and polyethylene glycol 3350 followed by colonic flushing immediately before colonoscopy in dogs. In this single-referral-center retrospective study, dogs with complete video documentation of the colon were included. Colonic cleanliness was assessed using the Boston Bowel Preparation Scale (BBPS), which scores the 3 colonic segments individually (total score range, 0 to 9 with higher scores indicating better preparation quality). Adequate preparation was defined as a total BBPS score ≥ 6 with no individual segment score < 2. Video footage from 49 colonoscopies performed in 47 dogs was assessed by a single examiner. Adequate colonic preparation was achieved in 41 of 49 (84%) colonoscopies. Median total BBPS score was 7 (range, 4 to 9), with median segment scores of 3, 2, and 2 for descending, transverse, and ascending colon, respectively. The ascending colon had significantly lower scores than the descending colon. In 57% of procedures, the indication for colonoscopy was evaluation of chronic enteropathy (combined upper and lower intestinal endoscopy) without specific suspicion of colonic disease. High-quality bowel preparation for colonoscopy can be achieved without complex or logistically demanding protocols. A straightforward, owner-friendly, at-home preparation regimen provided diagnostic-quality colonic visualization in dogs. These findings may facilitate broader clinical use of colonoscopy in dogs by supporting practical bowel preparation protocols that are feasible for owners and sufficient for diagnostic evaluation, particularly when complete colonic cleanliness is not essential for the intended diagnostic objective.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 대장내시경에서 간단한 장정결 프로토콜(자택에서 맑은 국물과 폴리에틸렌글리콜 3350 투여 후 시술 직전 대장 세척)로 84%의 적절한 정결 달성이 가능하며, 복잡한 프로토콜 없이도 진단 수준의 대장 가시화가 가능함을 입증했다.
[방법·수치] 단일 의뢰 센터 후향적 연구로 완전한 비디오 기록이 있는 47마리 개의 49건 대장내시경 시술을 대상으로 했다. Boston Bowel Preparation Scale(BBPS)을 사용하여 3개 대장 분절을 각각 평가(총점 0~9점, 높을수록 양호)했으며, 적절한 정결은 총점 ≥6이고 모든 분절 ≥2점으로 정의했다. 적절한 정결은 49건 중 41건(84%)에서 달성되었고, 중앙값 총 BBPS 점수는 7점(범위 4~9점), 하행결장·횡행결장·상행결장의 중앙값 분절 점수는 각각 3·2·2점이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 개의 임상 대장내시경 사용을 확대하기 위해 보유자가 실행 가능하고 진단 목표 달성에 충분한 실질적인 정결 프로토콜을 제시한다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구이며 완전한 대장 정결이 진단 목표에 필수적이지 않은 경우에 특히 유용하다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Surgical management of cricopharyngeal achalasia in dogs results in low mortality but moderate incidence of recurrence or persistent clinical signs.
papers.authors: Zhang RM, Brisson BA, Holt DE, Park B, Ham KM
papers.abstract: To describe diagnostic and surgical management of cricopharyngeal achalasia (CA) in dogs and to identify patient or management factors that may contribute to postoperative outcomes. Signalment, diagnostic imaging findings, surgical information, complications, and outcomes were retrospectively obtained. Fisher exact and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests were performed to identify predictors of unsatisfactory outcomes using sex, breed, age, videofluoroscopic swallow study findings, laterality of surgery, and muscles resected as variables. 26 dogs surgically managed for CA from 2009 through 2025 were included. The most common breeds were Poodle mixes (n = 12) and Golden Retrievers (8). Ventral bilateral surgery resulted in shorter operative times than through 2 lateral incisions. Postoperative complication and mortality rates were 23% and 11.5%, respectively. Aspiration pneumonia was the most common postoperative complication. Unsatisfactory outcomes were reported in 42.3%. Recurrence of clinical signs after initial resolution was noted in 34.6%, and revision surgery was performed in 26.9%. Median time to recurrence was 84 days (range, 7 to 1,320 days). No significant association was identified for age, sex, breed, laterality, videofluoroscopic swallow study findings, or muscles resected. Surgical management of CA resulted in low mortality, moderate incidence of recurrence and revision surgery, and residual symptoms requiring long-term conservative management. Surgery is a safe option for management of CA, but owners should be informed of the risks of recurrence and residual clinical signs that may require long-term dietary modifications. Animals with CA are at risk of aspiration pneumonia both pre- and postoperatively and should be monitored accordingly.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 윤상인두 이완불능증(CA)에 대한 수술적 관리는 낮은 사망률(11.5%)을 보이지만, 재발(34.6%)과 지속적인 임상증상(42.3%)의 중등도 발생률을 나타낸다.
[방법·수치] 2009~2025년 CA로 외과 치료받은 개 26마리의 후향적 분석으로, Poodle mixes(n=12)와 Golden Retrievers(n=8)가 가장 흔했다. 복부 양측 수술이 측면 절개 수술(2회)보다 짧은 수술시간을 나타냈고, 술후 합병증률 23%, 사망률 11.5%, 재발까지의 중앙값 84일(범위 7~1,320일), 재수술률 26.9%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] CA 수술은 안전한 옵션이지만 재발과 장기간의 식이 관리를 요할 수 있는 잔존 임상증상의 위험성에 대해 보호자에게 설명이 필요하며, 술전후 흡인성 폐렴 모니터링이 필수이다. 본 연구는 단일기관 후향적 연구로서 나이, 성별, 품종, 수술 방법, 근육 제거 범위와 예후 간의 유의미한 연관성을 찾지 못했다.

papers.title: Cytokine priming shifts mitochondrial architecture and extracellular vesicle cargo of feline placental mesenchymal stromal cells toward an immunosuppressive phenotype.
papers.authors: Soltero-Rivera M, Arzi B, Marycz K
papers.abstract: To characterize effects of inflammatory cytokine priming on viability, mitochondrial morphology, and extracellular vesicle (EV) cargo in feline placenta-derived mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs). Feline placenta-derived MSCs from 7 healthy cats were cultured under control, serum-deprived, or cytokine-stimulated (tumor necrosis factor-α, interferon-γ, IL-1, IL-6) conditions in vitro. Viability/apoptosis were assessed by flow cytometry and mitochondrial morphology by confocal microscopy with MicroP/MATLAB; EVs were characterized by surface markers, RNA sequencing, and microRNA (miR) profiling. Viability exceeded 96% across all conditions, with no significant intergroup differences. Kiel 67 proliferation marker and metabolic activity were significantly reduced under serum-free and cytokine-stimulated conditions versus controls (both P < .001). Cytokine priming increased branching and simple tubular mitochondria, whereas serum deprivation increased fragmented forms. Extracellular vesicle transcriptomics identified 329 differentially expressed genes, including upregulated immunosuppressive receptors C-C motif chemokine receptor 8 and poliovirus receptor-related immunoglobulin domain-containing protein and downregulated proinflammatory histone transcripts. microRNA (miR) profiling revealed 23 differentially expressed miRs, with enrichment of anti-inflammatory miR-204, let-7g, and miR-181b-2 and depletion of proinflammatory miR-34a and miR-320a. Cytokine priming induces mitochondrial elongation and shifts EV cargo toward an immunosuppressive phenotype without compromising viability, supporting inflammatory priming as a strategy to optimize MSC-based therapies for T-cell-mediated inflammatory diseases. Inflammatory priming prior to MSC administration may enhance therapeutic efficacy in cats, supporting investigation of cytokine licensing as a translatable approach to improving MSC therapy outcomes in veterinary medicine.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 염증성 사이토카인 자극은 고양이 태반 유래 중간엽 줄기세포의 세포 생존력을 유지하면서 미토콘드리아 구조를 변화시키고 세포외소포체 화물을 면역억제 표현형으로 전환시킨다.
[방법·수치] 7마리 고양이의 태반 유래 중간엽 줄기세포를 대조군, 혈청박탈, 사이토카인 자극(TNF-α, IFN-γ, IL-1, IL-6) 조건에서 배양했다. 세포생존력은 96% 이상 유지되었으며 군간 차이 없었고, Ki67 증식표지자와 대사활성은 사이토카인 자극군에서 유의하게 감소(P<0.001)했다. 사이토카인 자극은 미토콘드리아 분지형과 단순관상 형태를 증가시켰고, 세포외소포체 전사체에서 329개 차별발현유전자를 확인했으며 23개 차별발현 miRNA를 검출했다(항염증 miR-204, let-7g, miR-181b-2 증가; 염증 miR-34a, miR-320a 감소).
[임상 적용·한계] 염증성 사이토카인 사전자극을 통해 중간엽 줄기세포의 치료효능을 최적화하여 T세포 매개 염증질환 치료에 응용할 수 있으며, 고양이 임상에서의 효과 검증이 필요하다. 단일 세포원(태반), 소규모 샘플(7마리), 시험관 연구라는 한계가 있고 추후 임상 전환 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: MRI findings in cauda equina nerve roots and associated clinical signs in dogs with degenerative lumbosacral stenosis.
papers.authors: Siauciunaite A, Alder D, Richter H, Steffen F
papers.abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is the most commonly used advanced imaging modality for diagnosing degenerative lumbosacral stenosis (DLSS). However, stenosis of the central canal and intervertebral foramina does not reliably correlate with clinical signs, and additional diagnostic imaging criteria would strengthen the validity of MRI. This study aimed to evaluate the size, signal characteristics, position (nerve root sedimentation sign, NRSS), and course (redundant nerve roots, RNR) of cauda equina nerve roots in dogs with and without DLSS using high-field MRI, and to assess associations between these findings and clinical signs. A retrospective, blinded, case-control study was performed in client-owned dogs, including 50 dogs diagnosed with DLSS and 17 control dogs without clinical signs of DLSS. Lumbosacral foraminal stenosis was identified in 33/50 (66%) DLSS cases and 1/17 (5.88%) controls (p < 0.001, φ = 0.56). Lumbar nerve root pathology was observed in 30/50 (60%) cases and 2/17 (11.77%) controls (p < 0.001, φ = 0.42). A significant association was found between unilateral clinical signs and ipsilateral foraminal stenosis (p = 0.014, φ = 0.40 for the left; p = 0.018, φ = 0.43 for the right side). Ipsilateral thickening of the L7 nerve root was also significantly associated with unilateral nerve root dysfunction (p = 0.033, φ = 0.35 for the left; p = 0.01, φ = 0.45 for the right side). The NRSS findings did not differ significantly between case and control dogs (p = 0.237, φ = 0.15), whereas RNR showed a small to moderate association with DLSS (p < 0.028, φ = 0.27). While NRSS and RNR were not clearly associated with clinical signs in dogs with DLSS, thickening of the L7 nerve root showed significant correlation with clinical dysfunction. The presence of increased nerve root size may enhance the diagnostic utility of high-field MRI in dogs with DLSS.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 퇴행성 요천추관협착증(DLSS)에서 MRI상 L7 신경근의 비후가 일측성 신경근 기능부전과 유의미한 상관관계를 보이며, 신경근 크기 증가가 고자장 MRI의 진단 유용성을 높일 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 후향적 맹검 증례-대조군 연구로 DLSS 진단 개 50마리, 대조군 17마리를 고자장 MRI로 검사했다. 요천추공 협착은 DLSS군 66% vs 대조군 5.88%(p<0.001, φ=0.56), 요추 신경근 병변은 60% vs 11.77%(p<0.001, φ=0.42)에서 관찰되었고, 일측성 임상징후와 동측 공협착의 연관성은 유의미했다(p=0.014~0.018, φ=0.40~0.43).
[임상 적용·한계] 신경근 비후는 일측성 신경근 기능부전 평가에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 신경근 침강 징후(NRSS)와 중복 신경근(RNR)은 임상징후와 명확한 연관성이 없어 추가 연구가 필요하다. 단일 기관 후향적 연구로 대표성 제한.

papers.title: Complete blood count interpretation in dogs and cats and its analytical compatibility with Vis-NIR point-of-care hematology: A systematic literature review with narrative synthesis.
papers.authors: Bisiaux T, da Costa JM, Martins RC, Barroso TG
papers.abstract: This systematic literature review with narrative synthesis assessed the diagnostic contribution of complete blood count (CBC) interpretation in dogs and cats combined only with anamnesis and physical examination, without biochemistry or imaging, and the compatibility of the CBC variables and CBC-derived indices identified with emerging point-of-care (POC) hematology platforms using visible-short-wave-near-infrared (Vis-NIR) spectroscopy and self-learning artificial intelligence (SLAI). Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, studies published from 2015 to January 2026 were identified and integrated into tables associating hematological patterns, CBC-derived indices, clinical presentation, and differential diagnoses. The technology component was appraised separately for analytical compatibility, not as an independent systematic review. Recurrent signatures included inflammatory leukograms, regenerative and non-regenerative anemia, stress leukograms, leukopenic syndromes, and thrombocytopenic disorders. Conventional CBC findings and CBC-derived indices (neutrophil-to-lymphocyte, monocyte-to-lymphocyte, platelet-to-neutrophil and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratios, and the systemic immune-inflammation index) were investigated across infectious, inflammatory, neoplastic, endocrine, cardiovascular, and immune-mediated diseases. However, this evidence is concentrated on pyometra, parvovirosis, pancreatitis, parasitism, cardiopathies and endocrinopathies, derives predominantly from small studies in dogs; these indices remain non-specific markers of systemic inflammatory burden. For POC technology, proof-of-concept studies report agreement with reference analyzers for erythrocyte parameters and total leukocyte counts, but not for the differential and platelet counts several of these indices require. Analytical compatibility is therefore supported for selected CBC parameters, but not clinical validity for CBC-derived indices or disease diagnosis.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 CBC 해석은 염증성 백혈구증, 재생성/비재생성 빈혈, 스트레스 백혈구증, 백혈구감소증, 혈소판감소증 등의 패턴을 식별할 수 있으나, CBC 유래 지표(호중구-림프구 비, 단핵구-림프구 비, 혈소판-호중구 비, 혈소판-림프구 비, 전신 면역-염증 지수)는 감염, 염증, 종양, 내분비, 심혈관, 면역매개질환에서 비특이적 전신염증 지표로 남아있다. [방법·수치] 2015년부터 2026년 1월까지 발표된 논문을 PRISMA 2020 지침에 따라 체계적 문헌고찰로 검토했으며, 대부분의 근거는 소규모 개 연구에 집중되어 있고 화농성자궁염, 파보바이러스감염, 췌장염, 기생충감염, 심질환, 내분비질환에 치우쳐 있다. POC 기술의 분석적 호환성은 적혈구 매개변수와 총 백혈구수에서는 기준분석기와의 일치를 보이나, 감별계산 및 혈소판수에서는 불일치를 보인다. [임상 적용·한계] POC CBC 기술은 선별된 CBC 매개변수에 대해 분석적 호환성을 지원하지만, CBC 유래 지표의 임상 타당성과 질병 진단 목적의 임상 타당성은 입증되지 않았으며, 취약 환자와 만성·완화치료 환자에서의 임상적 효용성 증명은 추가 임상 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Clinically relevant hypomagnesemia during recovery from severe leptospirosis-associated acute kidney injury in a dog treated with continuous renal replacement therapy: a case report.
papers.authors: Cho J, Kang S, Kim S, Kim M, Park C
papers.abstract: Leptospirosis is an important cause of acute kidney injury (AKI) in dogs and commonly induces renal tubular dysfunction. Although electrolyte abnormalities are frequently recognized during the course of leptospirosis, clinically relevant hypomagnesemia associated with neurological manifestations has rarely been reported in dogs. This report describes a dog that developed severe symptomatic hypomagnesemia during recovery from severe leptospirosis-associated AKI treated with continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT). A 9 year old, 12 kg spayed female mixed-breed dog was referred for severe leptospirosis-associated AKI complicated by anuria, hyperbilirubinemia, thrombocytopenia, and pulmonary involvement. Blood and urine polymerase chain reaction assays confirmed Leptospira spp. Because of persistent anuria and progressive azotemia despite intensive medical management, the dog underwent two continuous renal replacement therapy sessions approximately 15 and 18 h, respectively. Urine production subsequently recovered, and the dog entered a polyuric recovery phase with progressive improvement in azotemia. On day 13 after admission, generalized tremors, hypersalivation, and altered mentation developed concurrently with severe hypomagnesemia (ionized magnesium, 0.24 mmol/L; total magnesium, 1.4 mg/dL). Fractional excretion of magnesium (FEMG) was markedly increased (38.8%), suggesting inappropriate renal magnesium loss despite improving renal function. Intravenous magnesium sulfate administered as a bolus followed by continuous rate infusion resulted in rapid resolution of the neurological signs. At follow-up evaluations performed 11 and 23 days after the hypomagnesemic episode, fractional excretion of magnesium remained increased at 30.2% and 28.4%, respectively, despite improvement in serum creatinine concentration, supporting persistent impairment of renal tubular magnesium handling during recovery.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 렙토스피라증으로 인한 급성신부전에서 지속적신대체요법 치료 후 회복기에 임상적으로 유의한 저마그네슘혈증이 발생할 수 있으며, 이는 신기능이 개선되었음에도 불구하고 신세뇨관의 마그네슘 재흡수 기능 손상으로 인해 나타난다.
[방법·수치] 9세 12kg 중성화 암컷 잡종견에서 렙토스피라증 확진(혈액 및 뇨 PCR 양성)으로 인한 무뇨성 급성신부전을 지속적신대체요법으로 치료한 증례보고. 입원 13일째 이온화 마그네슘 0.24 mmol/L, 총 마그네슘 1.4 mg/dL로 저하되었으며 마그네슘분획배설량(FEMG)은 38.8%로 현저히 증가. 추적검사에서 혈청 크레아티닌 개선 후에도 FEMG는 30.2~28.4%로 지속 증가.
[임상 적용·한계] 렙토스피라증 환자가 회복기에 신경학적 증상(진전, 과다유연, 의식변화)을 보일 때 저마그네슘혈증을 감별해야 하며, 황산마그네슘 정맥주입으로 증상이 급속 호전된다. 단일 증례보고로서 광범위 임상 적용에는 제한이 있으나, 렙토스피라증 환자의 마그네슘 농도 및 마그네슘분획배설량 모니터링의 중요성을 시사한다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Evaluation of Left Atrial Reservoir Strain by Two-Dimensional Speckle-Tracking Echocardiography in Cats with Stage B1 Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
papers.authors: Algan D, Varlik T, Bach MBT, Gleerup CH, Yilmaz Z
papers.abstract: Left atrial reservoir strain (LA S_R), assessed by two-dimensional speckle-tracking echocardiography (2D-STE), reflects left atrial (LA) function and may reveal subtle alterations in LA mechanics in cats with American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM) stage B1 hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) compared with healthy cats. This study aimed to determine whether LA S_R differs between cats with HCM (stage B1) and healthy cats using 2D-STE. Sixty-one client-owned cats were retrospectively identified and included from medical databases. These cats were classified as healthy controls (Stage A; n=30) or preclinical HCM (Stage B1; n=31) according to ACVIM consensus guidelines. All cats underwent a comprehensive conventional echocardiographic examination, including two-dimensional, M-mode, color Doppler, pulsed-wave Doppler, and tissue Doppler imaging, as part of clinical care or screening protocols. Conventional two-dimensional assessment of LA size and function included the LA/Ao ratio, LA diameter, LA area, LA fractional shortening (LA FS), and LA ejection fraction (LA EF). LA S_R was subsequently measured offline using automated function imaging software. Reproducibility was assessed via intra- and inter-observer intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC). Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was performed to compare the discriminatory performance of LA S_R and the evaluated LA variables between the predefined study groups. Cats with ACVIM stage B1 HCM had significantly lower LA S_R than healthy controls (19.0% [IQR, 14.5-22.0%] vs 38.0% [IQR, 30.25-42.50%], respectively; P < 0.001). LA S_R reproducibility was high with an intra-observer ICC of 0.974 and an inter-observer ICC of 0.894. Assessment of LA S_R was feasible in cats with stage B1 HCM. LA S_R values differed between affected cats and healthy controls, with lower values observed in the affected group and good reproducibility.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] ACVIM stage B1 비후성심근병증(HCM) 고양이에서 좌심방 저수지 변형률(LA S_R)이 건강한 고양이보다 유의하게 낮으며(19.0% vs 38.0%, P<0.001), 이는 임상적으로 나타나지 않는 단계에서도 좌심방 기능의 미묘한 변화를 감지할 수 있음을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 후향적 연구로 건강한 고양이 30마리(Stage A)와 전임상 HCM 고양이 31마리(Stage B1)를 2D-STE로 평가했다. LA S_R 재현성은 높은 수준으로 관찰자 내 ICC 0.974, 관찰자 간 ICC 0.894를 보였다.
[임상 적용·한계] LA S_R은 stage B1 HCM 고양이에서 좌심방 기능에 대한 보완적 정보를 제공할 수 있어 조기 질환 감지에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 단일기관 후향적 소규모 연구이고 임상 예후와의 연관성은 미확인이다.

papers.title: Comparison of an Anti-α(v)β(3) Integrin NIR Fluorescent Probe and Indocyanin Green for Precision Resection of Naturally Occurring Sarcomas in Dogs-A Randomized Blinded Case-Controlled Pilot Study.
papers.authors: Nolff MC, Grest P, Seehusen F, Beer P
papers.abstract: The infiltrative growth of sarcomas represents a challenge for complete resection, as tumour borders are not easily detectable. Fluorescence guided surgery (FGS) allows improved visualization of tumour margins and could improve resection accuracy. Unfortunately, studies validating the impact of FGS are rare, and direct comparisons of different dyes are not available. Dogs (n = 20) that were presented for sarcoma resection were prospectively enrolled and randomized to either receive indocyanine green (ICG, Group 1) or a targeted anti-αvβ3 integrin probe (Group 2) prior to surgery. FGS was performed in both groups with the surgeon blinded to treatment. The false positive and false negative rates as well as tumour-to-background ratio (TBR) were calculated for each dye. Correlation of fluorescent area and histologically confirmed tumour extension was determined using the Dice Coefficient (DC). The clinical impact of FGS was determined by assessing the rate of rightfully adapted resections. False positive signal was detected in 9/10 dogs in group 1 and 3/10 dogs in group 2. Mean TBR at skin level was higher in group 2 (4.5 and 5.3) compared to group 1, and this difference reached significance in formalin-fixed tissue (5.3 vs. 2.6, p = 0.016). Correlation of fluorescent signal and histologic tumour extent was strong for both dyes (DC group 1 = 0.64; group 2 = 0.78). Resection of additional neoplastic tissue based on FGS was more frequent in group 2 (3/10 dogs) compared to group 1 (1/10 dogs). The initial results of this study indicate that the targeted anti-αvβ3 integrin probe is more tumour selective than ICG in dogs. This pilot as well as the subsequent follow up study are registered at animalstudyregistry.org https://doi.org/10.17590/asr.0000321.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 항-α(v)β(3) 인테그린 NIR 형광 프로브가 ICG(인도시아닌 그린)보다 개의 육종에서 종양 선택성이 높으며, 형광 유도 수술(FGS)을 통해 종양 절제 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 육종 절제술을 받는 개 20마리를 ICG 그룹(n=10)과 항-α(v)β(3) 인테그린 프로브 그룹(n=10)에 무작위 배정한 블라인드 대조 시험이다. 거짓양성률은 ICG 90% 대 프로브 30%, 고정 조직에서의 종양-배경 비율(TBR)은 프로브가 유의하게 높았다(5.3 vs 2.6, p=0.016), 형광신호와 조직학적 종양 범위의 상관성(Dice Coefficient)은 ICG 0.64 대 프로브 0.78이다.
[임상 적용·한계] FGS 기반 추가 절제는 프로브 그룹에서 더 빈번했으며(30% vs 10%), 종양 경계 판정에서 프로브의 우월성을 시사한다. 그러나 소규모 조종 연구(n=20)이고 임상 추적 결과가 아직 부재하므로 추가 검증 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Dogs and cats undergoing surgery for penetrating thoracic trauma have high survival despite frequent complications, and imaging may underestimate injury severity.
papers.authors: Pathak N, Lozano B, Wang YW, Berns C, Ahn R
papers.abstract: To describe clinical and radiographic findings in dogs and cats with surgically confirmed penetrating thoracic trauma and evaluate associations with outcomes. This retrospective, multicenter observational study reviewed records from 5 referral hospitals to identify dogs and cats with surgically confirmed penetrating thoracic trauma between July 1, 2010, and July 31, 2025. Inclusion required thoracic radiographs, surgical reports, and perioperative records. A total of 86 dogs and 5 cats were identified. Mean animal trauma triage score was higher in nonsurvivors (7.6 ± 2.4; n = 20) than survivors (5.2 ± 2.5; 71). Radiographic findings included pneumothorax (73.6%), pulmonary contusions (65.9%), and rib fractures (62.6%). Computed tomography findings often identified more injuries. Time from presentation to surgery did not differ in survivors versus nonsurvivors. Lung lobectomy was performed in 24.2% of patients and was more common in nonsurvivors (45.0% vs 18.3%). Intra- and postoperative complications occurred in 56% and 51.7% of patients, respectively. Survival to discharge was 78.0% (71 of 91 patients), with a median hospitalization of 3.3 days (range, 1 to 12 days). Among 55 patients with follow up, 11 (20%) had complications related to thoracic trauma. Surgical management of penetrating thoracic trauma was associated with a high survival rate despite frequent complications. Animal trauma triage is a useful prognostic indicator. Computed tomography may alter treatment plans. Clinicians should anticipate higher injury severity than anticipated based on routine imaging and examination. Higher animal trauma triage scores were associated with nonsurvival and may provide useful prognostic information. Close monitoring is needed following surgery for penetrating thoracic trauma.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 관통성 흉부외상 수술 환자는 78.0%의 높은 생존율을 보였으나, 술중·술후 합병증이 각각 56%, 51.7%에서 발생했으며, 추적 관찰 시 20%에서 외상 관련 합병증이 지속되었다.
[방법·수치] 5개 응급 의료 센터의 후향적 다기관 관찰 연구로 2010년 7월~2025년 7월 사이 수술 확진된 개 86마리, 고양이 5마리를 대상했다. 생존자의 외상 중증도 점수(5.2±2.5)가 비생존자(7.6±2.4)보다 유의하게 낮았고, 흉부방사선에서 기흉(73.6%), 폐 타박상(65.9%), 갈비뼈 골절(62.6%)이 가장 흔했으며, 폐엽절제술은 비생존자에서 더 많았다(45.0% vs 18.3%).
[임상 적용·한계] CT 검사는 방사선 사진보다 더 많은 손상을 발견하여 치료 계획 변경 가능성이 높으므로, 임상의는 초기 영상검사 소견보다 심한 손상을 예상해야 한다. 외상 중증도 점수가 예후 판단의 유용한 지표이며 긴밀한 추적 관찰이 필요하나, 단일 종(고양이 5마리)에 대한 데이터 부족과 후향적 설계의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Effect of thoracic duct identification by CT lymphangiography and intraoperative contrast on surgical outcome in cats with idiopathic chylothorax.
papers.authors: Andrews C, Case JB, Burneko M, Thieman K, Williams RW
papers.abstract: To report the success of thoracic duct (TD) enhancement in cats with idiopathic chylothorax on preoperative computed tomography lymphangiography (CTLA) and intraoperative TD colorization (IOC), and to compare surgical outcomes between cats that did and did not have successful pre- and intraoperative TD enhancement. Multi-institutional retrospective study. A total of 24 cats undergoing preoperative CTLA, IOC and TD ligation between February 2016 and January 2025. Signalment, preoperative diagnostics, method of iohexol administration and quality of TD enhancement on CTLA, surgical procedure, success of TD enhancement via intraoperative colorization, postoperative complications, and clinical outcome were reviewed. TD enhancement on CTLA was successful in 70.8% of cats, with similar quality of enhancement appreciated with metatarsal and popliteal iohexol injection. TD colorization with indocyanine green (ICG) seen via near-infrared fluorescence (NIRF) was successful in four of five (80%) cats, while methylene blue was successful in eight of 15 (53%) cats. When both TD enhancement on CTLA and IOC occurred, clinical resolution rates were highest (77%) and significantly longer survival times were observed (p = .002), compared to when either CTLA or IOC (53%) or neither (25%) was successful. Successful enhancement of the TD via CTLA and IOC led to higher clinical resolution rates and was associated with longer survival compared to when only one or neither modality was successful. The success of TD enhancement via CTLA and IOC may have prognostic significance for cats with idiopathic chylothorax.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 특발성 흉부 삼출액증에서 술전 CT 림프관조영술과 술중 조영을 통한 흉관 동시 확인이 모두 성공했을 때 임상적 해결률 77%, 생존 기간이 유의하게 길었으며(p=.002), 술중 염료 조영 없거나 술전 CT 조영만 성공했을 때보다 예후가 우수했다.
[방법·수치] 24마리 고양이를 대상으로 한 다기관 후향적 연구(2016년 2월~2025년 1월). 술전 CTLA 성공률 70.8%, 술중 근적외선 형광 이용 ICG 염료 성공률 80%(4/5), 메틸렌 블루 성공률 53%(8/15). 흉관 동시 확인 시 임상적 해결률 77% 대 단일 방식 또는 양쪽 모두 실패 시 53%, 25% 대비.
[임상 적용·한계] 술전 CT 림프관조영술과 술중 근적외선 형광 염료 조영을 병용하면 고양이 특발성 흉부 삼출액증의 흉관 결찰술 예후 판정에 도움이 된다. 다기관 후향적 연구이고 술중 염료 조영 성공률이 방법에 따라 차이가 크며 표본 수가 제한적이다.

papers.title: Antithrombotic Therapy Management After Left Atrial Appendage Closure: Current Regimens, Evolving Evidence, and the Control Group Dilemma.
papers.authors: Raffo C, Greco A, Bujak K, Ammirabile N, Bordonaro C
papers.abstract: Percutaneous left atrial appendage closure is increasingly used for stroke prevention in patients with atrial fibrillation, particularly when long-term oral anticoagulation (OAC) is unsuitable. Although postprocedural antithrombotic therapy is necessary to prevent device-related thrombosis (DRT), it may increase bleeding and attenuate the benefit of avoiding long-term OAC. Uncertainty over the optimal antithrombotic strategy persists, with available randomized trials being small and heterogeneous. Direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) monotherapy and dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) are 2 common early strategies. In ANDES, DRT was numerically less frequent with DOAC than with DAPT (1.5% vs 4.1%). In ADALA, low-dose apixaban was associated with greater net benefit than DAPT (HR: 0.19; P = 0.02), although enrollment was prematurely stopped. A meta-analysis of randomized trials found significantly lower DRT with DOAC than with DAPT (risk ratio: 0.17). Current guidelines endorse regimens largely based on device-specific trial protocols or low-certainty evidence. During the initial postimplantation period, antithrombotic therapy should primarily aim to support device healing and prevent DRT, with treatment intensity tailored according to risk profile, concomitant indications, patient preferences, and the feasibility of imaging follow-up. Reassessment at 45 to 90 days should guide de-escalation once adequate device healing has been confirmed, with no fixed treatment stop date. In the absence of device-related complications, long-term OAC or DAPT should be continued only for concomitant indications, whereas continuation of single antiplatelet therapy or complete withdrawal of antithrombotic therapy should be individualized according to thrombotic and bleeding risk. Finally, definite or probable DRT generally warrants OAC, when feasible; in contrast, treatment decisions should not be based solely on the presence or size of a peridevice leak.
papers.summary_ko: [핵심 결론] 좌심방 귀 폐색술 후 항혈전 요법에서 직접경구항응고제(DOAC) 단독요법이 쌍항혈소판제(DAPT)보다 장치 관련 혈전증(DRT) 예방에 더 효과적이며, 초기 치료는 장치 치유 지원을 목표로 개별화된 접근이 필요하다. [방법·수치] ANDES 시험에서 DRT 발생률은 DOAC군 1.5% vs DAPT군 4.1%였고, ADALA 시험에서 저용량 아픽사반이 DAPT 대비 더 나은 순이득을 보였다(위험비 0.19; P = 0.02). 메타분석 결과 DOAC이 DAPT 대비 DRT를 유의하게 감소시켰다(위험비 0.17). [임상 적용·한계] 초기 45-90일 후 적절한 장치 치유 확인 시 치료 강도를 단계적으로 감소하고, 추가 적응증이 없으면 항혈전제를 중단 또는 개별화하며, 확실한 또는 가능성 높은 DRT에는 경구항응고제를 고려해야 한다. 다만 사용 가능한 무작위 대조 시험이 소규모이고 이질적이며 현재 가이드라인은 낮은 확실성 근거 기반이다.

papers.title: Occupational Disparities in Cardiovascular Risk and Management in Contemporary China.
papers.authors: Zhao Z, Li M, Wang Z, Jiang T, Wang C
papers.abstract: Although occupational disparities in cardiovascular health are increasingly recognized, a comprehensive understanding of cardiovascular health across contemporary occupational contexts-particularly in rapidly transitioning economies-remains limited. This study aimed to characterize geographic and occupational patterns of cardiovascular risk, risk-factor management, and potential prevention opportunities among employed adults in contemporary China. In this nationwide cross-sectional study, we analyzed 1,421,390 employees aged 20 to 65 years who underwent health examinations at 167 centers across 24 provinces in China between 2021 and 2023. Eighteen occupations were defined based on participants' employer registration and industry affiliation, and were classified into primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors, with the tertiary sector further subclassified into modern, public, and life services. Age- and sex-standardized prevalence of coronary heart disease (CHD) and cardiometabolic risk factors was estimated, along with age- and sex-standardized rates of treatment and control for hypertension and diabetes, and treatment for hypercholesterolemia and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) control. Ten-year atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) risk was calculated using the Prediction for ASCVD Risk in China model. We then assessed changes in the proportion of individuals classified as having moderate-to-high 10-year ASCVD risk under simulated scenarios that set elevated blood pressure and total cholesterol to target levels and current smoking to noncurrent smoking and compared these reductions across occupations. The mean age of participants was 33.8 years, and 53.4% were male. Overall, the age- and sex-standardized prevalence of CHD was 1.33% (95% CI: 1.29%-1.37%) and demonstrated a pronounced north-south gradient (P < 0.001), with the highest in the North and the lowest in the South.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 중국의 직업군별로 심혈관질환 위험도와 위험인자 관리율이 현저히 다르며, 현대 서비스업종은 질병 부담은 낮으나 위험인자 관리가 부실한 반면 1차 산업과 2차 산업(에너지·수도 공급)에서 가장 높은 심혈관질환 유병률을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 중국 24개 성 167개 센터에서 2021-2023년 건강검진을 받은 20-65세 직장인 1,421,390명을 대상으로 한 횡단면 연구; 연령·성별 표준화 관상동맥질환 유병률 1.33% (95% CI: 1.29%-1.37%), 고혈압 치료율 29.5%, 조절률 20.8%, 당뇨 치료율 36.6%, 조절률 21.9%, 고콜레스테롤혈증 치료율 17.0%, LDL-C 조절률 9.5%; 35세 이상에서 중등도 이상 10년 ASCVD 위험도 23.3% (농림축산어업 30.4%, 첨단 제조 서비스업 14.7%).
[임상 적용·한계] 직업군별 맞춤형 심혈관질환 예방 전략 수립에 활용 가능하며, 특히 관리율이 낮은 현대 서비스업과 질병 부담이 높은 에너지·수도 공급 업종에 대한 집중 중재가 필요함; 단일 국가, 건강검진 수검자(건강 근로자 편향), 2021-2023년 단기간 자료의 한계가 있음.

papers.title: Pulmonary valve sinus aneurysm associated with pulmonic stenosis and patent ductus arteriosus in a dog.
papers.authors: Vázquez DMP, Rodríguez JEV, Serrano PP
papers.abstract: A three-year-old neutered female Bernese mountain dog was referred for evaluation of multiple congenital cardiac abnormalities. Transthoracic echocardiography demonstrated features consistent with type A pulmonic stenosis, including a normal pulmonary valve annulus, an increased transvalvular pressure gradient, systolic doming of thickened and fused pulmonary valve leaflets, and concentric right ventricular hypertrophy. Additionally, a focal aneurysmal dilation arising from the intermediate pulmonary valve leaflet was identified. Furthermore, a concurrent left-to-right shunting patent ductus arteriosus was detected. Computed tomography confirmed thickening of the pulmonic valve, narrowing of the sinotubular junction, and thin-walled, contrast-enhancing saccular dilation originating of the intermediate pulmonary valve sinus. These findings supported the diagnosis of a pulmonary valve sinus aneurysm associated with severe type A pulmonic stenosis and patent ductus arteriosus.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 3세 버니즈 마운틴독에서 폐동맥판 협착증, 동맥관 개존증과 연관된 폐동맥판 동(sinus) 동맥류가 진단되었으며, 이는 선천성 심장 질환의 복합 병태로 나타났다.
[방법·수치] 초음파검사에서 정상 폐동맥판 고리, 증가된 판막 압력 구배, 수축기 돔 형태의 비후된 융합 폐동맥판엽, 동심원성 우심실비후를 확인했으며, 중간 폐동맥판엽에서 발생한 국소 동맥류 팽대와 좌-우 단락의 동맥관 개존증을 발견했다. 전산화단층촬영에서 폐동맥판 비후, 동맥관 연결부 협착, 폐동맥판 동에서 기원한 얇은 벽의 대조 증강 주머니 모양 팽대를 확인했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 복합 선천성 심장 질환의 초음파 및 CT 검사를 통한 정확한 진단 사례로 임상 참고 가치가 있으나, 단일 증례 보고로 대규모 임상 데이터가 부재하며 장기 임상 경과와 치료 결과에 대한 정보가 제한적이다.

papers.title: A retrospective (2020-2025), multicenter study of myxomatous mitral valve disease in Chihuahuas from Italy, Sweden, and the United States of America.
papers.authors: Spalla I, Bjerknaes MB, Bertuccini T, Menciotti G, Showers A
papers.abstract: Chihuahuas are affected by myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD). The aim of this study was to investigate MMVD in Chihuahuas, specifically clinical and echocardiographic characteristics including probability of pulmonary hypertension (PH), disease progression, and survival. A retrospective study of privately owned Chihuahuas with an echocardiographic study compatible with MMVD from four cardiology centers across three countries (2020-2025) was conducted. Differences between signalment, centers, and American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM) stages were assessed; disease progression and survival analysis were calculated. In total, 390 Chihuahuas of both coat types, with median age of 11 years, were included. A total of 181 out of 390 dogs (46%) were classified as ACVIM stage B1, 85 of 390 (22%) as stage B2, 114 of 390 (29%) as stage C, and 10 of 390 (3%) as stage D. Females were more numerous in ACVIM stage B1 and males in combined stages C and D; however, sex did not influence survival or disease progression. Among 122 dogs for which follow-up was available (median: 488 days), 47% (57/390) progressed in stage, while 53% (65/122) remained stable. The population median survival time was 783 days; survival differed among ACVIM stages (survival for ACVIM stage B1 was 1,164 days, ACVIM stage B2: 794 days, and ACVIM stages C and D: 345 days, log-rank test P<0.001). A multivariable survival analysis identified ACVIM staging and PH probability as risk factors for all-cause mortality and left atrium-to-aorta ratio and PH probability for cardiac-related death. Study limitations included the retrospective design and uneven center contribution. Left atrial enlargement, ACVIM staging, and PH probability were prognostic factors for cardiac and non-cardiac death in Chihuahuas with MMVD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 치와와에서 점액종성 승모판막질환(MMVD)의 ACVIM 병기, 좌심방 확대, 폐고혈압 확률이 심장 관련 사망과 전체 사망의 중요한 예후 인자이며, 병기가 진행할수록 생존 시간이 단축된다.
[방법·수치] 2020-2025년 미국, 스웨덴, 이탈리아의 4개 심장학 센터에서 MMVD 진단 받은 치와와 390마리(중앙연령 11세)를 대상으로 한 후향적 다기관 연구; ACVIM B1 46%, B2 22%, C 29%, D 3%; 추적 관찰 가능한 122마리 중 47%가 병기 진행, 53%가 안정적; 전체 중앙 생존 시간 783일(B1: 1,164일, B2: 794일, C/D: 345일, P<0.001).
[임상 적용·한계] ACVIM 병기와 폐고혈압 확률 평가가 치와와 MMVD 환자의 예후 판단과 치료 계획 수립에 필수적이며, 좌심방-대동맥 비율 측정도 심장 관련 사망 예측에 유용하다; 후향적 설계와 센터 간 불균등한 표본 수가 한계이다.

papers.title: Association of component measurement variability and disease severity with variability of calculated mitral regurgitant fraction in dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease.
papers.authors: McAulay G, Singleton D, Rishniw M
papers.abstract: Echocardiographic calculation of mitral regurgitant fraction (MR%) may complement variables used to assess myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD) severity. The geometric technique of calculating MR% uses four component variable measurements. Calculations using multiple measurements necessarily influence variability. The influence of disease severity on component measurements and MR% variability has not been explored. This study explored the contribution of component measurement variability and the markers of disease severity: left atrial-to-aortic ratio, R-R interval (RR) variability and heart rate on MR% variability. Echocardiographic studies from 109 dogs with MMVD were analysed. The co-efficient of variation (COV) was calculated from three measurements of each echocardiographic variable and calculated MR%. A multivariable linear regression model was devised modelling COV MR% as the outcome variable. The COV of MR% correlated negatively with MR% severity and decreased with increasing American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine stages. Component variables of MR% generally had variability <10% in all American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine stages. In a multivariable model, of the component variables, only COV aortic diameter measured between the open aortic leaflets at mid-systole in a right parasternal long-axis view showed positive correlation with MR% variability (2.17, P=0.010). However, MR% variability showed clearest association with left atrial-to-aortic ratio (-16.89, P=0.001) and variation in R-R interval (COV RR: 1.47, P=0.002, COV RR2 = -0.04, P=0.013). Modelling of retrospective data is a limitation of the present study. Variability of MR% is associated with disease severity. We propose beat-to-beat variation in component variables attributable to sinus arrhythmia is associated with variability of mitral regurgitation and echocardiographic calculation of MR% in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 심근종 승모판 질환에서 계산된 승모판 역류 분율의 변동성은 질환 심각도와 음의 상관관계를 보이며, 특히 좌심방-대동맥 비율과 R-R 간격 변동성이 주요 영향 인자이다.
[방법·수치] 심근종 승모판 질환이 있는 109마리 개의 심초음파 자료를 후향적으로 분석하였고, 각 변수의 변동계수(COV)를 3회 측정값으로부터 계산하였다. 다변량 선형 회귀 분석에서 대동맥 직경의 COV만 MR% 변동성과 양의 상관(2.17, P=0.010)을 보였으나, 좌심방-대동맥 비율(계수 -16.89, P=0.001)과 R-R 간격 변동(COV RR: 1.47, P=0.002)이 더 강한 연관성을 나타냈다.
[임상 적용·한계] 승모판 역류 분율 계산 시 질환 단계별로 측정 변동성을 고려한 해석이 필요하며, 동맥류에 의한 박동간 변동이 측정값 신뢰도에 영향을 미칠 수 있다. 본 연구는 후향적 단일기관 자료 분석으로 추가 전향적 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Cor triatriatum sinister resembling Lucas type C1a in a cat.
papers.authors: Kim BJ, Song KH
papers.abstract: A six-year-old neutered male cat was presented for acute respiratory distress. Transthoracic echocardiography identified a left atrial membrane consistent with cor triatriatum sinister (CTS) and turbulent flow across a single fenestration. Additionally, it was suspected that the distal chamber may receive at least one pulmonary vein. Because respiratory signs improved with corticosteroids but not with a short diuretic trial, and because echocardiography suggested that the distal chamber might receive at least one pulmonary vein, cardiac computed tomography angiography was performed to further characterize the pulmonary venous anatomy and to differentiate CTS from pulmonary vein stenosis and other congenital vascular malformations. Cardiac computed tomography angiography confirmed left atrial subdivision with one interchamber orifice (5.33 mm) and demonstrated a pulmonary venous connection pattern in which three pulmonary veins connected to the proximal chamber, whereas the left cranial pulmonary vein connected to the distal chamber, which was continuous with the mitral valve. Adapting the human Lucas classification scheme, the anatomic configuration most closely resembled Lucas type C1a, and no congestive heart failure attributable to CTS was identified.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 6세 고양이의 급성 호흡곤란은 좌심방 격막(cor triatriatum sinister, CTS)으로 인한 것으로, 심장 CT 혈관조영을 통해 Lucas 분류 C1a형으로 확진되었으나 울혈성 심부전은 동반되지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 6세 중성화 수컷 고양이 1마리에서 경흉부 심초음파와 심장 CT 혈관조영을 시행했다. 심초음파에서 단일 개공(fenestration)을 가진 좌심방 격막 확인, 심장 CT에서 격막 사이 개공 크기 5.33 mm, 3개 폐정맥은 근위실에, 좌두정 폐정맥은 원위실에 연결된 해부학적 구조 확인.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 CTS의 진단에 있어 경흉부 심초음파만으로 폐정맥 해부학을 정확히 파악하기 어려우므로 심장 CT 혈관조영의 추가 검사가 유용하며, 호흡곤란 증상 개선 반응의 불일치(코르티코스테로이드에만 반응)가 진단의 단서가 될 수 있다. 단일 증례 보고로 고양이 CTS의 장기 예후 및 치료 전략에 대한 근거는 제한적이다.

papers.title: A novel method for evaluating thoracic radiographs in dogs with pulmonary stenosis.
papers.authors: Ishizaka M, Nagura A, Ogawa-Yasumura M, Hsu HH, Miyagawa Y
papers.abstract: Pulmonary stenosis (PS) is a common congenital heart disease in dogs, often associated with poststenotic dilation of the pulmonary trunk or main pulmonary artery (MPA). We hypothesized that vertebrae-based radiographic measurement of the MPA might identify dogs with PS and potentially assess its severity. A retrospective cohort study of 29 dogs with PS, 30 normal dogs, and 30 dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease was conducted. Vertebral main pulmonary artery size (VMPS) was measured using dorsoventral (vertebral main pulmonary artery size measured using the dorsoventral radiograph [VMPS-DV] type 1, type 2) and right lateral (vertebral main pulmonary artery size measured using the right lateral radiograph [VMPS-LATE]) thoracic radiographs. Group differences were analyzed using the Kruskal-Wallis test. Correlation between VMPS and maximal instantaneous pressure gradient (continuous wave Doppler) was assessed using Spearman's correlation. Diagnostic performance was evaluated using receiver-operator characteristic analysis with Youden's index. Vertebral main pulmonary artery size measured using the dorsoventral radiograph type 1 and VMPS-LATE were significantly greater in the PS group than in the normal group (P<0.001) but not significantly different from the myxomatous mitral valve disease group. After excluding French bulldogs, these indices remained significantly elevated. A VMPS-DV type 1 > 1.06 and a VMPS-LATE > 3.6 were identified as optimal cutoffs for distinguishing dogs with PS from normal. No significant correlations between VMPS and pressure gradient were identified. Small sample size limited statistical power. Due to the absence of echocardiographic data, a comparison of MPA size between radiographic and echocardiographic modalities was not possible. Although VMPS did not reflect PS severity, a VMPS-DV type 1 > 1.06 and a VMPS-LATE > 3.60 support the diagnosis of PS in dogs with compatible clinical findings.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 척추 기반 흉부 방사선 촬영으로 측정한 주폐동맥 크기(VMPS)는 정상견과 폐동맥협착증 환견을 구별하는 데 유용하며, VMPS-DV type 1 > 1.06 및 VMPS-LATE > 3.6이 진단의 최적 임계값이다.
[방법·수치] 후향적 코호트 연구로 폐동맥협착증 29마리, 정상견 30마리, 심실점액종증 30마리를 대상으로 등배상 및 우측 측면 흉부 방사선 촬영으로 VMPS를 측정했다(P<0.001). 프렌치불독 제외 후에도 유의한 차이 유지. VMPS와 최대 압력 기울기 간에 유의한 상관관계 없음(수치 제시 없음). 민감도·특이도 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 폐동맥협착증 의심견의 진단 보조로 활용 가능하지만, 작은 표본 크기와 단일기관 후향적 연구라는 한계가 있다. 에코 데이터 부재로 영상 간 MPA 크기 비교가 불가능했으며, VMPS는 질환의 중증도를 반영하지 못한다.

papers.title: Transvenous occlusion of a patent ductus arteriosus in a cat with the Amplatzer™ Vascular Plug II.
papers.authors: Brennan C, Gunasekaran T
papers.abstract: A three-month-old male intact domestic shorthair cat was presented to Michigan State University for evaluation of a heart murmur and was diagnosed with a left-to-right shunting patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) via transthoracic echocardiography. The patient returned at eight months of age, and the PDA was successfully occluded with the Amplatzer™ Vascular Plug II using a transjugular approach. There are limited reports regarding non-surgical closure of a PDA in cats, including a single report describing closure of a PDA in a cat with this specific device. This case report highlights a feasible transjugular option for interventional closure of a PDA in cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 동맥관개존증(PDA)을 Amplatzer Vascular Plug II를 이용한 경정맥 접근법으로 성공적으로 폐쇄할 수 있으며, 이는 수술 외의 중재적 치료 옵션을 제시한다.
[방법·수치] 3개월령 수컷 국내산 단모종 고양이에서 경흉부 초음파로 좌-우 단락 PDA 진단 후, 8개월령에 경정맥 접근법으로 Amplatzer Vascular Plug II를 이용하여 PDA 폐쇄 시술을 시행했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이의 PDA에 대한 비수술적 폐쇄 보고가 제한적인 상황에서 중재적 폐쇄의 경정맥 접근법이 실행 가능한 선택지임을 제시하나, 단일 증례보고로서 장기 추적 결과와 적용 범위가 명확하지 않다.

papers.title: World Small Animal Veterinary Association Global Dental Guidelines.
papers.authors: Niemiec B, Gawor J, Nemec A, Chandler M, Mestrinho LA
papers.abstract: Dental, oral and maxillofacial diseases are the most common conditions seen in small animal veterinary practice. They may not only create significant pain but also infection. As such, the World Small Animal Veterinary Association believes that un- and undertreated oral and dental diseases pose a significant animal welfare concern. Dentistry is an area of veterinary medicine, which is still undertaught and thus is subject to many myths and misconceptions. Effective teaching of veterinary dentistry in the veterinary curriculum is the key to progression of the discipline. This will greatly improve the health and welfare for all our patients globally. The guidelines were created to provide veterinarians with the necessary foundations to provide gold standard therapy as well as define realistic minimum standards of care. Using the three-tiered continuing education system of World Small Animal Veterinary Association (based on the World Bank), the guidelines make global equipment and therapeutic recommendations and highlight the anaesthetic and welfare requirements for small animal patients worldwide. This document contains information on common oral and dental disease as well as basic diagnostic procedures and treatments. Sections on anaesthesia and pain management for dental procedures, home dental care, nutritional information and recommendations on the role of the universities in improving veterinary dentistry are also included. A discussion of the deleterious effects of anaesthesia-free dentistry is included, as this procedure is ineffective at best and damaging at worst. Finally, the negative effects of undiagnosed/not treated dental disease are discussed under the scope of animal welfare issue. The guidelines from 2019 have been revised to reflect the advances in diagnosis and treatment.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소동물 치과질환은 임상에서 가장 흔한 질환이며, 적절히 치료되지 않은 구강 및 치과 질환은 중대한 동물복지 문제를 야기한다. 수의사는 금표준 치료를 제공하면서도 현실적인 최소 진료 기준을 정의해야 한다.
[방법·수치] 세계소동물수의사협회(WSAVA)의 3단계 계속교육 체계에 기반하여 전지구적 장비 및 치료 권고안을 개발했다. 2019년 가이드라인을 2024년에 개정하여 마취, 진통, 외상, 방사선학, 간호사의 역할 등 신규 섹션을 추가했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 본 가이드라인은 수의과 교과 과정의 치과 교육 강화, 최소 진료 기준의 설정, 무마취 치과시술의 폐지 권고 등을 통해 전 세계 소동물 환자의 구강건강을 개선하는 데 활용할 수 있다. 그러나 국가별·기관별 의료 환경과 자원 가용성에 따른 적용의 차이가 존재할 수 있다.

papers.title: Urolithiasis and crystalluria in dogs with primary portal vein hypoplasia: a retrospective study (2010-2023).
papers.authors: Travail V, Walton-Clark M, Motta C, Serrani D, Pilati F
papers.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the prevalence of urolithiasis in dogs with primary portal vein hypoplasia and to compare clinicopathological changes and clinical signs between dogs with and without uroliths. The clinical records of 15 UK referral hospitals were searched for dogs diagnosed with primary portal vein hypoplasia between 2010 and 2023. Dogs lacking a histopathological diagnosis and those without comprehensive diagnostic imaging to exclude congenital extrahepatic or intrahepatic portosystemic shunts were excluded. Medical records were reviewed for clinical signs, biochemical parameters, urinalysis findings and the presence or absence of urolithiasis. Fourteen dogs with a definitive diagnosis of primary portal vein hypoplasia were documented, of which four (28.5%) had urolithiasis. All dogs with urolithiasis had crystalluria. One of the four dogs (25%) had bilirubin crystals, while the three other dogs (75%) with urolithiasis had ammonium biurate crystalluria, and two (50%) exhibited lower urinary tract signs. The median age was 15 months (range 3 to 38) and 39 months (range 6 to 104) in dogs with or without urolithiasis, respectively. The median duration of clinical signs was 71 days (range 14 to 150) in dogs with urolithiasis and 135 days (range 3 to 365) in those without. Acquired extrahepatic portosystemic shunts were documented in 2/4 (50%) dogs with urolithiasis and 1/10 (10%) of dogs without. Dogs with primary portal vein hypoplasia were at risk of developing uroliths, including both lower and upper urinary tract stones, and often exhibited associated clinical signs. These findings highlight the importance of performing urinalysis and diagnostic imaging in the evaluation of dogs with this condition.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 원발성 문맥 저형성증(primary portal vein hypoplasia) 진단 개 중 28.5%(4/14마리)에서 요석증이 발견되었으며, 요석증 있는 모든 개에서 결정뇨가 동반되었고 75%는 암모늄 비우산염, 25%는 빌리루빈 결정이었다.
[방법·수치] 2010-2023년 영국 15개 의료기관 후향적 연구, 조직병리학적 진단 확인된 원발성 문맥 저형성증 개 14마리 대상. 요석증 군 중앙연령 15개월, 무증상 군 39개월. 요석증 있는 개 50%에서 하부요로 임상징후 보임, 50%에서 후천성 간외문맥단락 발생(무석증 군은 10%).
[임상 적용·한계] 원발성 문맥 저형성증 환자에서 요석증과 관련 임상증상 발생 위험이 높으므로 요검사 및 영상진단 시행이 필수적이다. 소규모 단일국가 후향적 연구이고 개수가 제한적이므로 더 큰 규모의 다기관 연구 필요.

papers.title: Maine Coons and intestinal intussusception: breed predisposition and clinicopathological features.
papers.authors: Dainese M, Petini M, Zoia A
papers.abstract: To evaluate Maine Coon predisposition to intestinal intussusception and compare clinical and biochemical features with non-Maine Coon cats. Cross-sectional study (2004 to 2023) comparing Maine Coons with age-, sex- and weight-matched sick non-Maine Coon controls. Moreover, Maine Coons and unmatched non-Maine Coons with intestinal intussusception presented during the same period were also compared. A total of 371 sick Maine Coons were included. Age and sex were similar to matched controls, but Maine Coons were heavier (median difference 0.7 kg; 95% CI, 0.2 to 0.8), with lower body condition score (median difference 0; 95% CI, -1 to -1), lower serum cholesterol (median difference -11 mg/dL; 95% CI, -18 to -4) and higher simplified Feline Chronic Enteropathy Activity Index score (median difference 1; 95% CI, 0 to 1). Gastrointestinal diseases were more frequent in Maine Coons (25.2% vs. 11.1%; prevalence ratio 2.27; 95% CI, 2.2 to 3.17). Intussusception occurred in 18 Maine Coons, versus none of the controls (prevalence ratio 37; 95% CI, 2.24 to 611.74). During the same period, 12 non-Maine Coons also presented with intestinal intussusception. Compared with them, intussuscepted Maine Coons were younger (median difference -89 months; 95% CI, -130 to 9), heavier (median difference 2.3 kg; 95% CI 0.8 to 3.9) and had lower serum cholesterol (median difference -44 mg/dL; 95% CI, -80 to -4). Maine Coons more often had idiopathic intussusception (33% vs. 0%; Cramér's V 0.57) and lower hospital mortality (6% vs. 42%; prevalence ratio 0.14; 95% CI, 0.02 to 1.00). Maine Coon shows a higher prevalence of intestinal intussusception, younger age, milder intestinal disease and lower short-term mortality.
