[핵심 결론] 메인쿤 고양이는 장중첩증에 대한 뚜렷한 품종 소인을 보이며, 비메인쿤 고양이와 비교했을 때 더 어린 나이에 발생하고 더 낮은 단기 사망률(6% vs. 42%)을 보인다.
[방법·수치] 2004-2023년 교배 설계 연구로 371마리의 환자 메인쿤과 나이·성별·체중 매칭된 비메인쿤 대조군, 그리고 같은 기간의 비매칭 장중첩증 비메인쿤 12마리와 비교. 메인쿤에서 장중첩증 발생률은 18/371마리(대조군 0마리 대비 유병비 37; 95% CI 2.24-611.74), 소화기질환 유병률 25.2% vs. 11.1%(유병비 2.27), 메인쿤의 평균체중 0.7kg 더 무거움, 혈청 콜레스테롤 더 낮음(-11 mg/dL).
[임상 적용·한계] 메인쿤 품종의 장중첩증 진단 시 더 젊은 나이에 의심하고, 특발성 장중첩증이 33%로 더 높음을 고려해야 한다. 장중첩증 메인쿤이 비메인쿤보다 더 경한 임상증상을 보일 수 있어 진단 지연 위험이 있다. 단일 의료기관 자료이고 후향적 연구의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Clinical outcomes of lateral ear canal resection performed in routine clinical practice for chronic otitis externa in dogs: a retrospective descriptive study of 58 ears (2016-2025).
papers.authors: Kiriki K, Yabuzoe A, Iyori K
papers.abstract: To retrospectively evaluate the long-term clinical outcomes of lateral ear canal resection performed as part of routine clinical practice for chronic otitis externa in dogs, and to re-evaluate the practical utility of lateral ear canal resection from the perspective of contemporary treatment goals emphasising long-term maintenance of a manageable condition. A retrospective descriptive study was conducted involving 40 dogs (58 ears) that underwent lateral ear canal resection performed by a single non-specialist surgeon at a single primary care facility between May 2016 and March 2025, with a minimum postoperative follow-up of 12 months. Lateral ear canal resection was performed whenever chronic otitis externa was considered difficult to manage with medical treatment alone, without the application of predefined staging criteria. Changes in the annual frequency of ear cleaning before and after surgery were recorded, and owner assessments were conducted at or near the final follow-up visit at least 12 months postoperatively. Over a median follow-up period of 952 days (interquartile range 589.5 to 1617), no case progressed to end-stage ear canal disease or required conversion to total ear canal ablation with lateral bulla osteotomy. No serious postoperative complications were observed. The median annual ear-cleaning frequency decreased markedly from 6.74 (interquartile range 2.06 to 14.30) before surgery to 1.58 (interquartile range 0.42 to 3.77) after surgery. The median postoperative pruritus score improved from 100% preoperatively to 20% (interquartile range 10 to 35). Owner assessment scores exceeded a mean of 3.89 across all items. Lateral ear canal resection performed in routine clinical practice before the development of overt end-stage ear canal disease may suppress progression of chronic otitis externa and support long-term disease manageability.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 만성외이염에 대한 측측이도절제술은 질병 진행을 억제하고 장기적인 질병 관리 가능성을 지원하며, 완전이도절제술로의 진행을 피하는 데 도움이 될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 개 40마리(58귀)를 대상으로 한 후향적 기술 연구(2016-2025), 최소 추적 관찰 기간 12개월, 중간값 추적 관찰 기간 952일(사분위수 범위 589.5~1617), 수술 전후 연간 귀 세척 빈도 중간값이 6.74회에서 1.58회로 감소, 수술 후 소양증 점수는 100%에서 20%(사분위수 범위 10~35)로 개선, 소유자 평가 점수 평균 3.89점 이상, 중증 수술후 합병증 없음, 완전이도절제술 전환 사례 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 측측이도절제술은 일차 진료 시설에서 비전문가 외과의도 전문 장비 없이 수행 가능하므로, 만성외이염의 진행을 조기에 중재할 수 있는 치료 옵션으로 재평가할 가치가 있다. 단일 기관, 단일 외과의, 후향적 연구라는 한계가 있으며 다양한 임상 환경에서의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Retrospective study on diagnostic yield and medical impact of diagnostic imaging in dogs with immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia in Belgium.
papers.authors: Vlassenbroek R, Peeters D, Matthewman L, François C, Bolen G
papers.abstract: To assess the incidence of associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia in dogs diagnosed with immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia and to evaluate whether performing diagnostic imaging, specifically thoracic radiographs and abdominal ultrasound, influences outcomes in non-associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia. Medical records (2017 to 2023) were reviewed for dogs diagnosed with immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia. Dogs were classified as associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia or non-associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia. Survival odds at 3, 6 and 12 months were assessed for non-associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with a risk of decreased survival. Among 117 immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia cases, 7 (6%) had associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia, and 110 (94%) had non-associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia. In non-associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia dogs, thoracic radiographs were performed in 63 dogs (57.3%) and abdominal ultrasound in 90 dogs (81.8%), with unremarkable thoracic radiographs in 55.5% of cases and unremarkable abdominal ultrasound in 17.8%. Diagnostic imaging did not significantly affect the risk of decreased survival at 3, 6 and 12 months (P > .05). Increasing age (OR [95% CI]: 1.31 [1.06 to 1.61] at 12 months), elevated serum alanine aminotransferase (OR [95% CI]: 3.93 [1.11 to 14.0] at 3 months) and a higher number of packed red blood cell transfusions (OR [95% CI]: 2.10 [1.09 to 4.08] at 3 months and 1.91 [1.02 to 3.56] at 6 months) were associated with an increased risk of decreased survival. Performing diagnostic imaging was not associated with a change in survival odds in dogs with non-associative immune-mediated haemolytic anaemia in this cohort. These findings suggest individual case-based diagnostic imaging may be appropriate in clinical practice.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 비연관성 면역매개용혈성빈혈에서 흉부방사선 및 복부초음파 검사는 3, 6, 12개월 생존율에 유의미한 영향을 미치지 않으며, 개별 임상 사례 기반의 선택적 영상진단이 적절함을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 2017~2023년 벨기에에서 면역매개용혈성빈혈로 진단된 개 117마리(연관성 7마리 6%, 비연관성 110마리 94%)를 대상으로 후향적 의료기록 검토를 수행했다. 비연관성 그룹에서 흉부방사선은 63마리(57.3%), 복부초음파는 90마리(81.8%)에서 시행되었으며, 흉부방사선의 55.5%, 복부초음파의 17.8%에서 이상 소견이 없었다. 나이 증가(OR 1.31), 혈청 알라닌아미노전이효소 상승(OR 3.93, 3개월), 적혈구 수혈 횟수 증가(OR 2.10 3개월, 1.91 6개월)가 생존율 저하와 관련되었다(P>0.05).
[임상 적용·한계] 비연관성 면역매개용혈성빈혈 환자에서는 모든 개에 영상진단을 일률적으로 수행할 필요가 없으며, 개별 임상상황에 따라 선택적으로 시행하는 것이 합리적이다. 단일 국가 후향적 연구이고 표본크기가 제한적이며 영상검사 적응증이 기재되지 않은 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Infectious complications of dental procedures in dogs and cats, and the impact of antimicrobial prophylaxis: a systematic review.
papers.authors: Weese JS, Soltero-Rivera M, Weese HE, Scahill K
papers.abstract: To identify and describe available evidence pertaining to the local and systemic infectious complications in dogs and cats that have undergone dental procedures and the impact of peri-procedural antimicrobial prophylaxis. A systematic review was performed based on Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and MetaAnalysis guidelines. No studies clearly reported the incidence of sepsis or infective endocarditis data associated with dental procedures. The pooled prevalence of post-dental procedure bacteraemia was 47% (95% confidence interval 23% to 74%). Two studies investigated both dogs undergoing dental procedures and controls. Neither showed a clear association of dental procedures and bacteraemia. Bacteraemia was not associated with any clinical consequences based on these data, but data were very limited, with a very low level of certainty of evidence. No studies evaluated the impact of peri-procedural antimicrobial on endocarditis, sepsis or other infectious complications. Two relevant studies that used bacteraemia as the outcome were identified. Both studies were deemed to have some concerns of bias. Certainty of evidence was deemed to be very low. No data were available to assess the impact of post-procedural antimicrobials on infectious complications. The evidence base to assess the incidence and risks of infectious complications after dental procedures and impact of antimicrobial prophylaxis in dogs and cats is severely limited. This highlights a major research gap for a common patient population and hampers development of evidence-based guidelines for peri-procedural antimicrobial administration in dogs and cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개와 고양이의 치과 시술 후 균혈증의 풀링된 유병률은 47%(95% 신뢰구간 23~74%)이지만, 패혈증이나 감염성 심내막염의 발생률은 보고된 연구가 없으며, 균혈증과 임상적 결과 간의 연관성이 명확하지 않다. 치과 시술 후 항미생물제 예방의 효과를 평가한 연구도 없어 근거 기반 지침 수립이 불가능한 상태이다.
[방법·수치] 체계적 문헌고찰로 개와 고양이의 치과 시술 관련 감염성 합병증을 조사했다. 치과 시술 후 균혈증의 풀링된 유병률 47%(95% CI 23~74%), 치과 시술군과 대조군 비교 연구 2개 모두 치과 시술과 균혈증 간의 명확한 연관성이 없었다. 항미생물제의 영향을 평가한 연구는 2개뿐이며 모두 편향 위험이 존재했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 현재 개와 고양이의 치과 시술 전후 항미생물 예방 투여에 대한 근거 기반 지침이 없다. 연구 대상이 흔한 임상 집단임에도 불구하고 증거 기반이 극히 제한적이며, 큰 연구 공백이 있어 임상 적용에 주의가 필요하다.

papers.title: Severe post-GDV gastroparesis managed with sleeve-type gastrectomy in a dog.
papers.authors: Hatzav M, Zemer O, Benzioni-Bar H, Biton E, Gibson I
papers.abstract: A Belgian Malinois dog developed advanced gastroparesis with gastric atony and progressive dilatation following surgical correction of gastric dilatation-volvulus. Following gastric dilatation-volvulus, the dog developed recurrent gastric distension, vomiting of undigested food and progressive weight loss. Imaging and endoscopy demonstrated a markedly enlarged, static stomach with a patent pylorus, refractory to prokinetic therapy. Exploratory laparotomy revealed global gastric atony, and a radical sleeve-type gastrectomy was performed. Histopathology identified interstitial fibrosis and sparsely distributed nerve plexuses. Although delayed gastric emptying persisted postoperatively on barium contrast study, the dog regained weight, tolerated liquid meals and remained clinically stable without further vomiting or dilatation at 12 months follow-up. Severe gastroparesis with chronic gastric dilatation can occur as a delayed complication of gastric dilatation-volvulus, likely related to truncal vagal injury. Sleeve-type gastrectomy might represent a salvage option for dogs with end-stage, medically refractory gastric atony.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 위확장염전 수술 후 발생한 중증 위무력증은 미주신경 손상으로 인한 지연성 합병증이며, 보존적 치료에 불응하는 말기 위무력증 환자에서 슬리브형 위절제술이 구출용 수술 방법이 될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 벨기에 말리노이즈견 1마리를 대상으로 한 증례 보고. 위확장염전 외과적 교정 후 반복되는 위팽만, 미소화 음식물의 구토, 진행성 체중감소 발생. 영상검사와 내시경 검사에서 거대하고 운동 불능인 위 확인, 프로키네틱 약물 치료 불응. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 위확장염전 수술 후 보존적 치료에 불응하는 중증 위무력증 환자에서 슬리브형 위절제술 고려 가능. 술 후 12개월 추적관찰 시 체중 회복, 액상 식이 허용, 구토나 위팽만 미재발으로 임상적 안정성 입증. 단일 증례 보고로 후향적 치료 평가의 한계 있으며, 술 후에도 지연된 위배출이 지속되어 완전한 정상화는 달성하지 못함.

papers.title: Clotting and Coagulation Disorders in Cats: A clinical review of causes, diagnosis and management.
papers.authors: Evans J, Li RHL
papers.abstract: Hemostatic disorders in cats, while uncommon, can be life-threatening. In general, they can be diagnosed by utilizing a combination of history, physical examination findings, point-of-care assays and a basic understanding of hemostasis. This review aims to provide a general overview of hemostasis physiology, discuss common hemostatic disorders, diagnosis and interpretation of hemostatic testing, and summarize treatments of hemostatic disorders. The underlying cause of hemostatic disorders can often be diagnosed by a combination of history, physical examination and directed testing. Based on the information obtained during the work-up, a management plan can be constructed tailored to the individual patient. This article aims to review the literature surrounding the pathophysiology, diagnosis and management of hemostatic disorders in cats. By the end of this article, readers should be able to: understand the basic physiology of hemostasis; understand common primary and secondary hemostatic disorders in cats and their pathophysiologies in relation to clinical signs and diagnostic findings; compare and contrast common diagnostic tests to assess hemostasis and apply those that are appropriate; and list the appropriate therapeutic and management strategies for common primary and secondary hemostatic disorders in cats.

[핵심 결론] 고양이의 지혈 장애는 드물지만 생명을 위협할 수 있으며, 병력·신체검사·현장검사와 지혈 생리 이해를 통해 진단할 수 있다. 1차 및 2차 지혈 장애의 병태생리를 파악하고 각 질환에 맞는 진단 및 치료 전략을 수립하는 것이 중요하다.
[방법·수치] 고양이 지혈 장애에 관한 문헌 고찰로, 지혈 생리, 임상적 원인, 진단 검사법(지혈 검사), 치료 관리법을 종합적으로 검토했다. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상의가 지혈 장애의 기초 생리를 이해하고 1차·2차 장애를 감별하며 적절한 진단 검사를 선택·해석하고 맞춤형 치료 계획을 수립할 수 있도록 하는 것을 목표로 한다. 문헌 고찰로 인한 근거 수준의 제한이 있으며, 실제 임상 케이스에 따른 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Efficacy and tolerability of a sequential COP and doxorubicin chemotherapy protocol for treatment of high-grade lymphoma in cats.
papers.authors: Neiderfer K, Iwaki Y, Donnelly LL, Bryant JE, Bryan JN
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate tolerability of a COP/DOX protocol, where cats received COP (vincristine, cyclophosphamide, and prednisolone) induction weekly for 6 weeks followed by doxorubicin (DOX) consolidation every 3 weeks for six doses. A secondary objective was to evaluate the efficacy of the COP/DOX protocol in this cohort of cats. Records were retrospectively reviewed for cats with high-grade lymphoma treated with the COP/DOX protocol between 2005 and 2024. Data collected included signalment, method of diagnosis, tumor location, staging, baseline diagnostics, drug dosages, adverse events, restaging diagnostics, and treatment response. Progression-free survival and survival time were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared across selected variables using log-rank test. In total, 27 cats met the inclusion criteria. Gastrointestinal lymphoma was the most common form, occurring in 33.3% of cats. The number of cats achieving a maximal response of clinical remission and partial remission throughout COP was 10 (37.0%) and 12 (44.4%), respectively. Of the five cats who had stable disease or progressive disease during COP, one achieved partial remission on DOX. Four cats (14.8%) did not respond to either the COP or DOX part of the protocol. The overall response rate at 6 weeks after initiation of COP/DOX was 77.7%. Median progression-free survival was 98 days (interquartile range 41-141) and median survival time was 154 days (interquartile range 102-546). The cats who had clinical remission at the completion of DOX had progression-free survival of 554.5 days and median survival time of 546 days. High-grade adverse events included grade 3 and 4 neutropenia (n = 3 for each) during COP. Lymphocyte:monocyte ratio and response at the completion of DOX were significantly associated with progression-free survival and median survival time. We conclude that the COP/DOX protocol was well tolerated by this population.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 고등급 림프종에 대한 COP/DOX 순차 화학요법은 양호한 내약성을 보였으며, 전체 반응률 77.7%(관해 37.0%, 부분관해 44.4%)를 달성했고, 완전관해 달성 고양이에서 무진행 생존기간 554.5일, 전체 생존기간 546일을 기록했다.
[방법·수치] 2005~2024년 고등위 림프종으로 COP/DOX 치료받은 27마리 고양이의 후향적 의무기록 분석. COP 유도요법(빈크리스틴, 사이클로포스파미드, 프레드니솔론 주 1회, 6주)과 독소루비신 공고요법(3주 간격, 최대 6회). 위약 림프종 33.3%, 무진행 생존기간 중앙값 98일(사분위수 41-141), 전체 생존기간 중앙값 154일(102-546). 고등급 이상약 반응은 COP 중 3등급/4등급 호중구감소증(각 3마리). 림프구:단핵구 비율과 DOX 종료 시 반응이 무진행 생존기간 및 전체 생존기간과 유의한 연관성 보임.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 고등급 림프종에 효과적이고 안전한 치료 옵션으로 임상 적용 가능하나, 소규모 후향적 단일기관 연구이며 DOX 치료 완료 여부에 따른 반응률 차이에 대한 추가 분석 필요.

papers.title: Effect of oral gabapentin administered in-hospital on behavioral stress, compliance, and physiologic stress markers: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
papers.authors: Canosa C, Summers SC
papers.abstract: The aim of the study was to determine whether post admission oral gabapentin improves stress indices and handling tolerance in hospitalized cats. In this double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, parallel-design trial, healthy client-owned cats were enrolled. After the initial examination, cats received a 100 mg gabapentin or placebo capsule. At 90 min, a second examination, venipuncture, and brief dorsal positioning were performed. Five stress behaviors (struggling, vocalization, repelling, hypersalivation, mouth breathing), compliance, and enclosure activity score (1, sedate; 5, very active) were recorded; blood glucose, lactate, serum cortisol, and lymphocyte count were measured. Serum gabapentin concentrations were obtained 90 min after the capsule. A total of 30 cats (15 cats/group) were included in analysis. In the 15 cats who received gabapentin, the median gabapentin dose was 21.7 mg/kg (range 14.3-28.1), yielding a median serum concentration of 16.4 µg/ml (range 1.3-24.5). Most gabapentin-treated cats exhibited fewer stress behaviors (n = 13/15, 87%) and better compliance for handling during examination (n = 11/15, 73%) at 90 min post-capsule compared with 3/15 (20%) and 4/15 (27%), respectively, in placebo cats. Between-group differences were not detected for behavioral or compliance scores during venipuncture or dorsal positioning. Enclosure activity scores in the gabapentin group decreased from median 3 at baseline to 2 from 90-360 min post-dose (120, 240, and 300 min; P <0.05, respectively), consistent with mild sedation. Blood lactate and cortisol concentrations were lower in the gabapentin group than the placebo group (P = 0.002 and P = 0.04, respectively). A 100 mg oral dose of gabapentin provides modest improvement in stress behaviors during examination and favorably alters select physiologic stress markers within 90 min of administration, with sustained reductions in kennel activity.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 입원 후 경구 gabapentin 100mg 투여는 90분 내에 고양이의 스트레스 행동을 완화하고 혈청 lactate 및 cortisol을 감소시키며, kennel 활동을 수시간 동안 억제하는 경미한 진정 효과를 제공한다.
[방법·수치] 무작위 이중맹검 위약 대조 평행설계 연구로 건강한 고양이 30마리(각 군 15마리)를 대상으로 했으며, gabapentin 투여군의 용량은 중앙값 21.7mg/kg(범위 14.3-28.1)이고 혈청 농도는 중앙값 16.4μg/ml(범위 1.3-24.5)였다. 90분 후 gabapentin 군에서 스트레스 행동 감소(87% vs 20%, P<0.05), 처치 순응도 향상(73% vs 27%, P<0.05), lactate 감소(P=0.002), cortisol 감소(P=0.04)를 보였으나 채혈 및 복위 자세잡기 중에는 군 간 차이가 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 사전 약물 투여 없이 내원한 고양이의 진찰 및 순한 처치에 보조적으로 사용할 수 있으나, 저스트레스 환경(조용한 공간, 부드러운 취급) 등 다중양식 접근의 일부로 활용해야 하며 침습적 절차에는 추가 진정제가 필요할 수 있다. 단일 캡슐 흡수의 개체 간 변이가 크고, 소규모 단일기관 연구이다.

papers.title: Attitudes and practices of veterinarians regarding feline pain management in Western vs Eastern Europe.
papers.authors: Bukhari SSUH, Marangoni S, Almendros A, Luna SPL, Steagall PV
papers.abstract: This study aimed to report and compare attitudes and practices of veterinarians regarding feline pain management in Eastern and Western Europe. A questionnaire was developed and divided into demographic data, drug availability/administration, and pain management practices. The questionnaire went through content and face validity and was translated into several languages. An internet-based survey was created, and responses were collected using a convenience sampling method. Data were analyzed using multiple correspondence analysis. In total, 833 participants from Europe were included. Most respondents indicated good knowledge of acute pain assessment and recognition (n = 478, 57.4%). The Feline Grimace Scale was the most commonly used instrument to assess acute pain (n = 346, 41.5%). Chronic pain scoring instruments were not used by 48.5% (n = 404) of participants. Meloxicam and robenacoxib were the most used non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for chronic pain management. Limited knowledge of pain assessment, non-use of NSAIDs in cats undergoing surgery, and postoperative use of opioids were more closely associated with Eastern than Western Europe. Reported good knowledge of pain management, pre- and intraoperative use of NSAIDs, use of pain scales and preoperative opioids, having a specialty diploma, and working in a cat-friendly practice were associated with Western Europe compared with Eastern Europe. Important regional differences were found regarding feline pain management across Europe. Continuing education, wider implementation of validated pain assessment tools, and improved access to analgesics may help reduce regional disparities and improve feline welfare.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 유럽 내 고양이 통증 관리에 대한 수의사의 태도와 실제 임상 관행에서 동유럽과 서유럽 간 뚜렷한 지역적 차이가 존재하며, 서유럽에서 더 체계적이고 선제적인 통증 관리가 이루어지고 있다.
[방법·수치] 유럽 833명의 수의사를 대상으로 인터넷 설문조사(편의표본추출법)를 실시했으며, 급성 통증 평가·인식 양호군 57.4%(n=478), Feline Grimace Scale 사용률 41.5%(n=346), 만성 통증 평가 도구 미사용률 48.5%(n=404), 가장 많이 사용된 NSAID는 멜록시캄과 로베나콕시브였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 현장에서 고양이 급성 통증 평가 도구로 Feline Grimace Scale 도입을 권장하고, 수술 전·중·후 NSAIDs 및 오피오이드의 선제적 사용을 촉진해야 하며, 임상 교육 강화와 진통제 접근성 개선이 지역 격차 해소에 필수적이다. 본 연구는 편의표본추출법 기반 횡단 설문조사로 인과관계 추론에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Myocardial injury in cats with acute blunt trauma: Prevalence and prognostic implications.
papers.authors: Dossi G, Carnevale L, Mismetti M, Borromeo V, Pocar P
papers.abstract: The aim of the present study was to determine the prevalence of increased serum high-sensitivity cardiac troponin I (hs-cTnI) concentrations in cats with acute blunt trauma and assess associations with trauma severity, clinicopathological variables, echocardiographic findings, and short-term outcome. A total of 39 cats presenting within 48 h of blunt trauma were prospectively enrolled. All cats underwent physical examination, Animal Trauma Triage scoring, thoracic radiography, electrocardiography, echocardiography, complete blood count, serum biochemistry, N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide testing, and hs-cTnI measurement. Associations between hs-cTnI concentrations and clinical, laboratory, echocardiographic, and outcome variables were assessed. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis was performed as an exploratory assessment of prognostic performance. Increased hs-cTnI concentrations were detected in 34/39 (87%) cats (95% confidence interval 72-96). A significant ordinal association was identified between trauma severity and hs-cTnI class (linear-by-linear association, P = 0.036), although the overall Fisher-Freeman-Halton test was not significant (P = 0.088). Hs-cTnI concentrations correlated positively with urea, creatinine, neutrophil count, alanine aminotransferase, neutrophil:lymphocyte ratio, blood glucose, end-diastolic interventricular septal, and posterior wall thicknesses, and negatively with end-diastolic left ventricular internal diameter. Increased left ventricular wall thickness was identified in 10/39 cats and was associated with higher hs-cTnI concentrations (P = 0.033). No traumatic cardiac rupture, pericardial effusion, or pleural effusion were observed. Electrocardiographic abnormalities were detected in 6/39 cats and were not associated with hs-cTnI concentrations. Seven cats (18%) died during hospitalization. Increased urea concentration, white blood cell count, and neutrophil count were associated with non-survival.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 둔상 외상을 입은 고양이의 87%에서 고감도 심근손상표지자(hs-cTnI) 증가가 관찰되었으며, 이는 외상 심각도, 백혈구 관련 변수, 신장 기능 이상, 그리고 미묘한 심초음파 이상과 연관되었다.
[방법·수치] 둔상 외상 48시간 이내 내원한 고양이 39마리를 전향적으로 등록하여 신체검사, 외상중증도점수, 흉부방사선, 심전도, 심초음파, 혈액검사, NT-proBNP, hs-cTnI 측정을 시행했다. hs-cTnI 증가는 34/39마리(87%, 95% 신뢰도 72-96%)에서 관찰되었고, 외상 심각도와 hs-cTnI 등급 간 선형 연관성이 있었다(P=0.036). 좌심실벽 두께 증가는 10/39마리에서 발견되었고 높은 hs-cTnI와 연관되었다(P=0.033). 입원 중 사망은 7마리(18%)였다.
[임상 적용·한계] hs-cTnI는 외상 고양이에서 심근손상, 전신질환 심각도, 신기능 변화, 그리고 잠재적 기저 심질환을 반영하는 다인성 지표로 작용하므로, 외상 고양이의 심장 손상 평가에 보조적 진단 도구로 활용될 수 있다. 그러나 외상 전 기저 심장 상태를 알 수 없고, 제한된 사망 사건 수로 인해 예후 평가의 임상적 의의는 명확하지 않으며 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Flow cytometry-based direct antiglobulin test for suspected feline immune-mediated thrombocytopenia: Assay development and demographic factors associated with direct antiglobulin test positivity.
papers.authors: Nedumpun T, Kamenkit O, Thongwandi S, Tripipat T, Wadeerat S
papers.abstract: This study aimed to develop and evaluate an in-house flow cytometry-based direct antiglobulin test (DAT) for detecting IgG-bound platelets in cats and to investigate the prevalence of DAT positivity and associated risk factors among thrombocytopenic cats. Platelets were identified by CD41/61 expression, and platelet-bound IgG was assessed using flow cytometry. A diagnostic cutoff for the percentage of IgG-positive platelets was established using 100 healthy cats and preliminarily evaluated in 50 cats with severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count <20,000/µl) before being applied to the remaining 411 thrombocytopenic cats (platelet count <200,000/µl) to determine the prevalence of DAT positivity and its associations with platelet count, breed, age, and sex. Healthy cats showed 0-10% IgG-positive platelets, and a cutoff of >10% was established. Using this cutoff, 105/461 (22.8%) thrombocytopenic cats were classified as DAT positive. DAT-positive cats had significantly lower platelet counts than DAT-negative cats (median 4000/µl; mean 12,562/µl vs 34,000/µl; mean 47,956/µl; P <0.05), and the percentage of IgG-bound platelets was inversely correlated with platelet count (r = -0.38; P = 0.048). No breed association was identified. Cats aged 5 years were more likely to be DAT positive, whereas castrated male cats were less likely to be DAT positive. Flow cytometry-based DAT is a useful adjunctive diagnostic tool for assessing suspected immune-mediated platelet destruction in thrombocytopenic cats. Younger cats may be at increased risk, whereas castrated male cats may be at lower risk. However, the interpretation of a DAT-positive test result should be made alongside assessment of clinical findings and investigations for underlying causes of thrombocytopenia.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 유동세포분석 기반 직접항글로불린검사(DAT)는 고양이의 면역매개성혈소판감소증 진단에 유용한 보조도구이며, 5세 이상 고양이에서 양성률이 높고 중성화수컷에서는 낮다.
[방법·수치] 건강 고양이 100마리로 진단 절단값 설정(IgG-양성혈소판 >10%), 혈소판감소증 고양이 461마리 평가. DAT 양성 고양이 105/461마리(22.8%)에서 혈소판수 유의하게 낮음(중앙값 4,000/μl vs 34,000/μl, P<0.05), IgG-결합혈소판 백분율과 혈소판수의 역상관(r=-0.38, P=0.048).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 소견과 기저질환 평가와 함께 DAT 결과를 해석해야 하며, 단일기관 연구로서 다양한 고양이 집단에서의 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: The hormonal effects of owner-cat interactions on pet cats of different potential attachment styles.
papers.authors: He X, Huang H, Chang H, Xu W, Gui C
papers.abstract: The aim of the present study was to investigate how different owner-cat interaction types influence stress and owner-bonding in pet cats with different potential attachment styles, using salivary cortisol and oxytocin as physiological indicators. Twenty pet cats were classified into potential secure, insecure-anxious or insecure-avoidant attachment styles using the Secure Base Test. Owners engaged in four types of interactions with their cats at home on separate days. Saliva samples were collected before and after each interaction and analysed for cortisol and oxytocin concentrations. The effects of attachment style, interaction type and time on hormonal changes were examined. Significant interactive effects of potential attachment style and time, as well as interaction type and time, were observed for both cortisol and oxytocin. Passive interactions were associated with increased oxytocin and decreased cortisol, whereas forced interactions showed an opposite pattern. Secure cats exhibited more positive hormonal responses to human interactions compared with insecure cats, who showed increased cortisol or limited hormonal changes. Insecure cats also showed higher basal oxytocin levels than secure cats. Human-cat interactions trigger changes in cortisol and oxytocin levels, depending on the interaction type and cat's attachment style. These findings highlight the importance of considering individual cat attachment differences when promoting appropriate interaction strategies to improve cat welfare and human-cat relationships.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 애착 유형과 보호자와의 상호작용 방식에 따라 스트레스 호르몬(코르티솔)과 유대감 호르몬(옥시토신) 수치가 달라지며, 안정적 애착 고양이가 불안정 애착 고양이보다 상호작용에 더 긍정적인 호르몬 반응을 보인다.
[방법·수치] 20마리 고양이를 Secure Base Test로 안정적 애착(secure), 불안-초조형(insecure-anxious), 불안-회피형(insecure-avoidant)으로 분류하고, 4가지 유형의 보호자-고양이 상호작용 전후에 타액 샘플을 채취하여 코르티솔과 옥시토신 농도를 측정했다. 수동적 상호작용은 옥시토신 증가와 코르티솔 감소를 보였고, 강압적 상호작용은 반대 패턴을 나타냈다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상에서 고양이의 개별 애착 유형을 고려한 맞춤형 상호작용 전략을 권장하면 고양이 복지와 인간-고양이 관계 개선에 도움이 될 수 있다. 단일 기관의 소규모 연구이고 초록에 통계 유의성 수치(P값)는 제시되지 않았다.

papers.title: Evaluation of the clinical course of immune-mediated polyneuropathy in cats after treatment with human intravenous immunoglobulins.
papers.authors: Schmitz AK, Sablotni Aguilera AP, Buhmann G, van Renen J, Parzefall B
papers.abstract: Immune-mediated polyneuropathy (IMPN) manifests with generalised lower motor neuron (LMN) weakness and a remittent or relapsing clinical course. Evidence-based treatment recommendations for severely or chronically affected cats are limited. The objective of this study was to evaluate the clinical course and outcome of cats with IMPN after treatment with human intravenous immunoglobulins (hIVIg). Medical records from two veterinary referral hospitals were reviewed (2018-2025) for cats with IMPN treated with hIVIg. Cats were treated with 1-2 g/kg hIVIg divided over 2-4 days (0.5 g/kg/day). Clinical information, diagnostic findings, treatment details, and short- and long-term follow-up were evaluated retrospectively. Follow-up information was obtained from medical records and owner communication. Minimum follow-up duration was 8 months (range 8-51; median 17). Clinical course (partial and complete recovery, relapses) was compared between cats with acute/recent onset (four cats) or chronic presentation (five cats). Of nine cats, eight exhibited clinical improvement after hIVIg administration, achieving ambulatory status (walking >5 steps) within a median of 4 days (range 2-8). One cat failed to respond to hIVIg but improved after subsequent prednisolone therapy. For the overall cohort, the median time to complete recovery was 20 days, while the median time to partial recovery was 14 days. Relapses occurred in four cats, but weakness was less severe, and all cats recovered again. The remaining five cats remained relapse-free. Human IVIg was well tolerated in this small cohort, and rapid clinical improvement was observed in most treated cats. These findings suggest that hIVIg may be considered as a treatment option in selected cats with IMPN, including those with acute and chronic presentations. Larger prospective studies, including comparison with no treatment or corticosteroids, are warranted to further assess its efficacy.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 면역매개 다발신경병증에 대한 인간 정맥 면역글로불린(hIVIg) 치료는 8/9마리에서 임상 개선을 보였으며, 중앙값 4일 내에 보행 가능 상태(5보 이상)에 도달했고 완전 회복까지 중앙값 20일이 소요되었다.
[방법·수치] 2018-2025년 두 개의 동물병원 의료 기록 후향 검토, 총 9마리 고양이(급성 발병 4마리, 만성 4마리) 대상, 1-2g/kg hIVIg를 2-4일에 걸쳐 투여(0.5g/kg/일), 최소 추적 기간 8개월(범위 8-51개월, 중앙값 17개월), 부분 회복 중앙값 14일, 4마리에서 재발 관찰(재발 시 증상이 경증이었고 모두 회복).
[임상 적용·한계] hIVIg는 급성 및 만성 발병 고양이 면역매개 다발신경병증에 치료 옵션으로 고려될 수 있으며 양호한 내약성을 보였다. 다만 본 연구는 소규모(9마리) 후향 연구로 대조군, 무치료군, 코르티코스테로이드 비교 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: The effect of one-lung ventilation on sentinel lymph node mapping in dog lungs.
papers.authors: Marvel SJ, Kaschark N, Boscan P, Monnet E
papers.abstract: To determine the sentinel lymph node (SLN) for the caudal lung lobe using indocyanine green (ICG) and near infra-red fluorescence (NIRF) in normal dogs. The secondary objective was to determine the effect of one lung ventilation (OLV) on time to SLN detection. Prospective, randomized experimental study. Purpose-bred Beagles (n = 21). Dogs were randomized to undergo OLV or normal ventilation (NV) and to undergo right or left caudal lung injections with ICG through lateral intercostal thoracoscopy. The draining lymph nodes (DLNs) were visualized at 10 min intervals. A fluorescent lymph node (FLN) was detected in 19/21 dogs (90%) and was the right or left tracheobronchial lymph node (LN) in 79% of dogs. Six dogs had multiple FLNs detected simultaneously. In 4/19 dogs (21%) the first FLN(s) was the central tracheobronchial LN, sternal LN, cranial mediastinal LN or a combination of these LNs. The median time to fluorescence in the first FLN was 30 min (range: 10-50 min) for the OLV group and 10 min (range: 10-20 min) for the NV group (p = .0012). The SLN or DLN for the caudal lung in normal dogs was variable, but often included the tracheobronchial LN. One lung ventilation slowed the detection of ICG in the lymphatics. Biopsy of tracheobronchial LNs for caudal lung tumors without SLN mapping may provide inaccurate staging information in some dogs. During NIRF-guided SLN mapping, delaying OLV induction may improve SLN identification.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 미엽에서 ICG와 근적외선형광을 이용한 감시림프절 매핑 결과 주로 기관지폐동맥림프절이 드레이닝림프절이었으며, 편측폐환기는 림프절 형광 검출을 지연시켰다.
[방법·수치] 목적육종 비글 21마리를 대상으로 편측폐환기(OLV) 또는 정상환기(NV) 군으로 무작위 배정하여 흉강경으로 미엽에 ICG를 주입하고 10분 간격으로 형광림프절을 추적했다. 형광림프절은 19/21마리(90%)에서 검출되었고, OLV군의 첫 형광림프절 검출 시간 중앙값은 30분(범위 10-50분)이었으나 NV군은 10분(범위 10-20분)으로 통계적으로 유의하게 더 빨랐다(p=0.0012).
[임상 적용·한계] 미엽 종양의 정확한 병기설정을 위해서는 감시림프절 매핑이 필요하며, 근적외선형광 유도 감시림프절 매핑 시 편측폐환기의 지연 도입이 감시림프절 동정을 개선할 수 있다. 소규모 실험실 연구이고 정상견에서의 결과로 종양견에의 직접 적용에 주의가 필요하다.

papers.title: Variations on the rostral labial pivot flap for reconstruction of maxillary lip defects in four dogs.
papers.authors: Im H, Dark KV, Skinner OT
papers.abstract: To describe the technique and outcome of a rostral labial pivot flap variant in dogs. Four dogs with rostral lip/paranasal defect underwent rostral labial pivot flap. Short case series. Rostral lip and paranasal defects with concurrent nasal mucosal involvement resulting from tumor resection were reconstructed using the rostral labial pivot flap and its variants, including incorporation of a mucosal island flap ± nasal rotation flap for modification of lip heights. Medical records were reviewed for all dogs that underwent tumor resection followed by reconstruction with a rostral labial pivot flap technique and its modifications. The rostral labial pivot flap and its variants provided acceptable outcomes in four dogs for reconstruction of rostral lip and paranasal defects. Incorporation of a mucosal island flap was effective for nasal mucosal reconstruction, and use of a nasal rotation flap to reduce tension and address lip height discrepancy resulted in acceptable outcomes. Two dogs experienced minor complications, including an oronasal fistula and mild narial stenosis, neither of which was associated with clinical signs. All dogs were considered to have normal function and quality of life at follow-up. The rostral labial pivot flap can be a reasonable and adaptable option for reconstruction of rostral lip and paranasal defects in dogs. Acceptable cosmetic and functional outcomes with low morbidity were observed in this series; however, additional cases are needed to better define success rates and complications.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 상악 입술 및 부비강 결손은 rostral labial pivot flap와 그 변형술(점막섬 flap, 비강 회전 flap 포함)을 이용하여 허용 가능한 미용 및 기능적 결과를 얻을 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 종양 절제로 인한 상악 입술/부비강 결손을 가진 개 4마리를 대상으로 한 단기 사례 연구이며, 수치 제시 없음. Rostral labial pivot flap와 그 변형술을 적용하였고 필요에 따라 점막섬 flap과 비강 회전 flap을 조합하여 입술 높이 차이를 보정하였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 모든 개에서 정상적인 기능과 삶의 질을 보였으며 경미한 합병증(구비강 누공 1례, 경도 비공 협착 1례)이 발생했으나 임상증상은 없었다. 단기 사례 연구로 성공률과 합병증을 정의하기 위해서는 추가 증례가 필요하며 종양 절제 후 입술 결손 재건의 선택지로 고려할 수 있다.

papers.title: Use of a cell saver device for perioperative autotransfusion in 102 dogs and one cat.
papers.authors: Michalska A, Bray J
papers.abstract: To describe the application of a cell saver device (CSD) to manage blood loss in dogs and cats. Retrospective study. A total of 102 client-owned dogs and one cat. Medical records were reviewed for all animals in which autotransfusion using blood generated by the CSD was used. Data retrieved included signalment, surgical details, blood test results, degree of blood loss, blood collection method, transfusion volume, timing of administration, additional blood products used, variations in packed cell volume (PCV), and incidence of transfusion reactions. Short-term complications and overall outcome were assessed by telephone follow-up. There were 103 autotransfusions performed, during emergency (n = 40) and elective (n = 63) procedures. The mean transfusion volume was 14 mL/kg. For every 1 mL of blood transfused per kilogram of bodyweight, PCV increased by approximately 0.6%. Allogeneic blood products (ABPs) were used in addition to autologous blood in 14% of cases. The transfusion reaction rate associated with autotransfusion was 1%. The use of a CSD appeared safe and versatile for management of blood loss in dogs. The inclusion of only a single feline case highlights the need for further studies evaluating the safety and efficacy of this technique in cats. Autotransfusion using a CSD is applicable in a wide range of emergency and elective surgeries, presenting an alternative to ABPs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 세포 회수 장치(cell saver device)를 이용한 자가수혈은 개에서 안전하고 다목적으로 사용 가능하며, 동종 혈액제제의 대안이 될 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 개 102마리와 고양이 1마리를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구이며, 응급수술 40건과 선택수술 63건에서 총 103건의 자가수혈을 시행했다. 평균 수혈량은 14 mL/kg이었고, 체중당 1 mL의 혈액 수혈 시 PCV는 약 0.6% 증가했으며, 동종 혈액제제는 14%의 사례에서 추가 사용되었고, 수혈반응 발생률은 1%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 세포 회수 장치는 다양한 응급 및 선택수술에서 출혈 관리에 적용 가능하고 동종 혈액제제 사용을 줄일 수 있으나, 고양이에서는 단 1례만 포함되어 있어 고양이에서의 안전성과 효과에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Influence of intra-articular injectate volume on joint surface coverage and leakage following canine elbow arthroscopy: A cadaveric study.
papers.authors: Smith E, Stark S, Boynton S, Gordon-Evans W
papers.abstract: To determine whether reduced intra-articular (IA) injection volumes provide complete synovial surface coverage while minimizing leakage following canine elbow arthroscopy. Randomized cadaveric study. Forty elbow joints from 20 canine cadavers weighing >15 kg. Standard medial elbow arthroscopy was performed with portals placed under arthroscopic guidance. The egress portal was created along the caudal margin of the medial epicondylar ridge, directed toward the anconeal process. A third, craniomedial instrument portal was created approximately 1 cm cranial to the camera portal. Following arthroscopy, India ink-volume-matched to whole, half, or quarter of a 0.5 mg/kg ropivacaine dose (0.75% concentration)-was injected via the egress portal. Each joint underwent 10 passive flexion-extension cycles before dissection. A masked investigator (ES) qualitatively assessed synovial surface coverage (100%, 75%-99%, 50%-74%, 25%-49%, 0%-24%) and leakage severity (mild, moderate, severe). Portal placement attempts, cadaver age, and bodyweight were recorded. Mean cadaver age was 9.3 years (range: 1-16 years), and mean weight was 29.9 kg (range: 17.9-43.6 kg). Complete (100%) synovial surface coverage was observed in all 40 elbows, including those receiving quarter-dose injections. Leakage occurred in every dose group, with a similar distribution of mild, moderate, and severe categories. Portal placement was successful on the first attempt in 32 elbows (80%) and the second attempt in eight elbows (20%). Reduced IA injection volumes achieved complete synovial surface coverage but did not reduce leakage severity. Reduced intra-articular injection volumes were sufficient to achieve complete synovial surface coverage in this model, suggesting potential flexibility in clinical dosing strategies. Nonetheless, extravasation occurred at all tested volumes, reinforcing that some leakage should be expected in practice.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 팔꿈치 관절경술 후 감소된 관절내 주입량(전체, 절반, 1/4 용량)에서도 100% 활막 표면 피복을 달성할 수 있으나, 용량 감소가 누출 심각도를 감소시키지는 못함.
[방법·수치] 체중 15kg 이상의 개 20마리에서 40개 팔꿈치 관절을 대상으로 한 무작위 시체 연구; 로피바카인 0.5mg/kg 용량의 전체, 절반, 1/4 용량을 주입(0.75% 농도); 모든 용량군에서 100% 활막 피복 달성; 모든 용량에서 누출 발생; 첫 시도 성공률 80%, 2회 차 시도 성공률 20%; 평균 개 나이 9.3년, 평균 체중 29.9kg.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 복용량 전략의 유연성을 시사하여 더 낮은 용량으로 완전한 활막 피복 달성 가능하나, 감소된 용량에서도 누출이 발생하므로 임상 실무에서는 어느 정도의 누출을 예상해야 함; 시체 연구로서 생체 반응과 차이 가능성.

papers.title: Computed tomography versus magnetic resonance imaging for the perioperative management of acute thoracolumbar intervertebral disc extrusion in non-ambulatory chondrodystrophic dogs.
papers.authors: Low D, Markovic A
papers.abstract: To determine whether perioperative management guided by conditional computed tomography-myelography (C-CTM) is non-inferior to magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) regarding functional outcome for acute thoracolumbar intervertebral disc extrusion (IVDE) in non-ambulatory chondrodystrophic dogs. Quasi-randomized natural experiment utilizing unscheduled MRI downtime as an exogenous instrument. A total of 560 client-owned dogs (MRI, 518 dogs; C-CTM, 42 dogs). A retrospective cohort study was conducted. The primary outcome was recovery of ambulation, analyzed with intention-to-treat (ITT) and per-protocol (PP) principles with a prespecified non-inferiority margin of -12%. Secondary outcomes included safety events (postoperative neurologic deterioration, progressive myelomalacia, major complications) and time-adjusted treatment costs. C-CTM was non-inferior to MRI for recovery of ambulation in both ITT (risk difference + 6.5%, 95% CI: -2.7%-15.7%, one-sided p < .001) and PP analyses (risk difference + 2.5%, 95% CI: -7.3%-12.2%, one-sided p < .001). There was no difference in rates of postoperative neurologic deterioration, progressive myelomalacia, or major complications. Total treatment costs and imaging costs were significantly lower for C-CTM (p < .01). There was no difference in non-imaging costs between groups. In non-ambulatory chondrodystrophic dogs with acute thoracolumbar IVDE, C-CTM is non-inferior to MRI for recovery of ambulation with a similar safety profile, at significantly lower cost. In dogs with a high pretest probability of acute thoracolumbar IVDE, routine use of MRI may not be justified given the comparable clinical outcomes and lower treatment costs achieved with C-CTM.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 급성 흉요추부 추간판 탈출증이 있는 비보행 연골이형성견에서 조건부 CT척수조영술(C-CTM)은 MRI와 비교하여 보행 회복에 있어 비열등성을 보였으며, 안전성 프로필도 유사합니다.
[방법·수치] 560마리 개(MRI 518마리, C-CTM 42마리)를 대상으로 한 후향적 코호트 연구로서, 의도된 치료 분석에서 C-CTM은 MRI 대비 보행 회복률에서 위험도 차이 +6.5% (95% CI: -2.7%-15.7%, 단측 p<0.001)를 보였고, 프로토콜 준수 분석에서 +2.5% (95% CI: -7.3%-12.2%, 단측 p<0.001)를 나타냈습니다. 술후 신경학적 악화, 진행성 척수연화증, 주요 합병증 발생률에는 차이가 없었으며, C-CTM의 총 치료비용과 영상 비용이 유의미하게 낮았습니다(p<0.01).
[임상 적용·한계] 급성 흉요추부 추간판 탈출증의 사전 확률이 높은 개에서 MRI 대신 C-CTM을 일상적으로 사용하여 비용을 절감하면서도 비교 가능한 임상 결과를 얻을 수 있습니다. 다만 본 연구는 MRI 가용성 부족이라는 특수한 환경에서의 자연 실험이며, C-CTM 군의 표본 크기가 상대적으로 작다는 한계가 있습니다.

papers.title: Surgical closure of labial and alveolar cleft defects with a modified Millard technique: A prospective study of ten dogs.
papers.authors: Maitre P, Jourdain M, Brignon P, Loin J, Corre P
papers.abstract: To provide a step-by-step description of canine lip/alveolar cleft repair, describe intra- and postoperative complications, and report mid-term clinical, functional and cosmetic outcomes. Prospective study. A total of 10 client-owned puppies with unilateral or bilateral lip/alveolar clefts. Detailed clinical and historical data were recorded. The lip/alveolar clefts were repaired using a surgical technique adapted from human medicine including: (1) alveolar cleft and labial vestibulum repair, (2) cheilorhinoplasty and (3) palatal cleft repair when indicated. Intra- and postoperative complications, as well as clinical, functional and cosmetic outcomes, were recorded at 7 and 14 days and at a minimum of 3 months postoperatively. Cosmetic outcomes were evaluated using postoperative CT measurements. A total of 10 puppies (4 males, 6 females) were included. Of these, six presented with unilateral lip/alveolar clefts (2 right-sided and 4 left-sided) and four presented with bilateral clefts. A total of 14 lip/alveolar clefts were repaired. Four dogs had a complete secondary palate cleft. No intraoperative surgical complications were reported. Three cases of minor dehiscence of the cheilorhinoplasty suture line were observed, all healed by second intention within 14 days postoperatively. One case of oronasal communication on the hard palate was successfully treated with minor revision surgery. Successful clinical and functional outcomes were reported for all dogs at the 3-month postoperative evaluation. Overall cosmetic outcomes were rated as good to excellent. The described step-by-step surgical technique resulted in good to excellent clinical, functional, and cosmetic outcomes. This technique offers a new surgical treatment with a low complication rate.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 인의학의 Millard 기법을 개선하여 개의 입술/치조골 열증에 적용한 단계적 수술 기법은 양호 이상의 임상·기능·미용적 결과를 제공하며 합병증 발생률이 낮다.
[방법·수치] 일측성 또는 양측성 입술/치조골 열증을 가진 임상견 자견 10마리(수컷 4마리, 암컷 6마리)를 대상으로 한 전향적 연구. 편측 열증 6마리(우측 2마리, 좌측 4마리), 양측 열증 4마리, 총 14개 열증 수술. 술중 합병증 없음, 술후 경미한 열개 3건(14일 내 자연 치유), 경구비강 교통 1건(재수술로 해결). 술후 3개월 추적 평가에서 모든 개에서 성공적 임상·기능적 결과 달성, 미용적 결과는 양호 이상 평가.
[임상 적용·한계] 선천성 입술/치조골 열증 소견을 보이는 자견의 조기 수술적 교정에 적용할 수 있으나, 소수 사례(10마리) 단일기관 연구로 대규모 검증이 필요하고 중장기 추적(3개월)에 그친 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Retrospective Review of Rush Allergen-Specific Immunotherapy Safety in Cats With Atopic Skin Syndrome.
papers.authors: Wirkkala A, Rosenkrantz W, Mendelsohn C, Griffin C, Schaufele S
papers.abstract: Rush immunotherapy (RIT) accelerates the induction phase of allergen-specific immunotherapy treatment (ASIT) by administering incrementally increasing allergen doses over a single day. This approach reduces the time required to maintenance dosing. Safety information in cats with atopic skin syndrome (FASS) remains limited. The objective of the study was to evaluate the safety of RIT in cats with hypersensitivity disease compatible with FASS and to describe the frequency and nature of adverse events. Forty-seven client-owned cats that underwent RIT. A multicentre medical record review from 2019 to 2024 was performed to identify cats that met at least six of 10 criteria for non-flea-induced hypersensitivity dermatitis and were therefore considered consistent with a diagnosis of FASS. All included cats received documented flea prevention and underwent elimination diet trials. Data collected included signalment, medical history, concurrent medications, RIT protocol details, monitoring findings and follow-up communication. Adverse events (AEs) were recorded. In three of 47 cats (6.4%), AEs were observed including tachypnoea, behavioural distress and increased pruritus. In one cat, RIT was discontinued before protocol completion. All affected cats transitioned to maintenance ASIT without recurrence of AEs. Rush immunotherapy appears to be safe in cats with FASS when performed with clinical monitoring. Adverse events were infrequent, mild and self-limiting, supporting use of accelerated induction protocols in appropriately selected patients.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 아토피성 피부증후군에서 러시 알레르겐특이면역요법은 임상 모니터링 하에 안전하며, 부작용은 드물고 경미하며 자가제한적이다.
[방법·수치] 2019~2024년 다중기관 의무기록 후향적 검토, 47마리 고양이 대상, 비벼룩유발 과민성피부염 10개 기준 중 최소 6개 이상 충족한 경우 포함, 부작용 발생률 6.4% (3/47마리, 빈맥·행동불안·가려움증 증가).
[임상 적용·한계] 적절히 선택된 환자에서 가속화된 유도 프로토콜 사용을 지지하며, 모든 부작용 고양이가 유지 면역요법으로 성공적 전환됨. 후향적 다중기관 연구로 표본 크기가 제한적이고 장기 추적 결과 제시 없음.

papers.title: Associations Between Otic Cytological Findings and Clinical Severity by Pathogen Group in Canine Otitis Externa: A Retrospective Study of 318 Cases.
papers.authors: Shin ES, Kang SY, Kim MS, Hwang CY
papers.abstract: Otic cytological assessment is routinely used in canine otitis externa (OE) to assess microbial burden and inflammation. Evidence that cytological findings are associated with clinical severity, particularly by pathogen group, remains limited. To evaluate associations between otic cytological findings and clinical severity in canine OE, overall and by pathogen group. Three hundred and eighteen client-owned dogs with OE presented to a referral dermatological service. Clinical severity was scored using the Otitis Index Score 3 (OTIS3; 0-12). Cytological findings were evaluated using a semiquantitative 0-3 scale for cocci, rods and Malassezia, based on predefined institutional criteria. A total cytological score (0-9) was calculated as the sum of the scores for the three groups. Neutrophil presence was also recorded. OTIS3 scores showed a moderate correlation with total cytological score (p < 0.0001; Spearman's r = 0.45). Scores increased significantly with higher cocci and rod cytological scores (Kruskal-Wallis, p < 0.0001), while Malassezia scores were not. OTIS3 scores also were significantly higher when neutrophils were present. Associations between otic cytological findings and clinical severity of OE varied by pathogen group. Greater clinical severity was associated with neutrophil presence and bacterial burden. These findings support the interpretation of cytological findings combined with OTIS3 for assessment and monitoring of canine OE.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 외이염에서 이경 세포학 검사 소견과 임상 중증도는 중등도의 상관관계를 보이며, 특히 중성구 존재와 세균 부담이 높을수록 임상 중증도가 증가한다.
[방법·수치] 318마리 개를 대상으로 한 후향적 연구이며, Otitis Index Score 3(OTIS3; 0-12)로 임상 중증도를 평가하고 세포학적 소견을 반정량적 0-3 척도로 평가하였다. 전체 세포학적 점수와 OTIS3 점수는 중등도 상관관계(Spearman's r=0.45, p<0.0001)를 보였고, 구균과 간균 점수가 높을수록 OTIS3 점수가 유의하게 증가(Kruskal-Wallis, p<0.0001)하였으며, 중성구 존재 시 OTIS3 점수가 유의하게 높았다.
[임상 적용·한계] 이경 세포학 검사 소견을 OTIS3와 함께 해석하면 개의 외이염 평가 및 모니터링에 도움이 되나, 병원체 군별로 세포학적 소견과 임상 중증도의 연관성이 다르므로 감별 진단 시 주의가 필요하다. 단일 의뢰 피부과 센터의 후향적 연구로 외부 적용 가능성에 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Exploring Normal to Abnormal Variations of Grooming Behaviours in Cats.
papers.authors: Guillon M, Naudin L, Cochet-Faivre N, Titeux E, Gilbert C
papers.abstract: Grooming is a maintenance behaviour accounting for 4% of a cat's activity budget. It consists of several short bouts, and is modified by pruritus and some psychogenic diseases in cats. This study aimed to describe cats' grooming behaviour, investigating normal variations in relation to hair length and grooming modifications in cats with psychogenic alopecia (fPA). We analysed 118 videos of 29 healthy cats and seven fPA shorthair cats. We studied five activities for nine body parts performed by cats during grooming, the duration and number of grooming bouts, according to hair length and health status. Major individual variations occurred between cats, with no differences regarding mean grooming bout duration according to hair length or health status. Most (95%) grooming bouts consisted in grooming two to seven body parts. Number of parts groomed by fPA cats was significantly lower than healthy shorthair cats; no differences were noted between healthy cats with different hair length. Hairless cats chewed their skin longer than other cats. fPA cats chewed their skin 10 times longer than healthy shorthair cats (p < 0.001). Licking and rubbing were shorter bouts (p = 0.021). Time spent grooming each zone did not differ with hair length. fPA cats groomed their internal hind limbs significantly longer (p = 0.016) and their neck shorter (p = 0.003) than healthy shorthair cats. This study allows a better understanding of cats' grooming behaviour, helping to identify abnormal grooming behaviours, and supports classification of psychogenic alopecia as an abnormal repetitive behaviour.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 정상 그루밍 행동은 개인차가 크며, 심인성 탈모증(fPA) 고양이는 피부 씹기가 정상 단모종 고양이보다 10배 길고, 그루밍하는 신체 부위 수가 유의하게 적으며, 뒷다리 내측은 더 오래 그루밍하고 목은 더 짧게 그루밍하는 특징을 보인다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 단모종 고양이 29마리, 심인성 탈모증 단모종 고양이 7마리의 118개 영상 분석; 그루밍 시간과 횟수, 신체 부위별 그루밍 활동 조사; fPA 고양이의 피부 씹기 시간이 정상 단모종 고양이의 10배(p<0.001), 핥기와 비비기 시간이 더 짧음(p=0.021), 뒷다리 내측 그루밍 시간 유의하게 길음(p=0.016), 목 그루밍 시간 유의하게 짧음(p=0.003).
[임상 적용·한계] 심인성 탈모증을 비정상 반복행동으로 분류하는 근거를 제공하며, 임상 진료에서 과도한 피부 씹기와 뒷다리 집중 그루밍을 심인성 탈모증의 주요 지표로 활용할 수 있다; 샘플 크기가 작고 단일 형태의 고양이 그룹만 비교한 한계가 있다.

papers.title: External Validation of a Custom-Trained Artificial Intelligence Model for Canine Ear Canal Disease and Comparison With Veterinary Professionals.
papers.authors: McInnis M, Liu CC, Arbona V, Apostolopoulos N
papers.abstract: Otitis externa (OE) is common in dogs, yet accurate otoscopic diagnosis remains challenging. Artificial intelligence (AI) may augment clinical decision-making in otoscopy. Previous work suggested that dataset size and duplicate images affect model performance. External validation of four YOLOv8n models using new images and comparison with six veterinary professionals of varying experience. We expected that models trained on larger, deduplicated datasets would demonstrate superior performance, and that the best-performing model would outperform non-specialist veterinary professionals while remaining comparable to board-certified referral clinicians. Four YOLOv8n models (A-D) were trained using different dataset compositions and externally validated on 300 previously unseen otoscopic images (100 healthy, 100 OE, 100 ear canal masses). Predictions were compared with reference labels assigned by a board-certified referral clinician. Six veterinary professionals independently classified the same images, blinded to ground truth and AI outputs. Performance was assessed across multiple confidence thresholds (0.25-0.75) using overall agreement, Cohen's κ, sensitivity and specificity. Model D (largest deduplicated dataset) demonstrated the highest external performance, achieving 66.3% agreement and κ = 0.508 at a 0.25 confidence threshold. Classwise sensitivity/specificity for Model D (0.25) were: healthy (90.0%/69.0%), OE (59.0%/75.5%) and mass (50.0%/93.5%). Veterinary professionals outperformed all AI models (median agreement 77.2%, κ = 0.658), with the referral clinician achieving the highest concordance. Model D generalised best during external validation yet remained inferior to veterinary professionals. These results support the model's role as a decision-support tool rather than a replacement for clinical expertise.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 외이도질환 진단을 위해 훈련된 맞춤형 AI 모델(YOLOv8n)은 외부 검증에서 수의사보다 성능이 낮았으며, 의사결정 보조 도구로서의 역할에 적합함이 확인되었다.
[방법·수치] 서로 다른 데이터셋으로 훈련된 4개의 YOLOv8n 모델을 300개의 미공개 이경검사 이미지(정상 100장, 외이염 100장, 이도종괴 100장)로 외부 검증했으며, 6명의 수의사와 성능을 비교했다. 모델 D(가장 큰 중복제거 데이터셋)는 신뢰도 임계값 0.25에서 66.3% 일치도와 κ=0.508을 달성했고, 민감도/특이도는 정상(90.0%/69.0%), 외이염(59.0%/75.5%), 종괴(50.0%/93.5%)였다. 수의사들은 중앙값 77.2% 일치도와 κ=0.658을 보였으며 전문의가 가장 높은 일치도를 나타냈다.
[임상 적용·한계] AI 모델은 외이도질환 진단의 보조 도구로 임상 의사결정을 지원할 수 있으나, 현재 성능 수준에서는 수의사의 임상 판단을 대체할 수 없다. 외부 검증에 국한되었고, 단일 모델 구조로 평가되었으며, 임상 활용을 위해서는 추가 최적화가 필요하다.

papers.title: Standardising Assessment of Superficial Pyoderma in Dogs: Proposal of a Severity Score.
papers.authors: Pinto M, Grass D, Herrmann I
papers.abstract: Superficial pyoderma is common in dogs with atopic dermatitis, yet no validated and widely accepted severity scoring system exists. To develop a predictor for superficial pyoderma severity based on reliable objective lesion quantification combined with a clinician-assigned numerical severity rating. Sixty client-owned dogs presenting with follicular papules, pustules, epidermal collarettes, and/or yellow crusts were prospectively enrolled. Six clinicians assessed lesion types, numerical and categorical disease severity, and treatment efficacy at baseline and at up to two follow-up visits. Lesions were quantified by counting individual papules and pustules, and by standardised area measurements for confluent papules/pustules, epidermal collarettes and crusts. Inter- and intra-clinician reliability were evaluated. A predictive model for pyoderma severity was subsequently developed using lesion quantification and clinician-assigned numerical severity scores. Recognition of specific lesion types and categorical severity assessments showed poor agreement between clinicians, indicating limited reliability for severity assessment. By contrast, combined lesion quantification demonstrated good inter- and intra-clinician reliability, and clinician-assigned numerical severity scores showed good inter-clinician reliability. The resulting predictive model demonstrated good agreement with clinician-assigned severity scores, estimating pyoderma severity on a continuous scale from 0 (no pyoderma) to 100 (worst conceivable pyoderma), with a mean absolute error of approximately nine severity points per case. The proposed scoring system relies on combined lesion quantification without the need for subjective categorical grading. Although further validation is required, it provides a foundation for objective assessment of superficial pyoderma severity and introduces a mathematical model that translates combined lesion burden into clinician-perceived disease severity.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 표재성 농피증 심각도를 객관적으로 평가하기 위해 개별 병변 계산 및 표준화된 면적 측정을 결합한 정량화 체계와 예측 모델을 개발했으며, 주관적 등급 분류 없이 0~100 척도로 심각도를 연속적으로 추정할 수 있음을 입증했다.
[방법·수치] 표재성 농피증을 보이는 60마리 개를 대전향적으로 등록했고, 6명의 임상의가 기저선과 최대 2회 추적 방문 시 병변 유형, 수치적·범주적 심각도, 치료 효과를 평가했다. 병변 정량화는 개별 여드름과 농포 계수 및 표준화된 면적 측정으로 수행했으며, 임상의 간 신뢰도는 양호(합의 양호), 임상의 내 신뢰도는 양호였고, 개발된 예측 모델의 평균 절대 오차는 사례당 약 9점이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 임상의가 특정 병변 유형을 인식하고 범주적 심각도를 평가할 때 임상의 간 합의가 불량했으나, 결합된 병변 정량화는 신뢰할 만한 객관적 평가를 가능하게 한다. 추가 검증이 필요하며 단일 등록 연구로 외적 타당성에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Fibroepithelial Polyps of the Ear Canal in Dogs: A Retrospective Analysis of 17 Cases.
papers.authors: Mendes C, Berto L, Costa A, Nordio L, Bertolini G
papers.abstract: Fibroepithelial polyps (FEPs) are well-characterised benign hyperplastic lesions of the skin and mucous membranes. Little is known about their localisation in the ear canal of dogs. To provide clinical, endoscopic, computed tomography (CT) and histological descriptions of aural (a)FEPs in 14 dogs. Fourteen client-owned dogs diagnosed with aFEPs between 2018 and 2025. Retrospective analysis of the electronic medical records of dogs diagnosed with aFEPs based on compatible histopathological findings. Seventeen aFEPs were described in 14 dogs. All dogs were of brachycephalic breeds, and French bulldogs were the most common breed. Most dogs had a history of chronic-recurrent otitis externa (n = 12) and a diagnosis of atopic dermatitis (n = 10). Ear cytological results showed neutrophilic inflammation with bacteria in 14 of 17 cases. CT scan detected 15 of 17 aFEPs. In all cases, video-otoscopy revealed the presence of a pedunculated neoformation of variable size. All lesions were removed during the endoscopic procedure with a polypectomy snare or grasping forceps. Histologically, all masses were characterised by a broad fibrous core with a narrow stalk covered by either keratinised or keratinised and ciliated epithelium. Thirteen polyps contained broad trabeculae of bone. In two dogs, a second endoscopic procedure was needed to completely remove residual polyp fragments. During the follow-up period (1-80 months), 13 of the 14 dogs experienced no relapses. In dogs, aFEPs present distinctive histopathological characteristics and should be differentiated from other aural masses. Identification and removal of aFEPs might be critical for the resolution of chronic-recurrent otitis in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 귀도 섬유상피종양(fibroepithelial polyps)은 양성 과형성 병변으로 단독 또는 다중으로 발생하며, 내시경 절제술로 완전 제거 시 만성재발성 외이염의 해결에 중요한 역할을 한다.
[방법·수치] 2018-2025년 진단받은 단두종 개 14마리에서 17개의 귀도 섬유상피종양의 후향적 분석; 대상견 중 단두종만 해당, 프렌치불독이 가장 많음(n=12 만성재발성외이염, n=10 아토피성피부염, 세포학 검사에서 14/17에서 세균동반 호중구염증 소견, CT 15/17 감지), 평균 추적관찰 기간 1-80개월에 13/14마리에서 재발 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 비디오이경검사로 확진 가능하며 내시경 폴립절제술 또는 집게로 완전 제거 권장; 2마리에서 2차 시술 필요했으므로 불완전 제거 가능성 고려 필요, 단일기관 후향적 소규모 연구로 대표성 제한.

papers.title: Cutaneous Reactive Histiocytosis in Golden Retrievers: An Immunohistochemical Approach.
papers.authors: Albanese F, Lazzarini G, Orlandi M, Pirone A, Miragliotta V
papers.abstract: Canine cutaneous reactive histiocytosis (CRH) is a proliferative histiocytic disease characterised by the accumulation of dendritic cells (DCs). Differentiating CRH from other infectious or non-infectious granulomatous or histiocyte-rich diseases is challenging on histological evidence alone. This study aims to characterise the predominant histiocytic population in 11 golden retrievers with histological features compatible with CRH, using ionised calcium-binding adapter molecule 1 (Iba1) and a validated macrophage antibodies cocktail for canine skin diseases. Eleven golden retriever dogs were enrolled with a clinical and histological diagnosis of CRH. Paraffin-embedded skin biopsy samples from cases with a confirmed diagnosis of CRH were evaluated to identify the histiocytic cell type. Two antibody reagents were used: (1) anti-Iba1 (goat polyclonal), a broad histiocytic marker and (2) a cocktail of rabbit recombinant monoclonal antibodies against CD11b, CD68, CD163, CD14 and CD16 to phenotype cutaneous macrophages. All cases showed positive immunostaining with both antibodies. Although Iba1 immunostaining was diffuse in most of the histiocytoid cell population, only a few scattered histiocytoid cells stained with the anti-macrophage antibody cocktail. Strong Iba1 positivity in the histiocytoid cells, together with their lack of staining for macrophage markers, supports a dendritic cell phenotype and is consistent with a diagnosis of CRH. In conclusion, using a macrophage marker in combination with a broad histiocytic marker may help to distinguish CRH from granulomatous, macrophage-rich diseases in paraffin-embedded skin tissue.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 피부 반응성 조직구증(CRH)은 수지상세포의 축적을 특징으로 하며, Iba1 항체와 대식세포 항체 칵테일의 조합 사용으로 육아종성 질환이나 대식세포 풍부 질환과 구별 가능하다.
[방법·수치] 11마리의 골든 리트리버에서 CRH 조직학적 진단을 받은 파라핀 포매 피부생검 샘플을 Iba1(염화칼슘 결합 어댑터 분자1) 항체 및 CD11b, CD68, CD163, CD14, CD16에 대한 대식세포 항체 칵테일로 면역조직화학 검사를 수행했다. 모든 증례에서 두 항체 모두 양성 면역염색을 보였고, Iba1은 광범위한 양성이나 대식세포 항체 칵테일에는 산재된 소수 세포만 양성이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] Iba1 양성이면서 대식세포 마커 음성인 소견은 수지상세포 표현형을 지지하며 CRH 진단을 뒷받침한다. 본 연구는 소규모(n=11) 단일 견종 대상 연구로, 다른 견종이나 고양이 질환에 적용 가능성은 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Osseous Changes in Young Cats With Inflammatory Aural Polyps: A Cone Beam Computed Tomography Analysis.
papers.authors: Colón Rodríguez A, Campanale DN, Sarment D, Canfield MS
papers.abstract: Computed tomography is an imaging tool that has been used in veterinary medicine with excellent results to evaluate changes associated with inflammatory aural polyps (IPs) in feline patients. There is no known veterinary literature investigating the use of cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) to identify osseous changes in the middle and inner ear associated with IPs in cats. This study evaluates the utility of CBCT to identify osseous changes in the middle and inner ear associated with IPs in young cats, and to determine the frequency of osseous changes in young cats. Review of 38 medical records of cats diagnosed with IPs presented to a private practice dermatological service. CBCT bone window studies at a 0.3-mm isotropic slice thickness were performed without contrast and later evaluated by a board-certified veterinary radiologist. CBCT images were adequate to identify normal and affected structures in the middle and inner ear of cats. The most common osseous changes in descending order of occurrence were mild-to-severe bulla thickening (65.7%), auditory tube widening (52.6%), and cochlear and ossicular chain lysis (7.8%). This study demonstrates that CBCT is useful as an initial imaging diagnostic when an IP is suspected in cats. Osseous changes such as tympanic bulla thickening, cochlear and ossicular chain lysis, and auditory tube and internal acoustic meatus widening on CBCT imaging could be indicatory of an inflammatory aural polyp.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이의 염증성 이경 용종(IP) 진단에서 콘빔 컴퓨터단층촬영(CBCT)은 중이와 내이의 골변화를 효과적으로 식별할 수 있으며, 특히 고막포의 비후(65.7%), 청각관 확장(52.6%), 달팽이관 및 소골 용해(7.8%)가 주요 골변화 소견이다.
[방법·수치] 염증성 이경 용종으로 진단된 38마리 고양이의 의료기록을 후향적으로 검토하였고, 조영제 없이 0.3mm 등방성 슬라이스 두께의 CBCT 뼈창(bone window) 영상을 획득하여 수의방사선과 전문의가 평가했다.
[임상 적용·한계] CBCT는 고양이에서 염증성 이경 용종이 의심될 때 초기 영상진단 도구로 유용하게 사용될 수 있으며, 고막포 비후 및 골용해 소견은 질병의 지표가 될 수 있다. 단일 개인의원의 피부과 환자를 대상으로 한 연구로 일반화의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Fluorescent Light Energy (FLE) as an Adjunctive Therapy in Canine Cutaneous Epitheliotropic Lymphoma (CTCL).
papers.authors: Nowell S, Fantini O, Roman A, Milley C, Watson J
papers.abstract: Fluorescent light energy (FLE; Phovia, Vetoquinol) is a photobiomodulation therapy that promotes healing and reduces inflammation. Cutaneous epitheliotropic lymphoma (CTCL) is a neoplastic skin disease with limited treatment options. Although FLE is not considered genotoxic, its use in neoplastic conditions is off-label. To assess the safety and clinical effect of FLE as an adjunctive treatment for canine CTCL. Eight client-owned dogs were diagnosed with CTCL via biopsy analysis and immunohistochemical analysis. Each dog had one CTCL lesion treated with FLE with a lesion serving as a vehicle-control. Treatments were administered weekly for 6 weeks, followed by 3 months follow-up. Focal nodular lesions were assessed weekly using Response Evaluation Criteria of Solid Tumours (RECIST), while diffuse lesions were evaluated using the Canine Epitheliotropic Lymphoma Extent and Severity Index (CELESI). Owner-perceived efficacy and quality of life were assessed using the Owner Global Assessment of Treatment Efficacy (OGATE) and a quality-of-life (QoL) survey. No statistically significant differences in estimated marginal means were observed between sites at any time point (p > 0.05). Within-subject analyses suggested more favourable lesion progression at FLE-treated sites, and 75% of RECIST-evaluated FLE lesions maintained stable disease. Diffuse FLE-treated lesions demonstrated clinical severity reductions of ≤ 35.3%. Over 66% of owners rated treatment response as 'fair' to 'excellent' on the OGATE. One dog was withdrawn at Week 3 as a consequence of unrelated worsening. FLE appears to be a safe adjunctive therapy for canine CTCL, although statistically significant treatment effects were not demonstrated.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 형광 광에너지(FLE)는 개의 피부상피친화성림프종(CTCL)에 대한 보조치료로 안전하나, 통계적으로 유의한 치료 효과는 입증되지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 생검 및 면역조직화학으로 진단된 CTCL 환자견 8마리를 대상으로 한 병변당 FLE 치료군과 대조군을 6주간 주 1회 치료 후 3개월 추적 관찰했다. 초점성 결절병변은 RECIST, 미만성병변은 CELESI로 평가했으며, RECIST 평가 병변의 75%가 안정적 질병 유지, 미만성 병변에서 임상적 중증도 감소 ≤35.3%, 주인 평가(OGATE)에서 66% 이상이 '양호'~'우수'로 평가, 모든 시점에서 통계적 유의차 없음(p>0.05).
[임상 적용·한계] FLE는 CTCL 보조치료로 안전성 프로필이 양호하고 임상적 경향의 개선을 보이므로 종양 질환에서의 비표준 적응증 사용을 고려할 수 있으나, 소규모(n=8) 단일기관 연구이고 통계적 유의성 미달로 더 큰 규모의 무작위 대조군 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Comparative Efficacy and Safety of Adjunctive 0.015% Triamcinolone Acetonide Topical Spray With Lokivetmab Versus Lokivetmab Monotherapy as 'Reactive Therapy' for Canine Atopic Dermatitis: A Randomised, Single-Blinded, Controlled Preliminary Trial.
papers.authors: Banovic F, Austel M, Johnson L, von Simson C
papers.abstract: Lokivetmab is considered an effective systemic therapy for dogs with atopic dermatitis (AD); however, utilisation of lokivetmab with adjunctive topical anti-inflammatory glucocorticoids has not been investigated in canine AD. To evaluate the efficacy and safety of the combination therapy of lokivetmab and 0.015% triamcinolone acetonide (TCA) spray in dogs with AD. Twenty dogs with nonseasonal AD. This study was a randomised, single-blinded (investigators only) 4-week controlled trial. Dogs were randomised to receive lokivetmab monotherapy or lokivetmab-TCA spray per manufacturer instructions. Clinical assessments included the Canine Atopic Dermatitis Extent and Severity Index, 4th iteration (CADESI-04), CADESI-04E (i.e., extracted erythema grade alone) and the 10-grade pruritus Visual Analog Scale (PVAS10) at Day (D)0, D14 and D28. Complete blood count and serum biochemical analysis were performed on D0 and D28. The median CADESI-04 and CADESI-04E scores in the lokivetmab-TCA group were significantly reduced on D14 (p < 0.05 for both) and D28 (p < 0.01 for both) compared to baseline; there were no significant differences in lesional scores at any time point for the lokivetmab monotherapy group. Lokivetmab-TCA significantly reduced CADESI-04E values compared to the lokivetmab monotherapy group on D28 (p = 0.04). Both interventions significantly reduced PVAS10 scores on D14 and D28 compared to D0 (p < 0.05 for both groups). Topical application of TCA spray may be a useful and safe adjunctive therapy for systemic lokivetmab to alleviate pruritus and clinical lesions in the initial management of canine AD patients.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 국소 트리암시놀론 아세토나이드(TCA) 스프레이를 lokivetmab과 병용하면 단독 투여 대비 개의 아토피성 피부염 치료 초기에 임상 병변과 소양증을 더 효과적으로 감소시킨다.
[방법·수치] 비계절성 아토피성 피부염 개 20마리를 대상으로 한 4주 무작위 배정, 단일맹검 대조시험으로 진행했다. CADESI-04 점수는 lokivetmab-TCA 군에서 D14(p<0.05), D28(p<0.01)에 감소했으나 단독 투여군은 유의한 감소 없음. CADESI-04E(홍반)는 D28에 lokivetmab-TCA군이 단독투여군보다 유의하게 감소(p=0.04). 소양증 점수(PVAS10)는 양 군 모두 D14, D28에서 감소(p<0.05).
[임상 적용·한계] 국소 TCA 스프레이는 lokivetmab 초기 치료 단계에서 소양증과 임상 병변 완화의 안전한 보조 치료법이 될 수 있다. 소규모(n=20) 단일맹검 예비연구로 더 큰 규모의 연구 필요.

papers.title: Clinical Efficacy of Probiotic-Based Ear Drops Containing Lactobacilli in Canine Erythroceruminous Otitis Externa: An Open Label, Multicentre Study.
papers.authors: Carrasco I, Homedes J, Arcas A, Beasley S, Salichs M
papers.abstract: Otitis externa (OE) represents a common clinical problem in dogs. Allergic dogs exhibit reduced diversity of the otic microbiota, and inflammation-induced changes in the ear canal microenvironment result in a further decline in microbial biodiversity. Probiotics have demonstrated efficacy in certain dermatological conditions, including atopic dermatitis, which is, in turn, the leading primary cause of OE in dogs. To evaluate the efficacy of probiotic-based ear drops in controlling clinical signs related to erythroceruminous non-infected OE in dogs. Thirty-seven privately owned dogs with non-infected OE. Dogs received probiotic-based ear drops topically every 48 h for 28 days, in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions. Assessments were performed at enrolment (Day [D]0), D14 and D28, including cytological evaluation of ear discharge, pruritus intensity (PVAS, pruritis Visual Analogue Scale), severity of otic lesions (OTIS3, 0-3 Otitis Index Score) and a quality-of-life survey (QoL). At enrolment (D0), mean OTIS3 and PVAS scores for all included animals were 5.11 ± 1.20 and 4.93 ± 1.51, respectively. Both scores decreased significantly by D28, to 1.66 ± 1.75 and 2.09 ± 2.03, respectively. Clinical improvement was evident regardless of concomitant medication use or the type of micro-organism's overgrowth observed during the initial cytological assessment. Owner-reported QoL improved in 80% of the dogs. These probiotic-based ear drops may be a useful adjunctive therapy in cases of canine non-infectious erythroceruminous OE.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 락토바실러스 함유 프로바이오틱 귀약은 개의 비감염성 적색이루성 외이염 임상증상 조절에 효과적이며, 동반 약물 투여 여부나 초기 미생물 과증식 유형과 관계없이 개선 효과를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 비감염성 외이염을 가진 37마리의 개를 대상으로 프로바이오틱 귀약을 48시간마다 28일간 국소투여했다. 평가는 D0, D14, D28에 시행되었으며, OTIS3 점수는 D0 5.11±1.20에서 D28 1.66±1.75로, PVAS(가려움증 시각유사척도)는 D0 4.93±1.51에서 D28 2.09±2.03으로 유의하게 감소했다. 삶의질 개선은 80%의 개에서 보고되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 비감염성 적색이루성 외이염의 보조치료제로 활용 가능하나, 단일 치료 효능을 평가하지 못한 개방표지 연구이고 대조군이 없으며 표본크기가 작다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Therapeutic Outcomes and Owner Assessment in Canine Sebaceous Adenitis Across Breeds: A Multicentre Retrospective Analysis and Owner Survey.
papers.authors: Batt H, Griffin J, Daniels MW, Miller J
papers.abstract: Sebaceous adenitis (SA) is an idiopathic dermatological condition with numerous treatment modalities and variable clinical outcomes. No studies have compared breed response to therapies or evaluated owner perception of the disease. Goals of this retrospective analysis were to evaluate response to therapy in dogs with SA, identify if breed or treatment modality impacted therapeutic outcome and assess owner perception of response to implemented therapies. Medical records over a 10-year period from a multicentre veterinary dermatology group were evaluated and an owner survey was conducted. Response to therapy was based on percentage reduction in medication scores at the start of treatment compared to maintenance and the number of flares after attaining maintenance. Time to maintenance was calculated for each treatment modality category. Owner survey responses were compared to objective clinical response categories. One hundred and twenty-two dogs with SA were included; 35 respondents completed the survey. The number of cases in objective clinical response categories were as follows: excellent in 23 cases (18.9%), good in 36 (29.5%), fair in 26 (21.3%), no improvement in 13 (10.7%) and progressive in 23 (18.9%). Medication score differences by breed were not statistically significant (p-value 0.114). Dogs treated with multimodal therapy achieved maintenance the fastest. Thirty-nine percent of dogs experienced a flare after reaching maintenance. Owner perceptions did not align significantly with objective response categories. In SA, therapeutic outcomes cannot be predicted based on breed or treatment modality, confirming the need for tailored case management and medication adjustments based on individual treatment response.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 지루성 선염(sebaceous adenitis)은 품종이나 단일 치료 방식으로 치료 반응을 예측할 수 없으며, 개별 반응에 따른 맞춤형 치료 조정이 필수적이다.
[방법·수치] 10년간 다중기관 수의피부과 의료기록 122마리 개와 주인 설문 35명 대상 후향적 분석으로, 완전관해 18.9%(23예), 좋음 29.5%(36예), 보통 21.3%(26예), 호전 없음 10.7%(13예), 악화 18.9%(23예)로 분류했으며, 품종에 따른 약물점수 차이는 유의하지 않았고(p=0.114) 복합치료가 가장 빠르게 유지용량에 도달했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 주인의 주관적 평가가 객관적 임상 반응과 일치하지 않으므로 객관적 임상지표 모니터링이 중요하며, 유지용량 도달 후 39%에서 재발이 발생했음을 고려하여 장기 추적관찰이 필요하다. 한계로는 단일 품종별 표본수가 작고 주인 설문 응답률이 낮다(35/122).

papers.title: Clinical Signs and Offending Food Allergens in Canine Cutaneous Adverse Food Reactions in Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia: A Prospective Study.
papers.authors: Hernadi H, Siew HH
papers.abstract: Skin responses to dietary components in dogs are referred to as cutaneous adverse food reactions (CAFRs). The most frequently reported offending food allergens in dogs from Australia, Europe and North America are beef, dairy products, chicken, wheat and lamb. To determine the clinical signs and common offending food allergens associated with CAFRs of dogs from Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia. Forty-nine client-owned dogs with nonseasonal pruritus were referred to dermatology speciality practices in Malaysia and Singapore, and general practices in Indonesia between 2022 and 2024. After the exclusion of the other pruritic diseases, the dogs completed an elimination diet trial and relapsed on challenge. The offending protein source was recorded in addition to the breed, age of onset of disease and presenting clinical signs. Chicken protein was the most common allergen reported in Malaysia (65%), Singapore (31%) and Indonesia (63%). The most commonly affected breeds with CAFR were cross-breed in Malaysia (27%) and poodles in Singapore (22%) and Indonesia (38%). The mean age of onset of the dogs with CAFRs from the three countries was between 1 and 3 years of age (45%), with < 1 year of age reported less frequently (37%). Pedal pruritus and/or otitis were the most clinical signs affecting 68% of dogs. Chicken protein is the common offending food allergen associated with CAFRs in Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia, and clinical signs of pedal pruritus and, or otitis should warrant investigation of CAFRs once the pruritic dermatoses have been eliminated.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 말레이시아, 싱가포르, 인도네시아의 개에서 식이성 피부 이상반응(CAFR)의 주요 원인 단백질은 닭고기(65-63%)이며, 주요 임상증상은 발바닥 가려움증 및/또는 외이염(68%)이다.
[방법·수치] 2022-2024년 3개국 피부과 전문 클리닉 및 개원의에 의뢰된 비계절성 가려움증을 보이는 개 49마리를 대상으로 제거식이 시험 후 유발시험을 실시하여 원인 단백질 원을 기록했다. 닭고기는 말레이시아 65%, 싱가포르 31%, 인도네시아 63%에서 가장 흔했고, 질병 발생 평균 연령은 1-3세(45%), 1세 미만(37%)이었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 개에서 발바닥 가려움증 또는 외이염이 있을 때 다른 가려움증 피부질환을 배제한 후 CAFR을 조사해야 하며, 아시아 태평양 지역에서는 닭고기 단백질을 제거식이에 우선적으로 고려해야 한다. 소규모 대상군과 아시아 특정 지역만 포함된 연구이므로 다른 지역으로의 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Faecal Microbiota Transplantation Reduces Lesion Severity and Medication Use in Canine Atopic Dermatitis: A Randomised, Placebo-Controlled, Double-Blinded Clinical Trial.
papers.authors: Felten V, West EA, Martini F, Favrot C, Unterer S
papers.abstract: Faecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) is an established therapy for gastrointestinal disease, yet its role in canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) remains unclear. We hypothesised that adjunctive FMT improves clinical severity and reduces symptomatic medication use in dogs with cAD. The objective was to evaluate efficacy and safety versus placebo. Forty-six client-owned dogs with naturally occurring cAD were enrolled from a referral hospital population; 40 completed the study (FMT n = 20, placebo n = 20). Prospective, randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blinded clinical trial. Dogs received daily oral lyophilised FMT capsules for 90 days plus three monthly rectal FMT administrations (Day [D]0, D30, D60) or placebo capsules with sham handling. Concomitant symptomatic therapies were permitted. Outcomes included Canine Atopic Dermatitis Extent and Severity Index, fourth iteration (CADESI-04), pruritus Visual Analog Scale (PVAS), Medication Score (D0-90) and Owner Global Assessment of Treatment Efficacy (OGATE, D90). CADESI-04 scores were lower with FMT at month (M) 2 (7 ± 6 vs. 16 ± 12; p = 0.006) and month 3 (8 ± 6 vs. 15 ± 12; p = 0.020). Sustained responders (≥ 50% CADESI-04 improvement at M2 and M3) were more frequent with FMT (35% vs. 5%; p = 0.044). In the FMT group, the medication scores were lower at M2 (16 ± 10 vs. 23 ± 11; p = 0.033) and M3 (13 ± 10 vs. 24 ± 15; p = 0.007) compared to placebo. PVAS decreased in both groups without between-group differences. OGATE favoured FMT (p = 0.028). FMT was well tolerated. Adjunctive FMT reduced lesion severity and medication requirements, supporting its use as a safe microbiome-based add-on therapy in cAD.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 아토피성 피부염(cAD)에 대한 보조 치료로서 분변 미생물 이식(FMT)은 병변 심각도를 감소시키고 약물 사용량을 줄이며 안전하게 사용할 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 자연발생 cAD를 가진 40마리의 개(FMT군 20마리, 위약군 20마리)를 대상으로 한 전향적 무작위 위약-대조 이중맹검 임상시험으로, 90일간 경구 동결건조 FMT 캡슐과 3회 직장 FMT 투여(0일, 30일, 60일)를 실시했다. CADESI-04 점수는 2개월째 FMT군 7±6 vs 위약군 16±12 (p=0.006), 3개월째 8±6 vs 15±12 (p=0.020)이었고, 지속 반응자(CADESI-04 50% 이상 개선, 2-3개월)는 FMT군 35% vs 위약군 5% (p=0.044)였으며, 약물 점수도 FMT군에서 2개월째(p=0.033), 3개월째(p=0.007) 더 낮았다.
[임상 적용·한계] FMT는 cAD의 안전한 미생물 기반 보조 치료법으로 사용될 수 있으나, 단일 기관 연구이고 샘플 크기가 제한적이며 장기 추적 데이터가 부재하다.

papers.title: Treatment Choices for Acute Canine Otitis Externa in Sweden, Finland and Norway: A Comparative Study With a Focus on Antibiotic Use.
papers.authors: Saarinen K, Ljungquist D, Seppänen R, Kaimio M, Andersson AM
papers.abstract: Canine otitis externa (COE) is one of the most frequently recorded disorders in veterinary practices, making it an important focus for antibiotic stewardship. To investigate and compare treatment regimens for acute COE in Finland, Norway and Sweden, with a focus on antibiotic use. 1060 dogs with acute COE lasting for ≤ 4 weeks. This was a multicentre cross-sectional study based on a point prevalence survey conducted among Swedish, Finnish and Norwegian veterinary surgeons within a corporate group during spring 2024. In the survey, each practice had been asked to include the first 20 consecutive cases of acute COE and register information about their diagnostic and therapeutic management. Overall, antibiotic treatment was used in 18% of cases (190 of 1060 dogs), predominantly topical, with systemic use only reported in six cases. Antibiotic use was significantly higher in Norway (28%) and Finland (29%) than in Sweden (2%; p < 0.001). The most frequently used antibiotic was polymyxin B. Antibiotic treatment was more strongly associated with cytological findings, especially the presence of neutrophils and rods, than with clinical presentation. Overall, glucocorticoid treatment was used in 94% and ear cleaner in 89% of cases, with some differences between countries. In this study, most acute COE cases were managed with glucocorticoids and ear cleaners without antibiotics. Swedish practices stood out with a notably low antibiotic use of 2%. Our results provide valuable information on antibiotic use for acute COE in three Nordic countries, inspiring future antibiotic stewardship efforts.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 급성 개 외이염의 대부분은 글루코코르티코이드와 이도 세정제로 항생제 없이 관리되며, 항생제 사용은 국가별로 큰 차이를 보인다(스웨덴 2%, 노르웨이·핀란드 각 29%).
[방법·수치] 스웨덴·노르웨이·핀란드의 동물병원 1060마리 개의 급성 외이염(≤4주) 사례를 대상으로 한 다기관 횡단 연구(2024년 봄), 항생제 사용 18%(190/1060), 대부분 국소 투여(경신투여 6건만), 최빈 항생제는 polymyxin B, 글루코코르티코이드 94%, 이도 세정제 89%에서 사용(p<0.001).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 증상보다 세포학적 소견(호중구·간균 존재)이 항생제 사용과 더 강한 연관을 보여 감별 진단의 중요성을 강조하며, 스웨덴의 낮은 항생제 사용은 항생제 내성 관리 모범 사례를 제시한다; 단, 한 시점의 횡단 연구이고 장기 임상 경과는 추적되지 않았다.

papers.title: Oclacitinib for Controlling Pruritus and Associated Skin Lesions in 16 Horses With Allergic Dermatitis.
papers.authors: Tunhikorn M, Maneephan P, Tovanakasame N, Kampang C, Jandee P
