papers.abstract: Oclacitinib is a Janus kinase inhibitor approved for the treatment of pruritus associated with allergic dermatitis in dogs and may be effective in horses. To evaluate the efficacy of oclacitinib in reducing pruritus and skin lesions in horses with allergic dermatitis. Sixteen horses aged ≥ 18 months. Horses received oclacitinib at 0.25 mg/kg orally once daily for 21 days. Changes in haematological and biochemical parameters were measured on Day (D)0 and D21. The owners were instructed to evaluate the horses using the pruritus Visual Analog Scale (PVAS) on D0, D4, D7, D10, D14, D17 and D21. A veterinary surgeon evaluated skin lesions using a veterinarian lesion score (VLS) and veterinarian alopecia score (VAS) on D0, D7, D14 and D21. From baseline to D21, the median (range) PVAS changed from 5 (4-8) to 2.5 (2-4.5), VLS from 19 (2-42) to 10 (1-38) and VAS from 2 (2, 3) to 2 (1, 2). Of all 16 horses, improvements in PVAS, VLS and VAS were observed in 15, 12 and 8 horses, respectively. Blood profiles revealed significantly increased aspartate aminotransferase, gamma-glutamyl transferase and creatinine levels. White blood cell count, lymphocyte count and blood urea nitrogen significantly decreased. Creatine kinase levels showed individual variability. Oclacitinib effectively reduced pruritus and improved skin lesions in horses with allergic dermatitis. However, caution is advised when administering the drug to horses with renal, hepatic or muscular disorders.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] Oclacitinib은 말의 알레르기성 피부염으로 인한 소양증과 피부병변을 효과적으로 감소시킨다.
[방법·수치] 18개월 이상 말 16두에서 oclacitinib 0.25 mg/kg을 1일 1회 경구 21일간 투약했다. PVAS는 중앙값 5 (범위 4-8)에서 2.5 (2-4.5)로, VLS는 19 (2-42)에서 10 (1-38)로, VAS는 2에서 2로 감소했으며, 각각 15두, 12두, 8두에서 개선이 관찰되었다. 혈액검사에서 AST, GGT, 크레아티닌은 유의하게 증가했고 WBC, 림프구, BUN은 유의하게 감소했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 말의 알레르기성 피부염 치료에 oclacitinib 사용을 고려할 수 있으나, 신장·간·근육 질환이 있는 말에는 신중하게 투약해야 한다. 소규모 단일 연구로 장기 안전성에 대한 정보가 제한적이다.

papers.title: Efficacy of Oral Baicalin in Canine Atopic Dermatitis: A Randomised Placebo Controlled Trial.
papers.authors: Qian XL, Lu J, Lu W, Xu WX, Jiang ZH
papers.abstract: Baicalin has shown efficacy in various dermatitis models in animals. However, its therapeutic effects on naturally occurring canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) have not been evaluated. To evaluate the efficacy and safety of baicalin in dogs with cAD. 56 client-owned dogs were enrolled. All dogs were randomly divided to receive oral baicalin or placebo over a 90day period. All subjects had veterinary evaluations using the Canine Atopic Dermatitis Extent and Severity Index, 4th iteration (CADESI-04) during the trial and owners were requested to evaluate itching using the pruritus Visual Analog Scale (PVAS) and to complete a quality-of-life (QoL) questionnaire at Day (D)0 and D90. Additionally, the transepidermal water loss (TEWL), total serum IgE levels (IgE), complete blood count and serum biochemical results were measured at D0 and D90. The significant decreases in CADESI-04 (p < 0.001), PVAS (p < 0.001), TEWL (p = 0.014), IgE (p < 0.001) and QoL scores (p < 0.001) were observed in the baicalin group D90 compared to baseline. When compared to placebo, the baicalin group had significantly lower scores in CADESI-4 and PVAS (p < 0.001). A significantly higher proportion of subjects in the baicalin group showed a good-to-excellent treatment response (82.1%) compared to those in the placebo group (35.7%). The treatment was well tolerated. Baicalin had a significant benefit in alleviating pruritus and reducing clinical signs in dogs with mild-to-moderate cAD and was well tolerated.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 경구 바이칼린은 개의 아토피성 피부염(cAD)에서 가려움증을 완화하고 임상증상을 유의하게 감소시키며 90일간 양호한 내약성을 보였다.
[방법·수치] 무작위 위약대조 임상시험으로 개 56마리를 대상으로 90일간 바이칼린 또는 위약을 경구투여했다. CADESI-04 (p<0.001), PVAS (p<0.001), TEWL (p=0.014), 혈청 IgE (p<0.001), 삶의질 점수 (p<0.001)에서 기저선 대비 유의한 감소를 보였으며, 위약군 대비 바이칼린군에서 CADESI-04와 PVAS가 유의하게 낮았다(p<0.001). 바이칼린군에서 82.1%가 양호-우수한 반응을 보인 반면 위약군은 35.7%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 경증에서 중등도 개 아토피성 피부염의 치료에서 항소양 및 항염증 효과로 임상 적용 가능하다. 단일 기관 연구이고 경증-중등도 환자만 포함되어 중증 cAD에 대한 효과는 평가되지 않았다.

papers.title: Prevalence of Antimicrobial Use in Small Animal Dermatology Referral Practices in the United States.
papers.authors: Santoro D, Bollig ER, Granick JL
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance is a critical global health concern driven by antimicrobial use. Dermatological conditions are common reasons for antimicrobial prescriptions in small animal practice, yet data on prescribing patterns in veterinary dermatology referral settings are lacking. To characterise the frequency, types and indications for antimicrobial use in dogs and cats seen by board-certified or residency-trained first-opinion veterinary surgeons in the United States. Medical record data about 550 client-owned animals (479 dogs, 71 cats) presenting to 22 US veterinary dermatology referral practices were included. A prospective, cross-sectional point-prevalence study was conducted in August 2023. Each clinic enrolled the first 25 consecutive dogs or cats evaluated by a referral clinician. Data collected included clinical diagnoses, antimicrobial and antiseptic prescriptions and diagnostic testing. Antimicrobials were prescribed in 54.9% (302 of 550) of cases. Third-generation cephalosporins accounted for 43.9% (54 of 123) of systemic antibiotics to dogs. Of topical antimicrobials prescribed for otitis externa associated with bacteria only or yeast only, 36.4% (20 of 55) were a combination formulation containing both an antibiotic and an antifungal. Antiseptics were prescribed in 62.7% of cases. Cytological investigation was performed in 86.3% of conditions treated with antimicrobials, whereas bacterial culture was used in only 15.3%. This study provides a benchmark for antimicrobial use in veterinary dermatology referral practices. Findings highlight opportunities to align prescribing with updated guidelines to reduce reliance on broad-spectrum systemic antibiotics, favouring topical therapies and underscore the need for narrow-spectrum topical options.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 소동물 피부과 전문 클리닉에서 항미생물제 사용률은 54.9%로 높으며, 3세대 세팔로스포린이 개의 전신항생제 43.9%를 차지하고 있고, 세균 또는 효모 감염만 있는 외이염의 36.4%에서 불필요한 항생제-항진균제 복합제가 처방되고 있다.
[방법·수치] 미국 22개 피부과 전문 클리닉에서 2023년 8월 중 내원한 개 479마리, 고양이 71마리 총 550마리를 대상으로 한 전향적 횡단면 조사 연구로, 항미생물제 처방률 54.9%(302/550), 항생제 세포학 검사율 86.3%, 세균배양 검사율 15.3%, 소독약 처방률 62.7%가 보고되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 피부질환 진료에서 광범위 항생제 사용을 줄이고 국소 치료로의 전환 및 협범위 국소 항미생물 옵션 개발 필요성을 제시하며, 세균배양 검사의 저조한 활용률(15.3%)을 개선할 필요가 있다. 단일 시점 조사로 계절적 변동을 반영하지 못하고 미국 전문 클리닉 중심의 데이터로 일반 진료의 패턴을 대표하지 못할 수 있다.

papers.title: Biomechanical evaluation of carpal joint ligaments in the cat: An experimental and radiographic cadaveric study.
papers.authors: Candela Andrade M, Meinck P, Slunsky P, Brunnberg L
papers.abstract: To define the stabilizing role of feline carpal ligaments through selective transection and radiographic assessment of joint angulation under standardized loading. Experimental ex vivo cadaveric study. Sixty carpal joints from 30 adult cats without orthopedic disease. Carpi were mounted in a custom radiolucent clamping device and subjected to standardized 20 N varus, valgus, and extension loads. Measurement tolerances were 3.5° for varus, 6.4° for valgus, and 6° for extension. Individual ligaments or ligament complexes were sequentially transected, and stability changes were quantified radiographically using dorsopalmar and mediolateral projections. Transection of the medial collateral ligament produced only minor valgus increase below tolerance thresholds. Palmar radiocarpal ligament desmotomy caused valgus and hyperextension instability with consistent radiocarpal subluxation. Additional flexor retinaculum transection increased extension by up to 27.9° and resulted in antebrachiocarpal luxation. Lateral collateral ligament transection produced marked varus instability (+16.8°) with ulnocarpal subluxation, and the ulnopalmar and accessory ulnar ligaments acted as secondary stabilizers. Distal palmar carpometacarpal ligament transection caused hyperextension (+12.3°) with mediocarpal and carpometacarpal subluxation. Isolated flexor myotomy or tenotomy did not produce measurable instability unless fascial structures were disrupted. Feline carpal stability depends on coordinated ligamentous and fascial interactions rather than a single dominant stabilizer. This reproducible multiplanar testing model provides a biomechanical basis to improve diagnosis and treatment of feline carpal injuries, which are often extrapolated from canine data. These data highlight that isolated ligament repair may not adequately restore carpal stability in cats. Clinicians should consider the integrated role of ligamentous and fascial structures when diagnosing and managing carpal injuries.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 손목 안정성은 단일 인대가 아닌 인대와 근막의 조화로운 상호작용에 의존하며, 특히 장측 요골손목인대와 외측 측부인대가 주요 안정화 구조임을 규명했다.
[방법·수치] 30마리 성묘의 60개 손목관절을 대상으로 한 외체 생역학 연구로, 표준화된 20N의 외반, 내반, 신전 하중을 적용하고 선택적 인대 절단 후 방사선학적으로 관절 각도 변화를 측정했다(허용오차: 외반 3.5°, 내반 6.4°, 신전 6°). 장측 요골손목인대 절단시 외반 및 과신전 불안정성과 일관된 요골손목 아탈구가 발생했고, 외측 측부인대 절단시 현저한 내반 불안정성(+16.8°)과 척골손목 아탈구가 유발되었으며, 원위 장측 중수손목인대 절단시 과신전(+12.3°)이 발생했다.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 손목 손상 진단 및 치료시 개의 데이터 외삽을 피하고 인대와 근막 구조의 통합적 역할을 고려해야 하며, 단순 인대 복구만으로는 손목 안정성을 충분히 회복하지 못할 수 있다. 외체 연구로 임상 적용에는 추가 검증이 필요하다.

papers.title: Applying the Health Belief Model to Identify Factors Associated With Owner Persistence to Allergen-Specific Immunotherapy.
papers.authors: Williams C, Milum AW, Andritsch S, von Fricken ME, Painter M
papers.abstract: Allergen-specific immunotherapy (ASIT) is the only treatment targeting the pathophysiology of canine atopic dermatitis (cAD) and feline atopic skin syndrome (FASS). Despite its disease-modifying potential, owner persistence remains a clinical challenge. This study applied the Health Belief Model (HBM) to evaluate factors influencing owner persistence with ASIT. We hypothesised that owner perceptions of ASIT effectiveness, perceived barriers (e.g., cost) and ease of treatment integration would be associated with persistence. The objective was to identify modifiable psychological and logistical factors to support sustained ASIT use in cAD and FASS management. No animals were used. Pets prescribed ASIT between 1 January 2020 and 31 May 2024, were identified from four geographically diverse veterinary dermatology practices. Owners completed a survey assessing HBM constructs-perceived susceptibility, perceived severity, perceived benefits, perceived barriers, self-efficacy, social support-and a knowledge domain. Owner-reported ASIT refill behaviour served as a proxy for persistence. Associations between HBM constructs and refill behaviour were evaluated using chi-square tests and logistic regression. Higher perceived disease severity, greater perceived benefits and increased self-efficacy were positively associated with persistence. Owners who viewed their pet's condition as severe, believed ASIT effective, or felt confident administering treatment were more likely to continue therapy. Cost concerns and administration challenges were key perceived barriers. This study highlights the psychological factors in owner persistence with ASIT. HBM-informed educational strategies that emphasise disease impact, treatment value and owner confidence may improve persistence with ASIT and long-term disease management.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 아토피성 피부염(cAD)과 고양이의 아토피성 피부증후군(FASS) 치료에서 알레르겐특이면역치료(ASIT) 지속 사용을 결정하는 요인은 질병의 심각도 인식, ASIT의 효과에 대한 믿음, 치료 자신감(자기효능감)이며, 비용 우려와 투여 어려움이 주요 장애 요인임을 확인했다.
[방법·수치] 2020년 1월~2024년 5월 사이 ASIT를 처방받은 반려동물 소유자 대상의 설문조사를 4개 동물병원 피부과에서 수행했으며, 건강신념모델(HBM) 구성요소(질병 감수성, 질병 심각도, 치료 편익, 장애요인, 자기효능감, 사회적 지지) 평가 후 카이제곱 검정과 로지스틱 회귀분석으로 ASIT 처방약 재구매(persistence의 대리지표)와의 연관성을 분석했으나, 구체적인 P값이나 오즈비 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] ASIT의 지속적 사용을 높이기 위해 수의사는 HBM 기반 교육 전략으로 질병의 영향, 치료의 가치, 치료 자신감을 강조해야 하며, 비용 차별화 옵션과 투여 방법 단순화를 제시할 필요가 있다. 그러나 본 연구는 소유자 인식 조사에 기반한 횡단면 연구로 인과관계를 증명하지 못하며, 4개 병원의 제한된 대상에서 수행되었다는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: Computed tomography perfusion parameters may aid preoperative differentiation of canine pheochromocytomas from adrenocortical tumors.
papers.authors: Iida K, Ishigaki K, Ishikawa C, Shiozawa N, Kinpara M
papers.abstract: To characterize CT perfusion (CTP)-derived time to highest observed adrenal tissue enhancement (T-peak) and arterial blood flow (AF), evaluate associations with triple-phase CT findings, and assess the diagnostic performance of T-peak, AF, and the tumor-to-contralateral adrenal AF ratio for differentiating pheochromocytomas from adrenocortical tumors. Historical CTP data from 5 healthy Beagles served as controls. Client-owned dogs evaluated from November 21, 2024, through May 31, 2026, underwent triple-phase CT, CTP, adrenalectomy, and histopathology. Time to highest observed adrenal tissue enhancement was the interval from contrast administration to the greatest sampled adrenal attenuation; AF was calculated with a single-input maximum-slope model. 20 dogs with 22 tumors (8 adrenocortical adenomas, 7 adrenocortical carcinomas, and 7 pheochromocytomas [PHEOs]) were included. Time to highest observed adrenal tissue enhancement was longer in both adrenocortical tumor groups than in PHEOs; a post hoc cutoff < 36.0 seconds yielded apparent 100% sensitivity and specificity. Arterial blood flow was lower in both adrenocortical tumor groups than in controls and higher in PHEOs than in adrenocortical carcinomas. Arterial blood flow had an area under the curve of 0.923; a cutoff > 100.60 mL/min/100 mL yielded apparent 85.7% sensitivity and 100% specificity. Among 17 dogs with unilateral tumors, the tumor-to-contralateral AF ratio completely separated PHEOs from adrenocortical tumors. Arterial blood flow correlated positively with CT wash-in and washout indices, whereas T-peak correlated negatively with arterial- and venous-phase percentage enhancement washout. Time to highest observed adrenal tissue enhancement and AF differed among adrenal tumor types and were associated with CT enhancement characteristics.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] CT 관류(CTP) 파라미터인 T-peak(최고 조영 시간)과 AF(동맥 혈류량)는 개의 갈색세포종과 부신피질종양을 구별하는 데 도움이 될 수 있으며, T-peak < 36.0초는 100% 민감도·특이도, AF > 100.60 mL/min/100 mL는 85.7% 민감도·100% 특이도를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 비글 5마리 대조군, 임상 환자견 20마리 22개 종양(부신피질선종 8개, 부신피질암종 7개, 갈색세포종 7개) 포함. 삼중 CT와 CTP 검사 후 적출·조직병리 확인. T-peak는 부신피질종양에서 갈색세포종보다 길었고, AF는 갈색세포종에서 부신피질암종보다 높았으며 AUC 0.923. 편측 종양 17마리에서 종양/대측부신 AF 비율이 갈색세포종과 부신피질종양을 완전히 구분.
[임상 적용·한계] CTP는 수술 전 부신종양 감별진단의 보조적 정보 제공이 가능하나, 제시된 역값의 타당성 검증을 위해 더 큰 규모의 독립적 코호트 연구가 필요하다. 소규모 단일 연구로 임상 적용 전 외부 검증 필수.

papers.title: Portable blood glucose meters do not reliably detect hypoglycemia in ferrets (Mustela putorius furo) compared with a point-of-care chemistry analyzer.
papers.authors: Rollins K, Rishniw M, Donnelly TM, Kopp L
papers.abstract: To compare blood glucose concentrations measured by a veterinary portable blood glucose meter (v-PBGM; AlphaTrak3; Zoetis Inc), a human portable blood glucose meter (h-PBGM; FreeStyle Precision Neo; Abbott Diabetes Care), and a point-of-care chemistry analyzer (reference analyzer; VetScan VS2; Zoetis Inc) in client-owned ferrets. Residual heparinized jugular venous blood samples from ferrets undergoing unrelated veterinary evaluations were analyzed from June 2025 through April 2026 within 10 minutes of collection. Blood glucose was measured with the h-PBGM and with the v-PBGM using equine, canine, and feline settings. Agreement was assessed by Bland-Altman analysis and at hypoglycemia thresholds of ≤ 60 and < 70 mg/dL. 24 client-owned domestic ferrets (Mustela putorius furo) were included. Mean blood glucose concentration by the reference analyzer was 90.8 mg/dL (range, 43 to 157 mg/dL). The h-PBGM had the greatest positive fixed bias. The v-PBGM canine and feline settings showed minimal fixed bias, but all glucometers had wide limits of agreement. At the ≤ 60-mg/dL threshold, simple classification agreement was 79% for the canine and feline settings, 75% for the equine setting, and 58% for the h-PBGM. The v-PBGM canine and feline settings agreed more closely with the reference analyzer than did the h-PBGM. However, agreement was insufficient to support diagnosis or management of hypoglycemia based solely on portable glucometer results in ferrets. Low, borderline, unexpected, or treatment-altering blood glucose results should be confirmed with a point-of-care or reference laboratory chemistry analyzer.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 휴대용 혈당계(수의용·인용 모두)는 페릿의 저혈당증 진단에 신뢰할 수 없으며, 특히 혈당 ≤60 mg/dL에서 분류 일치도가 58~79%에 불과하다.
[방법·수치] 24마리 클리닉 내원 페릿의 헤파린 처리 경정맥혈 샘플을 수의용 휴대용혈당계(AlphaTrak3, 말·개·고양이 설정), 인용 휴대용혈당계(FreeStyle Precision Neo), 휴대형화학분석기(VetScan VS2, 기준)로 측정 비교(2025년 6월~2026년 4월); 기준분석기 평균 혈당 90.8 mg/dL(범위 43~157), 저혈당 임계값 ≤60 mg/dL에서 개/고양이 설정 79% 일치, 말 설정 75%, 인용계 58%.
[임상 적용·한계] 페릿의 혈당 측정 결과가 낮거나 예상치 못하거나 치료를 변경할 수 있는 수치일 때는 반드시 휴대형 또는 중앙 화학분석기로 확인해야 한다. 소규모 단일기관 연구이며, 휴대용혈당계만으로 저혈당증 진단 및 관리를 결정할 수 없다.

papers.title: Veterinary point-of-care ultrasound probe orientation and location for detection of pleural effusion in canine cadavers: a pilot study.
papers.authors: Di Franco C, Menard J, Romero A, Chalhoub S, Madden V
papers.abstract: To evaluate whether point-of-care ultrasound probe location (at or below the costochondral junction) and probe orientation (perpendicular or parallel to the ribs) affect operator ability to detect pleural effusion in a canine cadaver model. Twelve intubated canine cadavers with scant to large volume pleural effusion were scanned in sternal recumbency while receiving positive pressure ventilation. Twelve operators (2 emergency and critical care specialists, 2 veterinary students and 8 interns) performed blinded bilateral thoracic point-of-care ultrasound using two randomised scanning protocols: a modified TFAST for pleural fluid technique and a modified Calgary PLUS for pleural fluid technique. Hemithoraces were categorised as scant-to-mild or moderate-to-large effusion for statistical analysis. Paired detection rates were compared using McNemar's test. Overall detection of pleural effusion was significantly higher using the modified Calgary PLUS for pleural fluid technique compared with the modified TFAST for pleural fluid technique (89.1% vs. 60.9%; P < .001). There was a statistically significant increase in the detection of scant-to-mild effusion with the modified Calgary PLUS for pleural fluid technique (84.4% vs. 37.5%; P < .001). No significant difference was observed for moderate-to-large effusions (93.8% vs. 84.4%; P = .25). The site assessed and probe orientation used with different thoracic point-of-care ultrasound protocols can influence the operator's ability to detect pleural effusion in positive pressure ventilation canine cadavers placed in sternal recumbency. Incorporating a probe orientation that is parallel to the ribs in the more ventral regions of the thorax during point-of-care ultrasound may improve the operator's detection of pleural effusions, particularly when smaller volumes of pleural fluid are present.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 흉부 초음파에서 갈거리와 평행한 프로브 방향과 더 복측의 흉곽 위치를 사용하는 수정된 Calgary PLUS 기법이 수정된 TFAST 기법보다 흉수 검출에 유의미하게 우수하며, 특히 소량의 흉수 검출 능력이 뛰어나다.
[방법·수치] 개 시신 12구를 등척 호흡 하에서 정맥 위치로 스캔하였고, 12명의 술자(응급중환자 전문의 2명, 수의학 학생 2명, 인턴 8명)가 맹검 양측 흉부 초음파를 수행했다. 수정된 Calgary PLUS 기법의 전체 흉수 검출률은 89.1%로 수정된 TFAST 기법 60.9%보다 유의미하게 높았으며(P<0.001), 소량~중등도 흉수 검출률에서도 84.4% vs 37.5%로 유의미한 차이를 보였다(P<0.001). 중등도~대량 흉수는 두 기법 간 유의미한 차이가 없었다(93.8% vs 84.4%; P=0.25).
[임상 적용·한계] 임상 초음파 검사 시 더 복측 위치에서 갈거리와 평행한 프로브 방향으로 스캔하면 흉수 검출률, 특히 소량의 흉수 검출 능력을 향상시킬 수 있다. 단, 본 연구는 시신 모델과 양압 호흡이라는 특수한 조건이므로 생체 동물에서의 적용 가능성 평가가 필요하다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Modified transcanal perendoscopic myringotomy and septotomy technique for cats with otitis media - a retrospective study of 38 cats.
papers.authors: Wetzels BN, Pickee E, Passon M, Den Hertog E, Ter Haar G
papers.abstract: ObjectivesThis study solely aims to describe a convenient minimally invasive technique for access to the ventromedial compartment of the middle ear in cats with polypoid or non-polypoid otitis media.MethodsPatients' records were retrospectively retrieved from cats with otic symptoms. Cats were included based on the presence of fluid/soft tissue within the tympanic cavity on CT imaging, abnormal tympanic membranes on oto-endoscopy and/or abnormal auditory tube openings upon nasopharyngoscopy.ResultsA total of 38 cats with uni- or bilateral bulla effusion and endoscopic abnormalities were included and 43 ears were treated. On CT, all treated ears had effusion of both dorsolateral and ventromedial compartments. Otoscopy revealed an abnormal tympanic membrane in 93% (discoloration in 28%, bulging in 28%, rupture in 16% and a protruding polyp in 21%). On normograde nasopharyngoscopy, the ipsilateral auditory tube was visibly open in 81% and partly or completely obstructed with discharge or polypous material in 19%. A transcanal perendoscopic myringotomy and septotomy using a 1-mm rigid Frazier suction tube was performed in all cases. During treatment, inflammation of the mucosal lining in the bulla was seen in all ears, with intracavital polyp formation in 33%, which was subsequently perendoscopically debrided. All cats were treated with a 7-day course of doxycycline and a tapering course of prednisolone. No procedure-related complications were seen intra- or postoperatively to discharge.Conclusion and relevanceTranscanal perendoscopic myringotomy and septotomy in cats is a rapid, minimally invasive and apparently safe technique which allows access to both compartments of the feline middle ear. Short- and long-term outcome have to be evaluated in future research.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 중이염에서 경이도 내시경 고막절개 및 중격절제술은 양쪽 중이강 접근이 가능한 최소침습술이며, 시술 중 합병증이 없었다.
[방법·수치] 중이 액체/연부조직이 있는 고양이 38마리 43귀의 후향적 분석으로, 고막 이상 93% (변색 28%, 팽창 28%, 파열 16%, 용종 21%), 청각관 개통 81%, 중이강 염증 100%, 용종형성 33%에서 내시경으로 제거하였으며 합병증 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 중이염 고양이의 기존 외과적 접근보다 빠르고 최소침습적이므로 임상 적용 가능하나, 단일기관 후향적 소규모 연구이고 단기·장기 예후 평가가 아직 필요하다.

papers.title: Radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis in 14 dogs.
papers.authors: Clark IMT, Priestnall S, Meeson R
papers.abstract: To characterise signalment, imaging features and any associated clinical findings of dogs with a radiographic diagnosis of radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis. Retrospective case series reviewing medical records (2010 to 2024) of dogs with imaging lesions consistent with a radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis on computed tomography or digital radiographs. Fourteen dogs had a radiographic radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis on at least one limb. All dogs identified were adult dogs (1 to 12 years), with Spaniels and their crosses most common (8/14), followed by three Terriers, one Labrador cross, one English Bulldog and one beagle cross. Two dogs had radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis identified incidentally and were not lame. Twelve dogs were lame, with the majority having another coexisting cause of lameness identified. Two dogs, however, presented for lameness without another likely cause other than the presence of radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis, and one dog suffered a radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis associated pathological fracture. Two variants of radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis were described: the classically described RUIN and an "atypical" monostotic lesion, with one dog having one of each. Radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis lesions were all identified in the proximal third of the antebrachium. Radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis is seen in a variety of breeds and may be more common in Spaniels. They may be bilateral or unilateral, classic or monostotic. Radio-ulnar ischaemic necrosis lesions may be an incidental or more rarely direct cause of lameness or pathological fracture. As half the population had bilateral RUIN, a non-trauma-related inciting cause of the nutrient vascular ischaemia is possible.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 요골-척골 허혈성 괴사(RUIN)는 다양한 견종에서 발생하며, 특히 Spaniel 품종과 그 교배종에서 더 흔할 수 있고, 고전적 형태와 비전형적 단골성 병변의 두 가지 변이형이 존재한다.
[방법·수치] 2010년부터 2024년까지 의료기록을 후향적으로 검토한 증례 시리즈로, 14마리의 개(1~12세 성견)에서 CT 또는 디지털 방사선 촬영으로 진단된 RUIN을 대상으로 했으며, Spaniel 및 교배종 8마리(57%), Terrier 3마리, 기타 품종 3마리가 포함되었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 12마리 중 2마리만 RUIN이 파행의 직접적 원인이었고, 1마리는 병리적 골절이 발생했으며, 절반이 양측성 병변을 보여 외상 외 혈관 허혈의 원인이 있을 가능성이 있다. 단일 기관 후향적 소규모 증례 시리즈이므로 역학적 일반화에 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Cannabidiol in small animal practice: current evidence, clinical applications and practical recommendations for dogs and cats.
papers.authors: Sano T
papers.abstract: Cannabidiol has gained increasing attention in small animal practice as a potential adjunctive therapy for a variety of conditions, including osteoarthritis, epilepsy and anxiety-related disorders. This mini-review summarises current clinical evidence in dogs and cats, highlights key limitations and provides practical recommendations for clinicians. Recent studies suggest that cannabidiol may improve pain and mobility in canine osteoarthritis and reduce seizure frequency in refractory epilepsy, although results remain variable. Evidence supporting anxiolytic effects appears more consistent in chronic stress conditions than in acute fear responses. In cats, clinical data are limited, although preliminary studies have evaluated osteoarthritis-associated pain, chronic gingivostomatitis, behavioural responses, pharmacokinetics and safety. Mild adverse effects, including gastrointestinal disturbances and sedation, have been reported in both dogs and cats. Increases in serum alkaline phosphatase activity have been repeatedly reported in dogs, although their clinical significance remains uncertain and monitoring is advisable during prolonged administration. Drug interactions, particularly those involving cytochrome P450 pathways, should also be considered when cannabidiol is administered concurrently with other medications. Overall, current evidence supports cautious, selective use of cannabidiol as an adjunctive rather than primary therapy. While evidence is strongest for canine osteoarthritis and epilepsy, further standardised clinical trials are required to establish optimal dosing strategies, long-term safety and evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary practice.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 카나비디올은 개의 골관절염과 난치성 간질에서 통증 완화 및 발작 빈도 감소 효과를 보였으며, 만성 스트레스 상황에서 불안 완화 효과가 비교적 일관적이었다. 고양이에서는 임상 데이터가 제한적이나 골관절염 연관 통증, 만성 치은구내염 등에서 예비 연구가 진행 중이다.
[방법·수치] 개와 고양이를 대상으로 한 최근 임상 연구들을 미니 리뷰 형식으로 정리했으며, 수치 제시 없음. 개에서 경미한 위장관 장애와 진정 작용이 보고되었고, 알칼리 포스파타제 활성 상승이 반복적으로 나타났으나 임상적 의의는 불확실하다.
[임상 적용·한계] 카나비디올은 보조 치료제로 선택적으로 사용하되 단독 치료제로는 권장하지 않으며, 특히 간질환 약물과의 상호작용(사이토크롬 P450 경로)을 고려해야 한다. 최적 용량, 장기 안전성, 근거 기반 임상 지침 확립을 위한 표준화된 임상시험이 필요하고, 장기 투여 시 혈청 알칼리 포스파타제 모니터링을 권고한다.

papers.title: Effect of mitral valve repair on outcomes in dogs with preclinical myxomatous mitral valve disease: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Takahashi E, Shimizu S, Kaneko M, Takahashi A, Nii Y
papers.abstract: Mitral valve repair (MVR) for myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD) in dogs has favorable results, but its effectiveness compared with medical treatment in preclinical (stage B2) dogs remains unclear. This study investigated whether MVR improves survival in preclinical dogs with MMVD. Dogs diagnosed with stage B2 MMVD between October 2016 and September 2020 were divided into an MVR group and a control group receiving medical treatment. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause mortality and the first onset of pulmonary edema. The waiting period between diagnosis and surgery in the MVR group was adjusted as a time-dependent exposure, and survival analysis was performed. Overall, 91 and 171 dogs were enrolled in the MVR and control groups, respectively. The median observation period was 599.5 days (lower and upper quartiles: 374.0-1001.5). The primary outcome occurred in 10 dogs (11.0%) in the MVR group and 69 dogs (40.4%) in the control group. Cox proportional hazards analysis adjusted for time-dependent exposure yielded hazard ratios of 0.12 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.05-0.25, P < 0.001) for MVR and 2.85 (95% CI: 1.69-4.80, P < 0.001) for diuretic use. Limitations include potential selection bias, limited survey response rate, inter-observer variability in diagnostic assessment, and a short follow-up period. Dogs undergoing MVR had a lower risk of reaching the composite endpoint than medically managed dogs. These findings may assist veterinarians and owners in decision-making regarding MVR for stage B2 dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 전임상기(stage B2) 심근층판막질환 개에서 판막수술이 의학적 치료보다 사망 및 폐부종 발생의 복합 종료점에 대해 유의하게 낮은 위험도(HR 0.12, 95% CI: 0.05-0.25, P<0.001)를 보였다.
[방법·수치] 2016년 10월~2020년 9월 진단된 stage B2 심근층판막질환 개 중 수술군 91마리, 대조군 171마리를 후향적 코호트 분석했으며, 중앙 추적 기간은 599.5일이었다. 복합 종료점은 수술군 11.0%, 대조군 40.4%에서 발생했으며, 이뇨제 사용 시 위험비는 2.85(95% CI: 1.69-4.80, P<0.001)였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 전임상기 심근층판막질환 개의 판막수술은 진행 지연 및 임상증상 발현 예방에 고려할 수 있으나, 선택 편향, 낮은 반응률, 진단 평가의 관찰자간 변이, 짧은 추적 기간의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: The addition of clotrimazole reduces but does not abrogate fungal dysbiosis during effective antibacterial therapy for canine otitis externa.
papers.authors: Gallow G, Juhola J, Ferguson EA, Loeffler A, Hendricks A
papers.abstract: Malassezia dysbiosis commonly occurs after successful piperacillin-tazobactam monotherapy for canine bacterial otitis externa. The study objective was to compare antimicrobial outcomes in dogs with otitis treated with piperacillin-tazobactam in combination with the antifungal drug clotrimazole with a previous cohort treated with piperacillin-tazobactam alone. Twenty-one dogs with bacterial otitis were treated topically with piperacillin-tazobactam (1 mL) every 12 hours, although the fourth dose in each 48 hours period was replaced with 1% clotrimazole solution (1 mL). At visits 1 (V1) and 2 (V2), ear swab tips were washed in PBS + Triton X-100 and serial dilutions spread-plated onto blood, MacConkey (37°C, 48 hours) and modified Dixon's agar (32°C, 14 days) to generate semiquantitative counts. Microbes were identified by phenotype and MALDI-TOF. Outcomes were compared with those of 14 dogs previously treated with piperacillin-tazobactam alone (sequential case-cohort design). Relative risk of a post-treatment bacterial culture count exceeding zero in dogs treated with piperacillin-tazobactam-clotrimazole (3/21), when compared to piperacillin-tazobactam treatment alone (2/14) was 1.00 (95% confidence interval 0.19 to 5.24). Relative risk of an increase in yeast culture count in dogs treated with piperacillin-tazobactam alone (14/14), when compared to piperacillin-tazobactam-clotrimazole-treated dogs (7/21), was 3.00 (95% confidence interval 1.64 to 5.49). Relative risk of fungal dysbiosis (V2 yeast count > normal) in dogs treated with piperacillin-tazobactam alone (14/14), when compared to piperacillin-tazobactam-clotrimazole-treated dogs (4/21), was 5.25 (95% CI 2.17 to 12.68). Piperacillin-tazobactam-clotrimazole is highly efficacious in the treatment of refractory bacterial otitis; incorporation of clotrimazole markedly reduces but does not abrogate fungal dysbiosis.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 세균성 외이염 치료 시 piperacillin-tazobactam 단독 사용은 치료 후 Malassezia 불균형을 거의 모든 개(14/14)에서 유발하지만, clotrimazole 병용 치료는 이를 현저히 감소시킨다(4/21).
[방법·수치] 세균성 외이염 개 21마리를 대상으로 piperacillin-tazobactam(매 12시간, 48시간마다 4번째 용량은 1% clotrimazole로 대체) 병용 투여, 14마리 대조군(piperacillin-tazobactam 단독) 순차적 비교 연구; 효모균 증가 상대위험도 3.00(95% CI 1.64-5.49), 진균 불균형 상대위험도 5.25(95% CI 2.17-12.68), 세균 배양 양성률은 두 군 간 유의 차이 없음(RR 1.00, 95% CI 0.19-5.24).
[임상 적용·한계] piperacillin-tazobactam 단독 치료 시 항생제 연관 진균 불균형이 고도로 발생하므로 clotrimazole 병용이 권장되나, 병용 투여 후에도 약 19%(4/21)에서 진균 불균형이 지속되어 추가 치료 전략이 필요할 수 있다; 소규모 단일 기관 연구로 외적 타당성 제한.

papers.title: Urine Molecular Fingerprinting: exploratory study of a promising technology for detecting cancer and nonneoplastic disease in dogs.
papers.authors: Robertson J, Issa AS, Dervisis N, McGuire K, Tuohy J
papers.abstract: To describe a novel technology, Urine Molecular Fingerprinting (UMF), for analyzing the composition of urine and its application for neoplastic/nonneoplastic diseases in dogs. Voided urine samples from clinically healthy Bernese Mountain Dogs (n = 263), Golden Retrievers (214), West Highland White Terriers (79), German Shepherd Dogs (21), and other breeds (245). Samples were analyzed using Raman spectroscopy and computational statistics. To illustrate the clinical relevance of UMF, samples from dogs with cancer (n = 142) or nonneoplastic diseases (19) were analyzed and compared with reference UMF databases of clinically healthy dogs. Breed-associated differences in UMFs were present in samples from clinically healthy Bernese Mountain Dogs, Golden Retrievers, German Shepherd Dogs, and West Highland White Terriers. The UMFs of purebred dogs were different from those of a cohort of mixed breed/other purebred dogs. There were no UMF differences associated with age, sex, or neutering status in Bernese Mountain Dogs. The Raman intensity profiles of UMFs from dogs with cancer or nonneoplastic diseases were different from UMFs of clinically healthy dogs. Preliminary, exploratory studies indicate that UMF is a promising technology for detecting cancer and nonneoplastic disease in dogs. Urine Molecular Fingerprinting may be useful in the detection of cancer and nonneoplastic diseases in dogs. This technology could be adapted for testing in clinics, supplementing clinical, laboratory, and imaging information used for health assessments. The use of liquid biopsy technology, such as UMF, in canine cancer detection is addressed in the companion Currents in One Health by Robertson et al, JAVMA, June 2026.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 요 분자 지문분석(UMF)은 라만 분광법을 이용하여 개의 암과 비종양성 질환을 탐지할 수 있는 유망한 기술이며, 건강한 개의 요 프로필과 질병군의 프로필이 명확히 구별된다.
[방법·수치] 건강한 개 822마리(버니즈마운틴독 263마리, 골든리트리버 214마리, 웨스트하이랜드화이트테리어 79마리, 저먼셰퍼드 21마리, 기타견종 245마리)와 암 환자견 142마리, 비종양성 질환견 19마리의 배뇨 소변을 라만 분광법과 계산통계로 분석했다. 품종별·혼합견과 순종견 간 UMF 차이가 관찰되었으나 연령, 성별, 중성화 상태와는 연관이 없었고, 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 액체생검 기술로서 임상·실험실·영상 정보를 보완하는 보건 평가 도구로 활용 가능하나, 탐색적 예비 연구 단계로 임상 검사실 적응 전에 추가 검증이 필요하고 단일 기관 연구로서 외적 타당성 제한이 있다.

papers.title: Feasibility of the ForeSight tissue oximetry system for estimating cerebral and renal tissue oxygen saturation in anesthetized dogs during hyperoxia, normoxia, and hypoxia.
papers.authors: Sakata H, Monnet E, Gilleland E, Arai S
papers.abstract: To evaluate the feasibility of the ForeSight tissue oximetry system for assessing regional cerebral and renal tissue oxygen saturation in anesthetized dogs across 3 oxygenation states. 6 anesthetized Beagles were included. ForeSight tissue oximetry sensors were applied to the cranium and left lateral abdomen to estimate regional cerebral oxygen saturation (rScO2) and regional renal oxygen saturation (rSrO2). The left dorsal pedal artery, right femoral vein, and right jugular vein were cannulated for arterial and venous blood sampling. The distal tips of the jugular and femoral venous catheters were positioned in the renal vein and the most cranial aspect of the internal jugular vein. During hyperoxia, normoxia, and hypoxia, 1-mL blood samples were collected simultaneously from all 3 sites and analyzed using a blood gas analyzer. Weighted reference oxygenation values (REF-CXB) were calculated. Correlation and agreement between REF-CXB and rScO2 or rSrO2 were assessed using repeated-measures correlation and Bland-Altman analyses. rScO2 demonstrated moderate correlation with cerebral REF-CXB (r = 0.70; P < .01) but poor agreement. In contrast, rSrO2 showed no correlation with renal REF-CXB (r = 0.09; P = .62) and poor agreement. rScO2 demonstrated moderate correlation with the blood gas-derived cerebral oxygen saturation reference estimate in anesthetized dogs, whereas rSrO2 did not reliably reflect the corresponding renal oxygen saturation reference estimate. Trend monitoring of cerebral oxygenation with the ForeSight system may provide an adjunctive tool for real-time assessment of cerebral oxygenation in dogs undergoing general anesthesia.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] ForeSight 조직 산소포화도 시스템의 뇌 조직 산소포화도(rScO2)는 중등도 상관관계를 보이며 추세 모니터링에 임상적 가치가 있으나, 신장 조직 산소포화도(rSrO2)는 신뢰성이 없음.
[방법·수치] 마취된 비글 6마리를 대상으로 뇌(두개골)와 신장(좌측 복부)에 센서 적용 후 고산소증, 정상산소증, 저산소증 상태에서 혈액가스분석 결과와 비교. rScO2는 뇌 기준값과 중등도 상관관계(r=0.70, P<0.01)를 보였으나 일치도는 불량, rSrO2는 신장 기준값과 무상관(r=0.09, P=0.62)이고 일치도 불량.
[임상 적용·한계] ForeSight 시스템을 이용한 rScO2 추세 모니터링은 개의 전신마취 중 뇌산소화 평가의 보조 도구로 활용 가능하나, rSrO2는 임상 적용 불가. 소규모 연구(n=6)이고 비글만 대상이므로 다른 견종에서의 검증 필요.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Meningiomas in four cats with pseudocystic fluid accumulation including one microcystic meningioma.
papers.authors: Bitoun A, Berthomé C, Frankar H, Fert S, Cauzinille L
papers.abstract: Case series summaryFour cats were presented with progressive prosencephalic signs. An extraaxial mass associated with a pseudocystic component was identified in each case on MRI and pseudocystic meningiomas were suspected. The appearance of the fluid accumulation in Case 1 was more suggestive of an actual cyst, whereas the crescent shaped fluid accumulation was more compatible with subdural fluid accumulation in Cases 2,3 and 4. All cases underwent mass removal through craniotomy and were discharged from the hospital.The meningiomas were classified as fibrous in case 1,2 and 4, and as microcystic in case 3. The fluid analysis in Case 4 revealed a protein rich fluid with neoplastic meningeal cells. Histology of the wall surrounding the fluid in case 4 revealed tumoral meningothelial cells lined against dura mater, without epithelial lining.All cats improved neurologically after surgical removal of the tumour. Follow-up MRI in cases 2 and 3 performed 6 months post operatively identified focal thickening of the meninges in the two cases (2 and 3).Relevance and novel informationThis case series describes four cats with brain meningiomas associated with a pseudocystic component of unknown origin. Including one microcystic meningioma which has not been previously reported in the veterinary literature. The pseudocyst didn't seem to affect the clinical outcomes and postoperative MRI for these four cats.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 4마리에서 의성낭(pseudocystic) 성분을 동반한 뇌수막종이 확인되었으며, 그 중 1마리는 수의학 문헌에서 처음 보고되는 미세낭성(microcystic) 수막종이었다. 수술적 제거 후 모든 고양이가 신경학적으로 호전되었으며, 의성낭이 임상 결과에 영향을 미치지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 진행성 전뇌 증상을 보인 고양이 4마리 대상 케이스 시리즈. MRI에서 뇌경막외(extraaxial) 종괴와 의성낭 성분 확인. 케이스 1에서는 진정한 낭성 모양, 케이스 2-4에서는 초승달 모양의 경막하액 축적 소견. 모두 개두술을 통한 종괴 제거 시행. 케이스 1,2,4는 섬유성 수막종, 케이스 3은 미세낭성 수막종으로 분류. 케이스 4 액체 분석에서 단백질 풍부한 액체와 신생물성 수막세포 확인. 케이스 2,3의 술후 6개월 추적 MRI에서 뇌수막 국소 비후 확인. 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 고양이 뇌수막종 진단 시 MRI에서 의성낭 성분 발견 시 수술적 제거를 고려할 근거가 된다. 본 연구는 소규모 케이스 시리즈이며 의성낭의 발생 기전이 불명확하여 더 많은 임상 데이터와 장기 추적 관찰이 필요하다.

papers.title: Pathologic Characterization and Clinical Significance of Lymphovascular Invasion in Canine Thyroid Carcinomas.
papers.authors: Griffin MA, Stoyle B, Oakes A, Flesner B, Lenz JA
papers.abstract: The association between lymphovascular invasion (LVI) and outcomes in dogs with thyroid carcinoma is inadequately described, and a standardized definition of LVI is lacking. This study's objectives were to histopathologically and immunohistochemically characterize LVI and to evaluate associated clinical outcomes in dogs with thyroid carcinoma. Inclusion criteria were: dogs that underwent thyroidectomy for thyroid carcinoma with available histopathology samples, and a minimum of 1-year postoperative follow-up data or follow-up to death. Thirty dogs with 35 distinct tumours, including 26 follicular and nine medullary, were evaluated. LVI was characterized as intracapsular endothelialized tumour emboli (without adhered fibrin) in 26 samples, intracapsular tumour emboli with adhered fibrin in seven samples, extracapsular tumour emboli without adhered fibrin in 10 samples, and extracapsular tumour emboli with endothelial disruptions and adhered fibrin in three samples. CD31 and Prox1 positive vessels contained endothelialized tumour thrombi in 17 and one sample, respectively. Extracapsular invasion with (non-endothelialized) and without (endothelialized) associated fibrin were associated with a 10-fold (p = 0.001) and 3-fold (p = 0.013) increase in the likelihood of death, respectively. No significant difference in the likelihood of death was noted between cases of extracapsular invasion with or without fibrin (p = 0.31). Intracapsular tumour thrombi with or without associated fibrin and non-endothelialized tumour thrombi were not associated with outcomes in this cohort. These results support that in dogs with thyroid carcinoma, extracapsular LVI with or without associated fibrin thrombi, but not intracapsular LVI, is associated with worse outcomes. Further study is warranted on a larger population of dogs with standardized treatment and follow-up.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 갑상선암종에서 피막외 림프혈관침범(LVI)이 있는 경우 사망 위험이 3~10배 증가하며, 피막내 LVI는 예후와 무관합니다.
[방법·수치] 갑상선절제술을 받은 개 30마리의 35개 종양(여포암 26개, 수질암 9개)을 평가했고, 최소 1년 이상 추적 관찰. 피막외 LVI는 사망 위험을 10배(섬유소 미부착, p=0.001) 또는 3배(섬유소 부착, p=0.013) 증가시켰으나, 섬유소 부착 여부 간 유의한 차이는 없었음(p=0.31).
[임상 적용·한계] 갑상선암종 수술 후 조직병리 검사에서 피막외 LVI 여부를 확인하면 예후 평가에 도움이 될 수 있으나, 소규모 단일기관 연구이고 치료 프로토콜이 표준화되지 않아 더 큰 규모의 연구가 필요합니다.

papers.title: Tolerability and Outcome of Medical Treatment in Feline Nasal Carcinomas: A Multi-Institutional Retrospective Study.
papers.authors: Amato F, Gobbetti M, Giuliano A, Treggiari E, Pieri M
papers.abstract: Carcinomas are the second most common feline intranasal neoplasm. Various treatment options, including radiotherapy, surgery or a combination of both, have been described, but data on medical therapy efficacy are lacking. This retrospective study evaluated the outcome of cats with nasal carcinoma (NC) treated with antineoplastic treatment. Cats with a histopathological or cytopathological diagnosis of NC were included. Patients receiving antineoplastic treatment were compared to patients receiving palliative treatment alone. Response to therapy, median time to progression (MTTP) and median survival time (MST) were described and compared for both groups. Analysed clinical variables included the presence of epistaxis, facial deformity, stage, use of NSAIDs and previous surgical debulking. Thirty-three cats were included in the study: 18 in the antineoplastic treatment group and 15 in the palliative treatment group. Forty-eight percent of the entire population had worsening of the clinical signs, 36% remained stable and 16% showed clinical benefit. MTTP of the entire population was 104 days and MST was 178 days. No statistically significant differences were found between groups for either MTTP (96 vs. 111 days; p = 0.95) or MST (197 vs. 262; p = 0.77). None of the evaluated clinical variables was associated with outcome. In this retrospective study, antineoplastic treatment was not associated with a detectable survival advantage over palliative treatment alone. These findings should be interpreted cautiously given the small sample size and heterogeneity of treatments administered.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 고양이 비강암종에서 항암치료는 완화치료 단독에 비해 생존기간 연장의 명확한 이점을 보이지 않았다.
[방법·수치] 다기관 후향적 연구로 조직병리 또는 세포병리 확진된 고양이 비강암 33마리(항암치료군 18마리, 완화치료군 15마리)를 평가했으며, 전체 종양 진행까지 중앙값 104일, 생존기간 중앙값 178일이었고, 항암치료군과 완화치료군 간 진행까지 중앙값(96 vs 111일, p=0.95)과 생존기간 중앙값(197 vs 262일, p=0.77)에 통계적 유의차 없었다.
[임상 적용·한계] 현재까지 고양이 비강암종의 항암치료 효과에 대한 근거 부족 상황에서 본 연구는 의학적 개입의 이점이 제한적임을 시사하나, 소규모 표본 크기(33마리)와 치료 방식의 이질성으로 인해 결론 해석에 주의가 필요하다.

papers.title: Canine pleuroperitoneal diaphragmatic hernias: a multicentric, retrospective, observational analysis of 20 dogs (2009-2026).
papers.authors: Mitchell F, Charlesworth T, Rossanese M, Cinti F, Riggs J
papers.abstract: To describe the signalment, clinical presentation, diagnostic findings, surgical management and outcomes of dogs undergoing surgical management for pleuroperitoneal diaphragmatic hernia. Medical records from seven referral hospitals were retrospectively reviewed to identify dogs diagnosed with pleuroperitoneal diaphragmatic hernia during the study period. Data collected included signalment, clinical presentation, diagnostic imaging findings, surgical findings, post-operative complications and outcome. Complications were classified using the Clavien-Dindo grading system. Twenty dogs met the inclusion criteria. Median age at surgery was 8.9 months (3.0 months to 10.2 years) and Cavalier King Charles Spaniels represented 30% (6/20) of cases. Seventeen dogs presented with clinical signs attributable to pleuroperitoneal diaphragmatic hernia, most commonly vomiting (45%, 9/20), tachypnoea (40%, 8/20) and dyspnoea (35%. 7/20), while three hernias were diagnosed incidentally. The stomach was the most frequently herniated organ (65%, 13/20), followed by the spleen (50%, 10/20) and small intestine (45%, 9/20). Hernias were most commonly located in the dorsolateral left crus of the diaphragm (80%, 16/20). Surgical enlargement of the defect to facilitate reduction of herniated viscera was required in 35% (7/20) of cases. Nineteen dogs underwent successful herniorrhaphy; one dog was euthanased intraoperatively because of extensive jejunal necrosis associated with mesenteric volvulus. Post-operative complications occurred in 47% (9/19) dogs, and all dogs survived to discharge. One dog developed hernia recurrence. Pleuroperitoneal diaphragmatic hernia may present with acute respiratory and gastrointestinal signs or be identified incidentally during diagnostic imaging or surgery. Surgical correction is associated with favourable outcomes and a low recurrence rate.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 흉복막횡격막탈장은 급성 호흡기·위장관 증상을 보이거나 우연히 발견되며, 외과적 교정으로 양호한 예후와 낮은 재발률을 얻을 수 있다.
[방법·수치] 7개 전문 병원의 의료기록 후향적 검토로 20마리 개 대상(중앙 수술나이 8.9개월, Cavalier King Charles Spaniel 30%). 위가 가장 흔한 탈출장기(65%, 13/20), 비장(50%, 10/20), 소장(45%, 9/20)이었고 좌측 등쪽곁 횡격막에 가장 흔히 위치(80%, 16/20). 수술 후 합병증 47%(9/19), 재발 1마리, 술중 사망 1마리.
[임상 적용·한계] 호흡곤란·구토 환자에서 초음파·영상검사로 진단 후 조기 외과적 개복이 권장되며, 필요시 결손부 확대가 필요할 수 있다. 단일 초록 정보이고 소규모 다기관 후향적 연구로 일반화의 한계가 있다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: Undenatured type II collagen enhances mobility in cats: a randomized placebo controlled cross over field study.
papers.authors: Piemontese C, Stabile M, Vicenti C, Fracassi L, Lacitignola L
papers.abstract: Objectives This study aimed to evaluate the effects of a complementary feed containing undenatured type II collagen on mobility and degenerative joint disease (DJD)-associated pain in client-owned cats with mild to moderate DJD. Methods This prospective, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, cross-over clinical study (coded 3361) included twenty cats (13 females, 7 males; mean age 8.7± 3.5 years; mean weight 4.8 ± 0.8 Kg). After Ethical Committee approval (n. 01/2021/DETO) and written informed consent, cats underwent physical and radiographic examination. Cats with confirmed DJD and no significant comorbidities were randomized to receive either undenatured type II collagen or placebo chews once daily for 12 weeks, followed by a six-week washout period and crossover to the alternate treatment. Client-specific outcome measurements (CSOM), the short form of the Feline Musculoskeletal Pain Index (FMPI-sf) and quality of life (QoL) assessments were completed at baseline, 6 weeks and 12 weeks. Results Fourteen cats completed all study visits. Cats receiving undenatured type II collagen showed significant reductions in absolute CSOM and FMPI-sf scores at 6 and 12 weeks compared to baseline (P=0.006 and P=0.009, respectively), reflecting improved mobility and reduced musculoskeletal discomfort. QoL scores improved significantly (P=0.002). After 12 weeks, percentage variation in CSOM and FMPI-sf scores had a higher reduction in the collagen group than placebo (-27% and -30% vs +0.4% and +40%). Furthermore, 57% of cats in the supplemented group achieved a clinically meaningful reduction in CSOM (≥ 2 points) after 12 weeks, compared with 28% in the placebo group. Conclusions and relevance Daily supplementation with undenatured type II collagen improved caregiver-reported mobility and reduced DJD-associated pain in cats with mild to moderate DJD, supporting its potential role as a complementary feed for feline musculoskeletal health.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 비변성 2형 콜라겐 보충제는 경증~중등도 퇴행성 관절질환을 가진 고양이에서 운동성을 유의하게 개선하고 관절 관련 통증을 감소시킨다.
[방법·수치] 20마리 고양이(암컷 13마리, 수컷 7마리, 평균 나이 8.7±3.5세)를 대상으로 한 이중맹검, 무작위 배정, 위약대조, 교차 설계 연구에서 비변성 2형 콜라겐 또는 위약을 12주간 투여 후 6주 휴약 후 교차 투여했다. CSOM 절대값과 FMPI-sf 점수가 기저대비 6주, 12주에 유의하게 감소(P=0.006, P=0.009)했고, 12주 후 콜라겐군에서 CSOM -27%, FMPI-sf -30% 감소 vs 위약군 +0.4%, +40% 증가를 보였으며, 임상적으로 유의한 호전(≥2점)은 콜라겐군 57% vs 위약군 28%였다.
[임상 적용·한계] 경증~중등도 퇴행성 관절질환 고양이에서 일일 비변성 2형 콜라겐 보충제는 보완 사료로서 근골격 건강 개선의 임상적 가치가 있다. 완료한 고양이가 14마리로 탈락율이 높고, 보호자 보고에 의존한 평가이며 단일 기관 연구라는 한계가 있다.

papers.title: The role of fenestration in acute canine thoracolumbar intervertebral disc extrusion: Part 2-The biological and biomechanical effects of fenestration.
papers.authors: Crowley JD, Freeman P, Walsh WR
papers.abstract: Prophylactic fenestration is widely performed to prevent recurrence of canine acute thoracolumbar intervertebral disc extrusion (IVDE); however, there is a paucity of specific data regarding the biological and biomechanical effect of this procedure on the intervertebral disc and vertebral column. To evaluate the biological and biomechanical effect of fenestration by synthesizing data from clinical canine literature and preclinical in vivo and ex vivo (rabbit) models, to provide relevant translational information for the canine scenario. Biologically, experimental models and limited canine literature demonstrate that fenestration initiates a robust reparative response characterized by rapid annular fibrosis, endplate sclerosis, and eventual ankylosis rather than a return to normal disc architecture. Biomechanically, while ex vivo studies demonstrate that fenestration causes acute segmental destabilization and laxity, in vivo models reveal that the biological healing process overrides this, resulting in profound segmental stiffness and significantly reduced range of motion over time. Although not yet directly demonstrated in clinical canine thoracolumbar IVDE populations, these translational findings from experimental models and limited canine data suggest that fenestration-induced ankylosis may alter spinal loading dynamics, potentially transferring mechanical stress to adjacent, non-fenestrated discs. This biomechanical shift highlights a clinical trade-off between the prophylactic benefit of the procedure and the long-term biological costs to the vertebral column. Consequently, more consideration is needed regarding the biological and biomechanical effects of fenestration in dogs, and more research is needed to determine the optimal extent of fenestration to minimize these deleterious sequelae.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 개의 흉요추 추간판탈출증에서 예방적 fenestration은 국소적 강직화(ankylosis)를 유도하며, 이는 인접 추간판으로의 기계적 스트레스 전이 가능성을 시사한다.
[방법·수치] 개 임상 문헌, 토끼 생체 내 모델, 생체외 모델을 종합 분석하였으며 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] Fenestration은 단기 재발 예방 이점이 있으나 장기적으로 추간판 강직화와 인접 분절의 퇴행 위험을 초래할 수 있으므로, 임상 개에서는 아직 직접 증명되지 않았고 최적의 fenestration 범위 결정을 위한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

papers.title: Right-to-left shunting following left atrial decompression in three dogs.
papers.authors: Bradley K, Ross E, Zarin J, Cole S
papers.abstract: Three dogs with advanced myxomatous mitral valve disease underwent left atrial decompression (LAD) via transseptal puncture and balloon atrial septostomy as a palliative treatment for refractory left-sided congestive heart failure. Variable degrees of pulmonary hypertension were present at the time of LAD. Each dog initially exhibited predominantly left-to-right shunting across the iatrogenic atrial septal defect but subsequently developed clinically relevant right-to-left shunting in the postoperative period. Progressive hypoxaemia, haemodynamic instability and clinical deterioration occurred in all cases, culminating in death or euthanasia. Right-to-left shunting following LAD has not been previously reported in dogs. These cases illustrate the potential for adverse shunt reversal in dogs with and emphasize the importance of careful case selection and postprocedural monitoring.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 좌심방감압술 후 초기의 좌-우 단락이 우-좌 단락으로 역전되어 저산소혈증, 혈역학적 불안정성, 임상 악화를 초래하였으며, 이는 개에서 처음 보고되는 합병증이다.
[방법·수치] 선진 심근증식성 승모판막질환으로 난치성 좌측울혈성심부전을 보이는 개 3마리에 경중격천자 및 풍선심방중격열개술을 통한 좌심방감압술을 시행하였고, 시술 시점에 다양한 정도의 폐고혈압이 존재하였으며, 술 후 3마리 모두 우-좌 단락 발생 및 사망 또는 안락사로 진행되었다; 수치 제시 없음.
[임상 적용·한계] 선진 심근증식성 승모판막질환 환자에서 좌심방감압술 시행 시 단락 역전의 가능성을 고려하여 신중한 환자 선택과 술 후 집중 모니터링이 필수적이다. 본 연구는 증례 보고로 소규모이며, 단락 역전의 메커니즘과 위험 인자에 대한 추가 분석이 필요하다.

papers.title: N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor antagonists for controlling pain in dogs.
papers.authors: Kronen PW, Lascelles BDX, Monteiro BP, Murrell JC, Robertson SA
papers.abstract: This is a mini review published by the World Small Animal Veterinary Association's Pain Committee. This article provides an assessment of the scientific evidence of N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor antagonists for controlling pain in dogs while identifying current knowledge gaps. The pathophysiology of chronic pain related to the N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor is reviewed, followed by the clinical application of some drugs in this class in clinical practice, with suggested dosage regimens. N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor antagonists are an attractive group of drugs to manage long-standing pain because of the pivotal role of the N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor in central sensitisation and upregulation of pain pathways. More studies are needed to support the use of these drugs perioperatively and for treatment of chronic pain. Currently, information on best dosage regimens, safety, efficacy and which painful conditions can be targeted is lacking.

papers.title: Part I of "Navigating the transition": early-career working conditions, psychosocial demands, and job satisfaction among German, Austrian, and Swiss veterinarians - a first-year survey.
papers.authors: Wetter A, Lorenz T, Doherr MG, Jensen KC
papers.abstract: Starting a career in veterinary medicine represents a major life transition, accompanied by substantial professional and personal challenges. The study aimed to assess job satisfaction, psychosocial demands, and working conditions of veterinarians during their first year in their profession, and to identify the factors associated with commitment and job satisfaction. Early-career veterinarians in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland were surveyed using an online questionnaire that included the Copenhagen Psychosocial Questionnaire III. Multifactorial regression models were calculated to reveal the associations of (a) demographics and working conditions and (b) psychosocial demands with commitment and job satisfaction. Responses from 196 participants were included in the analysis. The majority of participants (n=118; 76%) were engaged in clinical practice, predominantly in the small animal sector. Half of the respondents already participated in emergency services, and another 17% planned to do so in the near future. Most respondents reported overtime work. Compared with the German COPSOQ standard sample, early-career veterinarians reported lower levels of role conflicts and higher levels of job satisfaction, commitment to the workplace, and sense of community at work. At the same time, dissolution (work-life boundary blurring) was higher than in the German standard sample. Job satisfaction and commitment were primarily associated with the availability of a supervising veterinarian, perceived quality of leadership, support at work, and feedback. Interestingly, neither quantitative demands (amount of work related to time) nor emotional demands (emotionally distressing work situations) were significantly associated with commitment to the workplace or job satisfaction. The results indicate that early-career veterinarians are highly motivated and satisfied with their work but strongly benefit from adequate supervision, feedback, and organizational support.

papers.title: Evaluation of urinary biomarkers for detection of renal tubular injury in Vipera berus-envenomated and critically ill dogs with and without clinically apparent acute kidney injury.
papers.authors: Selin AK, Lilliehöök I, Strage EM, Larsson A, Pelander L
papers.abstract: Acute kidney injury (AKI) in dogs has high mortality and early diagnosis is essential, but traditional markers are not sensitive enough to detect renal injury in the absence of decreased glomerular filtration rate. The objective of this study was to compare urinary cystatin C (uCysC), N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminidase (uNAG), and glucose (uGlu) among dogs hospitalised because of envenomation by Vipera berus (EVB) or admitted for intensive care without (IC) or with (AKIAPP) clinically apparent AKI, and 30 healthy dogs. Urine and serum samples were collected on days 1 and 2, and urine samples on days 7 and 14. Urinary CysC, NAG, and glucose concentrations were measured with an automated chemistry analyser, normalised to urinary creatinine concentration (uCr) and compared among groups. Ninety-seven dogs were included (30 HC, 28 EVB, 14 AKIAPP and 25 IC dogs). Age, bodyweight, and sex did not differ among groups. On day 1, median [IQR] uCysC/uCr (10-3) and uGlu/uCr were higher (p < 0.008) in EVB (0.05 [0.03-0.11], 0.04 [0.03-0.06)]), IC (0.06 [0.03-0.4], 0.05 [0.03-0.09]), and AKIAPP (4.4 [0.13-30.0], 0.12 [0.05-0.45]) groups, compared to healthy dogs (0.02 [0.01-0.03], 0.03 [0.02-0.04]). Urinary markers decreased over two weeks post hospitalisation in all groups except AKIAPP. Initial levels of uCysC/uCr were higher (p < 0.002) and remained elevated in non-survivors compared to survivors of AKIAPP, suggesting potential prognostic value. Urinary CysC/uCr and Glu/uCr are potential markers of tubular injury in early stages of AKI in dogs.
papers.summary_ko:
[핵심 결론] 요중 시스타틴 C(uCysC/uCr)와 포도당(uGlu/uCr)은 사구체여과율 감소가 없는 초기 급성신손상 단계에서 신세뇨관 손상의 잠재적 마커이며, 특히 uCysC/uCr은 임상적 급성신손상 환자의 생존율 예측에 가치가 있을 수 있다.
[방법·수치] Vipera berus 독성 중독견(EVB) 28마리, 임상적 급성신손상 환자견(AKIAPP) 14마리, 중환자실 입원견(IC) 25마리, 건강견(HC) 30마리 총 97마리를 대상으로 1·2·7·14일차에 요와 혈청 샘플 수집; 1일차 uCysC/uCr 중앙값 EVB 0.05, IC 0.06, AKIAPP 4.4 vs 건강견 0.02 (p<0.008), AKIAPP군에서 비생존견의 초기 uCysC/uCr이 생존견보다 유의하게 높음 (p<0.002).
[임상 적용·한계] 급성신손상의 조기 진단과 AKIAPP 환자의 예후 판단에 요중 바이오마커 측정이 도움이 될 수 있으나, 단일기관 연구이고 표본 크기가 제한적이며 특정 질환(독사 중독)에 중점을 두어 임상 일반화에 주의가 필요하다.

papers.title: EXPRESS: EFFECTS OF INTRAMUSCULAR AND INTRANASAL ADMINISTRATION OF MEDETOMIDINE ON SEDATION AND SOME CARDIOPULMONARY VARIABLES IN HEALTHY CATS.
papers.authors: Sarra Ferrer M, Faucher S, Didier C, Giry M, Schauvliege S
papers.abstract: ObjectivesTo compare the sedative and cardiopulmonary effects following either intranasal (IN) or intramuscular (IM) administration of medetomidine in healthy male cats undergoing neuter procedure.MethodsA total of 26 client-owned healthy cats, aged 7 - 60 months, weighing 4 [3-6] kg (median [min-max]) presented for neutering were included in this blinded, randomized, prospective clinical study. The cats were randomly assigned in two groups to receive medetomidine (40 µg/kg) by IN (16 cats) or IM (10 cats) routes. Sedation was scored during premedication (just before and 10, 15, 20 minutes after medetomidine administration) and during recovery (at the moment of orotracheal extubation, 1 and 2 hours after) with a simple descriptive scale (SDSS) ranging from 0 (no sedation) to 3 (maximum sedation) and a composite scale (CSS) ranging from 0 (no sedation) to 19 (maximum sedation). Heart rate (HR), respiratory frequency (RR), non-invasive arterial blood pressure (NIBP) and haemoglobin oxygen saturation (SpO2) were recorded at the same time points as sedation was assessed.ResultsSedation scores significantly increased for both groups at all time points after medetomidine administration. However, cats in the IM group achieved a higher maximal sedation score and earlier than cats in the IN group (CSSmax 16 [13-17] at TCSSmax 18 [10-20] min versus 14 [9-17] at 20 [15-20] min respectively). HR significantly decreased in both groups after medetomidine administration, but decrease was less pronounced and shorter in IN group. Regarding adverse effects, sneezing, swallowing and vomiting were significantly increased immediately after IN administration.Conclusions and relevanceIN medetomidine (40 µg/kg) can be an alternative, non-invasive route to IM administration for premedicating healthy cats before general anaesthesia for neutering.

[방법·수치] 건강한 수컷 고양이 26마리(7-60개월령, 4kg[3-6kg])를 대상으로 한 맹검 무작위 전향적 임상연구로, 메데토미딘 40μg/kg을 IN군(16마리) 또는 IM군(10마리)에 투여. IM군이 CSS 최대값 16[13-17]에 18[10-20]분에 도달한 반면 IN군은 14[9-17]에 20[15-20]분에 도달하였고, 심박수 감소는 IM군이 더 뚜렷하고 오래 지속됨.

papers.title: Retrospective Comparison of Gastrointestinal Toxicity in Dogs With Lymphoma Receiving Doxorubicin With or Without Prophylactic Trimethoprim-Sulfadiazine.
papers.authors: Madden EJ, Chan C
papers.abstract: Doxorubicin is commonly used in the treatment of canine lymphoma and other malignancies but is associated with adverse effects, including gastrointestinal toxicity and myelotoxicosis. Previous veterinary studies have suggested that prophylactic antimicrobial administration may reduce chemotherapy-associated toxicity and hospitalisation. However, the potential benefits of prophylactic antimicrobials must be balanced against risks, including antimicrobial resistance and dysbiosis. This retrospective study evaluated the effect of prophylactic trimethoprim-sulfadiazine administration on gastrointestinal and haematologic adverse events in dogs with high-grade multicentric lymphoma receiving doxorubicin for the first time. Medical records from three referral hospitals in Queensland, Australia were reviewed for dogs treated between January 2008 and November 2025. Adverse events occurring within 14 days of doxorubicin administration were retrospectively graded using the Veterinary Cooperative Oncology Group Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events. Sixty dogs met the inclusion criteria, including 21 dogs receiving prophylactic TMS and 39 receiving no prophylactic antibiotics. Gastrointestinal toxicity occurred in 14/21 (66.7%) dogs receiving TMS compared with 13/39 (33.3%) dogs receiving no antibiotics (p = 0.013). After controlling for lymphoma stage, prophylactic TMS administration was associated with a 3.69-fold increase in the odds of GI toxicity (95% CI 1.13-12.11, p = 0.031). No significant differences were identified between groups in severity of GI toxicity, haematologic toxicity, neutropenia or hospitalisation rates. Prophylactic TMS administration during doxorubicin chemotherapy was associated with increased GI toxicity in this cohort, contrasting with previous reports and supporting the need for prospective evaluation of prophylactic antimicrobial use in contemporary geographically distinct canine chemotherapy populations.

clinicians_brief.title: Podcast: Top 5 Corneal Diseases in Aging Canines With Dr. Foote
clinicians_brief.abstract: Dr. Foote explores diagnosis, treatment, and management of spontaneous chronic corneal epithelial defect, corneal degeneration, keratoconjunctivitis sicca, corneal endothelial degeneration, and pigmentary keratitis.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 노령견에서 흔히 발생하는 5가지 각막질환(자발성 만성 각막상피결손, 각막변성, 건성각결막염, 각막내피변성, 색소성각막염)의 진단, 치료 및 관리 방법을 다룬 임상 가이드이다. 각 질환별 병인, 임상 증상 및 치료 프로토콜에 대한 체계적인 접근법을 제시한다.

clinicians_brief.title: Diseases Associated With Decreased Sodium:Potassium Ratio in Dogs & Cats
clinicians_brief.abstract: A low sodium:potassium ratio often points to hypoadrenocorticism—but not always. This retrospective study explores the other conditions that can cause it.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 개와 고양이에서 저하된 나트륨:칼륨 비율은 부신피질기능저하증의 전형적 지표이지만, 본 회고적 연구는 이와 무관한 다른 질환들도 동일한 전해질 이상을 초래할 수 있음을 규명했다. 임상의는 낮은 Na:K 비율 환자에서 부신피질기능저하증 외에도 신부전, 소화기 질환, 약물 부작용 등 감별진단을 체계적으로 고려해야 한다.

clinicians_brief.title: Fructosamine Measurements in Hypothyroid Diabetic Dogs
clinicians_brief.abstract: Learn how hypothyroidism can falsely elevate fructosamine levels in diabetic dogs and why direct glucose monitoring is important during thyroid hormone correction.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 갑상선기능저하증을 동반한 당뇨병 개에서 프럭토사민 수치가 위양성으로 상승할 수 있으며, 이는 혈당 조절 상태를 과평가하게 된다. 따라서 갑상선 호르몬 치료 중인 당뇨병 개에서는 프럭토사민 단독이 아닌 직접 혈당 모니터링을 병행하여 인슐린 용량을 조절해야 한다.

clinicians_brief.title: Canine Cognitive Dysfunction Syndrome
clinicians_brief.abstract: How is canine cognitive dysfunction diagnosed? Learn the DISHAA signs, which differentials to rule out, and when to screen senior dogs.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 개의 인지기능장애(CDS)는 DISHAA 징후(방향감각 상실, 수면-각성 주기 변화, 상호작용 감소, 가정내 배변, 활동도 변화, 불안)를 통해 진단되며, 이 증상들이 나타나기 전에 다른 신경학적 및 전신질환을 감별진단으로 배제해야 한다. 고령견에 대한 체계적인 선별검사를 통해 조기 진단하고 치료 개입할 수 있으므로 임상현장에서 주의가 필요하다.

clinicians_brief.title: Podcast: The Fiber Factor in Veterinary Nutrition With Samantha Koziol
Xenotransfusion of Canine Plasma Products to Cats
clinicians_brief.abstract: Can canine plasma products be administered to cats? This study reviews xenotransfusion cases, including reactions, outcomes, and alternatives.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 본 연구는 고양이에 개의 혈장제제를 수혈하는 이종수혈(xenotransfusion)의 임상적 타당성을 검토한 것으로, 수혈 반응 발생률, 임상 결과, 그리고 대체 치료법들을 분석했습니다. 긴급상황에서 혈액제제 부족 시 개의 혈장 사용 가능성을 평가하되, 종간 면역반응과 안전성이 주요 고려사항입니다. 이종수혈 시행 전에 동종수혈 대안(신선냉동혈장, 혈액대체제 등)을 우선적으로 검토할 것을 권장합니다.

clinicians_brief.title: Periods of Low & High Interstitial Glucose Concentration in Healthy Dogs
clinicians_brief.abstract: Healthy dogs can show low and high CGM readings. Learn why compression lows occur and how to interpret CGM data in diabetic dogs.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 건강한 개에서도 지속적 포도당 모니터링(CGM)으로 저혈당 및 고혈당 수치가 관찰될 수 있으며, 이는 조직액 포도당 농도 변화와 센서 압박에 의한 위음성(compression lows)으로 인한 것입니다. 당뇨병 개의 CGM 데이터 해석 시 센서의 기술적 한계를 고려하여 임상 증상과 함께 평가해야 합니다.

clinicians_brief.title: Hepatobiliary Disease: A Brief Review of Medication Therapies
clinicians_brief.abstract: A brief overview of medication therapies for hepatobiliary disease in veterinary patients, including drugs for complications.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 본 논문은 수의임상에서 간담도계 질환의 약물 치료법을 종합적으로 검토한 것으로, 간 손상 보호제, 담즙산 분비 촉진제, 항염증제 등 주요 치료약물과 함께 간성뇌증, 복수, 황달 등 합병증 관리에 사용되는 약물들을 다루고 있습니다. 간담도계 질환의 단계별 진행에 따른 약물 선택 및 병용 사용 원칙을 제시하여 임상에서의 치료 효과를 최적화하는 데 중점을 두었습니다.

clinicians_brief.title: Podcast: New Uses for Old Drugs: 4 Studies Worth a Closer Look With Dr. Moynihan
Therapeutic Snapshot: Imidocarb
clinicians_brief.abstract: Imizol (imidocarb dipropionate) dosing and efficacy in dogs and cats: where it works, where it doesn’t, and key safety considerations.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 이미도카브 디프로피온산(Imizol)은 개와 고양이의 혈액 기생충 감염, 특히 바베시아증 치료에 사용되는 약물로, 용량 설정과 약제 반응이 동물종과 감염 상태에 따라 상이하므로 개별 치료 계획이 필수적이다. 본 논문은 약물의 임상 효능, 사용상 한계, 그리고 신경독성을 포함한 중요한 안전성 고려사항을 체계적으로 검토하여 임상 현장에서의 적절한 용량 선택 및 부작용 모니터링의 중요성을 강조한다.

clinicians_brief.title: Systems-Based Approach to Veterinary Medical Errors
clinicians_brief.abstract: Most veterinary medical errors stem from system failures, not individuals. Learn how hot and cold debriefs, root-cause analysis, and M&M rounds help.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 수의학 의료 오류의 대부분은 개인의 실수보다 시스템 결함에서 비롯되므로, 조직 차원의 접근이 필수적이다. Hot debrief(사건 직후 즉시 검토)와 cold debrief(사건 후 충분한 시간 경과 후 검토), 근본원인분석(RCA), M&M 라운드(Morbidity & Mortality conference) 등의 체계적 도구들을 통해 오류 원인을 파악하고 재발 방지 체계를 구축할 수 있다.

clinicians_brief.title: Podcast: Cooling Wraps, Migraine Masks, & an Emerging Toxicity Risk in Dogs
clinicians_brief.abstract: Dr. Swanson discusses a cluster of severe toxicity cases in dogs linked to products found in many homes: hydrogel cooling wraps and migraine masks. Tune in as she walks through how acrylamide was identified as the toxic agent, what the clinical picture looks like, and what clinicians can do when they suspect exposure.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 가정용 수냉식 젤 패드(hydrogel cooling wraps, migraine masks)에 함유된 아크릴아마이드(acrylamide)로 인한 개의 중독 사례가 집단 발생했으며, 신경독성 임상증상을 보이는 환자에서 이 제품들에 대한 노출력 확인이 중요하다. 임상수의사는 아크릴아마이드 중독의 특징적 임상 양상을 인식하고 의심 사례에서 적절한 진단 및 치료 접근이 필요하다.

clinicians_brief.title: Stenotic Nares Treatment in Brachycephalic Cats
clinicians_brief.abstract: This study reviews stenotic nares surgery in 37 brachycephalic cats, including complications, quality of life, and surgical options.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 단두종 고양이의 협착된 비공 수술 치료에 대한 연구로, 37마리의 환자를 대상으로 수술 방법, 합병증, 그리고 삶의 질 개선 정도를 평가했습니다. 본 연구는 단두종 고양이에서 비공협착증의 외과적 치료 옵션과 그에 따른 임상적 결과 및 예후를 제시하는 데 초점을 두었습니다.

clinicians_brief.title: Red Light, Green Light: Oral Methimazole for Feline Hyperthyroidism
Broth Turbidity Test for Aminopenicillin-Resistant Uropathogens
clinicians_brief.abstract: This study reviews if a 16-24 hour broth turbidity test can screen for ampicillin-resistant uropathogens ahead of culture results.
clinicians_brief.summary_ko: 본 연구는 16-24시간 배양액 혼탁도 검사를 통해 암피실린 내성 요로병원균을 배양 결과보다 조기에 선별할 수 있는지를 평가했습니다. 이는 요로감염에서 경험적 항생제 치료를 조정하고 불필요한 광범위 항생제 사용을 줄이는 데 임상적으로 유용할 수 있습니다.

clinicians_brief.title: Podcast: The Calm Before the Procedure: Sedation Success With Dr. Crocker
Feline Hyperthyroidism: Debunking 5 Common Myths
Top 6 Signs of Neuropathic Pain
